source_blocks.source_text_en: What to do if a complaint is filed against you
source_blocks.text: What to do if a complaint is filed against you

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State Department of Motor Vehicles regulates all repair shops, inspection stations, dealers, vehicle dismantlers and other related businesses in NYS. To legally operate as such a business, you must register with DMV. Once your application is approved you will receive a certificate from DMV. A copy of the Commissioner's Regulations that pertain to your type of business may be found on the DMV web site at dmv.ny.gov [1]. They will explain your responsibilities to consumers. You must follow all consumer protection laws and regulations.

A copy of the Commissioner's Regulations that pertain to your type of business may be found on the DMV web site at dmv.ny.gov [1]. They will explain your responsibilities to consumers. You must follow all consumer protection laws and regulations.

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV advises all consumers who have a complaint against a dealer, inspection station, repair shop, or dismantler to make an attempt to resolve their complaint with the business manager. If they are not successful, they are advised to contact the DMV Consumer & Facilities Services Complaint Unit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Complaint Process
source_blocks.text: The Complaint Process

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a complaint has been filed against you, a Consumer Services Rep from DMV will contact you in an attempt to resolve this complaint. The CSR will explain the nature of the complaint and will also inform you of your rights, responsibilities, and your liability. If the complaint is not resolved with the CSR, the case will be sent to an Automotive Facilities Inspector (AFI) for a formal investigation.

If the waiver is accepted, no hearing is required. If the offer is rejected, a hearing must be held.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are entitled to hire an attorney and to bring that attorney to the hearing. The Department of Motor Vehicles is the petitioner is this case and the complainant may be a witness for the case.

You will have 30 days from the date of the order by the judge to pay your fine or penalty.

source_blocks.text: 关于对检测站和认证检查员的投诉与收费

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are looking to file a complaint against an inspection station or certified inspector, please report a problem with a DMV regulated automotive business [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您想对检测站或认证检查员提出投诉，请举报与DMV监管的汽车业务相关的问题 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complaint filed against you or your business
source_blocks.text: 针对您或您的企业提出的投诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) regulates all repair shops, inspection stations, dealers, vehicle dismantlers and other related businesses in New York. To legally operate as such a business, you must register with the DMV. Once your application is approved you will receive a certificate from the DMV. You will also receive a copy of the Commissioner's Regulations that pertain to your type of business. They will explain your responsibilities to consumers. You must follow all consumer protection laws and regulations.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车管理局（DMV）监管纽约州所有修理厂、检测站、经销商、车辆拆解商及其他相关企业。要合法经营此类业务，您必须在DMV注册。申请获批后，您将收到DMV颁发的证书，同时也会收到一份与您业务类型相关的《专员条例》副本，其中会说明您对消费者的责任。您必须遵守所有消费者保护法律和法规。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV advises all consumers who have a complaint against a dealer, inspection station, repair shop, or dismantler to make an attempt to resolve their complaint with the business manager. If they are not successful, they are advised to contact the DMV Consumer & Facilities Services Complaint Unit.
source_blocks.text: DMV建议所有对经销商、检测站、修理厂或拆解商有投诉的消费者，先尝试与业务经理解决问题。若未能解决，建议联系DMV消费者与设施服务投诉部门。

source_blocks.source_text_en: protect your business: keep a copy of all work orders in an easy-to-access location
source_blocks.text: 保护您的业务：将所有工单副本存放在易于取用的位置

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complaint process
source_blocks.text: 投诉流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a complaint has been filed against you, a Consumer Services Representative (CSR) from the DMV will contact you in an attempt to resolve this complaint. The CSR will explain the nature of the complaint and will also inform you of your rights, responsibilities, and your liability. If the complaint is not resolved with the CSR, the case will be sent to an Automotive Facilities Inspector (AFI) for a formal investigation.
source_blocks.text: 如果针对您的投诉已提交，DMV的消费者服务代表（CSR）将与您联系以尝试解决该投诉。CSR会说明投诉性质，并告知您的权利、责任及应承担的法律责任。若投诉未能通过CSR解决，案件将转交给汽车设施检查员（AFI）进行正式调查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: avoid costly penalties, fines, and the loss of valuable customers by responding to all DMV inquiries in a timely manner
source_blocks.text: 及时回应所有DMV问询，以避免昂贵的罚款、处罚及失去宝贵客户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Investigation process
source_blocks.text: 调查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: The AFI will conduct a formal investigation. The result may be no action, a warning letter (Notice of Investigation) placed in your file, or a formal administrative hearing before an Administrative Law Judge (ALJ). When Vehicle Safety initiates the hearing process, you may be offered the opportunity through a "hearing waiver" to admit to the charges and to either pay a specified monetary penalty and/or to accept a suspension. If the waiver is accepted, no hearing is required. If the offer is rejected, a hearing must be held.
source_blocks.text: AFI将进行正式调查。结果可能是不采取行动、将警告信（调查通知）存入您的档案，或由行政法法官（ALJ）主持正式行政听证。当车辆安全部门启动听证程序时，您可能会收到通过“听证弃权书”承认指控并支付特定罚款和/或接受停业处罚的机会。若接受弃权，则无需听证；若拒绝，则必须举行听证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The result of the hearing may be no action, a civil penalty, and/or a suspension or revocation of your ability to operate as a vehicle related business in New York State. You may also be offered the opportunity to pay restitution to the consumer in lieu of the fines and/or penalties, or to have the penalty reduced.
source_blocks.text: 听证结果可能是不采取行动、民事罚款，和/或暂停或撤销您在纽约州经营车辆相关业务的资格。您也可能有机会向消费者支付赔偿金以代替罚款和/或处罚，或获得减轻处罚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hearing process
source_blocks.text: 听证流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are entitled to hire an attorney and to bring that attorney to the hearing. The DMV is the petitioner is this case and the complainant may be a witness for the case.
source_blocks.text: 您有权聘请律师并带其出席听证。在此案中，DMV是申诉方，投诉人可能作为证人出庭。

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a result of the hearing, the ALJ may sustain some, all, or none of the charges. There may be no action, a warning, the imposition of a suspension, revocation, and/or civil penalties. If the ALJ only imposes civil penalties, in order to prevent the loss of your operating privilege, you must pay all fines and penalties. You will receive a letter from the DMV shortly after the hearing. You will have 30 days from the date of the order by the judge to pay your fine or penalty.
source_blocks.text: 听证结束后，ALJ可能维持部分、全部或全部不维持指控。结果可能是不采取行动、警告、暂停、撤销和/或民事罚款。若ALJ仅处以民事罚款，为防止失去经营资格，您必须支付所有罚款和处罚。听证后不久，您将收到DMV的信函，需在法官裁决之日起30天内支付罚款或处罚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Failure to pay any fines or penalties or to serve out your suspension will result in indefinite suspension of your business certificate and the possible assessment of a lien against your business. However, if you pay your fine and/or penalty or serve out your period of suspension, you will be back in business after complete compliance. If you are revoked, you must surrender all supplies and cease to operate.
source_blocks.text: 未能支付任何罚款或处罚或未执行停业处罚，将导致您的营业执照无限期暂停，并可能对您的企业进行留置权评估。但是，若您支付罚款和/或处罚或完成停业期，完全合规后即可恢复营业。若被撤销资格，您必须交出所有用品并停止运营。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the right to appeal any adverse decision. If you chose to appeal, you have 60 days from the date of the ALJs decision to file the Appeal From DMV Hearing Determination (PDF) [2] (AA-33A), which must be accompanied by the appropriate filing fee.
source_blocks.text: 您有权对任何不利决定提出上诉。若选择上诉，需在ALJ裁决之日起60天内提交《DMV听证决定上诉书》（PDF）[2]（AA-33A），并附上相应的申请费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your facility license, registration or certification enables you to operate in New York State. Complaints filed and charges brought against you can result in the loss of your privilege to operate as a business here.
source_blocks.text: 您的设施许可证、注册或认证使您能够在纽约州运营。针对您提出的投诉和指控可能导致您失去在此经营业务的资格。

source_blocks.text: DMV建议所有对经销商、检测站、维修店或拆解商有投诉的消费者先尝试与业务经理解决问题。若未能解决，建议联系DMV消费者与设施服务投诉部门。

source_blocks.source_text_en: protect your business: keep a copy of all work orders in an easy-to-access location
source_blocks.text: 保护您的业务：将所有工单副本存放在易于查找的位置

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complaint process
source_blocks.text: 投诉流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a complaint has been filed against you, a Consumer Services Representative from the DMV will contact you in an attempt to resolve this complaint. The CSR will explain the nature of the complaint and will also inform you of your rights, responsibilities, and your liability. If the complaint is not resolved with the CSR, the case will be sent to an Automotive Facilities Inspector (AFI) for a formal investigation.
source_blocks.text: 如果针对您的投诉已提交，DMV的消费者服务代表（CSR）将与您联系以尝试解决该投诉。CSR会说明投诉性质，并告知您的权利、责任及赔偿责任。若投诉未能通过CSR解决，案件将转交汽车设施检查员（AFI）进行正式调查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: avoid costly penalties, fines, and the loss of valuable customers by responding to all DMV inquiries in a timely manner
source_blocks.text: 及时回应所有DMV问询，以避免昂贵的罚款、罚金及失去宝贵客户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Investigation process
source_blocks.text: 调查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: The AFI will conduct a formal investigation. The result may be no action, a warning letter (Notice of Investigation) placed in your file, or a formal administrative hearing before an Administrative Law Judge (ALJ). When Vehicle Safety initiates the hearing process, you may be offered the opportunity through a "hearing waiver" to admit to the charges and to either pay a specified monetary penalty and/or to accept a suspension. If the waiver is accepted, no hearing is required. If the offer is rejected, a hearing must be held.
source_blocks.text: AFI将进行正式调查。结果可能是不采取行动、将警告信（调查通知）存入您的档案，或由行政法法官（ALJ）主持正式行政听证。当车辆安全部门启动听证程序时，您可能有机会通过“听证豁免”承认指控，并支付特定金额的罚款和/或接受停业处罚。若接受豁免，则无需听证；若拒绝，则必须举行听证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The result of the hearing may be no action, a civil penalty, and/or a suspension or revocation of your ability to operate as a vehicle related business in New York State. You may also be offered the opportunity to pay restitution to the consumer instead of the fines and/or penalties, or to have the penalty reduced.
source_blocks.text: 听证结果可能是不采取行动、民事罚款，和/或暂停或撤销您在纽约州经营车辆相关业务的资格。您也可能有机会向消费者支付赔偿金以代替罚款和/或处罚，或减轻处罚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hearing process
source_blocks.text: 听证流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are entitled to hire an attorney and to bring that attorney to the hearing. The DMV is the petitioner is this case and the complainant may be a witness for the case.
source_blocks.text: 您有权聘请律师并带其出席听证。在此案中，DMV为申诉方，投诉人可能作为证人出庭。

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a result of the hearing, the ALJ may sustain some, all, or none of the charges. There may be no action, a warning, the imposition of a suspension, revocation, and/or civil penalties. If the ALJ only imposes civil penalties, in order to prevent the loss of your operating privilege, you must pay all fines and penalties. You will receive a letter from DMV shortly after the hearing. You will have 30 days from the date of the order by the judge to pay your fine or penalty.
source_blocks.text: 听证结束后，ALJ可能维持部分、全部或全部不维持指控。结果可能是不采取行动、警告、暂停、撤销和/或民事罚款。若ALJ仅处以民事罚款，为防止失去经营资格，您必须支付所有罚款和罚金。听证后不久，您将收到DMV的信函，需在法官裁决之日起30天内支付罚款或罚金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Failure to pay any fines or penalties or to serve out your suspension will result in indefinite suspension of your business certificate and the possible assessment of a lien against your business. However, if you pay your fine and/or penalty or serve out your period of suspension, you will be back in business after complete compliance. If you are revoked, you must surrender all supplies and cease to operate.
source_blocks.text: 未能支付任何罚款或罚金或未执行停业处罚将导致您的营业执照无限期暂停，并可能对您的企业设定留置权。但若您支付罚款和/或罚金或完成停业期，完全合规后即可恢复经营。若被撤销资格，您必须交出所有物资并停止运营。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the right to appeal any adverse decision. If you chose to appeal, you have 60 days from the date of the ALJs decision to file the Appeal From DMV Hearing Determination (PDF) [2] (AA-33A), which must be accompanied by the appropriate filing fee.
source_blocks.text: 您有权对任何不利决定提出上诉。若选择上诉，需在ALJ裁决之日起60天内提交《DMV听证决定上诉书》（PDF）[2]（AA-33A），并附上相应申请费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your facility license, registration or certification enables you to operate in New York State. Complaints filed and charges brought against you can result in the loss of your privilege to operate as a business here.
source_blocks.text: 您的设施许可证、注册或认证使您能够在纽约州经营。针对您提出的投诉和指控可能导致您失去在此经营业务的资格。

documents.source_title_en: About New York State Inspections
documents.title: 关于纽约州车辆检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: About New York State Inspections
source_blocks.text: 关于纽约州车辆检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you need a safety inspection
source_blocks.text: 何时需要进行安全检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: All vehicles registered in New York State must get a safety inspection at a DMV-licensed inspection station
source_blocks.text: 所有在纽约州注册的车辆必须在DMV授权的检查站进行安全检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: every 12 months when the ownership of the vehicle is transferred
source_blocks.text: 每12个月 当车辆所有权转移时

source_blocks.source_text_en: A valid inspection sticker must be displayed on your vehicle. Inspections expire the last day of the month punched on the inspection sticker.
source_blocks.text: 车辆上必须展示有效的检查贴纸。检查的有效期至检查贴纸上打孔月份的最后一天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle does not have a valid inspection
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆没有有效的检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: you cannot renew the registration 1 you can receive a fine 2 you can receive a parking ticket 3
source_blocks.text: 您将无法更新注册 1 您可能会被罚款 2 您可能会收到停车罚单 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: Emissions inspection
source_blocks.text: 排放检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most vehicles must also get an emissions inspection (or diesel emissions inspection [1]) at the time of the safety inspection. 4
source_blocks.text: 大多数车辆在安全检查时还必须进行排放检查（或柴油排放检查 [1]）。 4

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the New York Vehicle Inspection Program [2] (NYVIP2) page. You can find additional information in these brochures
source_blocks.text: 请参阅纽约车辆检查计划 [2] (NYVIP2) 页面。您可以在以下手册中找到更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Vehicle Safety/Emissions Inspection Program For Cars and Light Trucks [3] [4] (C-50) A Consumer Guide to Readiness Monitor Failures as Part of the New York State Vehicle Inspection Program [5] (C-114)
source_blocks.text: 纽约州汽车和轻型卡车车辆安全/排放检查计划 [3] [4] (C-50) 纽约州车辆检查计划中就绪监视器故障的消费者指南 [5] (C-114)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find an inspection station
source_blocks.text: 查找检查站

source_blocks.source_text_en: Licensed stations display a yellow and black sign that reads, 'Official Inspection Station.' Motorcycle inspection stations display a blue and orange sign.
source_blocks.text: 持牌检查站会展示黄黑相间的标志，上面写着“官方检查站”。摩托车检查站则展示蓝橙相间的标志。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find an inspection station near you [6]
source_blocks.text: 查找您附近的检查站 [6]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fees
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the Inspection Groups and Fee Chart (PDF) [7] (VS-77).
source_blocks.text: 请参阅检查类别和费用表 (PDF) [7] (VS-77)。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is checked
source_blocks.text: 检查内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV brochure, New York State Vehicle Safety/Emissions Inspection Program for Cars and Light Trucks [3] (C-50) lists the equipment items checked during a safety inspection, and a description of the safety inspection.
source_blocks.text: DMV手册《纽约州汽车和轻型卡车车辆安全/排放检查计划》 [3] (C-50) 列出了安全检查期间检查的设备项目，并描述了安全检查的内容。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I bought a vehicle from a dealer
source_blocks.text: 我从经销商处购买了车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: The dealer must have the vehicle inspected within 30 days of the date of sale and prior to delivery.
source_blocks.text: 经销商必须在销售日期后30天内且在交付前对车辆进行检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I bought a vehicle from a private seller (not a dealer)
source_blocks.text: 我从私人卖家（非经销商）处购买了车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you buy or get a vehicle from someone other than a dealer registered with the New York State DMV, you will receive an inspection extension that will last 10 days from the date of the registration.
source_blocks.text: 如果您从纽约州DMV注册的经销商以外的其他人处购买或获得车辆，您将获得一个检查延期，该延期自注册之日起持续10天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An inspection issued to the previous registrant is not valid.
source_blocks.text: 发给前一位注册人的检查无效。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I have moved to New York and registered my vehicle here
source_blocks.text: 我已搬到纽约并在此注册了我的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle was registered in another state which issues an inspection sticker, you do not need to have your vehicle inspected immediately. Your out-of-state inspection remains valid until it expires or for one year after the registration date, whichever comes first. When your out-of-state inspection expires, you must get a New York State vehicle inspection.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆是在另一个发放检查贴纸的州注册的，您不需要立即对车辆进行检查。您的外州检查在到期前或注册日期后一年内（以先到者为准）仍然有效。当您的外州检查到期时，您必须进行纽约州车辆检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the previous inspection was performed in a jurisdiction that does not issue an inspection sticker, you must have your vehicle inspected in New York.
source_blocks.text: 如果之前的检查是在不发放检查贴纸的司法管辖区进行的，您必须在纽约对车辆进行检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I need an extension (I am not in New York right now)
source_blocks.text: 我需要延期（我现在不在纽约）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are out of state when your inspection will expire, you can apply for an extension. First, determine if an expired out-of-state inspection is a violation of law in that state. Ask the authorities if a New York State inspection extension sticker prevents a ticket for the violation. The extension allows you 10 days from the date the vehicle returns to New York State to get an inspection.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在检查到期时不在州内，您可以申请延期。首先，确定过期的外州检查在该州是否违法。询问当局纽约州检查延期贴纸是否能防止因违规而被开罚单。延期允许您在车辆返回纽约州之日起10天内进行检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Allow 14 days for the DMV to process and mail your extension sticker. You will need it before you return your vehicle to New York.
source_blocks.text: 请留出14天时间让DMV处理并邮寄您的延期贴纸。在您将车辆返回纽约之前，您需要它。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To receive an extension, mail this information
source_blocks.text: 要获得延期，请邮寄以下信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: your name and current out-of-state mailing address the year and make of your vehicle the vehicle plate number the inspection sticker number and expiration date
source_blocks.text: 您的姓名和当前外州邮寄地址 您车辆的年份和品牌 车辆牌照号 检查贴纸编号和到期日期

source_blocks.source_text_en: to
source_blocks.text: 至

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS DMVBureau of Consumer and Facility ServicesInspection ExtensionP.O. Box 2700-ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0700
source_blocks.text: NYS DMV消费者和设施服务局检查延期P.O. Box 2700-ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0700

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you receive your extension sticker, do not put it on your windshield while your vehicle is out of state. Keep the sticker and the instructions in your vehicle to show to an out-of-state police officer. The sticker is not a guarantee that a police officer will not issue you a traffic ticket.
source_blocks.text: 当您收到延期贴纸时，在您的车辆还在外州时不要将其贴在挡风玻璃上。将贴纸和说明放在车内，以便向外州警察出示。贴纸并不保证警察不会给您开交通罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There will be no record of an inspection on New York State DMV records. You cannot renew the registration if there is no DMV record of an inspection within the past 12 months. If you must renew the registration before you get a New York State inspection, call 518-486-9786.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州DMV记录中将没有检查记录。如果在过去12个月内没有DMV的检查记录，您无法续签注册。如果您必须在获得纽约州检查之前续签注册，请致电518-486-9786。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you return your vehicle to New York State
source_blocks.text: 在您将车辆返回纽约州后

source_blocks.source_text_en: write the date the vehicle returned to New York on the extension sticker attach the sticker to your windshield get your vehicle inspected within 10 days
source_blocks.text: 在延期标签上写上车辆返回纽约的日期 将标签贴在挡风玻璃上 在10天内让您的车辆接受检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: The inspection sticker came off my vehicle
source_blocks.text: 检查标签从我的车辆上脱落了

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can attach it to the windshield again with clear tape or a small amount of clear adhesive. Remember that an inspection station must be able to remove the sticker during your next inspection.
source_blocks.text: 您可以用透明胶带或少量透明粘合剂将其重新贴在挡风玻璃上。请记住，在下次检查时，检查站必须能够取下该标签。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the sticker is not usable, you can have your vehicle re-inspected or you can order a replacement sticker using the form Request for Replacement Inspection Sticker (PDF) [8] (VS-118). Complete the form and mail it to the address on the form.
source_blocks.text: 如果标签无法使用，您可以重新检查车辆，或使用《更换检查标签申请表》（PDF）[8]（VS-118）订购替换标签。填写表格并邮寄至表格上的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I need to replace the inspection sticker
source_blocks.text: 我需要更换检查标签

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can have your vehicle re-inspected or you can order a replacement sticker using the form Request for Replacement Inspection Sticker (PDF) [8] (VS-118). Complete the form and mail it to the address on the form.
source_blocks.text: 您可以重新检查车辆，或使用《更换检查标签申请表》（PDF）[8]（VS-118）订购替换标签。填写表格并邮寄至表格上的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Inspection stations electronically send a record of all emissions inspections to the DMV. The DMV must have a record that your vehicle passed an emissions inspection during the previous year. Keep the receipt of your emissions inspection sticker to prove that your vehicle was inspected. If the inspection sticker on your vehicle has expired in the past 60 days, you can receive a fine of \$25 to \$50. If the inspection sticker is expired more than 60 days, the fine is between \$50 and \$100. If there is no inspection sticker, the fine is between \$50 and \$100. A mandatory state surcharge of \$88 (\$93 in town and village courts) is added to the fine. A parked vehicle with no inspection sticker, or with an expired inspection sticker, can receive a parking ticket. Vehicles are exempt from the emissions inspection if they are - motorcycles - less than two model years old (model year is greater than or equal to calendar year minus one) - more than 25 model years old (model year is less than or equal to calendar year minus 25 ) - diesel-powered, except diesel-powered vehicles that are 1997 or newer and that have a gross vehicle weight rating (GVRW) less than 8,501 pounds - electric-powered - issued historical plates - subject to the heavy vehicle safety inspection
source_blocks.text: 检查站会将所有排放检查记录以电子方式发送给DMV。DMV必须有一份记录，证明您的车辆在过去一年内通过了排放检查。请保留排放检查标签的收据，以证明您的车辆已接受检查。 如果您车辆上的检查标签在过去60天内过期，您可能会被处以25至50美元的罚款。如果检查标签过期超过60天，罚款在50至100美元之间。如果没有检查标签，罚款在50至100美元之间。此外，还需支付88美元（城镇和乡村法院为93美元）的强制性州附加费。 停放车辆如果没有检查标签或检查标签过期，可能会收到停车罚单。 以下车辆免于排放检查： - 摩托车 - 车龄少于两个车型年（车型年大于或等于日历年减一） - 车龄超过25个车型年（车型年小于或等于日历年减25） - 柴油动力车辆，但1997年及以后且总车重额定值（GVRW）低于8,501磅的柴油动力车辆除外 - 电动车辆 - 发放历史牌照的车辆 - 需接受重型车辆安全检查的车辆

documents.doc_id: About online and alternative delivery method courses (I-PIRP/ADM)#3_0
documents.source_title_en: About online and alternative delivery method courses (I-PIRP/ADM)
documents.title: 关于在线和替代授课方式课程（I-PIRP/ADM）

source_blocks.source_text_en: About online and alternative delivery method courses (I-PIRP/ADM)
source_blocks.text: 关于在线和替代授课方式课程（I-PIRP/ADM）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the I-PIRP/ADM Program?
source_blocks.text: 什么是I-PIRP/ADM项目？

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-PIRP/ADM is an acronym for the Internet Point & Insurance Reduction Program/Alternate Delivery Method. This program permits approved sponsors to provide Defensive Driving/Accident Prevention courses via the Internet or other alternate delivery methods, such as DVD or digital cable.
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP/ADM是互联网积分与保险减免项目/替代授课方式的缩写。该项目允许经批准的赞助商通过互联网或其他替代授课方式（如DVD或数字有线电视）提供防御性驾驶/事故预防课程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who offers the I-PIRP courses?
source_blocks.text: 谁提供I-PIRP课程？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must be sure any course you take for point and insurance reduction in New York State is a course approved by the NY State DMV. See the list of DMV approved sponsors for I-PIRP courses [1].
source_blocks.text: 您必须确保在纽约州参加的任何用于积分和保险减免的课程都是纽约州DMV批准的课程。请参阅DMV批准的I-PIRP课程赞助商列表[1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I receive point and insurance reduction if I take an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 如果我参加I-PIRP课程，我能获得积分和保险减免吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. When you complete an I-PIRP course, you receive the same benefits as when you complete a classroom PIRP course. You can reduce your driver violation point total by a maximum of four points, and you can save ten percent on your auto liability and collision insurance premiums.
source_blocks.text: 是的。当您完成I-PIRP课程后，您将获得与完成课堂PIRP课程相同的福利。您的驾驶违规积分总数最多可减少四分，并且您可以在汽车责任险和碰撞险保费上节省百分之十。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long does it take to complete an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 完成I-PIRP课程需要多长时间？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The I-PIRP course requires a minimum of 320 minutes of instruction time. The instruction time does not include the time required to register, validate your identity and your participation, or to download and take any tests. The course site has controls to ensure you meet all the requirements and you have at least 320 minutes of instruction.
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP课程要求至少320分钟的教学时间。教学时间不包括注册、验证您的身份和参与情况，或下载和参加任何测试所需的时间。课程网站设有控制措施，以确保您满足所有要求，并且您至少有320分钟的教学时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How does the I-PIRP course compare to the classroom course?
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP课程与课堂课程相比如何？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both the classroom PIRP course and the I-PIRP course have very similar content and information, and both courses include 320 minutes of instruction. The classroom course is given in one daytime session or two evening sessions. You can take the I-PIRP course from home, at a convenient time for you. You must complete the I-PIRP course within 30 days of the date you register for the course. You can take the I-PIRP course at your own speed within the 30-day period.
source_blocks.text: 课堂PIRP课程和I-PIRP课程的内容和信息非常相似，两门课程都包含320分钟的教学。课堂课程在一个白天的时段或两个晚上的时段进行。您可以在方便的时间在家参加I-PIRP课程。您必须在注册课程之日起30天内完成I-PIRP课程。您可以在30天期限内按照自己的进度参加I-PIRP课程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I log off and continue an I-PIRP course at a later time or use different computers for separate course sessions?
source_blocks.text: 我可以退出并在稍后继续I-PIRP课程，或者在不同的计算机上分别进行课程会话吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can complete the course in as many sessions as necessary, but you must complete the course within 30 calendar days of registration.
source_blocks.text: 是的。您可以根据需要分多次完成课程，但必须在注册后30个日历日内完成课程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your data will be stored online for each course session. Most sponsors assign you a user ID and a password when you register for the course. You can use your ID and password to log in on any computer that can access the Internet with an acceptable connection.
source_blocks.text: 您的数据将在线存储，用于每个课程会话。大多数赞助商在您注册课程时会为您分配一个用户ID和密码。您可以使用您的ID和密码在任何能够以可接受的连接访问互联网的计算机上登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there tests or a final exam for an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP课程有测验或期末考试吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: An I-PIRP course can have online quizzes, random tests and/or a final exam to verify your participation and determine if you understand the course content. Some sponsors may require you to take a final exam in person. Test requirements will be explained before you register for the course, normally in the course Terms and Conditions section.
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP课程可以有在线测验、随机测试和/或期末考试，以验证您的参与情况并确定您是否理解课程内容。一些赞助商可能要求您亲自参加期末考试。测试要求将在您注册课程之前说明，通常在课程的条款与条件部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to knowledge tests about course content, there will be questions to help verify your identity and participation in the course.
source_blocks.text: 除了关于课程内容的知识测试外，还会有问题来帮助验证您的身份和课程参与情况。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I fail the quizzes, tests or final exam?
source_blocks.text: 如果我测验、测试或期末考试不及格怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The test and exam process and the effect of results can vary from one sponsor to another. Carefully read the information about tests before you register for the course.
source_blocks.text: 测试和考试流程及成绩的影响因主办方而异。在注册课程之前，请仔细阅读有关测试的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course normally requires you to answer 70% of course content questions correctly. You normally will have two tries to get the correct answer to a question.
source_blocks.text: 该课程通常要求您正确回答70%的课程内容问题。通常，您有两次机会来获得问题的正确答案。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tests are timed, and you will have limited time during a test to look for an answer that you do not know. It is recommended that you review the section content before you begin the tests.
source_blocks.text: 测试有时间限制，在测试期间您查找未知答案的时间有限。建议您在开始测试之前复习章节内容。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I fail the course? Can I receive a course fee refund?
source_blocks.text: 如果我未通过课程怎么办？我可以获得课程费用退款吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not meet all the requirements to complete the course or meet the minimum test score requirements, you cannot receive credit for course completion and you cannot receive point and insurance reduction for the course.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未满足完成课程的所有要求或未达到最低测试分数要求，您将无法获得课程完成学分，也无法获得该课程的积分和保险减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A sponsor can offer for you to take the same course again at no additional costs. The sponsor is not required to offer this.
source_blocks.text: 主办方可以免费为您提供再次参加同一课程的机会。主办方并非必须提供此服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the cost of an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP课程的费用是多少？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The cost is set by the course sponsor and the fee varies from one course to another course. Your cost is stated clearly before you register for the course. It is to your advantage to compare courses and their fees.
source_blocks.text: 费用由课程主办方设定，不同课程的费用各不相同。在注册课程之前，您的费用已明确说明。比较课程及其费用对您有利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I pay for an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 我如何支付I-PIRP课程费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The sponsor will normally require you to pay with a credit card, but this is determined by each sponsor. Check with the sponsor for complete information about payment.
source_blocks.text: 主办方通常要求您使用信用卡支付，但这由各主办方决定。请与主办方联系以获取有关支付的完整信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the procedure for course cancellation and/or refunds?
source_blocks.text: 课程取消和/或退款的程序是什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the sponsor cannot conduct the course or any part of the course, they must give you the option to receive a full refund of all course fees. The sponsor can also offer you the option to reschedule the course, if and when the course is available.
source_blocks.text: 如果主办方无法进行课程或课程的任何部分，他们必须为您提供全额退还所有课程费用的选项。主办方还可以在课程可用时为您提供重新安排课程的选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What type of equipment and technology do I need to take an I-PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 参加I-PIRP课程需要什么类型的设备和科技？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The answer depends on the alternate delivery method (ADM) of the course. For example, if the course is an Internet course, you must have a computer and an acceptable connection to the Internet. For a DVD ADM course, you must have a television and a DVD player. The sponsors must provide any additional technology required to deliver the course. The sponsor must inform you of these requirements when you register for the course.
source_blocks.text: 答案取决于课程的替代授课方式（ADM）。例如，如果课程是网络课程，您必须有一台计算机和可接受的互联网连接。对于DVD ADM课程，您必须有电视和DVD播放器。主办方必须提供授课所需的任何额外技术。主办方必须在您注册课程时告知您这些要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How and when do I receive my course completion certificate?
source_blocks.text: 我如何以及何时收到课程完成证书？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course sponsor mails the course completion certificate to you by regular mail. An email copy of the certificate is not valid and will not be accepted by your insurance company.
source_blocks.text: 课程主办方通过普通邮件将课程完成证书邮寄给您。证书的电子邮件副本无效，您的保险公司不会接受。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course sponsor must issue the course completion certificates within 14 business days of course completion. Some sponsors offer express mail delivery options at an additional fee.
source_blocks.text: 课程主办方必须在课程完成后的14个工作日内颁发课程完成证书。一些主办方提供额外收费的快递邮寄选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does the DMV send my completion certificate directly to my automobile insurance company?
source_blocks.text: DMV是否会将我的完成证书直接发送给我的汽车保险公司？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. You must contact the insurance company and supply your certificate to them for insurance reduction benefits.
source_blocks.text: 不。您必须联系保险公司并向他们提供您的证书，以获得保险减免优惠。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are the I-PIRP websites secured?
source_blocks.text: I-PIRP网站是否安全？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The DMV requires that the sponsors and their delivery agents provide secure websites that protect the personal information of those who take the courses.
source_blocks.text: 是的。DMV要求主办方及其交付代理提供安全的网站，以保护参加课程者的个人信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What personal information is required to take the course?
source_blocks.text: 参加课程需要提供哪些个人信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The sponsors collect personal information to verify your identity and your participation. This can include identity information like the DMV ID Number (Client ID Number) from your NY State driver license and your name and date of birth. You should make sure to use your name exactly as it appears on your New York State Driver License (don t use nick names ). The sponsor will also collect credit card information for the course fee.
source_blocks.text: 主办方收集个人信息以验证您的身份和参与情况。这可能包括身份信息，如您纽约州驾照上的DMV ID号（客户ID号）、您的姓名和出生日期。您应确保使用与纽约州驾照上完全一致的姓名（不要使用昵称）。主办方还将收集信用卡信息以支付课程费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identification and participation information can also include biometrics like keystrokes, facial recognition or voice recognition.
source_blocks.text: 身份和参与信息还可能包括生物识别信息，如击键、面部识别或语音识别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is my personal information kept after I finish the course?
source_blocks.text: 完成课程后，我的个人信息会被保留吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read the privacy and security information at the web site of the I-PIRP sponsors. The sponsors are required to store your personal information on a secure server for a time period specified by DMV.
source_blocks.text: 请阅读I-PIRP主办方网站上的隐私和安全信息。主办方被要求在DMV规定的时间段内将您的个人信息存储在安全的服务器上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV verifies the security of the servers that host the course.
source_blocks.text: DMV会验证托管课程的服务器安全性。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is done to ensure that the person who registers for the course is the person who takes the course?
source_blocks.text: 如何确保注册课程的人就是参加课程的人？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Each course sponsor has different methods to validate that the person who registered for the course is the same person who takes the course. Any person who attempts to defraud the system or who accepts a course completion certificate and its associated benefits without having personally completed the entire course has committed a crime and may be subject to prosecution, fines and imprisonment.
source_blocks.text: 每个课程主办方都有不同的方法来验证注册课程的人与参加课程的人是同一人。任何试图欺骗系统或接受课程完成证书及其相关优惠而未亲自完成整个课程的人，均构成犯罪，可能面临起诉、罚款和监禁。

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: If you don t have a New York State DMV ID Number (Client ID Number) from your NY State driver license, the ADM course completion can t be applied to your license record. You may have to file Request for Driver and/or Vehicle Record Information form (PDF) [2] (MV-15) before you attempt to take an ADM course.
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：如果您没有纽约州DMV ID号（客户ID号），则ADM课程完成情况无法应用到您的驾照记录中。在尝试参加ADM课程之前，您可能需要提交《驾驶员和/或车辆记录信息申请表》（PDF）[2]（MV-15）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About point reduction
source_blocks.text: About point reduction

source_blocks.source_text_en: Completing a Point and Insurance Reduction Program (PIRP) course does not remove a violation, conviction, or the number of points from your driving record. Even after you complete the course, most violations, convictions and points will continue to show on your driving record for up to 4 years. Violations and convictions involving drugs or alcohol will remain on your driving record for ten or fifteen years, depending on the violation. If you get 11 points for traffic violations in an 18-month period, your driver license may be suspended. "Point reduction" means the number of points on your driving record used to calculate the number of total points received within 18 months will be reduced by 4 points and may help you avoid a suspension. See About the NY State Point System [1] for more information about how points are calculated.

If you get 11 points for traffic violations in an 18-month period, your driver license may be suspended. "Point reduction" means the number of points on your driving record used to calculate the number of total points received within 18 months will be reduced by 4 points and may help you avoid a suspension. See About the NY State Point System [1] for more information about how points are calculated.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I receive the point reduction?
source_blocks.text: How do I receive the point reduction?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The PIRP course sponsor will notify the DMV within 10 weeks after you complete the course. DMV will then reduce the active points on your driving record by up to 4 points.
source_blocks.text: The PIRP course sponsor will notify the DMV within 10 weeks after you complete the course. DMV will then reduce the active points on your driving record by up to 4 points.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know my driving record shows my PIRP course completion?
source_blocks.text: How do I know my driving record shows my PIRP course completion?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to verify that your course completion is on your DMV record, you can request a copy of your driving record [2].
source_blocks.text: If you need to verify that your course completion is on your DMV record, you can request a copy of your driving record [2].

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your course completion is not recorded on your driving record more than 10 weeks after you completed it, contact the course sponsor.
source_blocks.text: If your course completion is not recorded on your driving record more than 10 weeks after you completed it, contact the course sponsor.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What effect does point reduction have on my license and driving record?
source_blocks.text: What effect does point reduction have on my license and driving record?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction applies only to points assessed for violations that occurred within the eighteen months immediately before course completion. It does not affect points for earlier violations, and cannot be used as "credit" against future violations or points.
source_blocks.text: Point reduction applies only to points assessed for violations that occurred within the eighteen months immediately before course completion. It does not affect points for earlier violations, and cannot be used as "credit" against future violations or points.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction cannot reduce your point total lower than zero.
source_blocks.text: Point reduction cannot reduce your point total lower than zero.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your license has already been revoked or suspended, the point reduction will not affect that action. If a violation hearing has already been scheduled, the point reduction will not affect that action.
source_blocks.text: If your license has already been revoked or suspended, the point reduction will not affect that action. If a violation hearing has already been scheduled, the point reduction will not affect that action.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction does not prevent or cancel a mandatory revocation or suspension for violations such as DWI, DWAI, or three speeding violations within 18 months.
source_blocks.text: Point reduction does not prevent or cancel a mandatory revocation or suspension for violations such as DWI, DWAI, or three speeding violations within 18 months.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can only use a Point & Insurance Reduction Program course to reduce points once in a 18-month period.
source_blocks.text: You can only use a Point & Insurance Reduction Program course to reduce points once in a 18-month period.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV point system and your insurance company s "point" systems are separate and not related. Point reduction on your driving record does not affect points assigned by your insurance company for violations and accidents.
source_blocks.text: The DMV point system and your insurance company s "point" systems are separate and not related. Point reduction on your driving record does not affect points assigned by your insurance company for violations and accidents.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Completion of a course under the Point & Insurance Reduction Program also cannot prevent or reduce the calculation of points affecting a Driver Responsibility Assessment. [3]
source_blocks.text: Completion of a course under the Point & Insurance Reduction Program also cannot prevent or reduce the calculation of points affecting a Driver Responsibility Assessment. [3]

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Private Service Bureau (PSB) license is required of any person, firm, association or corporation engaged in the business of assisting for hire in securing licenses to drive motor vehicles, registrations, or titles of motor vehicles.

source_blocks.source_text_en: About problem driver restrictions
source_blocks.text: 关于问题驾驶员限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a problem driver restriction, you can drive only
source_blocks.text: 如果你有问题驾驶员限制，你只能驾驶

source_blocks.source_text_en: to and from your place of employment during the hours of your employment, if your occupation requires the operation of a motor vehicle to and from a medical appointment which is part of a necessary medical treatment for you or a member of your household (you may be required to provide a written statement from your licensed medical provider that verifies the travel is necessary) to and from a Motor Vehicle office to transact business related to the license/permit/privilege that contains a problem driver restriction to and from a child's school/day-care if the child's attendance at the school/day-care is necessary for you to maintain employment or to maintain enrollment at an accredited school, college or university or a state-approved institution of vocational or technical training to and from an accredited school, college or university or a State-approved institution of vocational or technical training in which you are enrolled
source_blocks.text: 往返于你的工作地点 在你的工作时间内，如果你的职业要求操作机动车 往返于必要的医疗预约，该预约是你或你家庭成员的必要医疗治疗的一部分（你可能需要提供来自你的持牌医疗提供者的书面声明，以证明该出行是必要的） 往返于机动车管理局办公室，以办理与包含问题驾驶员限制的驾照/许可证/特权相关的业务 往返于孩子的学校/日托中心，如果孩子在该学校/日托中心出勤对于你维持就业或维持在被认可的学校、学院或大学或州批准的职业技术培训机构注册是必要的 往返于你注册的被认可的学校、学院或大学或州批准的职业技术培训机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: These restrictions are outlined on an attachment issued to you by the DMV. You must carry the attachment whenever you operate a motor vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 这些限制在DMV发给你的附件中列出。你在操作机动车时必须携带该附件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To which classes of license can a problem driver restriction be applied?
source_blocks.text: 问题驾驶员限制可以应用于哪些驾照类别？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The problem driver restriction can only be applied to a class D license. It cannot be applied to any commercial driver license (CDL) Class A,B or C, junior operator license Class DJ, motorcycle operator license Class M or MJ or a class E driver license.
source_blocks.text: 问题驾驶员限制只能应用于D类驾照。它不能应用于任何商业驾驶执照（CDL）A、B或C类，初级驾驶员执照DJ类，摩托车驾驶员执照M或MJ类，或E类驾驶员执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I drive through New York State with my out-of-state CDL license if my New York State record has the problem driver restriction?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的纽约州记录中有问题驾驶员限制，我可以持外州的CDL驾照在纽约州驾驶吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. A driver with a CDL issued in another state cannot operate a commercial motor vehicle in New York State with a problem driver restriction on their New York State record.
source_blocks.text: 不能。持有其他州签发的CDL驾照的驾驶员，如果其纽约州记录中有问题驾驶员限制，则不能在纽约州操作商用机动车。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I drive through New York State with my out-of-state license with the problem driver restriction?
source_blocks.text: 我可以持外州驾照并带有问题驾驶员限制在纽约州驾驶吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You must carry your completed, signed and dated problem driver restriction attachment and abide by the problem driver restrictions listed on the attachment.
source_blocks.text: 可以。你必须携带你填写完整、签名并注明日期的问题驾驶员限制附件，并遵守附件上列出的问题驾驶员限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there a cost for this restriction?
source_blocks.text: 此限制有费用吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, you will pay the required driver license fees at the DMV office, but there is no additional fee for the problem driver restriction.
source_blocks.text: 没有，你需要在DMV办公室支付所需的驾驶员执照费用，但问题驾驶员限制没有额外费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where will the problem driver restriction be displayed?
source_blocks.text: 问题驾驶员限制将显示在哪里？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your photo driver license or permit will have an A2 restriction displayed on the front of the document, and the words "PROBLEM DRIVER RESTRICTION" will be displayed on the back of the document.
source_blocks.text: 你的照片驾驶员执照或许可证正面将显示A2限制，背面将显示“PROBLEM DRIVER RESTRICTION”字样。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long will the restriction be in effect? Is there any way I can have the restriction removed early?
source_blocks.text: 限制将持续多长时间？有没有办法提前取消限制？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your revocation was due to an alcohol-related incident, the restriction remains in effect for five years from the date you receive your driver license or permit. If your revocation was not due to an alcohol related incident, the restriction remains in effect for two years from the date you receive your driver license or permit.
source_blocks.text: 如果你的吊销是由于酒精相关事件，限制将从你获得驾驶员执照或许可证之日起持续五年。如果你的吊销不是由于酒精相关事件，限制将从你获得驾驶员执照或许可证之日起持续两年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The restriction cannot be removed earlier.
source_blocks.text: 限制不能提前取消。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I have a moving violation conviction before I obtain my driver license or permit with the problem driver restriction?
source_blocks.text: 如果我在获得带有问题驾驶员限制的驾驶员执照或许可证之前有移动违规定罪，会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The approval for a driver license or permit with the problem driver restriction will be withdrawn if you are convicted of any of these violations
source_blocks.text: 如果您因以下任何违规行为被定罪，带有问题驾驶员限制的驾驶执照或许可证将被撤销

source_blocks.source_text_en: following too closely (tailgating) speeding, speed contest operating out of restriction cell phone or texting violation reckless driving any two other traffic violations. This includes a seat belt violation by the vehicle operator, but does not include parking, stopping, standing, equipment, inspection or other non-moving violations.
source_blocks.text: 跟车过近（追尾） 超速、竞速 超出限制驾驶 使用手机或发短信违规 鲁莽驾驶 任何其他两项交通违规。这包括车辆操作员未系安全带，但不包括停车、停靠、站立、设备、检查或其他非移动违规。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your driver license will be revoked for a minimum of 30 days. You may then apply for to the DIU for a new license and must pay a non-refundable \$100 application fee.
source_blocks.text: 您的驾驶执照将被吊销至少30天。之后您可以向DIU申请新驾照，并必须支付不可退还的\$100申请费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Problem Driver Restriction with DMV Mandated Ignition Interlock Device
source_blocks.text: 问题驾驶员限制及DMV强制安装的点火连锁装置

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your driving history includes alcohol-related violations, you may be required to install an ignition interlock device on any and all vehicles you own and/or operate. You are also subject to the problem driving restrictions. In addition, your problem driver restriction attachment will indicate that you are required to have an ignition interlock device.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾驶历史包含与酒精相关的违规，您可能被要求在所有您拥有和/或操作的车辆上安装点火连锁装置。您还受到问题驾驶限制的约束。此外，您的问题驾驶员限制附件将表明您必须安装点火连锁装置。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The DMV mandated ignition interlock is imposed and removed administratively by DMV. An interlock restriction imposed by a court under Leandra's Law is imposed and removed by DMV under the orders of the court and is monitored by the court and designated monitors.
source_blocks.text: 是的。DMV强制安装的点火连锁装置由DMV行政上施加和移除。根据Leandra's Law，法院施加的连锁限制由DMV根据法院命令施加和移除，并由法院和指定监督员监督。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Any device that is approved by the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services [1].
source_blocks.text: 任何经NYS刑事司法服务部批准[1]的设备。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the Ignition Interlock page [1] at the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services website for a list of service center locations.
source_blocks.text: 请访问NYS刑事司法服务部网站上的Ignition Interlock页面[1]，查看服务中心地点列表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For information about installation fees, visit the Ignition Interlock page [1] at the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services website.
source_blocks.text: 有关安装费用的信息，请访问NYS刑事司法服务部网站上的Ignition Interlock页面[1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, devices must be installed in any and all vehicles you own or operate.
source_blocks.text: 不，设备必须安装在您拥有或操作的所有车辆上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The device must be installed for five years from the date you receive your driver license or permit.
source_blocks.text: 设备必须从您收到驾驶执照或许可证之日起安装五年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, you must have the device installed for five years while you have the problem driver restriction.
source_blocks.text: 不，你必须安装该设备满五年，且在此期间存在有问题的驾驶限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can be issued a traffic ticket for driving out of restriction. If you are convicted, your driver license will be revoked.
source_blocks.text: 你可能会因超出限制驾驶而被开具交通罚单。如果被定罪，你的驾驶执照将被吊销。

documents.doc_id: About the NYS Driver Point System#3_0
documents.source_title_en: About the NYS Driver Point System
documents.title: 关于纽约州驾驶员记分制度

source_blocks.source_text_en: About the NYS Driver Point System
source_blocks.text: 关于纽约州驾驶员记分制度

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the Driver Violation Point System and how does it work?
source_blocks.text: 什么是驾驶员违规记分制度，它是如何运作的？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Driver Violation Point System gives the New York State DMV a way to identify and take action against high risk drivers. The DMV assigns points for certain traffic violations. If you get 11 points in an 18-month period, your driver license may be suspended. 1 However, the point system is not the only way to lose your license (see Suspensions and Revocations [1]).
source_blocks.text: 驾驶员违规记分制度使纽约州车管所能够识别并对高风险驾驶员采取行动。车管所会对某些交通违规行为进行记分。如果在18个月内累计达到11分，您的驾驶执照可能会被吊销。1 然而，记分制度并不是失去驾照的唯一途径（见吊销和撤销[1]）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How your point total is calculated
source_blocks.text: 如何计算您的总分

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must be convicted of the traffic violation before points are added to your driving record your point total is calculated based on the date of the violation, not the date of the conviction the points for violations that all occurred within the last 18 months are added to calculate your point total 2
source_blocks.text: 您必须因交通违规被定罪后，分数才会被添加到您的驾驶记录中 您的总分是根据违规日期计算的，而不是定罪日期 将过去18个月内发生的所有违规行为的分数相加，即可计算出您的总分2

source_blocks.source_text_en: Number of points assigned for common traffic violations
source_blocks.text: 常见交通违规行为的记分数

source_blocks.source_text_en: Points are not assigned for the following violations
source_blocks.text: 以下违规行为不记分

source_blocks.source_text_en: any bicycle violation any pedestrian violation any parking violation any violation related to unregistered, unlicensed or uninsured operation any violation related to motor vehicle inspection, vehicle weights or dimensions or vehicle equipment other than inadequate service brakes any violation related to a business or the sale of goods established in the Vehicle and Traffic Law or any local law a violation related to the improper use of High Occupancy Vehicle Lanes in Suffolk County, between exits 49 and 57 of the Long Island Expressway any other violation not resulting from the operation of a motor vehicle
source_blocks.text: 任何自行车违规 任何行人违规 任何停车违规 任何与未注册、未取得驾照或未投保驾驶相关的违规 任何与机动车检验、车辆重量或尺寸或车辆设备（除制动器不足外）相关的违规 任何与《车辆与交通法》或任何地方法律中规定的商业或商品销售相关的违规 在萨福克县长岛高速公路49号出口至57号出口之间不当使用高占用率车辆车道相关的违规 任何其他非因驾驶机动车而导致的违规

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver Responsibility Assessment
source_blocks.text: 驾驶员责任评估

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive 6 or more points on your New York State driving record in 18 months, you must pay a Driver Responsibility Assessment fee [2].
source_blocks.text: 如果您在18个月内在纽约州驾驶记录上累计达到6分或以上，您必须支付驾驶员责任评估费[2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Out-of-state convictions
source_blocks.text: 州外定罪

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are convicted of a traffic violation in another state or country, points are not added to your New York State driving record, unless the violation occurred in Ontario or Quebec.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在另一个州或国家因交通违规被定罪，除非违规发生在安大略省或魁北克省，否则分数不会添加到您的纽约州驾驶记录中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State has a reciprocal agreement with Quebec and Ontario. Traffic violation convictions that occur in these provinces are recorded on your New York State driver record, and the convictions have the same effect and carry the same points as convictions that occur in New York State. This can affect your driver violation point total and Driver Responsibility Assessment.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州与魁北克省和安大略省签订了互惠协议。在这些省份发生的交通违规定罪将记录在您的纽约州驾驶记录中，并且这些定罪与在纽约州发生的定罪具有相同的效力并携带相同的分数。这可能会影响您的驾驶员违规总分和驾驶员责任评估。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance Premiums
source_blocks.text: 保险费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance companies have their own point systems and can increase your premiums based on your driving record. Contact your insurance company for more information.
source_blocks.text: 保险公司有自己的记分制度，并可能根据您的驾驶记录提高您的保费。请联系您的保险公司以获取更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point and Insurance Reduction Program
source_blocks.text: 记分与保险减免计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: Taking a DMV-approved Point and Insurance Reduction Program (PIRP) course will
source_blocks.text: 参加经车管所批准的记分与保险减免计划（PIRP）课程将

source_blocks.source_text_en: help to prevent you from losing your license in the event you accrued 11 or more points on your driving record - 4 points are 'subtracted' for the purposes of a suspension if you have 11 or more points - the tickets/pointsphysically come off your driving record save 10 percent on your automobile liability and collision insurance premiums
source_blocks.text: 帮助防止您在驾驶记录上累计达到11分或以上时失去驾照 - 如果您有11分或以上，为暂停驾照之目的，将“减去”4分 - 罚单/分数会从您的驾驶记录中实际移除 在您的汽车责任险和碰撞险保费上节省10%

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about the PIRP course [3].
source_blocks.text: 进一步了解PIRP课程[3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check My Points
source_blocks.text: 查询我的积分

source_blocks.source_text_en: You use the MyDMV 'My License, Permit or ID' service to check your points. You will need the ID number and document number from your New York State
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用MyDMV的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”服务来查询您的积分。您需要提供纽约州颁发的以下证件上的身份证号和证件号：

source_blocks.source_text_en: driver license, learner permit, or non-driver ID
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照， 学习许可证，或 非驾驶员身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you lost your document, renewed or ordered a new one recently and have not received it in the mail yet, you will need to wait for it to arrive before you can create a MyDMV account.
source_blocks.text: 如果您丢失了证件，最近续办或订购了新证件但尚未通过邮件收到，您需要等待其到达后才能创建MyDMV账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check my points through MyDMV [4] [4]
source_blocks.text: 通过MyDMV查询我的积分[4] [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you claim that someone else committed a violation on your record, you can request a hearing. But you cannot request a DMV hearing to prove that you were not guilty of the violations. Once 18 months have passed from the violation date, the points for that violation no longer count toward your total. However, the points remain on your driving record as long as the conviction remains on your record and may be used by your insurance company to increase premiums.
source_blocks.text: 如果您声称他人对您记录上的违规行为负责，您可以请求听证会。但您不能请求DMV听证会来证明您对违规行为无罪。 一旦自违规日期起已过去18个月，该违规行为的积分不再计入您的总分。然而，只要定罪记录仍在您的记录上，这些积分就会保留在您的驾驶记录中，并可能被您的保险公司用于提高保费。

documents.doc_id: Adding and removing users#3_0
documents.source_title_en: Adding and removing users
documents.title: 添加和移除用户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adding and removing users
source_blocks.text: 添加和移除用户

source_blocks.source_text_en: When DMV creates a LENS roster, we issue a personal user ID and password to the applicant. If your organization has more than one person who may use LENS, we will gladly issue additional user IDs. Every LENS user may, and should, have their own personal logon. Please do not share your logon or password with others.
source_blocks.text: 当DMV创建LENS名册时，我们会向申请人发放个人用户ID和密码。如果您的组织中有多人可能使用LENS，我们很乐意为您发放额外的用户ID。每位LENS用户都可以且应该拥有自己的个人登录凭据。请勿与他人共享您的登录信息或密码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I add a user?
source_blocks.text: 如何添加用户？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get an additional user ID, please email us at [email protected] [2] with all of the following
source_blocks.text: 要获取额外的用户ID，请发送电子邮件至[email protected] [2]，并提供以下所有信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: your 5-digit LENS roster number the user s NY State Driver license/non-driver ID number 1 the user's full name the business name the user's business address the user s business telephone number the user s business email address
source_blocks.text: 您的5位数LENS名册编号 用户的纽约州驾驶执照/非驾驶员ID号码1 用户的完整姓名 企业名称 用户的办公地址 用户的办公电话号码 用户的办公电子邮件地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will then
source_blocks.text: 然后我们将

source_blocks.source_text_en: send the user ID to the user s business email address, and mail the password to the user s personal license/ID mailing address.
source_blocks.text: 将用户ID发送至用户的办公电子邮件地址，以及 将密码邮寄至用户的个人执照/ID邮寄地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The password is the only LENS information that we ever send to a user s personal mailing address. We will not send a password to an office address.
source_blocks.text: 密码是我们唯一发送到用户个人邮寄地址的LENS信息。我们不会将密码发送到办公地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I remove a user?
source_blocks.text: 如何移除用户？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a LENS user leaves your organization you can remove them by completing the following steps:
source_blocks.text: 如果LENS用户离开您的组织，您可以通过完成以下步骤将其移除：

source_blocks.source_text_en: log on to LENS visit the LENS Main Menu and select Customer Information select User Profile Maintenance click Search to list all of your LENS users find the departing user and check the corresponding Remove box. Click Process .
source_blocks.text: 登录LENS 访问LENS主菜单并选择“客户信息” 选择“用户配置文件维护” 点击“搜索”以列出您的所有LENS用户 找到离职用户并勾选相应的“移除”框。点击“处理”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a LENS user leaves your organization and you cannot log in to LENS, please email us at [email protected] [2]. Identify the user and your LENS customer number. We will disable the departed user s access to your LENS roster.
source_blocks.text: 如果LENS用户离开您的组织且您无法登录LENS，请发送电子邮件至[email protected] [2]。请注明该用户和您的LENS客户编号。我们将禁用已离职用户对您的LENS名册的访问权限。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I change users?
source_blocks.text: 如何更改用户？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If someone is taking on another user s duties, follow the instructions in the topic above for requesting additional user IDs. Do not share the former user s ID and password with the new user. We will not provide support to any person who is using another person s user ID. We may revoke shared user IDs upon discovery.
source_blocks.text: 如果有人接替另一用户的职责，请按照上述主题中的说明请求额外的用户ID。请勿与前用户共享前用户的ID和密码。我们不会为任何使用他人用户ID的人提供支持。一旦发现共享用户ID，我们可能会撤销这些ID。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register for LENS [3]
source_blocks.text: 注册LENS [3]

source_blocks.source_text_en: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators
source_blocks.text: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators

source_blocks.source_text_en: An all-terrain vehicle (ATV) is any self-propelled vehicle with two or more wheels that is manufactured for sale to be used primarily off-highway or in off-road competitions, and that is no wider than 70 inches and weighs no more than 1,000 pounds. This does not include vehicles manufactured for off-highway use and designed exclusively for travel on snow or ice, and supported by one or more skis, belts or cleats that utilize an endless belt tread. Those vehicles, which include snowmobiles, are subject to other laws and regulations.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ATV REGISTRATION AND DATE OF EXPIRATION
source_blocks.text: ATV REGISTRATION AND DATE OF EXPIRATION

source_blocks.source_text_en: An ATV must be registered with the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) if it is operated anywhere in New York State, including on the owner's property.
source_blocks.text: An ATV must be registered with the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) if it is operated anywhere in New York State, including on the owner's property.

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you register a new or used ATV for the first time, your registration will expire each year on August 31. Registrations for ATVs originally registered before April 1, 2005, will continue to expire each year on April 30.
source_blocks.text: When you register a new or used ATV for the first time, your registration will expire each year on August 31. Registrations for ATVs originally registered before April 1, 2005, will continue to expire each year on April 30.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ATV dealers are required by law to register every ATV they sell to New York State residents or to non-residents before the purchaser takes delivery; unless the purchaser qualifies for an exemption from registration. A purchaser is exempt from registration when the ATV will be used exclusively: outside of New York State; at special events; for agricultural purposes; or for snow plowing other than for-hire. Dealers must have the purchaser complete and sign a "Declaration of Exemption From Snowmobile or All-Terrain Vehicle Registration" (RV-6).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Unless you qualify for an exemption from registration, you cannot take delivery from an authorized dealer until after the ATV is registered.
source_blocks.text: Unless you qualify for an exemption from registration, you cannot take delivery from an authorized dealer until after the ATV is registered.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you buy an ATV from a person who is not a New York State registered ATV dealer, you must register the ATV with the DMV. To register the ATV; you must complete an "Vehicle Registration/Title Application [1]" (MV-82) and submit it to a motor vehicle issuing office. To register an ATV; you must provide proofs of ownership, sales tax payment or exemption, your identity, and your date of birth.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you buy your ATV from a registered New York State dealer, you should receive a bill of sale in addition to the acceptable documents that prove ownership. The bill of sale must contain the dealer's name, address and dealer registration number, plus your name and address, the ATV vehicle identification number, the year, make, model, and number of wheels. The bill of sale also must indicate that the ATV is either new or used, and must confirm that the dealer has collected the appropriate sales tax.

The bill of sale also must indicate that the ATV is either new or used, and must confirm that the dealer has collected the appropriate sales tax.

Have the seller sign and give you a Statement of Transaction- Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (pdf) [4] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802). source_blocks.source_text_en: The ATV registration and registration renewal fee is \$12.50 per year it is not prorated by month. You also must pay a \$12.50 license plate fee when you first register your ATV. You will be issued a plate, a registration sticker and an attached registration document. The plate must be attached to the rear of the ATV, and the sticker should be placed at the right side of the plate. You should carry the registration document when operating your ATV.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may not operate any ATV anywhere in New York State, except on your own property, unless it is covered by liability insurance. Minimum required coverage is \$50,000/\$100,000 for death, \$25,000/\$50,000 for injury, and \$10,000 for property damage in any one accident. You must show proof of this insurance upon the request of a judge, the police, or a person claiming to have suffered injury or property damage from your operation of the ATV.

source_blocks.source_text_en: CHANGE OF ADDRESS
source_blocks.text: CHANGE OF ADDRESS

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you move, cross out the old address on your registration document and write in the new one. You also must report your address change to the DMV [6] within 10 days.

source_blocks.source_text_en: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
source_blocks.text: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your ATV has become stolen, you should immediately report the theft to the police. If the ATV is to be, or already has been, destroyed or permanently removed from New York State, you should surrender the plate and registration document to a local motor vehicle office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: OUT-OF-STATE REGISTRATIONS
source_blocks.text: OUT-OF-STATE REGISTRATIONS

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State honors valid out-of-state ATV registrations. If your home state does not require ATV registration, you must obtain a New York State registration before operating your ATV in this state.

source_blocks.source_text_en: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
source_blocks.text: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need a driver license to operate an ATV in New York State, but certain restrictions apply to operators under age 16.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are age 10 through age 15, you may operate an ATV only:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under adult supervision; or, Without adult supervision on lands owned or leased by your parent or guardian; or, On any lands where ATV use is permitted, without adult supervision, if you have completed an ATV safety training course approved by the DMV. You should carry your course completion certificate when operating any ATV.

source_blocks.source_text_en: RESPONSIBILITY OF PARENTS AND OWNERS
source_blocks.text: RESPONSIBILITY OF PARENTS AND OWNERS

source_blocks.source_text_en: A parent or guardian may not knowingly permit or authorize his or her child under age 16 to operate an ATV in violation of state or local laws. An ATV owner, or another person in possession of an ATV, may not knowingly permit or authorize any person under age 16 to operate an ATV in violation of any state or local law.

An ATV owner, or another person in possession of an ATV, may not knowingly permit or authorize any person under age 16 to operate an ATV in violation of any state or local law.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both the owner and the operator of an ATV may be held liable for injury and/or damages resulting from an ATV accident.

source_blocks.source_text_en: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
source_blocks.text: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV recommends you avoid crossing a highway unless absolutely necessary. If you cross, you must follow these rules:
source_blocks.text: DMV recommends you avoid crossing a highway unless absolutely necessary. If you cross, you must follow these rules:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must cross at an angle of approximately 90 degrees, at a place where there are no obstructions to prevent a quick, safe crossing. You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way to traffic on the highway before crossing. You may cross a divided highway only where it intersects with another street or highway. You may not cross an interstate highway or any controlled-access highway, such as the Thruway or a parkway at any time.

You may not cross an interstate highway or any controlled-access highway, such as the Thruway or a parkway at any time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ON HIGHWAYS
source_blocks.text: ON HIGHWAYS

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may not operate an ATV on a highway unless it has been designated and posted for ATV use by the state or local authority. Usually, only the part of a highway between two off-highway trails will be posted for ATV use. Check with local police to be sure. DMV recommends that you turn your headlight and taillight on and wear bright, reflective clothing whenever you ride on a highway. Always enter the highway with care, and yield to other traffic.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ON PUBLIC LAND
source_blocks.text: ON PUBLIC LAND

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may not operate an ATV on public land unless it is specifically designated for ATV use, and it is allowed by a posted sign.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ON PRIVATE LAND
source_blocks.text: ON PRIVATE LAND

source_blocks.source_text_en: To operate an ATV on private land, you must have permission of the land owner or lessee. If you receive permission, make sure you know the boundaries of the property, and respect any special restrictions or requests of the land owner. You could lose permission to ride on private land by littering, causing damage, or riding carelessly.

source_blocks.source_text_en: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
source_blocks.text: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT

source_blocks.source_text_en: Whether you are the operator or passenger, you must wear a USDOT-approved helmet when riding an ATV. DMV recommends that you also wear a face shield or goggles, and protective clothes and footwear.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your ATV must have the following equipment:
source_blocks.text: Your ATV must have the following equipment:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Brakes in good condition A muffler which is in good operating condition and meets federal standards A spark arrester approved by the U.S. Forest Service Tires with at least 2/32nds of an inch tread without visible breaks, cuts, exposed cords, bumps or bulges A lighted white headlight and red taillight if the ATV is driven at night

source_blocks.source_text_en: The law requires you to keep the ATV's headlight and taillight lighted when riding a half hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise. For greater safety, DMV recommends you keep the lights on at all times.

source_blocks.source_text_en: RIDING RESTRICTIONS
source_blocks.text: RIDING RESTRICTIONS

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to obeying the ATV laws and rules, it is wise to ride your ATV with common sense and courtesy. Having fun on an ATV does not include annoying others or taking foolish risks. ATV riders who ignore the rules and the rights of others may cause ATV operation to be restricted or prohibited on private and public lands.

Having fun on an ATV does not include annoying others or taking foolish risks. ATV riders who ignore the rules and the rights of others may cause ATV operation to be restricted or prohibited on private and public lands.

source_blocks.source_text_en: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
source_blocks.text: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other than while seated on the permanent, regular seat. With a passenger, unless the ATV is designed to carry a passenger. At a speed too fast for existing conditions or potential hazards. In a careless, reckless or negligent manner. While intoxicated or impaired by alcohol or drugs. On the tracks or right-of-way of a railroad. On a highway, if the ATV is equipped with studded tires other than automobile-type studs. In a tree nursery or planting in a manner which damages or destroys growing stock or creates a substantial risk of damage or destruction. Within 100 feet of a dwelling between midnight and 6 A.M. at a speed greater than necessary to keep the ATV moving. While pulling a person on skis, a toboggan, sleigh, sled or trailer, unless the device is attached to the ATV by a tow-bar or other rigid connection. On the ice or public water within 100 feet of a person, fishing shanty or shelter at a speed greater than necessary to keep the ATV moving. Over an area cleared of snow for skating, unless necessary for access to public waters.

source_blocks.text: LOCAL LAWS

source_blocks.source_text_en: No locality may require its own ATV licenses or registrations, but it may impose additional restrictions or rules on ATV operation. Find out about special ATV rules in your area, and obey them.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The person in charge of an ATV special event or off-road competition must apply to the local jurisdiction for written authorization at least 30 days in advance, unless it is held entirely on private property.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ATV ACCIDENTS
source_blocks.text: ATV ACCIDENTS

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are involved in an accident with your ATV, you must give your name and address, the name and address of the ATV owner and the plate number to injured persons, the owners of damaged property, and/or the police. You also must show proof of insurance to persons claiming to have suffered injury or damage. If property is damaged, and you cannot locate the owner, you must give the above information to police as soon as possible.

You also must show proof of insurance to persons claiming to have suffered injury or damage. If property is damaged, and you cannot locate the owner, you must give the above information to police as soon as possible.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must immediately report to the police any accident that involves death, personal injury or damage estimated at \$600 or more to the property of any one person.
source_blocks.text: You must immediately report to the police any accident that involves death, personal injury or damage estimated at \$600 or more to the property of any one person.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must also file a Report of Motor Vehicle Accident (MV-104) with the Department of Motor Vehicles about an accident that results in a fatality, personal injury, or property damage estimated at \$1,000 or more. You must file the report within 10 days of the accident and send a copy to the county sheriff or police commissioner.

You must file the report within 10 days of the accident and send a copy to the county sheriff or police commissioner.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are incapacitated, the written report may be filed by another party familiar with the accident. The investigating police officer must also file a written report, but that does not relieve you of your legal responsibility to file one.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Failure to report an accident is a misdemeanor. A conviction may result in suspension or revocation of your safety training certificate and/or the ATV registration.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Automatic license and registration extension for military personnel
source_blocks.text: Automatic license and registration extension for military personnel

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pursuant to Executive Order No. 2 by Governor Andrew M. Cuomo, all licenses and registrations for New York State military personnel returning from active military duty relating to the war on terrorism and military action in Iraq will automatically be extended. The following information will help minimize any potential inconvenience upon their return.
source_blocks.text: Pursuant to Executive Order No. 2 by Governor Andrew M. Cuomo, all licenses and registrations for New York State military personnel returning from active military duty relating to the war on terrorism and military action in Iraq will automatically be extended. The following information will help minimize any potential inconvenience upon their return.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if my NY State driver license expires while I am on active duty?
source_blocks.text: What happens if my NY State driver license expires while I am on active duty?

source_blocks.source_text_en: NY State law automatically extends license privileges throughout active military service for up to 6 months after discharge or separation. Discharged or separated military personnel may renew an expired NY State license up to two years after the extended expiration. No more than 30 months may have passed since discharge (6-month extension plus 24 -month grace period).
source_blocks.text: NY State law automatically extends license privileges throughout active military service for up to 6 months after discharge or separation. Discharged or separated military personnel may renew an expired NY State license up to two years after the extended expiration. No more than 30 months may have passed since discharge (6-month extension plus 24 -month grace period).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Active military personnel must show proof of date of entry into military service. If the NY State license was valid at any time during your military service, your license can be renewed.
source_blocks.text: Active military personnel must show proof of date of entry into military service. If the NY State license was valid at any time during your military service, your license can be renewed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A discharged serviceman must show a Certificate of Discharge, DD-214. You must have been discharged within the past 30 months. If the NY State license was valid at any time during your military service, your license can be renewed.
source_blocks.text: A discharged serviceman must show a Certificate of Discharge, DD-214. You must have been discharged within the past 30 months. If the NY State license was valid at any time during your military service, your license can be renewed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I required to notify DMV of my entry into the military?
source_blocks.text: Am I required to notify DMV of my entry into the military?

source_blocks.source_text_en: While not required, it is suggested that military personnel file a Notification of Military Service (pdf) [1] (MV -75) to ensure that the license record is not purged once the expiration date has passed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if my NY State registration expires while I am on active duty?
source_blocks.text: What happens if my NY State registration expires while I am on active duty?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registrations are extended for up to 60 days from return to New York State. This extension applies only to vehicles registered to military personnel. You must show proof of military service or separation. Liability insurance coverage must be maintained at all times, including the period of extension.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I had a lapse of insurance coverage during active duty?

"Federal Vehicle certified for Sale in California: This vehicle conforms to U.S. EPA regulations applicable to (the vehicle model year) model-year new motor vehicles, and is certified for sale in California."

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle complies with the California emissions standard, but the MCO does not indicate compliance or you do not have an Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO), you or the automobile dealer can certify compliance on a 'Certificate of Emissions Compliance or Exemption' form (MV-74).
