source_blocks.source_text_en: When you purchase a vehicle from a leasing company, you must have the title issued in your name. The title must be issued in your name before you can sell or transfer the vehicle. You can transfer the title by mail or at a DMV office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: the New York State title or other acceptable proof of ownership [4]. source_blocks.text: 纽约州所有权证书或其他可接受的所有权证明 [4]。所有权证书必须填写完整 - 买方和卖方信息（租赁公司和买方都必须提供签名、转让日期和地址） - 所有车龄为10年或更短的车辆的里程表和损坏披露声明

source_blocks.source_text_en: What will happen if I don't respond to the NOTICE OF NON-COMPLIANCE AND LICENSE DOWNGRADE?
source_blocks.text: What will happen if I don't respond to the NOTICE OF NON-COMPLIANCE AND LICENSE DOWNGRADE?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Failure to respond to the NOTICE OF NON-COMPLIANCE AND LICENSE DOWNGRADE will result in your Commercial Driver License automatically being downgraded to a Non-CDL class and/or your Commercial Learner Permit being cancelled as of the effective date on the notice. We strongly recommend that you submit your required information to the Medical Certification Unit at least 20 days before the effective date of the downgrade. This will allow for receipt and processing time.

We strongly recommend that you submit your required information to the Medical Certification Unit at least 20 days before the effective date of the downgrade. This will allow for receipt and processing time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the downgrade/cancellation occurs, your must complete and present an application to reinstate your commercial privileges in person at a DMV office. All normal transaction fees will apply. If you are a Commercial Learner Permit holder, you will need to retake any applicable knowledge tests you passed more than 180 days from the date you apply for reinstatement.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you no longer want a Commercial Driver License/ Commercial Learner Permit, you can get a non-commercial duplicate license online [4] after the Effective Date on the downgrade notice. The commercial class license document in your possession will no longer be valid.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Determine the fees for commercial vehicles
source_blocks.text: 确定商用车辆的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use both theregistration fee and county use tax charts to determine your registration fee and county use tax.
source_blocks.text: 使用注册费和县使用税表来确定您的注册费和县使用税。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If this is the original registration of your vehicle, you must pay

source_blocks.source_text_en: the fees for your vehicle plates (\$25.00) your title certificate fee of \$50.00 the sales tax 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registration fee chart for commercial vehicles
source_blocks.text: 商用车辆注册费表

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fees listed in the chart are for commercial vehicles that weigh less than 18,000 lbs. Diesel-powered commercial vehicles that weigh 8,501 pounds or more require an additional fee. 2 If you transfer vehicle plates for one vehicle to another, you cannot use this chart to calculate your fee.
source_blocks.text: 表中列出的费用适用于重量低于18,000磅的商用车辆。重量为8,501磅或以上的柴油动力商用车辆需要额外费用。2 如果您将一辆车的车辆牌照转移到另一辆车，则不能使用此表计算费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: County use taxes and supplemental fees
source_blocks.text: 县使用税和附加费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Residents of New York City and several counties in New York must pay a vehicle use tax when they register a commercial vehicle or renew a commercial vehicle registration. The DMV collects the taxes for the city and the counties. Read the table below to determine if you must pay a vehicle use tax. If you have questions about these taxes, ask the city or county where you reside or have a business.
source_blocks.text: 纽约市居民和纽约州几个县的居民在注册商用车辆或续签商用车辆注册时必须支付车辆使用税。DMV 代城市和县收取税款。阅读下表以确定您是否必须支付车辆使用税。如果您对这些税有疑问，请咨询您居住或经营业务的市或县。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you reside outside New York City and you are exempt from the vehicle use tax in the county where you reside or have a business, complete form UT-11C. If you reside in New York City and you are exempt from the NYC vehicle use tax, get form UT-11 from a local DMV office [1] or a DMV Call Center [2].
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在纽约市以外，并且您所在县或经营业务所在县的车辆使用税豁免，请填写表格 UT-11C。如果您居住在纽约市并且豁免 NYC 车辆使用税，请从当地 DMV 办公室 [1] 或 DMV 呼叫中心 [2] 获取表格 UT-11。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York City Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island)
source_blocks.text: 纽约市布朗克斯区、国王区（布鲁克林）、纽约区（曼哈顿）、皇后区、里士满区（史泰登岛）

source_blocks.source_text_en: All passenger vehicle original registrations and renewals
source_blocks.text: 所有乘用车原始注册和续签

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicle use tax - \$80 for 2 years (\$40 / year) Livery and for-hire vehicles in these registration classes - \$400 for 1 year 3 - Livery (OML) - Bus (OMR) - Taxi (OMT) Supplemental MCTD fee - \$50 for two years (\$25 per year)
source_blocks.text: 车辆使用税 - 2年 \$80（\$40/年） 以下注册类别的礼车和出租车辆 - 1年 \$400 3 - 礼车 (OML) - 巴士 (OMR) - 出租车 (OMT) 附加 MCTD 费用 - 两年 \$50（每年 \$25）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: The New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission regulates all "TC" vehicle plates. All registrants for "TC" vehicle plates must pay the vehicle use tax.
source_blocks.text: 注意：纽约市出租车和豪华轿车委员会监管所有“TC”车辆牌照。所有“TC”车辆牌照的注册人必须支付车辆使用税。

source_blocks.source_text_en: County use tax chart for counties outside of New York City
source_blocks.text: 纽约市以外县的县使用税表

source_blocks.source_text_en: The chart show the use taxes and supplemental fees for all original registrations and renewals.
source_blocks.text: 该表显示了所有原始注册和续签的使用税和附加费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of the sales tax depends on the purchase price and your locality. You can see the current sales tax rates by jurisdiction [3] at the Department of Taxation and Finance website. To determine the correct fee, add 3.25% to the fee listed in the chart, and change the result to the nearest \$0.25. Several registration classes are exempt from the additional fee. The classes include Agricultural (AGR), Ambulance (AMB), Farm (FAR), Historical (HIS), House Trailer (HOU), Semi Trailer (SEM), Special Purpose Commercial (SPC), and Trailer (TRL). This tax applies to Medallion taxis with a plate number configuration of "TnnnnnC" or "TnnnnnnC". This tax does not include Medallion taxis with plate number configurations: "TnnnnnT", "TnnnnnnT", "nana", "nanna", "nnnSBVa" and "nnnSBVan". (n=number, a=letter).
source_blocks.text: 销售税金额取决于购买价格和您所在的地区。您可以在税务和财政局网站上查看当前按司法管辖区划分的销售税率 [3]。 要确定正确的费用，请将表中列出的费用增加3.25%，并将结果调整为最接近的 \$0.25。几个注册类别免收额外费用。这些类别包括农业 (AGR)、救护车 (AMB)、农场 (FAR)、历史 (HIS)、房车 (HOU)、半挂车 (SEM)、特殊用途商用 (SPC) 和拖车 (TRL)。 此税适用于牌照号码配置为“TnnnnnC”或“TnnnnnnC”的奖章出租车。此税不包括牌照号码配置为“TnnnnnT”、“TnnnnnnT”、“nana”、“nanna”、“nnnSBVa”和“nnnSBVan”的奖章出租车。（n=数字，a=字母）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Conditional and restricted use licenses
source_blocks.text: Conditional 和 Restricted Use 许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must apply for a conditional or restricted use license in person at a DMV office. You can do this at most, but not all, Motor Vehicles offices. Contact your nearest office [1] to find out where you can apply.
source_blocks.text: 你必须亲自到 DMV 办公室申请 conditional 或 restricted use 许可证。你可以在大多数（但不是所有）Motor Vehicles 办公室办理。请联系离你最近的办公室 [1] 以了解在哪里申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Conditional
source_blocks.text: Conditional

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV can issue a conditional license to a qualified driver whose NY State license has been suspended or revoked because of an alcohol or drug-related violation. The driver must attend a Impaired Driver Program (IDP) [2] (previously known as Drinking Driving Program (DDP)) approved by the DMV.
source_blocks.text: DMV 可以向符合条件的驾驶员签发 conditional license，前提是该驾驶员的 NY State 驾照因酒精或毒品相关的违规行为而被吊销或撤销。该驾驶员必须参加由 DMV 批准的 Impaired Driver Program (IDP) [2]（以前称为 Drinking Driving Program (DDP)）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Restricted use
source_blocks.text: Restricted use

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV can issue a restricted use license to a driver who qualifies and whose license is suspended or revoked because of violations or incidents that are not alcohol or drug-related, or because of some drug-related violations.
source_blocks.text: DMV 可以向符合条件且其驾照因非酒精或毒品相关的违规或事故，或因某些毒品相关违规而被吊销或撤销的驾驶员签发 restricted use license。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers from other states
source_blocks.text: 来自其他州的驾驶员

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a driver license issued in another state, and you meet the other requirements, you can receive a conditional driving privilege or a restricted driving privilege to drive in NY State. The conditions or the restrictions are the same as the conditions or restrictions for a driver with a NY State driver license.
source_blocks.text: 如果你持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，并且满足其他要求，你可以获得在 NY State 驾驶的 conditional driving privilege 或 restricted driving privilege。其条件或限制与持有 NY State 驾驶执照的驾驶员相同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a DIAL-IN search account and who can get one?
source_blocks.text: What is a DIAL-IN search account and who can get one?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you regularly need to search DMV records for driver license, registration, vehicle (title) or insurance information, then DIAL-IN is the service you need. Our typical clients include attorneys, insurance and private investigators, process servers and building/site security personnel.
source_blocks.text: If you regularly need to search DMV records for driver license, registration, vehicle (title) or insurance information, then DIAL-IN is the service you need. Our typical clients include attorneys, insurance and private investigators, process servers and building/site security personnel.

source_blocks.source_text_en: See Drivers Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [2] for more information about permissible uses of DMV records.
source_blocks.text: See Drivers Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [2] for more information about permissible uses of DMV records.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for an account?
source_blocks.text: How do I apply for an account?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should complete form Motor Vehicle Record Search Account Application (PDF) [3] (MV-15D). The instructions are on the form.
source_blocks.text: You should complete form Motor Vehicle Record Search Account Application (PDF) [3] (MV-15D). The instructions are on the form.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send the form to:
source_blocks.text: Send the form to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Data Services - New Search AccountNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: Data Services - New Search AccountNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: How will I know my application has been accepted?
source_blocks.text: How will I know my application has been accepted?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will review your application. If you application is not complete, we will return your application with an explanation that will give you more instructions.
source_blocks.text: We will review your application. If you application is not complete, we will return your application with an explanation that will give you more instructions.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your application is complete, we will create an account for you. We will send you your account number and password. Your seven-digit account number will never change. You will enter this account number when you log in to the DIAL-IN system.
source_blocks.text: If your application is complete, we will create an account for you. We will send you your account number and password. Your seven-digit account number will never change. You will enter this account number when you log in to the DIAL-IN system.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there fees for using a DIAL-IN search account?
source_blocks.text: Are there fees for using a DIAL-IN search account?

source_blocks.source_text_en: According to the NYS Vehicle and Traffic Law, we must charge a fee to search DMV records. Private persons, commercial organizations, and not-for-profit organizations must pay a search fee. There is a fee of \$7.00 for each search that you make with the DIAL-IN service.
source_blocks.text: According to the NYS Vehicle and Traffic Law, we must charge a fee to search DMV records. Private persons, commercial organizations, and not-for-profit organizations must pay a search fee. There is a fee of \$7.00 for each search that you make with the DIAL-IN service.

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are some organizations that are exempt from search fees. Any public organization, its officers, a volunteer fire company, a volunteer ambulance service, or a legal aid bureau or society or other private entity acting pursuant to section 722 of the New York State County Law, that makes a search for a public purpose, is exempt from the search fee.
source_blocks.text: There are some organizations that are exempt from search fees. Any public organization, its officers, a volunteer fire company, a volunteer ambulance service, or a legal aid bureau or society or other private entity acting pursuant to section 722 of the New York State County Law, that makes a search for a public purpose, is exempt from the search fee.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I pay DIAL-IN Search Account fees?
source_blocks.text: How do I pay DIAL-IN Search Account fees?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Paying customers must include a deposit with the application. Your first deposit must be enough to pay for two months of searches. When we accept your application, your deposit is added to your new account balance. When you make a search, we subtract the search fee from your account balance.

When we accept your application, your deposit is added to your new account balance. When you make a search, we subtract the search fee from your account balance.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Payment by credit card is NOT available at this time.
source_blocks.text: Payment by credit card is NOT available at this time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use your account to pay for the mail-order searches and the online searches. If you must pay a fee for the service, your account records will reflect your debits and your credits and show your account balance. For more information, please visit our Escrow Accounts [4] page.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What business records must I keep to document the searches I perform?
source_blocks.text: What business records must I keep to document the searches I perform?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The business records you keep must exist prior to the search you perform and must establish the business purpose of the search.
source_blocks.text: The business records you keep must exist prior to the search you perform and must establish the business purpose of the search.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common examples of business records include invoices, retainer agreements, employment applications, consent forms, accident reports, and surveillance reports and numerous other types of records. The Terms of Service of your Search Account require you to maintain these records and to provide them to DMV when requested.

The Terms of Service of your Search Account require you to maintain these records and to provide them to DMV when requested.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will DMV contact me about the searches I perform using my DIAL-IN Search Account?
source_blocks.text: Will DMV contact me about the searches I perform using my DIAL-IN Search Account?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, DMV may ask you about a DIAL-IN search you performed. We inquire about searches to monitor compliance with the DIAL-IN Terms of Service.You must respond to the inquiry whether or not you have business records that support your search. Your response will be considered an incomplete reply if you do not give us the business records. You can complete an inquiry at any time if you send us the requested acceptable business records. If you performed the search on behalf of a client, you will need to show permissible use of your client, and your client agent relationship. If you personally did not perform the search we have inquired about, please check with the other users of your DIAL-IN account to see if one of them performed the search. If none of the known users performed the search, contact us immediately.If you do not respond to our inquiry about a DIAL-IN search, your search privileges will be suspended until you respond.

documents.source_title_en: Diesel inspections emission testing
documents.title: 柴油车排放检测

source_blocks.source_text_en: Diesel inspections emission testing
source_blocks.text: 柴油车排放检测

source_blocks.source_text_en: A non-exempt diesel-powered motor vehicle may be subject to either the OBDII emissions inspection or the diesel emissions inspection. Additional information about these inspections may be found on the table below.
source_blocks.text: 非豁免的柴油动力机动车可能需要进行OBDII排放检测或柴油排放检测。有关这些检测的更多信息，请参见下表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Emissions Inspections for Diesel-powered Vehicles
source_blocks.text: 柴油动力车辆排放检测

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles subject to diesel emissions inspection
source_blocks.text: 需进行柴油排放检测的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: All non-exempt diesel-powered vehicles registered in the NYMA or Diesel Emissions Metropolitan Area (DEMA) (some registrations may or may not show they are within DEMA), with a maximum gross weight (MGW), as indicated on the vehicle registration certificate, over 8,500 pounds, must get an annual diesel emissions inspection. The diesel emissions inspection must occur at the same time as the annual safety inspection. The DEMA includes the five boroughs of New York City, and Nassau County, Suffolk County, Rockland County, and Westchester County. The model year does not exempt a vehicle from the inspection. Read section 79.2(h) of the inspection regulations to get information about vehicles that are exempt.
source_blocks.text: 所有在NYMA或柴油排放大都市区（DEMA）注册的非豁免柴油动力车辆（某些注册可能显示或未显示其位于DEMA内），且车辆注册证书上标明的最大总重量（MGW）超过8,500磅，必须每年进行柴油排放检测。柴油排放检测必须与年度安全检测同时进行。DEMA包括纽约市五个区，以及拿骚县、萨福克县、罗克兰县和威斯特彻斯特县。车辆型号年份并不免除检测要求。请阅读检测法规第79.2(h)节，了解豁免车辆的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All diesel-powered vehicles registered outside of the Diesel Emissions Metropolitan Area (DEMA), with a maximum gross weight (MGW) over 8,500 pounds, do not require an annual diesel emissions inspection, but may be subject to a random roadside diesel emissions inspection.
source_blocks.text: 所有在柴油排放大都市区（DEMA）以外注册的柴油动力车辆，若最大总重量（MGW）超过8,500磅，则无需进行年度柴油排放检测，但可能接受随机的路边柴油排放检测。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All model year 1997 or newer non-exempt diesel-powered vehicles, registered anywhere in New York State, with a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) less than 8,501 pounds, must get an annual OBDII emissions inspection, and are not subject to the diesel emissions inspection.
source_blocks.text: 所有1997年款及更新的非豁免柴油动力车辆，在纽约州任何地方注册，且车辆总重量额定值（GVWR）低于8,501磅，必须每年进行OBDII排放检测，且不适用柴油排放检测。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All model year 1996 or older diesel-powered vehicles, registered anywhere in New York State, with a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) less than 8,501 pounds, are not subject to the OBDII emissions inspection, the low-enhanced emissions inspection, or the diesel emissions inspection.
source_blocks.text: 所有1996年款及更早的柴油动力车辆，在纽约州任何地方注册，且车辆总重量额定值（GVWR）低于8,501磅，不适用OBDII排放检测、低增强排放检测或柴油排放检测。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Diesel Opacity Emissions
source_blocks.text: 柴油烟度排放

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Diesel Opacity Emissions inspection is not required in other areas of NY State, or for vehicles register out-of-state. However, the NY State Department of Environmental Conservation, the NY State Department of Transportation, or the NY State Police can test any diesel-powered vehicle that has a MGW of more than 8,500 lbs. at any roadside inspection site that is located on any New York State highway. If a vehicle fails the roadside inspection, a traffic ticket can be issued.
source_blocks.text: 柴油烟度排放检测在纽约州其他地区或对州外注册车辆不作要求。然而，纽约州环境保护部、纽约州交通部或纽约州警察可在纽约州任何高速公路上的路边检测点对任何MGW超过8,500磅的柴油动力车辆进行检测。若车辆未通过路边检测，可能会被开具交通罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary Certificate of Emissions Waiver (VS-1078)
source_blocks.text: 临时排放豁免证书（VS-1078）

source_blocks.source_text_en: When an existing diesel emissions inspection certificate expires while the vehicle is outside the DEMA, that resident may apply to the Department of Motor Vehicles for a 'Temporary Certificate Emissions Waiver' (VS-1078). Temporary Certificate Emissions Waiver is only available at DMV Issuing Offices. The temporary emissions waiver certificate when displayed on the vehicle along with a valid New York Safety Inspection Certificate will allow the vehicle to be operated while the vehicle is outside the DEMA. The Temporary Certificate of Emissions Waiver will be valid for ten (10) days from the date that the vehicle returns to the NYMA. Read regulation 79.1(r) of the NY State DMV Motor Vehicle Inspection Regulations (pdf) [1] (CR-79).
source_blocks.text: 当现有的柴油排放检测证书在车辆位于DEMA之外时到期，该居民可向机动车管理局申请“临时排放豁免证书”（VS-1078）。临时排放豁免证书仅在DMV发证办公室提供。当临时排放豁免证书与有效的纽约安全检测证书一同展示在车辆上时，允许车辆在DEMA之外运行。临时排放豁免证书自车辆返回NYMA之日起十（10）天内有效。请阅读纽约州DMV机动车检测法规（pdf）[1]（CR-79）第79.1(r)条。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When and where does the diesel emissions inspection occur?
source_blocks.text: 柴油排放检测何时何地进行？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The diesel emissions inspection occurs at the time of the annual safety inspection and is conducted at a diesel emissions inspection station.
source_blocks.text: 柴油排放检测在年度安全检测时进行，并在柴油排放检测站进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-diesel emissions iInspection station in the New York Metropolitan Area (NYMA)
source_blocks.text: 纽约大都市区（NYMA）的非柴油排放检测站

source_blocks.source_text_en: The station can conduct other inspections but cannot inspect vehicles that are subject to the diesel emissions inspection.
source_blocks.text: 该检测站可进行其他检测，但不能检测需进行柴油排放检测的车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can refer to Inspection Groups and Fee Chart (pdf) [2] (VS-77) for this information.
source_blocks.text: 您可参阅检测组别与费用表（pdf）[2]（VS-77）获取此信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Become a diesel emissions inspection station
source_blocks.text: 成为柴油排放检测站

source_blocks.source_text_en: The inspection station must purchase a DMV-approved smokemeter (find a vendor). A station can conduct an emissions inspection on a diesel-powered vehicle if the station is licensed to conduct a safety inspection for that specific type of vehicle. To prove that an approved smokemeter was purchased, the station must send a photocopy of the invoice to this address
source_blocks.text: 检测站必须购买DMV认可的烟度计（查找供应商）。如果检测站获得许可对特定类型的车辆进行安全检查，则该站可对柴油动力车辆进行排放检测。为证明已购买经认可的烟度计，检测站必须将发票复印件发送至以下地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS DMV Bureau of Consumer & Facility Services Application Unit P.O. Box 2700 Albany, NY 12220-0700
source_blocks.text: NYS DMV Bureau of Consumer & Facility Services Application Unit P.O. Box 2700 Albany, NY 12220-0700

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions, call 1-518-474-0919.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fees for a learner permit and driver license

source_blocks.source_text_en: MCTD fee
source_blocks.text: MCTD费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Residents of these counties must pay a Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee:
source_blocks.text: 以下县的居民必须支付大都会通勤交通区（MCTD）费用：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island), Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester.
source_blocks.text: 布朗克斯、国王（布鲁克林）、纽约（曼哈顿）、皇后、里士满（史泰登岛）、达奇斯、拿骚、奥兰治、普特南、罗克兰、萨福克和威斯特彻斯特。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The MCTD fee is \$1.00 for every 6 months the permit or driver license will be in effect.
source_blocks.text: MCTD费用为每6个月有效期收取 \$1.00。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee chart
source_blocks.text: 费用表

source_blocks.source_text_en: The table below shows the total fees you pay. The table does not show
source_blocks.text: 下表显示您需支付的总费用。表中未显示

source_blocks.source_text_en: fees for a commercial driver licenses (CDL) the additional \$30 fee to get an enhanced driver license (EDL) instead of a regular driver license fees for a non-driver ID card [2]
source_blocks.text: 商业驾照（CDL）费用 获取增强版驾照（EDL）而非普通驾照的额外 \$30 费用 非驾驶员ID卡 [2] 的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: \ Includes MCTD
source_blocks.text: \ 包含MCTD费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: \\ Part of the Class M and MJ fee supports the Motorcycle Safety Program in New York State.
source_blocks.text: \\ Class M和MJ费用的一部分用于支持纽约州摩托车安全计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee to replace a driver license or learner permit
source_blocks.text: 更换驾照或学习驾照的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fee to replace a driver license or learner permit is \$17.50.
source_blocks.text: 更换驾照或学习驾照的费用为 \$17.50。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee to change information on a driver license or learner permit.
source_blocks.text: 更改驾照或学习驾照信息的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fee to change information (amend) on a driver license or learner permit is \$12.50.
source_blocks.text: 更改（修正）驾照或学习驾照信息的费用为 \$12.50。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee for an Enhanced Driver License (EDL) or Enhanced Permit.
source_blocks.text: 增强版驾照（EDL）或增强版学习驾照的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is an additional \$30.00 fee for an Enhanced Driver License.
source_blocks.text: Enhanced Driver License需额外支付\$30.00费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee for a motorcycle license
source_blocks.text: 摩托车驾照费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fees you pay when you get your first motorcycle license depend on
source_blocks.text: 首次申请摩托车驾照所需支付的费用取决于

source_blocks.source_text_en: whether or not you currently have another class of New York State driver license and your exact age when you apply.
source_blocks.text: 您目前是否持有其他类别的纽约州驾照，以及 申请时的确切年龄。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fees for a Class M or MJ driver license, or to add class M or MJ to your current driver license, can range from \$21 to \$120. We cannot calculate your exact fee until you apply.
source_blocks.text: Class M或MJ驾照的费用，或在现有驾照上增加Class M或MJ的费用，范围从\$21到\$120。我们无法在您申请前计算确切费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a refund of my driver license fees?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得驾照费用退款吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can receive a partial refund of the 8-year driver license fee if you qualify. The maximum amount you can receive is 50% (four years) of the original 8-year driver license fee. The partial refund does not include any application or document fees.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合条件，可以获得8年驾照费用的部分退款。最高退款金额为原8年驾照费用的50%（即4年）。部分退款不包括任何申请费或文件费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can qualify for a partial refund if your driver license
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合以下条件，则有资格获得部分退款：

source_blocks.source_text_en: was valid for 8 years when it was issued is surrendered to us or to another state during the first 4 years of the 8-year period was not suspended or revoked when you surrendered it was not exchanged for a non-driver ID card
source_blocks.text: 驾照签发时有效期为8年 在8年期限的前4年内将驾照交回给我们或另一州 交回时驾照未被吊销或撤销 未将驾照换成非驾驶员ID卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for a refund you must
source_blocks.text: 申请退款，您必须：

source_blocks.source_text_en: apply no later than 51 months after the date your driver license was issued complete a Request for Refund of Fee Paid for Motor Vehicle Registrations and Driver Licenses [3] (MV-215) attach the driver license to form MV-215 if you did not already surrender your driver license if you exchanged your NYS driver license for a driver license in another state, attach a photocopy of your out-of-state driver license to form MV-215 mail the required form and documents to the address listed on the form allow up to 12 weeks for the refund to be processed
source_blocks.text: 在驾照签发日期后不超过51个月内申请 填写《机动车注册和驾照费用退款申请表》[3] (MV-215) 如果尚未交回驾照，请将驾照附在MV-215表格上 如果您将纽约州驾照换成了其他州的驾照，请将外州驾照的复印件附在MV-215表格上 将所需表格和文件邮寄至表格上所列地址 退款处理时间最长可达12周

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving in New York State
source_blocks.text: Driving in New York State

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who can drive here?
source_blocks.text: Who can drive here?

source_blocks.source_text_en: To drive a car or motorcycle in New York State, you must
source_blocks.text: To drive a car or motorcycle in New York State, you must

source_blocks.source_text_en: be at least 16 years old 1 and have a valid New York State driver license or learner permit, or a valid driver license or permit issued by another state or country
source_blocks.text: be at least 16 years old 1 and have a valid New York State driver license or learner permit, or a valid driver license or permit issued by another state or country

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a New York State learner permit or one issued in another state, you must follow New York State permit restrictions [1].
source_blocks.text: If you have a New York State learner permit or one issued in another state, you must follow New York State permit restrictions [1].

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under age 18, you must obey New York's Graduated License Law [2].
source_blocks.text: If you are under age 18, you must obey New York's Graduated License Law [2].

source_blocks.source_text_en: Residents of New York
source_blocks.text: Residents of New York

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you become a New York State resident, you must get a New York State driver license within 30 days. If you have a valid driver license issued by another U.S. state or territory, federal district or Canadian province, you may be eligible to exchange it for a New York driver license (see Exchange an out-of-state license [3]), or see other information about moving to New York [4].
source_blocks.text: If you become a New York State resident, you must get a New York State driver license within 30 days. If you have a valid driver license issued by another U.S. state or territory, federal district or Canadian province, you may be eligible to exchange it for a New York driver license (see Exchange an out-of-state license [3]), or see other information about moving to New York [4].

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your license was issued outside the U.S. or Canada, you must apply for a new original New York State driver license at a DMV office (see Get a driver license [5]). When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definition of "Resident"
source_blocks.text: Definition of "Resident"

source_blocks.source_text_en: Section 250 (5) of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law says:
source_blocks.text: Section 250 (5) of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law says:

source_blocks.source_text_en: To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in New York State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.
source_blocks.text: To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in New York State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make New York a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of New York. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a New York State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make New York a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of New York. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a New York State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-residents
source_blocks.text: Non-residents

source_blocks.source_text_en: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
source_blocks.text: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another state or country. You don t need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.
source_blocks.text: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another state or country. You don t need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a driver license from another country you do not need to have an International Driving Permit, but it is helpful. The permit verifies in several languages that you have a valid driver license. Police officers who can t read the language on your foreign driver license will be able to read the permit. Contact the authorities in your home country to get an International Driving Permit.
source_blocks.text: If you have a driver license from another country you do not need to have an International Driving Permit, but it is helpful. Contact the authorities in your home country to get an International Driving Permit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visitors from other countries
source_blocks.text: Visitors from other countries

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a driver license from any nation, you do not need a New York State license to drive in New York State. You should only apply for a New York State driver license if you become a resident of New York State.
source_blocks.text: If you have a driver license from any nation, you do not need a New York State license to drive in New York State. You should only apply for a New York State driver license if you become a resident of New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have a license in your home country and want to get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test. See Get a driver license [5].
source_blocks.text: If you do not have a license in your home country and want to get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test. See Get a driver license [5].

source_blocks.text: Students

source_blocks.source_text_en: Students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered New York State residents.
source_blocks.text: Students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered New York State residents.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Out-of-state learner permits
source_blocks.text: Out-of-state learner permits

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may drive in New York State with a learner permit issued in another state if
source_blocks.text: You may drive in New York State with a learner permit issued in another state if

source_blocks.source_text_en: you are age 16 or older your out-of-state learner permit is valid outside the issuing state you obey all restrictions of the state that issued the learner permit and - the general restrictions for learner permit holders [1] in New York State - if you are under age 18, the additional restrictions explained in the Graduated Driver License (GDL) Law and drivers under age 18 [2]
source_blocks.text: you are age 16 or older your out-of-state learner permit is valid outside the issuing state you obey all restrictions of the state that issued the learner permit and - the general restrictions for learner permit holders [1] in New York State - if you are under age 18, the additional restrictions explained in the Graduated Driver License (GDL) Law and drivers under age 18 [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot exchange out-of-state permit for a New York State permit. You must apply for a New York permit at a DMV office if your out-of-state learner permit does not allow you to drive in New York State.
source_blocks.text: You cannot exchange out-of-state permit for a New York State permit. You must apply for a New York permit at a DMV office if your out-of-state learner permit does not allow you to drive in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Even if you have a learner permit or a driver license from another state, you are not exempt from this rule.

documents.title: 护航驾驶员认证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escort driver certification
source_blocks.text: 护航驾驶员认证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escort driver certification [1]
source_blocks.text: 护航驾驶员认证 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: When do I need to have escort driver certification?
source_blocks.text: 我何时需要持有护航驾驶员认证？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escort driver certification is mandatory if
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，护航驾驶员认证是强制性的

source_blocks.source_text_en: you escort over-dimensional loads on the highways of New York State 1 you act as a flag person for over-dimensional loads
source_blocks.text: 您在纽约州高速公路上护送超限货物 1 您担任超限货物的旗手

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escort driver certification is not mandatory if
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，护航驾驶员认证不是强制性的

source_blocks.source_text_en: you escort an over-dimensional load that is less than the requirement stated in footnote #1 you are a member of the military and escort military convoys you escort state governmental vehicles
source_blocks.text: 您护送的超限货物低于脚注#1中所述的要求 您是军人并护送军事车队 您护送州政府车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the qualifications for providing escort services?
source_blocks.text: 提供护航服务的资格要求是什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To qualify as a certified escort driver, you must
source_blocks.text: 要成为合格的认证护航驾驶员，您必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: be 21 years old or older have a valid New York State driver license or valid license in the state or jurisdiction in which you are a resident 2 pass the Escort Driver's Certification Test
source_blocks.text: 年满21岁或以上 持有有效的纽约州驾驶执照或您居住的州或司法管辖区颁发的有效驾驶执照 2 通过护航驾驶员认证考试

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get certified as an escort vehicle driver?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得护航车辆驾驶员认证？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get your escort vehicle driver certification
source_blocks.text: 要获得护航车辆驾驶员认证

source_blocks.source_text_en: go to a DMV office that offers the escort driver certification test complete the Vehicle Escort Driver Application (PDF) [2] (MV-65) take the written test 3
source_blocks.text: 前往提供护航驾驶员认证考试的DMV办公室 填写车辆护航驾驶员申请表（PDF）[2]（MV-65） 参加笔试 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need to make an appointment to take the test. However, the test is not offered in all DMV Offices. Call the DMV office where you plan to take the test to be sure the test is offered at that location. If you have a NY State driver license you must bring it with you when you go to the office to take the test. If you have a driver license issued by another state, you must bring your valid driver license and additional identification with you to the office. See the DMV Document Guide [3] for more information about acceptable additional identification.
source_blocks.text: 您无需预约即可参加考试。但是，并非所有DMV办公室都提供该考试。请致电您计划参加考试的DMV办公室，以确保该地点提供该考试。如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，前往办公室参加考试时必须携带。如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，则必须携带有效的驾驶执照和额外的身份证明前往办公室。有关可接受额外身份证明的更多信息，请参阅DMV文件指南 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All information necessary to pass the test is in the Department of Transportation Certified Escort Manual (PDF) [4].
source_blocks.text: 通过考试所需的所有信息均包含在交通部认证护航手册（PDF）[4]中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should also be familiar with the New York State Driver's Manual [5].
source_blocks.text: 您还应熟悉纽约州驾驶员手册 [5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you pass the test you will be immediately certified to provide escort services for over-dimensional loads. You will be given a 60-day Interim Escort Driver Certificate. Your permanent certificate will be sent by mail. You must have the certificate in your possession when providing escort services.
source_blocks.text: 如果您通过考试，您将立即获得提供超限货物护航服务的认证。您将获得一份为期60天的临时护航驾驶员证书。您的永久证书将通过邮件寄送。提供护航服务时，您必须随身携带该证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the fees?
source_blocks.text: 费用是多少？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fee to take the vehicle escort test is \$40.00. Checks must be made payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. There are no additional fees for the initial certification.
source_blocks.text: 参加车辆护送考试的費用为40.00美元。支票抬头必须写明支付给机动车管理局局长。初次认证不收取额外费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may take the written test again if you do not pass. The fee is \$40.00 each time you take the test.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未通过笔试，可以再次参加。每次参加考试的费用为40.00美元。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When does my escort vehicle certification expire and how to I renew it?
source_blocks.text: 我的护送车辆认证何时到期，以及如何续期？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a New York State driver license, your Escort Driver Certificate will expire at the same time as your driver license. If you have a driver license from another state, your certificate will be valid for four years from the date it is issued.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，您的护送驾驶员证书将与驾驶执照同时到期。如果您持有其他州的驾驶执照，您的证书自签发之日起有效期为四年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will receive a renewal notice in the mail. Follow the instructions in the renewal notice to renew your Escort Driver Certificate. Remember to keep your mailing address current with NY State DMV.
source_blocks.text: 您将通过邮件收到续期通知。请按照续期通知中的说明续办您的护送驾驶员证书。请记住保持您的邮寄地址在纽约州DMV的最新状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not renew your certification within two years of the expiration date, you will be required to retake and pass the written test prior to being recertified.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在到期日期后两年内未续期认证，您将需要重新参加并通过笔试，之后才能重新获得认证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I need to change my address or name?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要更改地址或姓名，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a New York State driver license, you must change your address [6] or name [7] within ten days. The Bus Driver Unit cannot make the changes for you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，您必须在十天内更改您的地址[6]或姓名[7]。巴士驾驶员部门无法为您进行更改。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a license issued by another state, you must notify DMV s Bus Driver Unit in writing within ten days. Send your DMV ID Number (Client ID Number) (located on your escort certificate), former address or name and your new address or name to:
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，您必须在十天内书面通知DMV的巴士驾驶员部门。请将您的DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（位于您的护送证书上）、以前的地址或姓名以及您的新地址或姓名发送至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesBus Driver Unit Customer Service Unit 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 136B Albany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车管理局巴士驾驶员部门客户服务部6 Empire State Plaza, Room 136B Albany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I need to replace my certificate?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要更换证书，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your Vehicle Escort Card is lost, stolen, or destroyed, you may apply for a replacement by writing to DMV. You must send your name, address, and DMV ID Number (Client ID Number) (located on your escort certificate), if available. Send your request and a check or money order for \$5 made payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is my escort vehicle certification still valid if my license is revoked or suspended?

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is an escrow account?
source_blocks.text: 什么是 escrow account（托管账户）？

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State DMV customers who frequently process any or all of the DMV products and services listed below can establish an escrow account.
source_blocks.text: 经常处理以下所列 DMV 产品或服务的纽约州 DMV 客户可以开设 escrow account（托管账户）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An escrow account is an alternative to sending a check or money order for each DMV transaction. You deposit money into the escrow account, and then the account is debited to pay for the transaction.
source_blocks.text: Escrow account（托管账户）是每次 DMV 交易时寄送支票或汇票的替代方式。您将资金存入托管账户，然后交易费用从该账户中扣除。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What DMV products and services can I use my escrow account to pay for?
source_blocks.text: 我可以使用 escrow account（托管账户）支付哪些 DMV 产品和服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escrow Account Definitions
source_blocks.text: 托管账户定义

source_blocks.source_text_en: Escrow Amount - The DMV requires a minimum escrow amount of at least \$200 for search accounts. We recommend that you keep enough money in the escrow account to cover 2 months of transactions. To change your escrow amount, you must send a request to DMV Revenue Accounts on your letterhead. The request must be signed and dated and include the account number.Escrow Account Statement - On the last business day of the month, the DMV automatically issues a statement of the activity in the escrow account during that month.Debit - The amount taken, by date, from the escrow account. Details about each debit are not available from your statement. Only the total debit amount by date and type of product or service is available from your statement.Credit - Payments to your escrow account by date. Payments are posted to your account by 3:00 pm on the day they are received. Balance - The amount in your escrow account available to use. If the balance reaches zero or a negative amount, the account is disabled. You cannot pay for transactions from the account until payment is received and processed. A negative amount indicates that the account is overdrawn.Monthly Charges to Date - The total debits to your account for the statement period. Total Charges - The cumulative total of debits to your account.Escrow Deficiency - Indicates that the balance in your account is less than the required Escrow Amount.Pay This Amount - The payment amount necessary to return your account balance to the required Escrow Amount.
source_blocks.text: 托管金额 - DMV要求搜索账户的最低托管金额至少为\$200。我们建议您在托管账户中保留足够的资金以覆盖2个月的事务。要更改您的托管金额，您必须使用公司信笺向DMV Revenue Accounts发送请求。请求必须签名并注明日期，并包含账户号码。托管账户对账单 - 在每月的最后一个工作日，DMV会自动发出该月托管账户活动的对账单。借记 - 按日期从托管账户中扣除的金额。您的对账单不提供每笔借记的详细信息。您的对账单仅提供按日期和产品或服务类型划分的总借记金额。贷记 - 按日期向您的托管账户支付的款项。款项在收到当天下午3:00前记入您的账户。余额 - 您的托管账户中可用的金额。如果余额达到零或负数，账户将被禁用。在收到并处理付款之前，您无法使用该账户支付交易。负数表示账户透支。截至目前的月度费用 - 对账单期间您账户的总借记额。总费用 - 您账户的累计借记总额。托管不足 - 表示您账户中的余额低于所需的托管金额。支付此金额 - 将您的账户余额恢复到所需托管金额所需的付款金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ACH (Automated Clearing House) Payments - Electronic transfer of funds from your bank account into your escrow account via the DMV website.
source_blocks.text: ACH（自动清算所）付款 - 通过DMV网站从您的银行账户向您的托管账户进行电子资金转账。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I put money in my escrow account?
source_blocks.text: 如何向我的托管账户存入资金？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Currently, the DMV can only accept checks, money orders or ACH (Automated Clearing House) as payments to escrow accounts. Make sure to include your account number with payments. Payments received without account numbers will be returned. Checks should be made payable to "NYS Department of Motor Vehicles".
source_blocks.text: 目前，DMV仅接受支票、汇票或ACH（自动清算所）作为托管账户的付款方式。请确保在付款中包含您的账户号码。未包含账户号码的付款将被退回。支票应支付给“NYS Department of Motor Vehicles”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drop-off payment
source_blocks.text: 投递付款

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not use ACH, the fastest way to submit a payment is at the DMV Revenue Accounts Drop-box. The Drop-box is located at the DMV Customer Service Counter on the first floor of the Swan Street Building in Albany. Any check or money order dropped off by 3:00 pm will be entered into the escrow account that day. You must call 518-474-0888 when you drop payment off.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不使用ACH，最快的付款方式是在DMV Revenue Accounts投递箱提交付款。投递箱位于Albany Swan Street Building一楼的DMV Customer Service Counter。下午3:00前投递的任何支票或汇票将在当天记入托管账户。投递付款时，您必须致电518-474-0888。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Payment by mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄付款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the DMV Revenue Accounts addresses provided above to make payments by regular, express or overnight mail.
source_blocks.text: 使用上述提供的DMV Revenue Accounts地址，通过普通邮件、快递或隔夜邮件进行付款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Payment by ACH
source_blocks.text: 通过ACH付款

source_blocks.source_text_en: This service allows you to electronically transfer funds from your bank account into your DMV escrow account via the DMV website at https://secap.dmv.ny.gov/vpass/ [1]. The funds are immediately credited to your account. This will eliminate the need to send your payments by mail. Your account liaison will also be able to update your business address and assign users to the system. You can post payment 7 days a week, 24 hours a day, whenever needed, so that you don t have to worry about running out of money or delays in replenishing your account.
source_blocks.text: 此服务允许您通过DMV网站https://secap.dmv.ny.gov/vpass/ [1]从您的银行账户向您的DMV托管账户进行电子资金转账。资金将立即记入您的账户。这将消除通过邮件发送付款的需要。您的账户联络人还将能够更新您的营业地址并为系统分配用户。您可以每周7天、每天24小时随时发布付款，这样您就不必担心资金耗尽或补充账户的延迟。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are interested in signing up for this service, you must download and complete these forms
source_blocks.text: 如果您有兴趣注册此服务，您必须下载并填写这些表格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Authorization Agreement for Direct Deposits (PDF) [3] (FM-138)
source_blocks.text: 直接存款授权协议（PDF）[3]（FM-138）

source_blocks.source_text_en: ACH Liaison Designation (PDF) [4] (FM-139)
source_blocks.text: ACH联络人指定（PDF）[4]（FM-139）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send both forms and a voided check to:
source_blocks.text: 将两份表格和一张作废支票发送至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Revenue Accounts NYS Department of Motor Vehicles PO Box 2409, Albany NY 12228.
source_blocks.text: Revenue Accounts NYS Department of Motor Vehicles PO Box 2409, Albany NY 12228.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also send these forms to us by fax at 518-473-9644 or email at [email protected] [2]. It will take approximately 2-3 weeks to set up your ACH account and liaison once received.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以将这些表格通过传真发送至518-473-9644，或通过电子邮件发送至[email protected] [2]。收到后，大约需要2-3周时间设置您的ACH账户和联络人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any questions about ACH, you may contact us at 518-474-0888.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对ACH有任何疑问，可以拨打518-474-0888联系我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I update my address?
source_blocks.text: 如何更新我的地址？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your address changes, you must notify DMV Revenue Accounts.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的地址发生变化，您必须通知DMV Revenue Accounts。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you use ACH, your account liaison can use the system to update the address.
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用ACH，您的账户联络人可以通过系统更新地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not use ACH, you must send a letter to DMV Revenue Accounts with your old and new address. The request must be on your letterhead, must include your account number and must be signed and dated.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不使用ACH，您必须向DMV Revenue Accounts发送一封信函，注明您的旧地址和新地址。请求必须使用您的信笺抬头，包含您的账户号码，并签名和注明日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I close my account?
source_blocks.text: 如何关闭我的账户？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To close your escrow account, send a request to close your account by mail, fax or email to DMV Revenue Accounts. The request must be on your letterhead, must include your account number and must be signed and dated. If you do not have letterhead, you can send in the request on your monthly statement.
source_blocks.text: 要关闭您的托管账户，请通过邮寄、传真或电子邮件向DMV Revenue Accounts发送关闭账户的请求。请求必须使用您的信笺抬头，包含您的账户号码，并签名和注明日期。如果您没有信笺抬头，您可以在月度对账单上发送请求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If there is a remaining balance in your account, you can have a refund check issued, or you can have the balance transferred to another escrow account that you have with DMV. When you close the account, please be sure to let us know what you want done with the remaining balance, if any, left in your account.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的账户中有余额，您可以要求开具退款支票，或者将余额转入您在DMV拥有的另一个托管账户。关闭账户时，请务必告知我们您希望如何处理账户中剩余的任何余额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I am studying in New York State. Do I need a New York State driver license?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Students from other states, countries or nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered residents of New York State, so they don t need to exchange their current driver license.
source_blocks.text: Students from other states, countries or nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered residents of New York State, so they don t need to exchange their current driver license.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Normally, you can t have a NY State driver license and a driver license from another state at the same time, but there are exceptions. However, it is a violation of Federal law to hold more than one commercial driver license (CDL).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers from other countries
source_blocks.text: Drivers from other countries

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.
source_blocks.text: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test. See Get a driver license [6].

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV has additional resources for drivers from other countries [7].

source_blocks.source_text_en: To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in NYS for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make NYS a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of NYS. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a NYS driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: FAQ for TNC Drivers
source_blocks.text: TNC司机常见问题解答

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a TNC ?
source_blocks.text: 什么是TNC？

source_blocks.source_text_en: TNC stands for transportation network company , a term defined in a recently enacted part of the State Vehicle & Traffic Law. A TNC is a business, also known as a "rideshare company", licensed by DMV to use a digital network to connect passengers to TNC drivers for prearranged trips.
source_blocks.text: TNC代表交通网络公司，这是最近颁布的《州车辆与交通法》中定义的一个术语。TNC是一种企业，也称为“拼车公司”，由DMV许可，使用数字网络将乘客与TNC司机连接起来，进行预先安排的行程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I become a TNC driver?
source_blocks.text: 我如何成为TNC司机？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact one of the New York State licensed TNC companies. Lyft and Uber are currently licensed by DMV.
source_blocks.text: 联系纽约州许可的TNC公司之一。Lyft和Uber目前由DMV许可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there an age and licensing requirement to be a TNC driver?
source_blocks.text: 成为TNC司机有年龄和驾照要求吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, by statute, TNC drivers must be at least 19 years old and hold a valid and current NYS driver s license issued by DMV.
source_blocks.text: 是的，根据法规，TNC司机必须年满19岁，并持有DMV颁发的有效且最新的纽约州驾照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does my vehicle need to be authorized for TNC use?
source_blocks.text: 我的车辆需要获得TNC使用授权吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Not by DMV. But TNC companies may have requirements on the vehicles they allow.
source_blocks.text: 不需要DMV授权。但TNC公司可能对其允许的车辆有要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I have a car loan, will my vehicle lender allow me to use my personal vehicle to drive for a TNC?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有汽车贷款，我的车辆贷款方会允许我使用个人车辆为TNC驾驶吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should read your lending agreement and contact your lender, as any such limitations are a matter of private contract, not the TNC Act or regulations.
source_blocks.text: 您应该阅读您的贷款协议并联系您的贷款方，因为任何此类限制都是私人合同问题，而非TNC法案或法规的规定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I use a taxi or livery vehicle to drive for a TNC?
source_blocks.text: 我可以使用出租车或礼宾车为TNC驾驶吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. The TNC Act prohibits taxis, livery vehicles, limousines or licensed for-hire vehicles from being used as a TNC vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。TNC法案禁止将出租车、礼宾车、豪华轿车或持照的出租车辆用作TNC车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the insurance requirements for a TNC driver?
source_blocks.text: TNC司机的保险要求是什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: TNC companies will make sure TNC drivers understand and have the required insurance. If you are interested in being a TNC driver, you should contact a TNC you are interested in working with.
source_blocks.text: TNC公司将确保TNC司机了解并拥有所需的保险。如果您有兴趣成为TNC司机，您应该联系您感兴趣合作的TNC。

source_blocks.source_text_en: May a driver be authorized by more than one TNC?
source_blocks.text: 司机可以被多个TNC授权吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: That is up to the TNC you want to work for, as there is no legal limit to driving for more than one TNC.
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您想为之工作的TNC，因为法律上没有限制为多个TNC驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I am an authorized TNC driver, may I pick up passengers in New York City?
source_blocks.text: 如果我是授权的TNC司机，我可以在纽约市接载乘客吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, not unless you are separately authorized by the New York City Taxi & Limousine Commission: www.nyc.gov/taxi [1].
source_blocks.text: 不，除非您另行获得纽约市出租车与豪华轿车委员会的授权：www.nyc.gov/taxi [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I am an authorized TNC driver, may I drop off a TNC passenger in New York City that I picked up outside the City?
source_blocks.text: 如果我是经授权的TNC司机，我是否可以在纽约市放下我在市外接载的TNC乘客？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes.
source_blocks.text: 可以。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I am licensed to operate for hire by the New York City Taxi & Limousine Commission, can I work as a TNC driver outside of New York City?
source_blocks.text: 如果我获得纽约市出租车与豪华轿车委员会的许可，可以在纽约市外作为TNC司机工作吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes but only if you are authorized by a licensed TNC company, and only if you use a different vehicle than you drive for hire in New York City (taxi and livery vehicles may not be used for TNC operation).
source_blocks.text: 可以，但前提是您获得持牌TNC公司的授权，并且仅当您使用的车辆不同于在纽约市用于出租运营的车辆（出租车和礼宾车不得用于TNC运营）。

documents.doc_id: Federal REAL ID#3_0
documents.source_title_en: Federal REAL ID
documents.title: 联邦真实身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal REAL ID
source_blocks.text: 联邦真实身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: What REAL ID means to you
source_blocks.text: 真实身份证对您意味着什么

source_blocks.source_text_en: Beginning on October 1, 2020, the federal government will require your driver license, permit or ID card to be REAL ID compliant if you wish to use it as identification to board a domestic flight (within the U.S.), or enter military bases and certain federal facilities.
source_blocks.text: 从2020年10月1日起，如果您希望使用驾驶执照、许可证或身份证作为身份证明来搭乘国内航班（美国境内）、进入军事基地和某些联邦设施，联邦政府将要求其符合真实身份证标准。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Enhanced driver license, permit, or non-driver ID [1] and valid U.S. Passport are already REAL ID compliant and can be used to board a flight.
source_blocks.text: 增强版驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员身份证[1]以及有效的美国护照已经符合真实身份证标准，可用于登机。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please visit www.dhs.gov [2] for more REAL ID information.
source_blocks.text: 请访问www.dhs.gov [2]了解更多真实身份证信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The REAL ID Act
source_blocks.text: 真实身份证法案

source_blocks.source_text_en: Passed by Congress in 2005, the REAL ID Act establishes minimum security standards for state-issued driver licenses, permits and ID cards. The Act also prohibits federal agencies, like the Transportation Security Administration (TSA), from accepting cards for official purposes from states that do not meet these standards.
source_blocks.text: 2005年由国会通过，真实身份证法案为各州颁发的驾驶执照、许可证和身份证确立了最低安全标准。该法案还禁止联邦机构（如运输安全管理局（TSA））接受不符合这些标准的州签发的证件用于官方目的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State DMV began issuing REAL ID licenses, permits, and ID cards on October 30, 2017
source_blocks.text: 纽约州DMV于2017年10月30日开始颁发真实身份证驾驶执照、许可证和身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get a REAL ID at any time, but you will need to go to a DMV Office. You cannot get a REAL ID online, by phone, or through mail.
source_blocks.text: 您可以随时申请真实身份证，但您需要前往DMV办公室。您不能通过在线、电话或邮件方式申请真实身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You MUST bring to the office the following original or certified proof documents:
source_blocks.text: 您必须携带以下原始或认证证明文件到办公室：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of identity, such as valid license, birth certificate or passport, with your full first, middle (if applicable) and last name. This name, as it appears on your proof of identity, will be displayed on your card as required by federal law. Proof of Social Security Number or Social Security Number ineligibility. If you a valid NY license, permit or ID card, you must bring your original social security card or W-2 with full SSN. If you a New York State driver license or identification card, you must bring your Social Security Card or a letter from the Social Security Administration proving your ineligibility to have a social security number. If you lost your Social Security Card, you must get a duplicate before you come to the DMV. The Social Security Administration website has more information on obtaining a duplicate card [4]. Proof of your date of birth. Proof of U.S. citizenship, lawful permanent residency or temporary lawful status in the U.S. Two different proofs of New York State residence such as utility bill, bank statement or mortgage statement (P.O. Box not acceptable). This address will be displayed on your card. If the name on your license, permit, or non-driver ID application does not match the name on your identity, lawful status, and social security proofs you must bring in court or government issued proof(s) documenting the event(s) causing your name change(s) such as a marriage license(s), divorce decree(s), adoption, or court order document(s).
source_blocks.text: 身份证明，如有效的驾驶执照、出生证明或护照，需包含您的全名（名、中间名（如有）和姓）。此姓名将按照联邦法律要求显示在您的卡片上，与您的身份证明上的姓名一致。 社会安全号码或不符合社会安全号码资格的证明。如果您持有有效的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或身份证，您必须携带您的原始社会安全卡或带有完整社会安全号码的W-2表格。如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照或身份证，您必须携带您的社会安全卡或社会安全管理局出具的信函，证明您不符合拥有社会安全号码的资格。如果您丢失了社会安全卡，您必须在前往DMV之前补办。社会安全管理局网站有更多关于补办卡片的信息[4]。 出生日期证明。 美国公民身份、合法永久居留权或在美国的临时合法身份证明。 两份不同的纽约州居住证明，如水电费账单、银行对账单或抵押贷款对账单（不接受邮政信箱）。此地址将显示在您的卡片上。 如果您的驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员身份证申请上的姓名与您的身份、合法身份和社会安全证明上的姓名不符，您必须携带法院或政府签发的证明文件，记录导致您姓名变更的事件，如结婚证、离婚判决书、收养文件或法院命令文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The application process also requires the DMV to take a new photo.
source_blocks.text: 申请过程还要求DMV拍摄新照片。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complete this guide to find out exactly what proof documents are needed before going to an office.
source_blocks.text: 完成本指南，了解在前往办公室之前需要哪些确切的证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find your proofs [5]
source_blocks.text: 查找您的证明文件 [5]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Cost for a REAL ID
source_blocks.text: 真实身份证的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is no additional cost to get a REAL ID. All normal transaction fees still apply.
source_blocks.text: 申请真实身份证没有额外费用。所有正常交易费用仍然适用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to apply for an Enhanced Driver License [1] or Enhanced ID Card [6], there is an additional \$30 fee.
source_blocks.text: 如果您想申请增强版驾驶执照[1]或增强版身份证[6]，需额外支付\$30费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sample of Enhanced, REAL ID, and Standard License
source_blocks.text: 增强版、REAL ID 和标准驾照样本

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [7].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于增强版、REAL ID 和标准文件的信息 [7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Getting a REAL ID is mandatory but is encouraged
source_blocks.text: 获取 REAL ID 是强制性的，但鼓励办理

source_blocks.source_text_en: A REAL ID is optional and is not needed for the following:
source_blocks.text: REAL ID 是可选的，以下情况不需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Being licensed to drive Voting or registering to vote Entering Federal facilities that do not require a person to present identification Applying for or receiving Federal benefits Accessing health or life preserving services (including hospitals and health clinics), law enforcement, or constitutionally protected activities (including a defendant s access to court proceedings) Participating in law enforcement proceedings or investigations
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照 投票或登记投票 进入不需要出示身份证件的联邦设施 申请或领取联邦福利 获得医疗或生命保障服务（包括医院和诊所）、执法或受宪法保护的活动（包括被告出庭） 参与执法程序或调查

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you decide you do not want a REAL ID or Enhanced document, please be advised that any license, permit or ID card issued after October 30, 2017 will be marked Not for Federal Purposes .
source_blocks.text: 如果您决定不需要 REAL ID 或增强版文件，请注意，2017年10月30日之后颁发的任何驾照、许可证或身份证件将标记为“不适用于联邦用途”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a U.S. Passport, it can be used for identification, boarding a plane for domestic and international flights, and entry into a federal building or military base.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有美国护照，可用于身份证明、国内和国际航班登机，以及进入联邦大楼或军事基地。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under 18 years old
source_blocks.text: 未满18岁

source_blocks.source_text_en: TSA does not currently require children under 18 years old to provide identification when traveling with a companion within the United States. The companion will need acceptable identification. Please visit www.tsa.gov [8] for more information.
source_blocks.text: 美国运输安全管理局（TSA）目前不要求未满18岁的儿童在美国境内与成人同行时提供身份证明。同行成人需出示可接受的身份证明。请访问 www.tsa.gov [8] 了解更多信息。

documents.doc_id: File a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request#1_0
documents.source_title_en: File a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request
documents.title: 提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: File a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request
source_blocks.text: 提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: File a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request [1]
source_blocks.text: 提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is FOIL?
source_blocks.text: 什么是 FOIL？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The NY State Freedom of Information Law provides access to state and local government records. See the Committee on Open Government [2] for more information.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州信息自由法提供对州和地方政府记录的访问。更多信息请参见开放政府委员会 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need to use FOIL?
source_blocks.text: 我需要使用 FOIL 吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Many DMV records are available using the Request for DMV Records (PDF) [3] (MV-15). Check the MV-15 form carefully before you submit a FOIL request for DMV records. If you use the MV-15, you will often receive records sooner than if you submitted a FOIL request.
source_blocks.text: 许多 DMV 记录可通过 DMV 记录请求表 (PDF) [3] (MV-15) 获取。在提交 FOIL 请求前，请仔细检查 MV-15 表格。如果您使用 MV-15，通常会比提交 FOIL 请求更快收到记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What DMV Records may I request under FOIL?
source_blocks.text: 根据 FOIL，我可以请求哪些 DMV 记录？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may request any DMV records under FOIL. However, certain records or parts of records can be withheld under Section 87(2) of the NY State Public Officers Law.
source_blocks.text: 您可以根据 FOIL 请求任何 DMV 记录。但是，根据纽约州公职人员法第 87(2) 条，某些记录或部分记录可能被扣留。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you request DMV records under FOIL, DMV will send you a letter within 5 business days after we receive your request. This letter will tell you your request was received.. In most cases, the records will be made available within 20 business days from the date of the acknowledgment letter. In some cases, it may take longer than 20 business days to produce records under FOIL. If the DMV cannot provide your records within 20 business days, we will tell you the date the records will be available.
source_blocks.text: 当您根据 FOIL 请求 DMV 记录时，DMV 将在收到您的请求后的 5 个工作日内向您发送一封信。这封信将告知您请求已收到。在大多数情况下，记录将在确认信日期后的 20 个工作日内提供。在某些情况下，根据 FOIL 生成记录可能需要超过 20 个工作日。如果 DMV 无法在 20 个工作日内提供您的记录，我们将告知您记录可用的日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the DMV Subject Matter List of Records [4].
source_blocks.text: 请参阅 DMV 记录主题列表 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I make a FOIL request?
source_blocks.text: 如何提出 FOIL 请求？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 1: Determine if you need to request under FOIL
source_blocks.text: 步骤 1：确定您是否需要根据 FOIL 提出请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read the Request for DMV Records (PDF) [3] (MV-15) to determine if the records are available without a request under the FOIL. If the record you are requesting is available by using the MV-15, doing so may allow you to receive your records more quickly than filing a FOIL request.
source_blocks.text: 阅读 DMV 记录请求表 (PDF) [3] (MV-15)，以确定记录是否无需根据 FOIL 提出请求即可获取。如果您请求的记录可通过使用 MV-15 获取，这样做可能使您比提交 FOIL 请求更快收到记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2: Make your request in writing
source_blocks.text: 步骤 2：书面提出您的请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you decide that you are eligible to request the records under FOIL, you must make your FOIL request in writing.
source_blocks.text: 如果您决定您有资格根据 FOIL 请求记录，您必须以书面形式提出 FOIL 请求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To make a request under FOIL do one of the following
source_blocks.text: 要根据 FOIL 提出请求，请执行以下操作之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: complete the Freedom of Information Law Request Form (PDF) [5] (MV-FOIL)
source_blocks.text: 填写信息自由法请求表 (PDF) [5] (MV-FOIL)

source_blocks.source_text_en: or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: write a letter that describes the records you seek. Make sure you include your mailing address or email address. This will allow the DMV to send the records to you.
source_blocks.text: 写一封描述你所需记录的信。确保包含你的邮寄地址或电子邮件地址。这将使DMV能够将记录发送给你。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 3: Submit your request
source_blocks.text: 第三步：提交你的请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the records you are requesting include personal information, please also include a photocopy of your driver license or other government issued photo ID card. If you wish, you may black out the picture. You must identify your permissible use for the record you are requesting. Permissible uses are listed on Page 2 of the MV-15FOIL.
source_blocks.text: 如果你请求的记录包含个人信息，请同时附上你的驾驶执照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证的复印件。如果你愿意，可以涂黑照片。你必须说明你请求记录的允许用途。允许用途列在MV-15FOIL的第2页。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your request, form or letter to
source_blocks.text: 将你的请求、表格或信件寄至

source_blocks.source_text_en: Records Access OfficerNew York State Department of Motor VehiclesFOIL Office6 Empire State Plaza, Room 136BAlbany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: Records Access OfficerNew York State Department of Motor VehiclesFOIL Office6 Empire State Plaza, Room 136BAlbany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: Email
source_blocks.text: 电子邮件

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read and complete the Freedom of Information Law Request Form (PDF) [5] (MV-FOIL). Attach the completed form to your email request. Email your request to [email protected] [6]
source_blocks.text: 阅读并填写《信息自由法请求表》(PDF) [5] (MV-FOIL)。将填写完整的表格附在你的电子邮件请求中。将你的请求发送至 [email protected] [6]

source_blocks.source_text_en: or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Email with your request to [email protected] [6]. In your message, include your name and mailing address or email address. Attach a copy of your government issued photo ID, if required.
source_blocks.text: 通过电子邮件将你的请求发送至 [email protected] [6]。在邮件中，包含你的姓名和邮寄地址或电子邮件地址。如有要求，附上你政府签发的带照片身份证的复印件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When will I get a response?
source_blocks.text: 我何时会收到回复？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The FOIL office will respond to your request within 5 business days of receiving the request. We will either provide you with the record requested or acknowledge receipt of your request. We will also provide a time frame for when you can expect to receive the record you requested.
source_blocks.text: FOIL办公室将在收到请求后的5个工作日内回复你的请求。我们将要么提供你请求的记录，要么确认收到你的请求。我们还会提供一个时间范围，说明你预计何时能收到所请求的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there a fee for records I request under FOIL?
source_blocks.text: 根据FOIL请求记录需要付费吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The law authorizes us to charge a \$10.00 search fee to determine if the records you requested are available. Your payment of the search fee does not guarantee that you will receive the records that you requested. We cannot refund the search fee.
source_blocks.text: 是的。法律授权我们收取\$10.00的搜索费，以确定你请求的记录是否可用。支付搜索费并不保证你会收到所请求的记录。搜索费不予退还。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will tell you if the records that you requested are available or not available. If the records are available and you want paper copies, we charge a copy fee of \$1.00 for each page. A page is a single sheet of paper, whether one-sided or two-sided.
source_blocks.text: 我们会告知你请求的记录是否可用。如果记录可用且你想要纸质副本，我们每页收取\$1.00的复印费。一页指一张纸，无论单面还是双面。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may pay the fees by credit card, or by a check or money order made payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.
source_blocks.text: 你可以通过信用卡、支票或汇票支付费用，收款人为Commissioner of Motor Vehicles。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The FOIL office will not release the record you have requested until payment has been received in full.
source_blocks.text: FOIL办公室在收到全额付款之前不会发布你请求的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When searches are being performed for a public purpose by certain individuals or organizations, they are exempt from paying search fees. The ONLY individuals or organizations this applies to are:
source_blocks.text: 当某些个人或组织为公共目的进行搜索时，他们免于支付搜索费。这仅适用于以下个人或组织：

source_blocks.source_text_en: government agencies volunteer fire companies volunteer ambulance services public officers, boards, or bodies legal aid bureaus or societies or other private entities when acting pursuant to Section 722 of the New York State County Law
source_blocks.text: 政府机构 志愿消防公司 志愿救护服务 公职人员、委员会或机构 法律援助局或协会，或根据《纽约州郡法》第722条行事的其他私人实体

source_blocks.source_text_en: When and where can I inspect copies of DMV records?
source_blocks.text: 我可以在何时何地查阅DMV记录的副本？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Records rarely can be produced on the same day that they are requested. Most DMV records are available within twenty (20) business days of the FOIL Office's written acknowledgment of your request. If a phone number was provided with your request, the FOIL office will call you when your records are ready to be inspected. Otherwise you will be notified by mail.
source_blocks.text: 记录很少能在请求当天生成。大多数DMV记录在FOIL办公室书面确认您的请求后的二十（20）个工作日内可用。如果您的请求中提供了电话号码，FOIL办公室将在您的记录准备好供查阅时致电给您。否则，您将通过邮件收到通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When the records you requested are ready to be inspected, you will need to come to the
source_blocks.text: 当您请求的记录准备好供查阅时，您需要前往

source_blocks.source_text_en: Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Customer Service Counter is open 8:00am to 3:45pm, Monday through Friday, except state holidays.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Selling a retail vehicle as is
source_blocks.text: 按现状销售零售车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some exceptions allow you to use a Salvage Certificate (MV-907A) to sell a vehicle as "junk". The DMV cannot issue a title certificate or a registration to a junk vehicle or a salvage vehicle that is rebuilt unless the vehicle passes a salvage vehicle examination. If a title certificate is issued it will receive a brand that displays "REBUILT SALVAGE:NY".
source_blocks.text: 某些例外情况允许您使用Salvage Certificate (MV-907A)将车辆作为“junk”出售。DMV不能为junk车辆或经过重建的salvage车辆颁发title certificate或注册，除非车辆通过salvage车辆检查。如果颁发了title certificate，它将带有“REBUILT SALVAGE:NY”的标记。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Selling price on Retail Certificates of Sale (MV-50) if I sell a vehicle wholesale
source_blocks.text: 如果批发销售车辆，在Retail Certificates of Sale (MV-50)上的销售价格

source_blocks.source_text_en: The selling price is not required on form MV-50 when a vehicle is sold wholesale.
source_blocks.text: 当车辆批发销售时，MV-50表格上不需要填写销售价格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Inspection required out-of-state customer
source_blocks.text: 外州客户所需的检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: A New York State inspection is not required for a vehicle registered in another state.
source_blocks.text: 对于在另一个州注册的车辆，不需要进行纽约州检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Warranty on a vehicle that has at least 110,000 miles was sold to a retail customer for \$1,295
source_blocks.text: 一辆至少有110,000英里的车辆以\$1,295的价格卖给零售客户的保修

source_blocks.source_text_en: These terms refer to the warranties described by the Office of the Attorney General (website: www.ag.ny.gov [3]) in the 'Lemon Law'. The Vehicle and Traffic Law requires a dealer to complete the Used Vehicle Certification on form MV-50. The law applies to all vehicles sold at any selling price and which display any odometer reading. The vehicle must be acceptable for use on the road at the time of sale.
source_blocks.text: 这些术语指的是Office of the Attorney General (网站：www.ag.ny.gov [3])在'Lemon Law'中描述的保修。Vehicle and Traffic Law要求经销商在MV-50表格上完成Used Vehicle Certification。该法律适用于以任何销售价格出售并显示任何里程表读数的所有车辆。车辆在销售时必须适合在道路上使用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary registration expiring soon
source_blocks.text: 临时注册即将到期

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you cannot get the title certificate for a vehicle you sold and the temporary registration expires soon, you cannot get another temporary registration. According to the DMV Commissioner's Regulations, you cannot sell a vehicle if you do not have proof of ownership. You cannot issue an additional temporary registration under any circumstances.
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法为已售车辆获得title certificate，且临时注册即将到期，您不能获得另一个临时注册。根据DMV Commissioner's Regulations，如果您没有所有权证明，就不能出售车辆。在任何情况下，您都不能签发额外的临时注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surety bond

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get a surety bond, you must contact a surety insurance company.
