source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a hazardous materials (HazMat) endorsement
source_blocks.text: 获取危险品（HazMat）签注

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get a hazardous materials (HazMat) endorsement?
source_blocks.text: 如何获取危险品（HazMat）签注？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must first have a CDL to apply for the HazMat endorsement. A driver with a NY State CDL must have an "H" or an "X" HazMat endorsement to operate commercial motor vehicles that carry hazardous materials. Read the CDL Manual [1] (CDL-10), Hazardous Materials Manual (pdf) [2] (CDL-11), and Driver License Class Descriptions (pdf) [3] (MV-500C) for more information.
source_blocks.text: 您必须首先持有CDL才能申请HazMat签注。持有纽约州CDL的驾驶员必须具有“H”或“X”HazMat签注，才能操作运输危险品的商用机动车。请阅读CDL手册[1]（CDL-10）、危险品手册（pdf）[2]（CDL-11）和驾驶执照类别说明（pdf）[3]（MV-500C）以获取更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What requirements do I have to meet to apply for a HazMat endorsement?
source_blocks.text: 申请HazMat签注需要满足哪些要求？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must be a U.S. citizen or a lawful permanent resident of the U.S. and present proof of citizenship or resident status at the time you apply for the hazardous materials endorsement. See Important Information about the Hazardous Materials Endorsement (pdf) [4] (HAZ-11) for a list of acceptable proof of citizenship or resident status. You must meet the federal medical requirements in 49 CFR Part 391 and have a valid USDOT Medical Examiner's Certificate. See Medical Certification Requirements [5] for more information. You must be fingerprinted for background checks. 1
source_blocks.text: 您必须是美国公民或美国合法永久居民，并在申请危险品签注时出示公民身份或居民身份的证明。有关可接受的公民身份或居民身份证明文件列表，请参阅《关于危险品签注的重要信息》（pdf）[4]（HAZ-11）。 您必须满足49 CFR第391部分中的联邦医疗要求，并持有有效的USDOT体检医师证明。有关更多信息，请参阅医疗认证要求[5]。 您必须进行指纹采集以进行背景调查。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there anything that may disqualify me from getting a HazMat endorsement?
source_blocks.text: 是否有任何情况可能使我没有资格获得HazMat签注？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, under federal law, the Federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) may disqualify you from being authorized to transport hazardous materials if
source_blocks.text: 是的，根据联邦法律，联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）可能取消您运输危险品的授权资格，如果：

source_blocks.source_text_en: you have been convicted or found not guilty by reason of insanity of any of the crimes listed on Important Information about the Hazardous Materials Endorsement (pdf) [4] (HAZ-11) during the seven years before the date you apply for the endorsement you have been released from incarceration in any jurisdiction for committing any disqualifying crime during the five years before the date you applied for the endorsement.
source_blocks.text: 在您申请签注日期之前的七年内，您曾因《关于危险品签注的重要信息》（pdf）[4]（HAZ-11）中列出的任何罪行被定罪或因精神错乱而被判无罪 在您申请签注日期之前的五年内，您因犯有任何取消资格的罪行而从任何司法管辖区的监禁中获释。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for the HazMat endorsement?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请HazMat签注？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complete the Application for a Hazardous Materials Endorsement (pdf) \6\ and make a copy of one or more of the legal status documents that are listed on the form. Mail the completed form and a copy of your legal status document(s) to:
source_blocks.text: 填写《危险品签注申请表》（pdf）[6]（HAZ-44），并复印表格上所列的一份或多份合法身份证明文件。将填好的表格和您的合法身份证明文件副本邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: HazMat UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: HazMat部门纽约州DMV帝国广场6号纽约州奥尔巴尼市，邮编12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may contact the HazMat unit if you have questions by phone at 1-518-408-2997 or email at [email protected] [7]
source_blocks.text: 如有疑问，您可以通过电话1-518-408-2997或电子邮件[email protected][7]联系HazMat部门。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need to take a written test?
source_blocks.text: 我需要参加笔试吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, you must pass a HazMat endorsement written test. You must visit a DMV office to pay the \$5.00 written test fee and take the test. The test result is valid until your CDL expires. 2
source_blocks.text: 是的，您必须通过HazMat签注笔试。您必须前往DMV办公室支付\$5.00的笔试费用并参加考试。考试成绩在您的CDL到期前有效。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can study the hazardous materials section of the NYS Commercial Driver License Manual [1] (CDL-10), or study the Hazardous Materials Manual (pdf) [2] (CDL-11).
source_blocks.text: 您可以学习纽约州商用驾驶执照手册[1]（CDL-10）中的危险品部分，或学习危险品手册（pdf）[2]（CDL-11）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I provide my fingerprints for background checks?
source_blocks.text: 如何提供我的指纹以进行背景调查？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The required fingerprinting service is being provided by Identogo. All HazMat endorsement applicants must be fingerprinted at one of the Identogo ID centers located throughout New York State. 3 4
source_blocks.text: 所需的指纹采集服务由Identogo提供。所有HazMat签注申请人都必须在纽约州各地的Identogo ID中心之一进行指纹采集。3 4

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fingerprinting is done by appointment only. You must contact Identogo to select a fingerprinting location and schedule an appointment. Visit https://uenroll.identogo.com [8] or by calling 1-877-472-6915.
source_blocks.text: 指纹采集仅限预约。您必须联系Identogo选择指纹采集地点并安排预约。请访问https://uenroll.identogo.com [8]或致电1-877-472-6915。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Attain Fingerprinting Services Information [9] (HAZ-600) to make your appointment. Bring your NY State CDL and one of the second proofs of ID that are listed on form HAZ-600 to the appointment site.
source_blocks.text: 获取指纹服务信息 [9] (HAZ-600) 以预约。预约时请携带您的纽约州CDL和HAZ-600表格上列出的第二种身份证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long will the background checks take and how will I be notified of the results?
source_blocks.text: 背景调查需要多长时间，我将如何收到结果通知？

source_blocks.source_text_en: It normally takes at least 30 days from the date you submit your fingerprints to complete the background check. However, the time period can be longer than 30 days.
source_blocks.text: 通常从您提交指纹之日起至少需要30天才能完成背景调查。然而，时间可能会超过30天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) will notify you by mail of the results of the background check based on federal standards only. The TSA website [10] has information about the federal background checks for the HazMat endorsements. 5
source_blocks.text: 联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）将根据联邦标准通过邮件通知您背景调查结果。TSA网站 [10] 有关于危险品背书的联邦背景调查信息。5

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please do not request the results of background checks from the DMV, Identogo, or the TSA. Wait to receive the notifications in the mail.
source_blocks.text: 请不要向DMV、Identogo或TSA索取背景调查结果。请等待邮件通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a temporary HazMat endorsement before the background checks are complete?
source_blocks.text: 在背景调查完成之前，我可以获得临时危险品背书吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. We cannot issue the HazMat endorsement until the background checks are completed and approved. The DMV will provide a CDL with the HazMat endorsement that is valid for 90 days only if
source_blocks.text: 不可以。在背景调查完成并批准之前，我们不能签发危险品背书。DMV将仅在以下情况下提供带有危险品背书的CDL，该背书有效期为90天：

source_blocks.source_text_en: you applied to renew a current NY State CDL with a HazMat endorsement the background checks are not completed and approved before the endorsement expires.
source_blocks.text: 您申请续期当前纽约州带有危险品背书的CDL 背景调查在背书到期前未完成并批准。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I do not pass the written test or the background checks?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有通过笔试或背景调查怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not pass the written test or the background checks, the DMV will issue a CDL that does not have a HazMat endorsement.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有通过笔试或背景调查，DMV将签发不带危险品背书的CDL。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How will I know whether or not my application has been approved?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道我的申请是否已获批准？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will mail you notification of approval along with instructions to go into a DMV office to obtain a CDL with the HazMat endorsement. Your new CDL will display the expiration date of your CDL and the expiration date of your HazMat endorsement. The endorsement is valid for five years.
source_blocks.text: 我们将通过邮件通知您批准结果，并附上前往DMV办公室获取带有危险品背书的CDL的说明。您的新CDL将显示您的CDL到期日期和危险品背书的到期日期。该背书有效期为五年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal and State laws require fingerprint-based background checks for anyone who wants a hazardous materials endorsement, to determine whether that person has a criminal history and/or poses a security threat that warrants denying him or her the authorization to transport hazardous materials. No hazardous materials endorsement may be issued, transferred or renewed unless the background checks result in a determination by the Federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and New York State that the person applying for the endorsement is authorized to transport hazardous materials. To initiate background checks, the rules require that the applicant be fingerprinted, and that his or her United States citizenship or permanent legal presence in the United States be verified. You must answer 80% or more of the questions correctly to pass the test. You can take the test as many times as necessary until you pass the test, but you must pay a \$5 fee for each test you take. You must provide fingerprints even if you provided fingerprints for another application, for example for a pistol permit or employment as a security guard. You must provide fingerprints for an H endorsement or an X endorsement on your CDL. The background checks include a check of criminal history data from the NY State Division of Criminal Justice Services and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). There is also a background check by the federal Transportation Safety Administration (TSA).
source_blocks.text: 联邦和州法律要求任何想要获得危险品背书的人进行基于指纹的背景调查，以确定该人是否有犯罪史和/或是否构成安全威胁，从而有必要拒绝其运输危险品的授权。除非背景调查结果使联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）和纽约州确定申请背书的人被授权运输危险品，否则不得签发、转让或续期任何危险品背书。为启动背景调查，规定要求申请人提供指纹，并核实其美国公民身份或在美国的永久合法居留身份。 您必须正确回答80%或以上的问题才能通过考试。您可以多次参加考试，直到通过为止，但每次考试需支付\$5费用。 即使您为其他申请（例如手枪许可证或保安工作）提供过指纹，您也必须提供指纹。 您必须为您的CDL上的H背书或X背书提供指纹。 背景调查包括对纽约州刑事司法服务处和联邦调查局（FBI）的犯罪历史数据的检查。还有联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）进行的背景调查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get the New York State Commercial Driver's Manual [2] (CDL-10) online or from a DMV office [3] or call center. source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2: Apply for a commercial learner permit at a DMV office
source_blocks.text: Step 2: Apply for a commercial learner permit at a DMV office

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must pass the written test for the CDL that you need. There is an application fee of \$10.00. This fee allows you to take all written tests (knowledge and endorsement) required for permit and license issuance applied for which are taken at the same time. There will be an additional \$5 fee for any other required tests not taken and passed at the time of initial application. There is a fee of \$40.00 to take the CDL road test (skills test). You can pay the road test fee when the DMV office issues your commercial learner permit, or you can pay the fee online [6]. You must pay the fee before you can schedule your road test.
source_blocks.text: You must pass the written test for the CDL that you need. There is an application fee of \$10.00. This fee allows you to take all written tests (knowledge and endorsement) required for permit and license issuance applied for which are taken at the same time. There will be an additional \$5 fee for any other required tests not taken and passed at the time of initial application. There is a fee of \$40.00 to take the CDL road test (skills test). source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I print substitute tickets for all my open TVB tickets?
source_blocks.text: 我可以打印我所有未处理的TVB罚单的替代件吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Once you provide information for one open TVB traffic ticket, you will be able to print any open TVB traffic ticket(s) you have. You will need to print them one at a time.
source_blocks.text: 可以。一旦您提供了一张未处理的TVB交通罚单的信息，您将能够打印您拥有的任何未处理的TVB交通罚单。您需要一次打印一张。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are substitute tickets I print from this transaction the same as tickets printed at a TVB office?
source_blocks.text: 我从此交易中打印的替代罚单与在TVB办公室打印的罚单相同吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. A substitute ticket that you print from this transaction has exactly the same information as tickets printed at a TVB office.
source_blocks.text: 是的。您从此交易中打印的替代罚单与在TVB办公室打印的罚单包含完全相同的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What can I do if my traffic ticket is not available?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的交通罚单不可用，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a traffic ticket is not available to print, the transaction will give you instructions on what you can do. Read all messages in the transaction carefully.
source_blocks.text: 如果交通罚单无法打印，交易将为您提供有关您可以采取的措施的说明。请仔细阅读交易中的所有消息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the traffic ticket was not answerable to a Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB), you cannot use this transaction for the ticket. The TVB does not handle parking violations, criminal driving violations (for example, DWI) or tickets answerable in a local court. If the ticket has been dismissed, or if there was a conviction and the fines, the fees and the surcharges were all paid, the ticket is a 'closed' ticket.
source_blocks.text: 如果交通罚单不属于交通违规局（TVB）处理范围，您不能使用此交易处理该罚单。TVB不处理停车违规、刑事驾驶违规（例如，酒驾）或需在地方法院处理的罚单。 如果罚单已被撤销，或者已有定罪且罚款、费用和附加费均已支付，则该罚单为“已结案”罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a driver license
source_blocks.text: 获取驾驶执照

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a driver license [1]
source_blocks.text: 获取驾驶执照 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State residents age 16 or over can apply for a New York driver license.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州16岁及以上居民可以申请纽约驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 1: Determine what license class and type you need
source_blocks.text: 第一步：确定您需要的执照类别和类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: Class: most people get a class D - Operator (if 18 or older) or a DJ - Junior Operator (if under 18). See instructions to get a
source_blocks.text: 类别：大多数人获得D类 - 操作员（如果18岁或以上）或DJ类 - 初级操作员（如果未满18岁）。请参阅说明以获取

source_blocks.source_text_en: class A, B, C- commercial license (CDL) [2] class M - motorcycle license [3] class E - taxi or limousine (livery) license [4]
source_blocks.text: A、B、C类 - 商业执照（CDL） [2] M类 - 摩托车执照 [3] E类 - 出租车或豪华轿车（包车）执照 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Type: DMV offers 3 types of licenses. Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [5].
source_blocks.text: 类型：DMV提供3种类型的执照。了解增强版、REAL ID和标准文件 [5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2: Get a learner permit
source_blocks.text: 第二步：获取学习许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you can get a license, you must apply for a learner permitat DMV office and take the written test. You can prepare by reading the New York State Driver's Manual and taking practice tests.
source_blocks.text: 在您获得执照之前，您必须到DMV办公室申请学习许可证并参加笔试。您可以通过阅读纽约州驾驶员手册和参加模拟测试来准备。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to get a learner permit [6].
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获取学习许可证 [6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 3: Practice driving and take a pre-licensing course
source_blocks.text: 第三步：练习驾驶并参加考前课程

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you have a learner permit, you must have supervised driving practice and you must take a pre-licensing course or a driver education course before you take your road test.
source_blocks.text: 一旦您持有学习许可证，您必须进行有监督的驾驶练习，并且在参加路考之前必须参加考前课程或驾驶员教育课程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to find a pre-licensing course and prepare for your road test [7].
source_blocks.text: 了解如何找到考前课程并为路考做准备 [7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 4: Pass a road test
source_blocks.text: 第四步：通过路考

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you pass your test, the examiner will give you an interim license that allows you to drive. Keep the interim license with your photo learner permit until your new license arrives in the mail (in about 2 weeks).
source_blocks.text: 如果您通过考试，考官会给您一份临时执照，允许您驾驶。请将临时执照与您的带照片学习许可证一起保管，直到您的新执照邮寄到达（大约2周内）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See how to schedule and take a road test [8].
source_blocks.text: 查看如何安排和参加路考 [8]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fees
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fees depend on what you are applying for, your age, and where you live. Use the fee chart to estimate your fee [9].
source_blocks.text: 费用取决于您申请的内容、您的年龄以及您居住的地方。使用费用表估算您的费用 [9]。

source_blocks.text: 更换、续期、恢复或交换

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace
source_blocks.text: 更换

source_blocks.source_text_en: See how to replace a license that was lost, stolen or destroyed [10].
source_blocks.text: 了解如何更换丢失、被盗或损毁的驾照 [10]。

source_blocks.text: 续期

source_blocks.source_text_en: See how to renew your license [11].
source_blocks.text: 了解如何续期您的驾照 [11]。

source_blocks.text: 恢复

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to restore your driving privilege and reapply for your license after a revocation [12].
source_blocks.text: 了解在驾照被吊销后如何恢复驾驶资格并重新申请驾照 [12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Exchange out-of-state license
source_blocks.text: 交换外州驾照

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are from another state, see how to exchange your out-of-state driver license [13]. If you are coming here from another country (overseas), see information about visiting or moving to New York [14].
source_blocks.text: 如果您来自其他州，请了解如何交换您的外州驾照 [13]。如果您从其他国家（海外）来到这里，请参阅关于访问或移居纽约的信息 [14]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are you under 18
source_blocks.text: 如果您未满18岁

source_blocks.source_text_en: Graduated license law
source_blocks.text: 分级驾照法律

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under age 18 or are the parent of a driver under age 18, it is very important that you understand the Graduated Driver License (GDL) Law and the restrictions on drivers under age 18 [15].
source_blocks.text: 如果您未满18岁，或者您是未满18岁驾驶员的父母，了解分级驾照（GDL）法律以及对未满18岁驾驶员的限制非常重要 [15]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Senior license before 18
source_blocks.text: 18岁前的高级驾照

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are 17, you are eligible for a senior driver license (Class D or M) if you have a junior driver license or limited junior driver license and have completed a state-approved high school or college driver education course. To change your junior license to a senior license, bring your junior license and the Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285) that you received from your instructor to any DMV office [16]. You must return your certificate and junior license to receive the senior license. If you do not change your junior license to a senior license, you are subject to the restrictions for junior drivers until you are age 18, even if you carry the completion certificate with you. You can also give your certificate with your junior permit to the license examiner at your road test.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满17岁，并且持有初级驾照或有限初级驾照，并且已完成州批准的高中或大学驾驶员教育课程，您就有资格获得高级驾照（D类或M类）。要将您的初级驾照更换为高级驾照，请携带您的初级驾照和您从教练那里收到的学生完成证书（MV-285）前往任何DMV办公室 [16]。您必须交回您的证书和初级驾照才能获得高级驾照。如果您不将初级驾照更换为高级驾照，您将受到初级驾驶员限制的约束，直到您年满18岁，即使您随身携带完成证书也是如此。您也可以在路考时将您的证书和初级许可证交给驾照考官。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you turn 18
source_blocks.text: 年满18岁时

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not eligible for a senior license you turn 18, you will automatically receive a senior license in the mail when you turn 18.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在年满18岁时没有资格获得高级驾照，您将在年满18岁时自动通过邮件收到高级驾照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Probationary period for new drivers
source_blocks.text: 新驾驶员试用期

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you pass your road test or restore a revoked driver license, you will have 6 month probationary period. During this time, your license will be suspended for 60 days if you are convicted of any the following
source_blocks.text: 一旦你通过路考或恢复被吊销的驾驶执照，你将有一个6个月的试用期。在此期间，如果你被判定犯有以下任何一项违规行为，你的驾照将被吊销60天

source_blocks.source_text_en: speeding participating in a speed contest reckless driving following too closely use of a mobile telephone use of a portable electronic device (for example a smart phone, tablet, GPS or MP3 player) any 2 other moving violations
source_blocks.text: 超速 参与速度竞赛 鲁莽驾驶 跟车过近 使用移动电话 使用便携式电子设备（例如智能手机、平板电脑、GPS或MP3播放器） 任何其他2项移动违规行为

source_blocks.source_text_en: After the suspension ends, you will have a second 6 month probation period.
source_blocks.text: 暂停期结束后，你将进入第二个6个月的试用期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are convicted of one of the violations above (or 2 other moving violations) during the second probation period, your license will be revoked for at least 6 months. When the revocation ends, you must serve another a 6 month probationary period.
source_blocks.text: 如果你在第二个试用期内被判定犯有上述违规行为之一（或其他2项移动违规行为），你的驾照将被吊销至少6个月。吊销期结束后，你必须再服6个月的试用期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your first license is valid for 5 years
source_blocks.text: 你的第一张驾照有效期为5年

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a Class D, Class DJ, and Class E driver license, the expiration date of your learner permit becomes the expiration date of your driver license. Together the learner permit and the driver license are valid for a maximum of 5 years. When you apply for a learner permit and a driver license, you pay the fee for the length of time that the documents are valid.
source_blocks.text: 对于D类、DJ类和E类驾驶执照，你的学习驾照的到期日将成为你驾驶执照的到期日。学习驾照和驾驶执照合计有效期最长为5年。当你申请学习驾照和驾驶执照时，你需支付证件有效期内相应的费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example, a learner permit that was issued to you in 2014 will be valid until your birthday in 2019. You pay the fee for a document that is valid for 5 years. If you pass your road test in 2017, your driver license will expire in 2019. Your driver license keeps the expiration date of your learner permit. When you a change from a Class DJ junior license to a Class D senior license, the date does not change.
source_blocks.text: 例如，2014年发给你的学习驾照将有效至2019年你的生日。你支付的是有效期为5年的证件费用。如果你在2017年通过路考，你的驾驶执照将在2019年到期。你的驾驶执照保留学习驾照的到期日。当你从DJ类初级驾照转为D类高级驾照时，日期不会改变。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers from other countries
source_blocks.text: 来自其他国家的驾驶员

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You don t need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident. 1
source_blocks.text: 你可以持其他国家的有效驾驶执照在纽约州驾驶。除非你成为纽约州居民，否则无需申请纽约州驾驶执照。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you choose to get a New York driver license (following the steps explained on this page), when you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.
source_blocks.text: 如果你选择获得纽约驾驶执照（按照本页所述步骤操作），当你通过路考时，你必须将你的外国驾驶执照交给DMV路考考官。当地DMV办公室将在60天后销毁你的外国驾驶执照。如果你计划返回祖国并需要你的外国驾驶执照，请向路考考官询问如何确保你的外国驾驶执照不被销毁。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Still haven't found what you're looking for?
source_blocks.text: 还没找到你要找的东西？

source_blocks.source_text_en: See a list of all driver license topics [17].
source_blocks.text: 查看所有驾驶执照主题列表 [17]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definition of Resident per Section 250 (5) of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law: "As used in this section, the term 'resident' shall mean domiciliary, that is, one who lives in this state with the intention of making it a fixed and permanent abode. It shall be presumptive evidence that a person who maintains a place of abode in this state for a period of at least ninety days is a resident of this state."
source_blocks.text: 根据纽约州车辆和交通法第250条第(5)款对居民的定义：“在本节中，‘居民’一词应指户籍居民，即居住在本州并意图将其作为固定和永久住所的人。一个人在本州维持住所至少90天，应被推定为本州居民。”

source_blocks.source_text_en: To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in NY State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.
source_blocks.text: 在纽约州的房屋、住宅、公寓、房间或其他类似地方居住90天，被视为“推定证据”表明你是纽约州居民。如果你在没有纽约州驾驶执照或车辆注册的情况下在纽约州驾驶，警察可以利用这一证据开具交通罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make NY State a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in NY State are usually not considered residents of NY State. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a New York State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.
source_blocks.text: 法官会考虑法律和你意图的证据，并决定你是否是纽约州居民。如果你在另一个州纳税或你的子女在另一个州上学，法官会考虑这些事实来决定你的意图是否是将纽约州作为“固定和永久”的住所。根据这项法律，来自其他州或其他国家在纽约州上学的学生通常不被视为纽约州居民。DMV不决定你是否是纽约州居民，是否必须获得纽约州驾驶执照，或是否必须在纽约州注册车辆。

source_blocks.text: Can I get the motorcycle road test waived?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the accident was filed electronically by police or occurred in one of the five boroughs of New York City, allow at least 14 days from the date of the accident before you search for the report. source_blocks.source_text_en: About
source_blocks.text: About

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can sign up to get email and/or text reminders before your driver license, non-driver ID card, registration or vehicle inspection expires. DMV will also enroll you after you complete an online registration renewal transaction as part of a new initiative to save taxpayers more than \$500,000 per year [2]. You can update your subscription at any time.
source_blocks.text: You can sign up to get email and/or text reminders before your driver license, non-driver ID card, registration or vehicle inspection expires. DMV will also enroll you after you complete an online registration renewal transaction as part of a new initiative to save taxpayers more than \$500,000 per year [2]. You can update your subscription at any time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial driver license (CDL) and commercial learner permit (CLP) holders can also sign up to get email and/or text reminders regarding the status of their medical certifications [3] and medical variances [4].

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your driver license, non-driver ID, registration, inspection, medical certification or medical variance is close to expiring when you sign up, you may not get electronic reminders until the next time it s due.

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received an email from the New York State DMV messages @nydmv.messagingchannel.com about an enhancement to the Electronic Reminder program. Is this real?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, it is. You received the email from mess[email protected] because you are in the DMV Electronic Reminders program. Please do not write to this email address. You will not receive a response. If you need to, see how to contact us [6].

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know if I can get reminders?
source_blocks.text: How do I know if I can get reminders?

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get registration renewal and inspection reminders, you must be the primary registrant (first name listed on a registration, if the vehicle is registered to more than one person).

source_blocks.source_text_en: You won t get reminders if your registration is not eligible to renew (for example, you can t renew if the registration is suspended or revoked).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will the email address I use to sign up replace any other email addresses I previously provided the DMV?

If your vehicle registration is due to expire within the next 75 days, you will probably not receive a paper reminder.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get my own CDL driving record (abstract)
source_blocks.text: 获取我自己的 CDL 驾驶记录（摘要）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get my own CDL driving record (abstract) [1]
source_blocks.text: 获取我自己的 CDL 驾驶记录（摘要）[1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a CDL driving record abstract?
source_blocks.text: 什么是 CDL 驾驶记录摘要？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial (CDL) abstracts show expanded driver history information that is not available on a Standard Driving Record. This includes convictions, suspensions, revocations and other licensing actions in any state in any type of vehicle. Medical Certification Status information and Self-Certification information is also provided. Employers or organizations can get CDL Abstracts for enrolled drivers through the New York DMV License Event Notification Service (LENS). See more information on CDL Abstracts [2].
source_blocks.text: 商业（CDL）摘要显示扩展的驾驶员历史信息，这些信息在标准驾驶记录（Standard Driving Record）上不可用。这包括在任何州驾驶任何类型车辆时的定罪、吊销、撤销和其他许可行动。还提供医疗认证状态（Medical Certification Status）信息和自我认证（Self-Certification）信息。雇主或组织可以通过纽约 DMV 许可证事件通知服务（LENS）为注册驾驶员获取 CDL 摘要。查看更多关于 CDL 摘要的信息 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An abstract of driving record is a certified DMV record. They all include a certification statement and the signature of the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles, as well as a security watermark.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶记录摘要是一份经过认证的 DMV 记录。它们都包含认证声明和机动车管理局局长的签名，以及安全水印。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get online through MyDMV
source_blocks.text: 通过 MyDMV 在线获取

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can save and print a PDF version of your record. You will have until 5 days after your order to download it. The fee is \$7.
source_blocks.text: 您可以保存并打印您的记录的 PDF 版本。您有 5 天时间在订单后下载它。费用为 \$7。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To create a MyDMV account, you will need
source_blocks.text: 要创建 MyDMV 账户，您需要

source_blocks.source_text_en: a New York State license, permit or non-driver ID or yourNew York State license, permit or non-driver ID 1
source_blocks.text: 纽约州驾照、许可证或非驾驶员 ID，或 您的纽约州驾照、许可证或非驾驶员 ID 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure your computer and web browser have all recent updates to avoid problems downloading your record [3].
source_blocks.text: 确保您的计算机和网络浏览器具有所有最新更新，以避免下载记录时出现问题 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are unable to access MyDMV, you can mail a Request for Certified CDL Abstract (PDF) [5] (MV-CDL) form along with the \$10 fee to the DMV to the address provided on the form, or have your employer order your CDL driving record abstract through LENS [6].
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法访问 MyDMV，您可以将认证 CDL 摘要请求（PDF）[5]（MV-CDL）表格连同 \$10 费用邮寄到 DMV，邮寄至表格上提供的地址，或者让您的雇主通过 LENS [6] 订购您的 CDL 驾驶记录摘要。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need the document number (see sample documents [7]) from your most recently issued document. If you renewed or ordered yours recently and have not received it in the mail yet, you will need to wait for it to arrive before you can create a MyDMV account.
source_blocks.text: 您需要最近签发的文件上的文件编号（参见示例文件 [7]）。如果您最近续期或订购了文件，但尚未收到邮件，您需要等待它到达后才能创建 MyDMV 账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help finding enough proof of ID
source_blocks.text: 帮助寻找足够的身份证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: I don't have my original U.S. birth certificate or marriage record
source_blocks.text: 我没有原始的美国出生证明或结婚记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State Department of Health Vital Records office [1] can help you with obtaining vital records in the state. Alternatively, you can order vital records online from New York and many other states through an independent partner, VitalChek Network Inc., at vitalchek.com [2].
source_blocks.text: 纽约州卫生部重要记录办公室 [1] 可以帮助您获取该州的重要记录。或者，您可以通过独立合作伙伴 VitalChek Network Inc. 在 vitalchek.com [2] 在线订购纽约及许多其他州的重要记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I don t have enough proof of name identification to bring to the DMV. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我没有足够的姓名身份证明带去 DMV。我能做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may already have more proof documents than you think, or you may be able to get some proof documents. Here are some suggestions.
source_blocks.text: 您可能已经拥有比您想象的更多的证明文件，或者您可能能够获得一些证明文件。以下是一些建议。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bank card (debit) with your name preprinted on it. Some banks will give you a card the same day you open an account. Online bill printouts. You can print out a copy of a paperless bill. For example, a phone bill, electricity/gas bill, water bill or cable bill. Divorce papers. You can contact your lawyer to find out where to go to obtain the papers, or check with the state where you got divorced. Remember, you must show us the original documents or a certified copy. Duplicate marriage certificate. You can check with the city, town or county where you were married. A lot of localities will allow you to order duplicates online. High school diploma or GED. You can contact the education department in the state where you graduated for a certified copy. If you attended school at a Community College, you may have received a (General Educational Development) GED certificate. You can contact the college for a certified copy. U.S. college transcripts. You can order these from a college or university you attended, even if you did not graduate there. You will need to have a photo ID from the college. Work ID, paystub or a W2 from state. These documents do not have to be from New York and they do not have to be current. Union card. The card can be from another state. If you lost the card, you can ask the union for help getting a duplicate. Even if you no longer have that union job, you may be a member for life. Life insurance policy. Check with your parents or spouse if they ever had a life insurance policy in your name. The policy must be in effect for at least 2 years. Check cashing card from a supermarket chain with your name printed on it.
source_blocks.text: 银行卡（借记卡），上面预印有您的姓名。有些银行会在您开户当天给您一张卡。 在线账单打印件。您可以打印无纸化账单的副本。例如，电话账单、电费/燃气费账单、水费账单或有线电视账单。 离婚文件。您可以联系您的律师了解在哪里获取这些文件，或者向您离婚所在州查询。请记住，您必须向我们出示原始文件或经认证的副本。 结婚证书副本。您可以向您结婚所在的城市、城镇或县查询。许多地方允许您在线订购副本。 高中文凭或 GED。您可以联系您毕业所在州的教育部门获取经认证的副本。如果您在社区学院就读，您可能已获得（普通教育发展）GED 证书。您可以联系该学院获取经认证的副本。 美国大学成绩单。您可以从您就读过的学院或大学订购这些成绩单，即使您未在那里毕业。您需要拥有该学院的带照片身份证。 工作证、工资单或州 W2 表格。这些文件不必来自纽约，也不必是当前的。 工会卡。该卡可以来自其他州。如果您丢失了卡，您可以向工会寻求帮助获取副本。即使您不再从事该工会工作，您也可能终身成为会员。 人寿保险单。向您的父母或配偶询问他们是否曾以您的名义投保人寿保险。该保单必须生效至少 2 年。 超市连锁店的支票兑现卡，上面印有您的姓名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use proof-of-residence documents that are in your spouse s name if
source_blocks.text: 如果满足以下条件，您可以使用配偶名下的居住证明文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: you and your spouse have the same last name
source_blocks.text: 您和您的配偶姓氏相同

source_blocks.source_text_en: or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: you show additional documents that prove your relationship (for example, a marriage certificate)
source_blocks.text: 您出示额外文件证明您的关系（例如，结婚证书）

documents.source_title_en: How insurance premium reduction works
documents.title: 保险费减免如何运作

source_blocks.source_text_en: How insurance premium reduction works
source_blocks.text: 保险费减免如何运作

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Point and Insurance Reduction Program (PIRP) is a DMV-approved course designed to teach motorists critical information about Highway Safety and Accident Prevention.
source_blocks.text: 积分与保险减免计划（PIRP）是DMV批准的课程，旨在向驾驶者传授关于高速公路安全和事故预防的关键信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得保险费减免？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course sponsor will mail you a completion certificate within 45 business days after you complete the classroom course (or 14 business days after you complete an online course). If you present your certificate to your insurance company or agent within 90 days after course completion, your liability and collision premium reduction will begin immediately, retroactive to the date you completed the course. If you present your certificate more than 90 days after course completion, the insurer may issue the premium discount effective from the date presented.
source_blocks.text: 课程主办方将在您完成课堂课程后的45个工作日内（或完成在线课程后的14个工作日内）将完成证书邮寄给您。如果您在课程完成后的90天内将证书提交给您的保险公司或代理人，您的责任险和碰撞险保费减免将立即生效，追溯至您完成课程的日期。如果您在课程完成90天后才提交证书，保险公司可能会从提交之日起给予保费折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not receive your certificate within eight weeks after completion, immediately contact the program sponsor. You must take the course once every 36 months to maintain insurance reduction benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在完成课程后八周内未收到证书，请立即联系课程主办方。您必须每36个月参加一次课程，以维持保险减免福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?
source_blocks.text: PIRP课程会阻止我的保险公司提高我的保费吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. PIRP does not prevent general premium increases, or premium increases due to violations or accidents. It provides a 10% reduction for three years, from the base rate of your current liability, no-fault and collision premiums.
source_blocks.text: 不会。PIRP不能阻止一般性保费上涨，或因违规或事故导致的保费上涨。它提供从您当前责任险、无过失险和碰撞险保费基本费率基础上降低10%的优惠，持续三年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if more than one person named on a policy completes the PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 如果保单上有多人完成PIRP课程怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Only the principal operator can receive the 10% reduction.
source_blocks.text: 只有主要驾驶人可以获得10%的减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will youthful drivers and drivers participating in the assigned risk pool receive the insurance premium discount?
source_blocks.text: 年轻驾驶者和参与指定风险池的驾驶者会获得保险费折扣吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Any insured driver who is the principal operator and completes a Point & Insurance Reduction Program course will receive the 10% reduction.
source_blocks.text: 会。任何作为主要驾驶人并完成积分与保险减免计划课程的受保驾驶者都将获得10%的减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a youthful driver is already receiving a driver education reduction, will the PIRP discount also be applied?
source_blocks.text: 如果年轻驾驶者已经获得驾驶教育减免，PIRP折扣也会同时适用吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact your insurance company or agent to learn if both reductions will be given at the same time.
source_blocks.text: 请联系您的保险公司或代理人，了解是否同时给予两项减免。

source_blocks.text: 了解如何减少驾驶记录积分。[1]

documents.source_title_en: How to renew a registration
documents.title: 如何续期注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to renew a registration
source_blocks.text: 如何续期注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to renew a registration [1]
source_blocks.text: 如何续期注册 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: You need to renew your registration before it expires. Your new registration documents will arrive in the mail in about 10 days. Renewing early will not change the new expiration date for your new registration. Members of the Armed Forces may have more time to renew [2].
source_blocks.text: 您需要在注册到期前进行续期。您的新注册文件将在大约10天内邮寄给您。提前续期不会改变您新注册的新到期日期。武装部队成员可能有更多时间续期 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot renew a registration that
source_blocks.text: 您不能续期以下情况的注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: is suspended or revoked is expired for more than 1 year 1 has not been inspected in the past 12 months
source_blocks.text: 被暂停或吊销 过期超过1年 1 在过去12个月内未接受检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online
source_blocks.text: 在线

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some registrations are not eligible. 2 Don't renew online if you are eligible for a 'no fee' renewal. 3 The fee is on your renewal notice, and displayed on your computer screen when you renew online.
source_blocks.text: 某些注册不符合条件。 2 如果您符合“免费”续期的条件，请不要在线续期。 3 费用在您的续期通知上，并且当您在线续期时会显示在电脑屏幕上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need
source_blocks.text: 您需要

source_blocks.source_text_en: your registration (plate) number your registration class the last name of the person on the registration (or business name) a credit or pinless debit card for payment
source_blocks.text: 您的注册（车牌）号码 您的注册类别 注册上的人（或企业名称）的姓氏 用于支付的信用卡或免密码借记卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: Renew a registration online [4]
source_blocks.text: 在线续期注册 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the bottom part of your registration renewal notice (MV-3 or OP-3) to the address listed on the notice. Include a personal check or money order payable to 'Commissioner of Motor Vehicles' for the fee.
source_blocks.text: 将您的注册续期通知（MV-3或OP-3）的底部部分邮寄到通知上列出的地址。附上一张个人支票或汇票，收款人为“机动车专员”，用于支付费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't have your MV-3 or OP-3, use the Application for Duplicate / Renewal Registration (PDF) [5] (MV-82D). If you do not know the correct amount to renew, send a check payable to 'Commissioner of Motor Vehicles', but do not write the amount.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有MV-3或OP-3，请使用重复/续期注册申请表（PDF） [5]（MV-82D）。如果您不知道正确的续期金额，请寄一张支票，收款人为“机动车专员”，但不要填写金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the MV-82D and your payment to
source_blocks.text: 将MV-82D和您的付款邮寄至

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesUtica Processing CenterP.O. Box 359Utica, NY 13503
source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车管理局尤蒂卡处理中心邮政信箱359尤蒂卡，纽约州 13503

source_blocks.source_text_en: At a DMV office
source_blocks.text: 在DMV办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring your registration renewal notice (MV-3 or OP-3) and payment to a DMV office. If you don't have your MV-3 or OP-3, complete the Application for Duplicate / Renewal Registration (PDF) [5] (MV-82D).
source_blocks.text: 携带您的注册续期通知（MV-3或OP-3）和付款到DMV办公室。如果您没有MV-3或OP-3，请填写重复/续期注册申请表（PDF） [5]（MV-82D）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional Information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: My registration is about to expire or already expired
source_blocks.text: 我的注册即将到期或已过期

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can renew online up to one year past the expiration date. You can download and print a temporary registration that'svalid for 10 days the day you renew. 4
source_blocks.text: 您可以在到期日期后一年内在线续期。续期当天，您可以下载并打印一份有效期为10天的临时注册证明。4

source_blocks.source_text_en: My address changed
source_blocks.text: 我的地址变更了

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your mailing address on DMV files must be current. You cannot change it during the transaction. First change your address online [6] and then renew.
source_blocks.text: 您在DMV档案中的邮寄地址必须是最新的。您不能在交易过程中更改地址。请先在线更改您的地址[6]，然后再续期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you file a request with the US Postal Service (USPS) to forward mail, there is no guarantee that the USPS will forward all DMV documents to your new address.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您向美国邮政服务（USPS）提交转寄邮件的请求，无法保证USPS会将所有DMV文件转寄到您的新地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: My name changed
source_blocks.text: 我的姓名变更了

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can still renew online but the new document will display your previous name. You cannot change your name during the online transaction. See how to change your name or other information on a registration or title [7].
source_blocks.text: 您仍然可以在线续期，但新文件将显示您之前的姓名。您不能在线交易过程中更改姓名。请参阅如何更改注册或所有权证书上的姓名或其他信息[7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need to register the vehicle [8] at a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 您需要在DMV办公室注册车辆[8]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot renew registrations online for
source_blocks.text: 您不能在线续期以下注册：

source_blocks.source_text_en: vehicles that are exempt registration fees - you must bring documentation that proves the vehicle is eligible for exempt status to a DMV office [9] - vehicles that require proof of insurance, a tax certificate, or another document for each renewal - vehicles that weigh 55,000 lbs. or more - for-hire vehicles (this includes taxis, livery vehicles, and buses) - semi-trailers with 6-year registrations - vehicles with an apportioned registration issued under the International Registration Plan (IRP) - vehicles with an ambulance, New York Press (NYP), government or official registration - rental vehicles
source_blocks.text: 免注册费的车辆 - 您必须携带证明车辆符合免税资格的文件到DMV办公室[9] - 需要提供保险证明、税收证明或其他文件才能续期的车辆 - 重量为55,000磅或以上的车辆 - 出租车辆（包括出租车、礼宾车和公共汽车） - 注册期为6年的半挂车 - 根据国际注册计划（IRP）发行的分摊注册车辆 - 救护车、纽约新闻（NYP）、政府或官方注册车辆 - 租赁车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are eligible for a 'no fee' registration, you will need to renew at an office. You will need to bring documentation to prove you are eligible for exempt status.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合“免收费用”注册的资格，您需要到办公室续期。您需要携带文件以证明您符合免税资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Only use the temporary if your registration is expired or about to expire, while you wait for your new registration documents to arrive in the mail.
source_blocks.text: 仅在您的注册已过期或即将到期时使用临时注册，同时等待新注册文件邮寄到您手中。

documents.title: 如何更换车辆注册证

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to replace a registration
source_blocks.text: 如何更换车辆注册证

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to replace a registration [1]
source_blocks.text: 如何更换车辆注册证 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fee to replace your vehicle registration document and windshield sticker is \$3.00, unless you are also replacing plates. 1
source_blocks.text: 更换车辆注册文件和挡风玻璃贴纸的费用为 \$3.00，除非您同时更换车牌。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to replace vehicle plates or documents that were lost in a crime, you must apply by mail or at a DMV office. See lost or stolen plates [2] for more information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更换因犯罪而丢失的车牌或文件，您必须通过邮寄或前往DMV办公室申请。有关更多信息，请参阅丢失或被盗车牌 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online and print a temporary document
source_blocks.text: 在线办理并打印临时文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can replace registration documents online for most vehicles. You computer must accept cookies. 2
source_blocks.text: 您可以在线更换大多数车辆的注册文件。您的电脑必须接受cookies。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sorry, you cannot replace registration documents online for
source_blocks.text: 抱歉，您无法在线更换以下车辆的注册文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: vehicles older than model year 1973 boats, snowmobiles or All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) vehicles with an expired, surrendered, suspended or revoked registration motorcycles, or other vehicles with plate stickers trailers transporter vehicles vehicles registered through DMV's International Registration Bureau
source_blocks.text: 1973年款之前的车辆 船只、雪地摩托或全地形车（ATV） 注册已过期、被放弃、暂停或吊销的车辆 摩托车或其他带有车牌贴纸的车辆 拖车 运输车辆 通过DMV国际注册局注册的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary registration
source_blocks.text: 临时注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can download and print a temporary registration in PDF format that is valid for 10 days. We also attach a copy to your confirmation email. You will get your new registration document by mail within 10 days.
source_blocks.text: 您可以下载并打印有效期10天的临时注册PDF文件。我们也会将副本附在您的确认邮件中。您将在10天内通过邮件收到新的注册文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You need
source_blocks.text: 您需要

source_blocks.source_text_en: vehicle plate or registration number registration class ZIP Code for the address on your registration credit or pinless debit card for payment
source_blocks.text: 车牌号或注册号 注册类别 注册地址对应的邮政编码 用于支付的信用卡或无密码借记卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace a registration online [4]
source_blocks.text: 在线更换注册 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send these items
source_blocks.text: 发送以下材料

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Duplicate / Renewal Registration (PDF) [5] (MV-82D) a photocopy of your NY State driver license, permit, non-driver ID, or other proof of identity [6] a check / money order for \$3 payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的《重复/续期注册申请表》(PDF) [5] (MV-82D) 您的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证、非驾驶员ID或其他身份证明的复印件 [6] 一张 \$3 的支票/汇票，收款人为“机动车管理局局长”

source_blocks.source_text_en: to
source_blocks.text: 至

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesUtica Processing CenterP.O. Box 359Utica, NY 13503
source_blocks.text: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesUtica Processing CenterP.O. Box 359Utica, NY 13503

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t update your name by mail. If your address changed, write your new address on the application.
source_blocks.text: 您不能通过邮件更新您的姓名。如果您的地址有变，请在申请表上写上您的新地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At a DMV office
source_blocks.text: 在DMV办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the Application for Duplicate / Renewal Registration (MV-82D), and bring these items to a DMV office [7]
source_blocks.text: 使用《补发/续期注册申请表》(MV-82D)，并携带以下物品到DMV办公室 [7]

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Duplicate / Renewal Registration (PDF) [5] (MV-82D) your NY State driver license, permit, non-driver ID, or other proof of identity [6] \$3 for payment of the fee
source_blocks.text: 一份填写完整的《补发/续期注册申请表》(PDF) [5] (MV-82D) 您的纽约州驾照、许可证、非驾驶员ID，或其他身份证明 [6] 支付费用$3

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your address changed
source_blocks.text: 如果您的地址有变

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your mailing address on DMV files must be current. You cannot change your address during the transaction. You can first change your address online [8]and then renew.
source_blocks.text: 您在DMV档案中的邮寄地址必须是最新的。您不能在交易期间更改地址。您可以先在线更改地址 [8]，然后再续期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you file a request with the US Postal Service (USPS) to forward mail there, is no guarantee that the USPS will forward all DMV documents to the new address.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您向美国邮政服务(USPS)提交转寄邮件的请求，不保证USPS会将所有DMV文件转寄到新地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your name changed
source_blocks.text: 如果您的姓名有变

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot change your name during this transaction. Your new document will display your previous name. If you recently changed your name, read the instructions to change your name or other information on a registration or title [9].
source_blocks.text: 您不能在此交易期间更改姓名。您的新文件将显示您之前的姓名。如果您最近更改了姓名，请阅读更改注册或所有权证上姓名或其他信息的说明 [9]。

documents.source_title_en: How to transfer a registration to another vehicle
documents.title: 如何将注册转移到另一辆车

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to transfer a registration to another vehicle
source_blocks.text: 如何将注册转移到另一辆车

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you sell or give away a vehicle, you can transfer the registration and vehicle plates to another vehicle you own.
source_blocks.text: 在您出售或赠送车辆后，您可以将注册和车牌转移到您拥有的另一辆车上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring these items to a DMV office [1]
source_blocks.text: 携带以下物品前往DMV办公室 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: original title (or other proof of ownership) 1
source_blocks.text: 原始所有权证书（或其他所有权证明）1

source_blocks.source_text_en: current NY State Insurance ID card (auto liability insurance) 2
source_blocks.text: 当前的纽约州保险ID卡（汽车责任保险）2

source_blocks.source_text_en: NY State driver license, permit, non-driver ID or other proof of identity 3
source_blocks.text: 纽约州驾驶执照、许可证、非驾驶员ID或其他身份证明3

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Registration / Title (PDF) [2] (MV-82)
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的注册/所有权申请表（PDF）[2]（MV-82）

source_blocks.source_text_en: payment for fees 4
source_blocks.text: 费用支付4

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print this checklist [3]
source_blocks.text: 打印此清单 [3]

source_blocks.source_text_en: For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in New York City, Westchester, Nassau, Suffolk, Rockland, Onondaga, Monroe or Albany Counties. For all other counties, see our office locations and hours [1].
source_blocks.text: 为了更快服务，请在访问纽约市、威斯特彻斯特、拿骚、萨福克、罗克兰、奥农达加、门罗或奥尔巴尼县的办公室之前在线预约。对于所有其他县，请查看我们的办公地点和营业时间 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make a Reservation [4]
source_blocks.text: 进行预约 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t want to transfer the registration, you must surrender the vehicle plates to the DMV [5]. You may be eligible to receive a refund [6] if you surrender the plates before the registration expires.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不想转移注册，您必须将车牌交还给DMV [5]。如果您在注册到期前交还车牌，您可能有资格获得退款 [6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transfer the of a vehicle (buy, sell, or give away)
source_blocks.text: 转移车辆所有权（购买、出售或赠送）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See Buy or sell a vehicle (transfer ownership) [7]
source_blocks.text: 请参阅购买或出售车辆（转移所有权） [7]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Cars, trucks, trailers & motorcycles
source_blocks.text: 汽车、卡车、拖车和摩托车

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1973 or newer, either
source_blocks.text: 1973年或更新的车型年份，任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: NY State Certificate of Title (original or certified copy, not a photocopy) with the transfer ownership section completed by the seller, or - acceptable proof of ownership from another state (original or certified copy, not a photocopy)
source_blocks.text: 纽约州所有权证书（原件或认证副本，非复印件），由卖方填写所有权转移部分，或 - 来自其他州的可接受的所有权证明（原件或认证副本，非复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1972 or older, either
source_blocks.text: 1972年或更旧的车型年份，任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: a NY State Transferable Registration (original or certified copy, not a photocopy) and bill of sale [8], or - acceptable proof of ownership from another state (original or certified copy, not a photocopy)
source_blocks.text: 纽约州可转让登记证明（原件或核证副本，不可用复印件）及销售单据 [8]，或 - 来自其他州的可接受的所有权证明（原件或核证副本，不可用复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See acceptable proofs [9] for other vehicles (manufactured homes, boats, ATVs, snowmobiles, gifted vehicles, vehicles with deceased owners).
source_blocks.text: 请参阅其他车辆（活动房屋、船只、全地形车、雪地车、赠与车辆、车主已故的车辆）的可接受证明 [9]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your insurance company will:
source_blocks.text: 您的保险公司将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1\) give you 2 barcoded original NY State Insurance ID cards (see a sample [10]) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card
source_blocks.text: 1\) 给您2张带有条形码的纽约州保险ID卡原件（参见示例 [10]）或为您提供访问数字电子纽约州保险ID卡的权限

source_blocks.source_text_en: 2\) send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)
source_blocks.text: 2\) 向DMV发送电子保险覆盖通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人不能提交此通知）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Insurance ID cards and the electronic notice together verify your coverage. We need both.
source_blocks.text: 您的纽约州保险ID卡和电子通知共同证明您的保险覆盖情况。我们需要两者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle within 180 days of the effective date on your Insurance ID Card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance ID Card with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险ID卡生效日期起180天内注册您的车辆。随身携带一份保险ID卡的副本或形式。DMV办公室将保留纸质卡。将另一张纸质卡放在车内作为您的保险证明。任何操作您车辆的人都必须能够提供保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements [11].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于纽约州保险要求的信息 [11]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must provide proof of identity and date of birth. You must be at least 16 years old (except for ATV and boat registrations).
source_blocks.text: 您必须提供身份和出生日期证明。您必须年满16岁（ATV和船只注册除外）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use a NY State
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用纽约州

source_blocks.source_text_en: driver license - learner permit, or - non-driver ID card
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照 - 学习许可证，或 - 非驾驶员ID卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: that is current or expired less than 2 years as proof of identity and age.If you don t have one of these, see other kinds of proof [12] you can use.
source_blocks.text: 作为身份和年龄证明，只要该证件是当前有效的或过期不超过2年。如果您没有这些证件，请参阅您可以使用的其他类型证明 [12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can estimate the registration fees [13] online if the registration is one of these classes
source_blocks.text: 如果注册属于以下类别之一，您可以在线估算注册费用 [13]

source_blocks.source_text_en: PAS - Passenger - COM - Commercial - RGL - Passenger - MOT - Motorcycle - ORM - Motorcycle - CSP - Commercial - ORC - Commercial - RGC - Commercial - ORG - Passenger - SPO - Passenger - SRF - Passenger
source_blocks.text: PAS - 乘用车 - COM - 商用车 - RGL - 乘用车 - MOT - 摩托车 - ORM - 摩托车 - CSP - 商用车 - ORC - 商用车 - RGC - 商用车 - ORG - 乘用车 - SPO - 乘用车 - SRF - 乘用车

source_blocks.source_text_en: The two vehicles must have the same registration type (passenger, commercial, motorcycle).
source_blocks.text: 两辆车必须具有相同的注册类型（乘用车、商用车、摩托车）。

documents.doc_id: If a family member has died#3_0
documents.source_title_en: If a family member has died
documents.title: 如果家庭成员去世

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a family member has died
source_blocks.text: 如果家庭成员去世

source_blocks.source_text_en: The death of a family member can be a busy and difficult time. When someone dies, they often leave outstanding issues that need to be resolved. On this page, you ll find information that will help you take care of any issues with the deceased individual s driver s license and vehicle registration and title.
source_blocks.text: 家庭成员的去世可能是一段忙碌而艰难的时期。当有人去世时，他们往往会留下需要解决的未了事宜。在此页面上，您将找到帮助您处理逝者驾照、车辆注册和所有权相关问题的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver license, permit, and ID
source_blocks.text: 驾照、许可证和身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your loved one has passed away, please mail a copy of the death certificate and a photo copy of their license or ID (if you have it) to the DMV. This will prevent further mailings or identity theft.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的亲人已去世，请将死亡证明的副本及其驾照或身份证（如果您有的话）的复印件邮寄给DMV。这将防止进一步的邮寄或身份盗窃。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV License Production BureauP.O. Box 2688 ESP Albany, NY 12220-0668
source_blocks.text: DMV驾照制作局P.O. Box 2688 ESP Albany, NY 12220-0668

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plate surrender and registration refund
source_blocks.text: 车牌交回和注册费退款

source_blocks.source_text_en: It may be possible to request a refund of the deceased individual s registration fee. DMV will issue the refund to the name of the estate. To request a refund
source_blocks.text: 可能可以申请退还逝者的注册费。DMV将以遗产的名义发放退款。要申请退款：

source_blocks.source_text_en: surrender the vehicle plates at a DMV office and request a transfer receipt , not a refund receipt have the executor of the deceased's estate send these items to the address listed on the request for refund - completed and signed Request for Refund (PDF [1]) (MV-215), with"deceased" written on the form - a photocopy of the death certificate - the transfer receipt
source_blocks.text: 在DMV办公室交回车牌，并索取转移收据，而非退款收据 让逝者遗产的执行人将以下物品寄至退款申请上所列的地址 - 填写并签署的退款申请表（PDF [1]）（MV-215），并在表格上注明“已故” - 死亡证明的复印件 - 转移收据

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the estate of the registrant is settled, call the DMV Revenue Accounting Unit at
source_blocks.text: 如果注册人的遗产已清算，请致电DMV收入会计部门，电话：

source_blocks.source_text_en: to request a 'Next of Kin' form. Send the 'Next of Kin' form, Request for Refund (MV-215) and the transfer receipt to the address on form MV-215. The refund is issued in the name of the next of kin.
source_blocks.text: 索取“近亲”表格。将“近亲”表格、退款申请表（MV-215）和转移收据寄至MV-215表格上的地址。退款将以近亲的名义发放。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transferring ownership of a deceased individual's vehicle
source_blocks.text: 转移逝者车辆的所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use this checklist to help you transfer the ownership when the vehicle owner is deceased (PDF) [2] (MV-843).
source_blocks.text: 使用此清单帮助您在车辆所有者去世时转移所有权（PDF） [2]（MV-843）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV has more information on how to transfer ownership of a vehicle if someone is deceased [3].
source_blocks.text: DMV有更多关于如何转移逝者车辆所有权的信息 [3]。

documents.doc_id: In-transit vehicle permits (temporary registrations)#3_0
documents.source_title_en: In-transit vehicle permits (temporary registrations)
documents.title: 跨州运输车辆许可证（临时注册）

source_blocks.source_text_en: In-transit vehicle permits (temporary registrations)
source_blocks.text: 跨州运输车辆许可证（临时注册）

source_blocks.source_text_en: To bring a vehicle from another state to register in New York
source_blocks.text: 从其他州将车辆带到纽约注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you purchase a vehicle in another state, you will need to go through that state's DMV office to get a temporary plate and registration to transport the vehicle to New York. Once the vehicle is in New York, you will need to follow the steps to register and title a vehicle [1] here.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在另一个州购买了车辆，您需要前往该州的DMV办公室获取临时牌照和注册，以便将车辆运输到纽约。车辆到达纽约后，您需要按照步骤在此处注册并为车辆上牌 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To bring a vehicle purchased in New York State to another state
source_blocks.text: 将纽约州购买的车辆带到其他州

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for an in-transit permit, which will allow you to transport a vehicle from a location in New York State to a location outside of New York State.
source_blocks.text: 您可以申请跨州运输许可证，该许可证允许您将车辆从纽约州内的地点运输到纽约州外的地点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To bring a vehicle purchased in New York State to another part of New York State to register
source_blocks.text: 将纽约州购买的车辆带到纽约州其他地区注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for an an in-transit permit, which will allow you to transport a vehicle from a location within New York to another location within New York.
source_blocks.text: 您可以申请跨州运输许可证，该许可证允许您将车辆从纽约州内的一个地点运输到纽约州内的另一个地点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In-transit permits duration
source_blocks.text: 跨州运输许可证的有效期

source_blocks.source_text_en: They are valid 30 days.
source_blocks.text: 有效期为30天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for an in-transit permit
source_blocks.text: 申请跨州运输许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring these items to a DMV office [2]
source_blocks.text: 携带以下物品前往DMV办公室 [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed In-Transit Permit / Title Application (pdf) [3] (MV-82ITP)
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的跨州运输许可证/所有权申请（pdf）[3]（MV-82ITP）

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of ownership 1
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of identity 2
source_blocks.text: 身份证明 2

source_blocks.source_text_en: payment for in-transit permit fee 3
source_blocks.text: 支付跨州运输许可证费用 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of insurance 4
source_blocks.text: 保险证明 4

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print this checklist [4]
source_blocks.text: 打印此清单 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Acceptable proof of insurance if you are not a resident of New York State
source_blocks.text: 如果您不是纽约州居民，可接受的保险证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a resident of New York State, you may submit one of these proofs of insurance
source_blocks.text: 如果您是纽约州居民，您可以提交以下其中一种保险证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: A letter from an out-of-state agent/broker if coverage has been purchased from an out-of-state insurance company. The letter must be on agent/broker letterhead and must contain the - name of insurance company - policy number and expiration date - effective date - insured's name and address - vehicle information including year, make and VIN An Insurance Binder. This form is usually an 8 1/2" by 11" page that says Insurance Binder at the top. The binder must contain - the name and address of the producer - the name and address of the insured - the name of the insurance company - the effective and expiration dates of the policy - a complete vehicle description including year, make and VIN - In the center of the form is a category titled "Automobile Liability". One of these boxes must be checked - Any Auto - All Owned Autos - Scheduled Autos
source_blocks.text: 来自外州代理人/经纪人的信函，如果保险是从外州保险公司购买的。信函必须使用代理人/经纪人信头，并且必须包含 - 保险公司名称 - 保单号码和到期日期 - 生效日期 - 被保险人的姓名和地址 - 车辆信息，包括年份、品牌和VIN 保险暂保单（Insurance Binder）。此表格通常是一张8.5英寸×11英寸的页面，顶部写有“Insurance Binder”。暂保单必须包含 - 生产商的名称和地址 - 被保险人的姓名和地址 - 保险公司的名称 - 保单的生效和到期日期 - 完整的车辆描述，包括年份、品牌和VIN - 表格中央有一个类别，标题为“Automobile Liability”。必须勾选其中一个框 - Any Auto - All Owned Autos - Scheduled Autos

source_blocks.source_text_en: Not all vehicles need proof of insurance to apply for a vehicle permit
source_blocks.text: 并非所有车辆都需要保险证明才能申请车辆许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles that do not require insurance in New York State (e.g. light trailers) are not required to present proof of insurance.
source_blocks.text: 在纽约州不需要保险的车辆（例如轻型拖车）无需出示保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Original insurance cards
source_blocks.text: 原始保险卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: All Insurance ID Cards must be original documents. A letter or an insurance binder can be an original document or a fax sent to a DMV office by the insurer. Photocopies are not acceptable.
source_blocks.text: 所有保险ID卡必须是原始文件。信函或保险暂保单可以是原始文件，也可以是由保险公司传真至DMV办公室的文件。不接受复印件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-New York State Residents can apply
source_blocks.text: 非纽约州居民可以申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need to be a New York State resident to apply for an in-transit permit.
source_blocks.text: 您无需是纽约州居民即可申请过境许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of ownership can be - Certificate of Title (MV-999) - Manufacturer s Certificate of Origin (MCO) - Manufacturer s Statement of Origin (MSO) - Statement of Ownership (MV-51B) - Findings DMV Administrative Hearing - Transferable Registration
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明可以是 - 所有权证书（MV-999） - 制造商原产地证书（MCO） - 制造商原产地声明（MSO） - 所有权声明（MV-51B） - DMV行政听证会调查结果 - 可转让注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must be at least 16 years old (except for ATV and boat registrations). - You can use a New York State - driver license - learner permit, or - non-driver ID card
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满16岁（ATV和船只注册除外）。 - 您可以使用纽约州的 - 驾驶执照 - 学习许可证，或 - 非驾驶员ID卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: that is current or expired less than 2 years as proof of both identity and age. - If you don t have one of these, see other kinds of proof [5] you can use.
source_blocks.text: 该证件必须当前有效或过期不到2年，作为身份和年龄的证明。 - 如果您没有这些证件，请参阅您可以使用的其他类型的证明 [5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For intrastate permits, you may also need to pay title or lien fees and sales tax.
source_blocks.text: 对于州内许可证，您可能还需要支付所有权或留置权费用以及销售税。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These proofs of insurance are acceptable
source_blocks.text: 以下保险证明是可接受的

source_blocks.source_text_en: NY State Insurance ID Card (FS -20 or FS-21) - Insurance Certificate For Hire Passenger Vehicle (FH-1 or FH-2) - Corporate Surety Bond For Hire Passenger Vehicle (FH-1B or FH-2B) - Temporary NY State Insurance Identification Card (FS-75) - The preparation date must be 7 days or less from the date of your application for the vehicle permit. Additionally, the Temporary Insurance ID Card (FS-75) must have "in-transit" or "in-transit permit" printed or written on it, and you must provide an In-transit Cancellation Authorization form (this is not a DMV form) from the insurance agent or broker who prepared the card.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州保险ID卡（FS-20或FS-21） - 雇佣客运车辆保险证书（FH-1或FH-2） - 雇佣客运车辆公司保证债券（FH-1B或FH-2B） - 临时纽约州保险识别卡（FS-75） - 准备日期必须距离您申请车辆许可证的日期不超过7天。此外，临时保险ID卡（FS-75）上必须印有或手写“in-transit”或“in-transit permit”，并且您必须提供由准备该卡的保险代理人或经纪人出具的过境取消授权表（这不是DMV表格）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See sample insurance documents [6].
source_blocks.text: 查看保险文件样本 [6]。

documents.doc_id: Information about Empire Gold plates#1_0
documents.source_title_en: Information about Empire Gold plates
documents.title: 关于帝国金色车牌的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information about Empire Gold plates
source_blocks.text: 关于帝国金色车牌的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information about Empire Gold plates [1]
source_blocks.text: 关于帝国金色车牌的信息 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Since April 1, 2010, DMV has issued Empire Gold vehicle license plates. DMV no longer issues Empire Blue and White plates.
source_blocks.text: 自2010年4月1日起，DMV已发放帝国金色车辆牌照。DMV不再发放帝国蓝色和白色牌照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need to get Empire Gold plates when you renew your registration
source_blocks.text: 续期注册时无需更换帝国金色车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can keep your current plates or order Empire Gold plates.
source_blocks.text: 您可以保留当前车牌，或订购帝国金色车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you are eligible to Empire Gold plates
source_blocks.text: 何时有资格获得帝国金色车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will get Empire Gold plates when you
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，您将获得帝国金色车牌：

source_blocks.source_text_en: apply to replace plates that are lost or stolen apply for a new (original) registration and do not transfer the plates or registration from another vehicle order new personalized plates
source_blocks.text: 申请更换丢失或被盗的车牌 申请新的（原始）注册，且不转移另一辆车的车牌或注册 订购新的个性化车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the to order Empire Gold plates
source_blocks.text: 您有权订购帝国金色车牌：

source_blocks.source_text_en: when you renew your registration online, by mail or at a DMV office [2] to replace your current plates (when your registration is not due for renewal)
source_blocks.text: 在线、邮寄或在DMV办公室续期注册时 [2] 更换当前车牌（当您的注册未到期续期时）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to order
source_blocks.text: 如何订购

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can order Empire Gold plates by phone, online or at a DMV office. The new plates and registration documents will be sent to you separately in the mail. In most cases, you will receive the new registration documents in the mail before you receive your plates.
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过电话、在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金色车牌。新车牌和注册文件将分别邮寄给您。在大多数情况下，您会先收到新的注册文件，然后再收到车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To avoid traffic tickets, put the new registration document on your vehicle even if your new plates have not yet arrived. Put the new plates on your vehicle as soon as you receive them.
source_blocks.text: 为避免交通罚单，即使新车牌尚未到达，也请将新的注册文件放置在您的车辆上。收到新车牌后，请尽快将其安装在您的车辆上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To order online, you must provide
source_blocks.text: 在线订购时，您必须提供：

source_blocks.source_text_en: the vehicle plate number vehicle class your name your ZIP Code (on DMV records)
source_blocks.text: 车辆车牌号 车辆类别 您的姓名 您的邮政编码（在DMV记录中）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order Empire Gold plates online [4]
source_blocks.text: 在线订购帝国金色车牌 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Cost
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must pay a plate fee of
source_blocks.text: 您需要支付车牌费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: \$25 for a two plate set \$12.50 for vehicles that receive only one plate (motorcycles, trailers, etc.)
source_blocks.text: 两片车牌套装为25美元 仅接收一片车牌的车辆（摩托车、拖车等）为12.50美元

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may need to pay additional fees. The fee to exchange a plate when your registration is not due for renewal is \$3.75.
source_blocks.text: 您可能需要支付额外费用。当您的注册未到期续期时，更换车牌的费为3.75美元。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keeping your same plate number
source_blocks.text: 保留您的原车牌号码

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle is registered in the one of the classes listed below, you can keep the same plate number from your current plates on your new Empire Gold plates for an additional fee of \$20.00.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆注册在以下列出的类别之一，您可以支付额外20.00美元的费用，将当前车牌号码保留在新的帝国金车牌上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: passenger (PAS) commercial (COM) motorcycle (MOT) trailer (TRL) other specific registration classes - see a list of registration classes eligible for Empire Gold plates and keep the same plate number [5]
source_blocks.text: 乘用车（PAS） 商用车（COM） 摩托车（MOT） 拖车（TRL） 其他特定注册类别 - 查看符合帝国金车牌资格并保留原车牌号码的注册类别列表 [5]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plate fee
source_blocks.text: 车牌费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need to get new Empire Gold plates and pay a plate fee when you renew. You can renew and keep your current plates.
source_blocks.text: 续期时，您无需获取新的帝国金车牌并支付车牌费用。您可以续期并保留当前车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need a new plate, or you choose to get new Empire Gold plates, you need to pay a plate fee.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要新车牌，或选择获取新的帝国金车牌，您需要支付车牌费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: the fee for a set of two vehicle plates is \$25 the fee for a single plate (for example, a plate for a trailer or motorcycle) is \$12.50
source_blocks.text: 两片车辆车牌的费用为25美元 单片车牌（例如拖车或摩托车车牌）的费用为12.50美元

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is an additional \$3.75 plate exchange transaction fee to order Empire Gold plates when there is not a registration renewal.
source_blocks.text: 当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I have a personalized plates. Can I keep the same plate number if I request Empire Gold plates?
source_blocks.text: 我有个性化车牌。如果我申请帝国金车牌，能否保留相同的车牌号码？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can get new Empire Gold plates and keep your personalized plate number when you renew your registration.
source_blocks.text: 可以。您可以在续期注册时获取新的帝国金车牌并保留您的个性化车牌号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to your renewal fee, you ll need to be the new plate fee (\$25 plate fee for a set of two new plates, or \$12.50 for vehicles that receive single plates). You will not be charged an additional fee to keep your same number, because you currently pay an annual personalized plate fee.
source_blocks.text: 除了续期费用外，您还需要支付新车牌费用（两片新车牌为25美元，或接收单片车牌的车辆为12.50美元）。您不会因保留相同号码而被收取额外费用，因为您目前每年支付个性化车牌费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your registration is not due to be renewed, but you want to order Empire Gold personalized plates to replace your current personalized plates, you can order Empire gold plates online or at a DMV office. There is an additional \$3.75 plate exchange transaction fee to order Empire Gold plates when there is not a registration renewal.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的注册未到期续期，但您想订购帝国金个性化车牌以替换当前的个性化车牌，您可以在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金车牌。当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to do with your old Empire Blue and White plates
source_blocks.text: 如何处理您的旧帝国蓝白车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you receive your new Empire Gold plates, do not return your old plate(s) to the DMV. Recycle your old plates based on local guidelines.
source_blocks.text: 当您收到新的帝国金车牌时，请勿将旧车牌退回DMV。请根据当地指南回收旧车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a statewide list of local recycling coordinators, visit the web site of the NYS Department of Environmental Conservation at http://www.dec.ny.gov/chemical/8511.html [6].
source_blocks.text: 如需全州地方回收协调员名单，请访问纽约州环境保护部网站：http://www.dec.ny.gov/chemical/8511.html [6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you recycle your old plates, use a permanent ink marker to cross out the plate number or otherwise deface the plates. For your own protection, separate the plates and put them in the recycle bin during different weeks.
source_blocks.text: 在回收旧车牌之前，请使用永久性墨水标记划掉车牌号码或以其他方式污损车牌。为保护您自己，请将车牌分开，并在不同周放入回收箱。
