documents.source_title_en: Information about transaction entries
documents.title: 关于交易条目（transaction entries）的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information about transaction entries
source_blocks.text: 关于交易条目（transaction entries）的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: ZIP Code and Email Entries
source_blocks.text: ZIP Code 和 Email 条目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If your address has changed, do not process your transaction online. Instead, follow the instructions to change your address [1].
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您的地址已更改，请勿在线处理交易。相反，请按照说明更改您的地址 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot update your address during an online transaction. The DMV website has instructions to change your name on DMV documents and records [2].
source_blocks.text: 您无法在在线交易期间更新您的地址。DMV 网站上有关于在 DMV 文件和记录上更改姓名的说明 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Current ZIP Code. Enter the ZIP Code for your current mailing address. To use this online transaction, your ZIP Code must
source_blocks.text: 当前 ZIP Code。请输入您当前邮寄地址的 ZIP Code。要使用此在线交易，您的 ZIP Code 必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: match the ZIP Code on your DMV record be a US ZIP Code
source_blocks.text: 与您 DMV 记录上的 ZIP Code 匹配 是美国 ZIP Code

source_blocks.source_text_en: All items are mailed to the address on your DMV record. See how to change your address [1] on your DMV vehicle records and documents.
source_blocks.text: 所有邮件均寄往您 DMV 记录上的地址。请参阅如何更改您 DMV 车辆记录和文件上的地址 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Email Address. Enter a valid email address, and re-enter the email address to verify it. The DMV will send you a confirmation of the transaction by email.
source_blocks.text: 您的 Email 地址。请输入有效的 email 地址，并重新输入 email 地址以进行验证。DMV 将通过 email 向您发送交易确认。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your email program must be able to receive email from addresses that include the domain: dmv.ny.gov. If you need help, see information about email addresses [3].
source_blocks.text: 您的 email 程序必须能够接收来自包含域名 dmv.ny.gov 的地址的邮件。如果您需要帮助，请参阅有关 email 地址的信息 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver License Information
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV ID Number. This is the 9 digit "ID" number printed in the upper portion of your driver license, learner permit or non driver ID (DMV photo document). Enter the 9 digits only; do not enter spaces, hyphens or other punctuation. See sample driver license documents [4].
source_blocks.text: DMV ID 号码。这是打印在您的驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员 ID（DMV 照片文件）上部的 9 位“ID”号码。仅输入 9 位数字；不要输入空格、连字符或其他标点符号。请参阅驾驶执照文件样本 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name. Enter your last name, first name and middle initial exactly as they would appear on your DMV photo document or another DMV document such as a driver record abstract, a revocation or suspension order or a letter related to your driver license. If you are not sure how your name appears, follow these rules to enter your name.
source_blocks.text: 姓名。请按照您的 DMV 照片文件或其他 DMV 文件（如驾驶记录摘要、吊销或暂停令或与您的驾驶执照相关的信函）上显示的姓名，输入您的姓氏、名字和中间首字母。如果您不确定您的姓名如何显示，请按照以下规则输入您的姓名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: names on DMV records appear in UPPERCASE and are displayed in UPPERCASE in online transactions enter letters only do not enter numbers a suffix should be entered in Roman numerals (for example "SMITH III, JOHN, A.") do not enter spaces or special characters such as commas or apostrophes (you can enter a hyphen if your name on DMV records includes a hyphen - for example, enter the name O'Brien as OBRIEN)
source_blocks.text: DMV 记录上的姓名以大写字母显示，并在在线交易中以大写字母显示 仅输入字母 不要输入数字 后缀应以罗马数字输入（例如“SMITH III, JOHN, A.”） 不要输入空格或特殊字符，如逗号或撇号（如果您的 DMV 记录上的姓名包含连字符，则可以输入连字符 - 例如，将姓名 O'Brien 输入为 OBRIEN）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Document Number. The document number is 8 or 10 characters, and is printed on the lower right corner of your DMV photo document, or on the back (for documents issues after January 29, 2014). The 8 character format is all numeric. The 10 character format is alpha and numeric. The alpha characters are in UPPERCASE. See sample driver license documents [4].
source_blocks.text: 文件号码。文件号码为 8 或 10 个字符，打印在您的 DMV 照片文件的右下角，或背面（对于 2014 年 1 月 29 日之后签发的文件）。8 字符格式全为数字。10 字符格式为字母和数字。字母字符为大写。请参阅驾驶执照文件样本 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Date of Birth. Enter two digits for the month, a slash, two digits for the day, a slash, and 4 digits for the year. For example, May 2, 1964 is entered as 05/02/1964.
source_blocks.text: 出生日期。输入两位月份、斜杠、两位日期、斜杠和四位年份。例如，1964 年 5 月 2 日输入为 05/02/1964。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Last 4 digits of SSN. Enter the last four digits of your Social Security Number. This information will be used only to help identify you for the transaction. See the Privacy and Security Statement [5].
source_blocks.text: SSN 后四位。请输入您的社会安全号码的后四位。此信息仅用于帮助识别您的交易身份。请参阅隐私与安全声明 [5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registration Renewal Entry Instructions
source_blocks.text: 注册续期输入说明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicle Plate or Boat Registration Number. Enter the vehicle plate number or boat registration number from your registration renewal notice or your registration document. Enter only letters and numbers; do not enter spaces or hyphens, or other special characters.
source_blocks.text: 车辆牌照或船只注册号码。请输入您的注册续期通知或注册文件上的车辆牌照号码或船只注册号码。仅输入字母和数字；不要输入空格、连字符或其他特殊字符。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a boat registration number, exclude the letters "NY" that may appear on your documents. Enter only the two other letters and four numbers.
source_blocks.text: 对于船舶注册号，请排除文件中可能出现的字母"NY"。仅输入另外两个字母和四个数字。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help, refer to the sample registration documents [6].
source_blocks.text: 如需帮助，请参阅示例注册文件[6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure when you enter the letter O or the number 0 (zero) that you enter the correct character. The letter O will appear wider than the number zero.
source_blocks.text: 输入字母O或数字0（零）时，请确保输入正确的字符。字母O看起来会比数字零更宽。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registration Class Code. Enter the three-letter registration class code from your registration document. If you need help, refer to the sample registration documents [6]. The registration class code for a boat is BOT.
source_blocks.text: 注册类别代码。请输入注册文件中的三位字母注册类别代码。如需帮助，请参阅示例注册文件[6]。船舶的注册类别代码为BOT。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
source_blocks.text: DMV记录地址的输入

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State law requires you to report a change of residence to the DMV within 10 days.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州法律要求您在10天内向DMV报告居住地变更。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you submit a mailing address change online, and you do not have a residence address on file with the DMV, you are required to enter a residence address. Your residence address cannot be a post office box.
source_blocks.text: 当您在线提交邮寄地址变更时，如果DMV没有您的居住地址记录，您必须输入居住地址。您的居住地址不能是邮政信箱。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already have a residence address on file with the DMV, you are not required to change it when you change your mailing address, but you can change the residence address if you want to.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在DMV已有居住地址记录，更改邮寄地址时无需更改居住地址，但您可以根据需要更改居住地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your residence address does not have to be the same as your mailing address, but you can select to use your mailing address as your residence address.
source_blocks.text: 您的居住地址不必与邮寄地址相同，但您可以选择将邮寄地址作为居住地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you report a change of address to the US Postal Service (USPS), it does not change your address on DMV records, but you can enter the new USPS address (National Change of Address or NCOA address) in this transaction.
source_blocks.text: 如果您向美国邮政服务（USPS）报告地址变更，这不会更改您在DMV记录中的地址，但您可以在本次交易中输入新的USPS地址（国家地址变更或NCOA地址）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you change an address with the DMV, it
source_blocks.text: 当您在DMV更改地址时，它

source_blocks.source_text_en: does not change your address on DMV records other than your driver license / DMV photo document records and/or registration records that you select in the transaction (for example, a change of address with the DMV does not change the address that appears on traffic ticket records) does not change an address on a registration record if you selected "No change" for that registration in the transaction does not change your address with the USPS or on any other record outside the DMV records specified above does not generate new documents with your new address (after you submit an online address change, you can replace your driver license, permit or non-driver ID [7] and/or replace your registration documents [8] that show your new address)
source_blocks.text: 不会更改您在DMV记录中的地址，除非是您选择在交易中更改的驾驶执照/DMV照片文件记录和/或注册记录（例如，在DMV更改地址不会更改交通罚单记录上显示的地址） 如果您在交易中为某注册选择了"无变更"，则不会更改该注册记录上的地址 不会更改您在美国邮政服务（USPS）或其他任何DMV指定记录之外的地址 不会生成带有您新地址的新文件（提交在线地址变更后，您可以更换驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID[7]和/或更换显示新地址的注册文件[8]）

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you submit an address change online, the change applies only to the DMV records you select. The online address change application shows the driver license, permit or non-driver ID (DMV photo document) and registration records that the DMV was able to locate under your name. If there are registrations in your name that are not shown, you can enter the plate or registration number to add them to the list and change the address(es) for those registrations.
source_blocks.text: 当您在线提交地址变更时，该变更仅适用于您选择的DMV记录。在线地址变更应用程序会显示DMV在您名下找到的驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID（DMV照片文件）和注册记录。如果您的名下还有未显示的注册，您可以输入车牌号或注册号将其添加到列表中，并更改这些注册的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you select "No Change" for any photo documents or registrations on your change address list, the new address you enter for other DMV records will not apply to those records. If you want to change the address for those records to a different new address, then you must process a separate address change and select only the records to which that address will be applied.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在地址变更列表中对任何照片文件或注册选择了"无变更"，您为其他DMV记录输入的新地址将不适用于这些记录。如果您想将这些记录的地址更改为不同的新地址，则必须处理单独的地址变更，并仅选择应用该地址的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a driver license, non-driver ID or registration on your change of address list is eligible to be renewed, the expiration date appears in bold red text on the Confirmation Page after you process the address change. You can then go online to renew your photo driver license or non-driver photo ID card [9], renew vehicle registration(s) [10] or renew boat registrations [10] and receive documents with your new address displayed.
source_blocks.text: 如果地址变更列表中的驾驶执照、非驾驶员ID或注册符合续期条件，处理地址变更后，到期日将在确认页面上以粗体红色文本显示。然后您可以上网续期您的照片驾驶执照或非驾驶员照片ID卡[9]、续期车辆注册[10]或续期船舶注册[10]，并收到显示新地址的文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After your address change is processed, links are provided to order replacement (duplicate) documents that show your new address. There are fees to order the replacement documents.
source_blocks.text: 地址变更处理完成后，会提供链接以订购显示新地址的补发（副本）文件。订购补发文件需支付费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online Manual Orders
source_blocks.text: 在线手册订单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most DMV manuals are available online through the DMV Publications [11] page. This includes the Online Driver's Manual and Study Guide with quizzes [12].
source_blocks.text: 大多数DMV手册可通过DMV出版物[11]页面在线获取。这包括在线驾驶员手册和带测验的学习指南[12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Single, printed copies of DMV manuals for drivers are also available free of charge at DMV offices [13] or by mail through the DMV Call Center [14] for your area code.
source_blocks.text: DMV 驾驶员手册的单份打印版也可在 DMV 办公室 [13] 免费获取，或通过您所在区号的 DMV 呼叫中心 [14] 邮寄索取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a title?
source_blocks.text: What is a title?

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Certificate of Title (MV-999) is the official proof of ownership for a car, truck, motorcycle, motorboat, travel or utility trailer weighing 1,000 pounds or more, or manufactured home (mobile home). The title certificate is used to transfer ownership from one person to another. The title also lists any "lienholders" those from whom the owner borrowed money to purchase the vehicle or manufactured home. It is wise to keep your title certificate in a safe place. Don't keep it in the car or carry it with you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: For most owners, a title certificate proves ownership of a car, truck, motorcycle, motorboat, or manufactured home. The title is used to transfer it to another owner.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A registration allows a driver to operate a motor vehicle on a public road, or a motorboat on a public waterway. Manufactured homes are not registered.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most often, you automatically apply for a when you first register your motor vehicle or motorboat. Use the form Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [1] (MV-82), available at any motor vehicle office, by request from a DMV Call Center or by download from the DMV internet site. You must pay the registration and license plate fees, any appropriate sales tax, and the fee for a title certificate \$50.00. The same process is followed by a dealership that handles your registration and title application. The dealership will issue you a temporary registration.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a lien, and how is it recorded on my title?
source_blocks.text: What is a lien, and how is it recorded on my title?

source_blocks.source_text_en: A "lien" means that someone other than the owner has a security interest in your motor vehicle, motorboat, or manufactured home. This usually is the bank or finance company that loaned you money to pay for its purchase. The lienholder is listed on the title certificate and on the DMV computer records. The lienholder or dealership will complete forms and pay a fee to have the DMV record the lien on your title. As the new owner, you probably will not be involved in filing the lien. The lender cannot charge you the recording fee.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I remove a lien from my NY title and get a "clear" title?
source_blocks.text: How do I remove a lien from my NY title and get a "clear" title?

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you have paid your loan in full, the lienholder must promptly send you a proof of lien satisfaction called a "lien release." This is usually a Notice of Recorded Lien (MV-901), marked and endorsed by the lender proving payment. It might also be a letter on the lender's stationery identifying the borrower's name, the vehicle by make, year and vehicle identification number, certifying the date of full payment and release of the security interest, and signed by an officer of the lending institution. Keep this lien release. You will need to give it to a buyer, along with your title certificate, when you transfer ownership. The DMV will accept only the signed, original release.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a motor vehicle "branding"?
source_blocks.text: What is a motor vehicle "branding"?

source_blocks.source_text_en: A motor vehicle branding is a written notice that a motor vehicle previously either: did not conform to its warranty; had been rebuilt following damage in excess of 75% of its retail value at the time of loss; originally entered New York State under a branded out-of-state title; had not been manufactured to U.S. standards; has been reconstructed; or is not equipped with a tamper-resistant odometer.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A dealer must inform a customer, in writing, if a branded vehicle is being shown or sold. This may be a notice placed on the dealer's bill of sale or handed to the customer. The branding also may be a printed notice on the front of the title.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance lapses
source_blocks.text: 保险失效

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is an insurance lapse in New York State?
source_blocks.text: 什么是纽约州的保险失效？

source_blocks.source_text_en: An insurance lapse means that there is no liability insurance coverage for a vehicle registered in New York State for a period of time. If there is a lapse of insurance for a vehicle registered to you, the DMV can suspend your registration and driver license.
source_blocks.text: 保险失效是指一辆在纽约州注册的车辆在一段时间内没有责任保险覆盖。如果您名下注册的车辆出现保险失效，DMV（机动车管理局）可以暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What can cause an insurance lapse?
source_blocks.text: 什么原因会导致保险失效？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Any amount of time that your vehicle is registered but not insured can cause a lapse in your insurance coverage. An insurance lapse can occur between the date your insurance is cancelled and the date
source_blocks.text: 您的车辆在注册期间任何未投保的时间都可能导致保险失效。保险失效可能发生在您的保险被取消之日与以下日期之间：

source_blocks.source_text_en: your new insurance begins you surrender your vehicle plates your registration expires 'other proof' of insurance (for example, a vehicle registered in another state, or a vehicle repossessed or impounded) is valid your insurance company reinstates your insurance coverage
source_blocks.text: 您的新保险开始生效 您交出车辆牌照 您的注册到期 保险的“其他证明”（例如，在另一州注册的车辆，或被收回或扣押的车辆）有效 您的保险公司恢复您的保险覆盖

source_blocks.source_text_en: A lapse in insurance coverage can also occur between the date you register your vehicle and the date your new insurance coverage begins. 1 See Respond to DMV insurance letters and orders [1] for instructions on how to resolve an insurance lapse.
source_blocks.text: 保险失效也可能发生在您注册车辆之日与您的新保险开始生效之日之间。1 参见“回应DMV保险信函和命令”[1]以获取解决保险失效的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the registration suspension period is more than 90 days, you must surrender your vehicle registration and plates. The DMV will also suspend your driver license. Your driver license will be suspended for the same number of days as your registration suspension. To reinstate your driver license, you must pay the DMV a \$50 license suspension termination fee [2].
source_blocks.text: 如果注册暂停期超过90天，您必须交出您的车辆注册和牌照。DMV还将暂停您的驾驶执照。您的驾驶执照将被暂停的天数与您的注册暂停天数相同。要恢复您的驾驶执照，您必须向DMV支付\$50的执照暂停终止费[2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What will happen if I drive without insurance (with lapsed insurance)?
source_blocks.text: 如果我无保险驾驶（保险失效）会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do not drive any vehicle that is not insured.
source_blocks.text: 不要驾驶任何未投保的车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you could be arrested or ticketed your vehicle can be impounded by a law enforcement officer the DMV will revoke your registration and your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您可能会被逮捕或收到罚单 您的车辆可能会被执法人员扣押 DMV将吊销您的注册和驾驶执照

source_blocks.source_text_en: What will happen if I or my uninsured vehicle is in a traffic crash?
source_blocks.text: 如果我或我的未投保车辆发生交通事故会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your license and registration will be suspended, and you will need to pay fines and penalties.
source_blocks.text: 您的驾驶执照和注册将被暂停，并且您需要支付罚款和罚金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle does not have insurance and you or someone else driving your uninsured vehicle are involved in a traffic crash, the DMV will revoke your driver license and vehicle registration for at least one year.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆没有保险，并且您或其他人驾驶您的未投保车辆发生交通事故，DMV将吊销您的驾驶执照和车辆注册至少一年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The traffic court fine could be as much as \$1,500 for driving without insurance or allowing another person to drive your uninsured vehicle. You will also need to pay the DMV a \$750 civil penalty to restore your driver license [3] if it is revoked.
source_blocks.text: 交通法庭罚款可能高达\$1,500，因为无保险驾驶或允许他人驾驶您的未投保车辆。如果您的驾驶执照被吊销，您还需要向DMV支付\$750的民事罚款以恢复您的驾驶执照[3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if my insurance is cancelled or reinstated, or I get new insurance?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的保险被取消、恢复或我获得新保险会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your insurance company must notify the DMV electronically if
source_blocks.text: 您的保险公司必须通过电子方式通知DMV，如果：

source_blocks.source_text_en: your insurance coverage is cancelled your insurance coverage is reinstated you get new insurance coverage
source_blocks.text: 您的保险覆盖被取消 您的保险覆盖被恢复 您获得新的保险覆盖

source_blocks.source_text_en: In your response to the DMV letter you must either
source_blocks.text: 在回复DMV的信函时，您必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: prove that you have insurance coverage prove that you sold the vehicle prove that insurance coverage was not required
source_blocks.text: 证明您有保险保障 证明您已出售车辆 证明不需要保险保障

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have insurance coverage, also ask your insurance company (do not ask your agent or broker) to file an electronic notice of insurance coverage with the DMV.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有保险保障，也请要求您的保险公司（不要询问您的代理人或经纪人）向DMV提交电子保险保障通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have auto liability insurance, you must surrender your vehicle plates to the DMV [4] immediately.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有汽车责任保险，您必须立即将车辆牌照交还给DMV [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I avoid an insurance lapse?
source_blocks.text: 如何避免保险中断？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remember this simple rule: no insurance, no plates!
source_blocks.text: 记住这个简单的规则：没有保险，就没有牌照！

source_blocks.source_text_en: keep the address for your vehicle registration and driver license current with the DMV have liability coverage from a company licensed by the NYS Department of Financial Services and authorized by the NYS DMV (out-of-state coverage is never acceptable on any vehicle registered in New York) have your insurance company report any changes to the DMV immediately (for more information, see Changes to my insurance policy [5]) keep insurance coverage on your vehicle for as long as it is registered in New York respond to DMV Insurance Letters and Orders immediately surrender your vehicle registration and license plates to DMV before your New York State coverage ends for any reason
source_blocks.text: 保持您的车辆注册和驾驶执照地址在DMV是最新的 拥有由纽约州金融服务部许可并经纽约州DMV授权的公司的责任保险（在纽约注册的任何车辆上，州外保险是绝对不可接受的） 让您的保险公司立即向DMV报告任何变更（更多信息，请参阅我的保险单变更 [5]） 只要您的车辆在纽约注册，就保持保险保障 立即回复DMV的保险信函和命令 在您的纽约州保险保障因任何原因结束之前，将您的车辆注册和牌照交还给DMV

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have valid auto liability insurance coverage for your vehicle, you must immediately surrender your registration and vehicle plates.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有有效的汽车责任保险保障，您必须立即交还您的注册和车辆牌照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Motorcycle plates do not have to be surrendered to DMV when auto liability insurance lapses. However, it is illegal to operate a motorcycle when it does not have proper auto liability insurance.
source_blocks.text: 当汽车责任保险中断时，摩托车牌照不必交还给DMV。但是，在没有适当的汽车责任保险的情况下驾驶摩托车是违法的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If my registration is suspended for a lapse of insurance, can another person register the vehicle?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的注册因保险中断而被暂停，其他人可以注册该车辆吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. The DMV will not issue a new registration if the DMV determines that the purpose of the new registration is to avoid the suspension.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。如果DMV确定新注册的目的是为了避免暂停，DMV将不会签发新的注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will not issue a registration if the applicant for the new registration
source_blocks.text: 如果新注册的申请人符合以下情况，DMV将不会签发注册：

source_blocks.source_text_en: has the same last name as the registrant whose registration is suspended, or resides at the same address as the registrant whose registration is suspended
source_blocks.text: 与注册被暂停的注册人同姓，或 与注册被暂停的注册人居住在同一地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will not issue a registration to any person unless that person makes a sworn statement on form FS-2. The statement certifies that the purpose of the application in not to avoid the results from the current suspension. The local DMV Office determines if the application will be accepted or rejected.
source_blocks.text: 除非该人在FS-2表格上作出宣誓声明，否则DMV不会向任何人签发注册。该声明证明申请的目的不是为了逃避当前暂停的结果。当地DMV办公室决定申请是否被接受或拒绝。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form FS-2 is available only at a local DMV Office.
source_blocks.text: FS-2表格仅可在当地DMV办公室获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If my license is suspended for a lapse of insurance, what can I do?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的驾照因保险中断而被暂停，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your registration has not expired, you must surrender your plates. A driver license becomes suspended when the lapse is 91 days or more or if the time period of the lapse has not yet been determined. To determine the lapse period
source_blocks.text: 如果您的注册尚未过期，您必须交还您的牌照。当中断时间达到91天或更长时间，或者中断的时间段尚未确定时，驾驶执照将被暂停。要确定中断期间，

source_blocks.source_text_en: the plates must be surrendered, or the plates must be reported lost/stolen/confiscated, or the registration must expire, or the plates must be transferred to another vehicle by DMV, or DMV must receive proof of new or reinstated insurance, or DMV must receive other acceptable proof
source_blocks.text: 必须交还牌照，或 必须报告牌照丢失/被盗/被没收，或 注册必须过期，或 必须由DMV将牌照转移到另一辆车，或 DMV必须收到新的或恢复的保险证明，或 DMV必须收到其他可接受的证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once the lapse is determined, the registration, and if the lapse period is 91 days or more, your driver license will also be suspended for the same number of days. The suspensions may not be effective on the same date. Therefore, you may serve the suspension on the driver license first or you may serve the suspension on the registration first. The suspension on the driver license will not end until you have paid the suspension termination fee and have served the suspension.
source_blocks.text: 一旦确定保险中断期，注册将被暂停，如果中断期为91天或以上，您的驾驶执照也将被暂停相同天数。暂停可能不在同一日期生效。因此，您可能先执行驾驶执照的暂停，或先执行注册的暂停。驾驶执照的暂停将不会结束，直到您支付了暂停终止费并执行完暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The registration suspension will last for the same number of days that your vehicle was registered in New York without auto liability coverage. If you are suspended you must either - surrender your plates to the DMV [4], or - if you are eligible, pay the optional civil penalty for the entire length of the lapse
source_blocks.text: 注册暂停将持续与您的车辆在纽约无汽车责任保险注册的天数相同。如果您被暂停，您必须要么 - 将您的车牌上交DMV [4]，或 - 如果您符合资格，支付整个中断期的可选民事罚款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Know Your Rights in Auto Repair
source_blocks.text: 了解您在汽车维修中的权利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Smart Shopping for Auto RepairsYou can help avoid trouble with an unreliable or dishonest repair shop by following these tips:
source_blocks.text: 明智选购汽车维修服务 遵循以下提示，可以帮助您避免与不可靠或不诚实的维修店发生纠纷：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deal only with a registered shop. Make sure there's a green and white "Registered State of New York Motor Vehicle Repair Shop" sign outside the shop and a valid New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) registration certificate inside.
source_blocks.text: 只与注册维修店打交道。确保店外有绿底白字的“纽约州注册机动车维修店”标志，店内持有有效的纽约州机动车管理局（DMV）注册证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the "Find a DMV-regulated Business" service to find a registered repair shop in your area.
source_blocks.text: 使用“查找DMV监管企业”服务，查找您所在地区的注册维修店。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask your family, friends and co-workers for advice on reliable repair shops in your area, as well as those you should avoid.
source_blocks.text: 向家人、朋友和同事咨询您所在地区可靠维修店的建议，以及应避免的维修店。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keep all records, including estimates, invoices, work orders, receipts, guarantees and warranties. Besides their importance in case you file a repair complaint, these papers serve as your record of service, and could increase your vehicle's resale value.
source_blocks.text: 保留所有记录，包括估价单、发票、工单、收据、保证和保修单。除了在您提出维修投诉时的重要性外，这些文件还可作为您的服务记录，并可能提高车辆的转售价值。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you authorize repair work by phone, write down the date and time, the name of the person you spoke with, any estimated price quoted, and other pertinent details.
source_blocks.text: 如果您通过电话授权维修工作，请记下日期和时间、您交谈对象的姓名、任何报价的估计价格以及其他相关细节。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Don't be afraid to ask questions. Management of a shop should take the time to explain required repairs and prices, discuss problems, and tell you about the training and experience of employees.
source_blocks.text: 不要害怕提问。维修店管理层应花时间解释必要的维修和价格，讨论问题，并告知您员工的培训和经验。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The "Consumer's Bill Of Rights"
source_blocks.text: “消费者权利法案”

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under the Repair Shop Act, you have the following rights when dealing with a repair shop:
source_blocks.text: 根据《维修店法案》，在与维修店打交道时，您享有以下权利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Written Estimate
source_blocks.text: 书面估价

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request it, the repair shop must give you a written estimate of the parts and labor necessary for each specific repair. The shop may charge a reasonable fee for developing a written estimate, but the labor charge for an estimate may not exceed the shop's usual hourly labor charge.The estimate must list each part and its cost, and show what parts, if any, are either used or not of original quality. It must show the labor charges for each repair and by what method they are calculated. The shop may not charge more than the estimated price without your permission.
source_blocks.text: 如果您要求，维修店必须为您提供每项具体维修所需零件和人工的书面估价。维修店可就制定书面估价收取合理费用，但估价的人工费不得超过维修店通常的每小时人工费。估价必须列出每个零件及其成本，并显示哪些零件（如有）是二手件或非原厂质量件。估价必须显示每项维修的人工费及其计算方式。未经您的许可，维修店不得收取超过估价的费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Authorizing Work
source_blocks.text: 授权维修

source_blocks.source_text_en: A shop may not perform any services unless you give your permission. If the shop prepares a written work order, it must give you a copy. If you prepare a written work order, the shop must attach it to the invoice. If work is authorized verbally or by telephone, the invoice must show the date, time, and name of the person giving authorization.
source_blocks.text: 未经您的许可，维修店不得进行任何服务。如果维修店准备书面工单，则必须给您一份副本。如果您准备书面工单，维修店必须将其附在发票上。如果维修是通过口头或电话授权的，发票必须显示授权日期、时间和授权人姓名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Parts
source_blocks.text: 零件

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are entitled to the return of all replaced parts, except warranty and exchange parts, but you must ask for them in writing before any work is done. If you authorize work by phone, the shop must keep any replaced parts, and make them available when you pick up the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 您有权取回所有更换下来的零件，但保修件和交换件除外，但您必须在任何工作开始前书面要求。如果您通过电话授权维修，维修店必须保留更换下来的零件，并在您取车时提供给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Invoice
source_blocks.text: 发票

source_blocks.source_text_en: When repairs are completed, the shop must give you a detailed invoice listing each repair done, each part replaced, the cost for each, and the cost of labor. The invoice must show which replacement parts, if any, are used, or not of original quality. It must show the odometer reading at the time you left the vehicle for repair and when the invoice was prepared. If the shop promised a delivery date, that must be listed on the repair order. If you received a written estimate, compare it with the invoice and try to resolve any questions before you pay for the repairs.
source_blocks.text: 维修完成后，维修店必须给您一份详细发票，列出每项完成的维修、更换的每个零件、每项费用以及人工费。发票必须显示哪些更换零件（如有）是二手件或非原厂质量件。发票必须显示您将车辆送修时的里程表读数以及发票准备时的读数。如果维修店承诺了交付日期，则必须在维修单上列出。如果您收到了书面估价，请将其与发票进行比较，并在付款前尽量解决任何疑问。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Inspection After Repair
source_blocks.text: 维修后检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the right to inspect your vehicle at the shop before paying for repairs. However, this does not give you the right to remove the vehicle from the shop without paying for the repairs, or to inspect it in areas where only authorized employees are allowed.
source_blocks.text: 您有权在支付维修费用之前在修理厂检查您的车辆。但是，这并不赋予您在未支付维修费用的情况下将车辆移出修理厂的权利，也不允许您进入仅限授权员工进入的区域进行检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Guarantees
source_blocks.text: 保修

source_blocks.source_text_en: A shop is not required to guarantee its work, but if a shop voluntarily guarantees repairs, the terms and time limit of the guarantee must be listed on the invoice.If you are not satisfied with the quality or price of a repair, discuss it with the management of the shop. Many misunderstandings can be resolved through a calm, honest discussion.
source_blocks.text: 修理厂并非必须为其工作提供保修，但如果修理厂自愿提供维修保修，则必须在发票上列出保修的条款和时限。如果您对维修质量或价格不满意，请与修理厂管理层讨论。许多误解可以通过冷静、诚实的讨论得到解决。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If You Have a Repair Problem
source_blocks.text: 如果您遇到维修问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, attempt to resolve the issue with the management of the business. Keep a written record of all contacts with management in addition to details about the repair. Copies of work orders and invoices are proof of your attempts to resolve the problem.If a satisfactory resolution is not reached and you wish to file a complaint, you must submit a Vehicle Safety Complaint Report (PDF) [1] \1\ along with any supporting documents to the DMV Consumer & Facilities Services Complaint Unit. To submit electronically, download the complaint report available at the link above to your personal device. Attach and then email the completed report as well as any supporting documents to [email protected] [2]. Please note that DMV staff will communicate with you through email.
source_blocks.text: 首先，尝试与企业管理层解决问题。保留与管理层所有联系的书面记录以及维修详情。工作订单和发票的副本是您尝试解决问题的证明。如果未能达成满意的解决方案，并且您希望提出投诉，您必须向DMV消费者与设施服务投诉部门提交车辆安全投诉报告（PDF）[1] 1以及任何支持文件。要以电子方式提交，请将上述链接中提供的投诉报告下载到您的个人设备。将填写完整的报告以及任何支持文件作为附件，然后通过电子邮件发送至[email protected] [2]。请注意，DMV工作人员将通过电子邮件与您沟通。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complaint UnitBureau of Consumer & Facility ServicesDepartment of Motor VehiclesP.O. Box 2700-ESP, Albany, NY 12220-0700FAX: (518) 486-4102Phone: 1-518-474-8943 (between 8:30 a.m. and 4:15 p.m., Monday - Friday)Email: [email protected] [2]
source_blocks.text: 投诉部门消费者与设施服务局机动车辆管理局邮政信箱2700-ESP，奥尔巴尼，纽约州12220-0700传真：(518) 486-4102电话：1-518-474-8943（周一至周五上午8:30至下午4:15）电子邮件：[email protected] [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: DMV staff will not investigate a complaint until a completed VS-35 Complaint Report has been received. The department does not investigate complaints that have been filed anonymously. There is a 90-day limit on reporting incidents related to a NYS Repair Shop. We cannot accept complaints against Repair Shops beyond the 90-day limit or 3,000 miles (whichever comes first). The DMV cannot resolve disputes over the terms of manufacturer or third party warranties or guarantees. If you feel you have a NYS Lemon Law complaint, please see Lemon Law Complaints [3].
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：DMV工作人员在收到填写完整的VS-35投诉报告之前，不会调查投诉。该部门不调查匿名提交的投诉。与纽约州修理厂相关的事件报告有90天的时限。我们无法接受超过90天时限或3,000英里（以先到者为准）的针对修理厂的投诉。DMV无法解决制造商或第三方保修或担保条款的争议。如果您认为自己有纽约州柠檬法投诉，请参阅柠檬法投诉[3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What Happens to Your Complaint
source_blocks.text: 您的投诉会怎样处理

source_blocks.source_text_en: A DMV customer service representative will try to resolve the problem by discussing it with you and the shop. About half the complaints received by DMV are resolved through mediation.If the repair problem isn't resolved, your complaint will often be referred to a DMV regional office for investigation. A DMV inspector may contact you to ask questions or discuss your case in detail. These inspectors are experienced automotive technicians trained to investigate and resolve complaints.If the DMV investigation indicates the shop violated the Repair Shop Act or regulations, DMV will either send a warning letter to the shop or schedule a hearing. If a hearing determines there were violations, DMV will take action against the shop. This may include suspending or revoking the shop's registration and/or imposing fines.If you suffer a financial loss due to overcharging or unnecessary or poor quality repairs, the administrative law judge presiding at the hearing may offer the shop the option of paying restitution. The shop may then receive a shorter suspension period and/or a lower fine.DMV cannot force a shop to pay restitution. Restitution is limited to the amount you were overcharged or the cost of proper repairs. Other expenses, such as the cost of renting a replacement car, cannot be included. Filing a complaint with DMV does not prevent you from seeking help from other consumer protection agencies or from taking the shop to court. However, if you receive a court settlement or one is pending, restitution through DMV is not available.
source_blocks.text: DMV客户服务代表将尝试通过与您和修理厂讨论来解决问题。DMV收到的投诉中约有一半通过调解解决。如果维修问题未得到解决，您的投诉通常会转交DMV地区办事处进行调查。DMV检查员可能会与您联系，询问问题或详细讨论您的案件。这些检查员是经验丰富的汽车技术人员，受过调查和解决投诉的培训。如果DMV调查表明修理厂违反了《修理厂法》或法规，DMV将向修理厂发送警告信或安排听证会。如果听证会确定存在违规行为，DMV将对修理厂采取行动。这可能包括暂停或吊销修理厂的注册和/或处以罚款。如果您因多收费或不必要或质量差的维修而遭受经济损失，主持听证会的行政法法官可能会向修理厂提供支付赔偿金的选择。修理厂随后可能获得较短的暂停期和/或较低的罚款。DMV不能强制修理厂支付赔偿金。赔偿仅限于您被多收的金额或适当维修的费用。其他费用，例如租用替代汽车的费用，不能包括在内。向DMV提交投诉并不妨碍您寻求其他消费者保护机构的帮助或将修理厂告上法庭。但是，如果您获得法院和解或和解待决，则无法通过DMV获得赔偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: With Your Help, The Repair Shop Act Works
source_blocks.text: 有了您的帮助，《修理厂法》才能发挥作用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under the Repair Shop Act, thousands of dollars are returned to consumers each year through mediation and restitution. In addition, hundreds of vehicles are repaired at no additional cost. The Repair Shop Act also helps to make our highways safer by promoting quality auto repairs.The Repair Shop Act works best when consumers take the time to shop wisely for auto repairs, keep records of their dealings with shops, and discuss repairs with shop management to avoid misunderstandings.
source_blocks.text: 根据《修理厂法》，每年通过调解和赔偿向消费者返还数千美元。此外，数百辆汽车无需额外费用即可得到维修。《修理厂法》还通过促进高质量的汽车维修，帮助使我们的高速公路更加安全。当消费者花时间明智地选择汽车维修服务、保留与修理厂交易的记录，并与修理厂管理层讨论维修以避免误解时，《修理厂法》才能发挥最佳作用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional information can be found at:Report a problem with a DMV regulated automotive business [4]
source_blocks.text: 更多信息可在以下网址找到：举报DMV监管的汽车业务问题[4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Leandra's Law & ignition interlock devices
source_blocks.text: 利安德拉法案与点火联锁装置

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is "Leandra's Law"?
source_blocks.text: 什么是“利安德拉法案”？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Leandra's Law was signed into law on November 18, 2009 in honor of Leandra Rosado. Leandra was an 11-year old killed while she rode in a vehicle with the intoxicated mother of one of her friends. In response to this tragedy, the NY State Legislature made several changes to the Vehicle and Traffic Law (VTL). The law strengthened the penalties against motorists who drink and drive, and requires that
source_blocks.text: 利安德拉法案于2009年11月18日签署成为法律，以纪念利安德拉·罗萨多。利安德拉是一名11岁的儿童，她在乘坐一位朋友醉酒母亲的车辆时丧生。针对这一悲剧，纽约州立法机构对《车辆与交通法》进行了多项修改。该法律加强了对酒后驾车者的处罚，并要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: any person sentenced for Driving While Intoxicated on or after August 15, 2010 must have an ignition interlock device installed on any vehicle they own or operate the driver will have an "ignition interlock" restriction added to their driver license
source_blocks.text: 任何在2010年8月15日或之后因醉酒驾驶被判刑的人，必须在其拥有或操作的任何车辆上安装点火联锁装置 驾驶员的驾驶执照上将被添加“点火联锁”限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: See additional information about Leandra's Law at the NY State Governor's Traffic Safety Committee Alcohol, Drugs and Impaired Driving [1] page.
source_blocks.text: 有关利安德拉法案的更多信息，请参阅纽约州州长交通安全委员会关于酒精、毒品和受损驾驶的页面[1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the different parts of Leandra's Law and what are the penalties for conviction?
source_blocks.text: 利安德拉法案的不同部分是什么，定罪的处罚是什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Leandra's Law includes the following provisions:
source_blocks.text: 利安德拉法案包括以下规定：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The law established a new Class E Felony. The law states that no person shall operate a motor vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs while a child who is 15 years of age or younger is a passenger in the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 该法律设立了一项新的E级重罪。法律规定，任何人不得在酒精或药物影响下操作机动车，而车内有15岁或以下的儿童乘客。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A court must sentence a person convicted of either to a period of probation or to a conditional discharge. The court must require the installation and use of an ignition interlock device in any motor vehicle owned or operated by a person convicted under this law. The ignition interlock device must remain in the vehicle for at least 12 months, unless otherwise permitted by the court.
source_blocks.text: 法院必须对被判犯有上述罪行的人判处缓刑或有条件释放。法院必须要求在被判犯有本法规定罪的人拥有或操作的任何机动车上安装和使用点火联锁装置。点火联锁装置必须在车辆中保留至少12个月，除非法院另有许可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A court that sentences a person for a conviction on or after August 15, 2010 must impose a conditional discharge or probation, and a condition of the sentence must be the installation and use of an ignition interlock device in any motor vehicle the person owns or operates. The ignition interlock device must remain in the vehicle for at least 12 months, unless otherwise permitted by the court.
source_blocks.text: 对于在2010年8月15日或之后被定罪的人，法院在判刑时必须施加有条件释放或缓刑，并且刑罚的条件必须是在该人拥有或操作的任何机动车上安装和使用点火联锁装置。点火联锁装置必须在车辆中保留至少12个月，除非法院另有许可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is an "ignition interlock device"?
source_blocks.text: 什么是“点火联锁装置”？

source_blocks.source_text_en: An ignition interlock device connects to a motor vehicle ignition system and measures the alcohol content in the breath of the operator. The device prevents the vehicle from being started until the motorist provides an acceptable breath sample.
source_blocks.text: 点火联锁装置连接到机动车点火系统，并测量操作者呼吸中的酒精含量。该装置阻止车辆启动，直到驾驶员提供可接受的呼吸样本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If ignition interlock is ordered by a court, the system must be installed on each vehicle the motorist owns or operates. The device must remain installed for at least six months. The ignition interlock restriction will be added to the driver license record even if the license is revoked. The restriction will appear on the back of the driver license document as "interlock device".
source_blocks.text: 如果法院下令安装点火联锁，系统必须安装在驾驶员拥有或操作的每辆车上。该装置必须保持安装至少六个月。即使驾驶执照被吊销，点火联锁限制也会添加到驾驶执照记录中。该限制将出现在驾驶执照文件的背面，显示为“联锁装置”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Courts and probation departments will direct convicted motorists to vendors for ignition interlock installation. The NY State Division of Criminal Justice Services [2] website provides details on ignition interlock device vendors and information from the manufacturers of the device.
source_blocks.text: 法院和缓刑部门将指示被定罪的驾驶员前往供应商处安装点火联锁。纽约州刑事司法服务部[2]网站提供了点火联锁装置供应商的详细信息以及设备制造商的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I remove the ignition interlock restriction from my driver license?
source_blocks.text: 如何从我的驾驶执照上移除点火联锁限制？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your ignition interlock monitor must give you a form that states that you are no longer required to install and maintain the ignition interlock device in motor vehicles you own or operate. You must take this form to a local DMV office and apply for a new document without the restriction.
source_blocks.text: 您的点火联锁监控器必须给您一份表格，说明您不再需要在您拥有或操作的机动车上安装和维护点火联锁装置。您必须将此表格带到当地DMV办公室，并申请一份没有该限制的新文件。

source_blocks.text: What are personalized plates?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Personalized plates are standard series plates that have a combination of numbers and letters that you select, for an additional fee in addition to your regular vehicle registration fee. 1
source_blocks.text: Personalized plates are standard series plates that have a combination of numbers and letters that you select, for an additional fee in addition to your regular vehicle registration fee. 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about picture and professional plates
source_blocks.text: 了解图片和专业车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: A picture or professional plate is a vehicle plate that has the words "New York" contained in a blue banner, and a picture or logo next to the plate number.
source_blocks.text: 图片或专业车牌是一种车辆牌照，其蓝色横幅上包含“New York”字样，并在车牌号码旁边有图片或标志。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some personalized [1] picture plates are available for an additional fee.
source_blocks.text: 部分个性化 [1] 图片车牌需额外付费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can browse the available styles of picture and professional plates online. The categories are:
source_blocks.text: 您可以在线浏览可用的图片和专业车牌样式。类别包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I Love NY Adventure Plates [2] Sports [3] Military and Veterans [4] Counties and Regions of NYS [5] Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [6] Causes [7] Professions [8] Organizations [9] Motorcycle Plates [10]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Cost of picture and professional plates
source_blocks.text: 图片和专业车牌的费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our picture and professional plates have a variety of prices. You can browse the available styles using the categories above to find detailed pricing information on the plate you re interested in.
source_blocks.text: 我们的图片和专业车牌价格多样。您可以使用上述类别浏览可用样式，以查找您感兴趣的车牌的详细定价信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Privileges of professional plates
source_blocks.text: 专业车牌的特权

source_blocks.source_text_en: Custom plates reserved for professional groups and emergency services organizations serve to identify the registrant as a member of that group. The plates come with no special rights or privileges. 1
source_blocks.text: 为专业团体和紧急服务组织保留的定制车牌用于识别注册人为该团体成员。这些车牌不附带任何特殊权利或特权。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Standard series plates to replace picture or professional plates
source_blocks.text: 用标准系列车牌替换图片或专业车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: To exchange custom plates for standard series plates
source_blocks.text: 要交换定制车牌为标准系列车牌：

source_blocks.source_text_en: complete a Vehicle Registration/Title Application (pdf) [11] (MV-82) bring the form, the plates and your NY State Driver License to a DMV office [12] pay a one-time plate exchange fee of \$28.75, and surrender your plates
source_blocks.text: 填写车辆注册/所有权申请表 (pdf) [11] (MV-82) 携带表格、车牌和您的纽约州驾驶执照前往 DMV 办公室 [12] 支付一次性车牌交换费 \$28.75，并交回车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will then issue your vehicle a set of standard series plates. 2
source_blocks.text: 然后我们将为您的车辆发放一套标准系列车牌。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I remove a vehicle from the road, can I keep my picture or professional plates?
source_blocks.text: 如果我将车辆从道路上移除，我可以保留我的图片或专业车牌吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can store your picture or professional plates at most DMV offices. 3
source_blocks.text: 可以。您可以在大多数 DMV 办公室存放您的图片或专业车牌。3

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a DMV office. [12]
source_blocks.text: 查找 DMV 办公室。[12]

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will receive a receipt (form FS-6T) when you surrender your plates. Verify the information listed on the receipt, make sure that the receipt displays the words "Stored at Local Office, and keep this receipt. We will indicate on the registration record that the vehicle plates have been stored.
source_blocks.text: 当您交回车牌时，您将收到一张收据（表格 FS-6T）。请核实收据上列出的信息，确保收据显示“Stored at Local Office”字样，并保留此收据。我们将在注册记录上注明车辆牌照已存放。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To register the vehicle again, or to use your stored picture or professional plates to register another vehicle, you must visit the office that has your vehicle plates. Make sure that you bring the receipt (form FS-6T) and the other documents required to register your vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 要重新注册车辆，或使用您存放的图片或专业车牌注册另一辆车，您必须前往存放您车辆牌照的办公室。请确保携带收据（表格 FS-6T）和注册车辆所需的其他文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New picture plate developed for a group or organization
source_blocks.text: 为团体或组织开发的新图片车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: A detailed information packet about the custom plate (picture plate) development program, including the Request for the Development of Custom Plates (pdf) [13] (MV-415) is available here.
source_blocks.text: 关于定制车牌（图片车牌）开发项目的详细信息包，包括《定制车牌开发申请表》（pdf）[13]（MV-415），可在此处获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Professional plates do not entitle you to any special parking privileges unless the city, town or village where you park your vehicle has granted such privileges. For more information, contact your local police or parking enforcement agency, or the agency that is responsible for parking regulations. You will no longer pay the custom plate fees when you renew your registration. If your registration is in the first year of a two-year registration, you must submit a Request for refund or fee paid for motor vehicle registrations and driver licenses (pdf) [14] (MV-215) to apply for a refund of the balance of the fee. (A processing fee of \$1.00 is subtracted from your refund.) You will not receive a refund if the registration expires in less than one year. The policy to store vehicle plates is different in each office.
source_blocks.text: 专业车牌并不赋予您任何特殊停车特权，除非您停车的城市、城镇或村庄已授予此类特权。如需更多信息，请联系您当地的警察或停车执法机构，或负责停车规定的机构。 您在续期注册时将不再支付定制车牌费用。如果您的注册处于两年注册期的第一年，您必须提交《机动车注册和驾照费用退款申请表》（pdf）[14]（MV-215）以申请余额退款。（退款中将扣除\$1.00的手续费。）如果注册在不到一年内到期，您将不会收到退款。 存放车辆车牌的政策各办公室不同。

documents.source_title_en: Let the Buyer be Aware
documents.title: 让买家警惕

source_blocks.source_text_en: Let the Buyer be Aware
source_blocks.text: 让买家警惕

source_blocks.source_text_en: Buying from a Dealer
source_blocks.text: 从经销商处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: In New York State, every automotive dealer must register with the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). A registered dealer must obey certain state and federal laws that protect your purchase of a new or used car, truck, or other motor vehicle, including one sold as "salvage." New vehicles are also protected by manufacturer's warranty. You can search for registered Automotive Dealers by using the Find a DMV-regulated Business [1] service.
source_blocks.text: 在纽约州，每个汽车经销商都必须向机动车管理局（DMV）注册。注册经销商必须遵守某些州和联邦法律，以保护您购买新车、二手车、卡车或其他机动车（包括以“salvage”出售的车辆）的权益。新车还受制造商保修的保护。您可以使用“查找DMV监管企业”[1]服务搜索注册的汽车经销商。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you buy a used vehicle, the dealer must certify, in writing, that it is "in condition and repair to render, under normal use, satisfactory and adequate service upon the public highway at the time of delivery." The dealer certification covers the entire vehicle except items that would be obvious to the customer before the sale, such as torn upholstery, missing hubcaps, etc. The vehicle also must have all safety equipment and emissions controls required by state and federal laws for the vehicle's model year.
source_blocks.text: 当您购买二手车时，经销商必须以书面形式证明，该车“在交付时，处于正常使用下，能够在公共高速公路上提供令人满意且足够的服务和维修状态”。经销商认证涵盖整个车辆，但销售前对客户显而易见的项目除外，如撕裂的内饰、缺失的轮毂罩等。车辆还必须具备州和联邦法律对该车型年份要求的所有安全设备和排放控制装置。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A dealer also must:
source_blocks.text: 经销商还必须：

source_blocks.source_text_en: have the vehicle inspected before selling it to a retail customer, even if the vehicle is new. The inspection must be done within 30 days of the date of sale and before you take delivery. The dealer may charge you the inspection fee. provide service or repairs under the manufacturer's warranty if the dealer is franchised by that manufacturer. Warranty service also may be available from other dealers franchised by the manufacturer. indicate, in writing, on the bill of sale whether a vehicle sold to a retail buyer is new, used, reconstructed, rebuilt salvage, or originally not manufactured to U.S. standards (see Title Branding). provide the buyer completed odometer and damage disclosure statements: - For motor vehicles that are 10 model years old or newer, the seller must complete the odometer disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate. For vehicles older than 10 model years, odometer disclosure is not required. - The damage disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate must be completed regardless of the vehicle s age.
source_blocks.text: 在将车辆出售给零售客户之前进行检验，即使车辆是新的。检验必须在销售日期后30天内、您提车之前完成。经销商可向您收取检验费。 如果经销商是该制造商的特许经销商，则根据制造商保修提供服务或维修。保修服务也可能由该制造商特许的其他经销商提供。 在销售单上以书面形式注明出售给零售买家的车辆是新车、二手车、重建车、重建报废车，还是最初未按美国标准制造的车辆（参见Title Branding）。 向买家提供完整的里程表和损坏披露声明： - 对于10个车型年或更新的机动车，卖方必须填写所有权证书背面的里程表披露声明。对于超过10个车型年的车辆，不需要里程表披露。 - 无论车辆年龄如何，都必须填写所有权证书背面的损坏披露声明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: The DMV will not register or grant title to a salvaged vehicle without a completed salvage disclosure statement. In addition, the DMV must examine each vehicle branded or identified by the seller as "Rebuilt Salvage" for stolen parts before the vehicle can be registered or titled.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果没有完整的报废披露声明，DMV将不会注册或授予报废车辆的所有权。此外，DMV必须检查每辆被卖方标记或标识为“Rebuilt Salvage”的车辆是否有被盗零件，然后才能注册或授予所有权。

source_blocks.source_text_en: complete and sign an odometer disclosure statement if the vehicle is 10 model years old or newer. This statement is on the Retail Certificate of Sale (MV-50). The buyer also must acknowledge and sign the odometer statement. indicate on the sales contract when a passenger car had been used primarily as a police car, taxicab, driver education or rental car.
source_blocks.text: 如果车辆为10个车型年或更新，则填写并签署里程表披露声明。此声明位于零售销售证书（MV-50）上。买家也必须确认并签署里程表声明。 在销售合同中注明客车是否主要用作警车、出租车、驾驶教育或租赁车。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a lien is being recorded or the dealer issued number plates, the dealer MUST handle the registration for you. The dealer may charge you up to \$75 for this service, plus the actual fees for the vehicle's Certificate of Title (MV-999), registration, and license plates. As a customer courtesy, a registered dealer may submit your completed Vehicle Registration/Title Application (MV-82) to the DMV. The dealer also may provide a temporary certificate of registration and, if needed, new license plates.
source_blocks.text: 如果正在记录留置权或经销商发放了车牌，经销商必须为您处理注册。经销商可为此服务向您收取最高\$75的费用，外加车辆所有权证书（MV-999）、注册和车牌的实际费用。作为客户礼遇，注册经销商可将您填写的车辆注册/所有权申请（MV-82）提交给DMV。经销商还可提供临时注册证书，并在需要时提供新车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Buying From a Private Seller
source_blocks.text: 从私人卖家处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: One advantage of buying a vehicle from a private seller is the possibility of lower cost compared to buying from a dealer. However, there are disadvantages.
source_blocks.text: 从私人卖家处购买车辆的一个优势是可能比从经销商处购买成本更低。然而，也有缺点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A private seller does not have to follow important regulations that a dealer must obey. In addition, a private seller rarely offers a warranty. If you have a complaint about the vehicle or purchase, you are on your own to resolve the problem with the seller, or in taking legal action. You cannot file a complaint with the DMV or other consumer assistance agencies if you buy a defective vehicle in a private sale. If you buy a vehicle 8 model years old or newer, the DMV will NOT register or issue you a new title certificate unless the seller has completed, and you have signed, the damage disclosure statement on the reverse of the vehicle's Certificate of Title (MV-999) or have attached a completed damage disclosure on an Odometer and Damage Disclosure Statement (MV-103). This statement indicates whether or not the vehicle's new title certificate should be branded "Rebuilt Salvage" (see Title Branding). An Odometer and Damage Disclosure Statement (pdf) [2] (MV-103) is available at any motor vehicle office. For motor vehicles that are 10 model years old or newer, the seller must complete the odometer disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate. For vehicles older than 10 model years, odometer disclosure is not required. The damage disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate must be completed regardless of the vehicle s age.
source_blocks.text: 私人卖家不必遵守经销商必须遵守的重要法规。此外，私人卖家很少提供保修。如果您对车辆或购买有投诉，您需要自行与卖家解决问题或采取法律行动。如果您在私人交易中购买了有缺陷的车辆，您不能向DMV或其他消费者援助机构提出投诉。 如果您购买8个车型年或更新的车辆，除非卖方已填写且您已签署车辆所有权证书（MV-999）背面的损坏披露声明，或附上已填写的里程表和损坏披露声明（MV-103），否则DMV将不会注册或向您颁发新的所有权证书。此声明表明车辆的新所有权证书是否应标记为“Rebuilt Salvage”（参见Title Branding）。里程表和损坏披露声明（pdf）[2]（MV-103）可在任何机动车办公室获取。 对于10个车型年或更新的机动车，卖方必须填写所有权证书背面的里程表披露声明。对于超过10个车型年的车辆，不需要里程表披露。 无论车辆年龄如何，都必须填写所有权证书背面的损坏披露声明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: THE DMV MUST EXAMINE EVERY VEHICLE IDENTIFIED AS "REBUILT SALVAGE" FOR STOLEN PARTS BEFORE THE VEHICLE CAN BE REGISTERED OR TITLED.
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：DMV必须检查每辆被标识为“REBUILT SALVAGE”的车辆是否有被盗零件，然后才能注册或授予所有权。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Title Branding
source_blocks.text: Title Branding

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a vehicle has been rebuilt, originally not manufactured to U.S. standards, or reconstructed, a branding notice must be printed in capital letters on the front of the New York State title certificate. A dealer must inform a customer, in writing, if a branded vehicle is being shown or sold to a retail customer. This may be a notice placed on the dealer's bill of sale or handed to the customer.
source_blocks.text: 如果车辆已重建、最初未按美国标准制造或重建，则必须在纽约州所有权证书正面以大写字母打印品牌通知。经销商必须以书面形式告知客户，如果向零售客户展示或出售品牌车辆。这可以是经销商销售单上的通知或交给客户的通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also find a printed notice on the front of the title certificate if a vehicle previously had been returned to the manufacturer, its agent, or dealer because it did not conform to warranty. It also will be printed on the title after a final determination of a court finding or settlement under the state's Lemon Law. This notice will read:
source_blocks.text: 如果车辆之前因不符合保修而被退回制造商、其代理商或经销商，您还可以在所有权证书正面找到打印的通知。在州柠檬法下的法院裁决或和解最终确定后，该通知也会打印在所有权上。此通知将显示：

source_blocks.source_text_en: "IMPORTANT: THIS VEHICLE WAS RETURNED TO THE MANUFACTURER OR DEALER BECAUSE IT DID NOT CONFORM TO ITS WARRANTY."
source_blocks.text: "重要提示：此车辆因不符合其保修而被退回制造商或经销商。"

source_blocks.source_text_en: The brands below may be printed on a New York State Certificate of Title (MV-999) for 1973 and newer vehicles:
source_blocks.text: 以下品牌可能打印在1973年及更新的纽约州所有权证书（MV-999）上：

source_blocks.source_text_en: REBUILT SALVAGE/NY
source_blocks.text: REBUILT SALVAGE/NY（重建报废车/纽约）

source_blocks.source_text_en: A vehicle with this label has been rebuilt after being wrecked, destroyed or damaged in excess of 75 percent of its retail value at the time of loss, or originally had entered New York State under a branded out-of-state title. Previous branding includes Salvage, Rebuilt Salvage, Salvage Restored, Junk, Parts Only, Water Damage, or other description. The Rebuilt Salvage branding will remain on the title for as long as the vehicle exists, no matter how many improvements are made to the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 带有此标签的车辆在损失时其零售价值的75%以上曾遭受碰撞、毁坏或损坏后经过重建，或者最初是以带有其他州品牌标题的形式进入纽约州的。之前的品牌包括Salvage（报废）、Rebuilt Salvage（重建报废）、Salvage Restored（修复报废）、Junk（废品）、Parts Only（仅零件）、Water Damage（水损）或其他描述。无论对车辆进行了多少改进，Rebuilt Salvage品牌将一直保留在标题上，只要车辆存在。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NON-USA-STD
source_blocks.text: NON-USA-STD（非美国标准）

source_blocks.source_text_en: A vehicle with this label was not originally manufactured in compliance with United States emissions or safety standards, or both.
source_blocks.text: 带有此标签的车辆最初并非按照美国排放或安全标准（或两者）制造。

source_blocks.source_text_en: RECONSTRUCTED
source_blocks.text: RECONSTRUCTED（重建车）

source_blocks.source_text_en: A vehicle with this label has been repaired or constructed with a glider kit, but not one manufactured in two or more stages. A glider kit includes all components of a vehicle except the power train. It is generally used to rebuild heavy trucks or tractors that have been extensively damaged. Passenger cars built from custom kits are not considered reconstructed vehicles.
source_blocks.text: 带有此标签的车辆已使用滑翔套件（glider kit）进行维修或制造，但不是由两个或更多阶段制造的。滑翔套件包括除动力总成外的所有车辆部件。它通常用于重建严重损坏的重型卡车或牵引车。由定制套件制造的乘用车不被视为重建车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reported Mileage
source_blocks.text: Reported Mileage（报告里程）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles over 10 model years old are exempt from mileage disclosure.
source_blocks.text: 车龄超过10年的车辆免于里程披露。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For all other titled vehicles, the odometer mileage reported during the vehicle's most recent transfer of ownership is printed on the front of its New York State Certificate of Title (MV-999). If the odometer had passed its maximum reading at the time of sale, the description "EXCEEDS MECHANICAL LIMITS" will be printed below the reported mileage. If the actual mileage is unknown because the odometer is broken, or has been repaired or replaced, the front of the title will be printed with "NOT ACTUAL MILEAGE, WARNING ODOMETER DISCREPANCY."
source_blocks.text: 对于所有其他有标题的车辆，在最近一次所有权转移期间报告的里程表读数将打印在纽约州机动车所有权证书（MV-999）的正面。如果在销售时里程表已超过其最大读数，则会在报告里程下方打印“EXCEEDS MECHANICAL LIMITS”（超出机械极限）。如果实际里程未知，因为里程表损坏、维修或更换，则标题正面将打印“NOT ACTUAL MILEAGE, WARNING ODOMETER DISCREPANCY”（非实际里程，警告里程表差异）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Choosing a Vehicle
source_blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle（选择车辆）

source_blocks.source_text_en: National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS) Vehicle History For Consumers [3] at YouTube
source_blocks.text: National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS) Vehicle History For Consumers（国家机动车所有权信息系统消费者车辆历史） [3] 在YouTube上

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicle price is not controlled by any government agency. Take time to choose a vehicle that meets your needs and budget. Before you buy a vehicle, compare prices by checking newspaper ads and visit a number of dealers and/or private sellers. Then take it for a test drive. If you are knowledgeable, examine the engine, transmission, drive axles, steering and suspension, brakes and electrical system. If you do not know what to look for, it may be wise to pay a professional automotive technician to examine the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 车辆价格不受任何政府机构控制。花时间选择符合您需求和预算的车辆。在购买车辆之前，通过查看报纸广告并访问多家经销商和/或私人卖家来比较价格。然后进行试驾。如果您有相关知识，请检查发动机、变速箱、驱动桥、转向和悬架、制动器和电气系统。如果您不知道要看什么，明智的做法是付费请专业汽车技师检查车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you buy from a dealer, find out about dealer or manufacturer warranties, what they cover, and for how long. Ask if the dealer performs service or subcontracts to a repair shop. Be sure all agreements, guarantees and warranties are in writing.
source_blocks.text: 在从经销商处购买之前，了解经销商或制造商的保修、保修范围及保修期限。询问经销商是自行维修还是分包给维修店。确保所有协议、保证和保修均以书面形式确认。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to look for
source_blocks.text: What to look for（注意事项）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Examine the vehicle in bright daylight. Look carefully at the body for signs of collision damage or rust. Check the paint and vinyl top, sides, or trim for signs of wear or damage. Check all lights, lenses and mirrors for cracks or other damage. Look inside the vehicle for signs of wear or damage that may reduce its value, such as splits or holes in the upholstery. Make sure all seat belts are in place, and in good working condition. Look under the rugs or mats for dampness or water damage, which could mean there are body leaks. Open the trunk or rear hatch and check for leaks. Examine the spare tire, taking it out if necessary. Make sure the jack and lug wrench are there. Examine the engine compartment for signs of rusted metal around fenders, oil leaks, or excessive dirt on the engine. These can be signs of high mileage. Look at and feel rubber parts such as fan belts and radiator hoses. If they are hard, cracked or too soft, they should be replaced. Make sure the exhaust emissions control systems are intact and working. Start the vehicle when the engine is cold and listen to make sure it runs smoothly when cold. While the engine warms, check the dash gauges and all inside and outside lights. Make sure the heater, defrosters, air conditioner, windshield washer and wipers work properly. If the vehicle is properly registered, you may choose to take it for a test drive. The engine should accelerate smoothly, and the transmission should shift without hesitation, roughness or loud noises. Drive the vehicle on a straight, flat surface, and let go of the steering wheel for a moment to see if the front wheels follow a straight track without pulling to either side. When braking, there should be no unusual noise, vibration, or pulling to either side. Your test drive should include stop-and-go driving on local streets and driving at highway speeds, over a variety of surfaces and several hills. Note how well the vehicle runs and handles. Also, check to see if the engine overheats. If you are satisfied after the test drive, have the vehicle raised on a lift or jacks. Examine the condition of the brakes, tires, front and rear suspension, exhaust system and catalytic converter. Look for oil or fluid leaks underneath.
source_blocks.text: 在明亮的日光下检查车辆。仔细观察车身是否有碰撞损坏或锈蚀的迹象。检查油漆和乙烯基车顶、侧面或饰条是否有磨损或损坏迹象。检查所有车灯、透镜和后视镜是否有裂纹或其他损坏。 检查车辆内部是否有磨损或损坏迹象，这些迹象可能降低其价值，例如内饰上的裂缝或孔洞。确保所有安全带都到位且工作状态良好。检查地毯或垫子下方是否有潮湿或水损，这可能意味着车身有泄漏。 打开后备箱或后舱门，检查是否有泄漏。检查备胎，如有必要请取出。确保千斤顶和轮胎扳手都在。 检查发动机舱，看挡泥板周围是否有金属锈蚀、漏油或发动机上过度污垢的迹象。这些可能是高里程的迹象。查看并触摸橡胶部件，如风扇皮带和散热器软管。如果它们变硬、开裂或过软，则应更换。 确保排气排放控制系统完好且工作正常。 在发动机冷态时启动车辆，并聆听以确保冷启动时运转平稳。在发动机预热时，检查仪表板仪表以及所有内外灯光。确保加热器、除霜器、空调、挡风玻璃清洗器和雨刮器正常工作。 如果车辆已正确注册，您可以选择进行试驾。发动机应平稳加速，变速箱换挡不应有犹豫、粗暴或噪音。在笔直平坦的路面上行驶，短暂松开方向盘，看前轮是否保持直线行驶而不偏向任何一侧。制动时不应有异常噪音、振动或偏向一侧。 您的试驾应包括在本地街道上的走走停停驾驶以及高速公路速度下的驾驶，覆盖各种路面和几个坡道。注意车辆的运行和操控性能。此外，检查发动机是否过热。 如果试驾后您满意，请将车辆升起或用千斤顶抬起。检查制动器、轮胎、前后悬架、排气系统和催化转化器的状况。检查下方是否有油或液体泄漏。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Taking Delivery
source_blocks.text: Taking Delivery（提车）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you decide the vehicle is in good condition and worth the price, be sure the seller has the proper ownership and transfer documents. Ask the seller, and examine the title certificate, for information about unsatisfied liens (bank loans, etc.). Carefully examine all documents before you pay for the vehicle. In a private sale, have the seller make out a bill of sale in addition to the ownership and sales tax documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果您决定车辆状况良好且价格合理，请确保卖方拥有正确的所有权和过户文件。向卖方询问并检查所有权证书，了解未清偿的留置权（如银行贷款等）信息。在付款前仔细检查所有文件。在私人交易中，除了所有权和销售税文件外，还应让卖方开具销售单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
source_blocks.text: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership（车辆所有权证明）

source_blocks.source_text_en: the proof of ownership is a Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) and the dealer's "Certificate of Sale" (MV-50).
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明是制造商原产地证书（MCO）和经销商的“销售证书”（MV-50）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: the proof of ownership is the Certificate of Title (MV-999), or a transferable registration for 1972 and older models, signed over to the dealer, and the dealer's Certificate of Sale (MV-50) showing ownership transfer to you. The dealer must complete, and you must acknowledge by signing, the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements.
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明是所有权证书（MV-999），或1972年及更老车型的可转让登记，已签署转让给经销商，以及经销商的销售证书（MV-50），显示所有权转让给您。经销商必须填写，您必须签署确认适当的里程表和损坏披露声明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: the proof of ownership is the Certificate of Title (MV-999), or a transferable registration for 1972 or older models, signed over to you. The seller must complete, and you must acknowledge by signing, the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements.
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明是所有权证书（MV-999），或1972年或更老车型的可转让登记，已签署转让给您。卖方必须填写，您必须签署确认适当的里程表和损坏披露声明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be sure the private seller completes the seller's section of the form Statement of Transaction - Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (pdf) [4] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802), available at motor vehicle offices or at the DMV web site. This form certifies the purchase price and determines the sales tax you must pay when registering the vehicle. If the form is not filled out by the seller, you will be charged sales tax based on the vehicle's current fair market value. Before you accept the title certificate from the seller, check the front of the title for the names and addresses of lien holders. A lien indicates the current owner owes money on a loan for the vehicle. If a lien is listed on the title, ask the seller to give you the proof the lien has been paid - in most cases, it will be an official from the lender. If proof is not provided, the lien holder could repossess the vehicle from you.
source_blocks.text: 确保私人卖方填写表格《交易声明 - 机动车、拖车、全地形车（ATV）、船只（Boat）或雪地摩托的销售或赠与》（pdf）[4]（纽约州税务和财政部门）（DTF-802）的卖方部分，该表格可在机动车办公室或DMV网站上获取。此表格证明购买价格并确定您在注册车辆时必须缴纳的销售税。如果卖方未填写该表格，您将根据车辆当前公平市场价值被收取销售税。 在接受卖方提供的所有权证书之前，检查证书正面是否有留置权人的姓名和地址。留置权表明当前车主欠有车辆贷款。如果所有权证书上列有留置权，请要求卖方提供留置权已清偿的证明 - 大多数情况下，这将是来自贷款机构的官方文件。如果未提供证明，留置权人可能会从您手中收回车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a concern or question about the title, registration, sales tax or proof of ownership, contact the DMV Call Center or any motor vehicle office before you buy the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对所有权、注册、销售税或所有权证明有疑问或疑虑，请在购买车辆前联系DMV呼叫中心或任何机动车办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
source_blocks.text: 交易或出售您的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you trade in or sell your old vehicle, be sure to remove the license plates and the windshield registration sticker, which shows your plate number. This will help prevent you from being charged with parking tickets that do not belong to you.
source_blocks.text: 在交易或出售您的旧车之前，请务必取下牌照和挡风玻璃上的注册贴纸，该贴纸显示您的车牌号。这将有助于防止您被指控不属于您的停车罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Turn in the plates to a motor vehicle office unless you are transferring them to a replacement vehicle. Always turn in your plates before you cancel liability insurance or before the insurance lapses. If you do not, your registration will be suspended, and your driver license could be suspended as well.
source_blocks.text: 将牌照交至机动车办公室，除非您将其转移到替代车辆上。在取消责任保险或保险失效之前，务必交还牌照。否则，您的注册将被暂停，您的驾驶执照也可能被暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When transferring the vehicle's title certificate to a new owner, you must fill out the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements, and sign your name at "Seller's Signature." Then enter the seller's information on the sales tax form Statement of Transaction - Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (pdf) [4] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802), available at any motor vehicle office and the DMV internet site.
source_blocks.text: 将车辆所有权证书转让给新车主时，您必须填写适当的里程表和损坏披露声明，并在“卖方签名”处签名。然后在销售税表格《交易声明 - 机动车、拖车、全地形车（ATV）、船只（Boat）或雪地摩托的销售或赠与》（pdf）[4]（纽约州税务和财政部门）（DTF-802）上填写卖方信息，该表格可在任何机动车办公室和DMV网站上获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
source_blocks.text: 机动车管理局消费者援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a complaint about your vehicle, bring it to the attention of the dealership management right away. Keep a record of all contacts with the dealer about the vehicle and any repairs or adjustments made. Keep copies of all work orders and invoices as proof of your attempts to resolve the problem.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对车辆有投诉，请立即向经销商管理层提出。保留与经销商就车辆及任何维修或调整的所有联系记录。保留所有工作订单和发票的副本，作为您尝试解决问题的证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you cannot resolve the problem with the dealer, write to: Bureau of Consumer and Facility Services, PO Box 2700-ESP, Albany, NY 12220-0700, or phone (518) 474-8943 between 8:30 a.m. and 4:15 p.m. weekdays.
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法与经销商解决问题，请写信至：Bureau of Consumer and Facility Services, PO Box 2700-ESP, Albany, NY 12220-0700，或致电（518）474-8943，时间为工作日8:30至16:15。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your complaint concerns a repair, you must file it with the Department of Motor Vehicles within 90 days or 3,000 miles of the repair, whichever comes first. If your complaint does not fall within its jurisdiction, DMV will refer you to the proper agency.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的投诉涉及维修，您必须在维修后90天或3,000英里内（以先到者为准）向机动车管理局提交。如果您的投诉不在其管辖范围内，DMV将转介您至适当的机构。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Lemon Laws
source_blocks.text: 柠檬法

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State's new and used car lemon laws provide legal remedies for consumers who buy or lease cars. If a car does not live up to the written warranty and cannot be repaired - or if it has not been repaired correctly after a reasonable number of attempts - the consumer could receive a refund or replacement car.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州的新车和二手车柠檬法为购买或租赁汽车的消费者提供法律救济。如果汽车不符合书面保修且无法修复 - 或在合理次数的尝试后仍未正确修复 - 消费者可能获得退款或更换车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For information and assistance concerning the Lemon Laws, contact:
source_blocks.text: 有关柠檬法的信息和帮助，请联系：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Office of the Attorney General [5] Albany, NY 12224 Telephone: 1-800-771-7755 or 1-518-474-5481 or any regional office of the Attorney General.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州总检察长办公室 [5] Albany, NY 12224 电话：1-800-771-7755 或 1-518-474-5481，或总检察长任何地区办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also contact:Department of State, Division of Consumer Protection Consumer Assistance Unit 99 Washington Avenue, Albany, NY 12231-0001 Telephone: 1-800-697-1220 or 1-518-474-8583.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以联系：州政府消费者保护司消费者援助部门 99 Washington Avenue, Albany, NY 12231-0001 电话：1-800-697-1220 或 1-518-474-8583。

source_blocks.text: DMV 呼叫中心电话号码 [6]

source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车管理局 Mark J. F. Schroeder，局长

documents.source_title_en: Lifetime driving records
documents.title: 终身驾驶记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: Lifetime driving records
source_blocks.text: 终身驾驶记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
source_blocks.text: 终身驾驶记录上显示哪些信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A "lifetime" driving record contains all the license information DMV currently has available about a driver. The lifetime driving record will display all information still in DMV s possession regardless of the data retention requirements found in Vehicle and Traffic Law. The record may not include information that dates back to when a driver was initially granted driving privileges.
source_blocks.text: “终身”驾驶记录包含DMV目前掌握的有关驾驶员的所有许可证信息。终身驾驶记录将显示DMV仍持有的所有信息，无论《车辆与交通法》中的数据保留要求如何。该记录可能不包含驾驶员最初获得驾驶特权时的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A standard driver license abstract only contains information that DMV is still required to keep. For example, most suspensions and revocations are only shown on the standard driving record abstract for 4 years from the date the suspension or revocation ended. A lifetime driving record will show suspensions and revocations that are older than 4 years.
source_blocks.text: 标准驾驶员执照摘要仅包含DMV仍被要求保留的信息。例如，大多数暂停和吊销仅在标准驾驶记录摘要上显示，自暂停或吊销结束之日起4年内。终身驾驶记录将显示超过4年的暂停和吊销。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Each driving record abstract contains information grouped within several sections. See Description of Abstract of Lifetime Driving Record [1] (DS-242.3) for more information on how to read and understand a lifetime driving record abstract.
source_blocks.text: 每份驾驶记录摘要包含多个部分的信息。请参阅终身驾驶记录摘要说明[1]（DS-242.3），了解如何阅读和理解终身驾驶记录摘要的更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Header 1
source_blocks.text: 标题1

source_blocks.source_text_en: The "Header" section includes the individual's information as applicable

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if the information on my driving record abstract is wrong?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的驾驶记录摘要上的信息有误怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you suspect that your DMV abstract contains incorrect information, contact the DMV Call Center [3].
source_blocks.text: 如果您怀疑您的DMV摘要包含不正确的信息，请联系DMV呼叫中心[3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This information is found at the top of driving record, but the word Header is not part of the abstract.
source_blocks.text: 此信息位于驾驶记录顶部，但单词 Header 不属于摘要的一部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This information is found at the top of a driving record, but the word Summary is not part of the abstract.
source_blocks.text: 此信息位于驾驶记录顶部，但单词 Summary 不属于摘要的一部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV lists an accident on the records of every driver in the accident. An accident that appears on a driving record does not assign the fault to that driver. The DMV does not determine the fault in an accident.
source_blocks.text: DMV 将事故列在每名涉事驾驶员的记录上。驾驶记录上出现的事故并不表示该驾驶员有过错。DMV 不判定事故责任。
