source_blocks.source_text_en: Lost, stolen, or destroyed plates
source_blocks.text: 车牌丢失、被盗或损毁

source_blocks.source_text_en: My vehicle plates were lost, stolen or destroyed. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我的车辆牌照丢失、被盗或损毁。我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must surrender the vehicle registration to the DMV.
source_blocks.text: 您必须向DMV交回车辆登记证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If two vehicle plates are lost, stolen or destroyed (or one plate if the vehicle was issued only one plate, e.g. motorcycles), you need to notify the police, and ask the police to complete a police report. Bring police report to a DMV office [1] to surrender the vehicle registration.
source_blocks.text: 如果两块车牌丢失、被盗或损毁（或者如果车辆只发放了一块车牌，例如摩托车，则是一块），您需要通知警方，并请警方完成一份警方报告。将警方报告带到DMV办公室 [1] 以交回车辆登记证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: if the plates were lost, stolen or destroyed in New York State, ask a NY State police agency to complete a 'Certification of Lost License, Permit or Plates' (MV-78B) (this form is only available from law enforcement - it is on the DMV website) if the plates were lost, stolen or destroyed outside of NY State, get a report printed on the letterhead of a police agency in the state where the incident happened
source_blocks.text: 如果车牌在纽约州丢失、被盗或损毁，请纽约州警察机构填写一份'丢失驾照、许可证或车牌证明'（MV-78B）（此表格仅可从执法机构获取——它不在DMV网站上） 如果车牌在纽约州以外丢失、被盗或损毁，请获取一份印有事件发生地所在州警察机构抬头的报告

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you cannot get a police report, write a statement that includes your plate number and explains why you cannot surrender your NY State plates.
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法获得警方报告，请写一份声明，包括您的车牌号，并解释为什么您无法交回您的纽约州车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If one plate (from a set of two plates) is lost, stolen or destroyed, you don t need to complete a police report. Bring the plate you have to a DMV office to surrender the registration. However, if you would like to replace your plates without paying a fee, you must submit a police report or an MV-78B indicating the plate was stolen or destroyed as a result of a crime.
source_blocks.text: 如果（一副两块中的）一块车牌丢失、被盗或损毁，您无需完成警方报告。将您持有的那块车牌带到DMV办公室以交回登记。但是，如果您希望免费更换车牌，您必须提交一份警方报告或MV-78B，表明该车牌是因犯罪而被盗或损毁。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I get new plates?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得新牌照？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may request a new set of plates at a DMV office. Bring these items with you:
source_blocks.text: 您可以在DMV办公室申请一套新牌照。请携带以下物品：

source_blocks.source_text_en: the original plate(s) or the MV-78B/police report/statement
source_blocks.text: 原始车牌或MV-78B/警方报告/声明

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Vehicle Registration/Title Application (pdf) [2] (MV-82)
source_blocks.text: 一份填写完整的车辆登记/所有权申请表（pdf） [2] （MV-82）

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of insurance 1
source_blocks.text: 保险证明 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of your identity 2
source_blocks.text: 身份证明 2

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print this checklist [3]
source_blocks.text: 打印此清单 [3]

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will issue you a new registration and replacement plates. If the plate(s) were lost or destroyed, you will need to pay for the new plates, and a fee of \$3.75 to issue a new registration. The fee for plates are
source_blocks.text: DMV将为您签发新的登记和更换牌照。如果车牌丢失或损毁，您需要支付新牌照的费用，以及签发新登记的\$3.75费用。牌照费用为

source_blocks.source_text_en: \$25 for a set of 2 plates \$12.50 for a vehicle that is only issued one plate; e.g. motorcycles)
source_blocks.text: 一副两块牌照\$25 仅发放一块牌照的车辆（例如摩托车）\$12.50

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don't need to pay a fee to replace stolen plates. However, you will need to provide a police report or an MV-78B indicating that the plates were stolen or destroyed as a result of a crime.
source_blocks.text: 更换被盗牌照无需支付费用。但是，您需要提供警方报告或MV-78B，表明牌照是因犯罪被盗或损毁。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What can I do if my vehicle was stolen?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的车辆被盗，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: See information about stolen and recovered vehicles [4].
source_blocks.text: 查看关于被盗和找回车辆的信息 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your insurance company will:
source_blocks.text: 您的保险公司将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1\) give you 2 barcoded original NY State Insurance ID cards (see a sample [5]) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card
source_blocks.text: 1\) 给您2张带条形码的纽约州保险ID卡原件（查看示例 [5]）或提供您访问数字电子纽约州保险ID卡的权限

source_blocks.source_text_en: 2\) send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)
source_blocks.text: 2\) 向DMV发送电子保险覆盖通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人不能提交此通知）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Insurance ID cards and the electronic notice together verify your coverage. We need both.
source_blocks.text: 您的纽约州保险ID卡和电子通知共同证明您的保险覆盖。我们需要两者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle within 180 days of the effective date on your Insurance ID Card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance ID Card with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险ID卡上的生效日期起180天内注册您的车辆。随身携带一份您的保险ID卡副本或表格。DMV办公室将保留纸质卡。将另一张纸质卡放在车内作为您的保险证明。任何操作您车辆的人都必须能够提供保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements [6].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于纽约州保险要求的信息 [6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your proof of identity can be your NY State Driver License, Permit, or Non-Driver ID Card. For other acceptable proofs see Proofs of Identity for Registration and Title (pdf) [7] (ID-82).
source_blocks.text: 您的身份证明可以是您的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID卡。其他可接受的证明请参见注册和所有权身份证明（pdf） [7]（ID-82）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical Certification FAQ's
source_blocks.text: 医疗认证常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Self-Certification
source_blocks.text: 自我认证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why do I have to self-certify?
source_blocks.text: 为什么我必须进行自我认证？

source_blocks.source_text_en: New federal regulations require all commercial drivers to certify to the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) the type of driving they perform or expect to perform. Drivers that self-certify to a non-excepted driving type (NA or NI) are also required to submit a copy of their USDOT Medical Examiner s Certificate.
source_blocks.text: 新的联邦法规要求所有商业驾驶员向机动车管理局（DMV）证明他们从事或预期从事的驾驶类型。自我认证为非豁免驾驶类型（NA或NI）的驾驶员还需提交其USDOT医疗检查员证书的副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This is a nationwide safety initiative that affects commercial driver in all states.
source_blocks.text: 这是一项影响所有州商业驾驶员的全国性安全倡议。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the self-certification driving types?
source_blocks.text: 自我认证的驾驶类型有哪些？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-Excepted Interstate (NI): Commercial driving operation is permitted across state lines, and you are required to meet the Federal medical requirements
source_blocks.text: 非豁免跨州（NI）：允许跨州商业驾驶操作，且您需要满足联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-Excepted Intrastate (NA): Commercial driving operation is restricted to New York State only, and you are required to meet the Federal medical requirements
source_blocks.text: 非豁免州内（NA）：商业驾驶操作仅限于纽约州内，且您需要满足联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Excepted Interstate (EI): Commercial driving operation is permitted across state lines for excepted operation only and you are exempt from the Federal medical requirements
source_blocks.text: 豁免跨州（EI）：允许跨州商业驾驶操作，但仅限于豁免操作，且您免于联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Excepted Intrastate (EA): Commercial driving operation is restricted to New York State, permitted for excepted operation only and you are exempt from the Federal medical requirements.
source_blocks.text: 豁免州内（EA）：商业驾驶操作仅限于纽约州内，仅允许豁免操作，且您免于联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if my driving type changes?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的驾驶类型发生变化怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your driving type changes, you must go into your local DMV office to change your self-certification driving type and have your license amended to add or delete the appropriate restrictions. A transaction fee will apply. If you are self-certifying to a non-excepted driving type (NA or NI) you will need to bring a copy of your valid USDOT Medical Examiners Certificate if it is not already on file with DMV.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾驶类型发生变化，您必须前往当地的DMV办公室更改您的自我认证驾驶类型，并通过修改驾照来添加或删除相应的限制。将收取交易费。如果您自我认证为非豁免驾驶类型（NA或NI），您需要携带有效的USDOT医疗检查员证书副本（如果尚未存档于DMV）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I change my self-certification driving type online?
source_blocks.text: 我可以在线更改我的自我认证驾驶类型吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, you must go into a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 不可以，您必须前往DMV办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I am eligible for an excepted operation, but I have a valid DOT Medical Examiner s Certificate. What driving type should I certify to?
source_blocks.text: 我有资格进行豁免操作，但我持有有效的DOT医疗检查员证书。我应该认证为哪种驾驶类型？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should certify to the type of driving in which you operate or expect to operate, and your CDL will have the restrictions for that driving type.
source_blocks.text: 您应认证为您操作或预期操作的驾驶类型，您的CDL将带有该驾驶类型的限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remember, your certification can be changed anytime at a local DMV office through a license amendment transaction.
source_blocks.text: 请记住，您可以随时通过驾照修改交易在当地的DMV办公室更改您的认证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: If you are capable of obtaining a Medical Examiner s Certificate, then the NI driving type will allow for the broadest commercial operation capability with no license restrictions applied.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您能够获得医疗检查员证书，那么NI驾驶类型将允许最广泛的商业操作能力，且无驾照限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I do not meet the USDOT federal medical requirements, and I cannot obtain a Medical Examiner s Certificate. I do not operate in any federal excepted operation, but I was able to keep my CDL because it was issued prior to 9/9/1999. Can I still keep my CDL license?
source_blocks.text: 我不符合USDOT联邦医疗要求，也无法获得Medical Examiner's Certificate。我不从事任何联邦豁免运营，但我的CDL是在1999年9月9日之前签发的，因此我保留了它。我还能保留我的CDL驾照吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, you are eligible for Excepted Intrastate operation (EA). You must ensure that your CDL has the required restrictions: K (CDL Intrastate Only) and A3 (Med Cert Exempt). CDL holders that certify to EA can only operate a commercial motor vehicle within New York State, and cannot deliver cargo coming from, or being delivered to, another state or foreign country.
source_blocks.text: 是的，您有资格进行Excepted Intrastate运营（EA）。您必须确保您的CDL具有所需的限制：K（仅限州内CDL）和A3（医疗证明豁免）。认证为EA的CDL持有者只能在纽约州内运营商用机动车，并且不能运送来自或运往其他州或外国的货物。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I work for a "private" company that provides school bus service to local school systems. Do I need to provide a Medical Examiner s Certificate or can I certify to "EI"?
source_blocks.text: 我为一家为当地学校系统提供校车服务的"私营"公司工作。我需要提供Medical Examiner's Certificate，还是可以认证为"EI"？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you operate or expect to operate in an excepted operation such as school operation for a private service, you can choose EI.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在豁免运营中运营或预期运营，例如为私营服务提供校车运营，您可以选择EI。

source_blocks.source_text_en: School operation is defined as "school to home/home to school" operation and includes interstate operation for school operation only. This does not include field trips. Only applicants employed by a municipality can drive for out-of-state field trips.
source_blocks.text: 校车运营被定义为"学校到家庭/家庭到学校"的运营，并且仅包括州际校车运营。这不包括实地考察旅行。只有受雇于市政当局的申请人才能驾驶进行州外实地考察旅行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is important to remember that when you choose driving type EI, you are limited to driving only for an excepted operation.
source_blocks.text: 重要的是要记住，当您选择驾驶类型EI时，您仅限于为豁免运营驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: If you are capable of obtaining a Medical Examiner s Certificate, then the NI driving type will allow for the broadest commercial operation capability with no license restrictions applied.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您能够获得Medical Examiner's Certificate，那么NI驾驶类型将允许最广泛的商业运营能力，且无需任何驾照限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I have a current CDL license with no restrictions. I do NOT have a Medical Examiner s Certificate and I do not use my CDL license to drive commercially. For example I am retired, not working, etc. I don t want to downgrade my license because I paid for a CDL and have several years before it expires. What driving type should I choose?
source_blocks.text: 我目前持有无限制的CDL驾照。我没有Medical Examiner's Certificate，也不使用我的CDL驾照进行商业驾驶。例如，我已退休、未工作等。我不想降级我的驾照，因为我为CDL付了钱，而且还有几年才到期。我应该选择哪种驾驶类型？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal regulations require all CDL drivers to certify to the type of driving in which they operate or expect to operate. You should choose the box which describes the type of driving that you perform or expect to perform.
source_blocks.text: 联邦法规要求所有CDL驾驶员认证他们运营或预期运营的驾驶类型。您应该选择描述您执行或预期执行的驾驶类型的选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you expect to operate in an excepted driving type (EA or EI) then a Medical Examiner s Certificate is not required. You will need to have the appropriate restrictions added to your driver s license (A3 and/or K). If you expect to operate in a non-excepted driving type (NA or NI) then a Medical Examiner s Certificate is required.
source_blocks.text: 如果您预期在豁免驾驶类型（EA或EI）中运营，则不需要Medical Examiner's Certificate。您需要在您的驾照上添加适当的限制（A3和/或K）。 如果您预期在非豁免驾驶类型（NA或NI）中运营，则需要Medical Examiner's Certificate。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remember, your certification can be changed anytime at a local DMV office through a license amendment transaction.
source_blocks.text: 请记住，您的认证可以随时在当地的DMV办公室通过驾照修正交易进行更改。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why did I receive my Medical Examiner s Certificate back in the mail with a rejection letter?
source_blocks.text: 为什么我收到退回的Medical Examiner's Certificate和拒绝信？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The rejection letter indicates why the Medical Examiner s Certificate is being returned to you. If information was incorrect, missing or illegible, you must contact your physician to have the form amended or another form completed.
source_blocks.text: 拒绝信说明了Medical Examiner's Certificate被退回给您的原因。如果信息不正确、缺失或难以辨认，您必须联系您的医生修改表格或重新填写一份。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your Medical Examiners Certificate was rejected because it was not completed by a doctor listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners, you must have a new exam completed by a doctor on the registry. To find a certified doctor in your area please visit the Federal website at National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners Search [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您的Medical Examiner's Certificate因未由National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners列出的医生完成而被拒绝，您必须由注册表上的医生重新进行体检。要查找您所在地区的认证医生，请访问联邦网站National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners Search [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I downgrade my license to a non-commercial class, am I eligible for a refund?
source_blocks.text: 如果我将驾照降级为非商业类别，我是否有资格获得退款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No refund will be given as the driver will have the remainder of the renewal period as well as the two year grace period to be granted back the CDL without re-testing requirements. A refund is only allowed by law if the license is surrendered in full and there is 4 years or more remaining at the time of surrender.
source_blocks.text: 不会退款，因为驾驶员将拥有剩余的续期期以及两年的宽限期，以便无需重新考试即可恢复CDL。只有在完全交回驾照且交回时剩余4年或更长时间的情况下，法律才允许退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will you send me a reminder when my Medical Examiner s Certificate or my medical variance is going to expire?
source_blocks.text: 当我的Medical Examiner's Certificate或医疗豁免即将到期时，你们会给我发送提醒吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, DMV sends reminders to CDL and CLP holders who have registered to receive email and/or text reminders about the status of their medical certifications [2] and medical variances [3]. To register to receive these reminders, go to Get email and/or text reminders [4].
source_blocks.text: 是的，DMV会向已注册接收电子邮件和/或短信提醒的CDL和CLP持有者发送关于其医疗认证 [2] 和医疗豁免 [3] 状态的提醒。要注册接收这些提醒，请访问Get email and/or text reminders [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Failure to submit an updated Medical Examiner s Certificate, or medical variance, prior to the expiration date of the one on file may result in your CDL being downgraded. You should allow at least two weeks to process your updated documents.
source_blocks.text: 未能在现有体检医师证明（Medical Examiner's Certificate）或医疗豁免（medical variance）到期日之前提交更新版本，可能导致您的CDL被降级。您应至少预留两周时间处理更新文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Medical Examiner s Certificate I previously sent has since expired or is due to expire. My next doctor s appointment is not for another two weeks. What happens to my CDL in the meantime?
source_blocks.text: 我之前提交的体检医师证明（Medical Examiner's Certificate）已过期或即将过期。我的下一次医生预约还要等两周。在此期间我的CDL会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once your Medical Examiner s Certificate on file expires, you are no longer certified to drive commercial vehicles. A notice advising you of your not certified medical status and impending license downgrade (56 days from the date of notice) will be sent to you. When we receive your new updated medical certificate, you will be re-certified. If your CDL was downgraded because of your "not certified" medical status, you will need to visit a local DMV office to upgrade your license back to a CDL.
source_blocks.text: 一旦您存档的体检医师证明（Medical Examiner's Certificate）过期，您将不再被认证驾驶商用车辆。您将收到一份通知，告知您未认证的医疗状态及即将到来的驾照降级（自通知日期起56天）。当我们收到您更新的医疗证明后，您将重新获得认证。如果您的CDL因“未认证”医疗状态而被降级，您需要前往当地DMV办公室将驾照升级回CDL。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know that the DMV received my self-certification and/or Medical Examiner s Certificate information?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道DMV是否收到了我的自我认证和/或体检医师证明（Medical Examiner's Certificate）信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are signed up for MyDMV or sign up at go to MyDMV [5] at the DMV website and use the service called "My License Status, Renewal and Replacement," you can look under "License Status" to determine your self-certification driving type, medical certification status and medical certificate expiration date.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已注册MyDMV或在DMV网站注册MyDMV [5]，并使用名为“My License Status, Renewal and Replacement”的服务，您可以在“License Status”下查看您的自我认证驾驶类型、医疗认证状态和医疗证明到期日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you self-certified to driving types NI & NA, you will have a medical certification status of either "Certified" or "Not Certified." If you self-certified to EI or EA, you will have a medical certification status of "Not Required".
source_blocks.text: 如果您自我认证为NI和NA驾驶类型，您的医疗认证状态将为“Certified”或“Not Certified”。如果您自我认证为EI或EA，您的医疗认证状态将为“Not Required”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: DMV is entering commercial driver self-certification and medical certification data daily, as soon as possible. However, due to the volume of responses it could take a period of time for a driver record to be fully updated. Self-certification driving types data will be entered and show first, followed later by medical certification data, So, there may be a period of time where an NI or NA driving type reflects a "Not Certified" medical status until the medical certification data is entered, when it will then be updated to "Certified".
source_blocks.text: 注意：DMV正在尽快每日录入商用驾驶员自我认证和医疗认证数据。然而，由于回复量较大，驾驶员记录完全更新可能需要一段时间。自我认证驾驶类型数据将首先录入并显示，随后是医疗认证数据。因此，在一段时间内，NI或NA驾驶类型可能显示“Not Certified”医疗状态，直到医疗认证数据录入后，才会更新为“Certified”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I contact the Medical Certification Unit?
source_blocks.text: 我如何联系医疗认证部门（Medical Certification Unit）？

source_blocks.text: 电子邮件：[email protected] [6]

source_blocks.text: 邮寄：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical Certification Requirements
source_blocks.text: 医疗认证要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal regulations require that every commercial learner permit (CLP) holder or driver license (CDL) holder must certify to the type of commercial driving they currently perform (or expect to perform).
source_blocks.text: 联邦法规要求每位商业学习驾照（CLP）持有人或商业驾照（CDL）持有人必须证明其当前（或预期）从事的商业驾驶类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: these requirements will affect all drivers who have, or apply for a commercial driver license (CDL) a USDOT Medical Examiner's Certificate will be required for some types of driving and must be submitted to DMV before your current certification expires you will lose your commercial driving privileges if you do not comply
source_blocks.text: 这些要求将影响所有持有或申请商业驾照（CDL）的驾驶员 某些驾驶类型需要USDOT医疗检查员证书，并且必须在当前认证到期前提交给DMV 如果不遵守，您将失去商业驾驶特权

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will send CDL/CLP holders a "Notice of Non-Compliance and License Downgrade" if their medical certification status becomes "Not Certified." Once we send the notification, DMV will cancel the CDL/CLP if the CDL/CLP holder does not submit an updated Medical Examiners Certificate (MCSA-5876) within 55 days. We can send employers a notification of these status changes if they subscribe to the NY State License Event Notification Service (LENS) [1]. We will send passenger carriers enrolled in the 19-A system notifications of CLP cancellation events.
source_blocks.text: 如果CDL/CLP持有人的医疗认证状态变为“未认证”，DMV将向其发送“不合规及驾照降级通知”。一旦我们发出通知，如果CDL/CLP持有人在55天内未提交更新的医疗检查员证书（MCSA-5876），DMV将取消其CDL/CLP。如果雇主订阅了纽约州驾照事件通知服务（LENS）[1]，我们可以向其发送这些状态变更的通知。我们将向注册了19-A系统的客运承运人发送CLP取消事件的通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Certification and driving types
source_blocks.text: 认证与驾驶类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a commercial driver license, Class A, B or C or CDL permit issued by the NY State DMV you must certify the type of driving you do anytime you perform a license transaction (other than an address change, or duplicate license). You will be required to choose only one driving type from the four federal driving types listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有纽约州DMV颁发的A类、B类或C类商业驾照或CDL许可证，在办理任何驾照业务（地址变更或补发驾照除外）时，您必须认证您所从事的驾驶类型。您需要从以下四种联邦驾驶类型中选择一种。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must also keep a current USDOT Medical Examiners Certificate on file with DMV if you self-certify to a Non-Excepted Driving type (NA or NI).
source_blocks.text: 如果您自我认证为非豁免驾驶类型（NA或NI），您还必须保持一份最新的USDOT医疗检查员证书存档于DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The four federal driving types
source_blocks.text: 四种联邦驾驶类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-Excepted [2] Interstate [3] (NI)
source_blocks.text: 非豁免 [2] 州际 [3] (NI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial driving operation is permitted across state lines, and you are required to meet the Federal medical requirements.
source_blocks.text: 允许跨州商业驾驶操作，并且您需要满足联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must be age 21 or older if you have a HAZMAT (H) or HAZMAT/Tank (X) endorsement [4], you may select this driving type you must not have a K (CDL Intrastate Only) [5] or A3 (Med Cert Exempt) [6] restriction on your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满21岁 如果您持有危险品（H）或危险品/罐车（X）签注 [4]，您可以选择此驾驶类型 您的驾照上不得有K（仅限州内CDL）[5]或A3（医疗证明豁免）[6]限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non-Excepted [2] Intrastate [3] (NA)
source_blocks.text: 非豁免 [2] 州内 [3] (NA)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial driving operation is restricted to New York State only, and you are required to meet the Federal medical requirements.
source_blocks.text: 商业驾驶操作仅限于纽约州内，并且您需要满足联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must be age 18 or older drivers with a HAZMAT (H) or HAZMAT/Tank (X) endorsement [4] may select this driving type you must have a K (CDL Intrastate Only) [5] restriction on driver license you must not have an A3 (Med Cert Exempt) [6] restriction on your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满18岁 持有危险品（H）或危险品/罐车（X）签注 [4] 的驾驶员可以选择此驾驶类型 您的驾照上必须有K（仅限州内CDL）[5]限制 您的驾照上不得有A3（医疗证明豁免）[6]限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: Excepted [2] Interstate [3] (EI)
source_blocks.text: 豁免 [2] 州际 [3] (EI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial driving operation is permitted across state lines for excepted operation only and you are exempt from the Federal medical requirements.
source_blocks.text: 允许跨州商业驾驶操作，但仅限于豁免操作，并且您免于联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must be age 18 or older (21 or older when noted for certain excepted operations) you must have an A3 (Med Cert Exempt) [6] restriction on your driver license you must not have a K (CDL Intrastate Only) [5] restriction on your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满18岁（某些豁免操作要求21岁以上） 您的驾照上必须有A3（医疗证明豁免）[6]限制 您的驾照上不得有K（仅限州内CDL）[5]限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: Excepted [2] Intrastate [3] (EA)
source_blocks.text: 豁免 [2] 州内 [3] (EA)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial driving operation is restricted to New York State, permitted for excepted operation only and you are exempt from the Federal medical requirements.
source_blocks.text: 商业驾驶操作仅限于纽约州内，仅允许例外运营，并且您豁免于联邦医疗要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must be age 18 or older (21 or older when noted for certain excepted operations) you must have the K (CDL Intrastate Only) [5] and the A3 (Med Cert Exempt) [6] restriction on your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满18岁或以上（某些例外运营中注明需21岁或以上） 您的驾驶执照上必须带有K（仅限州内CDL）[5]和A3（医疗证明豁免）[6]限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to obtain a USDOT Medical Examiners Certificate
source_blocks.text: 如何获取USDOT体检医师证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must get a USDOT physical performed by a medical examiner listed on the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration s (FMCSA) National Registry. To find an approved medical examiner, you can either go to the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiner Search [7], or call FMCSA at (202) 366-4001 and ask to speak to a representative. Once your physical is complete, the medical examiner will give you a Medical Examiners Certificate (Form MCSA-5876). To avoid a downgrade or cancellation of your CDL/CLP, you must take this certificate to the DMV when you apply for your CLP/CDL, or fax/email it to the NY State DMV Medical Certification Unit. (See important reminders below.)
source_blocks.text: 您必须由联邦汽车运输安全管理局（FMCSA）国家注册名单上的体检医师进行USDOT体检。要找到经批准的体检医师，您可以访问国家注册认证体检医师搜索[7]，或致电FMCSA (202) 366-4001并要求与代表通话。体检完成后，体检医师将给您一份体检医师证明（表格MCSA-5876）。为避免您的CDL/CLP被降级或取消，您必须在申请CLP/CDL时将此证明带到DMV，或传真/电子邮件发送至纽约州DMV医疗认证部门。（请参阅下方重要提醒。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV will send notifications regarding CDL/CLP downgrade/cancellation events to passenger carriers enrolled in the 19-A system. source_blocks.source_text_en: Moving out of New York State
source_blocks.text: 搬离纽约州

source_blocks.source_text_en: What do I need to do with my plates if I move out of New York?
source_blocks.text: 如果我搬离纽约，我的车牌需要怎么处理？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to register your vehicle in another state, you must surrender your vehicle registration and plates to the New York DMV [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您想在另一个州注册您的车辆，您必须将您的车辆注册和车牌交还给纽约DMV [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is out-of-state insurance acceptable for a vehicle registered in New York?
source_blocks.text: 对于在纽约注册的车辆，外州的保险是否可以接受？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. If your vehicle is registered in New York State, you must have New York insurance coverage. We will never accept out-of-state insurance coverage of any type for a vehicle registered in New York.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。如果您的车辆在纽约州注册，您必须拥有纽约的保险。对于在纽约注册的车辆，我们绝不会接受任何类型的外州保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I obtain out-of-state insurance and keep my vehicle registered in New York?
source_blocks.text: 我可以购买外州保险并继续在纽约注册我的车辆吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. If you replace your New York State insurance coverage with out-of-state insurance, your valid insurance coverage will lapse. We will suspend your registration and may suspend your driver license.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。如果您将纽约州的保险替换为外州保险，您的有效保险将会中断。我们将暂停您的注册，并可能暂停您的驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will take actions against your New York State registration and driver license even if you move out of New York. This can affect your ability to have a driver license in your new state. If you register your vehicle in another state, immediately surrender your vehicle registration and plates to the DMV [1].
source_blocks.text: 即使您搬离纽约，我们也会对您的纽约州注册和驾驶执照采取行动。这可能会影响您在新州获得驾驶执照的能力。如果您在另一个州注册您的车辆，请立即将您的车辆注册和车牌交还给DMV [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must surrender your vehicle registration and plates to the DMV before the New York State liability insurance is cancelled.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在纽约州责任保险被取消之前，将您的车辆注册和车牌交还给DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you register your vehicle in another state and surrender the New York vehicle plates to the New York DMV, you can get insurance in the other state. Your insurance must meet the requirements of the state where your vehicle is registered.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在另一个州注册您的车辆并将纽约车牌交还给纽约DMV，您可以在其他州购买保险。您的保险必须满足您车辆注册所在州的要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I registered my vehicle out of state, and then I received a letter from the DMV about a lapse of insurance on the vehicle. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我在外州注册了我的车辆，然后收到了DMV关于车辆保险中断的信件。我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please send us a copy of your out of state registration in your name along with a copy of your out of state insurance (if available) to:
source_blocks.text: 请将您名下的外州注册副本以及外州保险副本（如果有）发送至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles Financial Security Bureau PO BOX 2725 Albany NY 12220-0725
source_blocks.text: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles Financial Security Bureau PO BOX 2725 Albany NY 12220-0725

source_blocks.source_text_en: All proof must include the name and address of the registrant, and the year, make and vehicle identification number (VIN) of the vehicle. We will apply your proof to the NY record to reduce or clear a lapse of insurance coverage reported by your insurance company.
source_blocks.text: 所有证明必须包括注册人的姓名和地址，以及车辆的年份、品牌和车辆识别号码（VIN）。我们将把您的证明应用到纽约记录中，以减少或清除您的保险公司报告的保险中断情况。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definition of Resident per Section 250 (5) of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law: "As used in this section, the term 'resident' shall mean domiciliary, that is, one who lives in this state with the intention of making it a fixed and permanent abode. It shall be presumptive evidence that a person who maintains a place of abode in this state for a period of at least ninety days is a resident of this state." To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in NY State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a NY State driver license or vehicle registration. A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make NY State a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of NY State. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a NY State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: MyDMV Account Terms of Service
source_blocks.text: MyDMV 账户服务条款

source_blocks.source_text_en: MyDMV Account Terms of Service [1]
source_blocks.text: MyDMV 账户服务条款 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Introduction
source_blocks.text: 引言

source_blocks.source_text_en: A web account provides registered Users with secure and simplified access to use a variety of DMV s on-line applications and services.
source_blocks.text: 网络账户为注册用户提供安全、简化的访问方式，以便使用 DMV 的各种在线应用程序和服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: was created by the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), in cooperation with the New York State Office of Information Technology Services.
source_blocks.text: 该账户由纽约州机动车辆管理局（DMV）与纽约州信息技术服务办公室合作创建。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In order to register for a account, you must first select a Sign-In Username and Password and provide your identity information. Your Username, Password, and identity information are stored in a secure directory called the NY.gov , which is maintained by New York State Office of Information Technology Services.
source_blocks.text: 为了注册账户，您必须首先选择登录用户名和密码，并提供您的身份信息。您的用户名、密码和身份信息存储在名为 NY.gov 的安全目录中，该目录由纽约州信息技术服务办公室维护。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Username and Password
source_blocks.text: 用户名和密码

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you register for a account, you will be sent a temporary password by email. You must use the temporary password to complete the on-line registration process. After completing your registration, you can use your permanent Sign-In Username and Password for gaining access to applications and services.
source_blocks.text: 当您注册账户时，您将通过电子邮件收到一个临时密码。您必须使用该临时密码完成在线注册过程。完成注册后，您可以使用您的永久登录用户名和密码来访问应用程序和服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Upon validation of your identity, you will be permitted access to use DMV's secure web applications. This process is designed to protect the security of your identifying personal information. Your Sign-In Username and Password, and identifying personal information will be used solely for the purpose of NY.gov.
source_blocks.text: 在验证您的身份后，您将被允许访问 DMV 的安全网络应用程序。此过程旨在保护您个人身份信息的安全。您的登录用户名和密码以及个人身份信息将仅用于 NY.gov 的目的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: As an additional feature of NY.gov you can use the same Username and Password when you register to use secure web applications available at other New York State agencies that participate in NY.gov. After registering to gain access to use secure web applications at another NYS agency, you simply sign in using the same Username and Password.
source_blocks.text: 作为 NY.gov 的一项附加功能，当您注册使用参与 NY.gov 的其他纽约州机构的 secure 网络应用程序时，您可以使用相同的用户名和密码。在注册访问其他纽约州机构的 secure 网络应用程序后，您只需使用相同的用户名和密码登录即可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deactivation of NY.gov and Accounts
source_blocks.text: NY.gov 和账户的停用

source_blocks.source_text_en: For security purposes, the use of your MyDMV account is dependent upon validation of your identity by NY.gov. In the event that NY.gov deactivates access for any reason (e.g., unable to validate your identity), your account will also be deactivated, and thereafter access to applications and on-line services will be denied and the account will be locked.
source_blocks.text: 出于安全目的，您使用 MyDMV 账户取决于 NY.gov 对您身份的验证。如果 NY.gov 因任何原因（例如，无法验证您的身份）停用访问权限，您的账户也将被停用，此后将拒绝访问应用程序和在线服务，并且账户将被锁定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Unlocking Accounts
source_blocks.text: 解锁账户

source_blocks.source_text_en: In order to unlock your account you must contact NY.gov, as instructed, and provide the necessary information.
source_blocks.text: 为了解锁您的账户，您必须按照指示联系 NY.gov，并提供必要的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By registering for a account you acknowledge and agree that:
source_blocks.text: 注册账户即表示您承认并同意：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will abide by these Terms of Service; and the Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy for the use of NY.gov; You certify that all identifying personal information provided to create or access your account is accurate, and pertains solely to you as the User of the account; Any false statement, false certification, or false information provided in creating or using a account constitutes a criminal act which may result in the imposition of criminal sanctions; For the purpose of imposing criminal sanctions, any false statement you make in connection with creating the account, and each fraudulent log-in to access applications or services, may be treated as a separate criminal offense. DMV reserves the right, and sole discretion, to revoke your Username and access to your account, at any time, without prior notification, in the interest of preserving the security of the system. You are responsible for all use of your account, and you must protect your temporary password, Sign-In Username and Password from disclosure to any individual or entity, and must not permit the use of your account by another. You agree to Not bypass or attempt to bypass any security controls for access to your account; You will keep your Username and Password in a secure place and manner; You will prevent disclosure of your Username and Password; You will prevent others from watching you enter your Username and Password; You will select a Username and Password that is non-obvious and difficult to guess (e.g., not use your name, or the names of your spouse, children, pets, or other things that publicly identify you); You will sign off of the system whenever the your computer is unattended; You will take any action required by DMV or NY.gov to re-certify your identity, or to change your Username or Password; You will immediately report to DMV any known or suspected breach of system security that you become aware of.
source_blocks.text: 您将遵守这些服务条款；以及使用 NY.gov 的服务条款和可接受使用政策； 您证明为创建或访问您的账户而提供的所有个人身份信息是准确的，并且仅涉及您作为账户用户本人； 在创建或使用账户时提供的任何虚假陈述、虚假证明或虚假信息均构成犯罪行为，可能导致刑事制裁； 为了实施刑事制裁，您在创建账户时所做的任何虚假陈述，以及每次欺诈性登录以访问应用程序或服务，都可能被视为单独的刑事犯罪。 DMV 保留随时自行决定撤销您的用户名和账户访问权限的权利，恕不另行通知，以维护系统的安全性。 您应对您账户的所有使用负责，并且必须保护您的临时密码、登录用户名和密码不被任何个人或实体泄露，并且不得允许他人使用您的账户。 您同意不绕过或试图绕过访问您账户的任何安全控制； 您将把您的用户名和密码保存在安全的地方并以安全的方式保管； 您将防止您的用户名和密码被泄露； 您将防止他人看到您输入用户名和密码； 您将选择一个不明显且难以猜测的用户名和密码（例如，不要使用您的姓名，或您的配偶、子女、宠物或其他公开识别您的信息的名称）； 当您的计算机无人看管时，您将退出系统； 您将采取 DMV 或 NY.gov 要求的任何行动，以重新验证您的身份，或更改您的用户名或密码； 您将立即向 DMV 报告您已知或怀疑的系统安全漏洞。

documents.doc_id: New CDL testing and commercial learner permit (CLP) standards#3_0
documents.source_title_en: New CDL testing and commercial learner permit (CLP) standards
documents.title: 新的CDL考试和商业学习者许可证（CLP）标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: New CDL testing and commercial learner permit (CLP) standards
source_blocks.text: 新的CDL考试和商业学习者许可证（CLP）标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: Overview
source_blocks.text: 概述

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA [1]) has amended commercial driver license standards. This regulation is referred to as the 'CDL Permit Rule' and mandated compliance by July 8, 2015. The New York State DMV implemened the rules in phases, from April through July of 2015.
source_blocks.text: 联邦汽车运输安全管理局（FMCSA [1]）已修订商业驾驶执照标准。该法规被称为“CDL许可证规则”，并要求在2015年7月8日前合规。纽约州DMV从2015年4月至7月分阶段实施了这些规则。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We refer to the Commercial Learner Permit as "CLP", and the Commercial Driver License as "CDL." The changes are listed in order of implementation by the New York State DMV.
source_blocks.text: 我们将商业学习者许可证称为“CLP”，将商业驾驶执照称为“CDL”。以下变更按纽约州DMV的实施顺序列出。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Phase 1 - April 2015
source_blocks.text: 第一阶段 - 2015年4月

source_blocks.source_text_en: CDL skills testing changes
source_blocks.text: CDL技能测试变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you schedule or update a CDL Skills Test (road test) appointment, you will not be able to schedule an appointment within the first 14 days from the issuance of the CLP.
source_blocks.text: 当您安排或更新CDL技能测试（路考）预约时，您将无法在CLP签发后的前14天内安排预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: National suspension and revocation screening
source_blocks.text: 全国性暂停和吊销筛查

source_blocks.source_text_en: The CDL Permit Rule broadens the criteria used during CLP and CDL license applications to check for open suspensions and revocations in other states. New York State will reject any application where a driver has any open suspension or revocation in any state.
source_blocks.text: CDL许可证规则扩大了在CLP和CDL许可证申请期间用于检查其他州未决暂停和吊销的标准。如果驾驶员在任何州有任何未决的暂停或吊销，纽约州将拒绝任何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Phase 2 - May 2015
source_blocks.text: 第二阶段 - 2015年5月

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical Certification changes
source_blocks.text: 医疗认证变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State DMV will send CLP holders a notification if their medical certification status becomes "Not Certified." Once we send the notification, we will cancel the CLP if the CLP holder does not re-certify within 55 days. We can send employers a notification of these status changes if they subscribe to the NY State License Event Notification Service (LENS) [2]. We will send passenger carriers enrolled in the 19-A system notifications of CLP cancellation events.
source_blocks.text: 如果CLP持有人的医疗认证状态变为“未认证”，纽约州DMV将向其发送通知。一旦我们发送通知，如果CLP持有人在55天内未重新认证，我们将取消其CLP。如果他们订阅了纽约州许可证事件通知服务（LENS）[2]，我们可以向雇主发送这些状态变更的通知。我们将向注册了19-A系统的客运承运人发送CLP取消事件的通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Phase 3 - June 2015
source_blocks.text: 第三阶段 - 2015年6月

source_blocks.source_text_en: Endorsement and restriction changes
source_blocks.text: 签注和限制变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: New CDL restrictions defined below by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) may affect CLP holders when taking a Skills Test in a vehicle without full airbrakes and/or a manual transmission.
source_blocks.text: 联邦汽车运输安全管理局（FMCSA）定义的新CDL限制可能会影响在没有全气刹和/或手动变速器的车辆中进行技能测试的CLP持有人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: E - No Manual Transmission Equipped CMV L - No Airbrake Equipped CMV Z - No Full Airbrake Equipped CMV restrictions
source_blocks.text: E - 无手动变速器装备的CMV L - 无气刹装备的CMV Z - 无全气刹装备的CMV限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the vehicle used for your skills test has:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的技能测试所用车辆具有：

source_blocks.source_text_en: An automatic transmission, and this is your first road test in a commercial motor vehicle (CMV), you will be given an E restriction. No form of airbrakes, and this is your first road test in a CMV, you will be given an L restriction. Air over hydraulic brakes, and this is your first road test in a CMV, you will be given a Z. - If you have a CDL with an L restriction and you test in a vehicle with air over hydraulic brakes, you will be upgraded from an L to a Z restriction.
source_blocks.text: 自动变速器，并且这是您在商用机动车（CMV）中的首次路考，您将被给予E限制。 没有任何形式的气刹，并且这是您在CMV中的首次路考，您将被给予L限制。 液压气刹，并且这是您在CMV中的首次路考，您将被给予Z限制。 - 如果您持有带有L限制的CDL，并且您在带有液压气刹的车辆中进行测试，您的限制将从L升级为Z。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Also, please note that:
source_blocks.text: 另外，请注意：

source_blocks.source_text_en: CLPs will no longer be issued with the Double / Triple Trailer (T) endorsement. The T endorsement can be issued only to a driver holding a CDL. CLPs issued with a Passenger (P) or School Bus (S) endorsement will automatically get a new federally mandated "No Passengers in CMV Bus" (P) restriction. CLPs issued with a Tank Vehicles (N) endorsement will automatically get a federally mandated "No Cargo in CMV Tank Vehicle" (X) restriction. The P and X restrictions are issued for the CLP only. The CDL that is issued after all required tests have been passed will not have the P or X restrictions.
source_blocks.text: 不再签发带有双挂车/三挂车（T）签注的商用学习驾照（CLP）。T签注只能发给持有商用驾照（CDL）的驾驶员。 带有乘客（P）或校车（S）签注的CLP将自动获得新的联邦强制规定的“商用机动车巴士内无乘客”（P）限制。 带有罐式车辆（N）签注的CLP将自动获得联邦强制规定的“商用机动车罐式车辆内无货物”（X）限制。 P和X限制仅针对CLP签发。通过所有必要考试后签发的CDL将不带有P或X限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The CDL Permit Rule added 5 new restrictions, which required New York State to change the letter assigned to existing restrictions.
source_blocks.text: CDL许可规则新增了5项限制，这要求纽约州更改现有限制对应的字母。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These restriction changes go into effect June 4, 2015. We will send drivers a new CLP and/or CDL document with these changes printed on them after their next CLP or CDL application.
source_blocks.text: 这些限制变更自2015年6月4日起生效。在驾驶员下次申请CLP或CDL后，我们将向其寄发印有这些变更内容的新CLP和/或CDL文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Application requirement changes
source_blocks.text: 申请要求变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1\) All CLP and CDL transactions, with the exception of replacements (duplicates) will require proof of legal presence in the United States.
source_blocks.text: 1\) 所有CLP和CDL交易，除补发（副本）外，均需提供在美国合法存在的证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers who can prove U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency will only need to provide this proof on the on or after June 18, 2015. A record of this verification will be retained on the driver s record. Drivers with temporary visitor status will need to provide proof of legal presence in the U.S. with .
source_blocks.text: 能够证明美国公民身份或合法永久居留身份的驾驶员，只需在2015年6月18日或之后提供此证明。该验证记录将保存在驾驶员的档案中。 具有临时访客身份的驾驶员需提供在美国合法存在的证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: Because the federal regulations require submission of additional proofs in person, drivers cannot renew their CLP and/or CDL by mail.
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：由于联邦法规要求当面提交额外证明，驾驶员不能通过邮寄方式续办CLP和/或CDL。

source_blocks.source_text_en: CLP and CDL documents for drivers who are U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents (i.e., temporary visitors) will have the legend NON-DOMICILED printed on documents issued on or after June 18, 2015. The legend TEMPORARY VISITOR and the expiration date of their legal status documentation will continue to be displayed on the CLP and/or CDL document.
source_blocks.text: 对于美国公民或合法永久居民（即临时访客）的驾驶员，其CLP和CDL文件将在2015年6月18日或之后签发的文件上印有“非定居”字样。临时访客及其合法身份文件的到期日期将继续显示在CLP和/或CDL文件上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: 2\) For all CLP and CDL transactions, with the exception of replacements, we will require proof of New York State residence. Proof of residence is required every time for all drivers. The DMV Document Guide [3] lists all acceptable legal presence and New York State residence proof documents.
source_blocks.text: 2\) 对于所有CLP和CDL交易，除补发外，我们将要求提供纽约州居住证明。所有驾驶员每次均需提供居住证明。DMV文件指南[3]列出了所有可接受的合法存在和纽约州居住证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: PLEASE NOTE: You must provide us the original documents (not photocopies) for both requirements above.
source_blocks.text: 请注意：对于上述两项要求，您必须向我们提供原始文件（而非复印件）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial document changes
source_blocks.text: 商业文件变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: The following federally mandated changes will be made to commercial documents
source_blocks.text: 以下联邦强制规定的变更将应用于商业文件：

source_blocks.source_text_en: CL documents will have the warning "VALID ONLY WHEN ACCOMPANIED BY A NYS LICENSE printed on them interim (non-photo) licenses and permits will only be valid for 60 days from the date they are issued
source_blocks.text: CL文件将印有警告“仅在持有纽约州驾照时有效” 临时（无照片）驾照和许可自签发之日起仅有效60天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Phase 4 - July 2015
source_blocks.text: 第4阶段 - 2015年7月

source_blocks.source_text_en: Suspensions and revocations (sanctions)
source_blocks.text: 暂停和吊销（处罚）

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State is now required to apply federally mandated commercial suspensions and revocations to CLP holders. Federally mandated commercial suspensions and revocations that affect a driver's commercial privilege will now run consecutive (one to follow the other) with any other open commercial suspension or revocation on record.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州现在必须对CLP持有者实施联邦强制规定的商业暂停和吊销。影响驾驶员商业特权的联邦强制规定的商业暂停和吊销，现在将与档案中任何其他未结的商业暂停或吊销连续执行（一个接一个）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New revocations
source_blocks.text: 新的吊销

source_blocks.source_text_en: New federally mandated one year commercial revocations will be issued for drivers that are found guilty, or convicted of, falsifying, misrepresenting, or fraud in connection with
source_blocks.text: 新联邦规定的一年商业吊销将发给被发现犯有、或被判犯有与以下相关的伪造、虚假陈述或欺诈行为的驾驶员：

source_blocks.source_text_en: an application for a CLP/CDL self-certification driving type Medical Examiner's Certificate
source_blocks.text: 申请CLP/CDL 自我认证驾驶类型 体检医师证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Commercial document changes
source_blocks.text: 商业文件变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: The following federally mandated changes will be made to commercial documents
source_blocks.text: 以下联邦规定的变更将对商业文件进行：

source_blocks.source_text_en: CLPs will be valid for only 180 days with one renewal for an additional 180 days, after which the holder will have to apply for a new CLP, including retaking any required knowledge tests New York State will void and return an applicant s current CLP or CDL document when issuing a new CLP/CDL document
source_blocks.text: CLP有效期仅为180天，可续期一次，再延长180天，之后持有人必须申请新的CLP，包括重新参加任何必要的知识测试 纽约州在签发新的CLP/CDL文件时，将作废并退回申请人当前的CLP或CDL文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employer responsibilities expanded to CLP
source_blocks.text: 雇主责任扩展至CLP

source_blocks.source_text_en: Section 140(2)(c) of the New York State Transportation Law is amended to provide that no employer will allow an employee to operate a commercial motor vehicle during any period in which the operator
source_blocks.text: 纽约州交通法第140(2)(c)条经修订，规定任何雇主不得允许员工在以下任何期间操作商用机动车：

source_blocks.source_text_en: does not have a valid CLP or CDL does not have a CLP or CDL with the proper class or endorsement violates any restriction on the CLP or CDL has a suspended, revoked, or disqualified CLP or CDL has more than one CLP or CDL
source_blocks.text: 没有有效的CLP或CDL 没有具有适当类别或背书的CLP或CDL 违反CLP或CDL上的任何限制 拥有被暂停、吊销或取消资格的CLP或CDL 拥有多个CLP或CDL

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reference
source_blocks.text: 参考

source_blocks.source_text_en: CDL Permit Rule
source_blocks.text: CDL许可证规则

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can find the 'CDL Permit Rule' in its entirety in 49 CFR Parts 383, 384, and 385 and as posted on the Federal Register (Vol. 76, No. 89 / Monday, May 9, 2011 / Rules and Regulations).
source_blocks.text: 您可以在49 CFR第383、384和385部分以及联邦公报（第76卷，第89期/2011年5月9日星期一/规则与条例）中找到完整的“CDL许可证规则”。

source_blocks.text: 其他资源

documents.doc_id: New York State Insurance Requirements#3_0
documents.source_title_en: New York State Insurance Requirements
documents.title: 纽约州保险要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Insurance Requirements
source_blocks.text: 纽约州保险要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need insurance?
source_blocks.text: 我需要保险吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. To register a vehicle in New York State you must have New York State issued automobile liability insurance coverage. If you do not maintain the coverage, the DMV can suspend your vehicle registration and your driver license.
source_blocks.text: 是的。要在纽约州注册车辆，您必须拥有纽约州签发的汽车责任保险。如果您未维持该保险，DMV 可能会暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of insurance do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪种保险？

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York law requires that you have auto liability insurance coverage. The minimum amount of liability coverage is
source_blocks.text: 纽约州法律要求您拥有汽车责任保险。最低责任保险金额为

source_blocks.source_text_en: \$10,000 for property damage for a single accident \$25,000 for bodily injury and \$50,000 for death for a person involved in an accident \$50,000 for bodily injury and \$100,000 for death for two or more people in an accident
source_blocks.text: 单次事故财产损失 $10,000 事故中一人受伤 $25,000 及死亡 $50,000 事故中两人或以上受伤 $50,000 及死亡 $100,000

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your liability insurance coverage must
source_blocks.text: 您的责任保险必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: remain in effect while the registration is valid, even if you don t use the vehicle (there are exceptions for motorcycles 1) be New York State insurance coverage, issued by a company licensed by the NY State Department of Financial Services and certified by NY State DMV - out-of-state insurance is never acceptable be issued in the name of the vehicle registrant, and remain in the name of the registrant at all times 2
source_blocks.text: 在注册有效期内持续有效，即使您不使用车辆（摩托车除外 1） 为纽约州保险，由纽约州金融服务部许可并经纽约州 DMV 认证的公司签发 - 州外保险一律不可接受 以车辆注册人名义签发，并始终以注册人名义持有 2

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State Department of Financial Services website has more information about liability insurance and insurance companies licensed in New York: http://www.dfs.ny.gov [1].
source_blocks.text: 纽约州金融服务部网站提供有关责任保险和纽约州许可保险公司的更多信息：http://www.dfs.ny.gov [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More than 2 names on a vehicle registration
source_blocks.text: 车辆注册上超过两个名字

source_blocks.source_text_en: There can only be 1 or 2 names on a registration (registrants). Both the primary registrant (first name listed on the registration) and the co-registrant must sign the Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [2] (MV-82) and provide their proofs of identity and date of birth. Both names must appear on the Insurance ID Card.
source_blocks.text: 注册（注册人）只能有 1 或 2 个名字。主要注册人（注册上列出的第一个名字）和共同注册人必须签署车辆注册/所有权申请表（PDF）[2]（MV-82），并提供身份和出生日期证明。两个名字都必须出现在保险 ID 卡上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need insurance to register my vehicle?
source_blocks.text: 我需要保险才能注册车辆吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The DMV requires auto liability insurance to register a vehicle in New York. When you get insurance, your insurance company will issue proof of insurance in two ways. It will
source_blocks.text: 是的。DMV 要求在纽约注册车辆时必须拥有汽车责任保险。当您购买保险时，您的保险公司将以两种方式签发保险证明。它将

source_blocks.source_text_en: give you two original NY State Insurance ID Cards (see a sample [3]) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card 3 send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)
source_blocks.text: 给您两张纽约州保险 ID 卡原件（参见示例 [3]）或提供您的数字电子纽约州保险 ID 卡访问权限 3 向 DMV 发送电子保险通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人不能提交此通知）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Insurance Identification Cards and the electronic notice of insurance together verify your insurance coverage. We need both.
source_blocks.text: 您的纽约州保险 ID 卡和电子保险通知共同证明您的保险。我们需要两者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle at the DMV within 180 days of the effective date on your insurance ID card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance Identification Cards with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance while they are operating the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险 ID 卡生效日期起 180 天内到 DMV 注册您的车辆。携带一份或一种保险 ID 卡。DMV 办公室将保留纸质卡。将另一张纸质卡放在车内作为保险证明。任何操作您车辆的人都必须在操作时提供保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does the name on my vehicle registration application and Insurance Identification Card need to be the same?
source_blocks.text: 我的车辆注册申请和保险 ID 卡上的名字需要一致吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Your insurance cards must have the same name as the name on your vehicle registration application.
source_blocks.text: 是的。您的保险卡上的名字必须与车辆注册申请上的名字一致。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will the DMV accept copies or faxes of my Insurance Identification Card?
source_blocks.text: 车管所会接受我的保险身份证件的复印件或传真件吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. However, the DMV will not accept a card if the DMV barcode reader cannot read (scan) the barcode.
source_blocks.text: 会。但是，如果车管所的条形码读取器无法读取（扫描）条形码，车管所将不接受该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Out-of-state insurance documents
source_blocks.text: 州外保险文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will never accept out-of-state vehicle insurance coverage of any type. If your vehicle is registered in New York, it must have New York State auto liability insurance coverage.
source_blocks.text: 我们绝不会接受任何类型的州外车辆保险。如果您的车辆在纽约州注册，则必须拥有纽约州的汽车责任保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your motorcycle must have insurance coverage any time it is operated on a public road or highway. Unlike most other motor vehicles, motorcycles are registered for one year rather than two, and all motorcycle registrations expire on April 30. Also, you can terminate your motorcycle liability insurance without surrendering the plate at a DMV office. This makes it easier to put the motorcycle back on the road after winter storage. However, under no circumstances may your motorcycle operate on public highways without liability coverage in effect. A change on the insurance policy to a name different from the name on your registration may cause a lapse in insurance coverage, and DMV may suspend your driver license and your vehicle registration. Your vehicle's insurance and registration must always be in exactly the same name. You should always carry the paper or access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card in your vehicle. Electronic NY State Insurance ID Cards may not be used for the following: - All Owned Vehicles (AOV) - All Owned & Non-Owned Comprehensive Auto Liability Policy (AON) - Dealer Garage Auto Liability Policy (DGP) - Auto Liability Policy (ALP) - Self Insured Vehicles
source_blocks.text: 您的摩托车在公共道路或高速公路上行驶时，必须始终有保险保障。与大多数其他机动车不同，摩托车的注册期限为一年而非两年，且所有摩托车注册均于4月30日到期。此外，您可以在不向车管所交回车牌的情况下终止您的摩托车责任保险。这使得摩托车在冬季存放后更容易重新上路。但是，在任何情况下，您的摩托车都不得在没有有效责任保险的情况下在公共高速公路上行驶。 保险单上的姓名若与注册证明上的姓名不同，可能导致保险保障中断，车管所可能会吊销您的驾驶执照和车辆注册。您车辆的保险和注册必须始终使用完全相同的姓名。您应始终在车内携带纸质或可访问数字电子纽约州保险身份证件。 电子纽约州保险身份证件不得用于以下情况： - 所有自有车辆（AOV） - 所有自有及非自有综合汽车责任保险（AON） - 经销商车库汽车责任保险（DGP） - 汽车责任保险（ALP） - 自保车辆

documents.doc_id: NY State Adventure License FAQs#3_0
documents.source_title_en: NY State Adventure License FAQs
documents.title: NY State Adventure License 常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: NY State Adventure License FAQs
source_blocks.text: NY State Adventure License 常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the adventure license?
source_blocks.text: 什么是adventure license？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The adventure license is a way for holders of a NY State DMV issued photo document (driver license, learner permit or non-driver identification card) to have any of the various lifetime sporting/recreational licenses, privileges or certifications you have purchased from the Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) and/or the Office of Parks and Historical Preservation (Parks) added to your DMV issued photo document.
source_blocks.text: Adventure license是一种方式，让持有NY State DMV签发的带照片证件（driver license、learner permit或non-driver identification card）的人，可以将从Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC)和/或Office of Parks and Historical Preservation (Parks)购买的各种终身sporting/recreational licenses、privileges或certifications添加到其DMV签发的带照片证件上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What lifetime sporting/recreational licenses, privileges or credentials can be added to my DMV issued photo document?
source_blocks.text: 哪些终身sporting/recreational licenses、privileges或credentials可以添加到我的DMV签发的带照片证件上？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may add icons for the following lifetime licenses/privileges/certifications: Sportsman, Boating Safety, Small/Big Game, Fishing, Bow Hunting, Muzzle Loading, Trapping, and the Empire Passport. Only lifetime purchased licenses, privileges or certifications may be added to the NY State DMV issued photo documents - annual licenses cannot be added.
source_blocks.text: 你可以为以下终身licenses/privileges/certifications添加图标：Sportsman、Boating Safety、Small/Big Game、Fishing、Bow Hunting、Muzzle Loading、Trapping和Empire Passport。只有购买的终身licenses、privileges或certifications才能添加到NY State DMV签发的带照片证件上——年度licenses不能添加。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What will my DMV photo document look like with the icons?
source_blocks.text: 添加图标后，我的DMV照片证件会是什么样子？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I already have a lifetime sporting/recreational license, privilege or certification how do I have it added to my DMV photo document?
source_blocks.text: 如果我已经拥有终身sporting/recreational license、privilege或certification，如何将其添加到我的DMV照片证件上？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may request the icons be added to your DMV photo document in two ways; online using the New York State website [1] or by visiting a NY State Department of Motor Vehicles office and presenting the required proof.
source_blocks.text: 你可以通过两种方式请求将图标添加到你的DMV照片证件上：在线使用New York State网站[1]或前往NY State Department of Motor Vehicles办公室并出示所需证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What do I need to bring to the NY State DMV office to show as proof of my lifetime sporting/recreational license, privilege or certification?
source_blocks.text: 我需要带什么到NY State DMV办公室作为我的终身sporting/recreational license、privilege或certification的证明？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring to the NY State DMV office the original sporting license, privilege or certification document that you were issued by NY State Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation or NY State Department of Environmental Conservation and a completed Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [2] (MV-44). For example, if you would like to add the icon for the Lifetime Sportsman License to your NY State DMV issued photo document, bring your Lifetime Sportsman license issued by DEC. If you want to add the Boating Safety Certificate icon, bring your Boating Safety Certificate issued by NY State OPRHP, the United States Coast Guard, the Power Squadron or the United States Sailing Association.
source_blocks.text: 携带由NY State Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation或NY State Department of Environmental Conservation签发的原始sporting license、privilege或certification文件，以及填写完整的Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [2] (MV-44)。例如，如果你想将Lifetime Sportsman License的图标添加到你的NY State DMV签发的带照片证件上，请携带DEC签发的Lifetime Sportsman license。如果你想添加Boating Safety Certificate图标，请携带由NY State OPRHP、United States Coast Guard、Power Squadron或United States Sailing Association签发的Boating Safety Certificate。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I required to have these icons added to my DMV photo document?
source_blocks.text: 我是否必须将这些图标添加到我的DMV照片证件上？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, for most of the icons it is optional to have the icons displayed on your NY State DMV photo document. However, you must have the Lifetime Empire Passport displayed on your NY State DMV photo document; there will be no other proof that you have this credential.
source_blocks.text: 不，对于大多数图标，是否在NY State DMV照片证件上显示是可选的。但是，你必须将Lifetime Empire Passport显示在你的NY State DMV照片证件上；否则将没有其他证明你拥有此credential。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there an additional fee to have icons added to my DMV photo document?
source_blocks.text: 添加图标到我的DMV照片证件是否有额外费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are no additional fees if you request the icons be added at the time of your photo document renewal. If you wish to have the icons added prior to renewal, you will be required to pay the amendment fee as required by the Vehicle and Traffic Law (\$12.50 for driver licenses/permits and \$5.00 for non-driver identification cards).
source_blocks.text: 如果你在照片证件续期时请求添加图标，则无需额外费用。如果你希望在续期之前添加图标，则需要按照Vehicle and Traffic Law支付amendment fee（driver licenses/permits为\$12.50，non-driver identification cards为\$5.00）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I have these icons removed from my DMV photo document?
source_blocks.text: 我可以从我的DMV照片证件上移除这些图标吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You may contact the agency (Parks or DEC) that issued the lifetime license, privilege or credential to request they notify DMV to remove the icons. There is no fees associated with these requests. Any icon, except the Empire Passport icon, may also be removed by visiting a NY State DMV office. When removing icons through a visit to a DMV office, you will be required to pay the amendment fee as required by the Vehicle and Traffic Law (\$12.50 for driver licenses/permits and \$5.00 for non-driver identification cards).
source_blocks.text: 可以。你可以联系签发终身license、privilege或credential的机构（Parks或DEC），请求他们通知DMV移除图标。这些请求不收取费用。除Empire Passport图标外，任何图标也可以通过访问NY State DMV办公室移除。通过访问DMV办公室移除图标时，你需要按照Vehicle and Traffic Law支付amendment fee（driver licenses/permits为\$12.50，non-driver identification cards为\$5.00）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where is my document number located for my DMV issued photo document?
source_blocks.text: 我的DMV签发的带照片证件上的document number在哪里？

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is now located on the back of the photo document. If you have an enhanced document, it is located in the top line of the Machine Readable Zone and is the 10 alpha-numeric digits that appear after the "ID USA". If you do not have an enhanced document, it is located above the box with the wording, "I hereby make an anatomical gift".
source_blocks.text: 它现在位于照片证件的背面。如果你有enhanced document，它位于Machine Readable Zone的顶行，是出现在"ID USA"之后的10个字母数字字符。如果你没有enhanced document，它位于带有"I hereby make an anatomical gift"字样的方框上方。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long will it take to get my new photo document with the icons?
source_blocks.text: 拿到带有图标的新照片证件需要多长时间？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you paid the fee to request the icons be added to your photo document immediately (\$12.50 for driver licenses/permits and \$5.00 for non-driver identification cards), it may take approximately 2 weeks for you to receive your photo document in the mail. If you opted to have the icons printed at your next document renewal, you will receive your photo document with the icons after you renew your photo document.
source_blocks.text: 如果您支付了费用，要求立即将图标添加到您的照片证件上（驾照/许可证为12.50美元，非驾驶员身份证为5.00美元），您大约需要2周时间才能通过邮件收到您的照片证件。如果您选择在下次证件续期时打印图标，您将在续期后收到带有图标的照片证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I don t receive my new photo document with the icons?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有收到带有图标的新照片证件怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If it has been more than 2 weeks since you requested your photo document with DEC or Parks, contact the agency where you placed the order. For Boating Safety Certificate and Empire Passport holders, contact Parks via their website: www.parks.ny.gov [3]. For Lifetime Sportsman, Small/Big Game, Bow Hunting, Trapping, Muzzle Loading, or Fishing, contact DEC via their website: www.dec.ny.gov [4].
source_blocks.text: 如果您请求带有DEC或Parks图标的照片证件已超过2周，请联系您下单的机构。对于Boating Safety Certificate和Empire Passport持有者，请通过其网站联系Parks：www.parks.ny.gov [3]。对于Lifetime Sportsman、Small/Big Game、Bow Hunting、Trapping、Muzzle Loading或Fishing，请通过其网站联系DEC：www.dec.ny.gov [4]。

documents.title: NYS Adventure License 与 Adventure Custom Plates

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS Adventure License and Adventure Custom Plates
source_blocks.text: NYS Adventure License 与 Adventure Custom Plates

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS Adventure Custom Plates
source_blocks.text: NYS Adventure Custom Plates

source_blocks.source_text_en: The I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates (viewable here [2]) are available to individuals that hold a currently valid NYS Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) issued Sporting License and/or a NYS Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (Parks) issued Empire Passport. Available in passenger, commercial and motorcycle registration classes, these beautiful plates allow you to proudly display your love of the outdoors.
source_blocks.text: I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates（可在此处查看 [2]）适用于持有当前有效的 NYS Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) 颁发的 Sporting License 和/或 NYS Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (Parks) 颁发的 Empire Passport 的个人。这些精美的车牌适用于 passenger、commercial 和 motorcycle 注册类别，让您自豪地展示对户外活动的热爱。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What do the Adventure Custom Plates cost?
source_blocks.text: Adventure Custom Plates 的费用是多少？

source_blocks.source_text_en: \ The fee noted for each renewal is the \$15 annual I LOVE NY fee + the personalization fee (if applicable) and does not include the regular registration renewal fees due upon each renewal. As the \$15 I LOVE NY fee is an annual fee, if your registration is renewed every two years (passenger and commercial class), the fee is \$30 at renewal. Motorcycle classes renew every 1 year; therefore a \$15 I LOVE NY fee will be due at each renewal.
source_blocks.text: \ 每次续期所注明的费用是 \$15 的年度 I LOVE NY 费用加上个性化费用（如适用），不包括每次续期时应缴的常规注册续期费。由于 \$15 的 I LOVE NY 费用是年度费用，如果您的注册每两年续期一次（passenger 和 commercial 类别），续期时费用为 \$30。Motorcycle 类别每年续期一次；因此每次续期需缴纳 \$15 的 I LOVE NY 费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you purchased a LIFETIME NYS Parks issued Empire Passport or DEC issued LIFETIME Sporting License in 2014, the fees noted above (except personalization fees, if applicable) are waived for your first plate purchase and first renewal only. Personalization fees are \$31.25 for passenger and commercial registration classes and \$18.75 for motorcycle registration class.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在 2014 年购买了 NYS Parks 颁发的 LIFETIME Empire Passport 或 DEC 颁发的 LIFETIME Sporting License，则上述费用（个性化费用除外，如适用）在首次购买车牌和首次续期时免除。个性化费用为 passenger 和 commercial 注册类别 \$31.25，motorcycle 注册类别 \$18.75。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To obtain the I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates for a passenger or commercial registration class vehicle, you may order them online at I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates Gallery [2]or by mail by completing the Application for Custom Plates [3] (CP-30) and mailing it to the Custom Plates Unit at NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Custom Plates Unit, P.O. Box 2775, Albany, NY 12220. To obtain the I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates for a motorcycle registration class, you must order them by mail, no online ordering is possible. A copy of your driver license and a copy of your sporting license or Empire Passport must accompany the application form.
source_blocks.text: 要为 passenger 或 commercial 注册类别的车辆获取 I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates，您可以在线订购，请访问 I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates Gallery [2]，或通过填写 Application for Custom Plates [3] (CP-30) 并邮寄至 Custom Plates Unit at NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Custom Plates Unit, P.O. Box 2775, Albany, NY 12220 进行邮寄订购。要为 motorcycle 注册类别获取 I LOVE NY Adventure Custom Plates，您必须通过邮寄订购，无法在线订购。申请表必须附上您的 driver license 副本以及 sporting license 或 Empire Passport 的副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adventure Custom Plates cannot be ordered in a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: Adventure Custom Plates 无法在 DMV 办公室订购。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS Adventure License
source_blocks.text: NYS Adventure License

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV has teamed with the NYS Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) and the Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (Parks) to offer a new convenient service for purchasers of DEC issued Lifetime Sporting Licenses and Parks issued Lifetime Empire Passports and Boating Safety Certificates. Beginning February 3, 2014, your driver license, permit or non-driver ID can show evidence that you possess one of these new NYS Adventure Licenses.
source_blocks.text: DMV 与 NYS Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) 和 Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (Parks) 合作，为购买 DEC 颁发的 Lifetime Sporting Licenses 和 Parks 颁发的 Lifetime Empire Passports 及 Boating Safety Certificates 的购买者提供一项新的便捷服务。自 2014 年 2 月 3 日起，您的 driver license、permit 或 non-driver ID 可以显示您拥有这些新的 NYS Adventure Licenses 之一的证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The lifetime recreational license icons will be displayed on the DMV photo document as shown below:
source_blocks.text: 终身休闲许可证图标将显示在 DMV 照片文件上，如下所示：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Icon Key:
source_blocks.text: 图标说明：

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information about purchasing a NYS Adventure License may be obtained at the NYS website [1].
source_blocks.text: 有关购买 NYS Adventure License 的更多信息，请访问 NYS 网站 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I take advantage of this easy new service?
source_blocks.text: 如何利用这项便捷的新服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: New lifetime sporting license purchasers and those that complete a boating safety course can opt to have icons added to their NYS Driver license and non driver ID when you purchase your lifetime sporting license [4], or complete your boating safety certification [5] training. (As a reminder, effective May 1, 2014, all individuals born on or after May 1, 1996 are now required to successfully complete an approved course in boater education in order to operate a motorboat. For more information, go to the NYS PARKS website [6]). You may choose to get your new DMV photo document with the icons immediately, for a fee of \$12.50 (\$5.00 for non-driver ID holders), or wait for your next license renewal at no charge. Those purchasing a Lifetime Empire Passport [7] will be automatically issued a new license at no cost.
source_blocks.text: 新的终身休闲许可证购买者以及完成 boating safety course 的人员，可以在购买终身 sporting license [4] 或完成 boating safety certification [5] 培训时，选择将图标添加到他们的 NYS Driver license 和 non-driver ID 上。（提醒：自 2014 年 5 月 1 日起，所有在 1996 年 5 月 1 日或之后出生的人，现在必须成功完成经批准的 boater education 课程才能操作 motorboat。更多信息，请访问 NYS PARKS 网站 [6]）。 您可以选择立即获取带有图标的新 DMV 照片文件，费用为 \$12.50（non-driver ID 持有者为 \$5.00），或等到下次 license renewal 时免费获取。 购买 Lifetime Empire Passport [7] 的人将自动免费获得新的 license。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What If I already have a lifetime sporting license or safe boating certificate?
source_blocks.text: 如果我已经拥有终身 sporting license 或 safe boating certificate 怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may request the icons be added to your DMV photo document in two ways; online using the Online Sporting License System at the NYS website [1] or by visiting a NYS Department of Motor Vehicles office and presenting the required proof. When visiting the DMV office, there is a \$12.50 (\$5.00 for non-driver ID holders) new document fee unless you are renewing your photo document during your visit.
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过两种方式请求将图标添加到您的 DMV 照片文件：在线使用 NYS 网站 [1] 上的 Online Sporting License System，或前往 NYS Department of Motor Vehicles 办公室并出示所需证明。访问 DMV 办公室时，需支付 \$12.50（non-driver ID 持有者为 \$5.00）的新文件费，除非您在访问期间续期您的照片文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information, see the NYS Adventure License FAQs [8].
source_blocks.text: 有关更多信息，请参阅 NYS Adventure License 常见问题解答 [8]。

source_blocks.text: 重要提示：自2018年夏季起，关于经销商记录保存将有新规定。[1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: To register as a retail dealer licensed by the Department of Motor Vehicles in New York State

source_blocks.source_text_en: consult the DMV Commissioner s Regulations for Motor Vehicle Dealers and Transporters (pdf) [2] (CR-78) download and read Facility Requirements - Dealers/Transporters (pdf) \3\
