source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also call the Office of Vehicle Safety and Clean Air at 1-518-474-4653 to get the forms, or call 1-518-474-0919 to get more information.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以致电车辆安全与清洁空气办公室1-518-474-4653获取表格，或致电1-518-474-0919获取更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit
source_blocks.text: 您必须提交

source_blocks.source_text_en: Original Facility Application (pdf) [4] (VS-1) a copy of your complete original sealed and signed Surety Bond: Dealer Bond Under NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 415 (6-B) (pdf) [5] (VS-3) with power of attorney papers made out to your business name and address proof that you have permission to use the property at the business location (notarized statement from property owner, lease (may be contingent on facility approval), sub-lease with primary lease, mortgage, deed or receipted tax bill) your Sales tax ID number and a copy of your Sales Tax Certificate of Authority [6] (you may need a FEIN from the IRS [7] before this step) proof of Workers Compensation Insurance [8] for your employees (if you have no employees, indicate that on the application) a photocopy of driver license(s) or other government issued photo ID for everyone listed on the application a receipt for your purchase of the dealer s starter kit and signs all required fees, via checks (app/license check & MV-50 check) payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles a Filing Receipt found on the NY State Department of State website [9] (Corporation or LLC) or a Business Certificate from the County Clerk (individual using assumed name or partnership)
source_blocks.text: 原始设施申请表（pdf）[4]（VS-1） 一份完整、原始、密封并签名的担保债券副本：根据纽约州车辆与交通法第415(6-B)条规定的经销商债券（pdf）[5]（VS-3），并附上以您的企业名称和地址开具的授权委托书 证明您有权使用营业地点的财产（业主公证声明、租赁合同（可取决于设施批准）、附有主租赁合同的分租合同、抵押文件、地契或纳税收据） 您的销售税ID号及销售税授权证书副本[6]（在此之前，您可能需要从IRS[7]获得FEIN） 为您的员工投保的工伤保险证明[8]（如果没有员工，请在申请表上注明） 申请上列出的每个人的驾照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证件的复印件 购买经销商入门套件和标志的收据 所有必需费用，以支票形式（申请/许可证支票和MV-50支票）支付给机动车管理局局长 在纽约州国务院网站[9]上找到的备案收据（公司或有限责任公司）或县书记官出具的商业证书（使用化名的个人或合伙企业）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Certificate of Authority
source_blocks.text: 授权证书

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have your Certificate of Authority, do not submit an application with DMV yet!
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有授权证书，请勿向DMV提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Certificate of Authority and Sales Tax ID number are issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF). You may apply by visiting the NY State DTF website [6]. Be sure to record your Sales Tax ID on the Original Facility Application.
source_blocks.text: 授权证书和销售税ID号由纽约州税务与财政局（DTF）签发。您可以通过访问纽约州DTF网站[6]进行申请。请务必在原始设施申请表上记录您的销售税ID。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of Business Name
source_blocks.text: 企业名称证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have your Proof of Business Name, do not submit an application with DMV yet!
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有企业名称证明，请勿向DMV提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corporations and LLCs: You must submit a copy of your Filing Receipt from the Department of State. Instructions to file can be found on the NY State Department of State website [9].
source_blocks.text: 公司和有限责任公司：您必须提交国务院出具的备案收据副本。备案说明可在纽约州国务院网站[9]上找到。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Partnerships and Individuals Using an Assumed Name: You must submit a copy of your Business Certificate of Assumed Name . Contact your county clerk to obtain your business certificate.
source_blocks.text: 合伙企业和使用化名的个人：您必须提交《化名商业证书》副本。请联系您的县书记官获取商业证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of Workers Compensation Insurance
source_blocks.text: 工伤保险证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have your proof of Workers Compensation Insurance, do not submit an application with DMV yet!
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有工伤保险证明，请勿向DMV提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any employees (family included) you must submit proof of Workers Compensation Insurance. You can visit the NY State Workers Compensation Board website [8] for instructions on this process. If you do not have any employees, indicate that on your application.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有任何员工（包括家庭成员），您必须提交工伤保险证明。您可以访问纽约州工伤保险委员会网站[8]获取此过程的说明。如果您没有任何员工，请在申请表上注明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surety Bond
source_blocks.text: 保证金债券

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have your Surety Bond, do not submit an application with DMV yet!
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有保证金债券，请勿向DMV提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV does not provide Surety Bonds; you must contact a surety insurance company and have them fill out the Dealer Bond Under NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 415 (6-B) (pdf) [5] (VS-3). Be sure that the business name and mailing address on your bond exactly matches those that show on your application.
source_blocks.text: DMV不提供保证金债券；您必须联系担保保险公司，并让他们根据《纽约州车辆与交通法》第415条第(6-B)款（pdf）[5]（VS-3）填写经销商债券。请确保您债券上的企业名称和邮寄地址与申请上的完全一致。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of the bond depends on the number of vehicles you anticipate selling (used motor vehicle dealers):
source_blocks.text: 债券金额取决于您预计销售的车辆数量（二手汽车经销商）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send by mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄提交

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit a hard copy of your application, associated documents and fee to this address
source_blocks.text: 您必须将申请的纸质副本、相关文件和费用提交至以下地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS DMV Bureau of Consumer & Facility Services Application Unit P.O. Box 2700 Albany, NY 12220-0700
source_blocks.text: NYS DMV 消费者与设施服务局 申请科 邮政信箱2700 奥尔巴尼，纽约州 12220-0700

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will be contacted by a clerk from Vehicle Safety s Application Processing Unit.
source_blocks.text: 车辆安全申请处理部门的工作人员将与您联系。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once your application is reviewed for completeness at our Albany office, it will be sent to a regional office for review. They will contact you to schedule an on-site investigation.
source_blocks.text: 您的申请在奥尔巴尼办公室完成完整性审查后，将被发送至地区办公室进行审查。他们将与您联系，安排现场调查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On-site investigation
source_blocks.text: 现场调查

source_blocks.source_text_en: When the automotive facilities inspector (AFI) arrives to inspect your facility, they will be checking that you have the following items
source_blocks.text: 当汽车设施检查员（AFI）到达您的设施进行检查时，他们将检查您是否具备以下物品

source_blocks.source_text_en: dealer starter kit permanently mounted signs visible from the street ( the AFI will deny your application if your signs are not clearly visible) proof of identification for everyone named on the application (driver license or other government issued photo ID)
source_blocks.text: 经销商入门套件 从街道可见的永久性安装标志（如果您的标志不清晰可见，AFI将拒绝您的申请） 申请上所列所有人员的身份证明（驾驶执照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to the supplies listed above, the AFI will examine your location for these characteristics
source_blocks.text: 除上述物品外，AFI还将检查您的场所是否具备以下特征

source_blocks.source_text_en: a clear and permanent physical barrier from other businesses that may share your location (separating display areas, signs and offices) a display lot a mailbox at the business address dedicated to your business only a method of locking security items (locking cabinet, safe, etc.) heat, electricity, desk and chairs a business phone (cell phone is acceptable)
source_blocks.text: 与可能共用您场所的其他企业之间有清晰且永久的物理屏障（分隔展示区、标志和办公室） 展示场地 位于营业地址、仅用于您企业的专用邮箱 锁定安全物品的方法（带锁柜、保险箱等） 暖气、电力、办公桌和椅子 商务电话（手机也可接受）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If approved, the DMV will issue you a certificate of registration, MV-50s (Retail Certificates of Sale) and a dealer plate letter (if applicable).
source_blocks.text: 如果获得批准，DMV将向您颁发注册证书、MV-50表格（零售销售证书）以及经销商牌照信（如适用）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Official dealer sign
source_blocks.text: 官方经销商标志

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV does not provide official dealer signs. You may purchase these signs from various sign shops and automotive supply stores.
source_blocks.text: DMV不提供官方经销商标志。您可以从各种标志商店和汽车用品商店购买这些标志。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your sign needs
source_blocks.text: 您的标志需要

source_blocks.source_text_en: red background and white lettering to measure at least 3 feet wide by 2 feet tall display REGISTERED (Facility Number) STATE OF NEW YORK MOTOR VEHICLE DEALER in two inch block lettering, as configured in the example shown in the footnote 1 to be permanently mounted and visible at all times from the nearest street or highway
source_blocks.text: 红色背景和白色字体 尺寸至少为3英尺宽乘2英尺高 以两英寸块状字体显示“REGISTERED (设施编号) 纽约州机动车经销商”，配置如脚注1所示示例 必须永久安装，并始终从最近的街道或高速公路可见

source_blocks.source_text_en: Starter kit components
source_blocks.text: 启动套件组件

source_blocks.source_text_en: Book of Registry (Police Book) Bills of sale (Retail Certificate of Sale (MV-50) Odometer Statements (except ATV and Boat Dealers) Warranty Forms (except ATV and Boat Dealers)
source_blocks.text: 登记簿（警察簿） 销售账单（零售销售证书 (MV-50)） 里程表声明（ATV和船只经销商除外） 保修表格（ATV和船只经销商除外）

source_blocks.source_text_en: All forms must comply with current Regulations for Motor Vehicle Dealers and Transporters (pdf) [2] (CR-78).
source_blocks.text: 所有表格必须符合现行《机动车经销商和运输商法规》(pdf) [2] (CR-78)。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These items may be purchased through these vendors2
source_blocks.text: 这些物品可通过以下供应商购买2

source_blocks.source_text_en: Automotive Dealer Supplies, 518-465-9900, www.automotivedealersupplies.com/ [10] Fairmount Press, 212-255-2300 Jan Horan Co., 800-325-3006, www.janhoran.com/ [11] OMP Printing, 315-853-5569, www.ompprintingandgraphics.com/ [12] SNYADS Services, 800-916-9723, www.nysada.com/Programs/SNYADSServices.aspx [13] NFADA Wholesale Distributors, 716-631-8510, www.discountusedcarsupplies.com [14] Aratari Auto Finishers, 585-467-5858, www.aratariautofinishers.com [15] Larry Ligarzewski Co., 716-668-0390 Genesys Systems, 888-548-4000, http://www.newyorkdealerstartupkit.com [16]
source_blocks.text: Automotive Dealer Supplies, 518-465-9900, www.automotivedealersupplies.com/ [10] Fairmount Press, 212-255-2300 Jan Horan Co., 800-325-3006, www.janhoran.com/ [11] OMP Printing, 315-853-5569, www.ompprintingandgraphics.com/ [12] SNYADS Services, 800-916-9723, www.nysada.com/Programs/SNYADSServices.aspx [13] NFADA Wholesale Distributors, 716-631-8510, www.discountusedcarsupplies.com [14] Aratari Auto Finishers, 585-467-5858, www.aratariautofinishers.com [15] Larry Ligarzewski Co., 716-668-0390 Genesys Systems, 888-548-4000, http://www.newyorkdealerstartupkit.com [16]

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to get a Surety Bond
source_blocks.text: 如何获得保证债券

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV does not provide Surety Bonds, you must contact a surety insurance company and have them fill out Dealer Bond Under NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 415 (6-B) (pdf) [5] (VS-3) . Be sure that the business name and mailing address on your bond exactly matches those that show on your application.
source_blocks.text: DMV不提供保证债券，您必须联系担保保险公司，并让他们填写《纽约州车辆与交通法》第415(6-B)条下的经销商债券 (pdf) [5] (VS-3)。确保您债券上的企业名称和邮寄地址与申请上的完全一致。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of the bond depends on the number of vehicles you anticipate selling (used motor vehicle dealers)
source_blocks.text: 债券金额取决于您预计销售的车辆数量（二手车经销商）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Snowmobile Dealer
source_blocks.text: 雪地摩托车经销商

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for a snowmobile dealer business certificate you must use form Application for a Snowmobile Dealer Registration (pdf) [17] (RV-253).
source_blocks.text: 要申请雪地摩托车经销商营业执照，您必须使用《雪地摩托车经销商注册申请表》(pdf) [17] (RV-253)。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV does not endorse these companies or otherwise represent that DMV has any association with or oversight of these companies.
source_blocks.text: DMV不认可这些公司，也不表示DMV与这些公司有任何关联或监督关系。

documents.source_title_en: Open a driving school
documents.title: 开设驾驶学校

source_blocks.source_text_en: Open a driving school
source_blocks.text: 开设驾驶学校

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Driving School License is required of any person, firm, association or corporation engaged in the business of giving instruction in the operation of motor vehicles or motorcycles for hire. The process of opening a driving school involves several steps. These steps are also outlined in the form Opening a Driving School [1] (MV-299.2).
source_blocks.text: 任何从事以收费方式教授机动车或摩托车驾驶业务的个人、公司、协会或企业，均需持有驾驶学校执照（Driving School License）。开设驾驶学校的流程涉及多个步骤。这些步骤也已在表格《开设驾驶学校》[1]（MV-299.2）中列出。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To open a driving school, you will need
source_blocks.text: 要开设驾驶学校，您需要

source_blocks.source_text_en: to meet DMV s requirements below for your place of business a qualified, experienced instructor (see below) to meet DMV s requirements for records (receipts, etc.) and record-keeping authority to operate a business in New York State and this location
source_blocks.text: 满足下方 DMV 对您营业场所的要求 一名合格且有经验的教练（见下文） 满足 DMV 对记录（收据等）及记录保存的要求 在纽约州及该地点经营业务的授权

source_blocks.source_text_en: Requirements
source_blocks.text: 要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must receive approval from DMV for the use of the name for your driving school (see also Request for Approval of Driving School Name [2]) before you submit an application. Your place of business must - be at least 50 square feet, which is accessible by your customers - be in a suitable building (see Part 76.2 for details) - be at least 1,500 feet from a DMV office or road test area - have required signs posted: - Applicant must be given a receipt for all payments - hours of operation - schedule of fees
source_blocks.text: 在提交申请前，您必须获得 DMV 对驾驶学校名称使用的批准（另见《驾驶学校名称批准申请表》[2]）。 您的营业场所必须 - 面积至少 50 平方英尺，且客户可进入 - 位于合适的建筑内（详情见 Part 76.2） - 距离 DMV 办公室或路考区域至少 1,500 英尺 - 张贴必要的标志： - 必须向申请人提供所有付款的收据 - 营业时间 - 收费表

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: If your school will teach the Pre-licensing course, you must also have a classroom that meets DMV s requirements (see also Request for Premises Check [3]).
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您的学校将教授考前课程（Pre-licensing course），您还必须拥有符合 DMV 要求的教室（另见《场所检查申请表》[3]）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: you must have an experienced instructor who holds a valid instructor s card, and has at least 1,000 hours of experience as a behind-the-wheel instructor. you must keep appropriate records. you must have a vehicle(s) used for training and testing students that meets DMV s requirements (see also List of Driving School Vehicles) [4]. All vehicles (except motorcycles) must have Student Driver signs and be equipped with dual-control brakes and mirrors for the instructors use.
source_blocks.text: 您必须有一名持有有效教练卡且至少有 1,000 小时随车驾驶教学经验的资深教练。 您必须保存适当的记录。 您必须有用于培训和测试学生的车辆，且符合 DMV 的要求（另见《驾驶学校车辆清单》[4]）。所有车辆（摩托车除外）必须贴有“学生驾驶员”（Student Driver）标志，并配备供教练使用的双控刹车和后视镜。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you receive approval of your business name from DMV, you must submit the following items to DMV
source_blocks.text: 在您获得 DMV 对您商号的批准后，您必须向 DMV 提交以下材料

source_blocks.source_text_en: your Request for Approval of Driving School Name [2] form (MV-299.3) that shows your Driving School name was approved by the DMV (see "Driving School Name Approval" above) a completed Driving School License Application [5] form (MV-521). You must list at least one Driving School Instructor who holds a valid Driving School Instructor Certificate (MV-524) and has a minimum of 1,000 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction experience the application fee of \$50.00 (non-refundable). Make your check or money order payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles". We cannot accept cash or credit cards a completed Personal History [6] form (MV-521.1) for each owner, partner, corporate officer, agent, employee and major stockholder (20% or more of stock) listed on your Driving School Application (MV-521) if you have employees, you must submit proof of current Workers Compensation and Disability Benefits Insurance Coverage. See the instructions on the Driving School License Application [5] (MV-521) for more information if you do not have employees, you must submit a completed (CE-200) available from the NY State Worker's Compensation Board. This form is to show a government agency that NY State Workers Compensation and Disability Benefits insurance are not required a (X-201), a (X-74) or (DOS-1025). See Opening a Driving School [1] (MV-299.2) for more details a copy of the lease for your proposed place of business a Certificate of Occupancy for your proposed place of business a copy of the receipt provided to clients as required by Section 76.8 of the Commissioner's Regulations [7]. See also Receipts and Contracts [8] (MV-299.4) a copy of the Student Record Card as required by Section 76.8 of the Commissioner's Regulations [7] a schedule of fees for all services your driving school will provide a list of all vehicles to be used in training and testing. See also List of Driving School Vehicles [4] (MV-527) an Application for Driving School Instructor Certificate [9] (MV-523) for each instructor
source_blocks.text: 您的《驾驶学校名称批准申请表》[2]（MV-299.3），以证明您的驾驶学校名称已获 DMV 批准（见上文“驾驶学校名称批准”） 填写完整的《驾驶学校执照申请表》[5]（MV-521）。您必须至少列出一名持有有效《驾驶学校教练证书》（MV-524）且具有至少 1,000 小时随车驾驶教学经验的驾驶学校教练 申请费 \$50.00（不予退还）。支票或汇票请支付给“机动车管理局局长”（Commissioner of Motor Vehicles）。我们不接受现金或信用卡 为您的《驾驶学校申请表》（MV-521）上列出的每位所有者、合伙人、公司高管、代理人、员工及主要股东（持股 20% 或以上）填写完整的《个人履历表》[6]（MV-521.1） 如果您有员工，您必须提交当前有效的《工伤赔偿和伤残福利保险》投保证明。更多信息请参阅《驾驶学校执照申请表》[5]（MV-521）上的说明 如果您没有员工，您必须提交一份填写完整的（CE-200）表格，该表格可从纽约州工人赔偿委员会（NY State Worker's Compensation Board）获取。此表格用于向政府机构证明无需投保纽约州工伤赔偿和伤残福利保险 一份（X-201）、（X-74）或（DOS-1025）表格。更多详情请参阅《开设驾驶学校》[1]（MV-299.2） 您拟议营业场所的租赁合同副本 您拟议营业场所的占用证书（Certificate of Occupancy） 按照《专员条例》[7] 第 76.8 条要求提供给客户的收据副本。另见《收据与合同》[8]（MV-299.4） 按照《专员条例》[7] 第 76.8 条要求的学生记录卡（Student Record Card）副本 您的驾驶学校将提供的所有服务的收费表 所有用于培训和测试的车辆清单。另见《驾驶学校车辆清单》[4]（MV-527） 为每位教练提交一份《驾驶学校教练证书申请表》[9]（MV-523）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send all required items to:
source_blocks.text: 将所有必需材料寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesBureau of Driver Training Programs6 Empire State Plaza, Room 327Albany, NY 12228(518) 473-7174

source_blocks.source_text_en: Original Facility Application (pdf) [3] (VS-1) proof that you have permission to use the property at the business location (notarized statement from property owner, lease (may be contingent on facility approval), sub-lease with primary lease, mortgage, deed or receipted tax bill) proof of zoning: See the Repair Shop Zoning Requirements Letter (pdf) [4] (VS-146) for the specific requirements your Sales Tax ID number and a copy of your Sales Tax Certificate of Authority which can be found on the Department of Tax and Finance website [5] (you may need a FEIN from the IRS [6] before this step) proof of Workers Compensation Insurance [7] for your employees (if you do not have employees, indicate that on the application) you can visit the NY State Workers Compensation Board website [7] for instructions on this process a photocopy of driver license(s) or other government issued photo ID for everyone listed on the application a receipt for your purchase of the repair shop sign 1 all required fees, via a check payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles (Note: you may need to submit a separate check for MV-50 fees if also applying to become a dealer) a Filing Receipt from NY State Department of State website [8] (Corporation or LLC) or a Business Certificate from the County Clerk (individual using assumed name or partnership)

source_blocks.text: Certificate of Authority

source_blocks.text: 如果您还没有 Certificate of Authority，请勿向 DMV 提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Certificate of Authority and Sales Tax ID number are issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF). You may apply by visiting the NY State DTF website [5]. Be sure to record your Sales Tax ID on the Original Facility Application.
source_blocks.text: Certificate of Authority 和 Sales Tax ID 号码由 New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) 签发。您可访问 NY State DTF 网站 [5] 申请。请务必在 Original Facility Application 上记录您的 Sales Tax ID。

source_blocks.text: 如果您还没有企业名称证明，请勿向 DMV 提交申请！

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corporations and LLCs: You must submit a copy of your Filing Receipt from the Department of State. Instructions to file can be found on the NY State Department of State website [8]. Partnerships and Individuals Using an Assumed Name: You must submit a copy of your Business Certificate of Assumed Name . Contact your county clerk to obtain your business certificate.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any employees (family included) you must submit proof of Workers Compensation Insurance. You can visit the NY State Workers Compensation Board website [7] for instructions on this process. If you do not have any employees, indicate that on your application.

source_blocks.text: 一旦你的申请完整且准确，你将获得维修店注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Mobile Repair Shops require an on-site investigation. For more information contact Application Processing at 1-518-474-0919.
source_blocks.text: 注意：移动维修店需要进行现场调查。如需更多信息，请联系 Application Processing，电话 1-518-474-0919。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV does not provide official repair shop signs. You may purchase these signs from various sign shops and automotive supply stores. See Motor Vehicle Repair & Body Shop Regulations (pdf) [1] CR-82 (82.7) for specific requirements.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I order personalized plates?
source_blocks.text: 如何订购个性化车牌？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can order personalized plates for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and motorcycles. 1
source_blocks.text: 您可以为乘用车、商用车和摩托车订购个性化车牌。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about personalized plate fees, requirements and restrictions. [2]
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于个性化车牌费用、要求和限制的信息。[2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Many picture plates can also be personalized. You can browse our collection of picture plates online. The categories are:
source_blocks.text: 许多图片车牌也可以个性化。您可以在线浏览我们的图片车牌系列。类别包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I Love NY Adventure [3] Sports [4] Military and Veterans [5] Counties and Regions of NY State [6] Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [7] Causes [8] Professions [9] Organizations [10] Motorcycle Plates [11]
source_blocks.text: I Love NY Adventure [3] Sports [4] Military and Veterans [5] Counties and Regions of NY State [6] Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [7] Causes [8] Professions [9] Organizations [10] Motorcycle Plates [11]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order online
source_blocks.text: 在线订购

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can order personalized plates online unless you want personalized plates for people with disabilities that have the Universal Symbol of Access. 2
source_blocks.text: 您可以在线订购个性化车牌，除非您想要为残疾人定制带有Universal Symbol of Access的个性化车牌。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: To order personalized plates online:
source_blocks.text: 要在线订购个性化车牌：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must have a valid New York State vehicle registration in the passenger, commercial or motorcycle registration class that does not expire within 60 days. 3 The mailing address on your vehicle registration record must be your current mailing address. 4 Your vehicle registration record must match your current name if your name has changed. 5 You must provide your current plate number, the 3-letter registration class code and the first three letters of your last name. See a sample registration document. [12] You must have a credit card that DMV accepts, and a valid email address for confirmation purposes. 6
source_blocks.text: 您必须拥有有效的New York State车辆注册，属于乘用车、商用车或摩托车注册类别，且有效期不少于60天。3 您车辆注册记录上的邮寄地址必须是您当前的邮寄地址。4 如果您的姓名已更改，您的车辆注册记录必须与您当前姓名一致。5 您必须提供当前车牌号、3字母注册类别代码以及您姓氏的前三个字母。请参阅示例注册文件。[12] 您必须拥有DMV接受的信用卡，以及用于确认的有效电子邮件地址。6

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order personalized plates online [13]
source_blocks.text: 在线订购个性化车牌 [13]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮件

source_blocks.source_text_en: To order personalized plates by mail, use the Application for Custom Plates (PDF) [14] (CP-30). 7
source_blocks.text: 要通过邮件订购个性化车牌，请使用Application for Custom Plates (PDF) [14] (CP-30)。7

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the completed form and your payment to:
source_blocks.text: 将填写完整的表格和付款邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS DMV Custom Plates UnitP.O. Box 2775Albany, NY 12220
source_blocks.text: NYS DMV Custom Plates UnitP.O. Box 2775Albany, NY 12220

source_blocks.source_text_en: By phone
source_blocks.text: 通过电话

source_blocks.source_text_en: It s faster and easier to do it online. To order by phone, call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday. 8
source_blocks.text: 在线办理更快更容易。要通过电话订购，请拨打Custom Plates Unit电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。8

source_blocks.source_text_en: At a DMV office
source_blocks.text: 在 DMV 办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can save yourself trip. It s faster and easier to do it online.
source_blocks.text: 您可以省去一趟行程。在线办理更快、更简单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a DMV office. [15]
source_blocks.text: 查找 DMV 办公室。[15]

source_blocks.source_text_en: When to expect your new plates and registration
source_blocks.text: 何时收到新牌照和注册文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: In approximately 10 days or less after your order is processed, you will receive new registration documents that show your current plate number and your new plate combination. Allow at least six weeks for the custom plates to arrive Your new registration documents will be mailed separately from your new custom plates If you do not receive your registration documents within two weeks or your custom plates within six weeks, contact the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838.
source_blocks.text: 在您的订单处理完成后约 10 天或更短时间内，您将收到新的注册文件，其中显示您当前的牌照号码和新的牌照组合。 定制牌照至少需要六周时间才能送达 您的新注册文件将与新定制牌照分开邮寄 如果您在两周内未收到注册文件，或在六周内未收到定制牌照，请联系 Custom Plates Unit，电话 1-518-402-4838。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check my plate order mailing status. [16]
source_blocks.text: 检查我的牌照订单邮寄状态。[16]

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to do with your current vehicle plates when you receive new plates
source_blocks.text: 收到新牌照后如何处理当前车辆牌照

source_blocks.source_text_en: To protect against the fraudulent use of your current vehicle plates, mark each vehicle plate with a permanent ink pen. Do not put both vehicle plates in the recycling/garbage on the same day.
source_blocks.text: 为防止当前车辆牌照被欺诈使用，请用永久性墨水笔在每个车辆牌照上做标记。不要在同一天将两个车辆牌照放入回收/垃圾中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t order personalized plates before your vehicle is registered, when renewing your registration, or before transferring a registration. You must have a registration windshield sticker, receipt and regular series plates issued by DMV before ordering personalized plates. To order personalized plates for people with disabilities that have the Universal Symbol of Access, call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday. If your registration expires within the next 60 days, renew your registration [17] before you order personalized plates. Change your address online [18] before ordering personalized plates. You must visit a DMV office [15] to change your name on all DMV records and documents. Learn more about how to change your name [19]. We accept American Express, Discover, MasterCard and VISA. Some picture or professional plates can t be purchased by mail. Some plates are not available by phone. Professional, emergency services, veterans and some organization plates are limited to membership and must be ordered through the organization or directly from the Custom Plates Unit, with documentation.
source_blocks.text: 在车辆注册之前、续期注册时或转移注册之前，您不能订购个性化牌照。您必须拥有 DMV 颁发的注册挡风玻璃贴纸、收据和普通系列牌照，才能订购个性化牌照。 要为带有 Universal Symbol of Access 的残障人士订购个性化牌照，请致电 Custom Plates Unit，电话 1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午 8:00 至下午 4:00。 如果您的注册将在未来 60 天内到期，请在订购个性化牌照之前续期您的注册 [17]。 在订购个性化牌照之前，请在线更改您的地址 [18]。 您必须前往 DMV 办公室 [15] 更改所有 DMV 记录和文件上的姓名。了解更多关于如何更改姓名 [19] 的信息。 我们接受 American Express、Discover、MasterCard 和 VISA。 某些图片或专业牌照不能通过邮寄购买。 某些牌照不能通过电话订购。Professional、emergency services、veterans 和某些组织牌照仅限于会员，必须通过组织或直接从 Custom Plates Unit 订购，并附有文件。

documents.source_title_en: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law
documents.title: 残疾人停车——法律

source_blocks.source_text_en: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law
source_blocks.text: 残疾人停车——法律

source_blocks.source_text_en: (For information on how to apply, see Parking for People with Disabilities) [1]
source_blocks.text: （有关申请信息，请参阅《残疾人停车》）[1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reserved parking for people with disabilities ensures safe and equal access to goods and services, access which most of us take for granted. This publication explains the rules that businesses and all drivers should observe about reserved parking spaces. It also presents information on how to obtain license plates and parking permits that allow individuals with severe disabilities to use specially-marked parking spots.
source_blocks.text: 残疾人专用停车位可确保残疾人安全、平等地获得商品和服务，而这是我们大多数人认为理所当然的。本出版物解释了企业和所有驾驶员应遵守的关于残疾人专用停车位的规则。它还介绍了如何获得车牌和停车许可证，使患有严重残疾的个人能够使用带有特殊标记的停车位。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reserved parking for people with disabilities is a legal requirement, not just a courtesy. You can help support the law by parking in reserved spaces only if you have a permit or plates for people with disabilities, and only when the person who received the permit or plates is actually in the vehicle. Please avoid parking in the access aisle or striped area next to a reserved parking space - it is not a parking zone. This special area is needed for access by people who use wheelchairs and specially-equipped vehicles.
source_blocks.text: 残疾人专用停车位是法律要求，而不仅仅是礼貌。您可以通过仅在持有残疾人许可证或车牌且许可证或车牌持有人确实在车内时，才将车停在专用停车位来支持法律。请避免将车停在残疾人专用停车位旁边的无障碍通道或条纹区域——这不是停车区。这个特殊区域是供使用轮椅和特殊装备车辆的人通行的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is important to respect each other. Please, be parking considerate.
source_blocks.text: 相互尊重很重要。请文明停车。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
source_blocks.text: 严重残疾人车牌或停车许可证的合格残疾标准：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A qualifying disability is one or more of the following impairments, disabilities or conditions that are both permanent in nature and affect mobility:
source_blocks.text: 合格残疾是指以下一种或多种永久性且影响行动能力的损伤、残疾或状况：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use of portable oxygen; Legal blindness; Limited use, or no use, of one or both legs; Inability to walk 200 feet without stopping; A neuro-muscular dysfunction that severely limits mobility; A Class III or IV cardiac condition (American Heart Association standards); Severe limitation in the ability to walk due to an arthritic, neurological or orthopedic condition; Restriction because of lung disease to such an extent that forced (respiratory) expiratory volume for one second, when measured by spirometry, is less than one liter, or the arterial oxygen tension is less than sixty mm/hg of room air at rest; Any other physical or mental impairment not previously listed which constitutes an equal degree of disability, and imposes unusual hardship in the use of public transportation and prevents the person from getting around without great difficulty.
source_blocks.text: 使用便携式氧气； 法定失明； 一条或两条腿的使用受限或无法使用； 无法行走200英尺而无需停下； 严重限制行动能力的神经肌肉功能障碍； 三级或四级心脏状况（美国心脏协会标准）； 由于关节炎、神经或骨科状况导致行走能力严重受限； 因肺病导致用力（呼吸）呼气量（通过肺活量计测量）一秒内小于一升，或静息状态下动脉血氧张力小于六十毫米汞柱； 任何未在前述列出的其他身体或精神损伤，构成同等程度的残疾，并在使用公共交通时造成特殊困难，且使该人难以出行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A , valid for six months, may be issued when a person has a temporarily disabling condition that makes the person unable to walk without a cane, crutches, a walker or other assisting device.
source_blocks.text: 当一个人患有暂时性残疾状况，使其无法在没有手杖、拐杖、助行器或其他辅助设备的情况下行走时，可以签发有效期为六个月的临时许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important: Who Can Certify a Disability
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：谁可以证明残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: To qualify for the license plates or the parking permit, you must present proof of the disability from a medical doctor (MD), doctor of osteopathy (DO), doctor of podiatric medicine (DPM, licensed in NYS only) or optometrist (OD, for blindness). Only these medical professionals are considered "doctors" as the term is used in this publication. A doctor licensed in New York or another state may certify for conditions #1 through #8 previously listed. Only doctors licensed in New York State may certify for condition #9. A podiatrist must be licensed in NYS, and may certify applicants only for severe disabilities of the foot.
source_blocks.text: 要获得车牌或停车许可证，您必须提供来自医学博士（MD）、骨科医生（DO）、足病医学医生（DPM，仅在纽约州执业）或验光师（OD，针对失明）的残疾证明。只有这些医疗专业人员才被视为本出版物中使用的“医生”一词所指的医生。在纽约或其他州执业的医生可以证明前述第#1至#8项状况。只有纽约州执业的医生才能证明第#9项状况。足病医生必须在纽约州执业，并且只能为足部严重残疾的申请人进行证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of Disability
source_blocks.text: 残疾证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may provide one of these proofs of disability:
source_blocks.text: 您可以提供以下残疾证明之一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have your doctor fill out the Medical Certification, Part II, on the "Application for License Plates and Parking Permits for People with Severe Disabilities" (MV-664.1). This form may be used to apply for license plates for people with disabilities and is accepted by most localities for a parking permit. The form is available at any motor vehicle office, by request from the DMV Call Center, for the DMV Internet Office, and from most permit issuing agents in cities, towns and villages. To determine which governmental office issues permits in your area, contact your local town, city or village clerk. Obtain a statement from a doctor certifying that you have a qualifying disability. The statement must be less than one year old, describe the condition and how it limits your mobility, be on the doctor's letterhead, and include the doctor's professional license number and signature. If the doctor practices outside New York State, the statement must identify the doctor's licensing state. A similar statement is also acceptable from: - a hospital, clinic or medical facility; the NYS Office of Vocational Rehabilitation in the NYS Department of Education; or - the NYS Commission for the Blind and Visually Handicapped in the Office of Children and Family Services (for verification of legal blindness). If you have an obvious, visible, permanent disability, such as the complete or partial loss of a leg or foot, the requirement for a medical statement may be waived by a DMV supervisor if you are applying for the license plates, or by the local issuing agent if you are applying for a permit. If you have moved to NYS and want to apply for New York State license plates or a parking permit for people with disabilities, you must provide proof of disability listed in 1 - 3 of the sections above even if you had parking privileges in your former state. Your out-of-state permit cannot be accepted in exchange for a NYS permit or plates. If you already have license plates for people with disabilities, a locality may accept your registration as proof for issuing a permit. Check with your local issuing agent before applying.
source_blocks.text: 让您的医生填写《严重残疾人车牌和停车许可证申请表》（MV-664.1）第二部分“医疗证明”。此表格可用于申请残疾人车牌，并且大多数地方机构接受此表格用于申请停车许可证。该表格可在任何机动车管理局办公室获取，可通过DMV呼叫中心索取，可从DMV互联网办公室获取，也可从大多数城市、乡镇和村庄的许可证发放机构获取。要确定您所在地区的哪个政府机构发放许可证，请联系您当地的乡镇、城市或村庄办事员。 获取医生出具的证明您患有合格残疾的声明。该声明必须少于一年，描述病情及其如何限制您的行动能力，必须使用医生的信笺抬头，并包含医生的专业执照号码和签名。如果医生在纽约州以外执业，声明必须注明医生的执业所在州。以下机构出具的类似声明也可接受： - 医院、诊所或医疗机构；纽约州教育部下属的纽约州职业康复办公室；或 - 纽约州儿童与家庭服务办公室下属的纽约州盲人和视障人士委员会（用于验证法定失明）。 如果您有明显的、可见的、永久性残疾，例如一条腿或一只脚完全或部分缺失，如果您申请车牌，DMV主管可以免除医疗声明的要求；如果您申请许可证，当地发放机构也可以免除。 如果您已搬到纽约州并想申请纽约州残疾人车牌或停车许可证，即使您在原州享有停车特权，也必须提供上述第1至3节所列的残疾证明。您原州的许可证不能用来换取纽约州的许可证或车牌。 如果您已经拥有残疾人车牌，当地机构可能会接受您的车辆登记作为发放许可证的证明。申请前请咨询您当地的发放机构。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under the New York State Vehicle & Traffic Law (Section 392), it is a criminal violation (misdemeanor) to make a false statement or give false information on an application for license plates.
source_blocks.text: 根据纽约州车辆与交通法（第392条），在车牌申请中作出虚假陈述或提供虚假信息属于刑事犯罪（轻罪）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is also a misdemeanor under the NYS Penal Law (Section 210.45) to make a false statement or provide misinformation to obtain a parking permit for a person with a disability, and is punishable by fines from \$250 to \$1,000. Additional civil penalties from \$250 to \$1,000 may also be imposed under Section 1203-a (4) of the Vehicle and Traffic Law. These penalties also apply to doctors providing certifications, as well as applicants.
source_blocks.text: 根据纽约州刑法（第210.45条），为获得残疾人停车许可证而作出虚假陈述或提供虚假信息也属于轻罪，可处以\$250至\$1,000的罚款。根据车辆与交通法第1203-a（4）条，还可能处以\$250至\$1,000的额外民事罚款。这些处罚也适用于提供证明的医生以及申请人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About Plates
source_blocks.text: 关于车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Department of Motor Vehicles issues license plates for people with permanent disabilities for use on passenger cars, motorcycles, vans, and pickup trucks not used for commercial purposes. You do not have to be a resident of New York State or even a licensed driver to obtain the license plates, but you must be at least 16 years old to register a vehicle. License plates with the Universal Symbol of Access are only issued for a vehicle registered in the name of the person who has the disability, and each individual with a disability may have only one set of license plates. If you cannot register the vehicle in the name of the disabled person, refer to the section on Parking Permits.
source_blocks.text: 机动车辆管理局为永久性残疾人士发放车牌，供非商业用途的轿车、摩托车、厢式货车和小型货车使用。您不必是纽约州居民，甚至不必持有驾照即可获得车牌，但您必须年满16岁才能注册车辆。带有通用无障碍标志的车牌仅发放给以残疾人士本人名义注册的车辆，且每位残疾人士只能拥有一套车牌。如果无法以残疾人士名义注册车辆，请参阅关于停车许可证的部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may apply at any state or county motor vehicle office for a second set of license plates for another family member who also has a disability. In addition to providing the documentation for registering the vehicle, you also must provide the family member's driver license, proof of disability and a completed Application for License Plates and Parking Permits for People With Severe Disabilities [2] (MV-664.1).
source_blocks.text: 您可以在任何州或县机动车管理局办公室为另一位同样有残疾的家庭成员申请第二套车牌。除了提供注册车辆所需的文件外，您还必须提供该家庭成员的驾照、残疾证明以及填写完整的《重度残疾人士车牌及停车许可证申请表》[2]（MV-664.1）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Personalized license plates (up to six characters) with the Universal Symbol of Access are available for an additional charge. Please contact:
source_blocks.text: 带有通用无障碍标志的个性化车牌（最多六个字符）需额外收费。请联系：

source_blocks.source_text_en: NYS DMV Custom Plates UnitP.O. Box 2775Albany, NY 12220
source_blocks.text: 纽约州车管所定制车牌部门邮政信箱2775奥尔巴尼，纽约州 12220

source_blocks.source_text_en: or call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838

If your vehicle already has a valid registration with New York license plates and you already have a permanent parking permit for people with disabilities that was issued in New York State, you must present this permit and a copy of the (MV-664.1) showing the medical certification (or doctor's statement) used to obtain the parking permit. The medical certification must be dated no more than one year prior to the application for the license plates. Do NOT apply if you hold only a temporary parking permit. To apply, you must complete a Vehicle Registration/Title Application [3] (MV-82) and pay a fee for the new plates displaying the Universal Symbol of Access. If this transaction is done at any time other than at renewal, a \$3.75 transaction fee will be charged.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆已持有有效的纽约州车牌注册，并且您已持有纽约州签发的永久性残疾人停车许可证，则必须出示该许可证以及一份（MV-664.1）表格副本，该表格需显示用于获得停车许可证的医疗证明（或医生声明）。医疗证明的日期不得早于申请车牌日期前一年以上。如果您仅持有临时停车许可证，请勿申请。要申请，您必须填写《车辆注册/所有权申请表》[3]（MV-82），并为显示通用无障碍标志的新车牌支付费用。如果此交易不是在续期时办理，将收取3.75美元的交易费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle already has a valid registration with New York license plates and you do NOT already have a permanent parking permit for people with disabilities, bring proof of your disability, your current New York plates and registration receipt to any state or county motor vehicle office. You will be required to fill out a Vehicle Registration/Title Application [3] (MV-82) and pay a fee for the new plates showing the Universal Symbol of Access. If this transaction is done at any time other than at renewal, a \$3.75 transaction fee will be charged. Do NOT apply if you hold only a temporary parking permit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆已持有有效的纽约州车牌注册，但您尚未持有永久性残疾人停车许可证，请携带您的残疾证明、当前纽约州车牌和注册收据前往任何州或县机动车管理局办公室。您将被要求填写《车辆注册/所有权申请表》[3]（MV-82），并为显示通用无障碍标志的新车牌支付费用。如果此交易不是在续期时办理，将收取3.75美元的交易费。如果您仅持有临时停车许可证，请勿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are registering your vehicle for the first time, and you do not already have a permanent parking permit for people with disabilities, you must provide all of the items required for an original vehicle registration plus the proof of disability.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是首次注册车辆，且尚未持有永久性残疾人停车许可证，则必须提供原始车辆注册所需的所有文件以及残疾证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Renewing Plates
source_blocks.text: 续期车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is no additional fee for renewing a vehicle registered with plates for people with disabilities. You do not have to provide proof of disability when you renew your vehicle registration. However, when you sign your registration renewal notice you are certifying, under penalty of the law, that you have a severe disability and are eligible to have the license plates. Making a false certification is a misdemeanor.
source_blocks.text: 续期残疾人车辆注册无需额外费用。续期车辆注册时无需提供残疾证明。但是，在签署注册续期通知时，您在法律处罚的约束下证明自己患有严重残疾并有资格拥有该车牌。作出虚假证明属于轻罪。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About Parking Permits
source_blocks.text: 关于停车许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must live in New York State to be eligible for a permanent parking permit, but you need not be a licensed driver or own a vehicle. You must apply in the locality in which you live. A temporary parking permit, valid for six months, is available for a non-resident with a qualifying disability.
source_blocks.text: 您必须居住在纽约州才有资格获得永久停车许可证，但您不必是持照驾驶员或拥有车辆。您必须在居住地申请。符合条件的非居民可获得有效期为六个月的临时停车许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: State law requires every city, town and village to appoint an agent (usually the city, town or village clerk) to issue parking permits for people with disabilities. Contact your city, town or village clerk to find out which local agency issues the permits. There is no fee for the permit. DMV does not issue the parking permits.
source_blocks.text: 州法律要求每个城市、乡镇和村庄任命一名代理人（通常是城市、乡镇或村庄的书记员）来发放残疾人停车许可证。请联系您所在城市、乡镇或村庄的书记员，了解哪个地方机构发放许可证。许可证不收取费用。DMV不发放停车许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Localities follow the same general guidelines for issuing the permit as the DMV does for plates, but there may be some differences from one locality to another. Most issuing agents accept an (MV-664.1).
source_blocks.text: 地方机构在发放许可证时遵循与DMV发放车牌相同的一般准则，但各地之间可能存在一些差异。大多数发证机构接受（MV-664.1）表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This form is available at any motor vehicle office, by request from a DMV Call Center, and from the DMV Internet Office. However, some localities have their own application form, and not all localities issue temporary permits. Contact your local issuing agent for specific information on how to obtain a permit in your area.
source_blocks.text: 此表格可在任何机动车管理局办公室获取，也可通过DMV呼叫中心或DMV互联网办公室索取。但是，一些地方有自己的申请表，并非所有地方都发放临时许可证。请联系您当地发证机构，了解如何在您所在地区获得许可证的具体信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A permit is issued to any person with a qualifying disability. This enables the permit may be used in any vehicle in which that person is riding.
source_blocks.text: 许可证发放给任何有符合条件残疾的人。这使得该许可证可以在该人乘坐的任何车辆中使用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A local issuing agent also may issue parking permits to a state facility or an agency licensed by the state or locality. The permits will be issued only for vehicles primarily used to transport people with qualifying disabilities. To apply, the agency must provide a written request on its own letterhead describing its facility or agency, a copy of their New York State facility license and a list of the vehicles they use to transport people with disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 地方发证机构也可以向州立机构或由州或地方许可的机构发放停车许可证。许可证仅发放给主要用于运送符合条件残疾人士的车辆。要申请，该机构必须提供一份以其信笺抬头书写的书面请求，描述其设施或机构，并附上其纽约州设施许可证副本及其用于运送残疾人士的车辆清单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Each "permanent" or temporary permit has an expiration date. An expired permit is not valid and cannot be used. If your permit is due to expire, contact your local issuing agent to find out about the renewal procedures in your area.
source_blocks.text: 每张“永久”或临时许可证都有到期日。过期许可证无效，不能使用。如果您的许可证即将到期，请联系您当地发证机构，了解您所在地区的续期程序。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your disability is not permanent, you may qualify for a temporary permit valid for up to six months. To apply for a temporary permit, you must present the same proof of disability as required for a permanent permit. The temporary permit will allow the same access to reserved parking spaces. If you have a temporary parking permit that is due to expire, and you still have a qualifying disability, you must obtain a new medical certification before you can apply for another parking permit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的残疾不是永久性的，您可能有资格获得有效期最长为六个月的临时许可证。要申请临时许可证，您必须出示与申请永久许可证相同的残疾证明。临时许可证将允许您使用相同的无障碍停车位。如果您的临时停车许可证即将到期，且您仍有符合条件的残疾，您必须先获得新的医疗证明，然后才能申请另一个停车许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The permit is designed to hang from the rearview mirror when parked, but should be removed when the vehicle is being operated. If you lose your permit or it is stolen, immediately report it to the locality that issued the permit.
source_blocks.text: 该许可证设计为停车时挂在后视镜上，但在车辆行驶时应取下。如果您的许可证丢失或被盗，请立即向颁发许可证的地方机构报告。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proper Use of Valid Permits or License Plates
source_blocks.text: 有效许可证或车牌的适当使用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Any vehicle that has a license plate or valid permit displaying the Universal Symbol of Access may use parking spaces designated for use by a person with a disability. The person to whom the license plate or permit was issued must be traveling in the vehicle in order to use these spaces.
source_blocks.text: 任何悬挂带有国际无障碍标志的车牌或有效许可证的车辆，均可使用为残疾人设立的停车位。车牌或许可证的持有人必须在该车辆内，才能使用这些停车位。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plates and permits do not allow you to disobey state or local parking regulations. They also do not exempt you from parking fees unless a locality has adopted an ordinance to that effect. The fine for illegally parking in a space reserved for people with disabilities is \$50 to \$150, plus a mandatory \$30 surcharge.
source_blocks.text: 车牌和许可证不允许您违反州或地方停车规定。它们也不免除您的停车费，除非地方已通过相关法令。非法在残疾人专用停车位停车的罚款为50至150美元，外加30美元的强制性附加费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Misuse of Parking Permits or Plates
source_blocks.text: 滥用停车许可证或车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is a serious misuse of license plates and permits for people with disabilities when someone other that the person with a disability uses the plates or permit to park in a space reserved for people with disabilities. These license plates or parking permits are valid only when the person with a disability who received the plates or permit is driving the vehicle or is a passenger in it.
source_blocks.text: 当残疾人以外的人使用残疾人车牌或许可证在残疾人专用停车位停车时，即构成对残疾人车牌和许可证的严重滥用。这些车牌或停车许可证仅在获得该车牌或许可证的残疾人驾驶该车辆或作为乘客乘坐时有效。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you misuse plates or a parking permit or allow someone else to use them, the DMV may revoke the license plates or the locality that issued the permit may revoke the permit, or they may deny renewal.
source_blocks.text: 如果您滥用车牌或停车许可证，或允许他人使用，DMV（机动车管理局）可能会吊销车牌，或颁发许可证的地方机构可能会吊销许可证，或拒绝续期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Parking Spaces, Statewide
source_blocks.text: 全州范围内的停车位

source_blocks.source_text_en: Off-street parking spaces for people with disabilities are required by law at shopping centers that have five or more retail stores, and signs must be posted. Spaces reserved for people with disabilities must be located as close to the shopping center as possible and distributed to provide convenient access. A facility owner who does not comply may be fined up to \$250.
source_blocks.text: 法律规定，拥有五个或以上零售店的购物中心必须为残疾人提供路边停车位，并必须设置标志。残疾人专用停车位应尽可能靠近购物中心，并分布合理以提供便利的通道。不遵守规定的设施所有者可能被处以最高250美元的罚款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On-street parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities are designated by local law or ordinance. If you have a question about parking for people with disabilities on a particular street, contact the authorities responsible for maintaining the street.
source_blocks.text: 为残疾人保留的路边停车位由地方法律或法令指定。如果您对特定街道上为残疾人提供的停车位有疑问，请联系负责维护该街道的当局。

source_blocks.source_text_en: State and local laws and building codes also require reserved parking for people with disabilities at other facilities and when new parking lots are constructed. If you have a question about reserved parking at any facility with off-street parking, contact the facility management or the local building inspector.
source_blocks.text: 州和地方法律及建筑规范也要求在其他设施以及新建停车场时为残疾人提供预留停车位。如果您对任何设有路边停车位的设施的预留停车位有疑问，请联系设施管理部门或当地建筑检查员。

source_blocks.source_text_en: State, county or local law enforcement officers are authorized to enter the parking lot of any shopping center or other facility described in the State Building Code to enforce laws governing the use of parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 州、县或地方执法官员有权进入任何购物中心或州建筑规范中所述的其他设施的停车场，以执行有关残疾人专用停车位使用的法律。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Parking Spaces, New York City
source_blocks.text: 纽约市的停车位

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York City does not set aside reserved spaces on its streets for persons with disabilities. Reserved parking spaces are only available off-street, in parking lots for shopping centers/malls, office/apartment buildings and college campuses. You can use the vehicle plates for people with disabilities or a state permit for people with disabilities to park in reserved spaces in those off-street lots.
source_blocks.text: 纽约市不在其街道上为残疾人设立预留停车位。预留停车位仅在路边停车场提供，例如购物中心/商场、办公楼/公寓楼和大学校园的停车场。您可以使用残疾人车辆牌照或州残疾人许可证在这些路边停车场的预留车位停车。

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, the NYC Department of Transportation issues a City permit (a rectangular dashboard permit) that allows persons with severe disabilities to park at most curbsides on NYC streets. City permits are issued to people with a permanent disability that so severely affects their ability to walk that they require the use of a private automobile. The New York City parking permit is not valid outside of NYC. For more information or to obtain an application for a NYC permit, call (718) 433-3100 or visit the NYC Department of Transportation's web site [4].
source_blocks.text: 然而，纽约市交通局发放一种城市许可证（一种长方形仪表板许可证），允许严重残疾人士在纽约市街道的大多数路边停车。城市许可证发放给因永久性残疾严重影响行走能力而需要使用私人汽车的人。纽约市停车许可证在纽约市以外无效。如需更多信息或获取纽约市许可证的申请表，请致电(718) 433-3100或访问纽约市交通局网站[4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visiting from Out of State Or Traveling Outside New York State
source_blocks.text: 从外州来访或前往纽约州以外旅行

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State honors out-of-state plates and permits for people with disabilities, and most other states also honor New York's permits and plates. To be sure if you travel to another state, check with the police or motor vehicle agency of the other state about whether they honor New York State issued license plates or permits for people with disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 纽约州承认外州的残疾人车牌和许可证，而大多数其他州也承认纽约州的许可证和车牌。如果您前往其他州，为确保无误，请向该州的警察或机动车管理局查询他们是否承认纽约州颁发的残疾人车牌或许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remember: Apply for plates or a permit for people with disabilities only if you have a qualifying disability.
source_blocks.text: 请记住：仅当您有符合条件的残疾时，才申请残疾人车牌或许可证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When parked, hang the parking permit from the vehicle's inside rearview mirror. Remove the permit from the mirror before driving. Use the parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities only if you have the license plates or parking permit, and only when the person with a disability is driving or riding in the vehicle. Never park in the access aisle or striped area next to a reserved parking space. This allows access to the parking space by people with wheelchairs and specially-equipped vehicles. It is not a parking zone. Do NOT allow others to misuse your plates or permit. When you use the license plates or parking permit for people with disabilities, you are NOT exempt from parking regulations or fees.
source_blocks.text: 停车时，将停车许可证挂在车辆内部后视镜上。驾驶前请将许可证从后视镜上取下。 仅当您拥有残疾人专用车牌或停车许可证，且残疾人在驾驶或乘坐车辆时，才可使用为残疾人保留的停车位。 切勿在预留停车位旁边的无障碍通道或条纹区域停车。这允许使用轮椅和特殊装备车辆的人进入停车位。这不是停车区。 不要允许他人滥用您的车牌或许可证。 当您使用残疾人专用车牌或停车许可证时，您并不免除停车规定或费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Passenger vehicle registration fees, use taxes and supplemental fees
source_blocks.text: 乘用车注册费、使用税和附加费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Determine the fees and taxes for passenger vehicles
source_blocks.text: 确定乘用车的费用和税费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the both theregistration fee and county use tax charts to determine your registration fee and county use tax.
source_blocks.text: 使用注册费和县使用税图表来确定您的注册费和县使用税。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If this is the original registration of your vehicle, in addition to the registration fee and county use tax, you must pay
source_blocks.text: 如果这是您车辆的首次注册，除了注册费和县使用税外，您还必须支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: the fees for your vehicle plates (\$25.00) your title certificate fee of \$50.00 the sales tax - the amount of the sales tax depends on the purchase price and your locality. You can see the current sales tax rates by jurisdiction [1] at the Department of Taxation and Finance web site.
source_blocks.text: 车辆牌照费用（\$25.00） 您的所有权证书费用 \$50.00 销售税 - 销售税金额取决于购买价格和您所在的地区。您可以在税务和财政局网站上查看当前各司法管辖区的销售税率 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is a minimum 2-year fee of \$32.50 for a vehicle that has 6 or more cylinders, or for an electric vehicle. Dealers, this minimum fee is not a surcharge or an additional fee. 1
source_blocks.text: 对于拥有6个或更多气缸的车辆或电动汽车，最低费用为2年 \$32.50。经销商请注意，此最低费用不是附加费或额外费用。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registration fee chart for passenger vehicles
source_blocks.text: 乘用车注册费图表

source_blocks.source_text_en: The chart shows the 2 year fee by vehicle weight.
source_blocks.text: 该图表显示了按车辆重量计算的2年费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: County use taxes and supplemental fees
source_blocks.text: 县使用税和附加费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Residents of New York City and several counties in New York State must pay a vehicle use tax when they register a passenger vehicle or renew a passenger vehicle registration. 2
source_blocks.text: 纽约市居民和纽约州多个县的居民在注册乘用车或续签乘用车注册时必须缴纳车辆使用税。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you reside outside New York City and you are exempt from the vehicle use tax in the county where you reside or have a business, complete form UT-11C. 3
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在纽约市以外，并且在您居住或经营业务的县免缴车辆使用税，请填写UT-11C表格。3

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York City Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island)
source_blocks.text: 纽约市 布朗克斯、国王（布鲁克林）、纽约（曼哈顿）、皇后、里士满（史泰登岛）

source_blocks.source_text_en: All passenger vehicle original registrations and renewals
source_blocks.text: 所有乘用车原始注册和续签

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicle use tax - \$30 for two years (\$15 per year) Supplemental MCTD fee - \$50 for two years (\$25 per year)
source_blocks.text: 车辆使用税 - 两年 \$30（每年 \$15） 补充MCTD费 - 两年 \$50（每年 \$25）

source_blocks.source_text_en: County use tax chart for counties outside of New York City
source_blocks.text: 纽约市以外县的县使用税图表

source_blocks.source_text_en: The chart shows the use taxes for all original registrations and renewals by the weight of the vehicle. Residents of the 12 counties in the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) also pay a supplemental fee for each year the registration is in effect.
source_blocks.text: 该图表显示了按车辆重量计算的所有原始注册和续签的使用税。大都会通勤交通区（MCTD）内12个县的居民还需为注册有效期内每年支付补充费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do not add \$32.50 to the fee that the chart indicates or to the amount that the Estimate registration fees [2] service calculates. The DMV collects the taxes for the city and the counties. Read the table below to determine if you must pay a vehicle use tax. If you have questions about these taxes, ask the city or county where you reside or have a business. If you reside in New York City and you are exempt from the NYC vehicle use tax, get form UT-11 from a local DMV office [3] or a DMV Call Center [4].
source_blocks.text: 不要将 \$32.50 添加到图表所示的费用或估算注册费 [2] 服务计算的金额中。 DMV代收城市和县的税费。请阅读下表以确定您是否必须缴纳车辆使用税。如果您对这些税费有疑问，请咨询您居住或经营业务的市或县。 如果您居住在纽约市并且免缴纽约市车辆使用税，请从当地DMV办公室 [3] 或DMV呼叫中心 [4] 获取UT-11表格。

documents.doc_id: Pay driver civil penalty#1_0
documents.source_title_en: Pay driver civil penalty
documents.title: 支付驾驶员民事罚款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay driver civil penalty
source_blocks.text: 支付驾驶员民事罚款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay driver civil penalty [1]
source_blocks.text: 支付驾驶员民事罚款 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driver civil penalty is a fine you must pay to DMV for certain offenses before your license or driving privilege can be restored after a suspension or revocation. This fine is in addition to any other fines, penalties or surcharges that you must pay for a traffic conviction. The purpose of the driver civil penalty is to prevent the repeated behavior of problem drivers and to improve traffic safety. The quickest and easiest way is to pay a driver civil penalty online [2].
source_blocks.text: 驾驶员民事罚款是您在驾照或驾驶特权被吊销或撤销后，因某些违法行为必须向DMV缴纳的罚款。此罚款是在您因交通定罪而需支付的任何其他罚款、罚金或附加费之外的费用。驾驶员民事罚款的目的是防止问题驾驶员重复违规行为，并提高交通安全。最快最简单的方式是在线支付驾驶员民事罚款 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who must pay?
source_blocks.text: 谁必须支付？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must pay a driver civil penalty if
source_blocks.text: 如果出现以下情况，您必须支付驾驶员民事罚款：

source_blocks.source_text_en: your driver license or driving privilege was suspended or revoked because you violated the NY State Zero Tolerance Law for drivers under age 21 (see Penalties for alcohol or drug related offenses [3])
source_blocks.text: 您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权因违反纽约州针对21岁以下驾驶员的零容忍法律而被吊销或撤销（参见酒精或毒品相关违法行为的处罚 [3]）

source_blocks.source_text_en: or, if your driver license or driving privilege was revoked because
source_blocks.text: 或者，如果您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权因以下原因被撤销：

source_blocks.source_text_en: you refused to take a chemical test for alcohol or drugs you operated or permitted the operation of a motor vehicle without automobile liability insurance you operated a motor vehicle involved in a traffic crash and the vehicle was not covered by automobile liability insurance
source_blocks.text: 您拒绝接受酒精或毒品化学测试 您在没有汽车责任保险的情况下驾驶或允许他人驾驶机动车辆 您驾驶的机动车辆涉及交通事故，且该车辆未投保汽车责任保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Penalty amount
source_blocks.text: 罚款金额

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount depends on the reason for the suspension or revocation. You may owe more than one civil penalty.
source_blocks.text: 罚款金额取决于吊销或撤销的原因。您可能欠付多项民事罚款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay online
source_blocks.text: 在线支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can pay with a credit or debit card. 7 Your name and address on DMV records must be correct. Create a MyDMV account [4] to verify or change your address.
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用信用卡或借记卡支付。7 您在DMV记录中的姓名和地址必须正确。创建MyDMV账户 [4] 以验证或更改您的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must provide
source_blocks.text: 您必须提供

source_blocks.source_text_en: the last four digits of your Social Security Number your DMV ID Number (Client ID Number) from your NY State driver license, learner permit or non-driver photo ID card (see where to find information on your driver license [5]), or your full name, date of birth and gender
source_blocks.text: 您社会安全号码的最后四位数字 您纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片身份证上的DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（参见如何查找驾驶执照上的信息 [5]），或 您的全名、出生日期和性别

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your driver license is revoked, your payment of the driver civil penalty does not restore your privilege to drive. You must request and receive approval from DMV [6] to restore your license or driving privilege unless your revocation was for an uninsured accident. If your revocation was for an uninsured accident, you must contact the DMV Insurance Services Bureau. 8
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾驶执照被撤销，支付驾驶员民事罚款并不会恢复您的驾驶特权。您必须向DMV申请并获得批准 [6] 才能恢复您的驾照或驾驶特权，除非您的撤销是由于未投保事故。如果您的撤销是由于未投保事故，您必须联系DMV保险服务局。8

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are suspended for a violation of the Zero tolerance law, you must wait until the suspension period ends, pay a suspension termination fee and have a valid driver license before you can legally drive. To check if you have a valid driver license, create a MyDMV account [4] and use our My License, Permit or ID service.
source_blocks.text: 如果您因违反零容忍法律而被暂停驾驶，您必须等到暂停期结束，支付暂停终止费，并持有有效的驾驶执照才能合法驾驶。要检查您是否持有有效的驾驶执照，请创建MyDMV账户 [4] 并使用我们的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can pay more than one civil penalty online at a time
source_blocks.text: 您可以一次在线支付多项民事罚款

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are not required to pay all of your civil penalties in one transaction, but you cannot be approved for a new driver license or restoration of your driving privilege until you pay all the civil penalties you owe. You can return to the transaction later to pay additional civil penalties.
source_blocks.text: 您不必在一次交易中支付所有民事罚款，但在您支付所有欠付的民事罚款之前，您无法获得新驾驶执照的批准或恢复驾驶特权。您可以稍后返回交易以支付额外的民事罚款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay a driver civil penalty online [2]
source_blocks.text: 在线支付驾驶员民事罚款 [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: To pay a driver civil penalty by mail for uninsured operation or uninsured accident, send a certified check, personal check or money order payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to:
source_blocks.text: 如需通过邮寄支付因未投保驾驶或未投保事故产生的驾驶员民事罚款，请将抬头为 Commissioner of Motor Vehicles 的 certified check、个人支票或 money order 寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance Services BureauNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 332BAlbany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: Insurance Services BureauNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 332BAlbany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: To pay a driver civil penalty by mail for a chemical test refusal or violation of the Zero Tolerance Law, send a certified check or money order payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to:
source_blocks.text: 如需通过邮寄支付因拒绝化学测试或违反 Zero Tolerance Law 产生的驾驶员民事罚款，请将抬头为 Commissioner of Motor Vehicles 的 certified check 或 money order 寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5 (Phone Hours: M-F, 8:30 Noon)FAX (518) 474-6208
source_blocks.text: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5 (电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午)传真 (518) 474-6208

source_blocks.source_text_en: At a DMV office
source_blocks.text: 在 DMV 办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can pay the driver civil penalty at the office listed on your suspension or revocation order, but it s much faster and easier to pay online.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在您的吊销或撤销令上列出的办公室支付驾驶员民事罚款，但在线支付更快更便捷。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This is the civil penalty amount effective 11/1/2006. If your order was issued before that date, the civil penalty depends on the date of the order. - if the order was issued between January 1, 1981 and June 30, 1990, the civil penalty is \$100 - if the order was issued between July 1, 1990 and October 31, 1996, the civil penalty is \$200 - if the order was issued between November 1, 1996 and October 31, 2006, the civil penalty is \$300
source_blocks.text: 此为自2006年11月1日起生效的民事罚款金额。如果您的命令在该日期之前签发，民事罚款金额取决于命令的签发日期。 - 如果命令在1981年1月1日至1990年6月30日之间签发，民事罚款为 \$100 - 如果命令在1990年7月1日至1996年10月31日之间签发，民事罚款为 \$200 - 如果命令在1996年11月1日至2006年10月31日之间签发，民事罚款为 \$300

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a driver responsibility assessment?
source_blocks.text: What is a driver responsibility assessment?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The driver responsibility assessment is a fee you must pay to DMV over a three year period if you are convicted of certain traffic offenses in New York State or accumulate 6 or more points on your driving record within 18 months. This fee is in addition to any fines, penalties or surcharges that you must pay for a traffic conviction. The purpose of the assessment is to prevent the repeated behavior of problem drivers and to improve traffic safety.
source_blocks.text: The driver responsibility assessment is a fee you must pay to DMV over a three year period if you are convicted of certain traffic offenses in New York State or accumulate 6 or more points on your driving record within 18 months. This fee is in addition to any fines, penalties or surcharges that you must pay for a traffic conviction. The purpose of the assessment is to prevent the repeated behavior of problem drivers and to improve traffic safety.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Normally, you receive three annual statements. When you receive the first annual assessment statement, you can pay the annual assessment, or you can pay the total assessment for the three year period. When you receive the second annual assessment statement, you can pay the annual assessment or the total assessment for the two years that remain.
source_blocks.text: Normally, you receive three annual statements. When you receive the first annual assessment statement, you can pay the annual assessment, or you can pay the total assessment for the three year period. When you receive the second annual assessment statement, you can pay the annual assessment or the total assessment for the two years that remain.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also pay the total balance of assessments that remains at any time. For example, you have a total assessment of \$300, and you pay the minimum payment of \$100 due from your first annual statement. You can pay the \$200 balance at any time. You do not need to wait until you receive the second annual statement.
source_blocks.text: You can also pay the total balance of assessments that remains at any time. For example, you have a total assessment of \$300, and you pay the minimum payment of \$100 due from your first annual statement. You can pay the \$200 balance at any time. You do not need to wait until you receive the second annual statement.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To pay your DRA balance in this situation, you must pay the amount of the additional assessments as well as the balance of the initial assessment. For example, your initial total assessment is \$300. You must pay the \$100 due on the first annual statement. Your balance is \$200, but an additional total assessment of \$150 is added to your DRA account after you paid the \$100 annual assessment. You cannot pay the \$200 balance on the initial assessment unless you also pay the \$150 balance of the additional assessment. To pay your total DRA balance, you would have to pay \$350.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will be informed that there are additional assessments if you attempt to pay the balance of an initial assessment that does not include the additional assessments.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are not required to pay the balance of assessments before you receive the annual statements. If you do pay the balance, you will not receive future annual statements for assessments included in that balance.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A suspension means your driver license (or privilege to drive) is taken away for a period of time before it is returned. There are two types of suspensions.
source_blocks.text: 暂停意味着你的驾驶执照（或驾驶特权）在被归还前被吊销一段时间。有两种类型的暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definite suspension
source_blocks.text: 定期暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: A definite suspension has a clear beginning and end date. 1 The suspension termination fee for a definite suspension is currently \$50 2, unless the suspension was for breaking the NYS Zero Tolerance alcohol law. The suspension termination fee for this offense is \$100.
source_blocks.text: 定期暂停有明确的开始和结束日期。1 定期暂停的暂停终止费目前为 \$50 2，除非暂停是因为违反 NYS Zero Tolerance 酒精法。该违法行为的暂停终止费为 \$100。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Indefinite suspension
source_blocks.text: 不定期暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: An indefinite suspension means you must do something (such as answer a traffic ticket) before the suspension can be cleared. 3 By law, if you receive a definite suspension order from DMV, you must pay a suspension termination fee before your driver license or privilege to drive can be restored.
source_blocks.text: 不定期暂停意味着你必须先做某事（如回应交通罚单），暂停才能被解除。3 根据法律，如果你收到 DMV 的定期暂停令，你必须在驾驶执照或驾驶特权恢复之前支付暂停终止费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common questions
source_blocks.text: 常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I pay more than one definite suspension online?
source_blocks.text: 我可以一次在线支付多笔定期吊销（definite suspension）的费用吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can pay up to 10 suspension termination fees in one day.
source_blocks.text: 可以。您一天内最多可支付10笔吊销终止费（suspension termination fees）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After I pay the fee, how can I check the status of my driver license or driving privilege?
source_blocks.text: 支付费用后，如何查询我的驾照或驾驶特权状态？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can sign up for a MyDMV account [4] and use the My License service. If you need a certified copy of your driving records, you can order a copy of your driver record [5].
source_blocks.text: 您可以注册MyDMV账户[4]并使用My License服务。如需驾驶记录的认证副本，可订购您的驾驶记录副本[5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When will I get my license back?
source_blocks.text: 我什么时候能拿回驾照？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A definite suspension lasts until your suspension period ends. If you pay the suspension termination fee before the suspension period has ended, we will mail your license to you within 3 business days after the suspension period ends. 6 We will not mail your license to you if
source_blocks.text: 定期吊销持续到吊销期结束。如果您在吊销期结束前支付了吊销终止费，我们将在吊销期结束后3个工作日内将驾照邮寄给您。6 在以下情况下，我们不会邮寄您的驾照：

source_blocks.source_text_en: your driver license has expired you have a commercial driver license (CDL) 7 you have a conditional or restricted license 8 you have other suspensions, revocations or problems with your driver license
source_blocks.text: 您的驾照已过期 您持有商业驾照（CDL）7 您持有条件或限制性驾照8 您有其他吊销、撤销或驾照问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know if my license was mailed?
source_blocks.text: 如何知道我的驾照是否已寄出？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you pay the suspension termination fee, wait for 3 business days after the suspension period ends and then use our Photo ID Document Mailing Status service [6].
source_blocks.text: 支付吊销终止费后，在吊销期结束后等待3个工作日，然后使用我们的Photo ID Document Mailing Status服务[6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A definite suspension means your driver license or privilege to drive is taken away for a certain amount of time. If you have a definite suspension, your suspension order will tell you how long the suspension period will last.
source_blocks.text: 定期吊销意味着您的驾照或驾驶特权被剥夺一段时间。如果您有定期吊销，您的吊销令会告知吊销期持续多久。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot drive until the suspension period ends, you pay a suspension termination fee of \$50 and have valid driver license.
source_blocks.text: 在吊销期结束、支付\$50的吊销终止费并持有有效驾照之前，您不能驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common reasons for definite suspensions are
source_blocks.text: 定期吊销的常见原因包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: you did not have automobile liability insurance - you were convicted of an alcohol or drugged driving charge - you received too many traffic tickets in a certain amount of time - you did not follow the rules for junior drivers
source_blocks.text: 您没有购买汽车责任保险 - 您因酒驾或毒驾被定罪 - 您在特定时间内收到过多交通罚单 - 您未遵守青少年驾驶员规定

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the effective date of your suspension order is before July 6, 2009, the suspension termination fee is \$25.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的吊销令生效日期在2009年7月6日之前，吊销终止费为\$25。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An indefinite suspension means your driver license or privilege to drive was taken away because you failed to do something. Your driver license or privilege to drive will remain suspended until you comply with the instructions on your suspension order. You may also be required to pay a suspension termination fee. Common reasons for indefinite suspensions are - you did not answer a traffic ticket - you did not pay a traffic ticket fine - you did not file a motor vehicle accident report - you failed to pay child support
source_blocks.text: 不定期吊销（indefinite suspension）意味着您的驾照或驾驶特权因您未能履行某些事项而被剥夺。您的驾照或驾驶特权将保持吊销状态，直到您遵守吊销令上的指示。您可能还需支付吊销终止费。不定期吊销的常见原因包括 - 您未回应交通罚单 - 您未支付交通罚单罚款 - 您未提交机动车事故报告 - 您未支付子女抚养费

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can confirm or change your address online, but you must create a MyDMV account first [4]. If you need to change your name, you must go to a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在线确认或更改地址，但必须先创建MyDMV账户[4]。如需更改姓名，您必须前往DMV办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can check the status of your driver license and driving privilege online if you sign up for a MyDMV account [4] and use our MyLicense service. If you need proof that DMV removed your suspension, you can order a certified copy of your driving record [5].
source_blocks.text: 如果您注册MyDMV账户[4]并使用MyLicense服务，即可在线查询驾照和驾驶特权状态。如需证明DMV已解除您的吊销，可订购驾驶记录的认证副本[5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you surrendered your license, DMV will mail you a new document, not the one you surrendered.
source_blocks.text: 如果您上交了驾照，DMV将邮寄给您新证件，而非您上交的那份。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Although you can pay suspension termination fees online, you must go to a DMV office to get your commercial driver license back.
source_blocks.text: 虽然你可以在线支付暂停终止费用，但你必须前往 DMV 办公室才能取回你的商业驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Although you can pay suspension termination fees online, you must go to a DMV office to get your full driver license back if you have you have a conditional or restricted license.
source_blocks.text: 虽然你可以在线支付暂停终止费用，但如果你持有条件或限制性驾照，你必须前往 DMV 办公室才能取回你的完整驾驶执照。
