documents.title: 认罚或支付TVB罚单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plead to or pay TVB tickets
source_blocks.text: 认罚或支付TVB罚单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plead to or pay TVB tickets [1]
source_blocks.text: 认罚或支付TVB罚单 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB) traffic ticket that was issued in New York City, you can
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有纽约市发出的交通违规局（TVB）罚单，您可以

source_blocks.source_text_en: plead 'Guilty' and pay tickets answerable to TVB 1 plead 'Not Guilty' and schedule a TVB hearing online, over the phone or in a TVB office 2 pay tickets with a guilty decision change an earlier 'Not Guilty' plea to a 'Guilty' for tickets that do not require your appearance 3 re-schedule a 'Not Guilty' hearing (one time) 4 request to be notified by email when your traffic ticket has been entered into our system 5 request TVB schedule or re-schedule your tickets if no dates are available
source_blocks.text: 认‘有罪’并支付可向TVB 1答复的罚单 认‘无罪’并通过在线、电话或TVB办公室2安排TVB听证会 支付已有有罪判决的罚单 对于不需要您出庭的罚单3，将之前的‘无罪’抗辩改为‘有罪’ 重新安排‘无罪’听证会（一次）4 请求当您的交通罚单录入我们的系统时通过电子邮件通知您5 如果没有可用日期，请求TVB安排或重新安排您的罚单

source_blocks.source_text_en: We do not handle parking violations, red light camera tickets, criminal driving violations (for example, DWI) or tickets answerable in a local court.
source_blocks.text: 我们不处理停车违规、红灯摄像头罚单、刑事驾驶违规（例如，酒驾）或应在当地法院答复的罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need your
source_blocks.text: 您需要您的

source_blocks.source_text_en: TVB traffic ticket number [2] 6
source_blocks.text: TVB交通罚单编号 [2] 6

source_blocks.source_text_en: and either
source_blocks.text: 以及以下任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV ID Number [3] (Client ID Number) from your New York State license, permit, or non-driver ID
source_blocks.text: 来自您纽约州驾照、许可证或非驾驶员ID的DMV ID号 [3]（客户ID号）

source_blocks.source_text_en: OR
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: full name, date of birth, and gender as they appear on the traffic ticket (if your license is from another state)
source_blocks.text: 交通罚单上显示的您的全名、出生日期和性别（如果您的驾照来自其他州）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online
source_blocks.text: 在线

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can plead or pay your ticket now or schedule your hearing online.
source_blocks.text: 您现在就可以认罚或支付罚单，或在线安排听证会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your traffic ticket must
source_blocks.text: 您的交通罚单必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: display the words 'Traffic Violations Bureau' at the bottom (see a sample ticket [2]) be an 'open' ticket (unresolved)
source_blocks.text: 底部显示‘交通违规局’字样（参见示例罚单 [2]） 是‘未结案’罚单（未解决）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note that in some cases it can take several days for a ticket to be reported to the DMV. If you are certain that the information you entered is correct, please continue to check this every few days. If you have further questions, please call the Traffic Violations Bureau at (718) 488-5710.
source_blocks.text: 请注意，在某些情况下，罚单可能需要几天时间才能报告给DMV。如果您确定输入的信息正确，请继续每隔几天检查一次。如果您还有其他问题，请致电交通违规局（718）488-5710。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your address has changed and you plead Not Guilty to one or more traffic tickets, you must provide your new address so we can send you a Notice of Hearing in the mail. This will not update your other DMV records. Learn how to change your address on your license or registrations [4].
source_blocks.text: 如果您的地址已更改，并且您对一张或多张交通罚单认‘无罪’，您必须提供您的新地址，以便我们通过邮件向您发送听证通知。这不会更新您的其他DMV记录。了解如何更改您驾照或注册上的地址 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your name has changed and you plead Not Guilty to one or more traffic tickets, the DMV will send you a Notice of Hearing to you with your previous name.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的姓名已更改，并且您对一张或多张交通罚单认‘无罪’，DMV将向您发送听证通知，通知上使用您之前的姓名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plead to or pay TVB tickets online [5]
source_blocks.text: 在网上认罪或支付TVB罚单 [5]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Enter your plea on the ticket and include the appropriate fee (payable to 'Commissioner of Motor Vehicles') if you are pleading guilty. Mail to
source_blocks.text: 在罚单上填写您的认罪意向，并附上相应费用（如认罪，抬头写“机动车管理局局长”）。邮寄至

source_blocks.source_text_en: Traffic Violations Plea UnitP.O. Box 2950 - ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0950
source_blocks.text: 交通违规认罪部门P.O. Box 2950 - ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0950

source_blocks.source_text_en: At a TVB office
source_blocks.text: 在TVB办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can plead to or pay a TVB ticket, and schedule a hearing at a Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). Find a TVB near you [6].You cannot plead to or pay a TVB ticket, or schedule a hearing at a regular DMV Issuing Office.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在交通违规局（TVB）认罪或支付TVB罚单，并安排听证会。查找附近的TVB [6]。您不能在普通的DMV发证办公室认罪或支付TVB罚单，或安排听证会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I plead guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points?
source_blocks.text: 如果我认罪导致5个或更多点数，会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have 3 or more alcohol-related convictions on your entire driving record, a plea of guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points may result in the revocation of your license under Part 132 of the Commissioner's Regulations. You may want to consult with an attorney before you enter your plea.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的整个驾驶记录中有3次或以上与酒精相关的定罪，根据局长条例第132部分，对导致5个或更多点数的违规行为认罪可能导致您的驾照被吊销。在认罪前，您可能需要咨询律师。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received a TVB traffic ticket while riding a bicycle. Can I plead to or pay it online?
source_blocks.text: 我骑自行车时收到了TVB交通罚单。我可以在网上认罪或支付吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may plead to or pay TVB bicycle/in-line skate tickets in the same way as with any other TVB tickets online, by phone, by mail or at a TVB office.
source_blocks.text: 您可以像处理其他TVB罚单一样，通过网上、电话、邮寄或在TVB办公室认罪或支付自行车/轮滑罚单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note that convictions for bicycle/in-line skate offenses do not require the payment of a surcharge and they do not result in points being applied to your driving record.
source_blocks.text: 请注意，自行车/轮滑违规的定罪不需要支付附加费，也不会在您的驾驶记录上增加点数。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I am an attorney. How can I schedule TVB hearings for my clients?
source_blocks.text: 我是一名律师。我如何为我的客户安排TVB听证会？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an attorney admitted to the Bar in New York State who wants to process Not Guilty pleas and schedule hearings online for motorists who are your clients, please submit a TVB Ticket Management for Attorneys - Application for Web Access (PDF) [7] (AA-15) to the Traffic Violations Division- Attorney Scheduling.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是在纽约州获得律师资格的律师，希望在线为您的客户处理不认罪请求并安排听证会，请向交通违规部门-律师调度提交TVB律师罚单管理-网络访问申请表（PDF） [7]（AA-15）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plead Guilty , you must pay all fines, fees, and surcharges that result from the plea. You cannot plead Guilty online if the conviction will result in the suspension or revocation of your driving privilege. You must appear at a TVB office. Your hearing must be held in the jurisdiction where the ticket was issued. The transaction sets the earliest available date for your hearing. You can change the date of your hearing only once, but not within 24 hours of your hearing. If you fail to appear for your hearing - you may be convicted by default - you may need to pay additional fines - your driving privilege will be suspended
source_blocks.text: 如果您认罪，您必须支付认罪产生的所有罚款、费用和附加费。如果定罪将导致您的驾驶特权被暂停或吊销，您不能在网上认罪。您必须前往TVB办公室。 您的听证会必须在罚单签发的司法管辖区举行。该交易会设置您听证会的最早可用日期。您只能更改一次听证会日期，但不能在听证会前24小时内更改。如果您未能出席听证会 - 您可能会被缺席定罪 - 您可能需要支付额外罚款 - 您的驾驶特权将被暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot plead Not Guilty online if your driving privilege is suspended for failure to answer the ticket. If you have received a notice of pending suspension for failure to answer this ticket, you must go into a TVB office or schedule over the phone. If you previously pleaded Not Guilty to the traffic ticket, you can change your plea to Guilty . However, in order to plead not guilty you must pay all the fines, fees, and surcharges. Partial payments are not accepted. To avoid additional fees you must complete this transaction before the date of the hearing. After you select a Not Guilty hearing date and time, you can return to the transaction one time to select a different date and time (if available). When you return to the transaction to check for other hearing dates and times: - Enter the ticket number and the other required information in Step 1 - Verify the information in Step 2 - In Step 3, look for the ticket under 'Earlier Pleas of Not Guilty'Select 'Check for Other Available Hearing Dates'. When you then select 'Continue', the page will display other available hearing dates. If there is no button for 'Check for Other Available Hearing Dates,' the hearing for the ticket(s) was previously re-scheduled, and you cannot re-schedule again online. You must contact the TVB [6]to re-schedule your hearing. To enter a plea, your traffic ticket must already be in our system. If your traffic ticket is not currently in our system, you can request to be notified by email when your record is updated. If you do not receive a notification you are still responsible to contact TVB and enter a plea for your ticket. Please verify your computer privacy settings and check your spam folder for an email notification. If you do not have the ticket number, enter all of the other information to determine if we can locate the ticket record.Out of state motorists must have a ticket number.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾驶特权因未回应罚单而被暂停，您不能在网上认不认罪。如果您收到因未回应此罚单而即将暂停的通知，您必须前往TVB办公室或通过电话安排。 如果您之前对交通罚单认不认罪，您可以改为认罪。但是，为了认不认罪，您必须支付所有罚款、费用和附加费。不接受部分付款。为避免额外费用，您必须在听证会日期前完成此交易。 在您选择不认罪听证会日期和时间后，您可以返回交易一次以选择不同的日期和时间（如果有）。当您返回交易查看其他听证会日期和时间时： - 在步骤1中输入罚单号码和其他所需信息 - 在步骤2中验证信息 - 在步骤3中，在“早期不认罪请求”下查找罚单，选择“检查其他可用听证会日期”。当您选择“继续”时，页面将显示其他可用的听证会日期。如果没有“检查其他可用听证会日期”按钮，则该罚单的听证会之前已重新安排，您不能再次在线重新安排。您必须联系TVB [6]以重新安排您的听证会。 要认罪，您的交通罚单必须已在我们系统中。如果您的交通罚单当前不在我们系统中，您可以请求在记录更新时通过电子邮件通知您。如果您未收到通知，您仍有责任联系TVB并为您的罚单认罪。请检查您的计算机隐私设置并检查垃圾邮件文件夹中的电子邮件通知。 如果您没有罚单号码，请输入所有其他信息以确定我们能否找到罚单记录。州外驾驶员必须有罚单号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point & Insurance Reduction Program
source_blocks.text: 扣分与保险减免计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Point & Insurance Reduction Program (PIRP), approved by the Department of Motor Vehicles, is available through private companies or corporations, called "course sponsors," throughout New York State. Each qualifying course must meet strict standards for the safe driving information presented and program effectiveness. If you complete an approved PIRP course:
source_blocks.text: 由机动车管理局批准的扣分与保险减免计划（PIRP）可通过纽约州各地的私营公司或公司（称为“课程赞助商”）提供。每门符合条件的课程必须符合安全驾驶信息和课程有效性的严格标准。如果您完成了一门经批准的PIRP课程：

source_blocks.source_text_en: It will help refresh your driving knowledge with a review of time-tested safe driving tips and an overview of today's vehicle and traffic laws. You may be eligible to reduce as many as four (4) points on your driving record. The DMV computer will automatically note your eligibility to receive the reduction. If you are the principal operator of a motor vehicle, you will receive a minimum 10% reduction in the base rate of your automobile and motorcycle liability and collision insurance premiums each year for three years.
source_blocks.text: 它将通过回顾久经考验的安全驾驶技巧和概述当今的车辆与交通法规，帮助您更新驾驶知识。 您可能有资格减少驾驶记录上最多四（4）分。DMV计算机将自动记录您获得减免的资格。 如果您是机动车的主要驾驶人，您将在三年内每年获得汽车和摩托车责任险及碰撞险保险费基本费率至少10%的减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS ABOUT...
source_blocks.text: 关于……的问答

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Course
source_blocks.text: 课程

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much time does the PIRP course take, what is it like and what does it cost?
source_blocks.text: PIRP课程需要多长时间，是什么样的，费用是多少？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Beginning in 2009, you will have two options for completing the PIRP course. Your options will be the traditional classroom method or an Alternate Delivery Method (ADM), such as the Internet or other DMV approved method. Regardless of the delivery method, each course is at least six hours long. (Note: The motorcycle safety/accident prevention courses take substantially longer and are only available in a classroom setting.) Essential information about traffic safety issues such as driver attitude and behavior, defensive driving techniques, and the Vehicle & Traffic Law must be presented in each course. For both the classroom and ADM methods, additional content, approach, materials and fees vary from one sponsor to the next.
source_blocks.text: 从2009年开始，您将有两种完成PIRP课程的选择。您的选择将是传统的课堂方式或替代授课方式（ADM），例如互联网或其他DMV批准的方式。无论采用哪种授课方式，每门课程至少为六个小时。（注意：摩托车安全/事故预防课程所需时间要长得多，且仅在课堂环境中提供。）每门课程必须包含有关交通安全问题的基本知识，如驾驶员态度和行为、防御性驾驶技术以及《车辆与交通法》。对于课堂和ADM两种方式，附加内容、方法、材料和费用因赞助商而异。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information specific to the classroom course:
source_blocks.text: 课堂课程的具体信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course is presented in one or more classroom sessions and attendance is mandatory. No formal testing is required to complete the course. For information on where to attend a course, consult your local telephone book under "Driving Instruction" or equivalent sections. You may also contact one of the program sponsors presented in the DMV publication, "List of Course Sponsors" (C-31), available at any state or county motor vehicle office and by request from DMV Call Center. The information is also available on the department website: dmv.ny.gov [1].
source_blocks.text: 课程在一次或多次课堂会议中呈现，必须出席。完成课程不需要正式考试。有关在哪里参加课程的信息，请查阅当地电话簿中的“驾驶指导”或类似部分。您也可以联系DMV出版物《课程赞助商名单》（C-31）中列出的项目赞助商之一，该出版物可在任何州或县机动车办公室获取，也可向DMV呼叫中心索取。该信息也可在部门网站dmv.ny.gov [1]上获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information specific to the alternate delivery method:
source_blocks.text: 替代授课方式的具体信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course will be a minimum 320 minutes. Once you register with a sponsor, you have up to 30 days to complete the course. During the course, you will be asked to identify yourself with information given at registration. To ensure that you are taking the course, you will also be asked questions regarding the content. It is possible that you will be asked to register in person and/or take an exam at the end to once again ensure you are the one who completed the course. Each sponsor's method is different, so you should contact the sponsor to determine which course best fits your needs. You can contact approved ADM course sponsors presented in the DMV publication, "List of Course Sponsors [2]" (C-31), available at any state or county motor vehicle office and by request from the DMV Call Center. The most up-to-date information regarding who is approved to provide the alternate delivery method is available on the department website: dmv.ny.gov [1].
source_blocks.text: 课程将至少为320分钟。一旦您向赞助商注册，您有最多30天的时间完成课程。在课程期间，您将被要求使用注册时提供的信息确认身份。为确保您正在参加课程，您还将被问及有关内容的问题。您可能会被要求亲自注册和/或在结束时参加考试，以再次确保您是完成课程的人。每个赞助商的方法不同，因此您应联系赞助商以确定哪种课程最适合您的需求。您可以联系DMV出版物《课程赞助商名单 [2]》（C-31）中列出的经批准的ADM课程赞助商，该出版物可在任何州或县机动车办公室获取，也可向DMV呼叫中心索取。有关谁被批准提供替代授课方式的最新信息可在部门网站dmv.ny.gov [1]上获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point Reduction
source_blocks.text: 扣分减免

source_blocks.source_text_en: After I complete the PIRP course, how do I receive the point reduction?
source_blocks.text: 我完成PIRP课程后，如何获得扣分减免？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The PIRP sponsor will notify the DMV within ten weeks after you complete the course. A notice will then be entered on your driving record, and the DMV computer will automatically reduce your active point total by up to four points. Important: Completion of a course under the "Point & Insurance Reduction Program" does not remove, delete, subtract, or erase any violation, conviction, or notice of original number of points from your driving record. Even after you complete the course, most violations, conviction and points assessed will continue to show on your driving record for up to four years. Violations and convictions involving drugs or alcohol will remain on your driving record for ten or fifteen years, depending on the violation. "Point reduction" means the DMV will not count up to four points on your driving record toward license revocation or suspension.
source_blocks.text: PIRP赞助商将在您完成课程后的十周内通知DMV。然后将在您的驾驶记录中输入通知，DMV计算机将自动将您的有效扣分总数减少最多四分。重要提示：完成“扣分与保险减免计划”下的课程不会从您的驾驶记录中删除、移除、减去或擦除任何违规、定罪或原始扣分通知。即使您完成课程后，大多数违规、定罪和评估的扣分将继续在您的驾驶记录上显示长达四年。涉及毒品或酒精的违规和定罪将在您的驾驶记录上保留十年或十五年，具体取决于违规情况。“扣分减免”意味着DMV在考虑吊销或暂停驾照时，将不计算您驾驶记录上最多四分的扣分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know my driving record shows my PIRP course completion?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道我的驾驶记录显示我完成了PIRP课程？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to verify the course completion has been entered on your record, you may request a copy of your driving record from the DMV. To do so, you can order your driving record online [3], or complete a Request for Driver and/or Vehicle Record Information [4] (MV-15). This form is available on the DMV website at dmv.ny.gov [1] or at any motor vehicle office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要验证课程完成情况已输入您的记录，您可以向DMV索取驾驶记录副本。为此，您可以在线订购您的驾驶记录 [3]，或填写《驾驶员和/或车辆记录信息请求表》 [4]（MV-15）。此表格可在DMV网站dmv.ny.gov [1]或任何机动车办公室获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your course completion is not noted on your driving record more than ten weeks after you completed it, contact the course sponsor.
source_blocks.text: 如果您完成课程后超过十周，您的驾驶记录上仍未注明课程完成情况，请联系课程赞助商。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What effect does point reduction have on my license and driving record?
source_blocks.text: 扣分减免对我的驾照和驾驶记录有什么影响？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction applies only to points assessed for violations that occurred within the eighteen months immediately before course completion. It does not affect points for earlier violations, and cannot be used as "credit" against future violations or points.
source_blocks.text: 扣分减免仅适用于课程完成前十八个月内发生的违规行为所评估的扣分。它不影响更早违规的扣分，也不能用作针对未来违规或扣分的“信用”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction cannot reduce your point total lower than zero.
source_blocks.text: 扣分减免不能将您的总分降至零以下。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your license has already been revoked or suspended, or if a violation hearing has already been scheduled, point reduction will not affect that action.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾照已被吊销或暂停，或者违规听证会已经安排，扣分减免将不会影响该行动。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Point reduction does not prevent or cancel a mandatory revocation or suspension for violations such as DWI, DWAI, or three speeding violations within 18 months.
source_blocks.text: 扣分减免不会阻止或取消因违规（如酒驾、醉酒驾驶或18个月内三次超速违规）而导致的强制性吊销或暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Points may be reduced only once in any 18-month period. The DMV point system and insurance company "point" systems are separate and not related. Point reduction on your driving record does not affect points assigned by your insurance company for violations and accidents.
source_blocks.text: 扣分在任意18个月内只能减免一次。DMV扣分系统和保险公司的“扣分”系统是分开的，互不相关。驾驶记录上的扣分减免不会影响您的保险公司因违规和事故而分配的扣分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Completion of a course under the "Point & Insurance Reduction Program" also cannot prevent or reduce the calculation of points affecting a "Driver Responsibility Assessment." The most recent information about the Driver Responsibility Assessment [5] program is available from the DMV web site.
source_blocks.text: 完成“扣分与保险减免计划”下的课程也不能阻止或减少影响“驾驶员责任评估”的扣分计算。关于“驾驶员责任评估”[5]计划的最新信息可从DMV网站获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance Reduction
source_blocks.text: 保险减免

source_blocks.source_text_en: After completing the PIRP course, how do I receive the insurance reduction?
source_blocks.text: 完成PIRP课程后，我如何获得保险减免？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The course sponsor should mail you a completion certificate within 45 days after you complete the course. If you present your certificate to your insurance company or agent within 90 days after course completion, your liability and collision premium reduction will begin immediately, retroactive to the date you completed the course. If you present your certificate more than 90 days after course completion, the insurer may issue the premium discount effective from the date presented.
source_blocks.text: 课程主办方应在您完成课程后45天内将完成证书邮寄给您。如果您在课程完成后90天内将证书提交给您的保险公司或代理人，您的责任险和碰撞险保费减免将立即生效，追溯至您完成课程的日期。如果您在课程完成后超过90天才提交证书，保险公司可能会从提交日期起发放保费折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not receive your certificate within eight weeks after completion, immediately contact the program sponsor. You may take the course once every 36 months to maintain insurance reduction benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在完成后八周内未收到证书，请立即联系课程主办方。您每36个月可以参加一次课程，以维持保险减免福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?
source_blocks.text: PIRP课程会阻止我的保险公司提高我的保费吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Insurance reduction does not prevent general premium increases, or premium increases due to violations or accidents. It provides a 10% reduction for three years, from the base rate of your current liability, no-fault and collision premiums.
source_blocks.text: 不会。保险减免不会阻止一般性保费上涨，或因违规或事故导致的保费上涨。它提供三年10%的减免，基于您当前责任险、无过失险和碰撞险保费的基本费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if more than one person named on a policy completes the PIRP course?
source_blocks.text: 如果保单上有多人完成PIRP课程怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The insurance premium reduction applies to all motor vehicles principally operated by the motorist who completes the course. The reduction can be applied to only one driver for each covered vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 保险保费减免适用于完成课程的驾驶者主要操作的所有机动车辆。每辆受保车辆只能对一名驾驶者适用减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will youthful operators and drivers participating in assigned risk pool receive the insurance premium discount?
source_blocks.text: 年轻驾驶员和参与指定风险池的驾驶员会获得保险保费折扣吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Any insured driver who is the principal operator and completes a Point & Insurance Reduction Program course will receive the reduction.
source_blocks.text: 会。任何作为主要操作者并完成扣分与保险减免计划课程的受保驾驶者都将获得减免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a youthful operator is already receiving a driver education reduction, will the PIRP discount also be applied?
source_blocks.text: 如果年轻驾驶员已经获得驾驶教育减免，PIRP折扣也会同时适用吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check with your insurance company or agent to find out if both reductions will be given at the same time.
source_blocks.text: 请咨询您的保险公司或代理人，以了解两种减免是否会同时给予。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV Point System Summary
source_blocks.text: DMV 积分制度摘要

source_blocks.source_text_en: The following table shows the point values assigned to moving traffic violations. The "points" are assessed against your driving record based on the date you committed the violation, not the date you were convicted in court. If you accumulate 11 or more points in 18 months, you will be called to a DMV hearing, after which your license may be suspended or revoked. You will be offered the option of waiving the hearing or accepting a definite period of suspension.
source_blocks.text: 下表列出了交通违章行驶所对应的积分值。"积分"是根据您违章的日期（而非法院定罪的日期）计入您的驾驶记录的。如果您在18个月内累计达到11分或以上，您将被要求参加DMV听证会，之后您的驾照可能会被吊销或撤销。您将可以选择放弃听证或接受一段明确的吊销期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some license revocations and suspensions are mandatory and do not depend on points. These include three speeding violations within 18 months, and convictions involving alcohol or drugs.
source_blocks.text: 某些驾照的吊销和撤销是强制性的，不取决于积分。这些情况包括18个月内的三次超速违章，以及涉及酒精或药物的定罪。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information about license suspensions and revocations, please refer to the publication Suppose Your License Were Taken Away [6] (C-12), available at any motor vehicle office.
source_blocks.text: 有关驾照吊销和撤销的更多信息，请参阅出版物《假如您的驾照被吊销》[6]（C-12），可在任何机动车管理局办公室获取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Records:
source_blocks.text: 供您记录：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Date you completed the course:
source_blocks.text: 您完成课程的日期：

source_blocks.source_text_en: NEW YORK STATE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLESMark J. F. Schroeder, Commissioner
source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车管理局 Mark J. F. Schroeder，局长

documents.title: 为你的路考做准备

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prepare for your road test
source_blocks.text: 为你的路考做准备

source_blocks.source_text_en: What do I need to do before I take my road test?
source_blocks.text: 参加路考前我需要做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you have a learner permit, you must
source_blocks.text: 一旦你获得学习驾照，你必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: obey the learner permit restrictions [1] on where and when you may drive [1] complete a 5-hour Pre-licensing Course or a high school or college Driver Education Course get an appropriate amount of supervised driving practice 1 if you are under age 18, you must wait at least six months from the date you received your learner permit to schedule your road test [1]
source_blocks.text: 遵守学习驾照的限制 [1]，关于你可以在哪里以及何时驾驶 [1] 完成5小时的考前课程或高中或大学的驾驶教育课程 获得适当数量的有监督的驾驶练习 1 如果你未满18岁，你必须从获得学习驾照之日起至少等待六个月才能安排路考 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the Pre-licensing Course and how do I find one?
source_blocks.text: 什么是考前课程，我如何找到它？

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is a DMV-approved, standardized classroom course that provides knowledge you will need as a new driver. The course covers many important topics, including
source_blocks.text: 这是一门由DMV批准的标准化课堂课程，为你作为新驾驶员提供所需的知识。该课程涵盖许多重要主题，包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: driving within the highway transportation system driver habits and skills feelings, attitudes and risk taking alcohol, other drugs and driving
source_blocks.text: 在高速公路交通系统内驾驶 驾驶员的习惯和技能 感受、态度和冒险行为 酒精、其他药物和驾驶

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can find the course curriculum and other information in the Pre-Licensing Course Instructor s Manual (MV-277) [2].
source_blocks.text: 你可以在《考前课程指导员手册》(MV-277) [2] 中找到课程大纲和其他信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Pre-licensing Course is available through high schools, colleges, and many driving schools. To find providers in your area, look online or in your telephone directory for Driving Instruction.
source_blocks.text: 考前课程可通过高中、学院和许多驾驶学校提供。要查找你所在地区的提供者，请在线查找或查阅电话簿中的“驾驶教学”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you successfully complete the course, you will be given a Pre-licensing Course Certificate (MV-278). If you complete a high school or college driver education course, you will receive a Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285), and you do not need a Pre-licensing Course Certificate. You must have one of these certificates to schedule your road test. You must bring the original certificate to your road test to turn in to the license examiner.2
source_blocks.text: 当你成功完成课程后，你将获得《考前课程证书》(MV-278)。如果你完成高中或学院的驾驶教育课程，你将获得《学生完成证书》(MV-285)，并且你不需要《考前课程证书》。你必须持有其中一份证书才能安排路考。你必须携带原始证书参加路考，并交给驾照考官。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: For how long will my Pre-licensing Course Certificate be valid?
source_blocks.text: 我的考前课程证书有效期是多久？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Pre-licensing Course Certificate is valid for one year from the date it is issued. A Student Certificate of Completion is valid for two years. If your Pre-licensing Course Certificate expires, you must complete the course again to receive the certificate required to schedule a road test.
source_blocks.text: 你的考前课程证书自签发之日起有效期为一年。学生完成证书有效期为两年。如果你的考前课程证书过期，你必须重新完成课程以获得安排路考所需的证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your certificate must be valid on the date that you make your Road Test appointment, but can be expired on the date you take your road test.
source_blocks.text: 你的证书必须在预约路考的日期有效，但在你参加路考的日期可以已过期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need a Pre-Licensing Course Certificate to change my license from one class to another?
source_blocks.text: 我需要考前课程证书来将我的驾照从一种类别更改为另一种类别吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No, you do not need a Pre-licensing Course Certificate or a Student Certificate of Completion if you have a valid NY State driver license and you apply to amend to another license Class.
source_blocks.text: 不需要，如果你持有有效的纽约州驾照并申请更改到另一种驾照类别，则不需要考前课程证书或学生完成证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much supervised practice driving must I get before I take my road test?
source_blocks.text: 在参加路考之前，我必须进行多少小时的有监督的练习驾驶？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under age 18, before you take your road test you must
source_blocks.text: 如果你未满18岁，在参加路考之前，你必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: have a minimum of 50 hours of supervised practice driving with
source_blocks.text: 至少有50小时的有监督的练习驾驶，与

source_blocks.source_text_en: - at least 15 hours at night (after sunset) - at least 10 hours in moderate to heavy traffic
source_blocks.text: - 夜间（日落后）至少15小时 - 中等至繁忙交通条件下至少10小时

source_blocks.source_text_en: bring to the road test a Certification of Supervised Driving (MV-262) [3] completed by your parent or guardian to certify that you have had the required hours of supervised practice driving (you must give the MV-262 to the license examiner each time you take a road test)
source_blocks.text: 参加路考时，携带由你的父母或监护人填写的《监督驾驶证明》（MV-262）[3]，以证明你已完成所需的监督练习驾驶小时数（每次参加路考时，你必须将MV-262交给考官）

source_blocks.source_text_en: We recommend that all drivers of all ages have this amount and type of practice. We also recommend that you take a driver education course or professional driving lessons.
source_blocks.text: 我们建议所有年龄的驾驶员都进行此数量和类型的练习。我们还建议你参加驾驶员教育课程或专业驾驶课程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are additional requirements for motorcycle permits. See Get a motorcycle license [4].
source_blocks.text: 摩托车许可证有额外要求。参见《获取摩托车驾照》[4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I practice for my road test?
source_blocks.text: 我应该为路考练习什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Steering: Steer smoothly whether you are driving straight ahead, turning or backing up. Acceleration: Accelerate smoothly and moderately. Don't race the engine or cause it to stall. Braking: Bring the vehicle to a stop gently. Start braking well before your stopping position to avoid abrupt stops. Make sure you stop your vehicle in the proper position of the lane. Clutch/Gears: Always be sure your vehicle is in the correct gear. With either an automatic or a manual transmission, shift into the proper gear at the right time without "grinding" the gears. Speed: Obey the posted speed limit, of course, but also adjust your speed properly due to weather, road, visibility and traffic conditions. Following distance: Keep an adequate space "cushion" between your vehicle and those you are following. Use the "two second rule" described in the Driver's Manual. Be sure to increase your following distance in poor weather or visibility. Traffic signs, signals and markings: Know the meanings of signs, signals and pavement markings, and obey them consistently. Stopping position: If a stop is required, stop your vehicle before it reaches an intersecting street. If stop lines or crosswalks are present, stop before crossing them. If your view is blocked after stopping behind the crosswalk, move up until you can clearly see your way, then stop again if necessary. Lane selection and position: Keep your vehicle in the proper traffic lane, especially when preparing to make turns. Don't allow room for another vehicle to pass you on the side that you are turning toward. Communication: Let other drivers and pedestrians know which way you want to go. Use your directional signals or horn consistently and at the proper times. Observation: Look for and identify potential problems or hazards in the traffic around you - not just straight ahead, but behind you and on either side. Check your mirrors frequently, but be sure to look over your shoulder behind you when changing lanes or backing up. Anticipate and react: Anticipate possible driving errors by others and be ready to react safely to make up for their mistakes.
source_blocks.text: 转向：无论是直线行驶、转弯还是倒车，转向都应平稳。 加速：平稳且适度加速。不要猛踩油门或导致发动机熄火。 制动：平稳停车。提前开始制动，避免急停。确保车辆停在车道的正确位置。 离合器/挡位：始终确保车辆处于正确的挡位。无论是自动挡还是手动挡，都要在适当的时候换入正确的挡位，避免“磨”挡。 速度：当然要遵守限速标志，但也要根据天气、道路、视野和交通状况适当调整速度。 跟车距离：在你的车辆与前车之间保持足够的“缓冲”空间。使用驾驶员手册中描述的“两秒规则”。在恶劣天气或视野不佳时，务必增加跟车距离。 交通标志、信号和标线：了解标志、信号和路面标线的含义，并始终遵守。 停车位置：如果需要停车，应在车辆到达交叉路口前停下。如果有停车线或人行横道，应在越过它们之前停下。如果在人行横道后停车后视线受阻，向前移动直到能清楚看到路况，必要时再次停车。 车道选择和位置：保持车辆在正确的行车道上，尤其是在准备转弯时。不要留出空间让其他车辆在你转向的一侧超车。 沟通：让其他驾驶员和行人知道你想往哪个方向走。始终在适当的时候使用转向灯或喇叭。 观察：注意并识别周围交通中的潜在问题或危险——不仅前方，还有后方和两侧。经常检查后视镜，但在变道或倒车时，务必回头查看后方。 预判和反应：预判他人可能出现的驾驶错误，并准备好安全反应以弥补他们的失误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Refunds and transfer credits for surrendered plates
source_blocks.text: 退还车牌的费用和转让信用额度

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you surrender your vehicle plates to the DMV, you may be eligible to transfer the remaining registration (credit) to another vehicle you want to register, or get a refund for the registration fee. You get a refund or registration transfer credit for
source_blocks.text: 当您向DMV交回车牌时，您可能有资格将剩余的注册费（信用额度）转让给您想要注册的另一辆车，或者获得注册费的退款。您将获得以下费用的退款或注册转让信用额度

source_blocks.source_text_en: your vehicle plate fee title certificate fee any other fee or tax you paid when you registered the vehicle
source_blocks.text: 您的车牌费 车辆所有权证书费 您注册车辆时支付的任何其他费用或税费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transfer credit
source_blocks.text: 转让信用额度

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you transfer your remaining registration to another vehicle, your new registration will expire the same day as your old registration. You can only use the transfer credit for a new (original) registration. You cannot use it for a registration renewal.
source_blocks.text: 如果您将剩余的注册费转让给另一辆车，您的新注册将在旧注册的同一天到期。您只能将转让信用额度用于新的（原始）注册，不能用于注册续期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Refunds
source_blocks.text: 退款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here is an example to show how your refund amount is determined.
source_blocks.text: 以下示例说明如何确定您的退款金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You paid \$137.50 to register your vehicle for two years. The amount you paid included \$62.50 for the two years of the registration (\$31.25 per year), \$50.00 for the title certificate and \$25.00 for the vehicle plates. You surrender the vehicle plates during the first year of the registration, and you qualify for a refund of \$30.25. This is a refund of the \$31.25 fee for the second year of the registration with the \$1 processing fee subtracted. There is no refund of other fees or taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您支付了\$137.50注册您的车辆两年。您支付的金额包括两年的注册费\$62.50（每年\$31.25）、车辆所有权证书费\$50.00和车牌费\$25.00。您在注册的第一年内交回车牌，并且您有资格获得\$30.25的退款。这是第二年的注册费\$31.25减去\$1的手续费后的退款。其他费用或税费不予退还。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I get my refund (if I m eligible)?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有资格，如何获得退款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you surrender your plates, your Receipt (FS-6T) indicates if you are eligible to receive a refund. If you are eligible for a refund and you do not request a transfer receipt, we will process your refund automatically and you will receive it in the mail in several weeks.
source_blocks.text: 当您交回车牌时，您的收据（FS-6T）会显示您是否有资格获得退款。如果您有资格获得退款并且您没有要求转让收据，我们将自动处理您的退款，您将在几周内通过邮件收到退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not eligible for a refund or you request a transfer receipt, the DMV office issues a Receipt (FS-6T) that you can use to transfer the registration to another vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有资格获得退款，或者您要求转让收据，DMV办公室会签发一张收据（FS-6T），您可以使用该收据将注册转让给另一辆车。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for a full 2-year refund if the registration was never used?
source_blocks.text: 如果注册从未使用过，如何申请全额两年退款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for a refund of the 2-year registration fee ONLY if the registration was never used and it is not more than 60 days from the date the registration was issued. For example, if you renewed the registration, but never used the new registration sticker, you can apply for a refund of the 2-year fee that you paid when you renewed the registration. A processing fee of \$1 is subtracted from the refund amount.
source_blocks.text: 只有在注册从未使用过且自注册签发之日起不超过60天的情况下，您才能申请两年注册费的退款。例如，如果您续期了注册，但从未使用新的注册标签，您可以申请您在续期时支付的两年费用的退款。退款金额中将扣除\$1的手续费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The registration sticker cannot be used. If the sticker was attached to the windshield or the vehicle plate, you cannot remove the sticker and apply for a full refund.
source_blocks.text: 注册标签不能使用。如果标签已贴在挡风玻璃或车牌上，您不能移除标签并申请全额退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for a full 2-year refund, you must surrender the vehicle plates and the unused registration sticker and stub at a DMV office and request a 2-year refund. If eligible for the refund, the DMV office will issue a receipt that displays "two year refund."
source_blocks.text: 要申请全额两年退款，您必须在DMV办公室交回车牌和未使用的注册标签及存根，并申请两年退款。如果符合退款条件，DMV办公室将签发一张显示“两年退款”的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is it possible to receive a refund of the first-year of my registration fee?
source_blocks.text: 是否有可能获得第一年注册费的退款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have already received a refund for the 2nd year of the registration fee and you have the UNUSED registration sticker and stub, you may be eligible to apply for the 1st year of the registration fee. You have a maximum of 60 days after the date the registration was issued to apply for the 1st year of the registration fee.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经获得了第二年注册费的退款，并且您有未使用的注册标签和存根，您可能有资格申请第一年的注册费。您最多可以在注册签发之日起60天内申请第一年的注册费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for a refund of the first-year registration fee, send the following items to the address on the Request for Refund (MV-215) form
source_blocks.text: 要申请第一年注册费的退款，请将以下物品发送至退款申请表（MV-215）上的地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed and signed Request for Refund [1] (MV-215) the original registration document (stub) the unused registration sticker
source_blocks.text: 一份已填写并签署的退款申请表 [1] (MV-215) 原始注册文件（存根） 未使用的注册标签

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV will process a refund of the first-year fee if eligible.
source_blocks.text: 如果符合条件，DMV 将处理第一年费用的退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a refund if I changed my name?
source_blocks.text: 如果我改了名字，能获得退款吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Follow these instructions
source_blocks.text: 可以。请按照以下说明操作

source_blocks.source_text_en: surrender the vehicle plates at a DMV office and request a transfer receipt , not a refund receipt send these items to the address on the Request for Refund (MV-215) form - completed and signed Request for Refund [1] (MV-215) - a photocopy of the marriage certificate, the divorce documents or other court papers that prove the name has changed - the transfer receipt
source_blocks.text: 在 DMV 办公室交回车牌，并索取转账收据，而非退款收据 将以下物品寄送至退款申请表 (MV-215) 上的地址 - 已填写并签署的退款申请表 [1] (MV-215) - 结婚证书、离婚文件或其他证明姓名变更的法院文件的复印件 - 转账收据

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will issue your refund in your new name, if eligible.
source_blocks.text: 如果符合条件，DMV 将以您的新名字发放退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is it possible to get a refund if the registrant died?
source_blocks.text: 如果注册人已去世，是否可能获得退款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. DMV will issue the refund to the name of the estate. Follow these instructions
source_blocks.text: 可以。DMV 将以遗产的名义发放退款。请按照以下说明操作

source_blocks.source_text_en: surrender the vehicle plates at a DMV office and request a transfer receipt , not a refund receipt have the executor of the deceased s will send these items to the address listed on the Request for Refund (MV-215) - completed and signed Request for Refund [1] (MV-215), with "deceased" written on the form - a photocopy of the death certificate - the transfer receipt
source_blocks.text: 在 DMV 办公室交回车牌，并索取转账收据，而非退款收据 让逝者遗嘱的执行人将以下物品寄送至退款申请表 (MV-215) 上所列的地址 - 已填写并签署的退款申请表 [1] (MV-215)，并在表格上注明“已故” - 死亡证明的复印件 - 转账收据

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the estate of the registrant is settled, call the DMV Revenue Accounting Unit at 518-474-0902 to request a 'Next of Kin' form. Send the 'Next of Kin' form, Request for Refund (MV-215) and the transfer receipt to the address on form MV-215. The refund is issued in the name of the next of kin.
source_blocks.text: 如果注册人的遗产已清算，请致电 DMV 收入会计部门，电话 518-474-0902，索取“近亲”表格。将“近亲”表格、退款申请表 (MV-215) 和转账收据寄送至 MV-215 表格上的地址。退款将以近亲的名义发放。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are only eligible for a full refund if the registration sticker is unused. If the sticker was attached to the windshield or the vehicle plate, you CANNOT remove the sticker and apply for a refund.
source_blocks.text: 只有当注册标签未使用时，您才有资格获得全额退款。如果标签已贴在挡风玻璃或车牌上，您不能撕下标签并申请退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you paid New York State sales tax to the leasing company or dealer on the total amount of all your lease payments, provide your lease agreement that indicates that you paid the NY State sales tax, and complete the Claim for Sales Tax Exemption {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [5] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-803). If you did not pay New York State sales tax to the leasing company or dealer on all of your lease payments, provide your lease agreement, and complete Statement of Transaction {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [6] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802). You must pay NY State sales tax at the DMV office on any lease payments if the leasing company or dealer did not collect the sales tax. The sales tax is collected in one complete payment at the time of registration. If you made one payment to another state for the total amount of sales tax, complete Claim for Credit of Sales Tax Paid to Another State {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [7] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-804) to request credit for the tax you paid, and then pay the balance of any NY State sales tax. This process can reduce the amount of your NY State sales tax if NY State and the other state have an agreement about sales tax. Not all states have an agreement with New York. See DFT-804 page 2. If you made monthly sales tax payments in another state, complete form Statement of Transaction {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [6] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802), and pay the total amount of NY State sales tax in one payment for all the lease payments that remain.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is considered a limited use motorcycle (aka moped )?
source_blocks.text: What is considered a limited use motorcycle (aka moped )?

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York law defines limited use motorcycles, which are commonly called "mopeds" or "motor scooters", as "limited use vehicles with two or three wheels."
source_blocks.text: New York law defines limited use motorcycles, which are commonly called "mopeds" or "motor scooters", as "limited use vehicles with two or three wheels."

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there any special requirements to operate a limited use motorcycle (moped) in New York?
source_blocks.text: Are there any special requirements to operate a limited use motorcycle (moped) in New York?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The requirements to operate a moped are like those for motorcycles. You must have a driver license and register your moped to drive it on streets and highways. There are exceptions to these requirements listed in the table below. You can never operate a moped down a sidewalk.The DMV classifies a moped as a Class A, Class B or Class C limited use motorcycle according to its top speed. Only a certified model of limited use motorcycle can get a registration in New York State (only the manufacturer can certify a moped).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I register my pick-up truck as a 'passenger' class vehicle?
source_blocks.text: Can I register my pick-up truck as a 'passenger' class vehicle?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Your pick-up truck can qualify for passenger class plates if it meets certain conditions, depending on its unladen weight.
source_blocks.text: Yes. Your pick-up truck can qualify for passenger class plates if it meets certain conditions, depending on its unladen weight.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a modified or unmodified pick-up truck with an unladen weight less than 6,001 lbs., then you may register it in the passenger class if it meets the following conditions: - the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements, and - the pick-up is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes
source_blocks.text: If you have a modified or unmodified pick-up truck with an unladen weight less than 6,001 lbs., then you may register it in the passenger class if it meets the following conditions: - the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements, and - the pick-up is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a modified pick-up truck with an unladen weight greater than 6,000 lbs., then you may register it in the passenger class if it meets the following conditions: - the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements and is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes - a camper top having one or more side windows completely encloses the truck bed, - the pick-up truck has seats, seat fittings, or camping equipment installed in the truck bed ('camping equipment' indicates that you have a bed, a stove, or a refrigerator in the vehicle)
source_blocks.text: If you have a modified pick-up truck with an unladen weight greater than 6,000 lbs., then you may register it in the passenger class if it meets the following conditions: - the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements and is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes - a camper top having one or more side windows completely encloses the truck bed, - the pick-up truck has seats, seat fittings, or camping equipment installed in the truck bed ('camping equipment' indicates that you have a bed, a stove, or a refrigerator in the vehicle)

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: These modifications must be permanent. If you use the pick-up truck without the required modifications, then you must register it in the commercial registration class.
source_blocks.text: NOTE: These modifications must be permanent. If you use the pick-up truck without the required modifications, then you must register it in the commercial registration class.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are not required to apply for passenger class plates for your pick-up. You can use commercial plates.
source_blocks.text: You are not required to apply for passenger class plates for your pick-up. You can use commercial plates.

source_blocks.source_text_en: See Information For Pick-Up Truck Owners (PDF) [2] (MV-114) to get more information.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I find my truck s unladen weight?
source_blocks.text: How can I find my truck s unladen weight?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The unladen weight of your pick-up truck is stamped on a metal plate located on the door of your vehicle. The unladen weight is also listed on your title certificate. The unladen weight is different from the maximum gross weight (MGW) listed on your registration documents. Before you apply, make sure that the unladen weight of the truck is 6,000 lbs. or less.
source_blocks.text: The unladen weight of your pick-up truck is stamped on a metal plate located on the door of your vehicle. The unladen weight is also listed on your title certificate. The unladen weight is different from the maximum gross weight (MGW) listed on your registration documents. Before you apply, make sure that the unladen weight of the truck is 6,000 lbs. or less.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does passenger class change the MGW listed on registration documents?
source_blocks.text: Does passenger class change the MGW listed on registration documents?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Passenger class plates on a pick-up truck do not change the maximum gross weight (MGW) listed on the registration documents or the unladen weight listed on the title certificate.
source_blocks.text: No. Passenger class plates on a pick-up truck do not change the maximum gross weight (MGW) listed on the registration documents or the unladen weight listed on the title certificate.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does passenger class change the registration fees?
source_blocks.text: Does passenger class change the registration fees?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Passenger class plates on a pick-up truck do not change the registration fees. Commercial registration fees still apply. The DMV requests the unladen weight to verify that your pick-up truck is eligible for passenger class plates. The DMV does not change the unladen weight or the MGW.
source_blocks.text: No. Passenger class plates on a pick-up truck do not change the registration fees. Commercial registration fees still apply. The DMV requests the unladen weight to verify that your pick-up truck is eligible for passenger class plates. The DMV does not change the unladen weight or the MGW.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for passenger class plates?
source_blocks.text: How do I apply for passenger class plates?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must apply in person at a DMV office [3]. Before visiting a DMV office to register your pick-up truck as a "passenger" class vehicle, please complete the Document Guide to make sure you bring the correct documents with you.
source_blocks.text: You must apply in person at a DMV office [3]. Before visiting a DMV office to register your pick-up truck as a "passenger" class vehicle, please complete the Document Guide to make sure you bring the correct documents with you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must surrender your commercial plates (be sure to remove frames and fasteners).The DMV office will issue new registration documents and standard passenger plates with a new number. If you had custom plates or personalized plates, your new registration documents will list the numbers from your plates. The DMV will send you new passenger custom or personalized plates by mail.

source_blocks.source_text_en: My pick-up is rented or leased. What do I need to do?
source_blocks.text: My pick-up is rented or leased. What do I need to do?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit a certification (form) provided by the leasing company or owner of the pick-up truck which states that the truck will not be used for commercial purposes.
source_blocks.text: You must submit a certification (form) provided by the leasing company or owner of the pick-up truck which states that the truck will not be used for commercial purposes.

source_blocks.source_text_en: My registration is about to expire. Can I change the class when I renew?
source_blocks.text: My registration is about to expire. Can I change the class when I renew?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your registration will expire in less than 60 days, you can renew your registration at a DMV office and change to passenger class plates when you renew.
source_blocks.text: If your registration will expire in less than 60 days, you can renew your registration at a DMV office and change to passenger class plates when you renew.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also get passenger plates with no additional fee when you register a pick-up truck for the first time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: My pick-up truck weighs more than 6,000 pounds. Can I still register it as a passenger class?
source_blocks.text: My pick-up truck weighs more than 6,000 pounds. Can I still register it as a passenger class?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. If you have a pick-up truck that has an unladen weight of 6,001 lbs. or more, you cannot apply for passenger class plates through the process described above. You must modify the truck to qualify for a passenger class registration and passenger class plates. Learn more about vehicle modifications for registration class changes [5].

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I register my truck as a passenger class, can I drive it on parkways?
source_blocks.text: If I register my truck as a passenger class, can I drive it on parkways?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The agency that controls a parkway decides if pick-up trucks with passenger class plates are allowed on the parkway. To make sure you can drive your pick-up truck on a parkway, contact the agency that manages the parkway. Some parking regulations and traffic regulations in New York City depend on the type of vehicle plates on your vehicle. Passenger class plates on your pick-up truck can change how New York City regulations affect you. Contact New York City about their regulations.

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York law requires that the operator and passenger on a snowmobile wear protective headgear approved by the Commissioner of the NY State Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation [2]. You are not required to wear a helmet if (A) the snowmobile is operated on property where the operator or passenger is the property owner, or (B) the snowmobile is operated on private property which the operator or passenger has a contractual right to use (this exemption does not apply if the owner or passenger is a member of a club or association and the owner does not receive compensation for snowmobile operation). A court can suspend the privilege of a person to operate a snowmobile if the person is convicted of snowmobiling under the influence of alcohol or drugs. The court can also suspend the snowmobile registration. The law also provides for strict penalties and enforcement for these offenses. A person who refuses to take a chemical test (breath test) immediately receives a suspension of the privilege to operate a snowmobile, pending a DMV hearing. You must be at least 16 years old to register a vehicle in New York (except a boat or ATV). - A NY State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID card that is current or not expired for more than 2 years can serve as proof of both identity and age. If you don t have one of these documents, you must provide other kinds of proof [12].

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register a vehicle I bought at a sheriff or marshal auction

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you purchased a vehicle at a sheriff or marshal auction, you might not have the title to that vehicle. However, you can still apply for a New York State registration and a title certificate at a local DMV office [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您在治安官或执法官拍卖会上购买了车辆，您可能没有该车辆的所有权证书。但是，您仍然可以在当地DMV办公室申请纽约州注册和所有权证书 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to bring to the DMV
source_blocks.text: 前往DMV时需要携带的材料

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these
source_blocks.text: 以下之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: a copy of the posted notice of sale
source_blocks.text: 已张贴的销售通知的副本

source_blocks.source_text_en: or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: a copy of the newspaper ad containing

source_blocks.source_text_en: - the vehicle year, make and VIN
source_blocks.text: - 车辆年份、品牌和车辆识别码（VIN）

source_blocks.source_text_en: the name of the newspaper and the date the ad was published
source_blocks.text: 报纸名称和广告发布日期

source_blocks.source_text_en: or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: a statement from the Marshal or Sheriff that they complied with the law in regard to public notification or sale
source_blocks.text: 执法官或治安官出具的声明，证明他们遵守了有关公开通知或销售的法律

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these documents
source_blocks.text: 以下所有文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [2] (MV-82)
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的车辆注册/所有权申请表（PDF） [2] （MV-82）

source_blocks.source_text_en: the name and address of the purchaser and the price paid
source_blocks.text: 购买者的姓名和地址以及支付的价格

source_blocks.source_text_en: if the vehicle was sold within New York City, a copy of the judgement or execution order giving the Marshal or Sheriff authority to sell the vehicle

source_blocks.source_text_en: if the vehicle was sold within New York City, a statement by the Marshal or Sheriff that they had notified or attempted to notify the owner and lienholder that the vehicle was being auctioned

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fees
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fees depend on the vehicle weight and where you live. First-time registration fees normally include

source_blocks.source_text_en: the sales tax a vehicle plate fee or registration transfer fee a title certificate fee (in most counties) a vehicle use tax either a 1 or 2 year registration fee, depending on the type of registration
source_blocks.text: 销售税 车牌费或注册转移费 所有权证书费 （在大多数县）车辆使用税 1年或2年的注册费，具体取决于注册类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can estimate the registration fees [4] you will need to pay.
source_blocks.text: 您可以估算需要支付的注册费用 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Payment types
source_blocks.text: 支付方式

source_blocks.source_text_en: We accept
source_blocks.text: 我们接受

source_blocks.source_text_en: cash most credit, pinless debit or prepaid cards (American Express, Discover Card/Novus, MasterCard, VISA) a personal check or a money order payable to
source_blocks.text: 现金 大多数信用卡、免密码借记卡或预付卡（美国运通、Discover Card/Novus、MasterCard、VISA） 个人支票或汇票，收款人为

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can split your payment between cash and check if you need.
source_blocks.text: 如有需要，您可以将付款分为现金和支票。

source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.text: 更多帮助

source_blocks.text: 请参阅《车辆注册/所有权申请说明》（PDF）[5]（MV-82.1）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For specific information about registering various types of vehicles, refer to the webpages listed on this page.
source_blocks.text: 有关注册各类车辆的具体信息，请参阅本页列出的网页。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need to be United States resident to register a vehicle in New York
source_blocks.text: 您无需是美国居民即可在纽约注册车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: As long as you meet the registration requirements, you can register a vehicle here.
source_blocks.text: 只要您满足注册要求，就可以在这里注册车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINS) on vehicles or motorcycles
source_blocks.text: 关于车辆或摩托车上的车辆识别码（VIN）

source_blocks.source_text_en: In an effort to protect consumers, the DMV would like to inform you about New York State laws pertaining to vehicle identification numbers [6] (also called VINs).
source_blocks.text: 为了保护消费者，DMV希望告知您有关纽约州关于车辆识别码[6]（也称为VIN）的法律。

source_blocks.source_text_en: California emissions standards
source_blocks.text: 加利福尼亚州排放标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most vehicles mustcomply with California emission standards [7].
source_blocks.text: 大多数车辆必须符合加利福尼亚州排放标准[7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sharing registration information
source_blocks.text: 共享注册信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read more about sharing your information [8].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于共享您的信息[8]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registering the vehicle if you have a title
source_blocks.text: 如果您拥有所有权证书，注册车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read more about registering a vehicle if you have a title [9].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于如果您拥有所有权证书注册车辆的信息[9]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your insurance company will:
source_blocks.text: 您的保险公司将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1\) give you 2 barcoded original NY State Insurance ID cards (see a sample [10]) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card
source_blocks.text: 1\) 给您2张带有条形码的纽约州保险ID卡原件（参见示例[10]）或提供您访问数字电子纽约州保险ID卡的权限

source_blocks.source_text_en: 2\) send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)
source_blocks.text: 2\) 向DMV发送电子保险覆盖通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人不能提交此通知）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Insurance ID cards and the electronic notice together verify your coverage. We need both.
source_blocks.text: 您的纽约州保险ID卡和电子通知共同验证您的保险覆盖范围。我们需要两者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle within 180 days of the effective date on your Insurance ID Card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance ID Card with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险ID卡上的生效日期起180天内注册您的车辆。随身携带一份或形式的保险ID卡。DMV办公室将保留纸质卡。将另一张纸质卡放在车辆中作为您的保险证明。任何操作您车辆的人都必须能够提供保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements [11].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于纽约州保险要求[11]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must provide proof of identity and date of birth. You must be at least 16 years old (except for ATV and boat registrations).
source_blocks.text: 您必须提供身份和出生日期证明。您必须年满16岁（ATV和船只注册除外）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use a New York State
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用纽约州

source_blocks.source_text_en: driver license - learner permit, or - non-driver ID card
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照 - 学习许可证，或 - 非驾驶员身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: that is current or expired less than 2 years as proof of identity and age. If you don t have one of these, see other kinds of proof [12] you can use.
source_blocks.text: 作为身份和年龄证明，该证件需为当前有效或过期不超过2年。如果您没有这些证件，请参阅您可以使用的其他证明类型 [12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See Instructions for Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [5] (MV-82.1).
source_blocks.text: 请参阅车辆注册/所有权申请说明（PDF）[5]（MV-82.1）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register a vehicle when you are out-of-state
source_blocks.text: 在州外注册车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register a vehicle when you are out-of-state [1]
source_blocks.text: 在州外注册车辆 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I register while I am outside of New York State?
source_blocks.text: 当我在纽约州以外时如何注册？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for a New York State registration and a title certificate by mail from outside of New York. You will need to mail these items to a local DMV office [2] 1
source_blocks.text: 你可以从纽约以外的地方通过邮件申请纽约州注册和所有权证书。你需要将这些物品邮寄到当地的DMV办公室 [2] 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [3] (MV-82)
source_blocks.text: 一份填好的车辆注册/所有权申请表 (PDF) [3] (MV-82)

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of ownership 2 (must be original; we don t accept photocopies)
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明 2（必须是原件；我们不接受复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of NY State automobile liability insurance 3
source_blocks.text: 纽约州汽车责任保险证明 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof of identity and age 4 (send us photocopies; don t send us your original documents)
source_blocks.text: 身份和年龄证明 4（寄复印件给我们；不要寄原件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: payment for sales tax (see sales tax information [4])
source_blocks.text: 销售税支付（见销售税信息 [4]）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must contact the motor vehicle agency in the other state to determine if their laws require that you register your vehicles there. The definition of "resident" is different in each state. Read the NY State definition of 'resident.' 5
source_blocks.text: 你必须联系其他州的机动车管理局，以确定他们的法律是否要求你在那里注册车辆。每个州对“居民”的定义不同。阅读纽约州对“居民”的定义。5

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once we process your application, we will send you these items in one package
source_blocks.text: 一旦我们处理了你的申请，我们会将以下物品打包寄给你

source_blocks.source_text_en: your registration documents your vehicle plates a 10-day Inspection Extension Sticker (VS-1077)
source_blocks.text: 你的注册文件 你的车牌 10天检查延期贴纸 (VS-1077)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Put the 10-day Inspection Sticker on your vehicle when you enter New York State (not before). Mark the box on the sticker that indicates you entered New York, and write the date you entered.
source_blocks.text: 当你进入纽约州时（而不是之前），将10天检查贴纸贴在车上。在贴纸上标记你进入纽约的方框，并写上你进入的日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will send you your title certificate separately. Allow up to 90 days to receive it from us.
source_blocks.text: 我们会单独寄给你所有权证书。请留出最多90天的接收时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When will I get my documents?
source_blocks.text: 我什么时候能收到我的文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Allow 6 weeks for your registration documents to arrive by mail. Allow 90 days for your title certificate to arrive.
source_blocks.text: 留出6周时间让注册文件邮寄到达。 留出90天时间让所有权证书到达。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It will take longer to receive your documents if you are outside of the United States.
source_blocks.text: 如果你在美国境外，收到文件的时间会更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get registration documents by express mail?
source_blocks.text: 我可以通过快递邮件获得注册文件吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. To do this, enclose a pre-paid, pre-addressed express mail package with your application. Make sure the package can contain vehicle plates.
source_blocks.text: 可以。要做到这一点，请随申请附上一个预付邮资、写明地址的快递包裹。请确保该包裹能够容纳车辆牌照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I have my registration sent to an address that is different from my registration document?
source_blocks.text: 我能否将我的注册文件寄送到与我的注册文件上不同的地址？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Include a separate note with your Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [3] (MV-82), and clearly print the alternate address. Do not write the alternate address on your application. If you do, DMV will prints the alternate address on your registration document and registration record.
source_blocks.text: 可以。请随您的车辆注册/所有权申请（PDF）[3]（MV-82）附上一张单独的便条，并清晰打印备用地址。请勿在您的申请上写下备用地址。如果您这样做，DMV 会将备用地址打印在您的注册文件和注册记录上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I have my title certificate sent to an address different from my registration?
source_blocks.text: 我能否将我的所有权证书寄送到与我的注册地址不同的地址？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. The DMV sends the title certificate to the mailing address on your registration application. The DMV cannot send the title certificate to another address.
source_blocks.text: 不能。DMV 会将所有权证书寄送到您注册申请上的邮寄地址。DMV 无法将所有权证书寄送到其他地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: My vehicle is coming from another country. What do I need to do?
source_blocks.text: 我的车辆来自另一个国家。我需要做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read the instructions for how to register an imported [5] vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 请阅读如何注册进口 [5] 车辆的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can another person submit my registration application at a DMV office for me?
source_blocks.text: 其他人可以代替我在 DMV 办公室提交我的注册申请吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Read the instructions for how to register a vehicle for someone [6] else to learn how to do this.
source_blocks.text: 可以。请阅读如何为他人 [6] 注册车辆的说明，以了解如何操作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We recommend sending any original documents by insured or priority mail. It can be difficult to replace documents that are lost in the mail.
source_blocks.text: 我们建议通过保价或优先邮件发送任何原始文件。丢失在邮件中的文件可能难以补办。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For cars, trucks and motorcycles that are model year 1973 or newer, proof can be either
source_blocks.text: 对于 1973 年款或更新的轿车、卡车和摩托车，证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: a NY State Certificate of Title (the original or a certified copy, not a photocopy) - acceptable proof of ownership from any other state (the original or a certified copy, not a photocopy)
source_blocks.text: 纽约州所有权证书（原件或经认证的副本，而非复印件） - 任何其他州可接受的所有权证明（原件或经认证的副本，而非复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See acceptable proofs [7] for other vehicles (older than 1973, manufactured homes, boats, trailers, ATVs, snowmobiles, gifted vehicles, vehicles with deceased owners).
source_blocks.text: 请参阅其他车辆（1973 年以前、 manufactured homes、船只、拖车、ATV、雪地摩托、赠与车辆、车主已故的车辆）的可接受证明 [7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your insurance company will:
source_blocks.text: 您的保险公司将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1\) give you 2 barcoded original NY State Insurance ID cards (see a sample [8]) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card
source_blocks.text: 1\) 给您 2 张带有条形码的纽约州保险 ID 卡原件（请参阅示例 [8]）或提供您访问数字电子纽约州保险 ID 卡的权限

source_blocks.source_text_en: 2\) send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)
source_blocks.text: 2\) 向 DMV 发送电子保险覆盖通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人无法提交此通知）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Insurance ID cards and the electronic notice together verify your coverage. We need both.
source_blocks.text: 您的纽约州保险 ID 卡和电子通知共同验证您的保险覆盖范围。我们需要两者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle within 180 days of the effective date on your Insurance ID Card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance ID Card with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance.
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险ID卡上的生效日期起180天内注册您的车辆。请携带一份您的保险ID卡副本或表格。DMV办公室将保留纸质卡片。将另一张纸质卡片随车携带，作为您的保险证明。任何驾驶您车辆的人都必须能够提供保险证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements [9].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于纽约州保险要求 [9] 的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must be at least 16 years old (except for ATV registrations). A NY State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID card that is current or not expired for more than 2 years can serve as proof of both identity and age.If you don t have one of these, see other kinds of proof [10] you can use.
source_blocks.text: 您必须年满16岁（ATV注册除外）。纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员ID卡，只要当前有效或过期不超过2年，即可作为身份和年龄的证明。如果您没有这些证件，请参阅其他可使用的证明类型 [10]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most states allow a non-resident to register a vehicle. It can be easier to apply for a vehicle registration and title certificate in the other state.
source_blocks.text: 大多数州允许非居民注册车辆。在另一个州申请车辆注册和所有权证书可能更容易。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are traveling and your registration expires, you should determine if the other state can issue an "in-transit" permit, which allows you to transport a vehicle to New York so that you can register it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在旅行中且注册到期，您应确定该州是否可以签发“过境”许可证，该许可证允许您将车辆运至纽约以便注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definition of New York State Resident
source_blocks.text: 纽约州居民的定义

source_blocks.source_text_en: Section 250 (5) of the Vehicle and Traffic Law defines the term 'resident.' The law defines a resident as a person who lives in NY State with the intent to make NY State a "fixed and permanent" place to live. To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in NY State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of NY State. A police officer can use this evidence as the reason to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in NY State without a driver license or vehicle registration issued by NY State.
source_blocks.text: 《车辆与交通法》第250条第(5)款定义了“居民”一词。法律将居民定义为居住在纽约州并意图将纽约州作为“固定且永久”居住地的人。在纽约州的房屋、住宅、公寓、房间或其他类似地方居住90天，被视为您是纽约州居民的“推定证据”。如果您在没有纽约州颁发的驾驶执照或车辆注册的情况下在纽约州驾驶，警察可以利用此证据作为开具交通罚单的理由。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of NY State. For example, if you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make NY State a "fixed and permanent" residence. The DMV will not decide if you are a resident of NY State, if you must get a NY State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in NY State.
source_blocks.text: 法官会考虑法律和您的意图证据，并决定您是否为纽约州居民。例如，如果您在另一个州纳税或您的子女在另一个州上学，法官会考虑这些事实来决定您的意图是否是将纽约州作为“固定且永久”的居住地。DMV不会决定您是否为纽约州居民、是否必须获得纽约州驾驶执照，或是否必须在纽约州注册您的车辆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in NY State are normally not considered residents of NY State.
source_blocks.text: 根据该法律，来自其他州或其他国家在纽约州上学的学生通常不被视为纽约州居民。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do it by mail:
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄办理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail your completed registration application, additional documents and payment to a DMV office [2].
source_blocks.text: 将您填写完整的注册申请表、附加文件和付款邮寄至DMV办公室 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register a vehicle
source_blocks.text: 注册车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register and title a passenger or commerical car, truck or SUV
source_blocks.text: 注册并登记一辆乘用车、商用车、卡车或SUV

source_blocks.source_text_en: You or your business must register and title at a DMV office any vehicle you own or lease. Registrations don t need to be in the owner's name, or for only one person. Auto dealers can register and title vehicles, and issue plates (and charge a fee for this).
source_blocks.text: 您或您的企业必须在DMV办公室注册并登记您拥有或租赁的任何车辆。注册不需要以车主名义进行，也不仅限于一个人。汽车经销商可以注册和登记车辆，并发放车牌（并为此收取费用）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 1: Get your vehicle insured
source_blocks.text: 步骤1：为您的车辆投保

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must register your vehicle at the DMV within 180 days of the effective date on your insurance ID card. 1
source_blocks.text: 您必须在保险ID卡生效日期后的180天内到DMV注册您的车辆。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2: Bring required documents to the DMV
source_blocks.text: 步骤2：携带所需文件到DMV

source_blocks.source_text_en: What you need to register
source_blocks.text: 注册所需材料

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complete DMV s Document Guide to make sure you have the correct proofs of identification and other documents before you come to a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 完成DMV的Document Guide，以确保您在前往DMV办公室之前持有正确的身份证明和其他文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Summary of what you need
source_blocks.text: 所需材料摘要

source_blocks.source_text_en: the original title (or other proof of ownership) 2
source_blocks.text: 原始title（或其他所有权证明）2

source_blocks.source_text_en: the current NY State Insurance ID card (auto liability insurance) 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is considered an all-terrain vehicle ( ATV )?
source_blocks.text: What is considered an all-terrain vehicle ( ATV )?

source_blocks.source_text_en: An all-terrain vehicle (ATV) is any self-propelled vehicle, including an off-road motorcycle, that is manufactured for use on off-road trails or in off-road competitions. These vehicles are less than 70 inches wide and weigh less than 1,000 pounds.
source_blocks.text: An all-terrain vehicle (ATV) is any self-propelled vehicle, including an off-road motorcycle, that is manufactured for use on off-road trails or in off-road competitions. These vehicles are less than 70 inches wide and weigh less than 1,000 pounds.

source_blocks.text: Do I need insurance coverage for my ATV?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need insurance to register your ATV. However, you must have insurance unless you only drive your ATV on private property. You must show your proof of insurance to a judge, a police officer, or any person who makes a claim of injury or property damage.

If the out-of-state dealer collects out-of-state sales tax, you can apply for credit toward the payment of the NY State sales tax when you apply for registration in NY State. You can be eligible for credit only if New York and the other state have a reciprocal sales tax agreement (see Sales Tax Paid in Another State {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [7] (DTF-804)). If you purchased the ATV from a private seller, the seller and the buyer complete the Statement of Transaction {Sales Tax Form} (PDF) [8] (DTF-802). You can also show your proof of exemption or proof that the tax was paid. A NY State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID card that is current or not expired for more than 2 years can serve as proof of identity. If you don t have one of these documents, you must provide other kinds of proof [9].
