source_blocks.source_text_en: Registration suspensions for failure to pay tolls
source_blocks.text: 因未支付通行费而暂停注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a suspension for failure to pay tolls?
source_blocks.text: 什么是因未支付通行费而暂停注册？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not pay a required toll, fee or other charge to a tolling authority, which operates a toll highway, bridge and/or tunnel facility, your registration may be suspended.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未向运营收费公路、桥梁和/或隧道设施的收费机构支付所需的通行费、费用或其他收费，您的车辆注册可能会被暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who issues toll violations?
source_blocks.text: 谁发出通行费违规通知？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A tolling authority, which includes the New York State Thruway Authority, the Triborough Bridge and Tunnel Authority (MTA Bridges and Tunnels) and the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey.
source_blocks.text: 收费机构，包括纽约州高速公路管理局、三区桥梁和隧道管理局（MTA桥梁和隧道）以及纽约与新泽西港务局。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I don t pay a toll?
source_blocks.text: 如果我不支付通行费会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you fail to pay tolls, fees or other charges in relation to 3 or more tolling violations, all committed within 5 years, or fail to pay \$200 in tolls accumulated within 5 years, if the violations occurred in a commercial vehicle, or fail to have them dismissed or transferred, the NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, ("DMV") may send you a Notice of Registration Suspension. The notice will advise you that if you pay all of the tolls, fees or other charges owed to the tolling authority, or have them dismissed or transferred, the suspension will not take effect. You also have the right to a hearing before the DMV. If you request a DMV hearing, the suspension is placed on hold pending the outcome of the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在5年内有3次或以上未支付通行费、费用或其他收费的违规行为，或如果违规行为发生在商用车辆上，在5年内累计未支付通行费达到200美元，或未能让这些违规行为被撤销或转移，纽约州机动车辆管理局（“DMV”）可能会向您发送注册暂停通知。该通知将告知您，如果您支付所有欠收费机构的通行费、费用或其他收费，或让这些费用被撤销或转移，暂停将不会生效。您也有权在DMV举行听证会。如果您要求DMV听证会，暂停将在听证会结果出来之前被搁置。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the purpose of a DMV hearing?
source_blocks.text: DMV听证会的目的是什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The purpose of the hearing is to determine whether the tolling authority notified you that you failed to pay tolls, fees or other charges related to 3 or more violations of the Authority s toll collection regulations, all such violations committed within a 5 year period, or failed to pay \$200 in tolls accumulated within 5 years, if the violations occurred in a commercial vehicle, or failed to have them dismissed or transferred. At the hearing, you may NOT dispute whether you evaded a toll and/or failed to pay tolls, fees or other charges. You must raise those issues with the tolling authority outside of the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 听证会的目的是确定收费机构是否已通知您，您未支付与该机构收费规定相关的3次或以上违规行为的通行费、费用或其他收费，所有这些违规行为发生在5年内，或如果违规行为发生在商用车辆上，在5年内累计未支付通行费达到200美元，或未能让这些费用被撤销或转移。在听证会上，您不得就您是否逃避通行费和/或未支付通行费、费用或其他收费提出异议。您必须在听证会之外向收费机构提出这些问题。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Must I appear for the hearing?
source_blocks.text: 我必须出席听证会吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: As the Notice of Registration Suspension indicates, you may request an in-person DMV hearing or you may request a hearing by affidavit (this is a hearing on paper). The Notice of Registration Suspension provides instructions about how to submit the affidavit to DMV. If you submit the affidavit, you will not have to appear at a DMV hearing.
source_blocks.text: 如注册暂停通知所示，您可以要求亲自出席DMV听证会，或要求通过宣誓书进行听证（即书面听证）。注册暂停通知提供了如何向DMV提交宣誓书的说明。如果您提交宣誓书，则无需出席DMV听证会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At an in-person DMV hearing, you may be represented by an attorney.
source_blocks.text: 在亲自出席的DMV听证会上，您可以由律师代理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request a DMV hearing and do not appear or submit your affidavit, your registration will be suspended immediately.
source_blocks.text: 如果您要求DMV听证会但未出席或未提交宣誓书，您的注册将立即被暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I respond to a tolling authority about a non-payment of tolls?
source_blocks.text: 我如何就未支付通行费向收费机构作出回应？

source_blocks.source_text_en: \\\ DO NOT contact the New York State DMV to dispute whether you violated a toll regulation or failed to pay the toll, fees or other charges. \\\
source_blocks.text: 不要联系纽约州DMV来争议您是否违反通行费规定或未支付通行费、费用或其他收费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may contact the Customer Service Center and speak with a customer service specialist. Each tolling authority has a Customer Service Center and they can provide you information on your outstanding violation(s).
source_blocks.text: 您可以联系客户服务中心并与客户服务专员交谈。每个收费机构都有客户服务中心，他们可以为您提供有关您未处理违规行为的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To dispute an allegation that you violated a toll regulation or failed to pay the toll, fees or other charges, please contact the tolling authority listed on the Notice of Registration Suspension.
source_blocks.text: 要争议关于您违反通行费规定或未支付通行费、费用或其他收费的指控，请联系注册暂停通知上列出的收费机构。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Either mail:
source_blocks.text: 可以通过邮寄：

source_blocks.source_text_en: E-ZPass New York/DMV Registration Suspension PO Box 149005 Staten Island, NY 10314-9005
source_blocks.text: E-ZPass 纽约/车管所注册暂停 邮政信箱 149005 斯塔滕岛，纽约州 10314-9005

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or call the tolling authority at:
source_blocks.text: 或致电收费机构：

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Thruway Authority at 718-313-9414, Metropolitan Transit Authority at 718 313-9424, & Port Authority of New York and New Jersey at 718-313-9425
source_blocks.text: 纽约州高速公路管理局：718-313-9414，大都会交通管理局：718 313-9424，及纽约与新泽西港务局：718-313-9425

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are several ways that your violations can be paid:
source_blocks.text: 您的违规行为可以通过以下几种方式支付：

source_blocks.source_text_en: By Mail send your check or money order (no cash) to: E-ZPass New York, DMV Registration Suspension, P.O. Box 149005, Staten Island, NY 10314-9005.
source_blocks.text: 邮寄：请将支票或汇票（不接受现金）寄至：E-ZPass 纽约，车管所注册暂停，邮政信箱 149005，斯塔滕岛，纽约州 10314-9005。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By Phone call the Customer Service Center based on the tolling authority listed on the Notice of Registration Suspension. Provide the customer service specialist with the license plate number listed on the Notice of Registration Suspension. Accepted payment methods are credit card, debit card, and bank account debit. Below is the contact information:
source_blocks.text: 电话：请根据注册暂停通知上列出的收费机构，致电客户服务中心。向客户服务专员提供注册暂停通知上列出的车牌号。接受的付款方式包括信用卡、借记卡和银行账户扣款。以下是联系信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Thruway Authority: 718-313-9414 Metropolitan Transit Authority: 718 313-9424 Port Authority of New York and New Jersey: 718-313-9425
source_blocks.text: 纽约州高速公路管理局：718-313-9414 大都会交通管理局：718 313-9424 纽约与新泽西港务局：718-313-9425

source_blocks.source_text_en: In Person visit one of the E-ZPass Customer Service walk-in centers. Locations and hours of operation can be found at www.e-zpassny.com/en/about/csc.shtml [1].
source_blocks.text: 亲自前往：请前往任一 E-ZPass 客户服务中心。地点和营业时间可在 www.e-zpassny.com/en/about/csc.shtml [1] 上找到。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online Visit the EZPass website [2] for information about how to pay a toll online. Online, you can also check the status of a violation or attempt to resolve a violation.
source_blocks.text: 在线：请访问 EZPass 网站 [2] 了解如何在线支付通行费。在线还可以查看违规状态或尝试解决违规问题。

source_blocks.source_text_en: \\\ DO NOT contact the New York State DMV to dispute whether you violated a toll regulation or failed to pay the toll, fees or other charges. \\\
source_blocks.text: \\\ 请勿联系纽约州车管所以争议您是否违反通行费规定或未支付通行费、费用或其他收费。 \\\

source_blocks.source_text_en: Registrations
source_blocks.text: 注册（Registrations）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your 'registration' is the sticker placed on your windshield and the paper registration certificate that you must keep in your vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 您的“注册”是指贴在挡风玻璃上的贴纸以及必须放在车内的纸质注册证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You or your business must register and title at a DMV office any vehicle you own or lease. Registrations do not need to be in the owner's name, or for only one person. Auto dealers can register and title vehicles, and issue plates (and charge a fee for this).
source_blocks.text: 您或您的企业必须在 DMV 办公室为您拥有或租赁的任何车辆进行注册和所有权登记（title）。注册不需要以车主名义进行，也不限于一人。汽车经销商可以办理车辆注册和所有权登记，并发放车牌（并为此收取费用）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See information about vehicle plates [1] or vehicle titles [2].
source_blocks.text: 查看关于车辆牌照 [1] 或车辆所有权（title）[2] 的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles already registered in New York
source_blocks.text: 已在纽约注册的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Renew
source_blocks.text: 续期（Renew）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can renew your registration online and print a 10 day document to use until your new registration arrives in the mail. Please note: If your vehicle has been altered or stretched to increase the number of passengers or if there are other special circumstances, you cannot renew your registration online. See additional information and other ways to renew a registration [3].
source_blocks.text: 您可以在线续期注册，并打印一份 10 天的临时文件，在新注册文件邮寄到达前使用。请注意：如果您的车辆经过改装或加长以增加乘客数量，或存在其他特殊情况，则无法在线续期注册。查看更多信息及其他续期方式 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Renew registration online [4]
source_blocks.text: 在线续期注册 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other transactions
source_blocks.text: 其他业务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change address [5] Change name or other information [6] Check registration status [7] Replace registration [8] (and get a temporary document) Surrender (return) plates and cancel registration [9] Tell DMV your new registration has not come in the mail [10] Transfer a registration to another vehicle you own [11]
source_blocks.text: 更改地址 [5] 更改姓名或其他信息 [6] 查询注册状态 [7] 更换注册文件 [8]（并获取临时文件） 交回（退还）车牌并取消注册 [9] 告知 DMV 您的新注册文件尚未邮寄到达 [10] 将注册转移到您拥有的另一辆车 [11]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Suspensions
source_blocks.text: 暂停（Suspensions）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See information on registration suspensions due to
source_blocks.text: 查看因以下原因导致的注册暂停信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Parking tickets [12] 1 Toll violations [13] Insurance lapses [14]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remove a lienholder from a title
source_blocks.text: 从所有权证书上移除留置权人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remove a lienholder from a title [1]
source_blocks.text: 从所有权证书上移除留置权人 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to remove a lienholder from a title certificate
source_blocks.text: 如何从所有权证书上移除留置权人

source_blocks.source_text_en: PLEASE NOTE: When you sell a vehicle, you do not need to remove a lien from the certificate of title. You can give the original title and the original lien release to the buyer. If you want to get a lien free title, please read below for further instructions.
source_blocks.text: 请注意：当您出售车辆时，无需从所有权证书上移除留置权。您可以将原始所有权证书和原始留置权解除文件交给买方。如果您希望获得无留置权的所有权证书，请阅读以下进一步说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To remove a lien, you do not need to go to your local DMV. Just mail these items
source_blocks.text: 要移除留置权，您无需前往当地的DMV。只需邮寄以下材料

source_blocks.source_text_en: proof that the lien was satisfied (must be the original - photocopies are not accepted)
source_blocks.text: 证明留置权已清偿的文件（必须是原件——不接受复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: your current title certificate (must be the original photocopies not accepted)
source_blocks.text: 您当前的所有权证书（必须是原件，不接受复印件）

source_blocks.source_text_en: check or money order for \$20.00 payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles"
source_blocks.text: 抬头为“Commissioner of Motor Vehicles”的\$20.00支票或汇票

source_blocks.source_text_en: To
source_blocks.text: 邮寄至

source_blocks.source_text_en: Lien ReleaseNYS DMV Title Services6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228-0331
source_blocks.text: Lien ReleaseNYS DMV Title Services6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228-0331

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV will mail your certificate of title (that does not list the lien) in 60 to 90 days. The title certificate must be mailed to you; a DMV office cannot give you the title certificate.
source_blocks.text: DMV将在60至90天内将您的所有权证书（不列出留置权）邮寄给您。所有权证书必须邮寄给您；DMV办公室不能将所有权证书交给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are acceptable proof that a lien is satisfied?
source_blocks.text: 哪些是可接受的留置权已清偿证明？

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are two acceptable proofs. You can provide the DMV either
source_blocks.text: 有两种可接受的证明。您可以向DMV提供以下任一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Notice of Recorded Lien (MV-901). The lienholder can send this to you. An authorized officer of the lienholder must sign the form and indicate that the lien is satisfied.
source_blocks.text: 留置权记录通知（MV-901）。留置权人可以将此表格寄给您。留置权人的授权官员必须在表格上签名并注明留置权已清偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A letter from the lienholder. The lienholder must print the letter on the official letterhead of the loan company, and an authorized officer must sign the letter. The letter must identify the vehicle and indicate that the lien is satisfied. If the lienholder is a person and not a loan company, the letter must be notarized.
source_blocks.text: 留置权人的信函。留置权人必须使用贷款公司的正式信笺打印信函，并由授权官员签名。信函必须指明车辆并注明留置权已清偿。如果留置权人是个人而非贷款公司，信函必须经过公证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I transfer a title certificate that has a lien listed?
source_blocks.text: 我可以转让列有留置权的所有权证书吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can transfer the title certificate and give the new owner the original proof that any lien listed on the title certificate was satisfied. Keep a copy of the proof for your records. When the new owner applies for a registration and title certificate, DMV receives the title certificate and the proof that the lien is satisfied. When the DMV processes the title certificate of the new owner, the lien is removed. If the new owner does not provide the original proof that the lien is satisfied, the lienholder is listed on the title certificate of the new owner.
source_blocks.text: 您可以转让所有权证书，并将所有权证书上所列任何留置权已清偿的原始证明交给新车主。请保留证明副本以备记录。当新车主申请注册和所有权证书时，DMV会收到所有权证书和留置权已清偿的证明。当DMV处理新车主的权属证书时，留置权即被移除。如果新车主未提供留置权已清偿的原始证明，则留置权人将列在新车主的权属证书上。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if the lienholder has my title certificate?
source_blocks.text: 如果留置权人持有我的产权证书怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: In many other states, the lienholder keeps the title certificate until the lien is satisfied. The lienholder sends the title certificate to the owner when the lien is satisfied. If your vehicle is registered in NYS and you receive the out-of-state title certificate from the lienholder, send the title certificate to the Title Services Bureau at the address shown above. The DMV will send you a NYS title certificate. There is no fee because you paid the title certificate fee when you registered your vehicle in New York.
source_blocks.text: 在许多其他州，留置权人会保留产权证书，直到留置权得到满足。留置权满足后，留置权人会将产权证书寄给车主。如果您的车辆在纽约州注册，并且您从留置权人处收到外州的产权证书，请将产权证书寄至上方地址所示的Title Services Bureau。DMV将向您寄送纽约州的产权证书。由于您在纽约注册车辆时已支付产权证书费用，因此无需再付费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: My title certificate is lost and I need to remove a lien. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我的产权证书丢失了，但我需要移除留置权。我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send an Application for a Duplicate Certificate of Title (PDF) [2] (MV-902) and the original proof that indicates that the lien is satisfied to the address above, or bring them to a DMV office. The DMV processes a duplicate title certificate that does not list the lien and mails the certificate to you. The fee is \$20.00. If you request that the DMV remove a lien when you apply for a duplicate title certificate, you can apply by mail or at a DMV office [3].
source_blocks.text: 请将Application for a Duplicate Certificate of Title (PDF) [2] (MV-902) 以及表明留置权已满足的原始证明寄至上述地址，或亲自前往DMV办公室提交。DMV将处理一份不列出该留置权的补发产权证书，并将其邮寄给您。费用为\$20.00。如果您在申请补发产权证书时要求DMV移除留置权，您可以通过邮寄或在DMV办公室申请 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there any other way my lienholder can remove the lien?
source_blocks.text: 我的留置权人还有其他方式可以移除留置权吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your lienholder has an account with the DMV's Electronic Lien Transfer system (ELT), they can file to remove the lien electronically. If they electronically file to remove the lien, a new title will not be automatically sent to you. You will either need to send in your title, proof that the lien was satisfied, and a fee, as mentioned above, or apply for a dublicate title. For more information about the Electronic Lien Transaction system, please see the Electronic Lien Transfer Program Business User Manual (PDF) (ELT-1 [4]).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的留置权人在DMV的Electronic Lien Transfer系统 (ELT) 中拥有账户，他们可以以电子方式提交移除留置权的申请。如果他们以电子方式提交移除留置权，新的产权证书不会自动寄送给您。您需要按照上述方式寄送您的产权证书、留置权已满足的证明以及费用，或者申请补发产权证书。有关Electronic Lien Transaction系统的更多信息，请参阅Electronic Lien Transfer Program Business User Manual (PDF) (ELT-1 [4])。

source_blocks.text: What if I no longer need the HazMat endorsement?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not need a HazMat endorsement, do not take the written test and do not apply for the background checks. When it is time to renew your CDL, follow the instructions provided with your CDL renewal notice and pay the CDL renewal fee. The DMV will issue a CDL that does not have a HazMat endorsement.

When it is time to renew your CDL, follow the instructions provided with your CDL renewal notice and pay the CDL renewal fee. The DMV will issue a CDL that does not have a HazMat endorsement.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal and State laws require fingerprint-based background checks for anyone who wants a hazardous materials endorsement, to determine whether that person has a criminal history and/or poses a security threat that warrants denying him or her the authorization to transport hazardous materials. No hazardous materials endorsement may be issued, transferred or renewed unless the background checks result in a determination by the Federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and New York State that the person applying for the endorsement is authorized to transport hazardous materials. To initiate background checks, the rules require that the applicant be fingerprinted, and that his or her United States citizenship or permanent legal presence in the United States be verified. The background checks include a check of criminal history data from the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). There is also a background check by the federal Transportation Safety Administration (TSA). You must provide fingerprints even if you provided fingerprints for another application, for example for a pistol permit or employment as a security guard. You must provide fingerprints for an H endorsement or an X endorsement on your CDL. You must answer 80% or more of the questions correctly to pass the test. You can take the test as many times as necessary until you pass the test, but you must pay a \$5 fee for each test you take.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the fees for duplicate IRP registration items?

source_blocks.source_text_en: replacement apportioned vehicle plates with cab card - \$27.50 replacement cab card and sticker- \$2.50 replacement cab card - \$2.50
source_blocks.text: 更换按比例分配的车辆牌照及cab card - \$27.50 更换cab card和贴纸 - \$2.50 更换cab card - \$2.50

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do with a remaining apportioned plates when I receive my new apportioned plates?
source_blocks.text: 当我收到新的按比例分配的牌照后，旧的按比例分配的牌照应如何处理？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If one or both apportioned plates remain, you must send in the apportioned plate(s) and your old cab card within 30 days after you receive your new apportioned plates. Failure to return your license plates can result in suspension of your IRB account. The IRB will issue new apportioned plates that have a different number, along with a new matching cab card. You cannot request apportioned plates with the same number you had before.
source_blocks.text: 如果一块或两块按比例分配的牌照仍在您手中，您必须在收到新牌照后的30天内寄回旧牌照和旧的cab card。未能归还牌照可能导致您的IRB账户被暂停。IRB将发放带有不同号码的新牌照，以及配套的新cab card。您不能要求使用与之前相同的号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if my apportioned plates are lost or stolen?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的按比例分配的牌照丢失或被盗，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If both apportioned plates are lost or stolen, get form Report of Lost or Stolen Motor Vehicle Items (MV-78B) from a police agency. Also get form MV-78B if your items were lost because of a crime. Your items will be replaced at no fee if form MV-78B shows the items were lost because of a crime.
source_blocks.text: 如果两块按比例分配的牌照都丢失或被盗，请从警察机构获取表格Report of Lost or Stolen Motor Vehicle Items (MV-78B)。如果您的物品因犯罪而丢失，也请获取表格MV-78B。如果表格MV-78B显示物品因犯罪而丢失，您的物品将免费更换。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get form MV-78B if your items were lost because of a crime. Your items will be replaced at no fee if form MV-78B shows the items were lost because of a crime.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的物品因犯罪而丢失，请获取表格MV-78B。如果表格MV-78B显示物品因犯罪而丢失，您的物品将免费更换。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace license or permit
source_blocks.text: 更换驾照或许可证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace license or permit [1]
source_blocks.text: 更换驾照或许可证 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can replace your license or permit (including commercial and enhanced) if it was lost, stolen or destroyed, or after you update your address. You can't replace your document if it is expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾照或许可证（包括商业和增强版）丢失、被盗或损毁，或者您在更新地址后，可以申请更换。如果证件已过期，则无法更换。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are turning 21 soon, order within 40 days of your birthday. 1
source_blocks.text: 如果您即将年满21岁，请在生日前40天内下单。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plan on traveling
source_blocks.text: 如果您计划出行

source_blocks.source_text_en: We recommend you come to the DMV now to get an Enhanced or REAL ID, and avoid a second office visit later. 2 Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [2].
source_blocks.text: 我们建议您现在就来DMV办理Enhanced或REAL ID，以免日后再次跑一趟办公室。2 了解Enhanced、REAL ID和Standard证件 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace at an office and get an Enhanced or REAL ID
source_blocks.text: 在办公室更换并获取Enhanced或REAL ID

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don't have to get an Enhanced or REAL ID. 3 However, if you have a Standard, you will not be allowed to board a domestic flight starting in October 2020 (unless you have a Passport).
source_blocks.text: 您并非必须办理Enhanced或REAL ID。3 然而，如果您持有Standard证件，自2020年10月起将无法登机国内航班（除非持有护照）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification you need before you come to DMV.
source_blocks.text: 完成本指南，确保您在来DMV之前备齐所需的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find your proofs [3]
source_blocks.text: 查找您的证明文件 [3]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace online
source_blocks.text: 在线更换

source_blocks.source_text_en: WARNING: If you replace your Standard online, your new document will show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.
source_blocks.text: 警告：如果您在线更换Standard证件，您的新证件将显示：“NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.
source_blocks.text: 请勿拖延！立即获取您的Enhanced或REAL ID。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can replace online. Your document type will stay the same.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已持有Enhanced或REAL ID，或者您想保留Standard证件，可以在线更换。您的证件类型将保持不变。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.
source_blocks.text: 请勿拖延！立即获取您的Enhanced或REAL ID。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can replace by mail. Your document type will stay the same.

source_blocks.text: 寄送

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [5] (MV-44)
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的许可证、驾照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表（PDF）[5]（MV-44）

source_blocks.source_text_en: (if you do not know your DMV ID number, enter your date of birth and name as it appeared on your old document)
source_blocks.text: （如果您不知道您的DMV ID号码，请填写您的出生日期和旧证件上的姓名）

source_blocks.source_text_en: photocopies of acceptable proof of identity [6] payment of \$17.50 (check or money order payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles")
source_blocks.text: 可接受的身份证明文件的复印件 [6] 支付\$17.50（支票或汇票，收款人为“Commissioner of Motor Vehicles”）

source_blocks.source_text_en: To

source_blocks.text: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles207 Genesee Street, Suite 6Utica, NY 13501-2874

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fee
source_blocks.text: 费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fee is \$17.50.

If you apply by mail or at a DMV office, you can pay by credit/debit card or a check or money order made out to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. To apply online, you must use a credit/debit card. The DMV accepts:
source_blocks.text: 如果您通过邮寄或在DMV办公室申请，您可以使用信用卡/借记卡或支票或汇票支付，收款人为Commissioner of Motor Vehicles。在线申请时，您必须使用信用卡/借记卡。DMV接受：

source_blocks.source_text_en: American Express Card Discover Card /Novus MasterCard MasterCard Debit card without personal identification number (PIN) VISA Card Visa Debit Card without personal identification number (PIN)
source_blocks.text: American Express Card Discover Card /Novus MasterCard MasterCard Debit card without personal identification number (PIN) VISA Card Visa Debit Card without personal identification number (PIN)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want the fee waived for a license or permit lost due to a crime, you must apply at a DMV office and show form MV-78B completed by the police. 4
source_blocks.text: 如果您希望因犯罪导致的驾照或许可证丢失而免除费用，您必须前往DMV办公室并出示由警方填写的MV-78B表格。4

source_blocks.source_text_en: Address and mailing information
source_blocks.text: 地址和邮寄信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Updating address
source_blocks.text: 更新地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: We send documents to the address we have on our records at the time of the order. If you moved, first change your address [7], then order a replacement.
source_blocks.text: 我们将文件寄送到下单时记录中的地址。如果您搬家了，请先更改您的地址 [7]，然后再申请更换。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary address
source_blocks.text: 临时地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you order by mail or at a DMV office [8], you can ask that your replacement document be sent to an address that is different from the address on your document. 5 Sorry, you can't use a temporary address when you order online.
source_blocks.text: 当您通过邮寄或在DMV办公室申请时 [8]，您可以要求将更换文件寄送到与您证件上地址不同的地址。5 抱歉，在线申请时不能使用临时地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will mail you your document
source_blocks.text: 我们将邮寄您的文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: We will mail it to the mailing address currently on our records or an alternate address you provide. 6 To verify or change your address, see Address Change [7].
source_blocks.text: 我们会将其邮寄到当前记录中的邮寄地址或您提供的备用地址。6 如需核实或更改地址，请参阅地址变更 [7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It takes about 10 days for your license to come in the mail. You can check the mailing status online [9]. If it has been more than 2 weeks since you ordered your duplicate, contact us [10].
source_blocks.text: 您的驾照大约需要10天才能邮寄到。您可以在线查看邮寄状态 [9]。如果您订购补办驾照已超过2周，请联系我们 [10]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not need an eye exam when you replace your document.
source_blocks.text: 更换证件时无需进行视力检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your expiration date and ID number will not change when your replace your document.
source_blocks.text: 更换证件时，您的有效期和ID号码不会改变。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change my name or make other changes
source_blocks.text: 更改姓名或进行其他更改

source_blocks.source_text_en: To change your name or other non-address information (photo, height, add/remove corrective lenses), you will need go to a DMV office. See how to change your name or other information [11].
source_blocks.text: 要更改姓名或其他非地址信息（照片、身高、添加/移除矫正镜片），您需要前往DMV办公室。请参阅如何更改姓名或其他信息 [11]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran status designation
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人身份标注

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a qualified U.S. military veteran who was honorably discharged, and you have a NY State driver license, learner permit or non-driver photo ID card, you can have the word "Veteran" printed on the upper left hand of your photo document.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是符合条件的美国退伍军人，且荣誉退伍，并持有纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片ID卡，您可以在照片证件的左上角印上“Veteran”字样。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There is no additional fee for the veteran status designation on your document, but all regular transaction fees will apply.
source_blocks.text: 在证件上添加退伍军人身份标注不收取额外费用，但所有常规交易费用仍适用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to get the veteran status on your license [12].
source_blocks.text: 了解如何在您的驾照上获取退伍军人身份标注 [12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Overseas (out of the country, abroad)
source_blocks.text: 海外（国外、境外）

source_blocks.source_text_en: When overseas you must replace your license through the mail. Please submit
source_blocks.text: 在海外时，您必须通过邮寄方式更换驾照。请提交

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completedApplication for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [5] (MV-44) include payment of \$17.50
source_blocks.text: 一份填写完整的Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [5] (MV-44) 包含\$17.50的付款

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also recommend that you send us a pre-addressed priority mail return envelope with your application (this will help ensure that we send your license to the correct address).
source_blocks.text: 我们还建议您在申请中附上一个预先写好地址的优先邮件回邮信封（这将有助于确保我们将您的驾照寄送到正确的地址）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary visitors and international students
source_blocks.text: 临时访客和国际学生

source_blocks.source_text_en: As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can replace your license online, through the mail or in an office.
source_blocks.text: 只要DMV档案中的Temporary Visitor状态未过期，您就可以在线、通过邮寄或在办公室更换驾照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can replace your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的Temporary Visitor状态已延期，您必须携带来自Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS)的更新文件前往DMV办公室。我们将更新记录以显示您的Temporary Visitor状态已延期，以便您更换驾照。您的新驾照将显示新的临时访客到期日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request a replacement driver license 41 days or more before your 21st birthday, it will say UNDER 21.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在21岁生日前41天或更早申请补发驾照，驾照上会显示“UNDER 21”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Starting in October 2020, you will need an Enhanced or REAL ID to board a domestic flight (unless you have a passport).
source_blocks.text: 从2020年10月开始，您需要Enhanced或REAL ID才能搭乘国内航班（除非您持有护照）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your license or permit was issued before October 30, 2017 and is not Enhanced, you have a Standard document.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的驾照或许可证是在2017年10月30日之前签发且不是Enhanced，则您持有的是Standard文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Newly issued Standard documents show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.
source_blocks.text: 新签发的Standard文件显示：“NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to replace in an office and keep your Standard document type, follow these steps:
source_blocks.text: 如果您想在办公室补办并保留Standard文件类型，请按照以下步骤操作：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 1: Complete an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [5] (MV-44)
source_blocks.text: 步骤1：填写《许可证、驾照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表》（PDF）[5]（MV-44）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2: Come to an office. Bring
source_blocks.text: 步骤2：前往办公室。携带

source_blocks.source_text_en: your current license or permit - your application - payment
source_blocks.text: 您当前的驾照或许可证 - 您的申请表 - 付款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Newly issued Standard licenses and permits show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.
source_blocks.text: 新签发的Standard驾照和许可证显示：“NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get a free replacement for a driver license or learner permit that was stolen or was lost due to a crime, you must get form MV-78B from a police agency. This form is available only from police agencies, not from the DMV.
source_blocks.text: 要免费补发因被盗或因犯罪而丢失的驾照或学习许可证，您必须从警察机构获取MV-78B表格。此表格仅可从警察机构获得，而非DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want your new driver license sent to an alternate address, include an additional note and clearly print the alternate address. Don t write the alternate address on form MV-44. The mailing address you write on form MV-44 must be the address that is listed on your photo document and your DMV record.
source_blocks.text: 如果您希望将新驾照寄送到备用地址，请附上额外说明并清晰打印备用地址。不要在MV-44表格上写备用地址。您在MV-44表格上填写的邮寄地址必须是您照片文件和DMV记录中列出的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want your new driver license sent to an alternate address, include an additional note and clearly print the alternate address. Don t write the alternate address on form MV-44. The mailing address you write on form MV-44 must be the address that is listed on your photo document and your DMV record.
source_blocks.text: 如果您希望将新驾照寄送到备用地址，请附上额外说明并清晰打印备用地址。不要在MV-44表格上写备用地址。您在MV-44表格上填写的邮寄地址必须是您照片文件和DMV记录中列出的地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace or transfer personalized plates
source_blocks.text: 更换或转让个性化车牌

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace or transfer personalized plates [1]
source_blocks.text: 更换或转让个性化车牌 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I replace or transfer personalized plates?
source_blocks.text: 如何更换或转让个性化车牌？

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are a variety of circumstances in which you can replace or transfer personalized plates.
source_blocks.text: 在多种情况下，您可以更换或转让个性化车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I replace personalized plates that are old or damaged?
source_blocks.text: 我可以更换老旧或损坏的个性化车牌吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, for a fee. To replace your personalized plates that are old or damaged, you must call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.
source_blocks.text: 可以，但需付费。如需更换老旧或损坏的个性化车牌，您必须致电定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fees are \$28.75 for passenger vehicle plates, and \$18.75 for motorcycle plates.
source_blocks.text: 费用为：乘用车车牌28.75美元，摩托车车牌18.75美元。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I replace the personalized plates I have now with different personalized plates or personalized picture plates?
source_blocks.text: 我可以将现有的个性化车牌更换为不同的个性化车牌或个性化图片车牌吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, for a fee. To replace your current personalized plates with new custom plates or personalized plates, you must call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.
source_blocks.text: 可以，但需付费。如需将当前的个性化车牌更换为新的定制车牌或个性化车牌，您必须致电定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I have a personalized picture plate, and want to replace it with a different picture plate. Can I keep my current personalized combination and use it on my new picture plate?
source_blocks.text: 我拥有个性化图片车牌，想更换为不同的图片车牌。我可以保留当前的个性化组合并将其用于新的图片车牌吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the category of plate you want allows personalized combinations containing the number of characters on your current plates, you may have the combination on your new custom plates. Most picture plates require a \$31.25 annual personalized fee in addition to the \$31.25 custom plate fee. You must also pay a plate fee for the new plates, but you will get credit for the custom plate fees you already paid on your current registration. 1
source_blocks.text: 如果您想要的车牌类别允许使用当前车牌上的字符数进行个性化组合，您可以在新定制车牌上使用该组合。大多数图片车牌除了31.25美元的定制车牌费外，还需缴纳31.25美元的年度个性化费用。您还必须为新车牌支付车牌费，但您将获得当前注册中已支付的定制车牌费用的抵扣。1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday. 2
source_blocks.text: 请联系定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I transfer a current set of personalized plates to a new vehicle that I plan to purchase?
source_blocks.text: 我可以将当前的一套个性化车牌转让到我计划购买的新车上吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. If the registrant and registration class will not change, instruct the automobile dealer to transfer your personalized plates to your new vehicle. If you purchase the vehicle from a private person, ask the DMV to transfer your personalized plates when you register the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 可以。如果注册人和注册类别不变，请指示汽车经销商将您的个性化车牌转让到您的新车上。如果您从私人处购买车辆，请在注册车辆时请求DMV转让您的个性化车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I remove a vehicle from the road, can I keep my personalized plates?
source_blocks.text: 如果我将车辆停驶，可以保留我的个性化车牌吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can store your personalized plates at most DMV offices. 3
source_blocks.text: 可以。您可以在大多数DMV办公室存放您的个性化车牌。3

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a DMV office. [2]
source_blocks.text: 查找DMV办公室。[2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will receive a receipt (form FS-6T) when you surrender your personalized plates. Verify the information listed on the receipt, and make sure that the receipt displays the words, "Stored at Local Office, and keep this receipt. We will indicate on the registration record that the vehicle plates have been stored.
source_blocks.text: 当您上交个性化车牌时，您将收到一张收据（表格FS-6T）。请核对收据上列出的信息，并确保收据上显示“已存放在当地办公室”字样，并保留此收据。我们将在注册记录上注明车辆车牌已存放。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To register the vehicle again, or to use your stored personalized plates to register another vehicle, you must visit the DMV office that has your vehicle plates. Make sure that you bring the receipt (form FS-6T) and the other documents required to register your vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 要重新注册车辆，或使用您存储的自选车牌为另一辆车注册，您必须前往存放您车辆车牌的DMV办公室。请确保携带收据（表格FS-6T）以及注册车辆所需的其他文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example: You have IMJOE standard series personalized plates, with an annual fee of \$31.25 (\$62.50 per two-year registration). You order IMJOE on a picture plate (e.g., NASCAR, Yankees) and pay the \$62.50 annual custom plate fee (\$125 at the next two-year renewal in addition to other renewal fees), plus plate and document fees. The online custom plate order system cannot give you credit for the custom plate fees you have already paid on your current registration, but the Custom Plates Unit can. The policy to store vehicle plates is different in each office.
source_blocks.text: 例如：您拥有IMJOE标准系列自选车牌，年费为\$31.25（每两年注册费为\$62.50）。您订购带有图片的车牌（如NASCAR、Yankees）上的IMJOE，并支付\$62.50的年自选车牌费（下次两年续期时需支付\$125，另加其他续期费用），以及车牌和文件费用。 在线自选车牌订购系统无法为您当前注册中已支付的自选车牌费用提供抵扣，但自选车牌部门可以。 存储车辆车牌的政策各办公室不同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do it by phone:
source_blocks.text: 通过电话办理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must replace or transfer personalized plates by phone.
source_blocks.text: 您必须通过电话更换或转移自选车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838.
Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.
source_blocks.text: 办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do it by mail:
source_blocks.text: 通过邮件办理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t replace or transfer personalized plates by mail.
source_blocks.text: 您不能通过邮件更换或转移自选车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do it at the DMV:
source_blocks.text: 在DMV办理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t replace or transfer personalized plates at the DMV.
source_blocks.text: 您不能在DMV更换或转移自选车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a DMV regulated automotive business?
source_blocks.text: What is a DMV regulated automotive business?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV regulates all repair shops, inspection stations, dealers, junk and salvage vendors, and other automotive related businesses in New York State. 1
source_blocks.text: The DMV regulates all repair shops, inspection stations, dealers, junk and salvage vendors, and other automotive related businesses in New York State. 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I place a complaint against a DMV regulated automotive business?
source_blocks.text: How do I place a complaint against a DMV regulated automotive business?

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, attempt to resolve the issue with the management of the business. Keep a written record of all contacts with management in addition to details about the inspection, repair, or sale. Copies of work orders and invoices are proof of your attempts to resolve the problem. 2
source_blocks.text: First, attempt to resolve the issue with the management of the business. Keep a written record of all contacts with management in addition to details about the inspection, repair, or sale. Copies of work orders and invoices are proof of your attempts to resolve the problem. 2

To submit electronically, download the complaint report available at the link above to your personal device. Attach and then email the completed report as well as any supporting documents to [email protected] [3]. Please note that DMV staff will communicate with you through email.

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: DMV staff will not investigate a complaint until a completed VS-35 Complaint Report has been received. We cannot accept complaints against Repair Shops beyond the 90-day limit or 3,000 miles (whichever comes first). source_blocks.source_text_en: Requirements and forms for driving schools and instructors
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校和教练的要求与表格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving school
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving school is a commercial business authorized by DMV s Bureau of Driver Training Programs to provide driving instruction for hire, which could include behind-the-wheel driving lessons. DMV issues driving school licenses to those qualified to conduct a driving school business. The license must be clearly displayed at the place of business.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校是经DMV驾驶员培训项目局授权的商业企业，提供有偿驾驶指导，可能包括实际驾驶课程。DMV向符合条件开展驾驶学校业务者颁发驾驶学校许可证。许可证必须清晰展示在营业场所。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Upon meeting certain additional requirements, driving schools may also
source_blocks.text: 在满足某些额外要求后，驾驶学校还可以

source_blocks.source_text_en: provide the DMV approved 5-Hour Pre-licensing Course [1] to individuals who want to obtain a driver license
source_blocks.text: 向希望获得驾驶执照的个人提供DMV批准的5小时预许可课程 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: teach the basic 30-hour instructor's course, now known as the , for driving school instructors
source_blocks.text: 教授驾驶学校教练的基础30小时教练课程，现称为，

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving school instructor
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校教练

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving school instructor is someone who works for a licensed driving school, teaching customers of the school how to drive motor vehicles safely. DMV issues an Instructor Certificate (MV-524) to driving schools for instructors once they are certified to teach for the school. The instructor must carry this certificate at all times while driving instructions are given or when accompanying a driver license applicant to the road test site.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校教练是为持牌驾驶学校工作，教授学校客户如何安全驾驶机动车的人员。DMV向驾驶学校颁发教练证书（MV-524），用于教练获得该校任教资格后。教练在提供驾驶指导或陪同驾驶执照申请人前往路考地点时，必须随身携带此证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Upon meeting certain additional requirements, an instructor may be certified to teach the DMV approved 5-Hour Pre-licensing Course [1] to individuals who want to obtain a driver license.
source_blocks.text: 在满足某些额外要求后，教练可获认证教授DMV批准的5小时预许可课程 [1] 给希望获得驾驶执照的个人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Requirements for driving schools
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校的要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving school must meet several requirements, which are identified in Commissioner s Regulations Part 76 (PDF) [2] and Section 394 of the New York State Vehicle and Traffic Law (PDF) [3], including
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校必须满足多项要求，这些要求载于《专员条例》第76部分（PDF）[2] 和《纽约州车辆与交通法》第394条（PDF）[3]，包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: the driving school must have an approved place of business that consists of - an office that is open to the public, and - at least 50 square feet of space dedicated to the operation of the driving school business - required signage, displayed in plain sight: - driving school license - hours of operation (when the office is open to the public) - a sign that states Applicant must be given a receipt for all payments - acceptable receipts and contracts - acceptable record-keeping
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校必须有经批准的营业场所，包括 - 对公众开放的办公室，以及 - 至少50平方英尺专用于驾驶学校业务运营的空间 - 必须展示的标识，置于显眼处： - 驾驶学校许可证 - 营业时间（办公室对公众开放的时间） - 标明“必须向申请人提供所有付款收据”的标牌 - 可接受的收据和合同 - 可接受的记录保存

source_blocks.source_text_en: the driving school must have at least one certified driving instructor that has at least 1,000 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction experience. See Application for Driving School Instructor Certificate (PDF) [4] (MV-523) for additional information .
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校必须至少有一名持证驾驶教练，且该教练具有至少1,000小时的实际驾驶教学经验。更多信息请参见《驾驶学校教练证书申请表》（PDF）[4]（MV-523）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: if the driving school offers the 5-Hour Pre-licensing Course, the school must have - a DMV-approved classroom (either at the business location or off-site), and - at least one certified driving school instructor that is approved to teach the Pre-Licensing Course.
source_blocks.text: 如果驾驶学校提供5小时预许可课程，学校必须拥有 - DMV批准的教室（位于营业地点或异地），以及 - 至少一名获批准教授预许可课程的持证驾驶学校教练。

source_blocks.source_text_en: all vehicles used for driving instruction or testing must be reported to DMV using a List of Driving School Vehicles (PDF) [5] form (MV-527). Each vehicle must also be equipped with a Student Driver sign, and dual-control brake and rear-view mirrors for the instructor.
source_blocks.text: 所有用于驾驶教学或考试的车辆都必须使用驾驶学校车辆清单（PDF）[5]表格（MV-527）向DMV报告。每辆车还必须配备学生驾驶员标志，以及供教练使用的双控刹车和后视镜。

source_blocks.source_text_en: all employees who are not instructors must be reported to DMV using a Personal History (PDF) [6] form (MV-521.1).
source_blocks.text: 所有非教练的员工必须使用个人历史（PDF）[6]表格（MV-521.1）向DMV报告。

source_blocks.source_text_en: if a driving school instructor is terminated, the driving school must notify DMV using a Driving School Instructor Termination Notice (PDF) [7] form (MV-526).
source_blocks.text: 如果驾驶学校教练被解雇，驾驶学校必须使用驾驶学校教练解雇通知（PDF）[7]表格（MV-526）通知DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: the owner of the driving school must make sure that all advertisements (printed, electronic or otherwise) for the school comply with Section 76.21 of the Commissioner s Regulations (PDF) [2].
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校所有者必须确保学校的所有广告（印刷、电子或其他形式）符合专员条例第76.21条（PDF）[2]的规定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your business is approved as a driving school, DMV may conduct periodical inspections and audits to make sure you are following these requirements. You must also follow all of the rules and regulations of the municipality in which you are operating the driving school business.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的企业被批准为驾驶学校，DMV可能会进行定期检查和审计，以确保您遵守这些要求。您还必须遵守您经营驾驶学校业务所在市政当局的所有规则和条例。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Requirements for driving school instructors
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校教练的要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving school instructor can only be certified when s/he is employed by a licensed driving school. A driving school instructor must meet several requirements, which are identified in Section 76.15 of the Commissioner s Regulations (PDF) [2], including
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校教练只有在受雇于有执照的驾驶学校时才能获得认证。驾驶学校教练必须满足多项要求，这些要求在专员条例第76.15条（PDF）[2]中有所规定，包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: must be at least 21 years of age must have a driver license valid for operation in New York State that: - has been valid for at least 2 years preceding application in the class of vehicle that the instructor intends to teach in, and - has not been suspended or revoked in the last 2 years - shows an acceptable driving record
source_blocks.text: 必须年满21岁 必须持有在纽约州有效驾驶的驾驶执照，该执照： - 在申请前至少2年内，在教练打算教学的车辆类别中有效，并且 - 在过去2年内未被暂停或吊销 - 显示可接受的驾驶记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: must have a high school or high school equivalency diploma must pass the required tests, which include - a vision test - road sign test - written test - driving school instructor driving test
source_blocks.text: 必须拥有高中或高中同等学历文凭 必须通过要求的测试，包括 - 视力测试 - 路标测试 - 笔试 - 驾驶学校教练驾驶测试

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving school instructors must also complete a course in driver training and traffic safety, approved by the commissioner, consisting of at least 30 hours (known as the ) before the first renewal of their instructor certificate. This 30-hour course is taught by various community colleges and driving schools that have been approved by DMV to provide this course.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶学校教练还必须在首次续签教练证书之前完成由专员批准的驾驶员培训和交通安全课程，该课程至少包括30小时（称为）。这门30小时的课程由各个社区学院和经DMV批准提供此课程的驾驶学校教授。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving school instructor who wants to teach the Pre-licensing Course must also successfully complete a 30-hour Teaching Techniques and Methodology course (a college-level course) and have at least one year experience as a behind-the-wheel certified driving school instructor.
source_blocks.text: 想要教授预许可课程的驾驶学校教练还必须成功完成30小时的教学技巧和方法课程（大学水平课程），并且至少有一年作为经过认证的驾驶学校教练进行实际驾驶教学的经验。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For additional information, contact DTP at
source_blocks.text: 如需更多信息，请联系DTP：

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Department of Motor VehiclesBureau of Driver Training Programs6 Empire State Plaza, Room 327Albany, NY 12228(518) 473-7174
source_blocks.text: 纽约州机动车辆管理局驾驶员培训项目局帝国大厦广场6号，327室奥尔巴尼，纽约州12228(518) 473-7174

source_blocks.source_text_en: Only New York state residents need New York State driver licenses
source_blocks.text: Only New York state residents need New York State driver licenses

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.
source_blocks.text: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test.
source_blocks.text: To get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test.

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Non citizens and types of ID
source_blocks.text: Non citizens and types of ID

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York offers three types of ID documents [6]; standard licenses and IDs, Real IDs, and Enhanced licenses and IDs. Non citizens are eligibile for standard IDs and Real IDs. However, only US Citizens are eligibile for Enhanced IDs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Renewing your license
source_blocks.text: Renewing your license

source_blocks.source_text_en: As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your license online, through the mail or in an office.
source_blocks.text: As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your license online, through the mail or in an office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.
source_blocks.text: If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What does 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' mean?
source_blocks.text: What does 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' mean?

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Temporary Visitor is defined as anyone who is not immigrating to or not residing (living) in the United States. These visitors have US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) documentation that supports their legal status in this country.
source_blocks.text: A Temporary Visitor is defined as anyone who is not immigrating to or not residing (living) in the United States. These visitors have US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) documentation that supports their legal status in this country.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have DHS documents that identify you as a Temporary Visitor, your New York State driver license, permit or non-driver ID card will have
source_blocks.text: If you have DHS documents that identify you as a Temporary Visitor, your New York State driver license, permit or non-driver ID card will have

source_blocks.source_text_en: 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' on it, and the expiration date from your DHS document
source_blocks.text: 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' on it, and the expiration date from your DHS document

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note that your DMV document does not expire on the Temporary Visitor expiration date, nor will your privilege to drive in New York.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I have a driver license from another country and I have a NY State learner permit, can I drive without a supervising driver?
source_blocks.text: If I have a driver license from another country and I have a NY State learner permit, can I drive without a supervising driver?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Your valid foreign driver license allows you to drive without a supervising driver. You can drive on any street, road, highway, bridge, or tunnel, except in a DMV road test area.
source_blocks.text: Yes. Your valid foreign driver license allows you to drive without a supervising driver. You can drive on any street, road, highway, bridge, or tunnel, except in a DMV road test area.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your driver license is printed in any language except English, you must bring an International Driving Permit or a certified translation of your driver license to the road test. The translation must be certified by a consulate, the US Department of State, or another official agency. The translation must include

The supervising driver must be age 21 or over and must have a valid driver license to operate the vehicle that you drive.

documents.title: 回复DMV保险信函和命令

source_blocks.source_text_en: Respond to DMV insurance letters and orders
source_blocks.text: 回复DMV保险信函和命令

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received an insurance 'letter' or 'order' from the DMV. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我收到了DMV的保险“信函”或“命令”。我能做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read the letter or order (see a sample [1]) carefully, answer it quickly, and contact your insurance company immediately. If there is a problem, it is your responsibility to resolve it. If you do not, the DMV can suspend your vehicle registration and driver license.
source_blocks.text: 仔细阅读信函或命令（参见示例 [1]），迅速回复，并立即联系您的保险公司。如果有问题，您有责任解决。如果您不这样做，DMV可能会暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do not
source_blocks.text: 不要

source_blocks.source_text_en: use your vehicle if your insurance coverage is cancelled, even if you think it is a mistake keep the plates while you resolve a problem with your insurance company 1
source_blocks.text: 如果您的保险被取消，即使您认为这是个错误，也不要使用您的车辆 在您与保险公司解决问题时，不要保留车牌 1

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do
source_blocks.text: 要

source_blocks.source_text_en: surrender your vehicle registration and plates [2] before your insurance coverage ends
source_blocks.text: 在您的保险覆盖结束前，交出您的车辆注册和车牌 [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I respond to the letter or order?
source_blocks.text: 我如何回复信函或命令？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your response must either
source_blocks.text: 您的回复必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: prove that you have insurance coverage prove that you sold the vehicle prove that insurance coverage was not required
source_blocks.text: 证明您有保险覆盖 证明您出售了车辆 证明不需要保险覆盖

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have insurance coverage, also ask your insurance company (do not ask your agent or broker) to file an electronic notice of insurance coverage with the DMV. 2
source_blocks.text: 如果您有保险覆盖，也请您的保险公司（不要问您的代理人或经纪人）向DMV电子提交保险覆盖通知。 2

source_blocks.source_text_en: What must I do if I don t have liability insurance?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有责任保险，我必须做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have insurance, or if it is about to expire and you don t plan to replace it, you need to surrender your vehicle plates to the DMV [2] immediately. 3
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有保险，或者保险即将到期且您不打算更换，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车牌 [2]。 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received a Letter that states my insurance lapsed. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我收到一封说明我的保险失效的信。我能做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The letter means your insurance company notified the DMV that your insurance coverage ended, and that no other company notified the DMV about new coverage.
source_blocks.text: 这封信意味着您的保险公司通知DMV您的保险覆盖已结束，并且没有其他公司通知DMV关于新的覆盖。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have insurance, follow the instructions in the letter and contact your company or agent about the problem. Ask your company to file a notice of coverage with the DMV electronically.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并联系您的公司或代理人解决问题。请您的公司向DMV电子提交覆盖通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have insurance, you need to surrender your vehicle registration and plates to the DMV immediately.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有保险，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车辆注册和车牌。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received a Letter that states my license is suspended. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我收到一封说明我的驾照被暂停的信。我能做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The letter means your insurance company notified the DMV that your insurance coverage ended, and that no other company notified the DMV about new coverage.
source_blocks.text: 这封信意味着您的保险公司已通知DMV您的保险保障已终止，且没有其他公司就新保障通知DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have insurance, follow the instructions in the letter and contact your company or agent about the problem. Ask your company to file a notice of coverage with the DMV electronically.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并就问题联系您的公司或代理人。请您的公司以电子方式向DMV提交保障通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have insurance, you need to surrender your vehicle registration and plates to the DMV immediately.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有保险，您需要立即将车辆登记和车牌交还给DMV。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driver license becomes suspended when the lapse is 91 days or more or if the time period of the lapse has not yet been determined. To determine the lapse period
source_blocks.text: 当保障中断达到91天或以上，或中断期间尚未确定时，驾驶执照将被吊销。要确定中断期间，

source_blocks.source_text_en: the plates must be surrendered, or the plates must be reported lost/stolen/confiscated, or the registration must expire, or the plates must be transferred to another vehicle by DMV, or DMV must receive proof of new or reinstated insurance, or DMV must receive other acceptable proof
source_blocks.text: 车牌必须交还，或 车牌必须报告为丢失/被盗/被没收，或 登记必须到期，或 车牌必须由DMV转移到另一辆车，或 DMV必须收到新的或恢复的保险证明，或 DMV必须收到其他可接受的证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once the lapse is determined, the registration and, if the lapse period is 91 days or more, your driver license will also be suspended for the same number of days. The suspensions may not be effective on the same date. Therefore, you may serve the suspension on the driver license first or you may serve the suspension on the registration first. The suspension on the driver license will not end until you have paid the suspension termination fee [3] and have served the suspension.
source_blocks.text: 一旦中断期间确定，登记将被暂停，如果中断期间为91天或以上，您的驾驶执照也将被暂停相同天数。暂停可能不在同一日期生效。因此，您可能先执行驾驶执照的暂停，或先执行登记的暂停。驾驶执照的暂停不会结束，直到您支付暂停终止费[3]并执行完暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surrender your plates to the DMV. You can get your registration and new plates when the problem is corrected. Paper proof or e-mail messages are NOT acceptable. Your insurance agent or broker cannot file your proof of insurance electronically. Only your insurance company can file proof of insurance electronically. If you are not going to immediately replace your insurance coverage, you must surrender your plates.
source_blocks.text: 将您的车牌交还给DMV。当问题纠正后，您可以获得您的登记和新车牌。 纸质证明或电子邮件信息不可接受。您的保险代理人或经纪人不能以电子方式提交您的保险证明。只有您的保险公司才能以电子方式提交保险证明。 如果您不打算立即更换您的保险保障，您必须交还您的车牌。

documents.source_title_en: Restore license after revocation
documents.title: 吊销后恢复驾照

source_blocks.source_text_en: Restore license after revocation
source_blocks.text: 吊销后恢复驾照

source_blocks.source_text_en: Restore license after revocation [1]
source_blocks.text: 吊销后恢复驾照 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: As of September 27, 2019, the Driver Improvement Unit is reviewing applications that were received by mail on or before the following dates:
source_blocks.text: 截至2019年9月27日，驾驶员改进部门正在审核于以下日期或之前通过邮件收到的申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Regular Applications (less than 3) - July 18, 2019 Multiple Alcohol Applications (3 or more) - July 22, 2019
source_blocks.text: 常规申请（少于3次）- 2019年7月18日 多次酒驾申请（3次或以上）- 2019年7月22日

source_blocks.source_text_en: A serious traffic offense or multiple offenses can result in the revocation of your NY State driver license or driving privilege. 1 A revocation means your license is cancelled, and you must apply for a new one once the revocation period is over. You may also be required to take the written and driving tests again.
source_blocks.text: 严重交通违规或多次违规可能导致您的纽约州驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销。1 吊销意味着您的驾照被取消，一旦吊销期结束，您必须申请新的驾照。您可能还需要重新参加笔试和路考。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to restore
source_blocks.text: 如何恢复

source_blocks.source_text_en: For most revocations, you must first request and receive approval from the DMV Driver Improvement Unit (DIU) before you can apply for a new driver license at a DMV office. If you are licensed in another state, you must obtain approval from DIU to have your NY State driving privilege restored. DIU must examine your full driver record to see if you can be approved under NY State laws and requirements.
source_blocks.text: 对于大多数吊销情况，您必须先向DMV驾驶员改进部门（DIU）请求并获得批准，然后才能在DMV办公室申请新的驾驶执照。如果您在其他州持有驾照，您必须获得DIU的批准才能恢复您的纽约州驾驶特权。DIU必须审查您的完整驾驶记录，以确定您是否符合纽约州法律和要求获得批准。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online
source_blocks.text: 在线

source_blocks.source_text_en: The fastest and easiest way to request approval is online, although some drivers with complex records may need to submit their request to DIU in writing. Please review all the of the information below before you select the 'MyDMV' button at the bottom of this section to begin the restoration process.
source_blocks.text: 最快、最简单的请求批准方式是在线进行，但一些记录复杂的驾驶员可能需要以书面形式向DIU提交请求。在选择本部分底部的“MyDMV”按钮开始恢复流程之前，请仔细阅读以下所有信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request approval online, the system will
source_blocks.text: 如果您在线请求批准，系统将

source_blocks.source_text_en: automatically determine if you are eligible to submit an online request list the reason you are not eligible and explain your next steps explain any additional payments or actions required before you can receive approval issue your approval immediately if you are eligible (the processing of mailed requests can take up to 12 weeks)
source_blocks.text: 自动确定您是否有资格提交在线请求 列出您不符合资格的原因并说明您的后续步骤 说明在您获得批准之前需要支付的额外款项或采取的行动 如果您符合资格，立即发放批准（邮寄请求的处理可能需要长达12周）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot request approval online if
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，您无法在线请求批准

source_blocks.source_text_en: you were never issued a New York State driver license, learner permit, or non-driver ID 2 your revocation was for an uninsured accident. You must contact the DMV Insurance Services Bureau 3 as part of a reexamination of your ability to safely operate a motor vehicle, you were required to take a DMV road test and your driver license was revoked because you failed the road test, you must contact your local DMV office you have a valid or suspended conditional or restricted license or a current or former participant in the Impaired Driver Program. You must apply at a local Motor Vehicle office when you are eligible to receive your full license back your last full driver license issued was a Commercial Driver License (CDL) your revocation was a result of a conviction arising out of a fatal crash your revocation was a result of a conviction arising out of a Penal Law violation
source_blocks.text: 您从未获得过纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员ID 2 您的吊销是由于未投保事故。您必须联系DMV保险服务局 3 作为对您安全驾驶机动车能力的重新检查的一部分，您被要求参加DMV路考，并且由于您未通过路考而导致驾驶执照被吊销，您必须联系当地的DMV办公室 您持有有效或已暂停的条件性或限制性驾照，或者是受损驾驶员计划的现任或前任参与者。当您有资格获得完整驾照时，您必须在当地机动车办公室申请 您最后签发的完整驾驶执照是商业驾驶执照（CDL） 您的吊销是由于致命事故引发的定罪 您的吊销是由于违反刑法引发的定罪

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you can request approval online, you must
source_blocks.text: 在您在线请求批准之前，您必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: wait until the revocation period has been completely served before you submit your request resolve and clear any suspensions - this includes answering or paying fines imposed for traffic tickets - you cannot receive approval if your license is suspended as well as revoked - to check if your license is suspended, sign up for MyDMV [2] and use our MyLicense service sign up for a MyDMV account [2] - you must have the ID number from your NY State driver license, permit or non driver ID (you do not need to provide your photo document number) - your Social Security Number (SSN) must be on file with the NY State DMV be prepared to pay a re-application fee, if required, by credit or debit card (the system will tell you the amount you must pay)
source_blocks.text: 等到吊销期完全结束后再提交请求 解决并清除所有暂停 - 这包括回答或支付交通罚单所施加的罚款 - 如果您的驾照同时被暂停和吊销，您将无法获得批准 - 要检查您的驾照是否被暂停，请注册MyDMV [2]并使用我们的MyLicense服务 注册MyDMV账户 [2] - 您必须拥有纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID的ID号（您无需提供带照片的文件号码） - 您的社会安全号码（SSN）必须在纽约州DMV备案 准备好通过信用卡或借记卡支付重新申请费（如有需要）（系统将告知您需要支付的金额）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional fees and penalties
source_blocks.text: 额外费用和罚款

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you owe any of the following fines or penalties, they must be paid before you can submit your request
source_blocks.text: 如果您欠以下任何罚款或处罚，必须在提交请求之前支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: suspension termination fee driver license civil penalty driver responsibility assessment
source_blocks.text: 暂停终止费 驾驶执照民事罚款 驾驶员责任评估

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you begin to request approval online and owe additional fees or penalties, you will receive instructions for submitting payment. After you submit payment, you can complete your request for approval online.
source_blocks.text: 如果您开始在线申请批准并欠有额外费用或罚款，您将收到提交付款的说明。提交付款后，您可以完成在线批准申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional requirements
source_blocks.text: 附加要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is required to apply for a new license after revocation online?
source_blocks.text: 撤销后在线申请新驾照需要什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some situations require additional action before you can submit your request for approval. If you submit an application before addressing the items listed below, we will send you an email telling you what you will need to do. We will delay processing your application will be delayed, until the items are taken care of and DMV is notified:
source_blocks.text: 某些情况需要在您提交批准申请前采取额外行动。如果您在解决以下列出的项目之前提交申请，我们将发送电子邮件告知您需要做什么。我们将延迟处理您的申请，直到这些项目得到处理并通知DMV：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your sentence from a court includes serving a term of probation and the conditions include restrictions on reapplying for a license /privilege, you must provide: - A copy of your conditions of probation and a letter granting permission to apply for a driver license from the court that sentenced you or from the probation office that you must report to. The letter must be on court or probation letterhead; or
source_blocks.text: 如果法院判决包括缓刑期，且条件包括对重新申请驾照/特权的限制，您必须提供： - 一份缓刑条件副本，以及由判决您的法院或您需报到的缓刑办公室出具允许申请驾照的信函。信函必须使用法院或缓刑办公室的信头；或

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your probation was terminated, you must provide a letter from the court/probation department on their letterhead, that states the date your probation was terminated; or
source_blocks.text: 如果您的缓刑已终止，您必须提供法院/缓刑部门使用其信头出具的信函，说明缓刑终止日期；或

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the conditions of your probation do not include driving restriction, you must provide a copy of the conditions.Mail or fax this information to DIU at:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的缓刑条件不包括驾驶限制，您必须提供条件副本。请将此信息邮寄或传真至DIU：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5 (Phone Hours: M-F, 8:30 Noon)FAX (518) 474-6208
source_blocks.text: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5 (电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午)传真 (518) 474-6208

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once acceptable documentation is received by DIU, you can complete your request for restoration online. If you have two or more alcohol/drugged driving convictions in 25 years, you are required to complete an alcohol evaluation and or treatment within one year from the date of the final review. Your provider must electronically notify DMV of your successful completion. Paper proof submitted by you will not be accepted. You can find acceptable evaluation and treatment providers within NY State by accessing the NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS) website at www.oasas.ny.gov [3]. Click on the "FIND A PROVIDER" link located in the top box on the right-hand side. Click on the type of program: "Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender" to search for a list of OASAS approved providers of clinical services for impaired driving offenders in your area. You can search for approved providers by county, city or zip code. If you do not have access to the Internet, please call the OASAS HOPE line at 1-877-846-7369. This toll-free line operates 24 a day, seven days a week.When choosing an alcohol or drug evaluation/treatment provider, please be aware that the provider must appear on the listing. A provider will not be accepted unless they have been approved by OASAS. To get on this approval list the provider must contact OASAS at 1-800-482-9564 for instructions.For services provided outside of New York State, the provider must be on the approved list of providers on the Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA) website at https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4]. The provider will need form DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary . They may contact Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228 or by fax at (518) 473-8229, to obtain this form. If you owe any DMV fees (suspension termination fee, civil penalty or Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA)), they must be paid before applying for a license or the processing of your application will be delayed. For information on how to pay DMV fees, visit our website at dmv.ny.gov [5] and select the topic labeled Tickets, Points and Penalties. If you are currently suspended for failing to pay child support, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must contact your local child support collection unit to make a payment and to have the suspension cleared. By law, DMV cannot clear/remove a child support suspension unless directed to do so by the Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA). Once OTDA electronically notifies DMV to clear the suspension, you may continue with submitting your online request for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing your application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you are currently suspended for failing to pay New York State taxes, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must contact the NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] or call (518) 862-6000 to make a payment and to have the suspension cleared. By law, DMV cannot clear a delinquent tax suspension unless directed to do so by DTF. Once DTF electronically notifies DMV to clear the suspension, you may continue with submitting your online request for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing your application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you are currently suspended for failing to file an acceptable accident report with DMV, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must fax a completed Report of Motor Vehicle Accident, (form MV-104) to (518) 474-0718. Once this form is processed, you may continue with submitting your online request for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing your application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you have an open traffic tickets or owe fines to a court, you must contact the court of record. Outstanding tickets need to be addressed and all fines need to be paid before you may apply for a license. Once the court notifies DMV that the tickets have been satisfied, you may continue with submitting your online request for relicensing.
source_blocks.text: 一旦DIU收到可接受的文件，您就可以在线完成恢复申请。 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS)网站 www.oasas.ny.gov [3] 查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗提供者。点击右侧顶部框中的“FIND A PROVIDER”链接。点击项目类型：“Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender”以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索批准的提供者。如果您无法访问互联网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗提供者时，请注意提供者必须出现在列表中。除非提供者已获得OASAS批准，否则将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外的服务，提供者必须位于Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA)网站 https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4] 的批准提供者列表中。提供者将需要表格DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。 如果您欠任何DMV费用（暂停终止费、民事罚款或Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA)），必须在申请驾照前支付，否则您的申请处理将延迟。有关如何支付DMV费用的信息，请访问我们的网站dmv.ny.gov [5] 并选择标有Tickets, Points and Penalties的主题。 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除/移除子女抚养费暂停，除非Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA)指示这样做。一旦OTDA电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] 或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。 如果您目前因未向DMV提交可接受的事故报告而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须将填写完整的Report of Motor Vehicle Accident (表格MV-104)传真至(518) 474-0718。此表格处理后，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Any additional convictions of moving violations or other incidents added to your driving record can make you ineligible for approval or may delay the approval process.
source_blocks.text: 注意：任何额外的驾驶违规定罪或其他添加到您驾驶记录的事件可能使您不符合批准资格或延迟批准过程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you receive approval
source_blocks.text: 获得批准后

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will receive an approval to apply for a new driver license via email. The approval email will contain directions which you must follow to be successful when applying for a new driver license your local DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 您将通过电子邮件收到申请新驾照的批准。批准电子邮件将包含您在当地DMV办公室成功申请新驾照时必须遵循的指示。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are licensed by another state and you receive approval for restoration of your NY State driving privilege via email and you may resume driving in NY State if you have a valid out-of-state driver license.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有其他州的驾照，并且通过电子邮件收到恢复纽约州驾驶特权的批准，那么如果您持有有效的州外驾照，即可恢复在纽约州的驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For revoked NY State driver license holders who were approved for relicensing following a revocation, you cannot drive until your new NY State driver license is issued by a DMV issuing office. You may be required to take vision, written and/or road tests to qualify for a new license.
source_blocks.text: 对于被吊销纽约州驾照且获准在吊销后重新申请驾照的持有人，在DMV发证办公室签发新的纽约州驾照之前，您不能驾驶。您可能需要参加视力、笔试和/或路考才能获得新驾照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request online, you must first create a MyDMV account
source_blocks.text: 如需在线申请，您必须首先创建一个MyDMV账户

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need your
source_blocks.text: 您需要提供您的

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York State Driver License, Permit or Non-Driver ID Social Security Number
source_blocks.text: 纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID 社会安全号码

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is very important that you read the instructions on this page for applying online before you begin.
source_blocks.text: 在开始之前，请务必仔细阅读本页关于在线申请的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄方式

source_blocks.source_text_en: It can take up to 12 weeks for DIU to process a request received by mail. If you request approval by mail, you must wait until 30 days before the revocation period ends to send your request.
source_blocks.text: DIU处理通过邮寄收到的请求可能需要长达12周的时间。如果您通过邮寄方式请求批准，您必须等到吊销期结束前30天才能发送您的请求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to request approval to apply for a new license, you must complete an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card [7] (MV-44). Leave the I am applying for a boxes blank. If you do not know your NY State driver license number, you can leave that box blank. Mail the form to the Driver Improvement Bureau at the address below. If you reside out-of-state and need to request that your NY State driving privilege be restored you must complete the Request for NY State Driving Privileges form [8] (DS-115) and mail to the Driver Improvement Unit at the address below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要请求批准申请新驾照，您必须填写《许可证、驾驶执照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表》[7]（MV-44）。请将“我正在申请”的方框留空。如果您不知道您的纽约州驾驶执照号码，您可以将该方框留空。将表格邮寄至下方地址的Driver Improvement Bureau。 如果您居住在外州，需要请求恢复您的纽约州驾驶特权，您必须填写《纽约州驾驶特权请求表》[8]（DS-115），并邮寄至下方地址的Driver Improvement Unit。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you are convicted of a moving violation or another incident that affects your New York State driving record after you send your request, you may become ineligible for approval or need to wait longer for processing.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您在发送请求后因交通违规或其他影响纽约州驾驶记录的事件而被定罪，您可能不再符合批准条件，或者需要等待更长时间才能处理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Re-application fee
source_blocks.text: 重新申请费

source_blocks.source_text_en: A \$100 re-application fee must accompany your driver license application, Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card [7] (MV-44) or request for reinstatement of driving privileges. The re-application fee may be paid by check or money order made payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.
source_blocks.text: 您的驾驶执照申请、许可证、驾驶执照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表[7]（MV-44）或恢复驾驶特权的请求必须附有\$100的重新申请费。重新申请费可以通过支票或汇票支付，收款人为Commissioner of Motor Vehicles。
