source_blocks.source_text_en: What is required to apply for a new license after revocation?
source_blocks.text: 吊销后申请新驾照需要什么条件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit a completed Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card [7] (MV-44), a non-refundable \$100 fee and any pertinent items below with your application.
source_blocks.text: 您必须提交完整的《许可证、驾照或非驾驶员身份证申请表》[7]（MV-44）、不可退还的\$100费用以及下方任何相关材料。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your sentence from a court includes serving a term of probation and the conditions include restrictions on reapplying for a license /privilege, you must provide: - A copy of your conditions of probation and a letter granting permission to apply for a driver license from the court that sentenced you or from the probation office that you must report to. The letter must be on court or probation letterhead; or - If your probation was terminated, you must provide a letter from the court/probation department. On their letterhead, that states the date your probation was terminated; or - If the conditions of your probation do not include driving restriction, you must provide a copy of the conditions If you have two or more alcohol/drugged driving convictions in 25 years, you are required to complete an alcohol evaluation and or treatment within one year from the date of the final review. Your provider must electronically notify DMV of your successful completion. Paper proof submitted by you will not be accepted. You can find acceptable evaluation and treatment providers within NY State by accessing the NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS) website at www.oasas.ny.gov [3]. Click on the "FIND A PROVIDER" link located in the top box on the right-hand side. Click on the type of program: "Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender" to search for a list of OASAS approved providers of clinical services for impaired driving offenders in your area. You can search for approved providers by county, city or zip code. If you do not have access to the Internet, please call the OASAS HOPE line at 1-877-846-7369. This toll-free line operates 24 a day, seven days a week.When choosing an alcohol or drug evaluation/treatment provider, please be aware that the provider must appear on the listing. A provider will not be accepted unless they have been approved by OASAS. To get on this approval list the provider must contact OASAS at 1-800-482-9564 for instructions.For services provided outside of New York State, the provider must be on the approved list of providers on the Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA) website at https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4]. The provider will need form DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary . They may contact Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228 or by fax at (518) 473-8229, to obtain this form. If you owe any DMV fees (suspension termination fee, civil penalty or Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA)), they must be paid before applying for a license or processing of your application will be delayed. For information on how to pay DMV fees, visit our website at dmv.ny.gov [5] and select the topic labeled Tickets, Points and Penalties. If you are currently suspended for failing to pay child support, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must contact your local child support collection unit to make a payment and to have the suspension cleared. By law, DMV cannot clear a child support suspension unless directed to do so by the Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA). Once OTDA electronically notifies DMV to clear the suspension, you may continue with submitting your application for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you are currently suspended for failing to pay New York State taxes, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must contact the NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] or call (518) 862-6000 to make a payment and to have the suspension cleared. By law, DMV cannot clear a delinquent tax suspension unless directed to do so by DTF. Once DTF electronically notifies DMV to clear the suspension, you may continue with submitting your application for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing of your application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you are currently suspended for failing to file an acceptable accident report with DMV, before you may proceed with applying for a new driver license, you must fax a completed Report of Motor Vehicle Accident, (form MV-104) to (518) 474-0718. Once this form is processed, you may continue with submitting your application for relicensing. Failure to follow these directions will delay the processing of your application for relicensing due to open suspension(s) on your record. If you have an open traffic tickets or owe fines to a court, you must contact the court of record. Outstanding tickets need to be addressed and all fines need to be paid before you may apply for a license. Once the court notifies DMV that the tickets have been satisfied, you may continue with submitting your application for relicensing.
source_blocks.text: 如果法院判决中包含缓刑期，且缓刑条件包括对重新申请驾照/驾驶特权的限制，您必须提供： - 一份缓刑条件副本，以及由判决法院或您需报到的缓刑办公室出具的允许申请驾照的信函。信函必须使用法院或缓刑部门的信笺抬头；或 - 如果您的缓刑已终止，您必须提供法院/缓刑部门出具的信函，使用其信笺抬头，注明缓刑终止日期；或 - 如果您的缓刑条件不包含驾驶限制，您必须提供缓刑条件副本。 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的服务提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问纽约州酗酒和药物滥用服务办公室（OASAS）网站www.oasas.ny.gov [3]查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗服务提供者。点击右侧顶部方框中的“查找服务提供者”链接。点击项目类型：“为酒驾罪犯提供临床筛查和评估服务的提供者”，以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索经批准的服务提供者。如果您无法上网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天候24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗服务提供者时，请注意该服务提供者必须出现在列表中。除非经OASAS批准，否则服务提供者将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，服务提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外提供的服务，服务提供者必须出现在药物滥用与精神健康服务管理局（SAMHSA）网站https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4]的批准服务提供者列表中。服务提供者需要表格DS-449《酒精和药物滥用康复项目摘要》。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。 如果您欠任何DMV费用（暂停终止费、民事罚款或驾驶员责任评估（DRA）），必须在申请驾照前支付，否则您的申请处理将延迟。有关如何支付DMV费用的信息，请访问我们的网站dmv.ny.gov [5]并选择标有“罚单、积分和罚款”的主题。 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能解除子女抚养费暂停，除非临时残疾援助办公室（OTDA）指示这样做。一旦OTDA通过电子方式通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系纽约州税务和财政局（DTF）[6]或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能解除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF通过电子方式通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。 如果您目前因未向DMV提交可接受的事故报告而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须将填写完整的《机动车事故报告》（表格MV-104）传真至(518) 474-0718。此表格处理后，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理完毕，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。

source_blocks.text: 将您的申请、\$100重新申请费（支票或汇票，收款人为机动车管理局局长）以及法院/缓刑文件（如适用）邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Driver Improvement Unit (DIU) will make a determination based on your lifetime driving record, and a response will be mailed to you. The response will include instructions about your next steps. Those instructions are also outlined below whether your application is denied or approved.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶员改进部门（DIU）将根据您的终身驾驶记录做出决定，并将回复邮寄给您。回复将包含关于您下一步操作的说明。无论您的申请被拒绝还是批准，这些说明也将在下方概述。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: Motorists who have previously held a learner permit, driver license from another state or jurisdiction or who have had convictions /incidents of alcohol/drugged driving in another state or jurisdiction, will be sent an additional form to complete. This form must be completed and returned to the Driver Improvement Unit before a final review can be completed.
source_blocks.text: 注意：以前持有其他州或司法管辖区的学习驾照、驾照，或在其他州或司法管辖区有酒驾/毒驾定罪/事故的驾驶员，将被发送额外表格填写。此表格必须填写并返回驾驶员改进部门，才能完成最终审查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if my driver license application is denied by DIU?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的驾照申请被DIU拒绝会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the following four options (these options are also printed on denial letters issued by DIU):
source_blocks.text: 您有以下四个选项（这些选项也印在DIU发出的拒绝信上）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Accept the denial and take no further action. If there is a date printed on your denial letter that advises when you may reapply, you may submit a reapplication up to 60 days before that date.
source_blocks.text: 接受拒绝决定，不再采取进一步行动。如果您的拒绝信上印有建议您可重新申请的日期，您可在该日期前最多60天内提交重新申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request reconsideration of the denial by submitting the Request For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial form included as part of your denial letter to:
source_blocks.text: 通过提交随拒绝信附上的Request For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial表格，请求对拒绝决定进行复议，寄送至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5 (Phone Hours: M-F, 8:30 Noon)FAX (518) 474-6208
source_blocks.text: Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option #5（电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午）传真：(518) 474-6208

source_blocks.source_text_en: within sixty (60) days of the date of your denial letter. If you select this option please read and follow the directions below as you may submit all your unusual, extenuating and compelling circumstances only once per relicensing application. Please note that unusual, extenuating and compelling circumstances must meet all three criteria to be successful.IF, you have unusual, extenuating and compelling circumstances that you believe would form a valid basis for the Department to deviate from the general revocation policy and justify approval of your driver license application:
source_blocks.text: 在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内提交。如果您选择此选项，请阅读并遵循以下指示，因为您每次重新申请驾照时，仅有一次机会提交所有不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况。请注意，不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况必须同时满足所有三个标准才能成功。如果您认为存在不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况，可作为Department偏离一般吊销政策并批准您驾照申请的合理依据：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must explain in detail each circumstance; You must provide credible, verifiable documentation to support all circumstances claimed. For example, if you need a license to drive yourself or a family member to necessary medical treatment, you must provide documentation verifying and explaining the nature of the medical condition, the need to attend necessary appointments related to the condition or treatment and proving there is no other transportation (including affordable private and public transportation) that may be used to get to the medical appointments.Credible, verifiable documentation is documentation from a third party (not a relative) that supports your claim. Some examples are: letter/statement supporting your claims from your physician, employer, religious official, government official, professors, counselors, public transportation schedules, routes and/or maps, receipts, medical bill, appointment schedules, etc.If you do not provide credible, verifiable documentation for each circumstance claimed, your request will be denied.Please note: unusual, extenuating and compelling circumstances alone do not warrant granting an approval. If your driving history is indicative of a continued risk to highway safety, your application for relicensing may not be approved even with extenuating circumstances. Requests For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial sent to the Driver Improvement Bureau must include any documentation that was submitted with your initial application regarding unusual, extenuating, and compelling circumstances. If the letter to the Driver Improvement Bureau is late, it will not be considered, and the denial you received will be final. Your request/letter must be submitted to the Driver Improvement Bureau within sixty (60) days of the date of your denial letter. If it is received after the 60 days it will be rejected.
source_blocks.text: 您必须详细解释每种情况； 您必须提供可信、可验证的文件来支持所有声称的情况。例如，如果您需要驾照以便自己或家人前往必要的医疗治疗，您必须提供文件来验证并解释医疗状况的性质、参加与该状况或治疗相关的必要预约的需求，并证明没有其他交通方式（包括负担得起的私人及公共交通）可用于前往医疗预约。可信、可验证的文件是指来自第三方（非亲属）的支持您主张的文件。一些例子包括：来自您的医生、雇主、宗教官员、政府官员、教授、顾问的支持信/声明、公共交通时刻表、路线和/或地图、收据、医疗账单、预约时间表等。如果您未为每种声称的情况提供可信、可验证的文件，您的请求将被拒绝。请注意：不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况本身并不保证批准。如果您的驾驶记录表明您对高速公路安全构成持续风险，即使有可谅解的情况，您的重新申请也可能不被批准。 寄往Driver Improvement Bureau的Request For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial必须包含您初次申请时提交的关于不寻常、可谅解且令人信服情况的任何文件。 如果致Driver Improvement Bureau的信函逾期，将不予考虑，您收到的拒绝决定将成为最终决定。您的请求/信函必须在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内提交至Driver Improvement Bureau。如果在60天后收到，将被拒绝。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Submit an appeal of your revocation to the DMV appeals board. To submit an appeal, mail the appeal form [12], appeal and a copy of your denial letter to the DMV Appeals Board within sixty (60) days of the date of your denial letter. If it is received after the 60 days, your appeal request will be rejected. - By law, the Appeals Board cannot consider an appeal that is filed after 60 days. It also cannot review any arguments or claims that you have not first submitted to the Driver Improvement Bureau. Do not submit claims of unusual, extenuating and compelling circumstances to the Appeals Board. Submit another application for re-livcensure to the Driver Improvement UnitAlthough you may submit an application for a new driver license at any time, please be aware the Driver Improvement Unit will review your entire driving history based upon the same standards that resulted in the previous denial. Each application is also subject to the statutory \$100 fee. You may submit additional applications to the address mentioned above.
source_blocks.text: 向DMV上诉委员会提交对撤销的上诉。要提交上诉，请在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内，将上诉表格[12]、上诉书及拒绝信副本邮寄至DMV上诉委员会。如果在60天后收到，您的上诉请求将被拒绝。 - 根据法律，上诉委员会不能考虑超过60天提交的上诉。它也不能审查您未首先提交给Driver Improvement Bureau的任何论点或主张。不要向上诉委员会提交关于异常、可减轻处罚和令人信服的情况的主张。 向Driver Improvement Unit提交另一份重新许可申请。虽然您可以随时提交新驾驶执照的申请，但请注意，Driver Improvement Unit将根据导致先前拒绝的相同标准审查您的整个驾驶历史。每份申请还需缴纳法定的100美元费用。您可以向上述地址提交额外的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if my driver license application is approved by the DIU?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的驾驶执照申请被DIU批准会怎样？

source_blocks.source_text_en: For revoked NY State driver license holders who were approved for relicensing following a revocation, you cannot drive until your new NY State driver license is issued by a DMV issuing office.
source_blocks.text: 对于被撤销纽约州驾驶执照的持有人，如果在撤销后获准重新许可，您不能驾驶，直到新的纽约州驾驶执照由DMV发证办公室签发。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will receive an approval packet from the Driver Improvement Unit. This packet contains instructions specific to you. Follow the instructions to apply for your new driver license. Depending on your NY State driver license record you may be approved with a Problem Driver Restriction and an Ignition Interlock Device (IID). You may be required to install and maintain an Ignition Interlock Device on any, and all vehicles you own or operate prior to going to your local motor vehicles office to apply for your permit/license.
source_blocks.text: 您将收到来自Driver Improvement Unit的批准包。此包包含针对您的具体说明。按照说明申请您的新驾驶执照。根据您的纽约州驾驶执照记录，您可能会在Problem Driver Restriction和Ignition Interlock Device (IID)条件下获得批准。在前往当地机动车办公室申请许可证/执照之前，您可能需要在您拥有或操作的所有车辆上安装并维护Ignition Interlock Device。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For information about how to obtain an ignition interlock device and have it installed, please visit http://www.criminaljustice.ny.gov/opca/ignition.htm [13] . In the center of the page you will find tabs for Forms, Regulations/Laws, Manufacturers/Vendors and Interlock Devices. Select the Manufacturers/Vendors tab for information regarding manufacturers and installers and select the Interlock Devices tab for available models and fees.
source_blocks.text: 有关如何获取点火联锁装置并安装的信息，请访问http://www.criminaljustice.ny.gov/opca/ignition.htm [13]。页面中央有Forms、Regulations/Laws、Manufacturers/Vendors和Interlock Devices选项卡。选择Manufacturers/Vendors选项卡以获取有关制造商和安装商的信息，选择Interlock Devices选项卡以获取可用型号和费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you have the ignition interlock device installed, you are required to bring all of the following items from the approval packet you receive from Driver Improvement to any local Motor Vehicles Office in order to apply for your permit/license:
source_blocks.text: 在安装点火联锁装置后，您需要携带来自Driver Improvement的批准包中的以下所有物品到任何当地机动车办公室申请许可证/执照：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The approval notice The Application for Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (Form MV-44) The completed Department of Motor Vehicles Ordered Interlock Device Installation Confirmation Proof of name and date-of-birth Social Security Card
source_blocks.text: 批准通知 驾驶执照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表（表格MV-44） 已填写的Department of Motor Vehicles Ordered Interlock Device Installation Confirmation 姓名和出生日期证明 社会保障卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: The problem driver restriction and ignition interlock device is required under the authority contained in section 3.2(4) (c) of the Regulations of the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. You are required to install and maintain an Ignition Interlock Device for a period of five years in all motor vehicles that you own or operate. After you are relicensed, you may not drive any vehicle that does not have the interlock device installed except during the hours of employment, and only if your occupation requires the operation of a motor vehicle. Your employer must provide you with signed documentation, on company letterhead, saying they have knowledge of the ignition interlock restriction. The letter must also give you permission to operate the vehicle for business purposes without the device. You must carry this documentation with you when operating the employer s vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 问题驾驶员限制和点火联锁装置是根据《机动车管理局专员条例》第3.2(4)(c)条的授权而要求的。您需要在自己拥有或操作的所有机动车上安装并维护点火联锁装置，为期五年。在重新获得驾照后，除就业时间内且仅当您的职业要求操作机动车时，您不得驾驶任何未安装联锁装置的车辆。您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers with an A2 Problem Driver restriction may operate a vehicle only under the following restrictions:
source_blocks.text: 具有A2问题驾驶员限制的驾驶员只能在以下限制下操作车辆：

source_blocks.source_text_en: To and from place of employment or education; during the course of employment or education, when required. If you are driving for employment, your employer must provide you with signed documentation, on company letterhead, saying they have knowledge of the ignition interlock restriction. The letter must also give you permission to operate the vehicle for business purposes without the device. You must carry this documentation with you when operating the employer s vehicle. To and from a medical appointment which is part of a necessary medical treatment for you or a member of your household. You may be required to provide a written statement from your licensed medical practitioner that verifies such travel. To and from DMV offices in conjunction with the amendment of your driver's license with the problem driver restriction. To and from a place including a school, at which the child or children are cared for on a regular basis and which is necessary for the holder to maintain such holder's employment. Enrollment at an accredited school, college or university or a State-approved institution of vocational or technical training.
source_blocks.text: 往返于工作或教育场所；在工作或教育期间，如有需要。如果您因工作而驾驶，您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。 往返于为您或您的家庭成员进行必要医疗治疗的医疗预约。您可能需要提供持照医疗从业者的书面声明，以验证此类出行。 往返于DMV办公室，以修改带有问题驾驶员限制的驾驶执照。 往返于一个地方，包括学校，孩子定期在那里得到照顾，并且这对于持有人维持其就业是必要的。 在认可的学校、学院或大学或州批准的职业技术培训机构注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These restrictions will remain in effect for a period of five years from the issuance of the document. Should you incur any violations/convictions, the approval may be withdrawn and favorable consideration may not be given to any future request for restoration of your New York State Driver license.
source_blocks.text: 这些限制将从文件签发之日起持续五年。如果您有任何违规/定罪，批准可能会被撤销，并且可能不会对您恢复纽约州驾驶执照的任何未来请求给予有利考虑。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are licensed by another state and you receive approval for restoration of your NY State driving privilege, you may resume driving in NY State if you have a valid out-of-state driver license.
source_blocks.text: 如果您由其他州颁发驾照，并且您获得恢复纽约州驾驶特权的批准，如果您持有有效的州外驾驶执照，您可以恢复在纽约州的驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Regardless if you are applying for a NY State driver license or driving privilege, any additional convictions of moving violations or other incidents added to your driving record can make you ineligible for approval or may delay the approval process.
source_blocks.text: 注意：无论您是申请纽约州驾驶执照还是驾驶特权，任何额外的移动违规或其他事件添加到您的驾驶记录中，都可能使您不符合批准条件或可能延迟批准过程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving privilege means that out-of-state drivers are allowed to drive a motor vehicle in New York State. A driving privilege can be suspended or revoked for the same reasons as are New York State driver licenses and carries the same penalties as driving with a suspended or revoked license.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶特权是指州外驾驶员被允许在纽约州驾驶机动车。驾驶特权可能因与纽约州驾驶执照相同的原因而被暂停或撤销，并承担与无照或吊销驾照驾驶相同的处罚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need to request approval by mail.
source_blocks.text: 您需要通过邮件请求批准。

documents.title: 销售税信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sales tax information
source_blocks.text: 销售税信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of sales tax payment or sales tax exemption, or purchase price
source_blocks.text: 销售税支付或销售税豁免证明，或购买价格

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you register a vehicle in New York (at a DMV office), you must either
source_blocks.text: 当您在纽约（在DMV办公室）注册车辆时，您必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: pay the sales tax prove that sales tax was paid prove your vehicle registration is exempt from sales tax
source_blocks.text: 支付销售税 证明销售税已支付 证明您的车辆注册免于销售税

source_blocks.source_text_en: You probably also will need to pay county use tax when you register. See estimate registration fees and taxes [1] for information about county use taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您可能还需要在注册时缴纳县使用税。参见估算注册费和税费 [1] 了解县使用税的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must get a sales tax receipt from the DMV even if the transaction is exempt from sales tax.
source_blocks.text: 即使交易免于销售税，您也必须从DMV获得销售税收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here are specific instructions
source_blocks.text: 以下是具体说明

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the name on the NY State Title Certificate will not change, sales tax forms and proofs are not required. See information below if you were not a NY State resident when you purchased the vehicle. If you bought the vehicle from a NY State automobile dealer or an out-of-state dealer that is authorized to collect NY State sales tax, bring the dealer's bill of sale that shows that you paid NY State sales tax. Also bring a Dealer s Bill of Sale (MV-50) (NY State dealer only) or a completed Sales Tax Exemption {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-803) (for an out-of-state dealer). If NY State sales tax was paid to a NY State dealer, the DMV does not collect sales tax when you apply for a vehicle registration, and the DMV does not issue a sales tax receipt. If you bought your vehicle from another person in a private sale, both you (the buyer) and the seller must complete the Statement of Transaction {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [3] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802). Bring the form to a DMV office. The DMV calculates and collects the sales tax, and issues a sales tax receipt. If you leased the vehicle, see register a leased vehicle [4]. If the vehicle was a gift or was purchased from a family member, use the Statement of Transaction {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [3] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802) to receive a sales tax exemption. If you paid out-of-state sales tax, show the out-of-state dealer bill of sale. The bill of sale must show the purchase price and the amount of out-of-state sales tax paid to the dealer. Use Sales Tax Paid in Another State {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [5] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-804) form to claim credit for the state and local sales taxes you paid in the other state. This process can reduce the amount of your NY State sales tax if NY State and the other state have an agreement about sales tax. Not all states have an agreement with New York. See DTF-804 page 2. If you were not a resident of New York when the vehicle was purchased, use form Sales Tax Exemption {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-803) to receive a non-resident exemption from NY State sales tax. Form DTF-803 defines the terms "non-resident" and "resident". If you are a member of the U.S. Armed Forces and you do not reside in New York, you can defer your sales tax payment. Complete form Sales Tax Exemption {Sales Tax Form} (pdf) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-803) if - you are a NY State resident - you are now a member of the U.S. Armed Forces - you do not now reside in NY State or keep a residence in NY State
source_blocks.text: 如果纽约州所有权证书上的姓名不会改变，则不需要销售税表格和证明。如果您在购买车辆时不是纽约州居民，请参见下面的信息。 如果您从纽约州汽车经销商或经授权收取纽约州销售税的州外经销商处购买车辆，请携带显示您已支付纽约州销售税的经销商销售单。同时携带经销商销售单（MV-50）（仅限纽约州经销商）或填妥的销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-803）（适用于州外经销商）。如果纽约州销售税已支付给纽约州经销商，DMV在您申请车辆注册时不会收取销售税，并且DMV不会签发销售税收据。 如果您在私人交易中从他人处购买车辆，您（买方）和卖方都必须填写交易声明 {销售税表格} (pdf) [3] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-802）。将表格带到DMV办公室。DMV计算并收取销售税，并签发销售税收据。 如果您租赁车辆，请参见注册租赁车辆 [4]。 如果车辆是礼物或从家庭成员处购买，请使用交易声明 {销售税表格} (pdf) [3] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-802）以获得销售税豁免。 如果您支付了州外销售税，请出示州外经销商的销售单。销售单必须显示购买价格和支付给经销商的州外销售税金额。使用在其他州支付的销售税 {销售税表格} (pdf) [5] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-804）表格来申请您在其他州支付的州和地方销售税的抵免。如果纽约州和其他州有关于销售税的协议，此过程可以减少您的纽约州销售税金额。并非所有州都与纽约有协议。参见DTF-804第2页。 如果您在购买车辆时不是纽约州居民，请使用销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-803）表格以获得纽约州销售税的非居民豁免。DTF-803表格定义了“非居民”和“居民”的术语。 如果您是美国武装部队成员且不居住在纽约，您可以推迟缴纳销售税。如果您符合以下条件，请填写销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-803）表格 - 您是纽约州居民 - 您现在是美国武装部队成员 - 您现在不居住在纽约州或在纽约州没有住所

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Sales Tax Exemption (DTF-803) form provides information and the definitions to defer your sales tax. You must pay the sales tax when you leave the Armed Forces or you return to New York.
source_blocks.text: 销售税豁免（DTF-803）表格提供了推迟缴纳销售税的信息和定义。当您离开武装部队或返回纽约时，您必须缴纳销售税。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where can I get more information about sales tax?
source_blocks.text: 我在哪里可以获得更多关于销售税的信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information, visit the NY State Department of Taxation and Finance website [6].
source_blocks.text: 欲了解更多信息，请访问纽约州税务和财政局网站 [6]。

documents.source_title_en: Sharing your information
documents.title: 分享您的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sharing your information
source_blocks.text: 分享您的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does DMV sell driver license and vehicle information to others?
source_blocks.text: DMV 是否向他人出售驾驶执照和车辆信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. DMV makes driver license and vehicle registration information available for a fee using three methods: contract sales, pay-per-search and over-the-counter.
source_blocks.text: 是的。DMV 通过三种方式有偿提供驾驶执照和车辆注册信息：合同销售（contract sales）、按次搜索（pay-per-search）和柜台服务（over-the-counter）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone who accesses DMV information must comply with the federal Driver s Privacy Protection Act [1] (DPPA). The DPPA was enacted by Congress after a careful debate about why states should be allowed to share DMV data. The DPPA prohibits states from disclosing a driver s personal information to anyone who does not have what the DPPA considers a permissible use.
source_blocks.text: 任何访问 DMV 信息的人都必须遵守联邦《驾驶员隐私保护法》[1]（DPPA）。国会在经过仔细辩论后制定了 DPPA，讨论为何应允许各州共享 DMV 数据。DPPA 禁止各州向任何不符合 DPPA 所认为的允许用途的人披露驾驶员的个人信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DPPA defines personal information as an individual s photograph, social security number, driver identification number, name, address, telephone number and medical information. Information on crashes, driving violations, and driver's status is not considered personal information.
source_blocks.text: DPPA 将个人信息定义为个人的照片、社会安全号码、驾驶员识别号码、姓名、地址、电话号码和医疗信息。事故、驾驶违规和驾驶员状态的信息不被视为个人信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social security numbers are sold.
source_blocks.text: 社会安全号码会被出售。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contract Sales
source_blocks.text: 合同销售（Contract Sales）

source_blocks.source_text_en: In accordance with the federal DPPA and NY State law, DMV sells registration and vehicle data through an open procurement process every two years. The successful bidders cannot use DMV information for any purposes other than those in connection with the issuance of a manufacturer s warranty, safety recall or similar notices important things that keep the public safe. The data can be used for statistical compilations and analysis, which do not contain any personal, identifying information.
source_blocks.text: 根据联邦 DPPA 和纽约州法律，DMV 每两年通过公开采购流程出售注册和车辆数据。中标者不得将 DMV 信息用于除与制造商保修、安全召回或类似重要通知（保障公众安全）相关的任何其他目的。数据可用于统计汇编和分析，但不得包含任何个人身份信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV does not permit successful bidders to use the data for surveys, marketing, or solicitations.
source_blocks.text: DMV 不允许中标者将数据用于调查、营销或招揽。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV collects approximately \$2.2 million per year from contract sales.
source_blocks.text: DMV 每年从合同销售中收取约 \$220 万。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay-Per-Search
source_blocks.text: 按次搜索（Pay-Per-Search）

source_blocks.source_text_en: To access DMV data for legitimate DPPA purposes DMV offers a pay-per-search service. In accordance with NY State law, anyone requesting access using this method must apply to DMV and sign an agreement identifying their permissible use under the DPPA. Upon verification and approval of their application, a search account is established for the requestor. The majority of search account holders are insurance companies, who must rate and monitor drivers, and investigate claims, and employers who are required to monitor their employees driving records. Each search costs \$7 and is logged by DMV. Search account holders must have a DPPA permissible use for every search performed, and DMV monitors their compliance through an audit program.
source_blocks.text: 为了合法 DPPA 目的访问 DMV 数据，DMV 提供按次搜索服务。根据纽约州法律，任何使用此方法请求访问的人都必须向 DMV 申请并签署协议，明确其在 DPPA 下的允许用途。在申请经过验证和批准后，将为请求者建立搜索账户。大多数搜索账户持有者是保险公司（必须对驾驶员进行评级和监控，并调查索赔）以及需要监控员工驾驶记录的雇主。每次搜索费用为 \$7，并由 DMV 记录。搜索账户持有者必须对每次搜索都有 DPPA 允许用途，DMV 通过审计计划监控其合规性。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV collects approximately \$58 million per year from pay-per-search sales.
source_blocks.text: DMV 每年从按次搜索销售中收取约 \$5800 万。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Over-the-counter
source_blocks.text: 柜台服务（Over-the-counter）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone can visit a State or County DMV office to purchase a driver license record as long as the requestor provides sufficient and specific information that identifies one and only one record, and provides a DPPA permissible use. Each over-the-counter search is \$10.
source_blocks.text: 任何人都可以访问州或县 DMV 办公室购买驾驶执照记录，只要请求者提供足够且具体的信息以识别唯一一份记录，并提供 DPPA 允许用途。每次柜台搜索费用为 \$10。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV collects approximately \$3.0 million per year from over-the-counter sales.
source_blocks.text: DMV 每年从柜台销售中收取约 \$300 万。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The benefits of sharing DMV information
source_blocks.text: 共享 DMV 信息的好处

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV information shared with bus companies, employers, insurance companies, researchers, and motor vehicle manufacturers, through each of the three sharing methods, makes our lives safer and more convenient. If this information were not made available traffic safety and commerce would be negatively impacted. A few examples of how DMV s information sharing programs benefit all of us are provided below.
source_blocks.text: 通过三种共享方式与公交公司、雇主、保险公司、研究人员和汽车制造商共享的 DMV 信息，使我们的生活更安全、更便捷。如果这些信息不可用，交通安全和商业将受到负面影响。以下提供了一些 DMV 信息共享计划如何惠及我们所有人的示例。

source_blocks.source_text_en: School Bus Drivers
source_blocks.text: 校车司机

source_blocks.source_text_en: School districts and private school bus companies are required to know about their drivers driving history before they hire them to transport children and other passengers. Access to DMV information enables school bus companies to make informed decisions about whom to hire. Once hired, DMV requires bus operators to conduct regular searches of their drivers records to confirm nothing negative happens during their employment that would impact their ability to safely continue to drive school buses.
source_blocks.text: 学区及私立校车公司在雇用司机接送儿童及其他乘客之前，必须了解司机的驾驶历史。访问DMV信息使校车公司能够就雇用何人做出明智决定。一旦雇用，DMV要求巴士运营商定期查询其司机记录，以确认在其任职期间没有发生任何可能影响其安全驾驶校车能力的负面事件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hazardous Materials Drivers
source_blocks.text: 危险品运输司机

source_blocks.source_text_en: This same scenario applies to businesses transporting hazardous materials. All of us want to know the driver of a vehicle hauling dangerous materials is qualified to drive, properly trained, and possesses a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL). NY State laws require hazardous material companies to only hire and employ drivers who are qualified and have valid licenses. Employers must regularly obtain their employees license records from DMV.
source_blocks.text: 同样的情形也适用于运输危险品的企业。我们所有人都希望运输危险材料的车辆司机具备驾驶资格、受过适当培训，并持有有效的商业驾驶执照（CDL）。纽约州法律规定，危险品公司只能雇用和聘用合格且持有有效执照的司机。雇主必须定期从DMV获取其员工的驾驶记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Insurance Companies
source_blocks.text: 保险公司

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you are shopping for automobile insurance on-line, you expect a rate quote within minutes. Insurance companies are able to provide this convenient service because they have direct pay-per-search access to DMV information. They check your driving history to issue an immediate rate quote. If companies could not conduct these searches, insurance companies would require you to purchase your driver record and send it to them before issuing you a quote. This practice would make it more difficult for customers to shop for affordable rates, and could increase the potential for fraudulently altered or unreliable driver records.
source_blocks.text: 当您在线购买汽车保险时，您期望在几分钟内获得费率报价。保险公司之所以能提供这种便捷服务，是因为他们可以直接按次付费访问DMV信息。他们检查您的驾驶历史以立即给出费率报价。如果公司无法进行这些查询，保险公司将要求您购买自己的驾驶记录并发送给他们，然后才能为您提供报价。这种做法将使客户更难购买到实惠的费率，并可能增加欺诈性篡改或不可靠驾驶记录的可能性。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers
source_blocks.text: 汽车制造商

source_blocks.source_text_en: Purchasing a used car does not automatically register you as an owner of that vehicle with the manufacturer. Manufacturers rely on DMV s contract sales program to find and notify current owners of vehicles affected by safety recalls. Recalls do not only jeopardize the safety of the owner/operator of the affected vehicle, they could also affect the safety of every other person sharing the road with that potentially unsafe vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 购买二手车并不会自动在制造商处将您登记为该车的车主。制造商依赖DMV的合同销售计划来查找并通知受安全召回影响的车辆的当前车主。召回不仅危及受影响车辆车主/驾驶者的安全，还可能影响与该潜在不安全车辆共享道路的其他所有人的安全。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These are just a few examples of how DMV s information sharing programs are critical to improving public safety and making everyone s life more convenient.
source_blocks.text: 这些只是DMV信息共享计划如何对改善公共安全和使每个人的生活更加便利至关重要的几个例子。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why am I redirected to the 'Welcome to MyDMV' page?
source_blocks.text: 为什么我会被重定向到“欢迎来到 MyDMV”页面？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The username you used to sign in is not associated with your MyDMV account.
source_blocks.text: 您用于登录的用户名与您的 MyDMV 账户不关联。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To solve this issue:
source_blocks.text: 要解决此问题：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use this link to clear out your sign in information from our system [2]. This will stop you from being redirected to the Welcome to MyDMV page. Then, - If you created a MyDMV account before, go to the to use the Forgot your Username tool to get a list of all of your NY.gov ID Usernames. If you have more than one email address, be sure to check all of them. Sign in with the Username you created for MyDMV. If you don't remember the password you can use the Forgot your Password tool on the same page. - If you never created a MyDMV account before, use the sign up link.
source_blocks.text: 使用此链接清除您在我们系统中的登录信息 [2]。这将阻止您被重定向到“欢迎来到 MyDMV”页面。 然后， - 如果您之前创建过 MyDMV 账户，请前往使用“忘记用户名”工具获取您所有 NY.gov ID 用户名的列表。如果您有多个电子邮件地址，请务必检查所有地址。使用您为 MyDMV 创建的用户名登录。如果您不记得密码，可以在同一页面上使用“忘记密码”工具。 - 如果您从未创建过 MyDMV 账户，请使用注册链接。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact us [3] if you continue to experience problems signing in to MyDMV after following these instructions.
source_blocks.text: 如果您按照这些说明操作后仍然无法登录 MyDMV，请联系我们 [3]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I forgot my NY.gov username and/or password. What can I do?
source_blocks.text: 我忘记了 NY.gov 用户名和/或密码。我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use the tool to have your username (your username might be your email address) emailed to you. You will need to enter your name and email address. If you have more than one email address, use the tool for each address to make sure you retrieve your username for MyDMV.
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用该工具将您的用户名（您的用户名可能是您的电子邮件地址）发送到您的邮箱。您需要输入您的姓名和电子邮件地址。如果您有多个电子邮件地址，请对每个地址使用该工具，以确保您找回用于 MyDMV 的用户名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use the tool to reset it. You will need to enter your username and the security questions/answers (Shared Secrets) you chose when you created your account.
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用该工具重置密码。您需要输入您的用户名以及您在创建账户时选择的安全问题和答案（共享机密）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I sign in to MyDMV using my NY.Gov business or employee account?
source_blocks.text: 我可以使用我的 NY.gov 企业或员工账户登录 MyDMV 吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. New York State keeps your personal identity separate from your government employee or business partner identity. You will need to create a personal account with a different username than the one you use for work.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。纽约州将您的个人身份与您的政府员工或商业伙伴身份分开。您需要使用与工作不同的用户名创建一个个人账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Stolen and recovered vehicles
source_blocks.text: 被盗及找回车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: Stolen vehicles
source_blocks.text: 被盗车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle is stolen, report it to the police and your auto insurance company as soon as possible. The police will enter the information into national and state auto theft computer records. The theft will be noted on your vehicle title record to help prevent someone from selling the vehicle or applying for a title.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆被盗，请尽快向警方和您的汽车保险公司报案。警方会将信息录入国家和州的汽车盗窃计算机记录中。该盗窃记录会标注在您的车辆所有权证书记录上，以防止有人出售该车辆或申请所有权证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I report stolen plates?
source_blocks.text: 如何报告被盗车牌？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask the police to complete a 'Report of Lost or Stolen Motor Vehicle Items' form (MV-78B) for your stolen plates. The form is different from the stolen vehicle report, and it's available only from police agencies, not from DMV. Make a copy of the MV-78B report for your records, and bring the original form to a DMV office to surrender your registration. For further information, see Report or Replace Lost or Stolen Plates [1].
source_blocks.text: 请警方为您被盗的车牌填写一份“丢失或被盗机动车物品报告”表格（MV-78B）。该表格与车辆被盗报告不同，且仅可从警方机构获取，DMV不提供。请复印一份MV-78B报告留作记录，并将原件带到DMV办公室以交回您的注册。更多信息，请参见报告或更换丢失或被盗车牌 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I need a duplicate (replacement) title?
source_blocks.text: 我需要补发（替换）所有权证书吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle is not recovered, you may have to transfer ownership to your insurance company using your title certificate. If you have lost your title certificate, you must apply for a duplicate title. See Replace a Title Certificate [2] for more information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆未被找回，您可能需要使用您的所有权证书将所有权转让给您的保险公司。如果您丢失了所有权证书，您必须申请补发所有权证书。更多信息，请参见更换所有权证书 [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A duplicate title issued when a vehicle is stolen is marked to show the vehicle is stolen and that the duplicate title is valid for insurance transfer only.
source_blocks.text: 当车辆被盗时签发的补发所有权证书会标注车辆被盗，且该补发证书仅用于保险转让。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle is recovered before you transfer the "insurance transfer only" title to your insurance company, make sure the police have cancelled the stolen vehicle alarm. Then send the title to the Title Bureau along with a letter explaining that your vehicle was recovered, and DMV will issue a regular title. The address for the Title Bureau is
source_blocks.text: 如果在您将“仅限保险转让”的所有权证书转让给您的保险公司之前车辆被找回，请确保警方已取消被盗车辆警报。然后将所有权证书连同解释您的车辆已被找回的信函寄至Title Bureau，DMV将签发常规所有权证书。Title Bureau的地址为

source_blocks.source_text_en: Title BureauNYS DMVPO Box 2750Albany, NY 12220-0750
source_blocks.text: Title BureauNYS DMVPO Box 2750Albany, NY 12220-0750

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if my title was not yet issued?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的所有权证书尚未签发怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the vehicle was stolen before you were able to apply for registration and title in your name, you must first apply for a title in your name in order to transfer ownership to your insurance company. Obtain a letter from the insurance company on their letterhead stating that proof of ownership is required for insurance transfer only. Submit the letter with your Application for Title [Only] [3] (MV-82TON). DMV will issue a New York State Salvage Certificate (MV-907A) in your name. The MV-907A is an ownership document that can be transferred to your insurance company. See Apply for a Title Certificate Only [4] at our website.
source_blocks.text: 如果车辆在您能够以您的名义申请注册和所有权证书之前被盗，您必须首先以您的名义申请所有权证书，以便将所有权转让给您的保险公司。获取保险公司抬头的信函，说明所有权证明仅用于保险转让。将该信函与您的“仅申请所有权证书” [3]（MV-82TON）一同提交。DMV将以您的名义签发纽约州残值证书（MV-907A）。MV-907A是所有权文件，可转让给您的保险公司。请在我们的网站上参见仅申请所有权证书 [4]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Recovered vehicles
source_blocks.text: 找回车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vehicle is recovered, make sure the police cancel the stolen vehicle alarm so the recovery will be listed on your title record. Do not use the vehicle or apply for plates/registration until you are sure the alarm has been cancelled.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的车辆被找回，请确保警方取消被盗车辆警报，以便找回记录会列在您的所有权证书记录上。在确认警报已取消之前，请勿使用车辆或申请车牌/注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the vehicle is damaged or totaled, contact your auto insurance company. Do not apply for plates/registration as explained below until contacting your insurance company and resolving the matter with them.
source_blocks.text: 如果车辆损坏或全损，请联系您的汽车保险公司。在联系您的保险公司并解决此事之前，请勿按以下说明申请车牌/注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the plates are recovered with your vehicle and you filed form MV-78B, bring the plates and your copy of the MV-78B to a DMV office to surrender them and apply for new plates and to re-instate your registration.
source_blocks.text: 如果车牌随车辆一起找回，且您已提交MV-78B表格，请将车牌和您的MV-78B副本带到DMV办公室，交回它们并申请新车牌及恢复您的注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the plates are missing, bring your copy of form MV-78B to a DMV office and apply for new plates and reinstatement of your registration.
source_blocks.text: 如果车牌丢失，请携带您的MV-78B表格副本到DMV办公室，申请新车牌并恢复您的注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the vehicle and plates are recovered before you file form MV-78B, and the stolen vehicle alarm has been cancelled, your registration is still active and you may continue using the registration.
source_blocks.text: 如果在您提交MV-78B表格之前车辆和车牌已被找回，且被盗车辆警报已取消，您的注册仍然有效，您可以继续使用该注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may qualify for a refund of IRP registration fees you paid to NY State if you surrender the apportioned plates to the NY State IRB and any of these listed conditions occurred

source_blocks.source_text_en: the NY State IRB made an error and the error is on your invoice you paid duplicate apportioned registration fees for the same vehicle or vehicles you paid standard registration renewal fees in error after you changed to an IRP registration you can provide proof that the last date of operation of a vehicle occurred before the effective date of the IRP registration 3

source_blocks.source_text_en: Suspensions and revocations
source_blocks.text: 暂停与吊销

source_blocks.source_text_en: Conviction of a serious traffic violation or multiple traffic violations can result in the suspension or revocation of your driver license or privilege to drive in New York State. It is illegal to drive here when your driver license or driving privilege 1 is suspended or revoked.
source_blocks.text: 严重交通违规或多次交通违规定罪可能导致您的驾驶执照或纽约州驾驶特权被暂停或吊销。当您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权 1 被暂停或吊销时，在此驾驶属违法行为。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your license or driving privilege is suspended or revoked, DMV will send a notice (called an order ) to the address we have on file. Be sure to follow the instructions on the order.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的执照或驾驶特权被暂停或吊销，DMV 将向我们的档案中的地址发送通知（称为命令）。请务必遵循命令上的指示。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Suspended driving privilege
source_blocks.text: 驾驶特权暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: A suspension means your license or driving privilege will be taken away for a period of time. You may need to pay a suspension termination fee [1]. Your suspension period can be definite (which has a beginning and end date) or indefinite, which does not end until you take a required action.
source_blocks.text: 暂停意味着您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权将被剥夺一段时间。您可能需要支付暂停终止费 [1]。您的暂停期可以是定期的（有开始和结束日期）或不定期的，后者在您采取所需行动之前不会结束。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Definite suspensions
source_blocks.text: 定期暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive a , it will tell you how long the suspension period will last. You cannot drive until the period ends, you pay a termination fee, and have a valid driver license again. You can use DMV s My License, Permit or ID [2] service to check if your license is valid.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到，它将告知您暂停期的持续时间。在暂停期结束、支付终止费并重新持有有效驾驶执照之前，您不得驾驶。您可以使用 DMV 的“我的执照、许可证或身份证”[2] 服务来检查您的执照是否有效。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common reasons for definite suspensions
source_blocks.text: 定期暂停的常见原因

source_blocks.source_text_en: you did not have automobile liability insurance 2 you were convicted of an alcohol or drugged driving charge 3 you received too many traffic tickets in a certain amount of time 4 you did not follow the rules for junior drivers 5
source_blocks.text: 您没有购买汽车责任保险 2 您因酒驾或毒驾指控被定罪 3 您在特定时间内收到过多交通罚单 4 您未遵守青少年驾驶员规则 5

source_blocks.source_text_en: Indefinite suspensions
source_blocks.text: 不定期暂停

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive an , it will tell you what you must do to remove the suspension.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到，它将告知您必须采取哪些措施来解除暂停。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common reasons for indefinite suspensions
source_blocks.text: 不定期暂停的常见原因

source_blocks.source_text_en: you did not answer a traffic ticket 6 you did not pay for a traffic ticket fine 7 you did not file a motor vehicle accident report you failed to pay child support 8 you have unpaid NY State tax debts 9 you did not have automobile liability insurance 10
source_blocks.text: 您未回应交通罚单 6 您未支付交通罚单罚款 7 您未提交机动车事故报告 您未能支付子女抚养费 8 您有未付的纽约州税务债务 9 您没有购买汽车责任保险 10

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Your license or driving privilege may be suspended due to a medical condition that affects your ability to drive safely (see Administrative Review Suspensions [3]).
source_blocks.text: 注意：您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权可能因影响您安全驾驶能力的医疗状况而被暂停（参见行政审查暂停 [3]）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Revoked driver license or driving privilege
source_blocks.text: 驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive an order from DMV saying your license or driving privilege is revoked, this means your license has been cancelled and you must get a new one when the revocation period ends. In most cases, before you can get a new license you must first request approval from DMV [4] when the revocation period is over. You may be required to take the written and driving tests again and pay a license re application fee. Your application may be denied if you have a high risk driving record or fail to meet DMV requirements. You may also need to pay a driver civil penalty [5] before your license or driving privilege can be restored.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到 DMV 的命令，说明您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销，这意味着您的执照已被取消，您必须在吊销期结束后重新申请新执照。在大多数情况下，在吊销期结束后，您必须首先请求 DMV 的批准 [4]，然后才能获得新执照。您可能需要重新参加笔试和路考，并支付执照重新申请费。如果您有高风险驾驶记录或未能满足 DMV 要求，您的申请可能会被拒绝。在您的执照或驾驶特权恢复之前，您可能还需要支付驾驶员民事罚款 [5]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common reasons for revocations are
source_blocks.text: 吊销的常见原因包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: you operated or permitted operation of a vehicle without insurance you were involved in an uninsured motor vehicle accident you were convicted of an alcohol or drugged driving charge 11 you were convicted of a serious traffic offense or multiple offenses you failed a DMV road test you made a false statement on an application for a license or registration you were a driver in a motor vehicle crash that involved a fatality
source_blocks.text: 您在没有保险的情况下驾驶或允许他人驾驶车辆 您涉及未投保机动车事故 您因酒驾或毒驾指控被定罪 11 您因严重交通违规或多次违规被定罪 您未通过 DMV 路考 您在执照或注册申请中作出虚假陈述 您是一起涉及死亡的机动车事故的驾驶员

source_blocks.source_text_en: See also Suppose Your License was Taken Away [6].
source_blocks.text: 另请参阅“假设您的驾照被吊销”[6]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to check if your license is suspended or revoked
source_blocks.text: 如何检查您的驾照是否被吊销或撤销

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign up for MyDMV and use the My License, Permit or ID [2] service.
source_blocks.text: 注册MyDMV并使用“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A driving privilege is your legal authority to drive in a state other than the state that issued your driver license. If you have a driver license issued in another state, DMV can revoke your privilege to drive in New York State, but your out-of-state license may still be valid to drive in other states. If you were suspended for an insurance lapse, you can submit proof of insurance online [7]. If the vehicle is not insured and the registration is still valid, you must surrender your registration and plates [8] to DMV. If you are required to pay the suspension termination fee, you can pay online. See more information about insurance lapses [9]. For more information, see Alcohol or drug related violations [10]. For more information, see About the NY State Driver Point System [11] See Information about the Graduated License Law [12] for more information. If you were suspended because you did not answer a traffic ticket issued in New York City (the ticket will say Traffic Violations Bureau ), you can plead or pay for the ticket online [13]. If the traffic ticket was issued in any other part of New York State, you must contact the local court directly. DMV s My License, Permit or ID [2] service can give you additional information about where to respond to a traffic ticket. If you were suspended because you did not pay a fine for a traffic ticket issued in New York City (the ticket will say Traffic Violations Bureau ), you can pay the fine online [13]. If the traffic ticket was issued in any other part of New York State, you must contact the local court directly. DMV s My License service [2] can give you additional information about where to pay to a traffic ticket. To remove a suspension for the failure to pay child support, you must contact the local child support enforcement agency or the NY State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA). The OTDA website [14] has a list of local child support enforcement agencies. For information on clearing these suspensions, contact the Department of Taxation and Finance at 518-862-6000 or visit their website at www.tax.ny.gov [15]. If you were suspended for an insurance lapse, you can submit proof of insurance online [7]. If the vehicle is not insured and the registration is still valid, you must surrender your registration and plates [8] to DMV. See more information about insurance lapses [9]. See Alcohol or drug related violations [10] for more information.
source_blocks.text: 驾驶特权是您在除签发驾驶执照的州以外的其他州驾驶的合法权利。如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，DMV可以撤销您在纽约州的驾驶特权，但您的外州驾照在其他州可能仍然有效。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。如果您需要支付吊销终止费，您可以在线支付。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。 有关更多信息，请参阅关于纽约州驾驶积分系统[11]。 有关更多信息，请参阅毕业驾照法信息[12]。 如果您因未回应纽约市发出的交通罚单（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线认罪或支付罚单[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务可以为您提供有关在哪里回应交通罚单的更多信息。 如果您因未支付纽约市发出的交通罚单罚款（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线支付罚款[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照”服务[2]可以为您提供有关在哪里支付交通罚单的更多信息。 要解除因未支付子女抚养费而导致的吊销，您必须联系当地的子女抚养费执行机构或纽约州临时和残疾援助办公室（OTDA）。OTDA网站[14]上有当地子女抚养费执行机构的列表。 有关清除这些吊销的信息，请联系税务和财政部门，电话518-862-6000，或访问其网站www.tax.ny.gov[15]。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。

documents.doc_id: Temporary surrender of vehicle plates (store plates for a season)#3_0
documents.source_title_en: Temporary surrender of vehicle plates (store plates for a season)
documents.title: 临时上交车辆牌照（季节性存放牌照）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary surrender of vehicle plates (store plates for a season)
source_blocks.text: 临时上交车辆牌照（季节性存放牌照）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surrender plates temporarily or for a season
source_blocks.text: 临时或季节性上交牌照

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can surrender your vehicle plates at a local DMV office and reinstate the registration later. For example, you can surrender your vehicle plates and cancel liability insurance when you take your vehicle off the road for the winter.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在当地的DMV办公室上交您的车辆牌照，之后可以恢复注册。例如，当您冬季将车辆停驶时，可以上交车辆牌照并取消责任保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surrender in an office
source_blocks.text: 在办公室上交

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring your plates to a local DMV office and request a receipt for transfer . Do not request a registration fee refund receipt .
source_blocks.text: 将您的牌照带到当地的DMV办公室，并索取转让收据。不要索取注册费退款收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be sure to remove plate frames and fasteners before you surrender them. We will not accept plates with frames or fasteners attached.
source_blocks.text: 上交前请务必取下牌照框和紧固件。我们不会接受带有牌照框或紧固件的牌照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Plate storage
source_blocks.text: 牌照存放

source_blocks.source_text_en: The DMV does not store standard vehicle plates. If you surrender standard plates, they will be destroyed. You can apply for reinstatement of the registration at any DMV office that processes registration transactions. The DMV office will issue a new set of vehicle plates and can charge a vehicle plate fee of up to \$25.00.
source_blocks.text: DMV不存放标准车辆牌照。如果您上交标准牌照，它们将被销毁。您可以在任何处理注册交易的DMV办公室申请恢复注册。DMV办公室将发放一套新的车辆牌照，并可能收取最高\$25.00的车辆牌照费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you surrender personalized plates or custom plates, the DMV office will store them. You must apply for the reinstatement of the registration at the same DMV office where you surrendered your personalized plates or custom plates.
source_blocks.text: 如果您上交个性化牌照或定制牌照，DMV办公室将存放它们。您必须在您上交个性化牌照或定制牌照的同一DMV办公室申请恢复注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reinstate surrendered plates
source_blocks.text: 恢复已上交的牌照

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must apply in a DMV office to reinstatement of your registration and receive vehicle plates. Bring the following items
source_blocks.text: 您必须在DMV办公室申请恢复注册并领取车辆牌照。请携带以下物品

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Registration or Title (pdf) [1] (MV-82) the receipt (FS-6T) you received when you surrendered your vehicle plates an NY State Insurance ID Card (FS-20) that shows current insurance coverage (see a sample [2]) your proof of identity and date of birth a check or cash for any fees
source_blocks.text: 一份填好的注册或所有权申请表（pdf）[1]（MV-82） 您上交车辆牌照时收到的收据（FS-6T） 显示当前保险范围的NY State保险ID卡（FS-20）（参见示例[2]） 您的身份和出生日期证明 用于支付任何费用的支票或现金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remember that the registration expires on the same date as the registration you surrendered. If you reinstate your registration within 60 days before the registration expires, you can renew the registration and pay the renewal fees.
source_blocks.text: 请记住，注册到期日与您上交的注册相同。如果您在注册到期前60天内恢复注册，您可以续期注册并支付续期费用。

documents.doc_id: The Graduated License Law and Restrictions for Drivers under 18#1_0
documents.source_title_en: The Graduated License Law and Restrictions for Drivers under 18
documents.title: 毕业驾照法律及对18岁以下驾驶员的限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Graduated License Law and Restrictions for Drivers under 18
source_blocks.text: 毕业驾照法律及对18岁以下驾驶员的限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Graduated License Law and Restrictions for Drivers under 18 [1]
source_blocks.text: 毕业驾照法律及对18岁以下驾驶员的限制 [1]

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to the learner permit restrictions that apply to everyone [2], the Graduated License Law places restrictions on drivers under 18 years of age who have a junior learner permit or junior driver license (Class DJ, MJ or DJMJ). The restrictions depend on
source_blocks.text: 除了适用于所有人的学习者许可证限制 [2] 外，毕业驾照法律还对持有初级学习者许可证或初级驾照（Class DJ、MJ 或 DJMJ）的18岁以下驾驶员施加了限制。这些限制取决于

source_blocks.source_text_en: whether you have a junior learner permit or a junior driver license where and when you will be driving in New York State
source_blocks.text: 你持有的是初级学习者许可证还是初级驾照 你将在纽约州何处以及何时驾驶

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not comply with these restrictions, your junior learner permit or junior driver license could be suspended or revoked for 60 days.
source_blocks.text: 如果你不遵守这些限制，你的初级学习者许可证或初级驾照可能会被暂停或吊销60天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where will you be driving?
source_blocks.text: 你将在哪里驾驶？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your driving privileges will vary depending on which of the following three geographic regions you will be driving in
source_blocks.text: 你的驾驶特权将取决于你将在以下三个地理区域中的哪一个驾驶

source_blocks.source_text_en: Upstate New York (which is defined as any county north of the NYC border)
source_blocks.text: 纽约州北部（定义为纽约市边界以北的任何县）

source_blocks.source_text_en: New York City (which is defined by the five Boroughs)
source_blocks.text: 纽约市（定义为五个行政区）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Long Island (which includes Nassau and Suffolk County)
source_blocks.text: 长岛（包括拿骚县和萨福克县）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Map of Regions
source_blocks.text: 区域地图

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the difference between junior learner permit or a junior driver license?
source_blocks.text: 初级学习者许可证和初级驾照有什么区别？

source_blocks.source_text_en: a junior learner permit allows a young driver to drive only while supervised
source_blocks.text: 初级学习者许可证允许年轻驾驶员仅在有人监督的情况下驾驶

source_blocks.source_text_en: depending on the region in which you are driving, a junior driver license, may allow a young driver to drive unsupervised with certain restrictions.
source_blocks.text: 根据你驾驶的区域，初级驾照可能允许年轻驾驶员在特定限制下无人监督驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I drive outside of New York State with a junior learner permit or a junior driver license?
source_blocks.text: 我可以持初级学习者许可证或初级驾照在纽约州以外驾驶吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may drive outside New York State with your NY State junior learner permit or junior driver license if it is allowed by the laws of the other state. You must obey the junior permit and license restrictions that apply in that state. Check with the police or motor vehicle authorities in the state you will visit.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在纽约州以外的地方驾驶，前提是您持有纽约州的初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照，并且该州法律允许。您必须遵守该州适用的初级驾照和执照限制。请咨询您将前往的州的警察或机动车管理局。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I drive in New York State with a learner permit, junior learner or junior driver license from another state?
source_blocks.text: 我能否持其他州的学习驾照、初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照在纽约州驾驶？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under age 16, you cannot drive in New York State, even if you hold a permit or license issued by another state.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未满16岁，即使持有其他州签发的驾照或执照，也不能在纽约州驾驶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are age 16 or older and hold a learner permit, junior learner permit, or junior driver license from outside New York State, you must obey
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满16岁或以上，并持有纽约州以外的学习驾照、初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照，您必须遵守

source_blocks.source_text_en: any restrictions imposed by the state that issued your permit or driver license, and
source_blocks.text: 签发您驾照或驾驶执照的州所施加的任何限制，以及

source_blocks.source_text_en: the New York State general learner permit restrictions [2] and, if you are under age 18, the regional junior learner permit and junior driver license restrictions explained on these pages
source_blocks.text: 纽约州一般学习驾照限制 [2]，如果您未满18岁，还需遵守这些页面中解释的区域性初级学习驾照和初级驾驶执照限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure your learner permit or driver license is valid to drive outside your home state before you drive in New York State.
source_blocks.text: 在纽约州驾驶前，请确保您的学习驾照或驾驶执照在您所在州以外有效。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a class D or M license if I am under 18?
source_blocks.text: 如果我未满18岁，能否获得D类或M类驾照？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are 17, you are eligible for a senior driver license (Class D or M) if you have a junior driver license or limited junior driver license and have completed a state-approved high school or college driver education course. To change your junior license to a senior license, bring your junior license and the Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285) that you received from your instructor to any DMV office [3]. You must return your certificate and junior license to receive the senior license. If you do not change your junior license to a senior license, you are subject to the restrictions for junior drivers until you are age 18, even if you carry the completion certificate with you. You can also give your certificate with your junior permit to the license examiner at your road test. You will automatically receive a senior license when you become eligible.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满17岁，并且持有初级驾驶执照或有限初级驾驶执照，且已完成州批准的高中或大学驾驶教育课程，您就有资格获得高级驾驶执照（D类或M类）。要将您的初级驾照更换为高级驾照，请携带您的初级驾照和您从教练处获得的学生完成证书（MV-285）前往任何DMV办公室 [3]。您必须交回证书和初级驾照才能获得高级驾照。如果您不将初级驾照更换为高级驾照，您将受到初级驾驶员限制的约束，直到您年满18岁，即使您随身携带完成证书也是如此。您也可以在路考时将证书与初级驾照一起交给考官。当您符合条件时，您将自动获得高级驾照。

source_blocks.text: 主题：

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I am convicted of an alcohol or drug-related violation in New York State?
source_blocks.text: What happens if I am convicted of an alcohol or drug-related violation in New York State?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are convicted of an alcohol or drug-related driving violation, your license or privilege to drive in New York State will be revoked or suspended [1]. However, you may be eligible for a conditional license or a conditional driving privilege if you participate in New York State s Impaired Driver Program (IDP) (previously known as Drinking Driving Program (DDP)) or an approved out-of-state program.

However, you may be eligible for a conditional license or a conditional driving privilege if you participate in New York State s Impaired Driver Program (IDP) (previously known as Drinking Driving Program (DDP)) or an approved out-of-state program.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Order of Suspension or Revocation from the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) will indicate a nearby state or county motor vehicle office where you may enroll in the Impaired Driver Program and apply for a conditional license/privilege, if applicable.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your license suspension or revocation officially begins at your hearing or sentencing in court, unless the court gives you a Continuation of Driving Privileges (MV-1192). Your credit for serving the suspension or revocation begins on the effective date of the order. If you receive a continuation, your suspension or revocation will begin 20 days after sentencing

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is a criminal offense to drive a motor vehicle while your license is suspended or revoked. If you are convicted of driving under suspension or revocation, you may be fined and you may be sentenced to jail and/or probation. In addition, the police may impound the vehicle you were driving when arrested.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are placed on probation because of this conviction, you also must bring written permission from the sentencing court, or your probation officer, that allows you to apply for a license.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Moving violations

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your NY State Driver License will be suspended if you fail to answer a ticket for a moving violation in any state except Alaska, California, Michigan, Montana, Oregon or Wisconsin. Your license will remain suspended until you answer the ticket.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Drivers from any state, except those from the six states listed above, will have their driver licenses suspended in their own state for failure to answer a moving violation in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State DMV does not record out-of-state convictions of moving traffic violations of New York State non-commercial licensed drivers, except for traffic offenses committed in the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are 21 or older

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are 21 years of age or older when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation in any other state or the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least 90 days. Out-of-state drivers ticketed in New York State should contact the Motor Vehicle Department of their own state or province about the effect of a conviction in New York State.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under 21

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are under the age of 21 when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation that occurs out-of-state and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least one year. If you have any prior alcohol or drug related driving conviction, your license will be revoked for at least one year or until the age of 21, whichever is longer.

If you have any prior alcohol or drug related driving conviction, your license will be revoked for at least one year or until the age of 21, whichever is longer.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Convictions for criminal negligence, homicide or assault

source_blocks.source_text_en: The New York State DMV records the out-of-state convictions of any New York driver for criminal negligence, homicide, or assault, which arise out of the operation of a motor vehicle and which results in death. As a result of any of these convictions, your NY State Driver License will be revoked.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you continue to ignore the ticket after your license is suspended for failure to answer the ticket, you will automatically be convicted of the charge. source_blocks.source_text_en: Many DMV customers make easily avoidable mistakes that cause them significant problems, including encounters with law enforcement and impounded vehicles. Because we see customers make these mistakes over and over again, we are issuing this list of the top five DMV mistakes and how to avoid them.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Forgetting to Update Address
source_blocks.text: Forgetting to Update Address

source_blocks.source_text_en: By statute, you must report a change of address to DMV within ten days of moving. That is the case for the address associated with your license, as well as all the addresses associated with each registered vehicle, which may differ.
source_blocks.text: By statute, you must report a change of address to DMV within ten days of moving. That is the case for the address associated with your license, as well as all the addresses associated with each registered vehicle, which may differ.

source_blocks.source_text_en: It is not sufficient to only: write your new address on the back of your old license; tell the United States Postal Service; or inform the police officer writing you a ticket. If you fail to keep your address current, you will miss a suspension order and may be charged with operating an unregistered vehicle and/or aggravated unlicensed operation, both misdemeanors. This really happens, but the good news is this is a problem that is easily avoidable.

source_blocks.source_text_en: States communicate with each other, so when you move to another state, be sure to tie up any loose ends regarding your New York State license or registration. That means resolving any unanswered tickets, suspensions or revocations, and surrendering your license plates to NYS when you get to your new home state.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A license suspension or revocation here could mean that your new home state will not issue you a license there. Remember, it is important to notify DMV of your new address so that any possible mail correspondence can reach you. Also, turning in your plates is important to avoid an insurance lapse.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Letting Insurance Lapse
source_blocks.text: Letting Insurance Lapse

source_blocks.source_text_en: Because we all pay indirectly for crashes involving uninsured motorists, New York State requires every motorist to maintain auto insurance every single day a vehicle is registered. DMV works with insurance companies to electronically monitor your insurance coverage, and we know when coverage is dropped for any reason. When that happens, we mail you an insurance inquiry letter to allow you to clear up the problem.

source_blocks.source_text_en: INTRODUCTION
source_blocks.text: INTRODUCTION

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are issued a ticket for a non-criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New York City, it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked (aggravated unlicensed operation). However, TVBs do not handle parking violations.
source_blocks.text: If you are issued a ticket for a non-criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New York City, it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked (aggravated unlicensed operation). However, TVBs do not handle parking violations.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plead not guilty to a traffic ticket in one of these TVB areas, your case will be heard by a DMV Administrative Law Judge (ALJ), an experienced attorney with special training in the Vehicle and Traffic Law. An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if you are found guilty. An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if you are found guilty. An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Just as in traffic courts in other areas of the state, you may present witnesses and evidence at a hearing before an ALJ and be represented by an attorney.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Follow the instructions on the ticket for the plea you wish to make, and act promptly.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't answer the ticket in the time allowed, your driver license will be suspended. Later, you could be found guilty of the charge because of your failure to respond (a default conviction). Your license would be suspended for not paying the fine and a judgment would be entered against you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Driving with a suspended license is a crime. A felony conviction may result in fines of up to \$5,000, jail, probation, or confiscation of your vehicle. source_blocks.source_text_en: ATTEND YOUR HEARING

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hearings are open to the public. You may go to any TVB office to watch hearings so you know what to expect at yours.

You may pay the fine and surcharge by Visa or Mastercard, or by a check or money order payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. source_blocks.source_text_en: You may not plead guilty by mail if the charge against you will result in license or registration suspension or revocation upon conviction (such as driving without insurance or a third speeding violation within 18 months). If you plead guilty to such a charge by mail, you will be notified that you must go to the TVB to answer the charge in person.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may request your traffic ticket hearing to be postponed and rescheduled to a different date. For the ticket's first postponement, the appropriate TVB must receive your request by mail at least 10 days before the date of the scheduled hearing. You may also make your postponement request in person at that office or by telephone at least one day before your hearing date. If it would be a second or subsequent postponement for the same ticket, your request must be made in person at the appropriate TVB office at least one day before your hearing date. Your request for a second or subsequent postponement also must include a "good cause," which is the reason you want the hearing rescheduled. Your "good cause" is subject to approval by a TVB Administrative Law Judge.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You are considered innocent of the charge against you unless you are proven guilty at your hearing. You cannot be found guilty unless there is "clear and convincing evidence" that you committed the violation.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you find it hard to understand English, you may bring someone to help you. Tell the ALJ, before the hearing starts, that someone who speaks your native language and English is there to interpret.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The ALJ will listen to sworn testimony from the police officer, who will explain why you were given the ticket. Then, you or your attorney may ask the officer questions. You also may bring witnesses to testify for you and written evidence. The judge may ask witnesses questions to better understand their testimony.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You do not have to testify but you may if you wish. You cannot be found guilty just because you do not testify.

source_blocks.source_text_en: When all of the evidence and testimony have been given, the ALJ will decide whether or not you are guilty. That decision will be based only on the evidence and testimony presented at the hearing and what the law states. If the ALJ decides the charge against you was not proven by clear and convincing evidence, you will be found not guilty. If the charge is proven and you are found guilty, the judge will set a fine. Your license or registration also may be suspended or revoked, depending on the violation and your overall driving record.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The most common reasons your license may be suspended or revoked due to motor vehicle violations follow. source_blocks.source_text_en: Speeding/Misdemeanors If you commit three speeding and/or misdemeanor traffic violations within 18 months, your license will be revoked for at least six months.
source_blocks.text: Speeding/Misdemeanors If you commit three speeding and/or misdemeanor traffic violations within 18 months, your license will be revoked for at least six months.

source_blocks.source_text_en: New Driver Probation You are on license probation for six months after you pass a road test. If you are found guilty of committing any two moving violations during your probation period, your license will be suspended for 60 days. It will also be suspended for 60 days if you are found guilty of committing a single, more serious violation during the probation period, including speeding, tailgating, unauthorized racing or reckless driving. For violations committed on or after November 1, 2014 - If you are found guilty of committing a texting/cell phone violation during the probation period, your license will be suspended for 120 days. (For texting/cell phone violations committed between July 1, 2013 and October 31, 2014, your probationary license will be suspended for 60 days.)

If you are found guilty of committing any two moving violations during your probation period, your license will be suspended for 60 days. It will also be suspended for 60 days if you are found guilty of committing a single, more serious violation during the probation period, including speeding, tailgating, unauthorized racing or reckless driving. For violations committed on or after November 1, 2014 - If you are found guilty of committing a texting/cell phone violation during the probation period, your license will be suspended for 120 days. (For texting/cell phone violations committed between July 1, 2013 and October 31, 2014, your probationary license will be suspended for 60 days.)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a holder of a probationary/junior license or learner permit and you are charged with a cell phone/texting violation on or after July 1, 2013, you cannot plead by mail or online. You must appear for a hearing in a TVB office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Points Most traffic violations carry violation points. The points will be added to your record using the date the violation occurred, not the date you are found guilty. If your violation points in any 18-month period add up to 11 or more, your license may be revoked or suspended following a hearing.

source_blocks.source_text_en: the seller whose name appears on the proof of ownership must record the name of the buyer and sign the transfer section of the proof of ownership - the transfer section must be notarized if the proof of ownership is a Certificate of Title from Alaska, Arizona, Hawaii, Kentucky Louisiana, Mississippi, Montana, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Washington, Wyoming, or Puerto Rico the seller must sign a Vehicle Bill of Sale (PDF) [1] (MV-912) - if the vehicle was a gift, the seller must sign Section 6 on Page 2 of a Statement of Transaction- Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (PDF) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802) - if the seller has a title certificate that was transferred to them by another person, the seller cannot use that title certificate to transfer the ownership - before the seller can transfer ownership they must apply for a title certificate only [3] and transfer the new title certificate
