source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明为以下之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: a NY State Transferable Registration must be the original or a certified copy, acceptable proof from another state 4
source_blocks.text: 纽约州可转让登记必须是原件或经认证的副本， 来自其他州的可接受证明 4

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权时

source_blocks.source_text_en: the owner can use the transferable registration and a bill of sale make sure the registration document is marked "transferable" on the front the seller whose name appears on the transferable registration must sign the back
source_blocks.text: 车主可以使用可转让登记和销售单 确保登记文件正面标有“可转让”字样 可转让登记上列出的卖方必须在背面签字

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manufactured homes
source_blocks.text: 预制房屋

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1995 and newer the acceptable proof of ownership can be
source_blocks.text: 1995年及以后车型年份，可接受的所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: a Certificate of Title acceptable proof of ownership from any other state 5 the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin (MSO)
source_blocks.text: 所有权证书 来自任何其他州的可接受所有权证明 5 制造商原产地证书（MCO） 制造商原产地声明（MSO）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you purchase a new manufactured home from a dealer, the proof of ownership can be either
source_blocks.text: 如果您从经销商处购买新的预制房屋，所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin (MSO), transferred by the dealer to the purchaser
source_blocks.text: 制造商原产地证书（MCO） 制造商原产地声明（MSO），由经销商转让给购买者

source_blocks.source_text_en: along with
source_blocks.text: 以及

source_blocks.source_text_en: a bill of sale [4] an Application for Title Only (PDF) [5] (MV-82TON) with the Manufactured Home Dealer Certification section completed
source_blocks.text: 销售单 [4] 仅标题申请（PDF）[5]（MV-82TON），并填写预制房屋经销商认证部分

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: the seller whose name appears on the proof of ownership must sign the transfer section and provide a bill of sale if the seller has a title certificate that was transferred to them by another person, the seller cannot use that title certificate to transfer the ownership - the seller must apply for a title certificate only [3] and transfer the new title certificate the buyer's name must be on the title certificate make sure that the information listed on the title certificate is not altered, erased or changed 6
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明上列出的卖方必须签署转让部分并提供销售单 如果卖方持有由他人转让给他们的所有权证书，则卖方不能使用该所有权证书转让所有权 - 卖方必须仅申请标题证书 [3] 并转让新的标题证书 买方姓名必须出现在标题证书上 确保标题证书上列出的信息未被篡改、擦除或更改 6

source_blocks.source_text_en: Motorized boats
source_blocks.text: 机动船

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1987 or newer, and at least 14 ft. long
source_blocks.text: 1987年及以后车型年份，且长度至少14英尺

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: the NY State Certificate of Title must be the original or a certified copy, 7 acceptable proof of ownership from another state 8
source_blocks.text: 纽约州所有权证书必须是原件或经核证的副本，7 来自另一个州的可接受所有权证明 8

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: the seller whose name appears on the proof of ownership must sign the transfer section and provide a bill of sale if the seller has a title certificate that was transferred to them by another person, the seller cannot use that title certificate to transfer the ownership to you - the seller must apply for a title certificate only [3] and transfer the new title certificate the buyer's name must be on the title certificate make sure that the information listed on the title certificate is not altered, erased or changed 9
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明上列出的卖方必须签署转让部分并提供销售单 如果卖方持有由他人转让给他们的所有权证书，则卖方不能使用该所有权证书将所有权转让给您 - 卖方必须仅申请标题证书 [3] 并转让新的标题证书 买方姓名必须出现在标题证书上 确保标题证书上列出的信息未被篡改、擦除或更改 9

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1986 or older or any NY State-registered boat that is less than 14 ft. long
source_blocks.text: 1986年及以前车型年份或任何在纽约州注册且长度不足14英尺的船只

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: the NY State Transferable Registration - must be the original or a certified copy, acceptable proof of ownership from another state 10
source_blocks.text: 纽约州可转让注册证书 - 必须是原件或经核证的副本， 来自另一个州的可接受所有权证明 10

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: the owner can use the transferable registration and a bill of sale [4] make sure the registration document is marked "transferable" on the front the seller whose name appears on the transferable registration must sign the back
source_blocks.text: 车主可以使用可转让登记证和销售单 [4] 确保登记文件正面标有“可转让”字样 可转让登记证上列名的卖方必须在背面签名

source_blocks.source_text_en: Trailers
source_blocks.text: 拖车

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1973 or newer with an unladen weight of 1,000 lbs. or more
source_blocks.text: 1973年款或更新，且空载重量为1,000磅或以上

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明为以下任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: the NY State Certificate of Title must be the original or a certified copy, 11 acceptable proof of ownership from another state 12
source_blocks.text: 纽约州所有权证书必须是原件或经核证的副本，11 来自其他州的可接受的所有权证明 12

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: the seller whose name appears on the proof of ownership must sign the transfer section and provide a bill of sale [4] if the seller has a title certificate that was transferred to them by another person, the seller cannot use that title certificate to transfer the ownership - the seller must apply for a title certificate only [3] and transfer the new title certificate your name must appear on the title certificate as the buyer make sure that the information listed on the title certificate is not altered, erased or changed 13
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明上列名的卖方必须在转让部分签名，并提供销售单 [4] 如果卖方持有的所有权证书是由他人转让给他们的，则卖方不能使用该所有权证书转让所有权 - 卖方必须仅申请所有权证书 [3]，并转让新的所有权证书 您的姓名必须作为买方出现在所有权证书上 确保所有权证书上列出的信息未被涂改、擦除或更改 13

source_blocks.source_text_en: Model year 1972 or older, or ANY model year trailer with an unladen weight of 999 lbs. or less
source_blocks.text: 1972年款或更旧，或任何年款的空载重量为999磅或以下的拖车

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明为以下任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: the NY State Transferable Registration - must be the original or a certified copy, acceptable proof of ownership from another state 14
source_blocks.text: 纽约州可转让登记证 - 必须是原件或经核证的副本， 来自其他州的可接受的所有权证明 14

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权

source_blocks.source_text_en: the owner can use the transferable registration and a bill of sale make sure the registration document is marked "transferable" on the front the seller whose name appears on the transferable registration must sign the back
source_blocks.text: 车主可以使用可转让登记证和销售单 确保登记文件正面标有“可转让”字样 可转让登记证上列名的卖方必须在背面签名

source_blocks.source_text_en: All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
source_blocks.text: 全地形车（ATV）

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a new ATV, the acceptable proof of ownership is either
source_blocks.text: 对于新车，可接受的所有权证明为以下任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin (MSO)
source_blocks.text: 制造商原产地证书（MCO） 制造商原产地声明（MSO）

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a used ATV where the prior registration was not in New York State, acceptable proof is either
source_blocks.text: 对于先前未在纽约州注册的二手车，可接受的所有权证明为以下任一

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin (MSO)
source_blocks.text: 制造商原产地证书（MCO） 制造商原产地声明（MSO）

source_blocks.source_text_en: along with
source_blocks.text: 连同

source_blocks.source_text_en: the bill of sale [4]
source_blocks.text: 销售单 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a used ATV where the prior registration was in New York State, acceptable proof is either
source_blocks.text: 对于先前在纽约州注册的二手ATV，可接受的所有权证明可以是以下任一形式

source_blocks.source_text_en: a NY State transferable registration - must be the original or a certified copy, acceptable proof of ownership from another state
source_blocks.text: 纽约州可转让注册证明 - 必须是原件或经认证的副本， 来自其他州的可接受的所有权证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership
source_blocks.text: 转让所有权时

source_blocks.source_text_en: the owner can use the transferable registration make sure the registration document is marked "transferable" on the front the seller whose name appears on the registration must sign the back and provide a bill of sale
source_blocks.text: 车主可以使用可转让注册证明 确保注册文件正面标有“可转让”字样 注册文件上列出的卖方必须在背面签名并提供销售单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Purchased from a registered dealer
source_blocks.text: 从注册经销商处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must get a dealer's bill of sale. An acceptable bill of sale includes all of this information
source_blocks.text: 您必须获得经销商的销售单。可接受的销售单包含以下所有信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: the name, mailing address, and registration number of the dealer your name and your mailing address the vehicle identification number of the ATV the year and make of the ATV the model name and the number of wheels on the ATV the information that indicates if the ATV is new or used the information that proves that the dealer collected the correct amount of NY State sales tax
source_blocks.text: 经销商的姓名、邮寄地址和注册号 您的姓名和邮寄地址 ATV的车辆识别号 ATV的年份和品牌 ATV的型号名称和轮子数量 表明ATV是新车还是二手的信息 证明经销商已收取正确金额的纽约州销售税的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the ATV was never registered or the proofs of ownership are not available, complete an Affidavit (Statement) of Ownership (PDF) [6] (MV-51B), and get a bill of sale from the current owner.
source_blocks.text: 如果ATV从未注册或无法提供所有权证明，请填写所有权宣誓书（声明）（PDF）[6]（MV-51B），并从当前所有者处获取销售单。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Snowmobiles
source_blocks.text: 雪地摩托车

source_blocks.source_text_en: Purchased from a dealer
source_blocks.text: 从经销商处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership can be
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin the registration of the previous owner that is signed and transferred to the dealer a dealer's bill of sale [4] on company letterhead
source_blocks.text: 制造商原产地证书 制造商原产地声明 前车主签署并转让给经销商的注册证明 印在公司信纸上的经销商销售单 [4]

source_blocks.source_text_en: Previously registered in New York and purchased from an individual
source_blocks.text: 先前在纽约注册并从个人处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership is a snowmobile bill of sale [4] and a New York State registration. The person whose name appears on the proof of ownership must sign the transfer section.
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明是雪地摩托车销售单 [4] 和纽约州注册证明。所有权证明上列出的姓名必须签署转让部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An acceptable snowmobile bill of sale includes all of this information
source_blocks.text: 可接受的雪地摩托车销售单包含以下所有信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: buyer and seller names and mailing addresses the year and make of the snowmobile the model name, model number, color, and CC/HP of the snowmobile the snowmobile identification number the purchase price the signature of the seller
source_blocks.text: 买方和卖方的姓名及邮寄地址 雪地摩托车的年份和品牌 雪地摩托车的型号名称、型号编号、颜色和CC/HP 雪地摩托车识别号 购买价格 卖方的签名

source_blocks.source_text_en: Never registered and purchased from an individual
source_blocks.text: 从未注册且从个人处购买

source_blocks.source_text_en: The acceptable proof of ownership can be
source_blocks.text: 可接受的所有权证明可以是

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin or Manufacturer's Statement of Origin the dealer's bill of sale given to the original owner the sales tax receipts from all other transfers a snowmobile bill of sale [4] (as described above)
source_blocks.text: 制造商出厂证明或制造商出厂声明 经销商开给原始所有者的销售单据 所有其他转让的销售税收据 雪地车销售单 [4]（如上所述）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles purchased from dealers
source_blocks.text: 从经销商处购买的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: A DMV-licensed automobile dealer must have acceptable proof of ownership for a vehicle before they can sell that vehicle to you. Most NY State automobile dealers send the application for a vehicle registration and title certificate to the DMV. The dealer can charge a fee of \$75 for this service.
source_blocks.text: DMV授权的汽车经销商在将车辆出售给您之前，必须拥有可接受的所有权证明。纽约州的大多数汽车经销商会将车辆注册和所有权证书的申请发送给DMV。经销商可以为此服务收取\$75的费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The proof of ownership for a new vehicle is either
source_blocks.text: 新车的所有权证明是以下之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO) the Manufacturer's Statement of Origin (MSO) and form MV-50 (Retail Certificate of Sale)
source_blocks.text: 制造商出厂证明（MCO） 制造商出厂声明（MSO）和MV-50表格（零售销售证书）

source_blocks.source_text_en: The proof of ownership for a used vehicle is both
source_blocks.text: 二手车的所有权证明是以下两者

source_blocks.source_text_en: the title certificate that the previous owner signed to transfer the ownership to the dealer 'Retail Certificate of Sale' (MV-50) that the dealer signs to transfer ownership to you (out-of-state dealers use a different bill of sale form)
source_blocks.text: 前车主签署以将所有权转让给经销商的所有权证书 经销商签署以将所有权转让给您的“零售销售证书”（MV-50）（州外经销商使用不同的销售单表格）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you cannot get acceptable proof of ownership from a NY State dealer, learn how to file a complaint [7].
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法从纽约州经销商处获得可接受的所有权证明，请了解如何提出投诉 [7]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles purchased or received as a gift from another person
source_blocks.text: 从他人处购买或作为礼物收到的车辆

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you buy a vehicle, a boat, an ATV, or a snowmobile from another person who is not a DMV-licensed automobile dealer or receive it as a gift, make sure that you receive acceptable proof of ownership.
source_blocks.text: 如果您从非DMV授权的汽车经销商处购买车辆、船只、ATV或雪地车，或作为礼物收到，请确保您获得可接受的所有权证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Proof of ownership normally includes a bill of sale. The DMV does not provide a form for a bill of sale. The seller and the buyer complete the bill of sale. If the vehicle is transferred as a gift, indicate this on the bill of sale and indicate that the purchase price is \$0. You must also complete a Statement of Transaction- Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (PDF) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802) and indicate on the form that the vehicle is a gift.
source_blocks.text: 所有权证明通常包括销售单。DMV不提供销售单表格。卖方和买方填写销售单。如果车辆是作为礼物转让的，请在销售单上注明，并注明购买价格为\$0。您还必须填写交易声明 - 汽车、拖车、全地形车（ATV）、船只（船）或雪地车的销售或礼物（PDF） [2]（纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-802），并在表格上注明该车辆是礼物。

source_blocks.source_text_en: An acceptable bill of sale includes all of this information
source_blocks.text: 可接受的销售单包括以下所有信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: the year and make of the vehicle, boat or ATV the vehicle identification number (VIN) or the hull identification number (HIN) the date of the sale the purchase price of the vehicle or the boat the names and signatures of the buyer and the seller
source_blocks.text: 车辆、船只或ATV的年份和品牌 车辆识别号（VIN）或船体识别号（HIN） 销售日期 车辆或船只的购买价格 买方和卖方的姓名和签名

source_blocks.source_text_en: The buyer and seller can make photocopies of the bill of sale to keep for their records. The new owner must go to the DMV with the acceptable proof of ownership and a bill of sale. A bill of sale alone is not acceptable as proof of ownership without a title or transferable registration
source_blocks.text: 买方和卖方可以复印销售单以保留记录。新所有者必须携带可接受的所有权证明和销售单前往DMV。仅有销售单而没有所有权证书或可转让的注册，不能作为所有权证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deceased owner (motor vehicles only)
source_blocks.text: 已故车主（仅限机动车辆）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use this checklist to help you transfer the ownership when the vehicle owner is deceased (PDF) [8] (MV-843).
source_blocks.text: 使用此清单帮助您在车主去世时转让所有权（PDF） [8]（MV-843）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For transfers made by the 'According to the Estates, Powers & Trust Law of New York State,' the owner of one vehicle that has a value of \$25,000 or less automatically transfers to the surviving spouse. If the surviving spouse wishes to transfer ownership, they must print the decedent s name in the Seller s Name (Print in Full) section on the back of the Title and sign their name in the Seller s Signature Section followed by the words as surviving Spouse .
source_blocks.text: 对于根据《纽约州遗产、权力与信托法》进行的转让，价值为\$25,000或以下的一辆车辆的所有权自动转移给尚存配偶。如果尚存配偶希望转让所有权，他们必须在所有权证书背面的“卖方姓名（全名打印）”部分打印死者姓名，并在“卖方签名”部分签署自己的姓名，后跟“作为尚存配偶”字样。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The ownership of one vehicle that has a value of \$25,000 or less transfers to the surviving children under the age of 21 if there is no surviving spouse or the spouse is disqualified. The spouse or the legal guardian of one of the children must sign the title certificate. When the spouse or the guardian signs the title certificate, they must indicate the relationship to the deceased owner. A spouse writes the word "spouse" under the signature. A guardian writes "guardian of", and the name and the relationship of the child to the deceased owner (for example, "Charles Edwards, guardian of John Smith, son").
source_blocks.text: 如果没有尚存配偶或配偶不符合资格，价值为\$25,000或以下的一辆车辆的所有权转移给未满21岁的尚存子女。配偶或其中一名子女的法定监护人必须签署所有权证书。当配偶或监护人签署所有权证书时，他们必须注明与已故所有者的关系。配偶在签名下方写上“配偶”一词。监护人写上“监护人”，以及子女的姓名和与已故所有者的关系（例如，“查尔斯·爱德华兹，约翰·史密斯的监护人，儿子”）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To transfer ownership of the vehicle to another person, the spouse or guardian must complete an Affidavit for Transfer of Motor Vehicle (PDF) [9] (MV 349.1). The form must be notarized. The spouse or guardian also gives the new owner a photocopy of the death certificate or certification of death. The DMV accepts a photocopy of the death certificate or certification of death. When the new owner applies for a vehicle registration or a title certificate, they must provide form MV-349.1 and the copy of the death certificate or certification of death.
source_blocks.text: 要将车辆所有权转让给他人，配偶或监护人必须填写《机动车转让宣誓书》（PDF）[9]（MV 349.1）。该表格必须经过公证。配偶或监护人还需向新车主提供死亡证明或死亡证明书的复印件。DMV接受死亡证明或死亡证明书的复印件。当新车主申请车辆注册或所有权证书时，他们必须提供MV-349.1表格和死亡证明或死亡证明书的副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For transfers made by the Executor or Administrator of the Estate: If there is more than one vehicle or there is one vehicle that has a value of more than \$25,000, the vehicle or vehicles become part of the estate. You cannot use the Transfer of Vehicle Registered in Name of Deceased Person (PDF) [10] (MV-349) or an Affidavit for Transfer of Motor Vehicle (PDF) [9] (MV-349.1) to transfer the ownership
source_blocks.text: 对于由遗产执行人或管理人进行的转让：如果有多辆车辆或一辆价值超过\$25,000的车辆，该车辆或这些车辆成为遗产的一部分。您不能使用《已故人名下注册车辆转让表》（PDF）[10]（MV-349）或《机动车转让宣誓书》（PDF）[9]（MV-349.1）来转让所有权。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A copy of Letters of Testamentary, Letters of Administration, or Voluntary Administrator s affidavit from the Surrogate Court MUST be submitted together with the decedent s title transferred by the person given legal authority in the documents to sign. The Executor or Administrator of the estate must transfer the ownership by signing the title certificate. Under the signature of the Executor or Administrator, write: Executor (or Administrator) of the Estate of, and then enter the name of the deceased owner. For example: "Executor of the Estate of Mary Ann Smith".
source_blocks.text: 必须提交遗嘱认证法院出具的遗嘱执行书、遗产管理书或自愿管理人宣誓书的副本，连同由文件中授予法律权限的人签署的死者所有权证书。遗产执行人或管理人必须通过签署所有权证书来转让所有权。在执行人或管理人的签名下方，写上：“（死者姓名）遗产的执行人（或管理人）”，然后输入已故所有者的姓名。例如：“玛丽·安·史密斯遗产的执行人”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deceased owner (Manufactured Homes, Snowmobiles, Boats, Trailers and All Terrain Vehicles)
source_blocks.text: 已故所有者（活动房屋、雪地车、船只、拖车和全地形车）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the owner is deceased, the Estates, Powers & Trust Law of New York State provides for the transfer of the Manufactured Home, Snowmobile, Boat, Trailer or All Terrain Vehicle only through the property distributions of an estate set up by order of a Surrogate Court. A Surviving Spouse, minor child(ren) or next of kin CANNOT automatically assume ownership. Therefore, a Transfer of Vehicle Registered in Name of Deceased Person (PDF) [10] (MV-349) or an Affidavit for Transfer of Motor Vehicle (PDF) [9] (MV-349.1) cannot be used to transfer a manufactured home.
source_blocks.text: 如果所有者已故，根据《纽约州遗产、权力与信托法》，活动房屋、雪地车、船只、拖车或全地形车只能通过遗嘱认证法院命令设立的遗产财产分配进行转让。尚存配偶、未成年子女或近亲属不能自动取得所有权。因此，不能使用《已故人名下注册车辆转让表》（PDF）[10]（MV-349）或《机动车转让宣誓书》（PDF）[9]（MV-349.1）来转让活动房屋。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A copy of Letters of Testamentary, Letters of Administration, or Voluntary Administrator s affidavit from the Surrogate Court MUST be submitted together with the decedent s title transferred by the person given legal authority in the documents to sign. The Executor or Administrator of the estate must transfer the ownership by signing the title certificate. Under the signature of the Executor or Administrator, write: Executor (or Administrator) of the Estate of, and then enter the name of the deceased owner. For example: "Executor of the Estate of Mary Ann Smith".
source_blocks.text: 必须提交遗嘱认证法院出具的遗嘱执行书、遗产管理书或自愿管理人宣誓书的副本，连同由文件中授予法律权限的人签署的死者所有权证书。遗产执行人或管理人必须通过签署所有权证书来转让所有权。在执行人或管理人的签名下方，写上：“（死者姓名）遗产的执行人（或管理人）”，然后输入已故所有者的姓名。例如：“玛丽·安·史密斯遗产的执行人”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicles to a revocable living trust
source_blocks.text: 车辆转让给可撤销生前信托

source_blocks.source_text_en: The person who creates a trust is the settlor. The owner of the vehicle and the settlor of the trust can be the same person. The person or the persons who manage the property of the trust are the trustee or the trustees. The settlor can be a trustee, but the settlor cannot be the only trustee.
source_blocks.text: 创建信托的人是委托人。车辆所有者和信托委托人可以是同一个人。管理信托财产的人是一个或多个受托人。委托人可以是受托人，但委托人不能是唯一的受托人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The document that creates the trust is the trust document.
source_blocks.text: 创建信托的文件是信托文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When a person transfers a vehicle to a revocable living trust, the settlor becomes the new owner of the vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 当一个人将车辆转让给可撤销生前信托时，委托人成为车辆的新所有者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to Transfer the Vehicle to the Settlor (the Trust)
source_blocks.text: 如何将车辆转让给委托人（信托）

source_blocks.source_text_en: The owner and the settlor must complete Statement of Transaction- Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (PDF) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802). If the owner and the settlor are the same person, complete Part II of form DTF-802 for a gift. Complete the donor section and the recipient section.
source_blocks.text: 所有者和委托人必须填写《机动车、拖车、全地形车（ATV）、船只（船）或雪地车销售或赠与交易声明》（PDF）[2]（纽约州税务与财政局）（DTF-802）。如果所有者和委托人是同一个人，请填写DTF-802表格的第二部分作为赠与。填写赠与人和受赠人部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The person who is the owner of the vehicle must complete the seller sections on the back of the certificate. The owner must sign the title certificate as the seller.
source_blocks.text: 作为车辆所有者的人必须填写证书背面的卖方部分。所有者必须作为卖方签署所有权证书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The settlor must complete the odometer and damage disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate. The settlor must sign their full name in the buyer section of the title certificate and print the word "settlor" after their name.
source_blocks.text: 委托人必须填写所有权证书背面的里程表和损坏披露声明。委托人必须在所有权证书的买方部分签署全名，并在姓名后打印“委托人”一词。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The settlor must get new insurance identification cards from an insurance agent or insurance company. The insurance identification cards must identify the with the letters "TST" and identify the settlor with the letters "STL". For example:
source_blocks.text: 委托人必须从保险代理人或保险公司获取新的保险标识卡。保险标识卡必须用字母“TST”标识信托，并用字母“STL”标识委托人。例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: "John Jones TST" "John Jones STL"
source_blocks.text: “约翰·琼斯 TST” “约翰·琼斯 STL”

source_blocks.source_text_en: How the Settlor Applies for a Registration and a Title Certificate
source_blocks.text: 委托人如何申请登记和所有权证书

source_blocks.source_text_en: The settlor cannot use the registration or vehicle plates of the previous owner. The settlor must apply for a new title certificate and a new vehicle registration. The DMV issues new registration documents, new vehicle plates and a new title certificate to the settlor. The previous owner must transfer [11] or surrender the previous vehicle plates [12].
source_blocks.text: 委托人不能使用前车主的登记或车辆牌照。委托人必须申请新的所有权证书和新的车辆登记。DMV向委托人签发新的登记文件、新的车辆牌照和新的所有权证书。前车主必须转让[11]或交回前车辆牌照[12]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for the new registration and title certificate, the settlor must bring to a DMV office:
source_blocks.text: 要申请新的登记和所有权证书，委托人必须携带以下材料到DMV办公室：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Statement of Transaction- Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), Vessel (Boat), or Snowmobile (PDF) [2] (at NY State Department of Tax and Finance) (DTF-802) the insurance identification card that identifies the trust and the settlor Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [13] (MV-82) completed and signed by the settlor the trust document, which - describes the trust as a revocable living trust - shows the name of the trust - shows the names of the settlor, the names of the trustees and the Social Security Number (SSN) of the settlor (if an SSN of the settlor is not available, the settlor can show a New York State driver license with the ID number of the settlors driver license, permit or Non-Driver ID ).
source_blocks.text: 交易声明 - 机动车辆、拖车、全地形车（ATV）、船只（船）或雪地摩托的销售或赠与（PDF）[2]（纽约州税务和财政部门）（DTF-802） 识别信托和委托人的保险身份证 车辆登记/所有权申请（PDF）[13]（MV-82），由委托人填写并签名 信托文件，其中 - 将信托描述为可撤销生前信托 - 显示信托名称 - 显示委托人姓名、受托人姓名以及委托人的社会安全号码（SSN）（如果无法提供委托人的SSN，委托人可以出示带有委托人驾照、许可证或非驾驶员ID号码的纽约州驾照）。

source_blocks.text: 更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read the DMV brochures, Let the Buyer Be Aware [14], and Q&A About Your Title Certificate [15].
source_blocks.text: 阅读DMV手册《让买家知晓》[14]和《关于您的所有权证书的问答》[15]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?
source_blocks.text: I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?

source_blocks.source_text_en: To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.
source_blocks.text: To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.
source_blocks.text: If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not know which court to contact, you can call the NY State DMV Insurance Services Bureau. See Contact us [1].
source_blocks.text: If you do not know which court to contact, you can call the NY State DMV Insurance Services Bureau. See Contact us [1].

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get an unsatisfied judgment against another motorist?
source_blocks.text: How do I get an unsatisfied judgment against another motorist?

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get an unsatisfied judgment against a motorist as a result of a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash, you must file a Supporting Affirmation (PDF) [2] (SR-60) and the other documents listed on the affirmation (SR-60).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will the DMV suspend the driver license and all of the registrations of a person who has an unsatisfied judgment against them?
source_blocks.text: Will the DMV suspend the driver license and all of the registrations of a person who has an unsatisfied judgment against them?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The DMV will suspend the license and registrations if the person fails to pay or satisfy a judgment of more than \$1,000 and the judgment is related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash which causes property damage, bodily injury or death.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vehicle modifications and registration class
source_blocks.text: 车辆改装与注册类别

source_blocks.source_text_en: Modifications to a car, pick-up truck, van, motorcycle, or moped can affect its registration class.
source_blocks.text: 对轿车、皮卡、厢式货车、摩托车或轻便摩托车的改装可能会影响其注册类别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important: The DMV cannot examine your vehicle to determine the correct registration class. You must determine the correct registration class for your vehicle.
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：DMV 无法检查您的车辆以确定正确的注册类别。您必须自行确定您车辆的正确注册类别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Modifications to a motorcycle or moped, including Limited Use Motorcycles-
source_blocks.text: 对摩托车或轻便摩托车（包括 Limited Use Motorcycles）的改装

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you remove a speed governor that was originally installed to limit the top speed of a moped or add a speed governor that limits the top speed of a moped or motorcycle, you must notify DMV and register the moped or motorcycle in the appropriate class [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您移除了原本为限制轻便摩托车最高速度而安装的速度限制器，或者为轻便摩托车或摩托车加装了限制最高速度的速度限制器，您必须通知 DMV，并按相应类别注册该轻便摩托车或摩托车 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Modifications to cars, pick-up trucks, and vans
source_blocks.text: 对轿车、皮卡和厢式货车的改装

source_blocks.source_text_en: Part 106 of DMV Regulations describes the vehicles that are registered in the 'Commercial' class and in the passenger class. Part 106 also describes how some modifications that you make to your vehicle can affect the correct registration class of your vehicle. A description of the modifications appears below. Each description includes a reference to the DMV Regulations [2].
source_blocks.text: DMV Regulations 第 106 部分描述了哪些车辆注册为 'Commercial' 类别，哪些注册为 passenger 类别。第 106 部分还说明了您对车辆进行的一些改装如何影响车辆的正确注册类别。以下为改装说明，每条说明均引用了 DMV Regulations [2]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For all vehicle modifications, you must obtain a vehicle weight slip. You can get vehicle weight slips at most vehicle and/or metal scrapyards and from some auto-parts stores and mechanics, especially those specializing in vehicle modifications and camper body/equipment sales and installation.
source_blocks.text: 对于所有车辆改装，您必须获取车辆重量单。您可以在大多数车辆和/或金属废料场，以及一些汽车配件店和修理厂获取车辆重量单，尤其是那些专门从事车辆改装和露营车车身/设备销售与安装的店铺。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Modifications that change a registration from 'Passenger' class to 'Commercial' class
source_blocks.text: 将注册从 'Passenger' 类别变更为 'Commercial' 类别的改装

source_blocks.source_text_en: Cars (Part 106.2 (e))
source_blocks.text: 轿车（Part 106.2 (e)）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can register a car in the 'Commercial' class if all the seats behind the driver are removed. Instead of the seats, you must install a permanent box or permanent rack to carry cargo.
source_blocks.text: 如果驾驶员后方的所有座椅均被拆除，并安装了永久性货箱或永久性货架以承载货物，则您可以将轿车注册为 'Commercial' 类别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Station Wagons and Vans (Part 106.2 (f))
source_blocks.text: 旅行车和厢式货车（Part 106.2 (f)）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can register a station wagon in the 'Commercial' class if all the seats and all the seat fittings behind the driver are removed completely.
source_blocks.text: 如果驾驶员后方的所有座椅及座椅配件均被完全拆除，则您可以将旅行车注册为 'Commercial' 类别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Modifications that change a registration from 'Commercial' class to 'Passenger' class
source_blocks.text: 将注册从 'Commercial' 类别变更为 'Passenger' 类别的改装

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
source_blocks.text: 皮卡（Part 106.6 (b) 和 (c)）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can register a pick-up in the 'Passenger' class if it meets certain conditions, depending on its unladen weight.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的皮卡满足特定条件（取决于其空载重量），则您可以将其注册为 'Passenger' 类别。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your modified or unmodified pick-up truck has an unladen weight less than 6,001 lbs., you can register it in the 'Passenger' class if it meets the following conditions:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的改装或未改装皮卡的空载重量低于 6,001 磅，并且满足以下条件，则您可以将其注册为 'Passenger' 类别：

source_blocks.source_text_en: the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements the pick-up truck is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes
source_blocks.text: 皮卡上没有任何商业广告 皮卡仅用于非商业目的

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your modified pick-up truck with an unladen weight greater than 6,000 lbs., you can register it in the 'Passenger' class if it meets the following conditions:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的改装皮卡（pick-up truck）空载重量超过6,000磅，并且满足以下条件，则可以注册为'Passenger'（客车）类别：

source_blocks.source_text_en: the pick-up truck does not have any business advertisements and is used exclusively for non-commercial purposes a camper top having one or more side windows completely encloses the truck bed the pick-up truck has seats, seat fittings, or camping equipment installed in the truck bed - 'camping equipment indicates that you have a permanent bed, a permanent stove, or a permanent refrigerator in the vehicle. - if this equipment is removed and you use the van, you must register the van as a commercial vehicle
source_blocks.text: 皮卡上没有商业广告，且仅用于非商业用途 一个带有一个或多个侧窗的露营车顶（camper top）完全封闭货箱 皮卡货箱内安装了座椅、座椅配件或露营设备（camping equipment） - '露营设备'指车辆内配有永久性床铺、永久性炉灶或永久性冰箱。 - 如果移除这些设备并使用该货车，则必须将其注册为商用车辆（commercial vehicle）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
source_blocks.text: 厢式货车（Vans）（第106.3(d)条）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can register it in the 'Passenger' class if the van has
source_blocks.text: 如果厢式货车满足以下条件，则可以注册为'Passenger'类别：

source_blocks.source_text_en: at least one side window behind the driver, and at least one seat or set of seat fittings that is installed behind the driver, or camping equipment that is installed behind the driver. - 'camping equipment' indicates that you have a permanent bed, a permanent stove, or a permanent refrigerator in the vehicle - if you install seats behind the driver, you must also install seatbelts that meet NY State Occupant Restraint Law requirements
source_blocks.text: 驾驶员后方至少有一个侧窗，且 驾驶员后方至少安装一个座椅或一套座椅配件，或 驾驶员后方安装了露营设备。 - '露营设备'指车辆内配有永久性床铺、永久性炉灶或永久性冰箱 - 如果在驾驶员后方安装座椅，则还必须安装符合纽约州乘员约束法（NY State Occupant Restraint Law）要求的安全带

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: These modifications must be permanent. If you use a van or pick-up truck without the required modifications, then you must register it in the 'Commercial' registration class.
source_blocks.text: 注意：这些改装必须是永久性的。如果您使用未进行必要改装的厢式货车或皮卡，则必须将其注册为'Commercial'（商用）注册类别。

documents.doc_id: Veteran status designation on a photo document#3_0
documents.source_title_en: Veteran status designation on a photo document
documents.title: 照片文件上的退伍军人身份标注

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran status designation on a photo document
source_blocks.text: 照片文件上的退伍军人身份标注

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a qualified U.S. military veteran who was honorably discharged, and you have a NY State driver license, learner permit or non-driver photo ID card, you can have the word "Veteran" printed on the upper left hand of your photo document.There is no additional fee for the veteran status designation on your document, but all regular transaction fees will apply.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是符合资格、荣誉退役的美国退伍军人，并且持有纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片身份证，您可以在照片文件的左上角印上“Veteran”字样。退伍军人身份标注不收取额外费用，但所有常规交易费用仍适用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you receive the veteran designation, it will automatically be on all of your future DMV documents (when you replace or renew).
source_blocks.text: 在您获得退伍军人标注后，它将自动出现在您未来的所有DMV文件上（当您更换或续期时）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply, you must provide proof of an honorable discharge
source_blocks.text: 申请时，您必须提供荣誉退役证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Acceptable proofs are
source_blocks.text: 可接受的证明包括

source_blocks.source_text_en: a U.S. Department of Defense Form DD-214 that indicates an honorable discharge a form DD-215 that indicates an honorable discharge if discharged before January 1,1950, an Honorable Discharge form WD AGO 53, WD AGO 55, WD AGO 53-55, NAVPERS 553, NAVMC 78PD or NAVCG 553, or an "Enlisted Separation Paper" a Certification of Military Service (NA FORM 13038) that indicates a discharge that is either "honorable" or "under honorable conditions"
source_blocks.text: 美国国防部DD-214表格，注明荣誉退役 DD-215表格，注明荣誉退役 如果在1950年1月1日之前退役，需提供荣誉退役表格WD AGO 53、WD AGO 55、WD AGO 53-55、NAVPERS 553、NAVMC 78PD或NAVCG 553，或“退伍分离文件” 军事服务证明（NA FORM 13038），注明退役为“honorable”或“under honorable conditions”

source_blocks.source_text_en: \ If your license or permit was issued before October 30, 2017 and is not Enhanced, you have a Standard document.
source_blocks.text: \ 如果您的驾照或许可证是在2017年10月30日之前签发且非Enhanced，则您持有Standard文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: \\ Boarding a domestic (U.S.) flight, and entering a Federal Building or Military Base (starting October, 2020)
source_blocks.text: \\ 登机国内（美国）航班，以及进入联邦大楼或军事基地（自2020年10月起）

source_blocks.source_text_en: \\\ U.S. Border Crossing from Canada, Mexico and some Caribbean countries
source_blocks.text: \\\ 从加拿大、墨西哥及部分加勒比国家进入美国边境

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [1].
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于Enhanced、REAL ID和Standard文件的信息 [1]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply at DMV office if you also want to change to an Enhanced or REAL ID
source_blocks.text: 如果您还想更换为Enhanced或REAL ID，请前往DMV办公室申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a Standard license and want to change to a REAL ID or Enhanced while adding your veteran status, you must come into a DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有Standard驾照，并希望在添加退伍军人身份的同时更换为REAL ID或Enhanced，您必须前往DMV办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification you need. You will also need to bring your proof of honorable discharge (original or photocopies).
source_blocks.text: 完成此指南以确保您拥有所需的身份证明。您还需要携带荣誉退役证明（原件或复印件）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find your proofs [2]
source_blocks.text: 查找您的证明 [2]

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send
source_blocks.text: 寄送

source_blocks.source_text_en: a completed Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [3] (MV-44) your proof of honorable discharge (send photocopies, your original documents)
source_blocks.text: 填写完整的许可证、驾驶执照或非驾驶员身份证申请表（pdf） [3] (MV-44) 您的荣誉退役证明（寄送复印件，原件请自行保留）

source_blocks.source_text_en: To
source_blocks.text: 至

source_blocks.source_text_en: DMV License Production Bureau Room 331, 6 Empire State Plaza Albany, NY 12228
source_blocks.text: DMV 驾照生产局 331 室，6 Empire State Plaza Albany, NY 12228

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot apply by phone or online.
source_blocks.text: 您不能通过电话或在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you applied to have the Veteran Indicator added to your license, permit or non-driver ID and were charged a document fee, you are entitled to a refund for the fee
source_blocks.text: 如果您申请将退伍军人标识添加到您的驾照、许可证或非驾驶员ID，并支付了文件费，您有权获得该费用的退款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A law has been enacted that permits us to refund a fee paid by a veteran in order to place a veteran indicator on their DMV document. You don't need to request a refund or visit a DMV office. Each eligible customer will get a letter and refund check from New York State.
source_blocks.text: 已颁布一项法律，允许我们退还退伍军人为在其DMV文件上添加退伍军人标识而支付的费用。您无需申请退款或前往DMV办公室。每位符合条件的客户将收到纽约州的信函和退款支票。

documents.doc_id: Vision requirements & restrictions#3_0
documents.source_title_en: Vision requirements & restrictions
documents.title: 视力要求与限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vision requirements & restrictions
source_blocks.text: 视力要求与限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must pass a vision test when you apply for a driver license or to renew your license. The test must show that you have visual acuity of at least 20/40 (based on the Snellen Visual Acuity Scale) in either or both eyes, with or without corrective lenses.
source_blocks.text: 申请驾照或更新驾照时，您必须通过视力测试。测试必须证明您单眼或双眼的视力至少达到20/40（基于Snellen视力表），无论是否佩戴矫正镜片。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may take a vision test at a DMV office or your vision test results may be submitted to DMV
source_blocks.text: 您可以在DMV办公室进行视力测试，或者将视力测试结果提交给DMV

source_blocks.source_text_en: electronically by a vision care provider enrolled in the DMV Online Vision Registry [1] (search by ZIP Code [2] for an enrolled provider), or by a Vision Test Report (PDF) [3] (MV-619) 1 completed by a - physician - physician's assistant - ophthalmologist - optometrist - optician - registered nurse - nurse professional
source_blocks.text: 由已注册DMV在线视力登记处[1]的视力保健提供者以电子方式提交（按邮政编码[2]搜索注册提供者），或 通过由以下人员填写的视力测试报告（PDF）[3]（MV-619）1： - 内科医生 - 助理医师 - 眼科医生 - 验光师 - 配镜师 - 注册护士 - 执业护士

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are mailing or bringing a Vision Test Report to DMV. It must be completed in English.
source_blocks.text: 如果您邮寄或亲自递交视力测试报告给DMV，报告必须用英文填写。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Restrictions related to driver vision
source_blocks.text: 与驾驶员视力相关的限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your eye exam indicates you must wear corrective lenses to pass the vision test, a "B" restriction will be placed on your driver license or learner permit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的眼科检查表明您必须佩戴矫正镜片才能通过视力测试，您的驾照或学习驾照将被标注“B”限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are also restrictions for drivers with low vision.
source_blocks.text: 对于低视力驾驶员也有相关限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: \- Telescopic lenses are corrective lenses that are much more powerful than normal eyeglasses or contact lenses. If you need telescopic lens to pass a vision test, you must send a completed Eye Test Report for Medical Review Unit (PDF) [4] form (MV-80L) to DMV's Medical Review Unit (MRU). A "TELESCOPIC LENSES" restriction will be placed on your driver license or learner permit. If you no longer need telescopic lenses, you can submit a new form MV-80L to remove the restriction. \- If an eye care professional indicates that your vision at night is impaired, a "DAYLIGHT DRIVING ONLY" restriction will be added your driver license or learner permit.
source_blocks.text: \- 望远镜式镜片是比普通眼镜或隐形眼镜放大倍数更高的矫正镜片。如果您需要望远镜式镜片才能通过视力测试，您必须将填写完整的《眼科检查报告（供医疗审查部门使用）》（PDF）[4]表格（MV-80L）发送至DMV的医疗审查部门（MRU）。您的驾照或学习驾照将被标注“TELESCOPIC LENSES”限制。如果您不再需要望远镜式镜片，您可以提交新的MV-80L表格以移除该限制。 \- 如果眼保健专业人员表明您的夜间视力受损，您的驾照或学习驾照将被添加“DAYLIGHT DRIVING ONLY”限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to remove a CORRECTIVE LENSES restriction
source_blocks.text: 如何移除“矫正镜片”限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must prove that you can pass a vision test without corrective lenses.
source_blocks.text: 您必须证明您无需矫正镜片即可通过视力测试。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remove the restriction online
source_blocks.text: 在线移除限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can remove online if your vision test provider must be enrolled in the DMV Online Vision Registry [1].
source_blocks.text: 如果您的视力测试提供者已注册DMV在线视力登记处[1]，您可以在线移除限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once an enrolled provider electronically notifies us that you can pass a vision test without corrective lenses, the restriction will be removed when you renew your license [5] online.
source_blocks.text: 一旦注册提供者以电子方式通知我们您无需矫正镜片即可通过视力测试，当您在线更新驾照[5]时，该限制将被移除。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remove the restriction at a DMV office
source_blocks.text: 在DMV办公室移除限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you renew or replace your DMV document at an office, you can take a vision test there or prove that you have meet our vision requirements by providing a Vision Test Report (PDF) [3] (MV-619) completed by a qualified eye care provider. 2
source_blocks.text: 当您在办公室更新或更换DMV证件时，您可以在那里进行视力测试，或通过提供由合格眼保健提供者填写的视力测试报告（PDF）[3]（MV-619）来证明您符合我们的视力要求。2

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your vision care provider is enrolled in the DMV Online Vision Registry [1] and has submitted your vision test results electronically to DMV, you will not need to submit proof or take a vision test.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的视力保健提供者已注册DMV在线视力登记处[1]并已将您的视力测试结果以电子方式提交给DMV，则您无需提交证明或进行视力测试。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Remove the restriction by mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄移除限制

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to remove a CORRECTIVE LENS restriction before it is time to renew your driver license, you must obtain proof that you do not need corrective lenses and order a replacement document. Proof can be submitted to DMV
source_blocks.text: 如果你想在更新驾照之前移除CORRECTIVE LENS限制，你必须获得不需要矫正镜片的证明，并订购一份替换文件。证明可以提交给DMV

source_blocks.source_text_en: electronically by a vision care provider enrolled in the DMV Online Vision Registry [1], or by a Vision Test Report (PDF) [3] (MV-619) 3 completed by a - physician - physician's assistant - ophthalmologist - optometrist - optician - registered nurse - nurse professional
source_blocks.text: 由已注册DMV Online Vision Registry [1] 的视力护理提供者以电子方式提交，或 由视力测试报告（PDF）[3]（MV-619）3完成，由以下人员填写 - 内科医生 - 医生助理 - 眼科医生 - 验光师 - 配镜师 - 注册护士 - 执业护士

source_blocks.source_text_en: To order a replacement document without the restriction, you must
source_blocks.text: 要订购无限制的替换文件，你必须

source_blocks.source_text_en: complete an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [6] (MV-44) pay a replacement document fee of \$12.50 provide a completed Vision Test Report (PDF) [3] (MV-619) if your eye care provider is not enrolled in the DMV Online Vision Registry
source_blocks.text: 完成一份许可证、驾照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表（PDF）[6]（MV-44） 支付\$12.50的替换文件费 如果你的眼保健提供者未注册DMV Online Vision Registry，则需提供一份完成的视力测试报告（PDF）[3]（MV-619）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail these items to your local DMV office.
source_blocks.text: 将这些材料邮寄到你当地的DMV办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Vision Test Report (MV-619) has a print date of 9/03 or earlier, the form is valid for 6 months after the date of the eye test. If the form has a print date of 3/04 or later, the vision care professional marks a box on the form to indicate if the form is valid for 6 months or for 12 months after the date of the eye test.
source_blocks.text: 如果视力测试报告（MV-619）的打印日期为9/03或更早，该表格在眼科检查日期后6个月内有效。如果表格的打印日期为3/04或更晚，视力护理专业人员会在表格上勾选一个方框，以表明该表格在眼科检查日期后6个月或12个月内有效。

source_blocks.text: 你的视力护理报告（MV-619）必须由以下人员完成

source_blocks.source_text_en: a physician - a physician's assistant - an ophthalmologist - an optometrist - an optician - a registered nurse - a nurse professional

If the form has a print date of 3/04 or later, the vision care professional marks a box on the form to indicate if the form is valid for 6 months or for 12 months after the date of the eye test.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Vision Test Report (MV-619) has a print date of 9/03 or earlier, the form is valid for 6 months after the date of the eye test. If the form has a print date of 3/04 or later, the vision care professional marks a box on the form to indicate if the form is valid for 6 months or for 12 months after the date of the eye test.

source_blocks.text: 为儿童（未满18岁）申请 | 残疾福利 | SSA

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Benefits \| Apply For A Child (Under Age 18)
source_blocks.text: 残疾福利 \| 为儿童（未满18岁）申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply for a child...
source_blocks.text: 要为儿童申请...

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will need to complete an Application for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) AND a Child Disability Report. The report collects information about the child's disabling condition and how it affects his/her ability to function.
source_blocks.text: 您需要填写一份补充保障收入（SSI）申请表和一份儿童残疾报告。该报告收集有关儿童残疾状况及其如何影响其功能能力的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At this time, only the Child Disability Report can be completed online. Please contact us by phone or in person to schedule an appointment to complete the SSI application. We will help you in person or by phone.
source_blocks.text: 目前，只有儿童残疾报告可以在线完成。请通过电话或亲自联系我们，预约时间完成SSI申请。我们将亲自或通过电话为您提供帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Steps to Apply
source_blocks.text: 申请步骤

source_blocks.source_text_en: REVIEW the Child Disability Starter Kit. This kit answers common questions about applying for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits for children, and includes a worksheet that will help you gather the information you need. CONTACT Social Security right away to find out whether the income and resources of the parents and the child are within the allowed limits, and to start the SSI application process. FILL OUT the online Child Disability Report. At the end of the report, we will ask you to sign a form that gives the child's doctor(s) permission to give us information about his/her disability. We need this information so that we can make a decision on the child's claim.
source_blocks.text: 查看儿童残疾入门套件。此套件解答了关于为儿童申请补充保障收入（SSI）福利的常见问题，并包含一个工作表，帮助您收集所需信息。 立即联系社会保障局，了解父母和子女的收入和资源是否在允许的限额内，并开始SSI申请流程。 填写在线儿童残疾报告。在报告结束时，我们会要求您签署一份表格，授权儿童的医生向我们提供有关其残疾的信息。我们需要这些信息以便对儿童的申请做出决定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you previously started a Child Disability Report but did not finish it, you can use your re-entry number to return to your online Child Disability Report.
source_blocks.text: 如果您之前开始填写儿童残疾报告但未完成，您可以使用重新进入号码返回在线儿童残疾报告。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not want to do this report online or you need help, you can call us toll-free at 1-800-772-1213. If you are deaf or hard-of-hearing, call our toll-free TTY number, 1-800-325-0778.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不想在线完成此报告或需要帮助，您可以拨打我们的免费电话1-800-772-1213。如果您失聪或听力困难，请拨打我们的免费TTY号码1-800-325-0778。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Representatives are available Monday through Friday between 8 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.
source_blocks.text: 代表可在周一至周五上午8点至下午5:30提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Starting your Social Security retirement benefits is a major step on your retirement journey. This page will guide you through the process of applying for retirement benefits when you re ready to take that step. Our online application is a convenient way to apply on your own schedule, without an appointment. You can also apply by phone or by appointment at a Social Security office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review Retirement Benefits Basics
source_blocks.text: Review Retirement Benefits Basics

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can start your retirement benefits as early as age 62 or as late as age 70. If you re preparing to apply for retirement benefits, knowing when you re eligible to apply and how the system works are the first steps in choosing what age is right for you. Before you submit an application, go to our Learn About Retirement Benefits page to understand:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Understand The Application Process

source_blocks.source_text_en: The retirement benefits application process follows these general steps, whether you apply online, by phone, or in person:
source_blocks.text: The retirement benefits application process follows these general steps, whether you apply online, by phone, or in person:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Gather the information and documents you need to apply. Complete and submit your application. We review your application and contact you if we need more information. We mail you a decision letter. You start receiving your retirement benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Early Can I Apply?
source_blocks.text: How Early Can I Apply?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply four months before you want your Social Security retirement benefits to start. If you want your benefits to start at age 62, you can apply at age 61 and eight months.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ll turn 65 within three months, you can use our online application to apply for Medicare and Social Security retirement benefits at the same time, or you can use it to apply for just Medicare. source_blocks.source_text_en: Applying online is the easiest way to complete your application at a time that works for you, without a trip to the Social Security office. You can also apply by phone or at a Social Security office. This section will tell you about the different options.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply Online
source_blocks.text: Apply Online

source_blocks.source_text_en: Follow these steps to apply online:
source_blocks.text: Follow these steps to apply online:

source_blocks.source_text_en: To start your application, go to our Apply for Benefits page, read and agree to the Terms of Service. Click Next. On that page, review the Getting Ready section to make sure you have the information you need to apply. Select Start A New Application. We will ask a few questions about who is filling out the application. You will then sign into your mySocial Security account or you will be prompted to create one. Complete the application.
source_blocks.text: To start your application, go to our Apply for Benefits page, read and agree to the Terms of Service. Click Next. On that page, review the Getting Ready section to make sure you have the information you need to apply. Select Start A New Application. We will ask a few questions about who is filling out the application. You will then sign into your mySocial Security account or you will be prompted to create one. Complete the application.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Watch our video, Welcome To Our Online Retirement/Medicare Application, for an overview of the process.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tips For Using The Online Application
source_blocks.text: Tips For Using The Online Application

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ve worked hard to make applying online as simple as possible while also keeping your information safe.
source_blocks.text: We ve worked hard to make applying online as simple as possible while also keeping your information safe.

source_blocks.source_text_en: For security reasons, the online application gives you a warning if you leave it open and don t do anything for 25 minutes. You can choose to extend your time on the page if you get this warning. However, after the third warning, you must move to another page or your information will not be saved.
source_blocks.text: For security reasons, the online application gives you a warning if you leave it open and don t do anything for 25 minutes. You can choose to extend your time on the page if you get this warning. However, after the third warning, you must move to another page or your information will not be saved.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here are more tips for using the online application:
source_blocks.text: Here are more tips for using the online application:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get stuck on a question, you can skip to the next question and come back later. You can save your application to finish another time if needed. Next time you sign in, go to Return to a Saved Application. You are not allowed to use periods, commas, or other special characters for some answers, including addresses. If you get a message about this, go back and enter the information without periods or other characters.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll have a chance to review your answers and make changes, if needed. Once you ve filled everything out, we ll ask you to confirm that your answers are true to the best of your knowledge. You can be held liable for intentionally providing false or misleading information.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The last step is to sign the online application by clicking Submit Now. You can check the status of your submitted application using a confirmation number we provide.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Helping Someone Else Apply Online
source_blocks.text: Helping Someone Else Apply Online

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may help someone else fill out their application, but you are not allowed to sign it for them. Only the person applying for benefits can legally sign the application. If they are not able to sign online, we will mail them a copy to sign. Read more about Helping Someone Apply Online.

source_blocks.text: Apply With Your Local Office

Although our offices are closed to the public, employees from those offices are assisting people by telephone. You can find the phone number for your local office by using our Field Office Locator and looking under Social Security Office Information. The toll-free Office number is your local office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check The Status
source_blocks.text: Check The Status

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can check the status of your application online using your personal mySocial Security account. If you are unable to check your status online, you can call us 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) from 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday through Friday.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appeal A Decision
source_blocks.text: Appeal A Decision

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have a right to appeal any decision we make about whether you re entitled to benefits. You must request an appeal in writing within 60 days of receiving our decision. There are four levels of appeal:
source_blocks.text: You have a right to appeal any decision we make about whether you re entitled to benefits. You must request an appeal in writing within 60 days of receiving our decision. There are four levels of appeal:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reconsideration by Social Security staff. A hearing before an administrative law judge. A review by Social Security s Appeals Council. A review by the federal courts.

source_blocks.text: Withdraw Your Application

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sometimes, life changes occur after you submit your application. You have up to 12 months to withdraw your application, if you change your mind. You will be required to repay any benefits you ve already received. Learn more about Withdrawing Your Social Security Retirement Application.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security Disability Insurance pays benefits to you and certain members of your family if you are "insured," meaning that you worked long enough and paid Social Security taxes.

source_blocks.text: 福利规划器 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits Planner
source_blocks.text: 福利规划器

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security can provide you, your spouse, and other eligible members of your family with benefits:
source_blocks.text: 社会保障可以为您、您的配偶以及其他符合条件的家庭成员提供以下福利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: when you retire; if you become disabled; and when you die.
source_blocks.text: 当您退休时； 如果您残疾；以及 当您去世时。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our planners to help you better understand your Social Security protection as you plan for your financial future. Then choose a benefit calculator to get estimates of benefits you and your family may be eligible for.
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的规划器，帮助您更好地了解您的社会保障保护，为您的财务未来做规划。然后选择福利计算器，估算您和您的家人可能符合条件的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply For Benefits Online
source_blocks.text: 在线申请福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to apply for retirement benefits, disability benefits, or just Medicare and you meet certain criteria, you can complete your application online.
source_blocks.text: 如果您想申请退休福利、残疾福利或仅申请医疗保险，并且您符合某些标准，您可以在线完成申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You will be asked to agree to a Terms of Service Agreement and create or log in to your personal my Social Security account. If we are not able to process your request, you will receive specific information on how to contact us by phone or schedule an appointment.
source_blocks.text: 您将被要求同意服务条款协议，并创建或登录您的个人我的社会保障账户。如果我们无法处理您的请求，您将收到具体信息，告知如何通过电话联系我们或预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are the spouse or divorced spouse of a retired or disabled worker, within 3 months of age 62 or older and you meet certain criteria, you can fill out your application for monthly benefits or just Medicare online.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退休或残疾工人的配偶或离婚配偶，在年满62岁或以上的3个月内，并且您符合某些标准，您可以在线填写月度福利或仅医疗保险的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information about ways to apply, visit
source_blocks.text: 有关申请方式的更多信息，请访问

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information about applying for Medicare only and delaying retirement benefits, visit
source_blocks.text: 有关仅申请医疗保险和延迟退休福利的更多信息，请访问

source_blocks.source_text_en: Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: 退休福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our Retirement Planner to learn:
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的退休规划器了解：

source_blocks.source_text_en: how you qualify for Social Security retirement benefits; about possible benefits you may be eligible for on someone else's record; which members of your family may get benefits based on your earnings record; and how and when you should apply.
source_blocks.text: 您如何符合社会保障退休福利的资格； 关于您可能基于他人记录符合条件的潜在福利； 您的哪些家庭成员可能基于您的收入记录获得福利；以及 您应如何以及何时申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Benefits
source_blocks.text: 残疾福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our Disability Planner to find out how you and your family may qualify for benefits if you become severely disabled before you qualify for retirement benefits.
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的残疾规划器，了解如果您在符合退休福利资格之前严重残疾，您和您的家人如何可能符合福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Even very young workers may already have earned disability protection. Learn more about work credits and how they affect disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: 即使是非常年轻的工人也可能已经获得了残疾保护。了解更多关于工作积分及其如何影响残疾福利的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Survivors Benefits
source_blocks.text: 遗属福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our Survivors Planner to learn:
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的遗属规划工具来了解：

source_blocks.source_text_en: how your family members are protected if you die or how you may qualify as a survivor on someone else's Social Security record.
source_blocks.text: 如果您去世，您的家人如何受到保护，或 您如何作为遗属，在他人社会保障记录下符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This protection is particularly important for young families with children. Even very young workers may have this protection. Learn more about work credits and how they affect survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 这项保护对于有子女的年轻家庭尤为重要。即使是年轻的劳动者也可能享有此保护。了解更多关于工作积分及其如何影响遗属福利的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Spouse's Benefits
source_blocks.text: 配偶福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Even if you never worked under Social Security, you may still qualify for benefits if you are the:
source_blocks.text: 即使您从未在社会保障制度下工作，如果您符合以下身份，您仍可能有资格获得福利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: spouse or divorced spouse of a retired worker; spouse or divorced spouse of a disabled worker; or widow/widower or surviving divorced spouse of a deceased worker.
source_blocks.text: 退休工人的配偶或离婚配偶； 残疾工人的配偶或离婚配偶；或 已故工人的遗孀/鳏夫或未再婚的离婚配偶。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Online Tools
source_blocks.text: 在线工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use one of our benefit calculators to help you plan to:
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的福利计算器之一来帮助您规划：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get your online with your personal my Social Security account to verify that your earnings are posted correctly and to get estimates of your future retirement, disability, and survivors benefits. If you already have enough Social Security credits to qualify for benefits, you can use our Retirement Estimator to get a personalized, instant estimate of your retirement benefits. You can enter different dates and ages to determine the best time for you to retire. If you want an estimate for survivors or disability benefits, or you do not already have enough Social Security credits to qualify for benefits, use one of our benefit calculators to estimate your future retirement, disability, and survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 使用您的个人我的社会保障账户在线获取信息，以核实您的收入记录是否正确，并获得您未来退休、残疾和遗属福利的估算。 如果您已有足够的社会保障积分符合福利资格，您可以使用我们的退休估算器获得个性化的即时退休福利估算。您可以输入不同的日期和年龄，以确定最适合您的退休时间。 如果您需要遗属或残疾福利的估算，或者您尚未积累足够的社会保障积分以符合福利资格，请使用我们的福利计算器之一来估算您未来的退休、残疾和遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security Credits
source_blocks.text: 社会保障积分

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must earn at least 40 Social Security credits to qualify for Social Security benefits. You earn Social Security credits when you work and pay Social Security taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您必须至少获得40个社会保障积分才有资格享受社会保障福利。当您工作并缴纳社会保障税时，您就能获得社会保障积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits does not affect the amount of benefits you receive. It only determines if you are eligible or not. You do not get extra benefits for earning more than the minimum number of credits.
source_blocks.text: 积分的数量不会影响您获得的福利金额。它只决定您是否有资格。如果您赚取的积分超过最低要求，您不会获得额外福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cannot pay benefits to you if you don t have enough credits. We use the amount of credits you ve earned to determine your eligibility for retirement or disability benefits, as well as your family s eligibility for survivors benefits when you die.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有足够的积分，我们无法向您支付福利。我们使用您已获得的积分数量来确定您是否有资格享受退休或残疾福利，以及您去世后您的家人是否有资格享受遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Credits Are Earned
source_blocks.text: 如何赚取积分

source_blocks.source_text_en: Since 1978, when you work and pay Social Security taxes, you earn up to a maximum of four credits per year.
source_blocks.text: 自1978年以来，当您工作并缴纳社会保障税时，您每年最多可获得四个积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Credits are based on your total wages and self-employment income for the year. You might work all year to earn four credits, or you might earn enough for all four in much less time.
source_blocks.text: 积分基于您当年的总工资和自雇收入。您可能全年工作才能赚取四个积分，或者您可能在更短的时间内赚够四个积分所需的收入。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of earnings it takes to earn a credit may change each year. In 2020, you earn one Social Security or Medicare credit for every \$1,410 in covered earnings each year. You must earn \$5,640 to get the maximum four credits for the year.
source_blocks.text: 赚取一个积分所需的收入金额每年可能变化。2020年，您每赚取1，410美元的受保收入，即可获得一个社会保障或医疗保险积分。您必须赚取5，640美元才能获得当年最多四个积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: During your lifetime, you might earn more credits than the minimum number you need to be eligible for benefits. These extra credits do not increase your benefit amount. The average of your earnings over your working years, not the total number of credits you earn, determines how much your monthly payment will be when you receive benefits.
source_blocks.text: 在您的一生中，您可能赚取的积分超过您有资格享受福利所需的最低数量。这些额外积分不会增加您的福利金额。您工作期间的平均收入，而不是您赚取的总积分数量，决定了您领取福利时每月支付金额的多少。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read our publication, "How You Earn Credits," for more information.
source_blocks.text: 阅读我们的出版物《您如何赚取积分》以获取更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Number Of Credits Needed For Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: 退休福利所需积分数量

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were born after 1928, you need 40 credits to qualify for retirement.
source_blocks.text: 如果您出生于1928年之后，您需要40个积分才有资格退休。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Number Of Credits Needed For Disability Benefits
source_blocks.text: 残疾福利所需积分数量

source_blocks.source_text_en: To be eligible for disability benefits, you must meet a recent work test and a duration work test.
source_blocks.text: 要获得残疾福利资格，您必须满足近期工作测试和持续时间工作测试。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits necessary to meet the recent work test depends on your age. The rules are as follows:
source_blocks.text: 满足近期工作测试所需的积分数量取决于您的年龄。规则如下：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before age 24 - You may qualify if you have 6 credits earned in the 3-year period ending when your disability starts. Age 24 to 31 In general, you may qualify if you have credit for working half the time between age 21 and the time you become disabled. As a general example, if you become disabled at age 27, you would need 3 years of work (12 credits) out of the past 6 years (between ages 21 and 27). Age 31 or older - In general, you must have at least 20 credits in the 10-year period immediately before you become disabled.
source_blocks.text: 24岁之前 - 如果您在残疾开始前的3年期间内赚取了6个积分，您可能有资格。 24岁至31岁 - 一般来说，如果您在21岁至残疾发生时间之间工作了一半时间，您可能有资格。作为一般示例，如果您在27岁时残疾，您需要在过去6年（21岁至27岁之间）中有3年工作（12个积分）。 31岁或以上 - 一般来说，您必须在残疾发生前的10年期间内至少拥有20个积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The following table shows how many years of work credits you need to meet the duration of work test based on your age when your disability began. For the duration of work test, your work does not have to fall within a certain period. The table only provides an estimate of how many work credits you need. It does not cover all situations. If you are statutorily blind, you must only meet the duration of work test. When statutory blindness is involved, there is not a recent work test requirement.
source_blocks.text: 下表显示了根据您残疾开始时的年龄，您需要多少年的工作积分才能满足持续时间工作测试。对于持续时间工作测试，您的工作不必在特定时期内。该表仅提供您需要多少工作积分的估计。它并未涵盖所有情况。如果您是法定失明，您只需满足持续时间工作测试。当涉及法定失明时，没有近期工作测试要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: This table is an estimate only and does not cover all situations
source_blocks.text: 注意：此表仅为估算，并不涵盖所有情况

source_blocks.source_text_en: Number Of Credits Needed For Survivors Benefits
source_blocks.text: 遗属福利所需积分数

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits needed for family members to be eligible for survivors benefits depends on your age when you die. The younger you are, the fewer credits needed. Nobody needs more than 40 credits.
source_blocks.text: 家庭成员有资格领取遗属福利所需的积分数取决于您去世时的年龄。您越年轻，所需积分越少。任何人所需积分不超过40个。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under a special rule, we can pay benefits to your children and your spouse caring for your children, even if your record doesn't have the number of credits needed. They can get benefits if you have credits for one and one-half year's work (6 credits)in the three years before your death.
source_blocks.text: 根据一项特殊规定，即使您的记录中没有所需的积分数，我们也可以向您的子女以及照顾您子女的配偶支付福利。如果您在去世前三年内有一年半的工作积分（6个积分），他们就可以领取福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are already receiving retirement or disability benefits at the time of your death, we will pay your survivors based on that entitlement. We will not have to determine your credits again.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在去世时已经在领取退休或残疾福利，我们将根据该资格向您的遗属支付福利。我们无需再次确定您的积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security Credits
source_blocks.text: 社会保障积分

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must earn at least 40 Social Security credits to qualify for Social Security benefits. You earn Social Security credits when you work and pay Social Security taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您必须至少获得40个社会保障积分才有资格享受社会保障福利。当您工作并缴纳社会保障税时，您就能获得社会保障积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits does not affect the amount of benefits you receive. It only determines if you are eligible or not. You do not get extra benefits for earning more than the minimum number of credits.
source_blocks.text: 积分的数量不会影响您获得的福利金额。它只决定您是否有资格。如果您赚取的积分超过最低要求，您不会获得额外福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cannot pay benefits to you if you don t have enough credits. We use the amount of credits you ve earned to determine your eligibility for retirement or disability benefits, as well as your family s eligibility for survivors benefits when you die.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有足够的积分，我们无法向您支付福利。我们使用您已获得的积分数量来确定您是否有资格享受退休或残疾福利，以及您去世后您的家人是否有资格享受遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits Planner: Disability \| You're Approved
source_blocks.text: 福利规划器：残疾 \| 您已获批

source_blocks.source_text_en: When Your Benefits Start
source_blocks.text: 您的福利何时开始

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your application is approved, your first Social Security benefit will be paid for the sixth full month after the date we find that your disability began.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的申请获批，您的第一笔社会保障福利将在我们认定您的残疾开始的日期之后的第六个整月支付。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example, if your disability began on June 15, 2018, your first benefit would be paid for the month of December 2018, the sixth full month of disability.
source_blocks.text: 例如，如果您的残疾始于2018年6月15日，您的第一笔福利将支付2018年12月，即残疾的第六个整月。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security benefits are paid in the month following the month for which they're due. This means that the benefit due for December would be paid to you in January 2019, and so on.
source_blocks.text: 社会保障福利在应支付月份的下一个月支付。这意味着12月应得的福利将在2019年1月支付给您，以此类推。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Much You Will Receive
source_blocks.text: 您将收到多少金额

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of your monthly disability benefit is based on your lifetime average earnings covered by Social Security.
source_blocks.text: 您的每月残疾福利金额基于您受社会保障覆盖的终身平均收入。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't already have an estimate, you can get your online with your personal my Social Security account or use our Benefit Calculators to determine how much you would get if you became disabled right now.
source_blocks.text: 如果您还没有估算，您可以使用您的个人我的社会保障账户在线获取，或使用我们的福利计算器来确定如果您现在残疾，您将获得多少。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other Payments May Affect Your Disability Benefits
source_blocks.text: 其他付款可能影响您的残疾福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive certain other government benefits, such as workers' compensation, public disability benefits, or pensions based on work not covered by Social Security (for example, some government or foreign employment), the Social Security benefits payable to you and your family may be reduced.
source_blocks.text: 如果您领取某些其他政府福利，如工伤赔偿、公共残疾福利或基于不受社会保障覆盖的工作的养老金（例如，一些政府或外国就业），您和您的家人可领取的社会保障福利可能会减少。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information about how these benefits can affect your Social Security payments, refer to the following publications:
source_blocks.text: 有关这些福利如何影响您的社会保障付款的更多信息，请参阅以下出版物：

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Workers' Compensation And Other Disability Payments May Affect Your Benefit; Windfall Elimination Provision; or Government Pension Offset.
source_blocks.text: 工伤赔偿和其他残疾付款如何影响您的福利； 意外收益消除条款；或 政府养老金抵消。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Related Information
source_blocks.text: 相关信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Income Taxes And Your Social Security Benefits.
source_blocks.text: 所得税和您的社会保障福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare Coverage If You're Disabled
source_blocks.text: 如果您残疾，医疗保险覆盖

source_blocks.source_text_en: We automatically enroll you in Medicare after you get disability benefits for two years. The two parts of Medicare we enroll you in are hospital insurance and medical insurance.
source_blocks.text: 在您获得残疾福利两年后，我们会自动为您注册医疗保险。我们为您注册的医疗保险的两个部分是医院保险和医疗保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hospital insurance (Part A) helps pay for inpatient hospital bills and some follow-up care. The taxes you paid while you were working financed this coverage, so it is provided at no cost to you. Medical insurance (Part B) helps pay doctors' bills, outpatient hospital care, and other medical services. You will need to pay a monthly premium for this coverage if you want it.
source_blocks.text: 医院保险（A部分）帮助支付住院医院账单和一些后续护理费用。您在工作期间缴纳的税款资助了这项保险，因此您无需支付费用。 医疗保险（B部分）帮助支付医生账单、门诊医院护理和其他医疗服务。如果您想要这项保险，您需要每月支付保费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most people have both parts of Medicare. If you have questions about this coverage, you can contact Medicare toll-free at 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227) to speak to a Medicare Customer Service Representative. TTY users should call 1-877-486-2048.
source_blocks.text: 大多数人都同时拥有Medicare的A部分和B部分。如果您对这些保障有疑问，可以拨打Medicare的免费电话1-800-MEDICARE（1-800-633-4227）与Medicare客户服务代表交谈。TTY用户应拨打1-877-486-2048。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Other Parts of Medicare
source_blocks.text: Medicare的其他部分

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare Advantage (Part C). People with Medicare Parts A and Part B can choose to receive all of their health care services through plans that are offered by private companies and approved by Medicare. For more information, we recommend you read Medicare's
source_blocks.text: Medicare Advantage（C部分）。拥有Medicare A部分和B部分的人可以选择通过私人公司提供且经Medicare批准的计划来获得所有医疗服务。如需更多信息，我们建议您阅读Medicare的

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prescription Drug Coverage (Part D) helps pay for medications doctors prescribe for treatment. For more information on the enrollment periods for Part D, we recommend you read Medicare's page.
source_blocks.text: 处方药保险（D部分）帮助支付医生为治疗而开具的药物费用。有关D部分注册期的更多信息，我们建议您阅读Medicare的页面。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive Medicare and have limited resources and income, you may be eligible for Extra Help with Medicare Prescription Drug Plan Costs.
source_blocks.text: 如果您享受Medicare但资源和收入有限，您可能有资格获得Medicare处方药计划费用的额外帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help For Low-Income Medicare Beneficiaries
source_blocks.text: 针对低收入Medicare受益人的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get Medicare and have low-income and few resources, your state may pay your Medicare premiums and, in some cases, other Medicare costs for which you are normally responsible such as deductibles and coinsurance.
source_blocks.text: 如果您享受Medicare且收入低、资源少，您的州可能会支付您的Medicare保费，在某些情况下，还会支付您通常需要承担的其他Medicare费用，如免赔额和共付额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Only your state can decide if you qualify for this assistance. To find out if you do, contact your state or local welfare office or Medicaid agency.
source_blocks.text: 只有您的州才能决定您是否有资格获得此项援助。要了解您是否符合条件，请联系您所在州或地方的福利办公室或Medicaid机构。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For additional information about the program, please go to the Medicare's page.
source_blocks.text: 有关该计划的更多信息，请访问Medicare的页面。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need additional information about the other parts of Medicare, please read the "Who Can Get Medicare?" section of our Medicare booklet or visit Medicare.gov.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要有关Medicare其他部分的更多信息，请阅读我们Medicare手册中的“谁能获得Medicare？”部分或访问Medicare.gov。
