source_blocks.text: 福利规划器：遗属 | 如何申请 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits Planner: Survivors \| How You Apply
source_blocks.text: 福利规划器：遗属 \| 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: We should be notified immediately when a person dies. However, you cannot report a death or apply for survivors benefits online.
source_blocks.text: 当有人去世时，应立即通知我们。但是，您不能在线报告死亡或申请遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In most cases, the funeral home will report the person s death to us. You should give the funeral home the deceased person s Social Security number if you want them to make the report.
source_blocks.text: 在大多数情况下，殡仪馆会向我们报告死亡情况。如果您希望殡仪馆代为报告，应向其提供逝者的社会保障号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to report a death or apply for benefits, call 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778). You can speak to a Social Security representative between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. Monday through Friday. You can also visit your local Social Security office. An appointment is not required, but if you call ahead and schedule one, it may reduce the time you spend waiting to speak to someone.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要报告死亡或申请福利，请拨打1-800-772-1213（TTY 1-800-325-0778）。您可以在周一至周五上午7点至下午7点与社会保障代表通话。您也可以访问当地的社会保障办公室。无需预约，但如果您提前致电并预约，可能会减少您等待与工作人员交谈的时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When You Report a Death
source_blocks.text: 报告死亡时

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are getting benefits on your spouse's or parent's record: - You generally will not need to file an application for survivors benefits. - We'll automatically change any monthly benefits you receive to survivors benefits after we receive the report of death. - We may be able to pay the Special Lump-Sum Death Payment automatically. If you are getting retirement or disability benefits on your own record: - You will need to apply for the survivors benefits. - We will check to see whether you can get a higher benefit as a widow or widower. If you are not getting benefits, you should apply for survivors benefits promptly because, in some cases, benefits may not be retroactive.
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在领取基于配偶或父母记录的福利： - 您通常无需提交遗属福利申请。 - 在我们收到死亡报告后，会自动将您每月领取的任何福利转换为遗属福利。 - 我们可能能够自动支付特别一次性死亡抚恤金。 如果您正在领取基于自己记录的退休或残疾福利： - 您需要申请遗属福利。 - 我们将核查您作为遗孀或鳏夫是否能获得更高的福利。 如果您目前未领取任何福利，您应及时申请遗属福利，因为在某些情况下，福利可能无法追溯。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Documents Needed to Apply
source_blocks.text: 申请所需文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please select the benefit you will be applying for from the list below to see what information and documents you may need when you apply:
source_blocks.text: 请从以下列表中选择您将申请的福利，以了解申请时可能需要的信息和文件：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Widows/Widowers or Surviving Divorced Spouse's Benefits Child's Benefits Mother's or Father's Benefits (You must have a child under age 16 or disabled in your care.) Lump-Sum Death Payment Parent's Benefits (You must have been dependent on your child at the time of his or her death.)
source_blocks.text: 遗孀/鳏夫或幸存离婚配偶福利 子女福利 母亲或父亲福利（您必须照顾未满16岁的子女或残疾子女。） 一次性死亡抚恤金 父母福利（您必须在子女去世时依赖其赡养。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't have all the documents you need, don't delay applying for Social Security.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有所需的所有文件，请不要延迟申请社会保障。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In many cases, your local Social Security office can contact your state Bureau of Vital Statistics and verify your information online at no cost to you. If we can't verify your information online, we can still help you get the information you need.
source_blocks.text: 在许多情况下，您当地的社会保障办公室可以联系您所在州的 vital statistics 部门，并免费在线核实您的信息。如果我们无法在线核实您的信息，我们仍可以帮助您获取所需信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Just as you plan for your family's protection if you die, you should consider the Social Security benefits that may be available if you are the survivor that is, the spouse, child, or parent of a worker who dies. That person must have worked long enough under Social Security to qualify for benefits.
source_blocks.text: Just as you plan for your family's protection if you die, you should consider the Social Security benefits that may be available if you are the survivor that is, the spouse, child, or parent of a worker who dies. That person must have worked long enough under Social Security to qualify for benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Your Spouse Earns Social Security Survivors Benefits
source_blocks.text: How Your Spouse Earns Social Security Survivors Benefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: A worker can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, your spouse can earn one credit for each \$1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When your spouse has earned \$5,440, they have earned their four credits for the year.
source_blocks.text: A worker can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, your spouse can earn one credit for each \$1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When your spouse has earned \$5,440, they have earned their four credits for the year.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits needed to provide benefits for survivors depends on the worker's age when they die. No one needs more than 40 credits (10 years of work) to be eligible for any Social Security benefit. But, the younger a person is, the fewer credits they must have for family members to receive survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: The number of credits needed to provide benefits for survivors depends on the worker's age when they die. No one needs more than 40 credits (10 years of work) to be eligible for any Social Security benefit. But, the younger a person is, the fewer credits they must have for family members to receive survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits can be paid to the worker's children and the surviving spouse who is caring for the children even if the worker doesn't have the required number of credits. They can get benefits if the worker has credit for one and one-half years of work (6 credits) in the three years just before their death. source_blocks.source_text_en: Widow Or Widower
source_blocks.text: Widow Or Widower

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are the widow or widower of a person who worked long enough under Social Security, you can:
source_blocks.text: If you are the widow or widower of a person who worked long enough under Social Security, you can:

source_blocks.source_text_en: receive full benefits at full retirement age for survivors or reduced benefits as early as age 60. If you qualify for retirement benefits on your own record, you can switch to your own retirement benefit as early as age 62. begin receiving benefits as early as age 50 if you are disabled and the disability started before or within seven years of the worker's death. If a widow or widower who is caring for the worker's children receives Social Security benefits, they're still eligible if their disability starts before those payments end or within seven years after they end. receive survivors benefits at any age, if you have not remarried and you take care of the deceased worker's child who is under age 16 or is disabled and receives benefits on the worker's record.

If you qualify for retirement benefits on your own record, you can switch to your own retirement benefit as early as age 62. begin receiving benefits as early as age 50 if you are disabled and the disability started before or within seven years of the worker's death. If a widow or widower who is caring for the worker's children receives Social Security benefits, they're still eligible if their disability starts before those payments end or within seven years after they end. receive survivors benefits at any age, if you have not remarried and you take care of the deceased worker's child who is under age 16 or is disabled and receives benefits on the worker's record.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you remarry after you reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), your remarriage will not affect your eligibility for survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you remarry after you reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), your remarriage will not affect your eligibility for survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse cannot apply online for survivors benefits. You should contact Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 to request an appointment. (If you are deaf or hard of hearing, call our TTY number at 1-800-325-0778.) If you wish to apply for disability benefits as a survivor, you can speed up the disability application process if you complete an Adult Disability Report and have it available at the time of your appointment. We use the same definition of disability for widows and widowers as we do for workers.

source_blocks.source_text_en: A few other situations:
source_blocks.text: A few other situations:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already receive benefits as a spouse, your benefit will automatically convert to survivors benefits after we receive the report of death. If you are also eligible for retirement benefits (but haven't applied yet), you have an additional option. You can apply for retirement or survivors benefits now and switch to the other (higher) benefit at a later date. For those already receiving retirement benefits, you can only apply for benefits as a widow or widower if the retirement benefit you receive is less than the benefits you would receive as a survivor. If you became entitled to retirement benefits less than 12 months ago, you may be able to withdraw your retirement application and apply for survivors benefits only. If you do that, you can reapply for the retirement benefits at a later date when they will be higher.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surviving Divorced Spouse
source_blocks.text: Surviving Divorced Spouse

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are the divorced spouse of a worker who dies, you could get benefits the same as a widow or widower, provided that your marriage lasted 10 years or more.
source_blocks.text: If you are the divorced spouse of a worker who dies, you could get benefits the same as a widow or widower, provided that your marriage lasted 10 years or more.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits paid to you as a surviving divorced spouse won't affect the benefit amount for other survivors getting benefits on the worker's record.
source_blocks.text: Benefits paid to you as a surviving divorced spouse won't affect the benefit amount for other survivors getting benefits on the worker's record.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you remarry after you reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), the remarriage will not affect your eligibility for survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are caring for a child under age 16 or disabled and gets benefits on the record of your former spouse, you would not have to meet the length-of-marriage rule. The child must be your former spouse's natural or legally adopted child.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify because you have the worker's child in your care, your benefit will affect the amount of the benefits of others on the worker's record.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Minor Or Disabled Child
source_blocks.text: Minor Or Disabled Child

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are the unmarried child under 18 (up to age 19 if attending elementary or secondary school full time) of a worker who dies, you can be eligible to receive Social Security survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you are the unmarried child under 18 (up to age 19 if attending elementary or secondary school full time) of a worker who dies, you can be eligible to receive Social Security survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: And you can get benefits at any age if you were disabled before age 22 and remain disabled.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Besides the worker's natural children, their stepchildren, grandchildren, or adopted children may receive benefits under certain circumstances.

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Parents
source_blocks.text: For Your Parents

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are the dependent parent, who is at least age 62, of a worker who dies, you may be eligible to receive Social Security survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you are the dependent parent, who is at least age 62, of a worker who dies, you may be eligible to receive Social Security survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must have been receiving at least half of your support from your working child and you must not be eligible to receive a retirement benefit that is higher than the benefit we could pay on your child s record. Generally, you must not have married after your deceased adult child s death; however, there are some exceptions.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Besides being the natural parent, you could also be the stepparent, or the adoptive parent if you became the deceased worker s parent before he or she was age 16.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Survivors Benefit Amount
source_blocks.text: Survivors Benefit Amount

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your survivors benefit amount is based on the earnings of the person who died. The more they paid into Social Security, the higher your benefits would be.
source_blocks.text: Your survivors benefit amount is based on the earnings of the person who died. The more they paid into Social Security, the higher your benefits would be.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The monthly amount you would get is a percentage of the deceased's basic Social Security benefit. It depends on your age and the type of benefit you are eligible to receive.
source_blocks.text: The monthly amount you would get is a percentage of the deceased's basic Social Security benefit. It depends on your age and the type of benefit you are eligible to receive.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the person who died was receiving reduced benefits, we base your survivors benefit on that amount.

source_blocks.source_text_en: These are examples of the benefits that survivors may receive:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Maximum Family Amount
source_blocks.text: Maximum Family Amount

source_blocks.source_text_en: There's a limit to the amount that family members can receive each month. The limit varies, but it is generally equal to between 150 and 180 percent of the basic benefit rate.
source_blocks.text: There's a limit to the amount that family members can receive each month. The limit varies, but it is generally equal to between 150 and 180 percent of the basic benefit rate.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the sum of the benefits payable to family members is greater than this limit, the benefits will be reduced proportionately. (Any benefits paid to a surviving divorced spouse based on disability or age won't count toward this maximum amount.)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other Things You Need To Know
source_blocks.text: Other Things You Need To Know

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are limits on how much survivors may earn while they receive benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits for a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse may be affected by several additional factors:
source_blocks.text: Benefits for a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse may be affected by several additional factors:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you remarry before you reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), you cannot receive benefits as a surviving spouse while you are married. If you remarry after you reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), you will continue to qualify for benefits on your deceased spouse's Social Security record. However, if your current spouse is a Social Security beneficiary, you may want to apply for spouse's benefits on their record. If that amount is more than your widow's or widower's benefit, you will receive a combination of benefits that equals the higher amount. If you receive benefits as a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse, you can switch to your own retirement benefit as early as age 62. This assumes you are eligible for retirement benefits and your retirement rate is higher than your rate as a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse. In many cases, a widow or widower can begin receiving one benefit at a reduced rate and then, at full retirement age, switch to the other benefit at an unreduced rate. If you will also receive a pension based on work not covered by Social Security, such as government or foreign work, your Social Security benefits as a survivor may be affected.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits Planner: Survivors \| Planning For Your Survivors
source_blocks.text: 福利规划器：遗属 \| 为您的遗属规划

source_blocks.source_text_en: As you plan for the future, you'll want to think about what your family would need if you should die now. Social Security can help your family if you have earned enough Social Security credits through your work.
source_blocks.text: 在规划未来时，您需要考虑如果自己现在去世，您的家人需要什么。如果您通过工作赚取了足够的社会保障积分，社会保障可以帮助您的家人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, you earn one credit for each \$1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When you have earned \$5,440, you have earned your four credits for the year.
source_blocks.text: 您每年最多可以获得四个积分。例如，在2019年，每赚取1,360美元的工资或自雇收入，您就获得一个积分。当您赚取5,440美元时，您就获得了当年的四个积分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits needed to provide benefits for your survivors depends on your age when you die. No one needs more than 40 credits (10 years of work) to be eligible for any Social Security benefit. But, the younger a person is, the fewer credits they must have for family members to receive survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 为您的遗属提供福利所需的积分数量取决于您去世时的年龄。任何人获得任何社会保障福利都不需要超过40个积分（10年工作）。但是，一个人越年轻，其家庭成员获得遗属福利所需的积分就越少。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits can be paid to your children and your spouse who is caring for the children even if you don't have the required number of credits. They can get benefits if you have credit for one and one-half years of work (6 credits) in the three years just before your death.
source_blocks.text: 即使您没有所需的积分数量，您的子女和照顾子女的配偶也可以获得福利。如果您在去世前的三年内有一年半的工作积分（6个积分），他们就可以获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Widow Or Widower
source_blocks.text: 为您的遗孀或鳏夫

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are about five million widows and widowers receiving monthly Social Security benefits based on their deceased spouse's earnings record. And, for many of those survivors, particularly aged women, those benefits are keeping them out of poverty.
source_blocks.text: 大约有五百万遗孀和鳏夫每月根据已故配偶的收入记录领取社会保障福利。而且，对于许多遗属，特别是老年女性，这些福利使她们免于贫困。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Widows and widowers can receive:
source_blocks.text: 遗孀和鳏夫可以领取：

source_blocks.source_text_en: reduced benefits as early as age 60 or full benefits at full retirement age or older. If widows or widowers qualify for retirement benefits on their own record, they can switch to their own retirement benefit as early as age 62. benefits as early as age 50 if they're disabled AND their disability started before or within seven years of your death. If a widow or widower who is caring for your children receives Social Security benefits, they're still eligible if their disability starts before those payments end or within seven years after they end. benefits at any age, if they have not remarried, and if they take care of your child who is under age 16 or disabled and receives benefits on your record. If a widow or widower remarries after they reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), the remarriage will not affect their eligibility for survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 最早在60岁时领取减额福利，或在完全退休年龄或以上领取全额福利。 如果遗孀或鳏夫符合根据自己记录领取退休福利的条件，他们最早可以在62岁时转为自己的退休福利。 如果他们残疾，并且残疾在您去世之前或去世后七年内开始，最早可以在50岁时领取福利。 如果照顾您子女的遗孀或鳏夫领取社会保障福利，如果他们的残疾在这些付款结束之前或结束后七年内开始，他们仍然有资格。 如果他们没有再婚，并且照顾您未满16岁或残疾并领取您记录福利的子女，可以在任何年龄领取福利。 如果遗孀或鳏夫在年满60岁（如果残疾则为50岁）之后再婚，再婚不会影响他们获得遗属福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Widows, widowers, and surviving divorced spouses cannot apply online for survivors benefits. They should contact Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) to request an appointment.
source_blocks.text: 遗孀、鳏夫和未再婚的遗属离婚配偶不能在线申请遗属福利。他们应致电社会保障局 1-800-772-1213（TTY 1-800-325-0778）预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If applying for disability benefits on a deceased worker s record, they can speed up the application process if they complete an Adult Disability Report and have it available at the time of their appointment.
source_blocks.text: 如果申请已故工人记录上的残疾福利，他们可以填写成人残疾报告并在预约时提供，以加快申请过程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We use the same definition of disability for widows and widowers as we do for workers.
source_blocks.text: 我们对遗孀和鳏夫使用与工人相同的残疾定义。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Surviving Divorced Spouse
source_blocks.text: 为您的未再婚的遗属离婚配偶

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a surviving divorced spouse, they could get the same benefits as your widow or widower provided that your marriage lasted 10 years or more.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有未再婚的遗属离婚配偶，只要您的婚姻持续了10年或以上，他们可以获得与您的遗孀或鳏夫相同的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your surviving divorced spouse qualifies for retirement benefits on their own record they can switch to their own retirement benefit as early as age 62.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的未再婚的遗属离婚配偶符合根据自己记录领取退休福利的条件，他们最早可以在62岁时转为自己的退休福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits paid to a surviving divorced spouse won't affect the benefit amounts your other survivors will receive based on your earnings record.
source_blocks.text: 支付给未再婚的遗属离婚配偶的福利不会影响您其他遗属根据您的收入记录获得的福利金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your surviving divorced spouse remarries after they reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), the remarriage will not affect their eligibility for survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的未再婚的遗属离婚配偶在年满60岁（如果残疾则为50岁）之后再婚，再婚不会影响他们获得遗属福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your former spouse is caring for your child who is under age 16 or disabled and gets benefits on your record, they will not have to meet the length-of-marriage rule. The child must be your natural or legally adopted child.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的前配偶正在照顾您未满16岁或残疾且根据您的记录领取福利的孩子，则他们无需满足婚姻持续时间规定。该孩子必须是您的亲生子女或合法收养的子女。

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, if they qualify for benefits as a surviving divorced mother or father who is caring for your child, their benefits may affect the amount of benefits your other survivors will receive based on your earnings record.
source_blocks.text: 然而，如果他们作为照顾您子女的遗属离婚母亲或父亲符合福利资格，他们的福利可能会影响您其他遗属根据您的收入记录所能获得的福利金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Children
source_blocks.text: 针对您的子女

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your unmarried children who are under 18 (up to age 19 if attending elementary or secondary school full time) can be eligible to receive Social Security benefits when you die.
source_blocks.text: 当您去世时，您未婚且未满18岁（若全日制就读小学或中学，则最高可至19岁）的子女可能有资格领取社会保障福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: And your child can get benefits at any age if they were disabled before age 22 and remain disabled.
source_blocks.text: 而且，如果您的子女在22岁之前残疾且持续残疾，则无论年龄多大都可以领取福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Besides your natural children, your stepchildren, grandchildren, step grandchildren or adopted children may receive benefits under certain circumstances. For further information, view our publication.
source_blocks.text: 除了您的亲生子女外，您的继子女、孙子女、继孙子女或收养子女在某些情况下也可能领取福利。如需更多信息，请查阅我们的出版物。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Your Parents
source_blocks.text: 针对您的父母

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must have been providing at least half of your parent s support and your parent must not be eligible to receive a retirement benefit that is higher than the benefit we could pay on your record. Generally, your parent also must not have married after your death; however, there are some exceptions.
source_blocks.text: 您必须至少承担了您父母一半的生活费，且您的父母不能有资格领取高于我们根据您的记录所能支付的退休福利。通常，您的父母在您去世后也不得再婚；但也有一些例外情况。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to your natural parent, your stepparent or adoptive parent may receive benefits if they became your parent before you were age 16.
source_blocks.text: 除了您的亲生父母外，您的继父母或养父母如果在您年满16岁之前成为您的父母，也可能领取福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Much Would Your Survivors Receive
source_blocks.text: 您的遗属能领取多少

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much your family could receive in benefits depends on your average lifetime earnings. The higher your earnings were, the higher their benefits would be. We calculate a basic amount as if you had reached full retirement age at the time you die.
source_blocks.text: 您的家庭能领取的福利金额取决于您的平均终身收入。您的收入越高，他们的福利就越高。我们会计算一个基本金额，就像您在去世时已达到完全退休年龄一样。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are already receiving reduced benefits when you die, survivors benefits are based on that amount.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在去世时已经在领取减额福利，遗属福利将基于该金额计算。

source_blocks.source_text_en: These are examples of monthly benefit payments:
source_blocks.text: 以下是每月福利支付的示例：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Widow or widower, full retirement age or older 100 percent of your benefit amount; Widow or widower, age 60 to full retirement age 71 to 99 percent of your basic amount; Disabled widow or widower, age 50 through 59 71 percent; Widow or widower, any age, caring for a child under age 16 75 percent; A child under age 18 (19 if still in elementary or secondary school) or disabled 75 percent; and Your dependent parent(s), age 62 or older: - One surviving parent 82 percent. - Two surviving parents 75 percent to each parent.
source_blocks.text: 遗孀或鳏夫，达到完全退休年龄或以上：您福利金额的100%； 遗孀或鳏夫，年龄在60岁至完全退休年龄之间：基本金额的71%至99%； 残疾遗孀或鳏夫，年龄在50岁至59岁之间：71%； 遗孀或鳏夫，任何年龄，照顾未满16岁的子女：75%； 未满18岁（若仍在读小学或中学则为19岁）或残疾的子女：75%；以及 您年满62岁或以上的受抚养父母： - 一位在世父母：82%。 - 两位在世父母：每位75%。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Percentages for a surviving divorced spouse would be the same as above.
source_blocks.text: 对于遗属离婚配偶，百分比与上述相同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There may also be a special lump-sum death payment.
source_blocks.text: 可能还有一笔特殊的一次性死亡抚恤金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Maximum Family Amount
source_blocks.text: 家庭最高金额

source_blocks.source_text_en: There's a limit to the amount that family members can receive each month. The limit varies, but it is generally equal to between 150 and 180 percent of the basic benefit rate.
source_blocks.text: 家庭成员每月能领取的金额有限制。该限额各不相同，但通常相当于基本福利费率的150%至180%之间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the sum of the benefits payable to family members is greater than this limit, the benefits will be reduced proportionately. (Any benefits paid to a surviving divorced spouse based on disability or age won't count toward this maximum amount.)
source_blocks.text: 如果应付给家庭成员的利益总和大于此限额，利益将按比例减少。（基于残疾或年龄支付给尚存离异配偶的任何利益不计入此最高金额。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get your online or check our Benefit Calculators for an estimate of the benefits your family could receive if you died right now.
source_blocks.text: 获取您的在线信息或查看我们的利益计算器，以估算如果您现在去世，您的家人可能获得的利益。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other Things You Need To Know
source_blocks.text: 您需要了解的其他事项

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are limits on how much survivors may earn while they receive benefits.
source_blocks.text: 对于遗属在领取利益期间能赚取多少有限制。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits for a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse may be affected by several additional factors:
source_blocks.text: 寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶的利益可能受到几个额外因素的影响：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If they remarry
source_blocks.text: 如果他们再婚

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse remarries before they reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), they cannot receive benefits as a surviving spouse while they're married.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶在年满60岁（若残疾则为50岁）之前再婚，他们在婚姻期间不能作为尚存配偶领取利益。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse remarries after they reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), they will continue to qualify for benefits on your Social Security record.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶在年满60岁（若残疾则为50岁）之后再婚，他们将继续有资格根据您的社会保障记录领取利益。

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, if their current spouse is a Social Security beneficiary, they may want to apply for spouse's benefits on their record. If that amount is more than the widow's or widower's benefit on your record, they will receive a combination of benefits that equals the higher amount.
source_blocks.text: 然而，如果他们当前的配偶是社会保障受益人，他们可能希望根据其记录申请配偶利益。如果该金额高于根据您的记录应得的寡妇或鳏夫利益，他们将获得等于较高金额的利益组合。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If they're eligible for retirement benefits on their own record
source_blocks.text: 如果他们自己有资格根据自身记录领取退休利益

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse receives benefits on your record, they can switch to their own retirement benefit as early as age 62. This assumes they're eligible for retirement benefits and their retirement rate is higher than their rate as a widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶根据您的记录领取利益，他们最早可在62岁时转为自己的退休利益。这假设他们有资格领取退休利益，且其退休费率高于作为寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶的费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In many cases, a widow or widower can begin receiving one benefit at a reduced rate and then, at full retirement age, switch to the other benefit at an unreduced rate.
source_blocks.text: 在许多情况下，寡妇或鳏夫可以开始以降低的费率领取一种利益，然后在完全退休年龄时转为以未降低的费率领取另一种利益。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Full retirement age for retirement benefits may not match full retirement age for survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 退休利益的完全退休年龄可能与遗属利益的完全退休年龄不同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If they will also receive a pension based on work not covered by Social Security
source_blocks.text: 如果他们还将领取基于非社会保障覆盖工作的养老金

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your widow, widower, or surviving divorced spouse will also receive a pension based on work not covered by Social Security, such as government or foreign work, their Social Security benefits as a survivor may be affected.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的寡妇、鳏夫或尚存离异配偶还将领取基于非社会保障覆盖工作的养老金，例如政府或外国工作，他们作为遗属的社会保障利益可能会受到影响。

source_blocks.source_text_en: As you plan for the future, you'll want to think about what your family would need if you should die now. Social Security can help your family if you have earned enough Social Security credits through your work.
source_blocks.text: As you plan for the future, you'll want to think about what your family would need if you should die now. Social Security can help your family if you have earned enough Social Security credits through your work.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, you earn one credit for each \$1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When you have earned \$5,440, you have earned your four credits for the year.
source_blocks.text: You can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, you earn one credit for each \$1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When you have earned \$5,440, you have earned your four credits for the year.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of credits needed to provide benefits for your survivors depends on your age when you die. No one needs more than 40 credits (10 years of work) to be eligible for any Social Security benefit. But, the younger a person is, the fewer credits they must have for family members to receive survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits can be paid to your children and your spouse who is caring for the children even if you don't have the required number of credits. They can get benefits if you have credit for one and one-half years of work (6 credits) in the three years just before your death.

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are about five million widows and widowers receiving monthly Social Security benefits based on their deceased spouse's earnings record. And, for many of those survivors, particularly aged women, those benefits are keeping them out of poverty.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Widows and widowers can receive:
source_blocks.text: Widows and widowers can receive:

source_blocks.source_text_en: reduced benefits as early as age 60 or full benefits at full retirement age or older. If widows or widowers qualify for retirement benefits on their own record, they can switch to their own retirement benefit as early as age 62. benefits as early as age 50 if they're disabled AND their disability started before or within seven years of your death. If a widow or widower who is caring for your children receives Social Security benefits, they're still eligible if their disability starts before those payments end or within seven years after they end. benefits at any age, if they have not remarried, and if they take care of your child who is under age 16 or disabled and receives benefits on your record. If a widow or widower remarries after they reach age 60 (age 50 if disabled), the remarriage will not affect their eligibility for survivors benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you moving, currently receiving benefits or enrolled in Medicare and want to know how to change your address? You can change and update your information anytime, anywhere by logging in to or creating a free my Social Security account.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get Social Security benefits (retirement, survivors, or disability), you can update your contact information in a safe, quick, and convenient way by following these five steps:
source_blocks.text: 如果您领取Social Security福利（退休、遗属或残疾），您可以通过以下五个步骤安全、快速、便捷地更新您的联系信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Log in to my Social Security. Select the My Profile link on the right side of the screen. source_blocks.source_text_en: Set Up or Change Your Direct Deposit of Benefit Payment
source_blocks.text: 设置或更改您的福利金直接存款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do you want to set up or change the direct deposit of your benefit payment? We are constantly expanding and improving our online services, including the ability to set up or change your direct deposit information. If you already receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits and you have a bank account, simply log in to or create your personal and secure my Social Security account.
source_blocks.text: 您是否想要设置或更改福利金的直接存款？我们正在不断扩展和改进我们的在线服务，包括设置或更改直接存款信息的功能。如果您已经领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI）福利，并且拥有银行账户，只需登录或创建您的个人安全 my Social Security 账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign inCreate your account
source_blocks.text: 登录创建您的账户

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is Direct Deposit?
source_blocks.text: 什么是直接存款？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Direct deposit is a simple, safe, and secure way to get benefits. If you need us to send your payment to a bank or credit union account, have all of the following information ready when you apply.
source_blocks.text: 直接存款是一种简单、安全且可靠的方式领取福利。如果您需要我们向银行或信用合作社账户发送款项，请在申请时准备好以下所有信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security number Bank routing transit number Account type (checking or savings) Account number
source_blocks.text: 社会保障号码 银行路由转账号码 账户类型（支票或储蓄） 账户号码

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to Set Up or Change Direct Deposit of Benefit Payment Online
source_blocks.text: 如何在线设置或更改福利金直接存款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Log in to your account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in and Select the blue Benefits & Payment Details link on the right side of the screen.
source_blocks.text: 登录并选择屏幕右侧蓝色的 Benefits & Payment Details 链接。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Scroll down and select the Update Direct Deposit button, and choose if you are the owner or co-owner of the bank account.
source_blocks.text: 向下滚动并选择 Update Direct Deposit 按钮，然后选择您是银行账户的所有者还是共同所有者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Enter your bank account information and select Next.
source_blocks.text: 输入您的银行账户信息并选择 Next。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review and verify your banking information and select Submit then select Done.
source_blocks.text: 查看并验证您的银行信息，选择 Submit，然后选择 Done。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also decide when your change will take effect, by simply using the My Profile tab within my Social Security.
source_blocks.text: 您还可以通过 my Social Security 中的 My Profile 标签来决定更改何时生效。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Don't have a my Social Security Account?
source_blocks.text: 没有 my Social Security 账户？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Creating a free my Social Security account takes less than 10 minutes, lets you set up or change your direct deposit and gives you access to many other online services.
source_blocks.text: 创建免费的 my Social Security 账户只需不到10分钟，您可以设置或更改直接存款，并访问许多其他在线服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn MoreSign Up
source_blocks.text: 了解更多注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional information related to this service
source_blocks.text: 与此服务相关的附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: As of March 1, 2013, you are required to receive your payments electronically. If you applied for benefits before that date and did not sign up for electronic payments at that time, we strongly urge you to do so now. For more information regarding switching to an electronic payment if you don t have a bank account, visit Treasury s Go Direct website or call the helpline at 1-800-333-1795.
source_blocks.text: 自2013年3月1日起，您需要以电子方式接收付款。如果您在该日期之前申请了福利，但当时未注册电子支付，我们强烈建议您现在进行注册。有关在没有银行账户的情况下切换到电子支付的更多信息，请访问Treasury的Go Direct网站或拨打帮助热线1-800-333-1795。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Still have questions?
source_blocks.text: 仍有疑问？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions or need help understanding how to set up or change direct deposit online, call our toll-free number at 1-800-772-1213 or visit your Social Security office. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, call our toll-free TTY number, 1-800-325-0778, between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. Monday through Friday.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有疑问或需要帮助了解如何在线设置或更改直接存款，请拨打我们的免费电话1-800-772-1213或访问您当地的Social Security办公室。如果您是聋人或听力障碍者，请在周一至周五上午7点至下午7点之间拨打我们的免费TTY号码1-800-325-0778。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Benefits | Social Security Administration
source_blocks.text: 残疾福利 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Benefits
source_blocks.text: 残疾福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about Disability Benefits
source_blocks.text: 了解残疾福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security pays disability benefits to people who can't work because they have a medical condition that's expected to last at least one year or result in death. Find out if you qualify and how Social Security can help you.
source_blocks.text: 社会保障向因医疗状况预计至少持续一年或导致死亡而无法工作的人支付残疾福利。了解您是否符合资格以及社会保障如何帮助您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: USE OUR DISABILITY PLANNER
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的残疾规划工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: Already Receiving Benefits
source_blocks.text: 已领取福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive Social Security disability benefits, you can get information and services for managing your benefits online.
source_blocks.text: 如果您领取社会保障残疾福利，您可以在线获取信息和服务来管理您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: MANAGE YOUR BENEFITS
source_blocks.text: 管理您的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you prefer to complete your application in a language other than English, the online application will give you the option to schedule an appointment to apply for benefits in your preferred language. The online application is currently only available in English.
source_blocks.text: 如果您希望用英语以外的语言完成申请，在线申请将为您提供预约以您首选语言申请福利的选项。目前在线申请仅提供英语版本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for Disability Return to a Saved Application Check Application or Appeal Status
source_blocks.text: 申请残疾福利 返回已保存的申请 检查申请或上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who can apply for adult disability benefits online?
source_blocks.text: 谁可以在线申请成人残疾福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use the online application to apply for disability benefits if you:
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合以下条件，可以使用在线申请申请残疾福利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are age 18 or older; Are not currently receiving benefits on your own Social Security record; Are unable to work because of a medical condition that is expected to last at least 12 months or result in death; and Have not been denied disability benefits in the last 60 days. If your application was recently denied, our Internet Appeal application is a starting point to request a review of the determination we made.
source_blocks.text: 年满18岁或以上； 目前未根据您自己的社会保障记录领取福利； 因预计至少持续12个月或导致死亡的医疗状况而无法工作；且 在过去60天内未被拒绝残疾福利。如果您的申请最近被拒绝，我们的互联网上诉申请是请求审查我们所作决定的起点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can now also file for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) online but only if you meet certain requirements. You are eligible to file online for SSI if you:
source_blocks.text: 您现在也可以在线申请补充保障收入（SSI），但仅当您满足某些要求时。如果您符合以下条件，则有资格在线申请SSI：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are between the ages of 18 and 65; Have never been married; Aren t blind; Are a U.S. citizen residing in one of the fifty states, District of Columbia, or the Northern Mariana Islands; Haven t applied for or received SSI benefits in the past; and Are applying for Social Security Disability Insurance at the same time as your SSI claim. Find out if you are eligible to receive Social Security Disability Benefits.
source_blocks.text: 年龄在18至65岁之间； 从未结婚； 不盲； 是美国公民，居住在五十个州、哥伦比亚特区或北马里亚纳群岛之一； 过去未申请或领取过SSI福利；且 在提交SSI申请的同时申请社会保障残疾保险。了解您是否有资格领取社会保障残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you finish the online process, a Social Security representative will contact you by telephone or by mail for any additional information needed for the applications.
source_blocks.text: 完成在线流程后，社会保障代表将通过电话或邮件与您联系，以获取申请所需的任何额外信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also schedule an appointment with a local Social Security office to file an application. Call 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday or contact your local Social Security office.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以预约当地社会保障办公室提交申请。请于周一至周五上午7点至下午7点致电1-800-772-1213（TTY 1-800-325-0778），或联系您当地的社会保障办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here is what you need to do to apply for benefits online:
source_blocks.text: 以下是在线申请福利所需执行的操作：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print and review the Adult Disability Checklist It will help you gather the information you need to complete the application. Complete the Disability Benefit Application.
source_blocks.text: 打印并查看《成人残障检查清单》。它将帮助您收集完成申请所需的信息。 填写《残障福利申请表》。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What information do I need to apply for benefits?
source_blocks.text: 申请福利需要提供哪些信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We suggest that you have the following information at hand. It will make completing the application much easier.
source_blocks.text: 我们建议您准备好以下信息。这将使填写申请变得更加容易。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information About You
source_blocks.text: 关于您的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your date and place of birth and Social Security number The name, Social Security number and date of birth or age of your current spouse and any former spouse. You should also know the dates and places of marriage and dates of divorce or death (if appropriate) Names and dates of birth of your minor children Your bank or other financial institution's Routing Transit Number [more info] and the account number, if you want the benefits electronically deposited
source_blocks.text: 您的出生日期、出生地点和社会安全号码 您现任配偶及任何前任配偶的姓名、社会安全号码及出生日期或年龄。您还应了解结婚日期和地点以及离婚或死亡日期（如适用） 您未成年子女的姓名和出生日期 如果您希望福利金以电子方式存入，需提供您的银行或其他金融机构的路由转账号码 [更多信息] 和账号

source_blocks.source_text_en: Information About Your Medical Condition
source_blocks.text: 关于您的医疗状况的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name, address and phone number of someone we can contact who knows about your medical conditions and can help with your application Detailed information about your medical illnesses, injuries or conditions: - Names, addresses, phone numbers, patient ID numbers and dates of treatment for all doctors, hospitals and clinics; - Names of medicines you are taking and who prescribed them; and - Names and dates of medical tests you have had and who sent you for them.
source_blocks.text: 我们可以联系的一位了解您病情并能够协助您申请的人的姓名、地址和电话号码 关于您的疾病、损伤或状况的详细信息： - 所有医生、医院和诊所的姓名、地址、电话号码、患者ID号和治疗日期； - 您正在服用的药物名称及开药医生；以及 - 您做过的医学检查的名称和日期，以及为您安排检查的医生。

source_blocks.text: 关于您的工作信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of money earned last year and this year The name and address of your employer(s) for this year and last year A copy of your The beginning and ending dates of any active U.S. military service you had before 1968 A list of the jobs (up to 5) that you had in the 15 years before you became unable to work and the dates you worked at those jobs Information about any workers' compensation, black lung, and/or similar benefits you filed, or intend to file for. These benefits can: - Be temporary or permanent in nature; - Include annuities and lump sum payments that you received in the past; - Be paid by your employer or your employer's insurance carrier, private agencies, or Federal, State or other government or public agencies; and - Be referred to as: 1. Workers' Compensation; 2. Black Lung Benefits; 3. Longshore and Harbor Workers' Compensation; 4. Civil Service (Disability) Retirement; 5. Federal Employees' Retirement; 6. Federal Employees' Compensation; 7. State or local government disability insurance benefits; or 8. Disability benefits from the military (This includes military retirement pensions based on disability but not Veterans' Administration (VA) benefits.)
source_blocks.text: 去年和今年的收入金额 您今年和去年雇主（们）的名称和地址 您的 您在1968年之前服过任何现役美国军队的开始和结束日期 在您无法工作之前的15年内从事过的工作（最多5份）清单，以及在这些工作上的工作日期 关于您已提交或打算提交的任何工人赔偿、黑肺和/或类似福利的信息。这些福利可以： - 是临时性或永久性的； - 包括您过去收到的年金和一次性付款； - 由您的雇主或雇主的保险公司、私人机构或联邦、州或其他政府或公共机构支付；以及 - 被称为： 1. 工人赔偿； 2. 黑肺福利； 3. 码头和港口工人赔偿； 4. 公务员（残障）退休； 5. 联邦雇员退休； 6. 联邦雇员赔偿； 7. 州或地方政府残障保险福利；或 8. 军队残障福利（这包括基于残障的军队退休金，但不包括退伍军人管理局（VA）福利。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What documents do I need to provide?
source_blocks.text: 我需要提供哪些文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may ask you to provide documents to show that you are eligible, such as:
source_blocks.text: 我们可能会要求您提供文件以证明您符合资格，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Birth certificate or other proof of birth; Proof of U.S. citizenship or lawful alien status if you were not born in the United States [more Info]; U.S. military discharge paper(s) if you had military service before 1968; W-2 forms(s) and/or self-employment tax returns for last year; Medical evidence already in your possession [more info]. This includes medical records, doctors' reports, and recent test results; and Award letters, pay stubs, settlement agreements or other proof of any temporary or permanent workers' compensation-type benefits you received [more info].
source_blocks.text: 出生证明或其他出生证明文件； 如果您不是在美国出生，需提供美国公民身份或合法外国人身份证明 [更多信息]； 如果您在1968年之前服过兵役，需提供美国军队退役证明文件； 去年的W-2表格和/或自雇纳税申报表； 您已有的医疗证据 [更多信息]。这包括医疗记录、医生报告和最近的检查结果；以及 您收到的任何临时或永久性工人赔偿类福利的获奖信、工资单、和解协议或其他证明 [更多信息]。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We accept photocopies of W-2 forms, self-employment tax returns or medical documents, but we must see the original of most other documents, such as your birth certificate. (We will return them to you.)
source_blocks.text: 我们接受W-2表格、自雇纳税申报表或医疗文件的复印件，但大多数其他文件（如出生证明）必须出示原件。（我们会将其退还给您。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do not delay applying for benefits because you do not have all the documents. We will help you get them.
source_blocks.text: 不要因为没有所有文件而延迟申请福利。我们将帮助您获取这些文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mailing Your Documents
source_blocks.text: 邮寄您的文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you mail any documents to us, you must include the Social Security number so that we can match them with the correct application. Do not write anything on the original documents. Please write the Social Security number on a separate sheet of paper and include it in the mailing envelope along with the documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果您将任何文件邮寄给我们，您必须附上社会安全号码，以便我们将其与正确的申请匹配。不要在原始文件上写任何内容。请将社会安全号码写在一张单独的纸上，并将其与文件一起放入邮寄信封中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not want to mail these documents, you may bring them to a Social Security office. Do not mail foreign birth records or any documents from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), formerly the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS), especially those you are required to keep with you at all times. These documents are extremely difficult, time-consuming and expensive to replace if lost. Some cannot be replaced. Instead, bring them to a Social Security office where we will examine them and return them to you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不想邮寄这些文件，您可以将其带到社会保障办公室。不要邮寄外国出生记录或国土安全部（DHS）（原移民和归化局（INS））的任何文件，尤其是那些要求您随时随身携带的文件。这些文件如果丢失，更换起来极其困难、耗时且昂贵。有些甚至无法更换。相反，请将它们带到社会保障办公室，我们将检查并退还给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the advantages of applying using our online disability application process?
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的在线残疾申请流程有哪些优势？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our online disability application process offers several advantages. You can:
source_blocks.text: 我们的在线残疾申请流程具有多项优势。您可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Start your disability claim immediately. There is no need to wait for an appointment. Apply from the convenience of your own home or on any computer. Stop and return to your saved application before submission. Avoid trips to a Social Security office. Complete the process online even if you live outside the United States.
source_blocks.text: 立即开始您的残疾索赔。无需等待预约。 在您自己家中或任何电脑上方便地申请。 在提交前，可以暂停并返回您已保存的申请。 避免前往社会保障办公室。 即使您居住在美国境外，也可以在线完成流程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I apply?
source_blocks.text: 申请后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: After we receive your online application, we will:
source_blocks.text: 在我们收到您的在线申请后，我们将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Provide confirmation of your application- either electronically or by mail. Review the application. Contact you by telephone or by mail if we need more information or documentation. Inform you if other family members may be able to receive benefits on your record, or if you may be able to receive benefits on another person s record, such as your spouse or your parent. Process your application. Mail our decision to you.
source_blocks.text: 提供申请确认——无论是电子方式还是邮寄方式。 审查申请。 如果我们需要更多信息或文件，将通过电话或邮件与您联系。 告知您其他家庭成员是否可能根据您的记录获得福利，或者您是否可能根据他人的记录（如您的配偶或父母）获得福利。 处理您的申请。 将我们的决定邮寄给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What other ways can I apply?
source_blocks.text: 我还可以通过哪些其他方式申请？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also apply:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以通过以下方式申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: By phone - Call us at 1-800-772-1213 from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday through Friday. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can call us at TTY 1-800-325-0778. In person - Visit your local Social Security office. (Call first to make an appointment.)
source_blocks.text: 电话：周一至周五上午7点至下午7点，拨打1-800-772-1213联系我们。如果您失聪或有听力障碍，可以拨打TTY 1-800-325-0778联系我们。 亲自前往：访问您当地的社会保障办公室。（请先致电预约。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not live in the U.S. or one of its territories you can also contact the nearest U.S. Social Security office, U.S. Embassy or consulate.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不住在美国或其领土，您也可以联系最近的美国社会保障办公室、美国大使馆或领事馆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You, or Your Family Members, May Be Eligible for Increased Benefits
source_blocks.text: 您或您的家人可能有资格获得增加的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our mission is to deliver Social Security services that meet the changing needs of the public.
source_blocks.text: 我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It's not unusual for a benefit recipient's circumstances to change after they apply or became eligible for benefits. If you, or a family member, receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income (SSI), certain life changes may affect eligibility for an increase in your federal benefits. For example, if your spouse or ex-spouse dies, you may become eligible for a higher Social Security benefit.
source_blocks.text: 福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To find out if you, or a family member, might be eligible for a benefit based on another person s work, or a higher benefit based on your own work, see the information about benefits on the Social Security website. You can also use the Benefit Eligibility Screening Tool (BEST) to find out if you could get benefits that Social Security administers. Based on your answers to questions, this tool will list benefits for which you might be eligible and tell you more information about how to qualify and apply.
source_blocks.text: 要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The questions and answers below are about a few of the life changes that could possibly increase your benefits.
source_blocks.text: 以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Has your spouse or ex-spouse died?
source_blocks.text: 您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your spouse or ex-spouse has died, you may be eligible for a higher survivor benefit based on his or her work. The death of an ex-spouse may allow you to be eligible for a higher survivor benefit even if you are already receiving a survivor benefit on another spouse.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you receiving Medicare benefits based on your work that includes at least 10 years of earnings from which you paid Social Security taxes?
source_blocks.text: 您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are at least age 65, you may be eligible for cash benefits on your own record. If you are full retirement age or older, you can work and receive your monthly Social Security benefits, no matter how much you earn. Please review this publication for more information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is your adult child who was helping to support you deceased?
source_blocks.text: 您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child had enough work credits and was providing at least half of your support, you may be eligible for a higher parent's benefit based on his or her work.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的父母福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you receiving Social Security benefits based on your spouse s work?
source_blocks.text: 您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have worked, you may be eligible for a higher retirement benefit based on your own work.
source_blocks.text: 如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you receiving Social Security benefits based on your parent s work?
source_blocks.text: 您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have worked, you may be eligible for a higher disability benefit based on your own work.
source_blocks.text: 如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you currently unmarried but formerly married for 10 years or more?
source_blocks.text: 您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are at least 62 years old and unmarried, you may be eligible for a benefit based on a former spouse s work if that marriage lasted 10 years or more.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is your child entitled to Social Security child's benefits based on your spouse's work?
source_blocks.text: 您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for spouse's benefits if you have in your care a child who is under age 16 or disabled prior to age 22.
source_blocks.text: 如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you currently entitled to retirement or disability benefits and have a child in your care who is under age 18 or disabled?
source_blocks.text: 您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child may be eligible for benefits based on your work.
source_blocks.text: 您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI) or Social Security benefits and have past military service?
source_blocks.text: 您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served in the U.S. military, you may be eligible for benefits through the Veterans Administration. Visit this link for more information: http://www.va.gov/
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信息：http://www.va.gov/

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and have a parent who is deceased or receiving Social Security benefits?
source_blocks.text: 您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are unmarried and under age 18 or were disabled prior to age 22, and your parent is deceased or receiving Social Security benefits, you may be eligible for child benefits based on your parent s work.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Has your income declined or have you experienced a loss of financial resources?
source_blocks.text: 您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get additional income through the Supplemental Security Income program, which helps seniors and the disabled who have limited income and financial resources.
source_blocks.text: 您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: IMPORTANT: If you are receiving benefits, there are certain life events that you are required to report. For a complete list, please select the publication below that applies to the type of benefits you receive.
source_blocks.text: 重要提示：如果您正在领取福利，有某些生活事件您必须报告。如需完整列表，请选择下方适用于您所领取福利类型的出版物。

source_blocks.source_text_en: NOTE: Failure to report a change may result in an overpayment.
source_blocks.text: 注意：未能报告变更可能导致多付款项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contacting Social Security
source_blocks.text: 联系社会保障局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our website is a valuable resource for information about all of Social Security's programs. There are a number of things you can do online.
source_blocks.text: 我们的网站是了解社会保障局所有计划信息的重要资源。您可以在线办理许多事项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In addition to using our website, you can call us toll-free at 1-800-772-1213. We treat all calls confidentially. We can answer specific questions from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. Generally, you ll have a shorter wait time if you call during the week after Tuesday. We can provide information by automated phone service 24 hours a day. (You can use our automated response system to tell us a new address or request a replacement Medicare card.) If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you may call our TTY number, 1-800-325-0778.
source_blocks.text: 除了使用我们的网站，您还可以拨打我们的免费电话1-800-772-1213。我们对所有通话保密。我们可以在周一至周五上午7点至下午7点回答具体问题。通常，如果您在周二之后的工作日打电话，等待时间会更短。我们通过自动电话服务全天24小时提供信息。（您可以使用我们的自动应答系统告知我们新地址或申请更换医疗保险卡。）如果您失聪或听力困难，您可以拨打我们的TTY号码1-800-325-0778。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also want to make sure you receive accurate and courteous service. That is why we have a second Social Security representative monitor some telephone calls.
source_blocks.text: 我们还希望确保您获得准确且礼貌的服务。因此，我们有第二位社会保障代表监听部分电话。

Read on to understand how Social Security fits into your retirement plan.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Retirement Benefits Work
source_blocks.text: How Retirement Benefits Work

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security replaces a percentage of a worker s pre-retirement income based on their lifetime earnings. The portion of your pre-retirement wages that Social Security replaces is based on your highest 35 years of earnings and varies depending on how much you earn and when you choose to start benefits.
source_blocks.text: Social Security replaces a percentage of a worker s pre-retirement income based on their lifetime earnings. The portion of your pre-retirement wages that Social Security replaces is based on your highest 35 years of earnings and varies depending on how much you earn and when you choose to start benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Social Security system works like this: when you work, you pay taxes into Social Security. We use the tax money to pay benefits to:
source_blocks.text: The Social Security system works like this: when you work, you pay taxes into Social Security. We use the tax money to pay benefits to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: People who have already retired. People who are disabled. Survivors of workers who have died. Dependents of beneficiaries.
source_blocks.text: People who have already retired. People who are disabled. Survivors of workers who have died. Dependents of beneficiaries.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The money you pay in taxes isn t held in a personal account for you to use when you get benefits. We use your taxes to pay people who are getting benefits right now. Any unused money goes to a Social Security trust fund that pays monthly benefits to you and your family when you start receiving retirement benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Planning For Retirement
source_blocks.text: Planning For Retirement

source_blocks.source_text_en: Planning is the key to creating your best retirement. You ll need to plan and save for years to achieve your retirement goals. While many factors affect retirement planning, we want you to understand what Social Security can mean to you and your family s financial future.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security Should Be Just One Part Of Your Retirement Plan
source_blocks.text: Social Security Should Be Just One Part Of Your Retirement Plan

source_blocks.source_text_en: On average, retirement beneficiaries receive 40% of their pre-retirement income from Social Security. As you make your retirement plan, knowing the approximate amount you will receive in Social Security benefits can help you determine how much other retirement income you ll need to reach your goals.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are You Eligible?
source_blocks.text: Are You Eligible?

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you work and pay Social Security taxes, you earn credits toward Social Security benefits. The number of credits you need to get retirement benefits depends on when you were born. If you were born in 1929 or later, you need 40 credits (usually, this is 10 years of work).
source_blocks.text: When you work and pay Social Security taxes, you earn credits toward Social Security benefits. The number of credits you need to get retirement benefits depends on when you were born. If you were born in 1929 or later, you need 40 credits (usually, this is 10 years of work).

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you stop working before you have enough credits to qualify for benefits, the credits will remain on your Social Security record. If you return to work later, more credits may be added. We can t pay any retirement benefits until you have 40 credits. Our retirement planner has additional details on how Social Security Credits work.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Verify Your Earnings History
source_blocks.text: Verify Your Earnings History

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of the Social Security benefits you or your family receives depends on the amount of earnings shown on your record. Regularly checking your Social Security earnings history can help ensure there are no surprises when it s time for you to start receiving benefits. You can find your earnings history on your annual Social Security Statement. Create a free mySocial Security account to check your earnings history online. See how at Get Your Social Security Statement.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deciding When To Start Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: Deciding When To Start Retirement Benefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: Choosing when to start receiving retirement benefits is a personal decision. If you choose to retire begin receiving benefits when you reach your full retirement age, you ll receive your full benefit amount. We will reduce your benefit amount if you retire start benefits before reaching full retirement age.
source_blocks.text: Choosing when to start receiving retirement benefits is a personal decision. If you choose to retire begin receiving benefits when you reach your full retirement age, you ll receive your full benefit amount. We will reduce your benefit amount if you retire start benefits before reaching full retirement age.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To make an informed choice, consider the following factors as you think about when to start your Social Security benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What Age Should You Start To Receive Benefits?
source_blocks.text: What Age Should You Start To Receive Benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The age you begin collecting your retirement benefit affects how much you will receive. There are three important things to know about age when thinking about when to start your benefits.
source_blocks.text: The age you begin collecting your retirement benefit affects how much you will receive. There are three important things to know about age when thinking about when to start your benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Full Retirement Age
source_blocks.text: Full Retirement Age

source_blocks.source_text_en: Full retirement age is the age when you will be able to collect your full retirement benefit amount. The full retirement age is 66 if you were born from 1943 to 1954. The full retirement age increases gradually if you were born from 1955 to 1960, until it reaches 67. For anyone born 1960 or later, full retirement benefits are payable at age 67. You can find your full retirement age by birth year in the full retirement age chart.

The full retirement age increases gradually if you were born from 1955 to 1960, until it reaches 67. For anyone born 1960 or later, full retirement benefits are payable at age 67. You can find your full retirement age by birth year in the full retirement age chart.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Early Retirement Age
source_blocks.text: Early Retirement Age

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get Social Security retirement benefits as early as age 62. However, your benefit is reduced if you start receiving benefits before your full retirement age. Understand how claiming retirement benefits early will affect your benefit amount.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Delayed Retirement Age
source_blocks.text: Delayed Retirement Age

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you delay collecting benefits beyond your full retirement age, the amount of your retirement benefit will continue to increase up until age 70. There is no incentive to delay claiming after age 70.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What Else Affects Your Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: What Else Affects Your Retirement Benefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: Everyone s retirement is unique. Beyond deciding when to begin receiving retirement benefits, other factors that can affect your benefits include whether you continue to work, what type of job you had, and if you have a pension from certain jobs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Continuing To Work
source_blocks.text: Continuing To Work

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can choose to keep working beyond your full retirement age. If you do, you can increase your future Social Security benefits. Each extra year you work adds another year of earnings to your Social Security record. Higher lifetime earnings can mean higher benefits when you choose to receive benefits.

Each extra year you work adds another year of earnings to your Social Security record. Higher lifetime earnings can mean higher benefits when you choose to receive benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Original Card for a Noncitizen Child
source_blocks.text: 非公民子女的原始卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) can apply for a Social Security number. If your child does not have permission to work but needs a Social Security number for other purposes, see "If your child does not have permission to work" for further information.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得国土安全部（DHS）工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您的子女没有工作许可但因其他目的需要社会保障号，请参阅“如果您的子女没有工作许可”以了解更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们无法接受影印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是最新的（未过期）。我们无法接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adoption
source_blocks.text: 收养

source_blocks.source_text_en: In some cases, we can assign your adopted child a number before the adoption is complete, but you may want to wait. Then, you can apply for the number using your child's new name. If you want to claim your child for tax purposes while the adoption is still pending, contact the Internal Revenue Service for Form W-7A, Application for Taxpayer Identification Number for Pending U.S. Adoptions. For more information, see Social Security Numbers For Children (Publication No. 05-10023).
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，我们可以在收养完成前为您的收养子女分配一个号码，但您可能希望等待。然后，您可以使用子女的新姓名申请号码。如果您希望在收养尚未完成时出于税务目的申报子女，请联系美国国税局获取W-7A表格，即待处理美国收养的纳税人识别号申请表。有关更多信息，请参阅《儿童社会保障号》（出版物编号05-10023）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immigration status
source_blocks.text: 移民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your child's U.S. immigration status, you must show us your child's current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为证明您子女的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示您子女当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa); I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport.
source_blocks.text: I-551（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）； I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）；或 I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境印章。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is an F-1 or M-1 student, we must see your child's I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是F-1或M-1学生，我们必须看到您子女的I-20（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must see your child's DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是J-1或J-2交流访问者，您必须看到您子女的DS-2019（交流访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. For most foreign workers, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得DHS工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。对于大多数外国工人，我们只需要看到I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境印章，显示允许工作的入境类别。一些外国工人必须出示DHS签发的I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 学生：如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将要从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要看到该就业的证据，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的雇主必须在信函上签名并注明日期。信函必须描述：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的受雇起始日期； 您正在或将工作的小时数；以及 您主管的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training (CPT), you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是获准参加课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，您必须向我们提供您的I-20表格，其中就业页需由您指定的学校负责人填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生并持有国土安全部（DHS）签发的工作许可证（I-766），您必须出示该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，您必须提供担保人的信函。信函应使用担保人信笺抬头，并带有授权您就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child does not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You do not need a number to conduct business with a bank, register for school, apply for educational tests, obtain private health insurance, apply for school lunch programs or apply for subsidized housing. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的孩子没有工作许可：合法入境的非公民可以在没有社会安全号码的情况下获得许多福利和服务。您无需号码即可与银行开展业务、注册入学、申请教育测试、购买私人健康保险、申请学校午餐计划或申请补贴住房。您不能仅为获得驾照而申请社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Government benefits or services: If your child does not have permission to work, the child may apply for a Social Security number only if:
source_blocks.text: 政府福利或服务：如果您的孩子没有工作许可，孩子仅在以下情况下可以申请社会安全号码：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A federal law requires your child to provide a Social Security number to get a particular benefit or service; or A state or local law requires you to provide your Social Security number to get general assistance benefits for which you already have qualified.
source_blocks.text: 联邦法律要求您的孩子提供社会安全号码才能获得特定福利或服务；或 州或地方法律要求您提供社会安全号码以获得您已有资格获得的公共援助福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child needs a number to meet these state or local requirements, you must bring us a letter from the government agency. It must be on letterhead stationery (no form letters or photocopies) and:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的孩子需要号码以满足这些州或地方要求，您必须向我们提供政府机构的信函。信函必须使用官方信笺抬头（不接受格式信函或复印件），并且：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Specifically identify your child as the applicant; Cite the law requiring your child to have a Social Security number; Indicate that your child meets all the agency's requirements, except having the number; and Contain an agency contact name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 明确指明您的孩子为申请人； 引用要求您的孩子拥有社会安全号码的法律； 表明您的孩子满足该机构的所有要求，但缺少号码；以及 包含机构联系人的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Taxes: If you need a number for your child for tax purposes and your child is not authorized to work in the United States, you can apply for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number for your child from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS). Visit IRS in person or call the IRS toll-free number, 1-800-TAXFORM (1-800-829-3676), and request Form W-7A (Application for Taxpayer Identification Number for Pending U.S. Adoptions).
source_blocks.text: 税务：如果您因税务目的需要为您的孩子获取一个号码，而您的孩子未获授权在美国工作，您可以向美国国税局（IRS）为您的孩子申请个人纳税人识别号。请亲自前往国税局或拨打国税局免费电话1-800-TAXFORM（1-800-829-3676），索取W-7A表格（待美国收养人纳税人识别号申请表）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are assigned a number for non-work purposes, you cannot use it to work. If you use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 如果您被分配了一个非工作用途的号码，您不能使用该号码工作。如果您使用该号码工作，我们将通知国土安全部（DHS）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Age
source_blocks.text: 年龄

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present your child's foreign birth certificate if you have it or can get it within 10 days. If not, we will consider other documents such as your child's passport or a document issued by DHS as evidence of your child's age.
source_blocks.text: 如果您持有或能在10天内获得您孩子的外国出生证明，您必须出示该证明。如果没有，我们将考虑其他文件，如您孩子的护照或DHS签发的文件，作为您孩子年龄的证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone age 12 or older requesting an original Social Security number must appear in person for an interview. We will ask for evidence to show that your child does not have a Social Security number. If your child lived outside the United States for an extended period, a current or previous passport, school and/or employment records, and any other record that would show long-term residence outside the United States could be used to show that your child does not have a Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 任何年满12岁或以上申请原始社会保障号码的人必须亲自参加面谈。我们将要求提供证据证明您的孩子没有社会保障号码。如果您的孩子在美国境外居住较长时间，可以使用当前或以前的护照、学校和/或就业记录以及任何其他能证明在美国境外长期居住的记录，来证明您的孩子没有社会保障号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: Social Security will ask to see your child's current DHS document. Acceptable documents include:
source_blocks.text: 您的孩子：社会保障局将要求查看您孩子当前的DHS文件。可接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录及未过期的外国护照；或 DHS签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child does not have a current DHS document, we can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names) and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: 如果您的孩子没有当前的DHS文件，我们只能接受某些文件作为您孩子身份的证明。可接受的文件必须显示您孩子的姓名、身份信息（如年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），并且最好有近期照片。如果非照片身份文件有足够的信息来识别孩子（如孩子的姓名和年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），我们通常可以接受。我们更希望看到孩子的美国护照。如果该文件不可用，我们可能接受孩子的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) can apply for a Social Security number. If your child does not have permission to work but needs a Social Security number for other purposes, see "If your child does not have permission to work" for further information.

source_blocks.source_text_en: In some cases, we can assign your adopted child a number before the adoption is complete, but you may want to wait. Then, you can apply for the number using your child's new name. If you want to claim your child for tax purposes while the adoption is still pending, contact the Internal Revenue Service for Form W-7A, Application for Taxpayer Identification Number for Pending U.S. Adoptions. For more information, see Social Security Numbers For Children (Publication No. 05-10023).

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. For most foreign workers, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child does not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.
