source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.

source_blocks.text: Certification of Report of Birth (DS-1350); Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240, CRBA); U.S. passport or Certificate of Citizenship (N-560/N-561).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: Identity

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: We can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names), and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth, or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: Your child: We can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names), and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth, or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:

source_blocks.source_text_en: State issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.
source_blocks.text: State issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.

source_blocks.text: Note

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity.
source_blocks.text: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity.

source_blocks.text: 了解获取社会保障卡需要哪些文件 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replacement Card for a Noncitizen Child
source_blocks.text: 非公民子女的补办卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can replace your child's Social Security card for free if it is lost or stolen. You are limited to three replacement cards in a year and 10 during a lifetime. Legal name changes and other exceptions do not count toward these limits. For example, changes in immigration status that require card updates may not count toward these limits. Also, you may not be affected by these limits if you can prove you need the card to prevent a significant hardship.
source_blocks.text: 如果孩子的社会保障卡丢失或被盗，您可以免费补办。每年最多补办三张，一生中最多补办十张。合法改名和其他例外情况不计入这些限制。例如，因移民身份变更而需要更新卡片的情况可能不计入这些限制。此外，如果您能证明需要该卡以避免重大困难，您可能不受这些限制的影响。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) can apply for a Social Security number. If your child does not have permission to work but needs a Social Security number for other purposes, see "If your child does not have permission to work" for further information.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得国土安全部（DHS）工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您的孩子没有工作许可但出于其他目的需要社会保障号，请参阅“如果您的孩子没有工作许可”以了解更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是最新的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immigration status
source_blocks.text: 移民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your child's U.S. immigration status, you must show us your child's current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为证明您孩子的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示您孩子当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa); I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport.
source_blocks.text: I-551（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）； I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）；或 I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is an F-1 or M-1 student, we must see your child's I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的孩子是F-1或M-1学生，我们必须看到您孩子的I-20（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must see your child's DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的孩子是J-1或J-2交换访问者，您必须出示您孩子的DS-2019（交换访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. For children with work-authorization, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. Some children must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得DHS工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。对于有工作授权的儿童，我们只需查看I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章，显示允许工作的入境类别。有些儿童必须出示DHS颁发的I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 学生：如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要看到该工作的证据，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的雇主必须签署并注明日期。信函必须描述：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的就业开始日期； 您正在或将工作的小时数；以及 您雇主的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training (CPT), you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是获授权参加课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，你必须向我们提供你的I-20表格，且就业页需由你的指定校方负责人填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是F-1学生并持有DHS签发的工作许可证（I-766），你必须出示该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，你必须提供担保人出具的函件。函件需使用担保人信笺纸，并带有授权你就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child does not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You do not need a number to conduct business with a bank, register for school, apply for educational tests, obtain private health insurance, apply for school lunch programs or apply for subsidized housing. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.
source_blocks.text: 如果你的孩子没有工作许可：合法入境的非公民无需社会安全号码即可获得许多福利和服务。你无需号码即可与银行办理业务、注册入学、申请教育测试、购买私人健康保险、申请学校午餐计划或申请补贴住房。你不能仅为获取驾照而申请社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Government benefits or services: If your child does not have permission to work, the child may apply for a Social Security number only if:
source_blocks.text: 政府福利或服务：如果你的孩子没有工作许可，仅在以下情况下，孩子可以申请社会安全号码：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A federal law requires your child to provide a Social Security number to get a particular benefit or service; or A state or local law requires you to provide your Social Security number to get general assistance benefits for which you already have qualified.
source_blocks.text: 联邦法律要求你的孩子提供社会安全号码才能获得特定福利或服务；或 州或地方法律要求你提供社会安全号码，以获得你已有资格获得的公共援助福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child needs a number to meet these state or local requirements, you must bring us a letter from the government agency. It must be on letterhead stationery (no form letters or photocopies) and:
source_blocks.text: 如果你的孩子需要号码以满足这些州或地方要求，你必须向我们提供政府机构的函件。函件必须使用信笺纸（不接受表格信或复印件），并且：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Specifically identify your child as the applicant; Cite the law requiring your child to have a Social Security number; Indicate that your child meets all the agency's requirements, except having the number; and Contain an agency contact name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 明确指明你的孩子为申请人； 引用要求你的孩子拥有社会安全号码的法律； 表明你的孩子符合该机构的所有要求，但缺少号码；以及 包含机构联系人姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Taxes: If you need a number for your child for tax purposes and your child is not authorized to work in the United States, you can apply for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number for your child from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS). Visit IRS in person or call the IRS toll-free number, 1-800-TAXFORM (1-800-829-3676), and request Form W-7A (Application for Taxpayer Identification Number for Pending U.S. Adoptions).
source_blocks.text: 税务：如果你出于税务目的需要为你的孩子申请号码，而你的孩子未获授权在美国工作，你可以向美国国税局（IRS）为你的孩子申请个人纳税人识别号（ITIN）。请亲自前往IRS或拨打IRS免费电话1-800-TAXFORM（1-800-829-3676），索取W-7A表格（待美国收养者纳税人识别号申请表）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are assigned a number for non-work purposes, you cannot use it to work. If you use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 如果你因非工作目的获得号码，你不能使用该号码工作。如果你使用它工作，我们将通知DHS。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: Social Security will ask to see your child's current DHS document. Acceptable documents include:
source_blocks.text: 你的孩子：社会保障局将要求查看你孩子当前的DHS文件。可接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录及未过期外国护照；或 DHS签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child does not have a current DHS document, we can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names) and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth or parents' names). If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: 如果你的孩子没有当前的DHS文件，我们只能接受某些文件作为你孩子身份的证明。可接受的文件必须显示你孩子的姓名、身份信息（如年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），最好附有近期照片。我们通常可以接受无照片的身份文件，只要该文件包含足够的信息来识别孩子（如孩子的姓名和年龄、出生日期或父母姓名）。如果该文件不可用，我们可能接受孩子的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: State-issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.
source_blocks.text: 州签发的非驾照身份证； 收养判决书； 医生、诊所或医院记录； 宗教记录； 学校或日托中心记录；或 学校身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 你：我们还必须查看你的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前的（未过期），并显示你的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须查看你的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州签发的非驾照身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果你没有这些特定文件之一，或无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发件，我们将要求查看其他文件。提交的任何文件（包括以下文件）必须是当前的（未过期），并显示你的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学校身份证； 健康保险卡（非Medicare卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not a U.S. citizen, Social Security will ask to see a current DHS document. Acceptable documents include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您不是美国公民，Social Security将要求查看当前的DHS文件。可接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport; I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录及未过期外国护照； DHS签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use a DHS work permit as proof of both immigration status and identity.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能使用一份文件用于两个目的。例如，我们可能使用DHS工作许可作为移民身份和身份证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your name because of marriage, divorce, court order, or any other reason, you need to tell Social Security so that you can get a corrected card. If you are working, you also need to tell your employer. If you do not tell us when your name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您因结婚、离婚、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改姓名，您需要告知社会保障局，以便获得更正卡。如果您在职，您还需要告知您的雇主。如果您在姓名变更时未告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prevent your wages from being posted correctly to your Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your future Social Security benefits. Cause delays when you file your taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您的工资无法正确记入您的社会保障记录，这可能会降低您未来社会保障福利的金额。 在您报税时造成延误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是最新的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have not already established your U.S. citizenship with us, we need to see proof of U.S. citizenship. We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未向我们确立您的美国公民身份，我们需要查看美国公民身份证明。我们只接受某些文件作为美国公民身份证明。这些包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. passport; Certificate of Naturalization (N-550/N-570); Certificate of Citizenship (N-560/N-561); Certificate of Report of Birth (DS-1350); Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240, CRBA).
source_blocks.text: 美国护照； 归化证书（N-550/N-570）； 公民证书（N-560/N-561）； 出生报告证书（DS-1350）； 海外出生领事报告（FS-240，CRBA）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: We require this documentation only if you have NOT already established U.S. citizenship with us.
source_blocks.text: 仅当您尚未向我们确立美国公民身份时，我们才要求提供此文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name Change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change your name on your Social Security card, you must show us proof of your legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove a legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改社会保障卡上的姓名，您必须向我们出示合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Marriage document; Divorce decree; Certificate of Naturalization showing the new name; or Court order approving the name change.
source_blocks.text: 结婚文件； 离婚判决书； 显示新姓名的归化证书；或 批准姓名变更的法院命令。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of a legal name change does not give us enough information to identify you in our records or if you changed your name more than two years ago (four years ago if you are under 18 years of age), you must show us an identity document in your prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的作为合法姓名变更证据的文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您，或者如果您更改姓名超过两年（如果您未满18岁，则为四年），您必须向我们出示您先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受您旧姓名下已过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your new name as long as we can properly establish your identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能正确确立您在我们记录中的身份，我们可能接受您新姓名下未过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can accept only certain documents as proof of identity. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see:
source_blocks.text: 我们只能接受某些文件作为身份证明。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须看到：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州颁发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。任何提交的文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好还有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（不是医疗保险卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your new card will have the same number as your previous card, but will show your new name. We will mail your card as soon as we have all of your information and have verified your documents.
source_blocks.text: 您的新卡将与您之前的卡号码相同，但会显示您的新姓名。一旦我们收到您的所有信息并核实您的文件，我们将尽快邮寄您的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corrected Card for a Noncitizen Adult
source_blocks.text: 非公民成人更正卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you change your name, become a U.S. citizen, or your immigration status or work authorization has changed, you need to tell Social Security so we can update our records and when necessary, issue a new card.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的姓名变更、成为美国公民，或者您的移民身份或工作许可发生变化，您需要告知社会保障局，以便我们更新记录，并在必要时签发新卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you request a replacement or a corrected Social Security card, you must show us proof of your identity, immigration status and work authorization. In addition, if you need to change or correct any information on your Social Security card, you need to show us certain documents about the change. We can only accept certain documents.
source_blocks.text: 当您申请补发或更正社会保障卡时，您必须向我们出示您的身份、移民身份和工作许可的证明。此外，如果您需要更改或更正社会保障卡上的任何信息，您需要向我们出示有关该变更的特定文件。我们只接受特定文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What documents do I need to prove my identity?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些文件来证明我的身份？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security will ask to see your current U.S. immigration documents. Acceptable documents include:
source_blocks.text: 社会保障局将要求查看您当前的美国移民文件。可接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport, or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551 永久居民卡 I-94 入境/离境记录，附有未过期的外国护照，或未过期外国护照上的入境章；或 来自国土安全部的 I-766 就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是当前有效的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能将一份文件用于两个目的。例如，我们可能将您的美国护照作为公民身份和身份的双重证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What other documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我还需要哪些其他文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name Change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your name because of marriage, divorce, court order, or any other reason, you should tell Social Security.
source_blocks.text: 如果您因结婚、离婚、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改姓名，您应告知社会保障局。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are working, you also need to tell your employer. If you do not tell us when your name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您在职，您还需要告知您的雇主。如果您在姓名变更时未告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prevent your wages from being posted correctly to your Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your future Social Security benefits. Cause delays when you file your taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您的工资无法正确记入您的社会保障记录，这可能会降低您未来社会保障福利的金额。 在您报税时造成延误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must show us proof of your legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove a legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 您必须向我们出示合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Marriage document; Divorce decree; Court order approving the name change; or
source_blocks.text: 结婚文件； 离婚判决书； 批准姓名变更的法院命令；或

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of a legal name change does not give us enough information to identify you in our records or if you changed your name more than two years ago (four years ago if you are under 18 years of age), you must show us an identity document in your prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您，或者如果您在两年多前（如果您未满18岁，则为四年前）更改了姓名，您必须向我们出示您先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受您旧姓名下已过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your new name, as long as we can properly establish your identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有以前姓名的身份证件，只要我们能根据记录正确确认您的身份，我们可能会接受您新姓名的未过期身份证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we assigned you a Social Security number for non-work purposes, special rules apply. If DHS did not authorize you to work, we will change your name on our records but we cannot issue you a corrected card. If you do not have permission to work, but need a Social Security card for other reasons, see "If you do not have permission to work" for further information. Remember that you cannot use a Social Security number assigned for non-work purposes to work. If you use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们为您分配了非工作用途的社会安全号码，则适用特殊规则。如果国土安全部未授权您工作，我们将更改我们记录中的姓名，但无法为您签发更正卡。如果您没有工作许可，但因其他原因需要社会安全卡，请参阅“如果您没有工作许可”以了解更多信息。请记住，您不能使用为非工作用途分配的社会安全号码去工作。如果您使用它去工作，我们将通知国土安全部。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we issue you a new card, it will have the same number as your previous card, but will show your new name. We will mail your card as soon as we have all of your information and have verified your immigration documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们为您签发新卡，其号码将与您之前的卡相同，但会显示您的新姓名。一旦我们收到您的所有信息并核实您的移民文件，我们将尽快寄出您的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immigration Status
source_blocks.text: 移民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your U.S. immigration status, you must show us your current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为证明您的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示您当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa); I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport. If you are an F-1 or M-1 student, you also must show us your I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: I-551表（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）； I-766表（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）；或 I-94表（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章。 如果您是F-1或M-1学生，您还必须向我们出示您的I-20表（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must show us your DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1或J-2交流访问者，您必须向我们出示您的DS-2019表（交流访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have DHS' permission to work can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see your I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in your unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. You may need to show your I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得国土安全部工作许可的非公民才能申请社会安全号码。如果您是外国工人，我们只需查看您的I-94表（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章，显示允许工作的入境类别。您可能需要出示国土安全部签发的I-766表（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are lawfully present in the United States and plan to apply for work authorization, you can apply for both work authorization from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) and request a Social Security card from the Social Security Administration at the same time. For more information on this process, read Apply For Your Social Security Number While Applying For Your Work Permit .
source_blocks.text: 如果您在美国合法居留并计划申请工作授权，您可以同时向国土安全部（DHS）下属的美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）申请工作授权，并向社会保障局申请社会安全卡。有关此流程的更多信息，请阅读《在申请工作许可证的同时申请您的社会安全号码》。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you submit evidence of lawful work-authorized status along with evidence of your name change, we can issue you a corrected card with your new name.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提交合法工作授权身份的证据以及姓名变更的证据，我们可以为您签发带有新姓名的更正卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student:
source_blocks.text: 学生：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要查看该工作的证据，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的主管必须在信函上签名并注明日期。信函必须描述：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的就业开始日期； 您正在或将工作的小时数；以及 您主管的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training, you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是获授权进行课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，您必须向我们提供您的I-20表格，其中就业页面需由您指定的学校负责人填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生并持有国土安全部（DHS）签发的工作许可证（I-766），您必须出示该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，您必须提供担保人出具的信函。信函应使用担保人信笺抬头，并带有授权您就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You do not need a number to conduct business with a bank, register for school, apply for educational tests, obtain private health insurance, apply for school lunch programs or apply for subsidized housing. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有工作许可：合法入境的非公民可以在没有社会安全号码的情况下获得许多福利和服务。您无需号码即可与银行进行业务往来、注册入学、申请教育测试、获得私人健康保险、申请学校午餐计划或申请补贴住房。您不能仅为获得驾照而申请社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have not already established your U.S. citizenship with us, we need to see proof of U.S. citizenship. We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未向我们证明您的美国公民身份，我们需要您出示美国公民身份的证明。我们只接受特定文件作为美国公民身份的证明。这些文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. passport; Certificate of Naturalization (N-550/N-570); Certificate of Citizenship (N-560/N-561); Certificate of Report of Birth (DS-1350); Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240, CRBA).
source_blocks.text: 美国护照； 归化证书（N-550/N-570）； 公民证书（N-560/N-561）； 出生报告证明（DS-1350）； 海外出生领事报告（FS-240，CRBA）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: We require citizenship documentation only if you are a U.S. citizen and you have NOT already established U.S. citizenship with us.
source_blocks.text: 我们仅要求您提供公民身份文件，如果您是美国公民且尚未向我们证明您的美国公民身份。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn what documents you will need to get a Social Security Card | Social Security Administration
source_blocks.text: 了解获取社会保障卡所需文件 | 社会保障管理局 (Social Security Administration)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corrected Card for a U.S. Born Adult
source_blocks.text: 美国出生成人的更正卡 (Corrected Card)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your name because of marriage, divorce, court order or any other reason, you need to tell Social Security so that you can get a corrected card. If you are working, also tell your employer. If you do not tell us when your name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您因结婚、离婚、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改姓名，您需要告知社会保障局 (Social Security)，以便获得更正卡。如果您在职，也请告知您的雇主。如果您在姓名变更时未告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prevent your wages from being posted correctly to your Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your future Social Security benefits. Cause delays when you file your taxes.
source_blocks.text: 您的工资无法正确计入您的社会保障记录，这可能会降低您未来的社会保障福利金额。 在您报税时造成延误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document. All documents must be current (not expired).
source_blocks.text: 我们无法接受复印件或公证副本。我们无法接受显示您已申请文件的收据。所有文件必须为当前有效（未过期）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能将一份文件用于两个目的。例如，我们可能将您的美国护照用作公民身份和身份证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have not already established your U.S. citizenship with us, we need to see proof of U.S. citizenship. We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include a U.S. birth certificate or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未向我们确立您的美国公民身份，我们需要查看美国公民身份证明。我们仅接受特定文件作为美国公民身份证明。这些包括美国出生证明或美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: This documentation is only required if you have NOT already established citizenship with us.
source_blocks.text: 仅当您尚未向我们确立公民身份时，才需要此文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change your name on your Social Security card, you must show us proof of your legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove a legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改社会保障卡上的姓名，您必须向我们出示合法姓名变更证明。社会保障局可能接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Marriage document; Divorce decree; Certificate of Naturalization showing the new name; or Court order approving the name change.
source_blocks.text: 结婚文件； 离婚判决书； 显示新姓名的入籍证书 (Certificate of Naturalization)；或 批准姓名变更的法院命令。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of a legal name change does not give us enough information to identify you in our records or if you changed your name more than two years ago (four years ago if you are under 18 years of age), you must show us an identity document in your prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您，或者您更名已超过两年（如果您未满18岁，则为四年），您必须出示旧姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受已过期的旧姓名身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your new name, as long as we can properly establish your identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有旧姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能正确确立您在记录中的身份，我们可能接受您新姓名的未过期身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can accept only certain documents as proof of identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 我们只接受特定文件作为身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，Social Security必须看到您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州签发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。任何提交的文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（不是Medicare卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your new card will have the same number as your previous card, but will show your new name. We will mail your card as soon as we have all of your information and have verified your documents.
source_blocks.text: 您的新卡将与旧卡号码相同，但会显示您的新姓名。一旦我们收到您的所有信息并核实您的文件，我们将尽快寄出您的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corrected Card for a Foreign Born U.S. Citizen Child
source_blocks.text: 外国出生的美国公民子女的更正卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your child's name because of adoption, court order or any other reason, you need to tell Social Security so that your child can get a corrected card. If your child is working, also tell your child's employer. If you do not tell us when your child's name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您因收养、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改子女的姓名，您需要告知社会保障局，以便您的子女获得更正卡。如果您的子女正在工作，也请告知其雇主。如果您在子女姓名变更时未告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Delay your tax refund or your child's refund; and Prevent your child's wages from being posted correctly to your child's Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your child's future Social Security benefits.
source_blocks.text: 延迟您的退税或子女的退税；以及 阻止子女的工资正确记入其社会保障记录，这可能会降低子女未来社会保障福利的金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们无法接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是最新的（未过期）。我们无法接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have not previously established your child's U.S. citizenship with us, we need to see proof of U.S. citizenship. We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您之前未向我们证明子女的美国公民身份，我们需要查看美国公民身份证明。我们仅接受特定文件作为美国公民身份证明。这些文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Certification of Report of Birth (DS-1350); Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240); U.S. passport; Certificate of Naturalization (N-550/N-570); or Certificate of Citizenship (N-560/N-561).
source_blocks.text: 出生报告证明（DS-1350）； 海外出生领事报告（FS-240）； 美国护照； 入籍证书（N-550/N-570）；或 公民证书（N-560/N-561）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change the name on your child's Social Security card, you must show us proof of your child's legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove your child's legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改子女社会保障卡上的姓名，您必须向我们出示子女合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受的文件以证明子女合法姓名变更包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Final adoption decree with the new name; Certificate of Naturalization showing the new name; or Court order approving the name change.
source_blocks.text: 带有新姓名的最终收养令； 显示新姓名的入籍证书；或 批准姓名变更的法院命令。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of your child's legal name change does not give us enough information to identify your child in our records or if you changed your child's name more than four years ago, you must show us an identity document in your child's prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your child's old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的子女合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您的子女，或者如果您更改子女姓名的时间超过四年，您必须向我们出示子女先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受已过期的子女旧姓名身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your child's prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your child's new name as long as we can properly establish your child's identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有子女先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能正确建立子女在我们记录中的身份，我们可能接受子女新姓名的未过期身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: We can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names) and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: 您的子女：我们仅接受特定文件作为子女身份的证明。可接受的文件必须显示子女的姓名、识别信息（即年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），并且最好附有近期照片。我们通常可以接受无照片的身份证明文件，只要其包含足够信息以识别子女（如子女的姓名和年龄、出生日期或父母姓名）。我们更倾向于查看子女的美国护照。如果该文件不可用，我们可能接受子女的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: State-issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.
source_blocks.text: 州签发的非驾驶员身份证； 收养令； 医生、诊所或医院记录； 宗教记录； 学校日托中心记录；或 学校身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 您：我们还必须查看您的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须看到您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州颁发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。提交的任何文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（不是医疗保险卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child's new card will have the same number as your child's previous card, but will show a new name. We will mail your child's card as soon as we have all of your child's information and have verified your child's documents.

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport, showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you submit evidence of lawful work-authorized status for your child along with evidence of name change, we can issue your child a corrected card with his or her new name.

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, if we assigned your child a Social Security number for non-work purposes, special rules apply. source_blocks.text: 了解获取社会保障卡需要哪些文件 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corrected Card for a Noncitizen Child
source_blocks.text: 非公民子女的更正卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your child's name because of adoption, court order or any other reason, you need to tell Social Security. If your child is working, also tell your child's employer. If you do not tell us when your child's name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您因收养、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改子女的姓名，您需要告知社会保障局。如果您的子女有工作，也请告知子女的雇主。如果您在子女姓名变更时未告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Delay your tax refund or your child's refund; and Prevent your child's wages from being posted correctly to your child's Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your child's future Social Security benefits.
source_blocks.text: 延迟您的退税或子女的退税；以及 阻止子女的工资正确记入子女的社会保障记录，这可能会降低子女未来社会保障福利的金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受影印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是当前有效的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immigration status
source_blocks.text: 移民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your child's U.S. immigration status, you must show us your child's current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为证明子女的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示子女当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa); I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport.
source_blocks.text: I-551表（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）； I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可）；或 I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is an F-1 or M-1 student, we must see your child's I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是F-1或M-1学生，我们必须看到子女的I-20（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must see your child's DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是J-1或J-2交流访问者，您必须出示子女的DS-2019（交流访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport, showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得DHS工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您是外国工人，我们只需要看到I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章，显示允许工作的入境类别。一些外国工人必须出示DHS签发的I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you submit evidence of lawful work-authorized status for your child along with evidence of name change, we can issue your child a corrected card with his or her new name.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提交子女合法工作授权身份的证据以及姓名变更的证据，我们可以为子女签发带有新姓名的更正卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, if we assigned your child a Social Security number for non-work purposes, special rules apply. If your child is not authorized to work by DHS, we will change your child's name on our records, but we cannot issue a corrected card. Your child cannot use a Social Security number assigned for non-work purposes to work. If your child does use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 但是，如果我们为子女分配了非工作目的的社会保障号，则适用特殊规则。如果子女未经DHS授权工作，我们将更改记录中子女的姓名，但我们无法签发更正卡。子女不能使用为非工作目的分配的社会保障号去工作。如果子女确实使用它去工作，我们将通知DHS。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 学生：如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要看到该工作的证明，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的上级必须在信上签名并注明日期。信函必须说明：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的受雇起始日期； 您正在或将工作的小时数；以及 您上级的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training (CPT), you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是获准参加课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，您必须向我们提供您的I-20表格，其中就业页需由您指定的校方官员填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生并持有国土安全部（DHS）签发的工作许可证（I-766），您必须出示该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，您必须提供担保人的信函。信函应使用担保人信笺抬头，并带有授权您就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change the name on your child's Social Security record, you must show us proof of your child's legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove your child's legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改子女社会保障记录上的姓名，您必须向我们出示子女合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明子女合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Final adoption decree with the new name; Court order approving the name change.
source_blocks.text: 包含新姓名的最终收养令； 批准姓名变更的法院命令。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of your child's legal name change does not give us enough information to identify your child in our records or if you changed your child's name more than four years ago, you must show us an identity document in your child's prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your child's old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的子女合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您的子女，或者您更改子女姓名的时间超过四年，您必须向我们出示子女先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受子女旧姓名下已过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your child's prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your child's new name, as long as we can properly establish your child's identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有子女先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能适当确认子女在我们记录中的身份，我们可能接受子女新姓名下未过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: Social Security will ask to see your child's current U.S. immigration document from DHS. Acceptable immigration documents include your child's:
source_blocks.text: 您的子女：社会保障局将要求查看您子女当前由国土安全部（DHS）签发的美国移民文件。可接受的移民文件包括您子女的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录，附有未过期外国护照或未过期外国护照中的入境章；或 国土安全部（DHS）签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 您：我们还必须查看您的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须查看您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州签发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。任何提交的文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); U.S. military identification card; or Doctor, clinic or hospital record.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（非Medicare卡）； 美国军人身份证；或 医生、诊所或医院记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not a U.S. citizen, Social Security will ask to see your current U.S. immigration document from DHS. Acceptable immigration documents include your:
source_blocks.text: 如果您不是美国公民，社会保障局将要求查看您当前由国土安全部（DHS）签发的美国移民文件。可接受的移民文件包括您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (includes machine-readable immigrant visa) with unexpired foreign passport; I-94 or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551表格（包括机器可读的移民签证）及未过期的外国护照； 未过期外国护照中的I-94或入境章；或 来自国土安全部的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we issue your child a new card, it will have the same number as your child's previous card, but will show a new name. We will mail your child's card as soon as we have all of your child's information and have verified your child's immigration documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们为您的孩子签发新卡，其号码将与您孩子之前的卡相同，但会显示新姓名。一旦我们收到您孩子的所有信息并核实其移民文件，我们将尽快邮寄您孩子的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your child's U.S. immigration status, you must show us your child's current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为证明子女的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示子女当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa); I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport.
source_blocks.text: I-551表（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）； I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可）；或 I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is an F-1 or M-1 student, we must see your child's I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是F-1或M-1学生，我们必须看到子女的I-20（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your child is a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must see your child's DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的子女是J-1或J-2交流访问者，您必须出示子女的DS-2019（交流访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see an I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport, showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得DHS工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您是外国工人，我们只需要看到I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章，显示允许工作的入境类别。一些外国工人必须出示DHS签发的I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you submit evidence of lawful work-authorized status for your child along with evidence of name change, we can issue your child a corrected card with his or her new name.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提交子女合法工作授权身份的证据以及姓名变更的证据，我们可以为子女签发带有新姓名的更正卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: However, if we assigned your child a Social Security number for non-work purposes, special rules apply. If your child is not authorized to work by DHS, we will change your child's name on our records, but we cannot issue a corrected card. Your child cannot use a Social Security number assigned for non-work purposes to work. If your child does use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 但是，如果我们为子女分配了非工作目的的社会保障号，则适用特殊规则。如果子女未经DHS授权工作，我们将更改记录中子女的姓名，但我们无法签发更正卡。子女不能使用为非工作目的分配的社会保障号去工作。如果子女确实使用它去工作，我们将通知DHS。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 学生：如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要看到该工作的证明，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的上级必须在信上签名并注明日期。信函必须说明：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的受雇起始日期； 您正在或将工作的小时数；以及 您上级的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training (CPT), you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是获准参加课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，您必须向我们提供您的I-20表格，其中就业页需由您指定的校方官员填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生并持有国土安全部（DHS）签发的工作许可证（I-766），您必须出示该证件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，您必须提供担保人的信函。信函应使用担保人信笺抬头，并带有授权您就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change the name on your child's Social Security record, you must show us proof of your child's legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove your child's legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改子女社会保障记录上的姓名，您必须向我们出示子女合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明子女合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Final adoption decree with the new name; Court order approving the name change.
source_blocks.text: 包含新姓名的最终收养令； 批准姓名变更的法院命令。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of your child's legal name change does not give us enough information to identify your child in our records or if you changed your child's name more than four years ago, you must show us an identity document in your child's prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your child's old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的子女合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息以在我们的记录中识别您的子女，或者您更改子女姓名的时间超过四年，您必须向我们出示子女先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受子女旧姓名下已过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your child's prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your child's new name, as long as we can properly establish your child's identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有子女先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能适当确认子女在我们记录中的身份，我们可能接受子女新姓名下未过期的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: Social Security will ask to see your child's current U.S. immigration document from DHS. Acceptable immigration documents include your child's:
source_blocks.text: 您的子女：社会保障局将要求查看您子女当前由国土安全部（DHS）签发的美国移民文件。可接受的移民文件包括您子女的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录，附有未过期外国护照或未过期外国护照中的入境章；或 国土安全部（DHS）签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 您：我们还必须查看您的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须查看您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州签发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。任何提交的文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); U.S. military identification card; or Doctor, clinic or hospital record.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（非Medicare卡）； 美国军人身份证；或 医生、诊所或医院记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not a U.S. citizen, Social Security will ask to see your current U.S. immigration document from DHS. Acceptable immigration documents include your:
source_blocks.text: 如果您不是美国公民，社会保障局将要求查看您当前由国土安全部（DHS）签发的美国移民文件。可接受的移民文件包括您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (includes machine-readable immigrant visa) with unexpired foreign passport; I-94 or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551表格（包括机器可读的移民签证）及未过期的外国护照； 未过期外国护照中的I-94或入境章；或 来自国土安全部的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we issue your child a new card, it will have the same number as your child's previous card, but will show a new name. We will mail your child's card as soon as we have all of your child's information and have verified your child's immigration documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们为您的孩子签发新卡，其号码将与您孩子之前的卡相同，但会显示新姓名。一旦我们收到您孩子的所有信息并核实其移民文件，我们将尽快邮寄您孩子的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn what documents you will need to get a Social Security Card | Social Security Administration
source_blocks.text: 了解申请社会保障卡需要哪些文件 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Corrected Card for a U.S. Born Child
source_blocks.text: 为美国出生的儿童更换更正卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you legally change your child's name because of adoption, court order or any other reason, you need to tell Social Security so that you can get a corrected card. If your child is working, also tell your child's employer. If you do not tell us when your child's name changes, it may:
source_blocks.text: 如果您因收养、法院命令或任何其他原因合法更改孩子的姓名，您需要告知社会保障局，以便获得更正卡。如果您的孩子有工作，也请告知孩子的雇主。如果您未在孩子姓名变更时告知我们，可能会导致：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Delay your tax refund or your child's refund; and Prevent your child's wages from being posted correctly to your child's Social Security record, which may lower the amount of your child's future Social Security benefits.
source_blocks.text: 延迟您的退税或孩子的退税；以及 阻止孩子的工资正确记入其社会保障记录，这可能会降低孩子未来社会保障福利的金额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们无法接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是当前有效的（未过期）。我们无法接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have not already established your child's U.S. citizenship with us, we need to see proof of U.S. citizenship. We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include a U.S. birth certificate or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未向我们证明您子女的美国公民身份，我们需要查看美国公民身份的证明。我们仅接受特定文件作为美国公民身份的证明。这些包括美国出生证明或美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: This documentation is only required if your child has NOT already established citizenship with us.
source_blocks.text: 仅当您的孩子尚未在我们这里确立公民身份时，才需要此文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name change
source_blocks.text: 姓名变更

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change the name on your child's Social Security card, you must show us proof of your child's legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove your child's legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改孩子社会保障卡上的姓名，您必须向我们出示孩子合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明孩子合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Final adoption decree with the new name; Court order approving the name change; or Amended birth certificate with the new name.
source_blocks.text: 包含新姓名的最终收养判决书； 批准姓名变更的法院命令；或 包含新姓名的修正出生证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of your child's legal name change does not give us enough information to identify your child in our records or if you changed your child's name more than four years ago, you must show us an identity document in your child's prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your child's old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的孩子合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息，使我们无法在记录中识别您的孩子，或者您更改孩子姓名的日期已超过四年，您必须向我们出示孩子先前姓名（如我们记录所示）的身份证明文件。我们将接受已过期的、使用孩子旧姓名的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your child's prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your child's new name, as long as we can properly establish your child's identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有孩子先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能妥善确认孩子在记录中的身份，我们可能接受使用孩子新姓名的未过期身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: We can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names) and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: 您的孩子：我们仅接受特定文件作为孩子身份的证明。可接受的文件必须显示孩子的姓名、身份识别信息（即年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），并最好附有近期照片。通常，如果非照片身份证明文件包含足够信息以识别孩子（如孩子的姓名和年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），我们也可以接受。我们更倾向于查看孩子的美国护照。如果无法提供该文件，我们可能接受孩子的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: State-issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.
source_blocks.text: 州政府签发的非驾驶员身份证； 收养令； 医生、诊所或医院记录； 宗教记录； 学校或日托中心记录；或 学校身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 您：我们还必须查看您的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须看到您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州政府签发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中一份文件的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。提交的任何文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学校身份证； 健康保险卡（不是医疗保险卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child's new card will have the same number as your child's previous card, but will show a new name. We will mail your child's card as soon as we have all of your child's information and have verified your child's documents.
source_blocks.text: 您孩子的新卡将具有与之前卡相同的号码，但会显示新姓名。一旦我们收到您孩子的所有信息并核实了您孩子的文件，我们将尽快邮寄您孩子的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to change the name on your child's Social Security card, you must show us proof of your child's legal name change. Documents Social Security may accept to prove your child's legal name change include:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要更改孩子社会保障卡上的姓名，您必须向我们出示孩子合法姓名变更的证明。社会保障局可能接受以证明孩子合法姓名变更的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Final adoption decree with the new name; Court order approving the name change; or Amended birth certificate with the new name.
source_blocks.text: 载有新姓名的最终收养判决书； 法院批准姓名变更的命令；或 载有新姓名的修正版出生证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the document you provide as evidence of your child's legal name change does not give us enough information to identify your child in our records or if you changed your child's name more than four years ago, you must show us an identity document in your child's prior name (as shown in our records). We will accept an identity document in your child's old name that has expired.
source_blocks.text: 如果您提供的孩子合法姓名变更证明文件未能提供足够信息，使我们在记录中识别您的孩子，或者您更改孩子姓名的日期已超过四年，您必须向我们出示孩子先前姓名（即我们记录中显示的姓名）的身份证明文件。我们将接受已过期的、使用孩子旧姓名的身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have an identity document in your child's prior name, we may accept an unexpired identity document in your child's new name, as long as we can properly establish your child's identity in our records.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有孩子先前姓名的身份证明文件，只要我们能妥善确认孩子在记录中的身份，我们可能接受使用孩子新姓名的未过期身份证明文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child: We can accept only certain documents as proof of your child's identity. An acceptable document must show your child's name, identifying information (i.e., age, date of birth, or parents' names) and preferably a recent photograph. We generally can accept a non-photo identity document if it has enough information to identify the child (such as the child's name and age, date of birth or parents' names). We prefer to see the child's U.S. passport. If that document is not available, we may accept the child's:
source_blocks.text: 您的孩子：我们仅接受特定文件作为孩子身份的证明。可接受的文件必须显示孩子的姓名、身份识别信息（即年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），并最好附有近期照片。通常，如果非照片身份证明文件包含足够信息以识别孩子（如孩子姓名和年龄、出生日期或父母姓名），我们也可以接受。我们更倾向于查看孩子的美国护照。如果该文件不可用，我们可能接受孩子的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: State-issued non-driver's identification card; Adoption decree; Doctor, clinic or hospital record; Religious record; School daycare center record; or School identification card.
source_blocks.text: 州政府签发的非驾照身份证； 收养令； 医生、诊所或医院记录； 宗教记录； 学校日托中心记录；或 学校身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You: We also must see proof of your identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 您：我们还必须查看您的身份证明。可接受的文件必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，Social Security 必须查看您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州政府签发的非驾照身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中一份文件的补发件，我们将要求查看其他文件。提交的任何文件，包括以下文件，必须是当前有效的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学校身份证； 健康保险卡（不是 Medicare 卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your child's new card will have the same number as your child's previous card, but will show a new name. We will mail your child's card as soon as we have all of your child's information and have verified your child's documents.
source_blocks.text: 您孩子的新卡将具有与您孩子之前的卡相同的号码，但会显示新姓名。一旦我们拥有您孩子的所有信息并核实了您孩子的文件，我们将尽快邮寄您孩子的卡。
