source_blocks.source_text_en: Original Card for a Foreign Born U.S. Citizen Adult
source_blocks.text: 外国出生的美国公民成人原始卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是最新的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Citizenship
source_blocks.text: 公民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can accept only certain documents as proof of U.S. citizenship. These include:
source_blocks.text: 我们仅接受特定文件作为美国公民身份的证明。这些文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. passport; Certificate of Naturalization (N-550/N-570); Certificate of Citizenship (N-560/N-561); Certificate of Report of Birth (DS-1350); Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240, CRBA).
source_blocks.text: 美国护照； 入籍证书（N-550/N-570）； 公民证书（N-560/N-561）； 出生报告证书（DS-1350）； 海外出生领事报告（FS-240，CRBA）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Age
source_blocks.text: 年龄

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present your foreign birth certificate if you have it or can get it within 10 days. If not, we will consider other documents such as your passport or a document issued by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) as evidence of your age.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有外国出生证明，或者能在10天内获得，则必须出示。如果没有，我们将考虑其他文件，如您的护照或国土安全部（DHS）签发的文件，作为年龄证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone age 12 or older requesting an original Social Security number must appear in person for an interview. We will ask for evidence to show you do not have a Social Security number. Here are examples of documents you can use to prove a Social Security number was never assigned:
source_blocks.text: 任何年满12岁或以上申请原始社会保障号码的人必须亲自参加面试。我们将要求提供证据，证明您没有社会保障号码。以下是可用于证明从未分配社会保障号码的文件示例：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you lived outside the United States for an extended period, a current or previous passport, school and/or employment records, and any other record that would show long-term residence outside the United States could be used to show you do not have a Social Security number. If you have lived in the United States and you are applying for an original Social Security number, we may ask you for information about the schools you attended or we may ask you to provide copies of tax records that would show you were never assigned a Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在美国境外居住较长时间，可以使用当前或以前的护照、学校和/或就业记录，以及任何其他能显示您长期居住在美国境外的记录，来证明您没有社会保障号码。 如果您曾居住在美国，并且正在申请原始社会保障号码，我们可能会要求您提供所就读学校的信息，或要求您提供税务记录副本，以证明您从未被分配社会保障号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can accept only certain documents as proof of identity. An acceptable document must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph. For example, as proof of identity Social Security must see your:
source_blocks.text: 我们仅接受特定文件作为身份证明。可接受的文件必须是最新的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片。例如，作为身份证明，社会保障局必须看到您的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: U.S. driver's license; State-issued non-driver identification card; or U.S. passport.
source_blocks.text: 美国驾照； 州签发的非驾驶员身份证；或 美国护照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have one of these specific documents or you cannot get a replacement for one of them within 10 days, we will ask to see other documents. Any documents submitted, including the following, must be current (not expired) and show your name, identifying information (date of birth or age) and preferably a recent photograph:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有这些特定文件之一，或者无法在10天内获得其中之一的补发，我们将要求查看其他文件。提交的任何文件，包括以下文件，必须是最新的（未过期），并显示您的姓名、身份信息（出生日期或年龄），最好附有近期照片：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employee identification card; School identification card; Health insurance card (not a Medicare card); or U.S. military identification card.
source_blocks.text: 员工身份证； 学生证； 健康保险卡（不是医疗保险卡）；或 美国军人身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use your U.S. passport as proof of both citizenship and identity. However, you must provide at least two separate documents.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能会将一份文件用于两种用途。例如，我们可能会使用您的美国护照作为公民身份和身份证明。但是，您必须至少提供两份单独的文件。

source_blocks.text: 了解获取社会保障卡需要哪些文件 | 社会保障管理局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Original Card for a Noncitizen Adult
source_blocks.text: 非公民成人的原始卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) can apply for a Social Security number. If you do not have permission to work but need a Social Security number for other purposes, see "If you do not have permission to work" for further information.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得国土安全部（DHS）工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您没有工作许可但因其他目的需要社会保障号，请参阅“如果您没有工作许可”以获取更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important
source_blocks.text: 重要

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present original documents or copies certified by the agency that issued them. We cannot accept photocopies or notarized copies. All documents must be current (not expired). We cannot accept a receipt showing you applied for the document.
source_blocks.text: 您必须出示原始文件或由签发机构认证的副本。我们不接受复印件或公证副本。所有文件必须是当前有效的（未过期）。我们不接受显示您已申请该文件的收据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What original documents do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要哪些原始文件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immigration status
source_blocks.text: 移民身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: To prove your U.S. immigration status, you must show us your current U.S. immigration document, such as:
source_blocks.text: 为了证明您的美国移民身份，您必须向我们出示您当前的美国移民文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Form I-551 (Lawful Permanent Resident Card, Machine Readable Immigrant Visa) with your unexpired foreign passport; I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit); or I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport.
source_blocks.text: I-551表（合法永久居民卡，机器可读移民签证）以及您未过期的外国护照； I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）；或 I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 or M-1 student, you also must show us your I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1或M-1学生，您还必须向我们出示您的I-20（非移民学生身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor, you must show us your DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status).
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1或J-2交流访问者，您必须向我们出示您的DS-2019（交流访问者身份资格证明）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work eligibility
source_blocks.text: 工作资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, only noncitizens who have permission to work from DHS can apply for a Social Security number. If you are a foreign worker, we only need to see your I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record) or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport showing a class of admission permitting work. Some foreign workers must show their I-766 (Employment Authorization Document, EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，只有获得DHS工作许可的非公民才能申请社会保障号。如果您是外国工人，我们只需要看到您的I-94（抵达/离境记录）或未过期外国护照上的入境章，显示允许工作的入境类别。一些外国工人必须出示DHS颁发的I-766（就业授权文件，EAD，工作许可证）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Student: If you are an F-1 student and eligible to work on campus, you must provide a letter from your designated school official that:
source_blocks.text: 学生：如果您是F-1学生且有资格在校内工作，您必须提供指定学校官员出具的信函，该信函需：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identifies you; Confirms your current school status; and Identifies your employer and the type of work you are, or will be, doing.
source_blocks.text: 确认您的身份； 确认您当前的学校状态；以及 确认您的雇主以及您正在或将要从事的工作类型。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also need to see evidence of that employment, such as a recent pay slip or a letter from your employer. Your supervisor must sign and date the letter. The letter must describe:
source_blocks.text: 我们还需要看到该就业的证据，例如最近的工资单或雇主的信函。您的 supervisor 必须在信函上签名并注明日期。信函必须描述：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your job; Your employment start date; The number of hours you are, or will be, working; and Your supervisor's name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 您的工作； 您的就业开始日期； 您正在或将要工作的小时数；以及 您 supervisor 的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student authorized to work in curricular practical training (CPT), you must provide us your Form I-20 with the employment page completed and signed by your designated school official.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是获准进行课程实习训练（CPT）的F-1学生，您必须向我们提供您的I-20表，其中就业页面已由您的指定学校官员填写并签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are an F-1 student and have a work permit (I-766) from DHS, you must present it.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是F-1学生并持有DHS签发的工作许可（I-766），则必须出示该许可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are a J-1 student, student intern or international visitor, you must provide a letter from your sponsor. The letter should be on sponsor letterhead with an original signature that authorizes your employment.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是J-1学生、学生实习生或国际访客，则必须提供担保人出具的函件。该函件应使用担保人信笺抬头，并带有授权您就业的原始签名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not have permission to work: Lawfully admitted noncitizens can get many benefits and services without a Social Security number. You do not need a number to conduct business with a bank, register for school, apply for educational tests, obtain private health insurance, apply for school lunch programs or apply for subsidized housing. You cannot get a Social Security number for the sole purpose of obtaining a driver's license.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有工作许可：合法入境的非公民无需社会安全号码即可获得许多福利和服务。您无需号码即可与银行办理业务、注册学校、申请教育测试、购买私人健康保险、申请学校午餐计划或申请补贴住房。您不能仅为获得驾照而申请社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Government benefits or services: If you do not have permission to work, you may apply for a Social Security number only if:
source_blocks.text: 政府福利或服务：如果您没有工作许可，仅在以下情况下可以申请社会安全号码：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A federal law requires you to provide your Social Security number to get a particular benefit or service; or A state or local law requires you to provide your Social Security number to get general assistance benefits for which you already have qualified.
source_blocks.text: 联邦法律要求您提供社会安全号码才能获得特定福利或服务；或 州或地方法律要求您提供社会安全号码才能获得您已有资格获得的一般援助福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need a number to meet these state or local requirements, you must bring us a letter from the government agency. It must be on letterhead stationery (no form letters or photocopies) and:
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要号码以满足这些州或地方要求，您必须向我们提供政府机构的函件。该函件必须使用信笺抬头（不接受表格信函或复印件），并且：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Specifically identify you as the applicant; Cite the law requiring you to have a Social Security number; Indicate that you meet all the agency's requirements, except having the number; and Contain an agency contact name and telephone number.
source_blocks.text: 明确指明您为申请人； 引用要求您拥有社会安全号码的法律； 表明您满足该机构的所有要求，但拥有号码除外；以及 包含机构联系人的姓名和电话号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Taxes: If you need a number for tax purposes and you are not authorized to work in the United States, you can apply for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS). Visit IRS in person or call the IRS toll-free number, 1-800-TAXFORM (1-800-829-3676), and request Form W-7 (Application for IRS Individual Taxpayer Identification Number).
source_blocks.text: 税务：如果您因税务目的需要号码但未获授权在美国工作，您可以向国内税务局（IRS）申请个人纳税人识别号。请亲自前往IRS或拨打IRS免费电话1-800-TAXFORM（1-800-829-3676），并索取W-7表格（IRS个人纳税人识别号申请表）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are assigned a number for non-work purposes, you cannot use it to work. If you use it to work, we will inform DHS.
source_blocks.text: 如果您因非工作目的获得号码，则不能将其用于工作。如果您将其用于工作，我们将通知DHS。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Age
source_blocks.text: 年龄

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must present your foreign birth certificate if you have it or can get it within 10 days. If not, we will consider other documents such as your passport or a document issued by DHS as evidence of your age.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有外国出生证明或能在10天内获得，则必须出示。如果没有，我们将考虑其他文件，如护照或DHS签发的文件，作为年龄证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone age 12 or older requesting an original Social Security number MUST be interviewed by Social Security. We will ask for evidence to show you do not have a Social Security number. If you lived outside the United States for an extended period, a current or previous passport, school and/or employment records, and any other record that would show long-term residence outside the United States could be used to show you do not have a Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 任何年满12岁或以上申请原始社会安全号码的人必须接受社会保障局的面试。我们将要求提供证据以证明您没有社会安全号码。如果您在美国境外居住较长时间，当前或以前的护照、学校和/或就业记录以及任何其他能显示在美国境外长期居住的记录，都可用于证明您没有社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity
source_blocks.text: 身份

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security will ask to see a current DHS document. Acceptable documents include:
source_blocks.text: 社会保障局将要求查看当前的DHS文件。可接受的文件包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: I-551 Permanent Resident Card; I-94 Arrival/Departure Record with unexpired foreign passport or admission stamp in the unexpired foreign passport; or I-766 Employment Authorization Document, (EAD, work permit) from DHS.
source_blocks.text: I-551永久居民卡； I-94入境/离境记录，附有未过期外国护照或未过期外国护照上的入境章；或 DHS签发的I-766就业授权文件（EAD，工作许可）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note
source_blocks.text: 注意

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may use one document for two purposes. For example, we may use a DHS work permit as proof of both immigration status and identity. However, you must provide at least two separate documents.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能将一份文件用于两个目的。例如，我们可能将DHS工作许可用作移民身份和身份的双重证明。但是，您必须至少提供两份单独的文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manage Your Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: 管理您的退休福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Successfully filing for retirement benefits isn t the end of your Social Security journey. We have resources to save you time on important retirement tasks and keep you in control of your Social Security account benefits through a free mySocial Security account.
source_blocks.text: 成功申请退休福利并不是您社会保障旅程的终点。我们提供资源，帮助您节省处理重要退休事务的时间，并通过免费的 my Social Security 账户让您掌控自己的社会保障账户福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign Up For mySocial Security
source_blocks.text: 注册 my Social Security

source_blocks.source_text_en: A free mySocial Security account makes it easy to manage your information.
source_blocks.text: 免费的 my Social Security 账户让您轻松管理您的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Create An Account
source_blocks.text: 创建账户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Jump to a topic on this page:
source_blocks.text: 跳转到此页面上的主题：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Understand Your Benefits/Inform Us Of Changes/Use Our Resources And Services To Stay In Control/Keep Your Information Secure
source_blocks.text: 了解您的福利/通知我们变更/利用我们的资源和服务保持掌控/确保您的信息安全

source_blocks.source_text_en: Understand Your Benefits
source_blocks.text: 了解您的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Effectively managing your retirement benefits is an ongoing part of retired life. A solid foundation for this includes understanding what you re entitled to, staying up to date on program changes, and making sure we have your current information.
source_blocks.text: 有效管理您的退休福利是退休生活持续的一部分。为此打下坚实基础包括了解您有权享受的福利、及时了解计划变更，并确保我们掌握您的最新信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Know What You're Entitled To
source_blocks.text: 了解您有权享受的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help ensure you get the retirement benefits you should by reviewing the basics like how we determine your benefit amount and who else in your family might be eligible. Visit our Learn About Retirement Benefits page to make sure you know the basics of retirement benefits.
source_blocks.text: 通过回顾基础知识，如我们如何确定您的福利金额以及您家庭中还有谁可能有资格享受福利，帮助确保您获得应得的退休福利。请访问我们的“了解退休福利”页面，确保您了解退休福利的基本知识。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Stay Up To Date
source_blocks.text: 保持最新

source_blocks.source_text_en: With SSA.gov, there are a few ways to stay in the know on the latest Social Security information:
source_blocks.text: 通过 SSA.gov，有几种方式可以随时了解最新的社会保障信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Subscribe to our Social Security Matters blog to hear from us on tips, tools, and updates on Social Security issues important to you. Check our annual Cost-of-Living Adjustments (COLA) updates and learn about any impact to your monthly benefit amount. Subscribe to our Email Digest for information to you on policy changes, agency news, and notifications on important events. Create your personal mySocial Security account to receive important notices online through the Message Center. The Message Center is a secure, convenient portal where you can receive sensitive communications we don t send through email or text.
source_blocks.text: 订阅我们的 Social Security Matters 博客，了解我们提供的有关对您重要的社会保障问题的提示、工具和更新。 查看我们每年的生活费用调整（COLA）更新，并了解对您每月福利金额的任何影响。 订阅我们的电子邮件摘要，获取有关政策变更、机构新闻和重要事件通知的信息。 创建您的个人 my Social Security 账户，通过消息中心在线接收重要通知。消息中心是一个安全便捷的门户，您可以在其中接收我们不会通过电子邮件或短信发送的敏感通信。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional Information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore The Benefits You May Be Due Benefits For Your Family
source_blocks.text: 探索您可能有权享受的福利 为您家庭提供的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: FAQs
source_blocks.text: 常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is a mySocial Security online account and how do I get one? How do I sign up for Medicare?
source_blocks.text: 什么是我的社会保障在线账户，我该如何获取一个？ 我该如何注册医疗保险？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Inform Us Of Changes
source_blocks.text: 告知我们变更情况

source_blocks.source_text_en: When change happens in your life, letting us know ensures your benefits and information is kept up to date. Remember to tell us whenever there s a change in your life circumstance that could affect your benefits.
source_blocks.text: 当您的生活发生变化时，告知我们能确保您的福利和信息保持最新。请记住，每当您的生活状况发生可能影响您福利的变化时，都要告诉我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Common changes to notify us of:
source_blocks.text: 需要告知我们的常见变更：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Moving. Getting married or divorced. Changing your name. Adopting a child. No longer caring for a child who receives benefits. If you are a non-citizen and your status changes. Start getting a pension from work not covered by Social Security. Leave the United States for more than 30 days. Become unable to manage your funds. Are convicted of a criminal offense. The beneficiary dies.
source_blocks.text: 搬家。 结婚或离婚。 更改姓名。 收养子女。 不再照顾领取福利的子女。 如果您是非公民且身份发生变化。 开始从非社会保障覆盖的工作领取养老金。 离开美国超过30天。 变得无法管理自己的资金。 被判刑事罪行。 受益人去世。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already receive Social Security benefits, you can update much of your information online with your personal mySocial Security account.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经在领取社会保障福利，您可以通过个人我的社会保障账户在线更新大部分信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to make a change that cannot be done through mySocial Security, you can contact us for additional support.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要进行无法通过我的社会保障完成的变更，您可以联系我们获取额外支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional Information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Social Security Can Help You When A Family Member Dies
source_blocks.text: 社会保障如何在家庭成员去世时帮助您

source_blocks.source_text_en: FAQs
source_blocks.text: 常见问题解答

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I change my address? What should I do when someone dies?
source_blocks.text: 我如何更改地址？ 当有人去世时我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use Our Resources And Services To Stay In Control
source_blocks.text: 利用我们的资源和服务保持掌控

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are many time-saving options available to you. Here are our most popular online services:
source_blocks.text: 有许多节省时间的选项可供您使用。以下是我们最受欢迎的在线服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your application status. Set up or change direct deposit. Get a proof of income letter. Get a Social Security 1099 (SSA-1099) form. Request a replacement Social Security card. Opt out of certain mailed notices. Advanced Designation of Representative Payee.
source_blocks.text: 查看您的申请状态。 设置或更改直接存款。 获取收入证明信。 获取社会保障1099（SSA-1099）表格。 申请补发社会保障卡。 选择退出某些邮寄通知。 预先指定代表收款人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We continue to expand the services available online. Visit our online services page to see a complete list, including the newest services to help you manage your information. You can also search our comprehensive FAQs section for help with specific retirement issues.
source_blocks.text: 我们继续扩展在线可用的服务。请访问我们的在线服务页面查看完整列表，包括帮助您管理信息的最新服务。您也可以搜索我们全面的常见问题解答部分，以获取特定退休问题的帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help with managing your benefits and cannot find the answer or service above, visit our contact us page for other ways to get support.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要管理福利的帮助，但找不到上述答案或服务，请访问我们的联系我们页面，了解其他获取支持的方式。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keep Your Information Secure
source_blocks.text: 确保您的信息安全

source_blocks.source_text_en: Identity theft affects millions of people each year and can cause serious financial and identity-related problems. Protect yourself by securing your personal information, taking the time to understand the threat of identity theft, and exercising caution.
source_blocks.text: 身份盗窃每年影响数百万人，并可能导致严重的财务和身份相关问题。通过保护您的个人信息、花时间了解身份盗窃的威胁并保持谨慎来保护自己。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Protect Yourself From Fraud
source_blocks.text: 保护自己免受欺诈

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security is diligently working at national, regional, and local levels to combat the fraud that undermines our mission to serve the American public.
source_blocks.text: 社会保障局正在国家、地区和地方各级努力工作，以打击破坏我们服务美国公众使命的欺诈行为。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are steps you can take to help protect your personal information:
source_blocks.text: 您可以采取以下步骤来帮助保护您的个人信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do not routinely carry your Social Security card. Never say your Social Security number aloud in public. Beware of phishing scams (emails, internet links, texts, and phone calls) to trick you into revealing personal information. Create a mySocial Security account to help you keep track of your records. Visit If You Want Extra Security to learn about extra verification steps we can add to your account.
source_blocks.text: 不要日常随身携带您的社会保障卡。 切勿在公共场合大声说出您的社会保障号码。 警惕网络钓鱼诈骗（电子邮件、互联网链接、短信和电话），这些手段旨在诱骗您泄露个人信息。 创建一个我的社会保障账户，以帮助您跟踪您的记录。 访问“如果您需要额外安全”了解我们可以为您的账户添加的额外验证步骤。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Report Suspicious Activity
source_blocks.text: 报告可疑活动

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive a suspicious call from someone claiming to be from Social Security, hang up and then report details of the call to the Office of the Inspector General. You can do this by submitting a report online.
source_blocks.text: 如果您接到自称来自社会保障局的可疑电话，请挂断电话，然后向监察长办公室报告通话详情。您可以通过在线提交报告来完成此操作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Additional Information
source_blocks.text: 附加信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Protecting Personal Information Fraud Prevention And Reporting Legal Enforcement And Financial Penalties
source_blocks.text: 保护个人信息 欺诈预防与报告 法律执法与财务处罚

source_blocks.source_text_en: FAQs
source_blocks.text: 常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I get a call claiming there's a problem with my Social Security number or account? How do you protect my identity when I use a mySocial Security account?
source_blocks.text: 如果我接到电话声称我的社会保障号码或账户有问题，我该怎么办？ 当我使用我的社会保障账户时，你们如何保护我的身份？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration
source_blocks.text: Medicare 福利 | 社会保障局

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare Benefits
source_blocks.text: Medicare 福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: How To Apply Online For Just Medicare
source_blocks.text: 如何仅在线申请 Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online for Medicare even if you are not ready to retire. Use our online application to sign up for Medicare. It takes less than 10 minutes. In most cases, once your application is submitted electronically, you re done. There are no forms to sign and usually no documentation is required. Social Security will process your application and contact you if we need more information. Otherwise, you ll receive your Medicare card in the mail. Learn more about your Medicare card.
source_blocks.text: 即使您尚未准备好退休，也可以在线申请 Medicare。使用我们的在线申请来注册 Medicare。这只需不到10分钟。在大多数情况下，一旦您的申请以电子方式提交，您就完成了。无需签署表格，通常也不需要提供文件。社会保障局将处理您的申请，如果我们需要更多信息，会与您联系。否则，您将通过邮件收到您的 Medicare 卡。了解更多关于您的 Medicare 卡的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for Medicare Only
source_blocks.text: 仅申请 Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: Return to Saved Application \| Check Application Status \| Replace Medicare Card
source_blocks.text: 返回已保存的申请 \| 检查申请状态 \| 更换 Medicare 卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare is managed by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Social Security works with CMS by enrolling people in Medicare.
source_blocks.text: Medicare 由 Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) 管理。社会保障局与 CMS 合作，为人们注册 Medicare。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information about applying for Medicare only and delaying retirement benefits, visit Applying for Medicare Only Before You Decide.
source_blocks.text: 有关仅申请 Medicare 并延迟退休福利的更多信息，请访问 Applying for Medicare Only Before You Decide。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a Health Savings Account (HSA) and/or health insurance based on employment, you may want to ask your personnel office or insurance company how signing up for Medicare will affect you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有 Health Savings Account (HSA) 和/或基于就业的健康保险，您可能想咨询您的人事部门或保险公司，了解注册 Medicare 将如何影响您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To find out what documents and information you need to apply, go to the Checklist For The Online Medicare, Retirement, And Spouses Application.
source_blocks.text: 要了解您需要哪些文件和信息来申请，请访问 Checklist For The Online Medicare, Retirement, And Spouses Application。

source_blocks.source_text_en: New Medicare Cards
source_blocks.text: 新的 Medicare 卡

source_blocks.source_text_en: To help protect your identity, Medicare has sent you a new Medicare card. Your new card will have a new Medicare Number that s unique to you, instead of your Social Security Number. If you did not receive your new Medicare card, there may be something that needs to be corrected, like your mailing address. You can update your mailing address by logging in to or creating your personal my Social Security account.
source_blocks.text: 为帮助保护您的身份，Medicare 已向您发送了一张新的 Medicare 卡。您的新卡将有一个新的 Medicare Number，该号码对您来说是唯一的，而不是您的 Social Security Number。如果您没有收到新的 Medicare 卡，可能有需要更正的地方，例如您的邮寄地址。您可以通过登录或创建您的个人 my Social Security 账户来更新您的邮寄地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about Medicare
source_blocks.text: 了解 Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medicare is our country s health insurance program for people age 65 or older. Certain people younger than age 65 can qualify for Medicare, too, including those with disabilities and those who have permanent kidney failure. To learn more, read our Medicare publication.
source_blocks.text: Medicare 是我们国家为65岁或以上人群提供的健康保险计划。某些65岁以下的人也可能符合 Medicare 的资格，包括残疾人和患有永久性肾衰竭的人。要了解更多信息，请阅读我们的 Medicare 出版物。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Already Enrolled in Medicare
source_blocks.text: 已注册 Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already have Medicare, you can get information and services online. Find out how to manage your benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经有 Medicare，您可以在线获取信息和服务。了解如何管理您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already have Medicare Part A and wish to sign up for Medicare Part B, please complete form CMS 40-B, Application for Enrollment in Medicare - Part B (Medical Insurance), and take or mail it to your local Social Security office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经有 Medicare Part A，并希望注册 Medicare Part B，请填写表格 CMS 40-B，即 Application for Enrollment in Medicare - Part B (Medical Insurance)，并将其带到或邮寄到您当地的社会保障局办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Anyone who has Medicare can get Medicare prescription drug coverage. Some people with limited resources and income also may be able to get Extra Help to pay for the costs.
source_blocks.text: 任何拥有 Medicare 的人都可以获得 Medicare 处方药保险。一些资源和收入有限的人也可能获得 Extra Help 来支付费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Applying for Medicare
source_blocks.text: 申请 Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you apply for Medicare, you can sign up for Part A (Hospital Insurance) and Part B (Medical Insurance). Because you must pay a premium for Part B coverage, you can turn it down. However, if you decide to enroll in Part B later on, you may have to pay a late enrollment penalty for as long as you have Part B coverage. Your monthly premium will go up 10 percent for each 12-month period you were eligible for Part B, but didn t sign up for it, unless you qualify for a special enrollment period.
source_blocks.text: 当您申请 Medicare 时，您可以注册 Part A（医院保险）和 Part B（医疗保险）。由于您必须为 Part B 保险支付保费，您可以选择放弃。然而，如果您决定稍后加入 Part B，您可能需要在拥有 Part B 保险期间支付延迟投保罚金。您每错过一个 12 个月的合格期，月保费将增加 10%，除非您符合特殊投保期资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible at age 65, your initial enrollment period begins three months before your 65th birthday, includes the month you turn age 65, and ends three months after that birthday. However, if you don t enroll in Medicare Part B during your initial enrollment period, you have another chance each year to sign up during a general enrollment period from January 1 through March 31. Your coverage begins on July 1 of the year you enroll. Read our Medicare publication for more information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在 65 岁时符合资格，您的初始投保期从您 65 岁生日前三个月开始，包括您年满 65 岁的当月，并在该生日后三个月结束。但是，如果您在初始投保期内未加入 Medicare Part B，您每年还有一次机会在 1 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日的一般投保期内注册。您的保险将从您注册当年的 7 月 1 日开始。请阅读我们的 Medicare 出版物以了解更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you live in Puerto Rico you will not receive Medicare Medical Insurance (Medicare Part B) automatically. You will need to sign up for it during your initial enrollment period or you will pay a penalty. To sign up, please call our toll-free number at 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) or contact your local Social Security office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在波多黎各，您不会自动获得 Medicare 医疗保险（Medicare Part B）。您需要在初始投保期内注册，否则将支付罚金。要注册，请拨打我们的免费电话 1-800-772-1213（TTY 1-800-325-0778） 或联系您当地的 Social Security 办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Questions about our online application
source_blocks.text: 关于我们的在线申请的问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who can apply for Medicare online?
source_blocks.text: 谁可以在线申请 Medicare？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use our online Medicare application if you:
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合以下条件，可以使用我们的在线 Medicare 申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are at least 64 years and 9 months old; Want to sign up for Medicare but do not currently have ANY Medicare coverage; Do not want to start receiving Social Security benefits at this time; and Are not currently receiving Social Security retirement, disability or survivors benefits.
source_blocks.text: 年满 64 岁零 9 个月； 想注册 Medicare 但目前没有任何 Medicare 保险； 此时不想开始领取 Social Security 福利；以及 目前未领取 Social Security 退休、残疾或遗属福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When should I apply?
source_blocks.text: 我应该何时申请？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should sign up for Medicare three months before reaching age 65, even if you are not ready to start receiving retirement benefits. You can opt out of receiving cash retirement benefits now once you are in the online application. Then you can apply online for retirement benefits later.
source_blocks.text: 您应该在年满 65 岁前三个月注册 Medicare，即使您尚未准备好开始领取退休福利。您可以在在线申请中选择暂不领取现金退休福利。之后您可以稍后在线申请退休福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: With our online application, you can sign up for Medicare Part A (Hospital Insurance) and Part B (Medical Insurance). Because you must pay a premium for Part B coverage, you can turn it down.
source_blocks.text: 通过我们的在线申请，您可以注册 Medicare Part A（医院保险）和 Part B（医疗保险）。由于您必须为 Part B 保险支付保费，您可以选择放弃。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you choose not to enroll in Medicare Part B and then decide to do so later, your coverage may be delayed and you may have to pay a higher monthly premium for as long as you have Part B. Your monthly premium will go up 10 percent for each 12-month period you were eligible for Part B, but didn t sign up for it, unless you qualify for a "Special Enrollment Period."
source_blocks.text: 如果您选择不加入 Medicare Part B，但后来决定加入，您的保险可能会延迟，并且您可能需要在拥有 Part B 期间支付更高的月保费。您每错过一个 12 个月的合格期，月保费将增加 10%，除非您符合“特殊投保期”资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
source_blocks.text: 特殊投保期（SEP）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have medical insurance coverage under a group health plan based on your or your spouse's current employment, you may not need to apply for Medicare Part B at age 65. You may qualify for a "Special Enrollment Period" (SEP) that will let you sign up for Part B during:
source_blocks.text: 如果您根据您或您配偶当前的工作加入了团体健康计划，您可能无需在 65 岁时申请 Medicare Part B。您可能有资格获得“特殊投保期”（SEP），允许您在以下期间注册 Part B：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Any month you remain covered under the group health plan and your, or your spouse's, employment continues; or The 8-month period that begins with the month after your group health plan coverage or the employment it is based on ends, whichever comes first.
source_blocks.text: 在您仍受团体健康计划保障且您或您配偶的工作持续的任何一个月份；或 从您的团体健康计划保险或其依据的工作结束后的次月开始的 8 个月期间，以先到者为准。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why apply for Medicare online?
source_blocks.text: 为什么在线申请 Medicare？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Using the online Medicare application has a number of benefits. You can:
source_blocks.text: 使用在线 Medicare 申请有许多好处。您可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Avoid trips to your Social Security Office, saving you time and money. Answer questions at your convenience by starting and stopping the application without fear of losing any information you entered. Make corrections to the application prior to submission. Submit your application electronically. There is no need to mail in your application. When you are finished, just select Submit Now to send your application to Social Security. Receive a receipt online for your application that you can print and keep for your records. Check the status of your application online. You will receive a confirmation number once you submit your application.
source_blocks.text: 避免前往 Social Security 办公室，节省时间和金钱。 随时开始和停止申请，方便回答问题，无需担心丢失已输入的信息。 在提交前更正申请。 以电子方式提交申请。无需邮寄申请。完成后，只需选择“立即提交”即可将申请发送给 Social Security。 在线收到申请收据，可打印并保存以备记录。 在线查看申请状态。提交申请后，您将收到确认号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I apply?
source_blocks.text: 申请后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once we receive your application, we will
source_blocks.text: 收到您的申请后，我们将

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review your application and contact you if we need more information or if we need to see your documents; Process your application once we have all of the necessary information and documents; and Mail you a decision letter.
source_blocks.text: 审核您的申请，如需更多信息或查看您的文件，将与您联系； 在获得所有必要信息和文件后处理您的申请；以及 邮寄给您一份决定信。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other Medicare registration/enrollment options
source_blocks.text: 其他Medicare注册/登记选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also apply:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以通过以下方式申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: By phone - Call us at 1-800-772-1213 from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday through Friday. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can call us at TTY 1-800-325-0778. In person - Visit your local Social Security office. (Call first to make an appointment.)
source_blocks.text: 电话 - 周一至周五上午7点至下午7点拨打1-800-772-1213。如果您失聪或有听力障碍，可拨打TTY 1-800-325-0778。 亲自前往 - 访问您当地的社会保障办公室。（请先致电预约。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you do not live in the U.S. or one of its territories you can also contact the nearest U.S. Social Security office, U.S. Embassy or consulate.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不在美国或其领土居住，您也可以联系最近的美国社会保障办公室、美国大使馆或领事馆。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online for Medicare even if you are not ready to retire. Use our online application to sign up for Medicare. It takes less than 10 minutes. In most cases, once your application is submitted electronically, you re done. There are no forms to sign and usually no documentation is required. Social Security will process your application and contact you if we need more information. Otherwise, you ll receive your Medicare card in the mail. Learn more about your Medicare card.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To create a my Social Security account, you ll be asked to:
source_blocks.text: To create a my Social Security account, you ll be asked to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Verify your identity by providing personal information about yourself and answering questions that only you are likely to know. Create a username and password you ll use to access your online account. Confirm your email address or phone number by entering a one-time security code within 10 minutes of receiving it in order to help keep your personal information safe.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do you have a security freeze or fraud alert on your credit report?
source_blocks.text: Do you have a security freeze or fraud alert on your credit report?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a security freeze, fraud alert, or both on your credit report, you can still open a my Social Security account by temporarily lifting it.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact our Identity Services Provider and request that they temporarily lift your security freeze or fraud alert. Create a my Social Security account online after lifting the security freeze or fraud alert. Reinstate the security freeze or fraud alert with the Identity Services Provider if needed. When you request a temporary lift of your credit freeze or fraud alert, the Identity Services Provider may automatically reinstate it after your temporary lift expires.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t want to temporarily lift your security freeze or fraud alert, you can visit your local Social Security office to open an account in person. For more information on security freezes and fraud alerts, read the Federal Trade Commission s Credit Freeze FAQs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your personal my Social Security account is for your use only
source_blocks.text: Your personal my Social Security account is for your use only

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security is dedicated to protecting the information and resources entrusted to us, including your personal information and investment. For your protection, you re the only one who can create your personal my Social Security account for your own exclusive use. No one can create or use an account on your behalf, even with written permission. Don t share the use of your account with anyone else under any circumstances, as unauthorized use of this service is a misrepresentation of your identity to the federal government and could subject you to criminal or civil penalties, or both.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To create a my Social Security account, you ll be asked to:
source_blocks.text: To create a my Social Security account, you ll be asked to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Verify your identity by providing personal information about yourself and answering questions that only you are likely to know. Create a username and password you ll use to access your online account. Confirm your email address or phone number by entering a one-time security code within 10 minutes of receiving it in order to help keep your personal information safe.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do you have a security freeze or fraud alert on your credit report?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a security freeze, fraud alert, or both on your credit report, you can still open a my Social Security account by temporarily lifting it.
source_blocks.text: If you have a security freeze, fraud alert, or both on your credit report, you can still open a my Social Security account by temporarily lifting it.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact our Identity Services Provider and request that they temporarily lift your security freeze or fraud alert. Create a my Social Security account online after lifting the security freeze or fraud alert. Reinstate the security freeze or fraud alert with the Identity Services Provider if needed. When you request a temporary lift of your credit freeze or fraud alert, the Identity Services Provider may automatically reinstate it after your temporary lift expires.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your personal my Social Security account is for your use only
source_blocks.text: Your personal my Social Security account is for your use only

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security is dedicated to protecting the information and resources entrusted to us, including your personal information and investment. For your protection, you re the only one who can create your personal my Social Security account for your own exclusive use. No one can create or use an account on your behalf, even with written permission. Don t share the use of your account with anyone else under any circumstances, as unauthorized use of this service is a misrepresentation of your identity to the federal government and could subject you to criminal or civil penalties, or both.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Online Identity Verification Process
source_blocks.text: The Online Identity Verification Process

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of our most important responsibilities is protecting your investment and personal information. Social Security takes this responsibility very seriously, and we have a robust cybersecurity program in place to help us succeed. Our security process follows federal guidelines that includes additional security measures so we can be sure that you are who you say you are when you conduct online business with us.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To protect the privacy of your identity and your information, we are using a new identity verification process.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If You Want Extra Security
source_blocks.text: If You Want Extra Security

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer you the choice to add extra security when you create an online account. In the past, we told you Social Security would never ask for your credit card number or other financial information. We have changed our policy for this one service. Now, we may ask you for the last eight digits of your Visa, MasterCard, or Discover credit card, or some other financial information. Once you give us this additional information, we will send you a letter in the mail in five to 10 business days. You will need this letter to complete the voluntary process to add extra security.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Internet Phishing Alert
source_blocks.text: Internet Phishing Alert

source_blocks.source_text_en: Internet scam artists use clever phishing schemes to defraud millions of people each year. Phishing is the practice of using social engineering techniques over email to trick a recipient into revealing personal information, clicking on a malicious link, or opening a malicious attachment.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I detect a phishing email pretending to be Social Security?
source_blocks.text: How can I detect a phishing email pretending to be Social Security?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most emails from Social Security will come from a .gov" email address. If an email address does not end in .gov , use caution before opening attachments or clicking on pictures or links in the email. Currently, Social Security sends emails from no-reply@ssa.gov, subscription.service@subscriptions.ssa.gov and ThankYou@ssa.gov. - In a few instances, we use marketing firms to raise awareness of Social Security s online services, and this includes creating a my Social Security account. We allow these firms to send email directly to individuals. Any links you find within these emails should always point to a .gov/ web address. Links, logos, or pictures in the body of an official Social Security email will always direct you to an official Social Security website. Rather than relying on the way a link looks, please follow these steps to confirm a link s authenticity: - To verify the web address of a link or picture, hover over it with your mouse until a text box appears with the web address. This is the actual address you will be directed to and it should always end in .gov/ A forward slash should always follow the .gov domain. - Example - https://www.ssa.gov/myaccount/ - Links to the official Social Security website will always begin with https://www.socialsecurity.gov/ or https://secure.ssa.gov/. Below are examples of fraudulent websites pretending to direct you to Social Security. Notice the location of the forward slash. - https://www.socialsecurity.gov.gmx.de/ - http://www.socialsecurity.gov.bx.co.rx/setup

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I ve received a phishing email pretending to be from Social Security?
source_blocks.text: What should I do if I ve received a phishing email pretending to be from Social Security?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are not certain that an e-mail you received came from Social Security or one of our marketing firms, DO NOT respond to the email or click on any links contained in the email message. Report the incident by forwarding the suspicious email to the U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Team (US-CERT) at phishing-report@us-cert.gov. (http://www.us-nocert.gov/nav/reportphishing.html).
source_blocks.text: If you are not certain that an e-mail you received came from Social Security or one of our marketing firms, DO NOT respond to the email or click on any links contained in the email message. Report the incident by forwarding the suspicious email to the U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Team (US-CERT) at phishing-report@us-cert.gov. (http://www.us-nocert.gov/nav/reportphishing.html).

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are other tips I can use for detecting phishing emails?
source_blocks.text: What are other tips I can use for detecting phishing emails?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Verify the sender. Exercise caution when receiving email from a sender you don t know or haven t heard from in a long time. Hover over the From email address to ensure it matches the displayed email or name of the sender. Look for poor choices in wording, phrasing, or spelling. If an email includes a business name, telephone number, or website link, verify the legitimacy of these items by searching for the official number or website in a search engine. Do not respond to emails requesting personal information. Reputable businesses and public agencies will not ask you for personal information in an email.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: Apply for Retirement Benefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security offers an online retirement application that you can complete in as little as 15 minutes. It's so easy. Better yet, you can apply from the comfort of your home or office at a time most convenient for you. There's no need to drive to a local Social Security office or wait for an appointment with a Social Security representative.

There's no need to drive to a local Social Security office or wait for an appointment with a Social Security representative.

source_blocks.source_text_en: In most cases, once your application is submitted electronically, you're done. Social Security will process your application and contact you by telephone or by mail if any further information is needed.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who can apply for retirement benefits online?
source_blocks.text: Who can apply for retirement benefits online?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online for retirement benefits or benefits as a spouse if you:
source_blocks.text: You can apply online for retirement benefits or benefits as a spouse if you:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Before you apply for retirement benefits, there are certain Social Security "basics" you should know about:
source_blocks.text: Before you apply for retirement benefits, there are certain Social Security "basics" you should know about:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your "full retirement age" - Depending on your date of birth, that may be between age 66 and 67. This could affect the amount of your benefits and when you want the benefits to start. When you can start benefits - You may start receiving benefits as early as age 62 or as late as age 70. Benefits are reduced for age - Your monthly benefits will be reduced if you start them any time before "full retirement age." Working while you receive benefits - If you elect to receive benefits before you reach full retirement age, you should understand how continuing to work can affect your benefits. Delayed retirement credits - Delayed retirement credits may be added to your benefits if they start after your full retirement age. Life expectancy - Many of us will live much longer than the average retiree, and most women live longer than men. More than one in three 65 year olds today will live to age 90, and more than one in seven will live to age 95. Social Security benefits, which last as long as you live, provide valuable protection against outliving savings and other sources of retirement income. Again, you ll want to choose a retirement age based on your circumstances so you ll have enough income when you need it. We urge you to use our Retirement Estimator to get a personal estimate of how much your benefits will be at different ages and "stop work" dates before you begin the application.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why apply for retirement online?
source_blocks.text: Why apply for retirement online?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Using our online application has a number of benefits:
source_blocks.text: Using our online application has a number of benefits:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can avoid trips to your Social Security office. That saves you time and money. You can answer questions on your schedule. You don't have to complete the application the same day that you started it. You can start and stop the application without losing any of the information you entered. You will have a chance to correct mistakes. You can go back and make changes until you finish the application. You'll also be given a chance to review your answers and go back and make corrections before you submit the application. If you have trouble answering a question, you can find additional information in our [More Info] links. You don't need to mail your application. When you're finished, just click "Submit Now" to send your application to Social Security. You'll get a receipt for your online application. You can print the receipt and keep for your records. You can check the status of your online application. Your receipt includes a confirmation number you can use to check the status of your application. However, if you choose to apply for benefits more than two months in the future, you will not be able to check the status of your application until one month before you start receiving benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Retirement Estimator
source_blocks.text: 退休估算器

source_blocks.source_text_en: How the Retirement Estimator Works
source_blocks.text: 退休估算器的工作原理

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Retirement Estimator gives estimates based on your actual Social Security earnings record. Please keep in mind that these are just estimates.
source_blocks.text: 退休估算器基于您的实际社会保障收入记录提供估算。请记住，这些仅为估算。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Estimate Your Retirement Benefits
source_blocks.text: 估算您的退休福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can t provide your actual benefit amount until you apply for benefits. And that amount may differ from the estimates provided because:
source_blocks.text: 在您申请福利之前，我们无法提供您的实际福利金额。该金额可能与提供的估算有所不同，原因如下：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your earnings may increase or decrease in the future. After you start receiving benefits, they will be adjusted for cost-of-living increases. Your estimated benefits are based on current law. The law governing benefit amounts may change because, by 2035, the combined trust fund reserves are projected to become depleted one year later than projected last year. Payroll taxes collected will be enough to pay only about 80 cents for each dollar of scheduled benefits. Your benefit amount may be affected by military service, railroad employment or pensions earned through work on which you did not pay Social Security tax.
source_blocks.text: 您未来的收入可能会增加或减少。 在您开始领取福利后，这些福利将根据生活成本增加进行调整。 您的估算福利基于现行法律。由于到2035年，合并信托基金储备预计将比去年预测的时间晚一年耗尽，规定福利金额的法律可能会发生变化。征收的工资税将仅足以支付每美元计划福利的约80美分。 您的福利金额可能受到兵役、铁路就业或未缴纳社会保障税的工作所获得的养老金的影响。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who Can Use the Retirement Estimator
source_blocks.text: 谁可以使用退休估算器

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use the Retirement Estimator if:
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下条件，则可以使用退休估算器：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have enough Social Security credits at this time to qualify for benefits and You are not: - Currently receiving benefits on your own Social Security record; - Waiting for a decision about your application for benefits or Medicare; - Age 62 or older and receiving benefits on another Social Security record; or - Eligible for a Pension Based on Work Not Covered By Social Security.
source_blocks.text: 您目前拥有足够的社会保障积分以符合福利资格，并且 您不属于以下情况： - 目前正在根据您自己的社会保障记录领取福利； - 正在等待有关您的福利或Medicare申请的决定； - 年满62岁或以上，并根据另一份社会保障记录领取福利；或 - 有资格获得基于未纳入社会保障覆盖的工作的养老金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you are currently receiving only Medicare benefits, you can still get an estimate. For more information go to this link for our publication Retirement Information For Medicare Beneficiaries.
source_blocks.text: 如果您目前仅领取Medicare福利，您仍然可以获得估算。有关更多信息，请访问此链接查看我们的出版物《Medicare受益人的退休信息》。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you cannot use the Retirement Estimator or you want a survivors or disability benefit estimate, please use one of our other benefit Calculators.
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法使用退休估算器，或者您需要遗属或残疾福利估算，请使用我们的其他福利计算器。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You cannot use the Retirement Estimator if you blocked access to your personal information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您阻止了对您个人信息的访问，则无法使用退休估算器。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How Long Can You Stay On Each Page?
source_blocks.text: 您可以在每个页面上停留多长时间？

source_blocks.source_text_en: For security reasons, there are time limits for viewing each page. You will receive a warning after 25 minutes without doing anything, and you will be able to extend your time on the page.
source_blocks.text: 出于安全原因，查看每个页面有时间限制。如果您在25分钟内没有任何操作，您将收到警告，并且可以延长您在页面上的时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After the third warning on a page, you must move to another page. If you do not, your time will run out and your work on that page will be lost.
source_blocks.text: 在页面上的第三次警告后，您必须移至另一个页面。如果不这样做，您的时间将耗尽，并且您在该页面上的工作将丢失。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you turned JavaScript off in your browser, you will not receive these warnings. After you spend 30 minutes on a page, you must move to another page or you will be logged out.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在浏览器中关闭了JavaScript，您将不会收到这些警告。在页面上花费30分钟后，您必须移至另一个页面，否则您将被注销。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Direct Deposit Information / How Do I Sign Up to Receive an Electronic Payment?
source_blocks.text: 直接存款信息 / 如何注册接收电子支付？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Already receiving benefits
source_blocks.text: 已领取福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you already receive Social Security or SSI benefits and you have a bank account, you can sign up for Direct Deposit by:
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经在领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI）福利，并且拥有银行账户，您可以通过以下方式注册直接存款：

source_blocks.source_text_en: starting or changing Direct Deposit online (Social Security benefits only), or contacting your bank, credit union or savings and loan association, or calling Social Security toll-free at 1-800-772-1213(TTY 1-800-325-0778), or
source_blocks.text: 在线开始或更改直接存款（仅限社会保障福利），或 联系您的银行、信用合作社或储蓄贷款协会，或 拨打社会保障免费电话 1-800-772-1213（TTY 1-800-325-0778），或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Consider the Direct Express debit card as another viable option.
source_blocks.text: 考虑直接快递借记卡作为另一个可行的选择。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Direct Express card is a debit card you can use to access your benefits. And you don't need a bank account.
source_blocks.text: 直接快递卡是一种借记卡，您可以用它来获取您的福利。而且您不需要银行账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: With the Direct Express card program, we deposit your federal benefit payment directly into your card account. Your monthly benefits will be available on your payment day on time, every time. You can use the card to make purchases, pay bills or get cash at thousands of locations.
source_blocks.text: 通过直接快递卡计划，我们将您的联邦福利金直接存入您的卡账户。您的每月福利将在您的支付日准时到账，每次都是如此。您可以在数千个地点使用该卡购物、支付账单或提取现金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It s quick and easy to sign up for the card. Call the toll-free Direct Express hotline at 1-800-333-1795. Also, Social Security can help you sign up.
source_blocks.text: 注册该卡既快捷又简单。拨打直接快递免费热线 1-800-333-1795。此外，社会保障局也可以帮助您注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't have an account, you must open an account before you can sign up for Direct Deposit. You should shop around in your area to find an account that has the features you want at a price you can afford. When you decide on the account that is right for you, let the representative at the financial institution know that you are interested in signing up to receive your benefits by Direct Deposit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有账户，您必须先开设一个账户，然后才能注册直接存款。您应该在您所在地区货比三家，找到一个具有您想要的功能且价格实惠的账户。当您决定适合您的账户时，请告知金融机构的代表您有兴趣注册通过直接存款接收您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Not currently receiving benefits
source_blocks.text: 目前未领取福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t get Social Security or SSI benefits yet but are planning to apply, tell the Social Security representative when you apply for benefits that you want to sign up for Direct Deposit. If you already have an account, have your checkbook or a copy of your bank statement with you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未领取社会保障或 SSI 福利，但计划申请，请在申请福利时告知社会保障代表您想注册直接存款。如果您已有账户，请随身携带您的支票簿或银行对账单副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Related Information
source_blocks.text: 相关信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you would like to learn more about Direct Express view Treasury's You Tube Video
source_blocks.text: 如果您想了解更多关于直接快递的信息，请查看财政部的 YouTube 视频

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you would like to learn more about preventing identity theft visit Treasury's website at
source_blocks.text: 如果您想了解更多关于防止身份盗窃的信息，请访问财政部的网站

source_blocks.source_text_en: Many students get federal student aid to help pay for their study at international schools, either at the undergraduate or graduate level.
source_blocks.text: Many students get federal student aid to help pay for their study at international schools, either at the undergraduate or graduate level.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Whether you plan to study abroad for a semester or get your entire degree outside the United States, you may be able to use federal student aid to pay your expenses. The type of aid you can get and the process you must follow will depend on the type of program (study-abroad or full degree) you plan to enter. Your status as an undergraduate or graduate student also affects the type of aid for which you re eligible, just as it does at schools in the U.S.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may receive federal student aid for a study-abroad program, if you meet the aid eligibility criteria. If you aren t already in the habit of filling out a Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) form each year for college, be sure to learn about the federal student aid programs and the FAFSA process. You ll need to fill out a FAFSA form before you can receive federal student aid to study abroad.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve decided to get your degree from a school outside the U.S., congratulations. Now let us help you find out which international schools participate in the federal student aid programs and guide you through the process of getting federal aid to make a dent in that tuition bill.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I research schools and their requirements?
source_blocks.text: How can I research schools and their requirements?

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, don t panic. You re on your own, but if you re organized and determined, you ll be okay. In this section, we ll share some tips about preparing to study at an international school and some resources to help you learn about schools that participate in the American federal student aid programs.
source_blocks.text: First, don t panic. You re on your own, but if you re organized and determined, you ll be okay. In this section, we ll share some tips about preparing to study at an international school and some resources to help you learn about schools that participate in the American federal student aid programs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here are general tips:
source_blocks.text: Here are general tips:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Start early. You ve got more to do than your friends who are going to American schools, so don t think you can apply for financial aid this month and use it to pay your tuition next month. If you re interested in a particular school, check its website to find out about program availability (does it offer the degree you want?), cost, enrollment policies, and resources and programs for international students. Do your research and keep a to-do list. For instance, what paperwork needs to be done? (Visas? Housing forms? Registering with the police? Valid passport? Emergency contacts? Medical insurance?) Create a file to organize your documents and information from your school. Find out who at the school will be processing your financial aid. Get their email address, and contact them when you have questions. (If you re not sure where to start, try the school s office for international students.) Don t forget that you can get help filling out the FAFSA form either within the form itself at fafsa.gov or by phone at 1-800-4-FED-AID (1-800-433-3243; TTY for the deaf or hard of hearing 1-800-730-8913).

source_blocks.source_text_en: What federal student aid can I receive for my degree at an international school?
source_blocks.text: What federal student aid can I receive for my degree at an international school?

source_blocks.source_text_en: At many schools around the world, you can receive a federal student loan from the William D. Ford Federal Direct Loan (Direct Loan) Program. (Find out which international schools participate in the Direct Loan Program.) You may receive a Direct Subsidized Loan or Direct Unsubsidized Loan for your undergraduate education. Direct Unsubsidized Loans and Direct PLUS Loans are available to graduate students. Your parent also might be able to borrow on your behalf; he or she should ask about getting a Direct PLUS Loan for parents. International schools do not participate in the U.S. Department of Education s grant programs, so you will not be able to obtain a Federal Pell Grant to get your degree at an international school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much can I receive in federal student loan funds?
source_blocks.text: How much can I receive in federal student loan funds?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The annual limit for Direct Subsidized Loans plus Direct Unsubsidized Loans varies from \$5,500 to \$20,500, depending on a variety of factors (year in school, status as a dependent or independent student, etc.). Direct PLUS Loan amounts are determined by subtracting any other financial aid you re receiving from your total cost of attendance at the school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for a federal student loan to use at an international school?
source_blocks.text: How do I apply for a federal student loan to use at an international school?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for student loans at your international school using the same process you use to apply for aid in the U.S.
source_blocks.text: Apply for student loans at your international school using the same process you use to apply for aid in the U.S.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out a FAFSA form at fafsa.gov as early as possible. The FAFSA form is available on Oct. 1 for school attendance that begins any time from July 1 of the following year through June of the year beyond that. There is no special FAFSA form for students planning to attend international schools. Learn how to fill out the FAFSA form. Make sure the school you plan to attend has your FAFSA information. International schools have the ability to access your FAFSA information electronically. When you fill out the FAFSA form, list the school you plan to attend in the question about Federal School Codes. (The FAFSA site has a tool to let you search for your school s Federal School Code.) Once it s listed on your FAFSA form, your school will then download your data. Find out the next steps from your chosen school. Different schools proceed differently at this stage of the process. Ask your school how you will get your loan money what paperwork do you need to fill out, what are the deadlines, etc. Keep track of everything that is required of you; make copies of paper documents (or scan them) and file them safely; and meet those deadlines! And if your parent plans to get a Direct PLUS Loan, he or she should keep a close eye on required documents and deadlines as well. If you are a first-year student borrowing federal funds for the first time, you will have to complete entrance counseling. This means you ll be required to read text or watch a video online, or attend an in-person presentation, in order to learn about the responsibilities of taking out a loan. Your entrance counseling might happen before you leave the U.S. or after you arrive at your school; it depends on the school.

There is no special FAFSA form for students planning to attend international schools. Learn how to fill out the FAFSA form. Make sure the school you plan to attend has your FAFSA information. International schools have the ability to access your FAFSA information electronically. When you fill out the FAFSA form, list the school you plan to attend in the question about Federal School Codes. (The FAFSA site has a tool to let you search for your school s Federal School Code.) Once it s listed on your FAFSA form, your school will then download your data. Find out the next steps from your chosen school. Different schools proceed differently at this stage of the process. Ask your school how you will get your loan money what paperwork do you need to fill out, what are the deadlines, etc. Keep track of everything that is required of you; make copies of paper documents (or scan them) and file them safely; and meet those deadlines! And if your parent plans to get a Direct PLUS Loan, he or she should keep a close eye on required documents and deadlines as well. If you are a first-year student borrowing federal funds for the first time, you will have to complete entrance counseling. This means you ll be required to read text or watch a video online, or attend an in-person presentation, in order to learn about the responsibilities of taking out a loan. Your entrance counseling might happen before you leave the U.S. or after you arrive at your school; it depends on the school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How will I get paid?
source_blocks.text: How will I get paid?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your loan funds will be electronically transmitted from the U.S. Treasury to the international school s designated bank. First the school will put the funds toward anything you owe them (tuition, fees, etc.). If there is any money left over after the funds are applied to your account at the school, the extra money will go to you.
source_blocks.text: Your loan funds will be electronically transmitted from the U.S. Treasury to the international school s designated bank. First the school will put the funds toward anything you owe them (tuition, fees, etc.). If there is any money left over after the funds are applied to your account at the school, the extra money will go to you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your funds might not be disbursed (paid out) before you leave the U.S., so you will most likely have to come up with your travel expenses yourself.
source_blocks.text: Your funds might not be disbursed (paid out) before you leave the U.S., so you will most likely have to come up with your travel expenses yourself.

source_blocks.source_text_en: When and how do I repay the loan?
source_blocks.text: When and how do I repay the loan?

source_blocks.source_text_en: That depends on whether it s a subsidized or unsubsidized loan versus a PLUS loan. Repayment of a loan used to pay for international study works the same way as repayment of a loan used to pay for an American school. Get information about repaying federal student loans.
