source_blocks.source_text_en: How we use the combined ratings table
source_blocks.text: 我们如何使用合并评级表

source_blocks.source_text_en: We follow these steps to calculate your combined rating.
source_blocks.text: 我们按照以下步骤计算您的合并评级。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 1
source_blocks.text: 第一步

source_blocks.source_text_en: We start by putting your disability ratings in order, from highest to lowest percentage.
source_blocks.text: 我们首先将您的伤残评级按百分比从高到低排列。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example: If you had 2 disabilities rated as 50% disabling and 30% disabling, we d rank them in this order: 50%, then 30%.
source_blocks.text: 例如：如果您有2项伤残评级分别为50%和30%，我们会按此顺序排列：50%，然后30%。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 2
source_blocks.text: 第二步

source_blocks.source_text_en: Next, we look for your highest rating in the left column of the combined ratings table, and the next highest rating in the top row of the combined ratings table.
source_blocks.text: 接下来，我们在合并评级表的左栏中查找您的最高评级，并在合并评级表的顶行中查找次高评级。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In our example: We d look for 50 in the left column and 30 in the top row.
source_blocks.text: 在我们的示例中：我们会在左栏中查找50，在顶行中查找30。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 3
source_blocks.text: 第三步

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then, we look across from the 50 in the left column and down from the 30 in the top row to find the number that appears where the left column and top row meet. This is the combined value of the 2 ratings.
source_blocks.text: 然后，我们从左栏的50向右，从顶行的30向下，找到左栏与顶行交汇处的数字。这就是这两项评级的合并值。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In our example: This would be 65.
source_blocks.text: 在我们的示例中：这将是65。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 4
source_blocks.text: 第四步

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have 2 disabilities We round that combined value to the nearest 10% to find your combined disability rating. We round combined values ending in 1 to 4 down, and those ending in 5 to 9 up.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有2项伤残，我们将该合并值四舍五入到最接近的10%，以确定您的合并伤残评级。我们将以1至4结尾的合并值向下舍入，以5至9结尾的向上舍入。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In our example: Your combined disability rating would be 70%.
source_blocks.text: 在我们的示例中：您的合并伤残评级将为70%。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Step 5
source_blocks.text: 第五步

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have more than 2 disabilities
source_blocks.text: 如果您有超过2项伤残

source_blocks.source_text_en: We repeat the process for each additional disability. This means we take the combined value (before rounding) of the first 2 disability ratings and then combine that with the third highest rating, and so on until we ve added all disability ratings. We then round the final value to the nearest 10% to get your combined disability rating.
source_blocks.text: 我们对每项额外伤残重复此过程。这意味着我们取前2项伤残评级的合并值（未舍入），然后将其与第三高评级合并，依此类推，直到我们添加了所有伤残评级。然后我们将最终值四舍五入到最接近的10%，以获得您的合并伤残评级。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example: If we added a third disability rated at 10% disabling to our original example, we would take your combined value of 65 and look for that number in the left column of the combined ratings table. We would then look for 10 in the top row and find the number where the left column and top row meet. In this example, that number would be 69.
source_blocks.text: 例如：如果我们向原始示例中添加第三项伤残评级为10%，我们将取您的合并值65，并在合并评级表的左栏中查找该数字。然后我们会在顶行中查找10，并找到左栏与顶行交汇处的数字。在此示例中，该数字将为69。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We would then round this number up to 70%, and this would be your combined disability rating.
source_blocks.text: 然后我们会将这个数字向上取整至70%，这就是您的综合伤残等级。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Watch our videos to learn more about how VA disability ratings and compensation work: Compensation 101: How did I get this rating? (YouTube)Compensation 101: What is disability compensation? (YouTube)Compensation 101: What is service connection? (YouTube)
source_blocks.text: 观看我们的视频，了解更多关于VA伤残等级和补偿如何运作的信息：补偿101：我是如何获得这个等级的？（YouTube）补偿101：什么是伤残补偿？（YouTube）补偿101：什么是服役关联？（YouTube）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help understanding your benefits or accessing services, please call us at 877-827-1000. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要帮助理解您的福利或获取服务，请拨打我们的电话877-827-1000。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上9:00为您服务。

documents.title: 关于 VA 健康福利 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA Health Benefits | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 关于 VA 健康福利 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA health benefits
source_blocks.text: 关于 VA 健康福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for VA health care, you ll receive coverage for the services you need to help you get and stay healthy. Learn more about your health care benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合 VA 医疗保健的资格，您将获得所需服务的保障，以帮助您保持健康。了解更多关于您的医疗保健福利的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What care and services does VA health care cover?
source_blocks.text: VA 医疗保健涵盖哪些护理和服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Each Veteran s medical benefits package is unique. Yours will include care and services to help:
source_blocks.text: 每位退伍军人的医疗福利套餐都是独一无二的。您的套餐将包括以下护理和服务，以帮助：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Treat illnesses and injuries Prevent future health problems Improve your ability to function Enhance your quality of life
source_blocks.text: 治疗疾病和伤害 预防未来的健康问题 改善您的功能能力 提高您的生活质量

source_blocks.source_text_en: All Veterans receive coverage for most care and services, but only some will qualify for added benefits like dental care. The full list of your covered benefits depends on:
source_blocks.text: 所有退伍军人都能获得大多数护理和服务的保障，但只有部分人有资格获得额外福利，如牙科护理。您所覆盖福利的完整列表取决于：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your priority group, and The advice of your VA primary care provider (your main doctor, nurse practitioner, or physician s assistant), and The medical standards for treating any health conditions you may have
source_blocks.text: 您的优先组别，以及 您的 VA 初级保健提供者（您的主治医生、执业护士或医师助理）的建议，以及 治疗您可能患有的任何健康状况的医疗标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about priority groups
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于优先组别的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should also know that being signed up for VA health care meets your Affordable Care Act (ACA) health coverage requirement of having minimum essential health coverage. We ll update this site if the ACA changes with new laws.Learn more about the ACA, VA, and you
source_blocks.text: 您还应该知道，注册 VA 医疗保健即满足《平价医疗法案》(ACA) 对拥有最低必要健康保险的覆盖要求。如果 ACA 因新法律而发生变化，我们将更新此网站。了解更多关于 ACA、VA 和您的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I m just separating from active duty and don t know where to start?
source_blocks.text: 如果我刚从现役退役，不知道从哪里开始怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can help you learn about and apply for VA health care benefits. A member of our Concierge for Care (C4C) team will call you soon after your separation from military service. We can answer any questions you may have, process your application over the phone, and help you schedule your first VA medical appointment.
source_blocks.text: 我们可以帮助您了解和申请 VA 医疗保健福利。我们的 Concierge for Care (C4C) 团队成员将在您退役后不久致电给您。我们可以回答您的任何问题，通过电话处理您的申请，并帮助您安排第一次 VA 医疗预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about transitioning from TRICARE to VA health care
source_blocks.text: 了解从 TRICARE 过渡到 VA 医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: More about your medical benefits package
source_blocks.text: 更多关于您的医疗福利套餐

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover preventive care services, like:
source_blocks.text: 我们涵盖预防性护理服务，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health exams (including gender-specific exams) - Health education (including nutrition education) - Immunization against infectious diseases (like flu shots) - Counseling on genetic diseases (diseases that run in families)
source_blocks.text: 健康检查（包括性别特定检查） - 健康教育（包括营养教育） - 针对传染病的免疫接种（如流感疫苗） - 遗传病（家族遗传疾病）咨询

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover inpatient hospital services, like:
source_blocks.text: 我们涵盖住院医院服务，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surgeries - Medical treatments - Kidney dialysis - Acute care (short-term treatment for a severe illness or injury or after surgery) - Specialized care (including organ transplants, intensive care for mental and physical conditions, and care for traumatic injuries).See more VA medical and surgical specialty care services
source_blocks.text: 手术 - 医疗治疗 - 肾透析 - 急性护理（针对严重疾病或伤害或手术后的短期治疗） - 专科护理（包括器官移植、心理和身体疾病的重症监护，以及创伤护理）。查看更多 VA 医疗和外科专科护理服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover urgent and emergency care services, like:
source_blocks.text: 我们涵盖紧急和紧急护理服务，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Urgent or emergency care at some VA health facilities.Find a VA health facility near you - Urgent care for injuries and illnesses that need attention right away, but aren't life threatening, at urgent care locations that are part of our contracted network. This may include care at a VA-approved: - Walk-in retail health clinic for minor illnesses like a sore throat or earache - Urgent care facility for more pressing (but not life-threatening) illnesses or injuries that require treatment like splinting, casting, or wound care
source_blocks.text: 在某些VA医疗机构提供的紧急或紧急护理。查找附近的VA医疗机构 - 对于需要立即关注但不危及生命的伤病，在我们的合同网络内的紧急护理地点提供紧急护理。这可能包括在VA批准的： - 免预约零售健康诊所，用于治疗喉咙痛或耳痛等轻微疾病 - 紧急护理设施，用于需要夹板、石膏或伤口护理等治疗的更紧迫（但不危及生命）的疾病或伤害

source_blocks.source_text_en: To use these services, you ll need to be enrolled in VA health care, and you'll need to have received care from us within the past 24 months. Be sure to tell the urgent care provider that you're using the VA urgent care benefit when you arrive.Learn more about urgent care - Emergency care in a non-VA hospital, clinic, or other medical setting only under certain conditions. For us to consider covering non-VA emergency care for a non-service-connected condition, you ll need to meet several requirements.Learn more about non-VA emergency medical care
source_blocks.text: 要使用这些服务，您需要注册VA医疗保健，并且在过去24个月内接受过我们的护理。到达时，请务必告知紧急护理提供者您正在使用VA紧急护理福利。了解更多关于紧急护理的信息 - 仅在特定条件下，在非VA医院、诊所或其他医疗场所提供紧急护理。对于非服务相关疾病，如果我们考虑覆盖非VA紧急护理，您需要满足多项要求。了解更多关于非VA紧急医疗护理的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover other services and needs, like:
source_blocks.text: 我们涵盖其他服务和需求，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mental health services to treat certain issues like posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), military sexual trauma (MST), depression, and substance use problems.Learn more about mental health services - Assisted living and home health care (depending on your needs and income as well as space in the programs).Learn more about assisted living and home health care - Prescriptions written or approved by a VA doctor.Refill your prescriptions
source_blocks.text: 心理健康服务，用于治疗某些问题，如创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、军事性创伤（MST）、抑郁症和物质使用问题。了解更多关于心理健康服务的信息 - 辅助生活和家庭保健（取决于您的需求和收入以及项目空间）。了解更多关于辅助生活和家庭保健的信息 - 由VA医生开具或批准的处方。续配处方

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may cover services that your VA primary care provider concludes you need to support your treatment (called ancillary services), like:
source_blocks.text: 我们可能涵盖您的VA初级保健提供者认为您需要支持治疗的服务（称为辅助服务），例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tests used to diagnose health conditions, including blood work, X-rays, and ultrasounds - Therapy and rehabilitation services, including physical therapy, vision rehab, and therapy for traumatic brain injury - Additional services, including prosthetic items, audiology (care for hearing loss), and radiation oncology (cancer care)
source_blocks.text: 用于诊断健康状况的检查，包括血液检查、X光和超声波 - 治疗和康复服务，包括物理治疗、视力康复和创伤性脑损伤治疗 - 其他服务，包括假肢、听力学（听力损失护理）和放射肿瘤学（癌症护理）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get help with some non-medical services, like:
source_blocks.text: 您可能能够获得一些非医疗服务的帮助，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Beneficiary travel benefits (help paying for travel related to treatment) - Caregiver support (help for the person who cares for you) - Veterans transportation service (help getting to and from appointments)
source_blocks.text: 受益人旅行福利（帮助支付与治疗相关的旅行费用） - 照护者支持（为照顾您的人提供帮助） - 退伍军人交通服务（帮助往返预约）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact the patient advocate at the VA medical center where you go for care. Your patient advocate can help you get foreign language or American Sign Language services to help you or your family members understand your medical or health care benefits.
source_blocks.text: 联系您接受护理的VA医疗中心的患者倡导者。您的患者倡导者可以帮助您获得外语或美国手语服务，以帮助您或您的家人理解您的医疗或保健福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To find out how to reach the patient advocate at your VA medical center, go to the website of the VA health care system that the medical center is part of. In the page s navigation, click on Patients & Visitors. A submenu will appear. Select Patient Information and then Customer Service. Find your medical center s website
source_blocks.text: 要了解如何联系您所在VA医疗中心的患者倡导者，请访问该医疗中心所属的VA医疗保健系统的网站。在页面导航中，点击“患者与访客”。将出现一个子菜单。选择“患者信息”，然后选择“客户服务”。查找您医疗中心的网站

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover routine eye exams and preventive tests. In some cases, you may get coverage for eyeglasses or services for blind or low-vision rehabilitation.Learn more about vision care through VA
source_blocks.text: 我们涵盖常规眼科检查和预防性检查。在某些情况下，您可能获得眼镜或盲人或低视力康复服务的覆盖。了解更多关于VA视力护理的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: In certain cases, you may receive dental care as part of your VA health benefits.Find out if you can get dental care through VA
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，您可能作为VA健康福利的一部分获得牙科护理。了解您是否可以通过VA获得牙科护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a Veteran, you may be able to get assisted living, residential (live-in), or home health care through VA.Find out how to access these long-term care services
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人，您可能能够通过VA获得辅助生活、居住（住宿）或家庭保健服务。了解如何获得这些长期护理服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: These services are not included in your VA medical benefits package:
source_blocks.text: 这些服务不包括在您的VA医疗福利包中：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Abortions and abortion counseling - Cosmetic surgery, unless we conclude that it s medically necessary (needed to prevent or treat a certain illness, injury, condition, disease, or symptoms) - Gender alteration (gender reassignment surgery) - Health club or spa membership - Medicines and medical devices that aren t approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), except in 2 special cases: - You re in an approved clinical trial, or - You re seriously ill and your VA health care provider prescribes a new, unapproved medicine because there are no other comparable treatment options (called a compassionate use or expanded access exemption) - Inpatient hospital or outpatient care if you re a patient or inmate in a non-VA government agency institution, if that agency must provide the care or services by law
source_blocks.text: 堕胎和堕胎咨询 - 整容手术，除非我们认为这是医学上必要的（需要预防或治疗某种疾病、伤害、状况、疾病或症状） - 性别改变（性别重置手术） - 健康俱乐部或水疗会员资格 - 未经美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的药物和医疗器械，但有两种特殊情况除外： - 您参加批准的临床试验，或 - 您病情严重，且您的VA医疗保健提供者开具新的、未经批准的药物，因为没有其他可比较的治疗选择（称为同情使用或扩大访问豁免） - 如果您是非VA政府机构的患者或被监禁者，且该机构依法必须提供护理或服务，则住院或门诊护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll fill prescriptions by a non-VA community provider only if you meet all the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 只有满足以下所有要求，我们才会配发非VA社区提供者开具的处方。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件都必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re enrolled in VA health care - You have an assigned VA primary care provider - You ve given your VA provider your medical records from your non-VA provider - Your VA provider agrees with the prescription
source_blocks.text: 您已注册VA健康护理 - 您有一位指定的VA初级保健提供者 - 您已向您的VA提供者提供了来自非VA提供者的医疗记录 - 您的VA提供者同意该处方

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about prescriptions from community providers
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于社区提供者的处方信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: This will depend on factors like your income level, disability rating, and military service history. Most Veterans need to complete a financial assessment when they enroll. This helps us determine if you qualify for free VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 这将取决于您的收入水平、残疾评级和军事服务历史等因素。大多数退伍军人在注册时需要完成财务评估。这有助于我们确定您是否有资格获得免费的VA健康护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VA copaysFind out more about financial assessments
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于VA共付额 了解更多关于财务评估的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: At VA, we take a team approach to health care with you at the center. Research shows this kind of approach leads to better quality care, more satisfied patients, and fewer hospital visits.Find out who will care for you when you become part of the VA health care program.
source_blocks.text: 在VA，我们采取团队合作的方式进行健康护理，以您为中心。研究表明，这种方法能带来更高质量的护理、更满意的患者和更少的住院次数。了解当您加入VA健康护理计划后，谁将为您提供护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you sign up for VA health care, you become part of the country s largest integrated health care system with more than 1,200 care locations serving nearly 9 million Veterans each year.Learn more about where you ll get care
source_blocks.text: 当您注册VA健康护理时，您将成为全国最大的综合医疗系统的一部分，该系统拥有超过1,200个护理地点，每年为近900万退伍军人提供服务。了解更多关于您将在哪里获得护理的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have other forms of health care coverage (like a private insurance plan, Medicare, Medicaid, or TRICARE), you can use VA health care benefits along with these plans.Learn more about how VA works with other health insurance
source_blocks.text: 如果您有其他形式的健康保险（如私人保险计划、Medicare、Medicaid或TRICARE），您可以将VA健康护理福利与这些计划一起使用。了解更多关于VA如何与其他健康保险合作的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes.
source_blocks.text: 是的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're an eligible American Indian or Alaska Native Veteran
source_blocks.text: 如果您是符合资格的美国印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you receive care through an Indian Health Service facility or Tribal Health facility that has a reimbursement agreement with us:
source_blocks.text: 当您通过与我们签订报销协议的Indian Health Service设施或Tribal Health设施接受护理时：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don't need us to approve (or "preauthorize") your care before you get treated, and - You don't need to pay a VA copay
source_blocks.text: 您在接受治疗前无需我们批准（或“预先授权”）您的护理，并且 - 您无需支付VA共付额

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you live in Alaska
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在阿拉斯加

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to receive care through an Indian Health Service facility or Tribal Health facility even if you're not an eligible American Indian or Alaska Native Veteran.
source_blocks.text: 即使您不是符合资格的美国印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民退伍军人，您也可能能够通过Indian Health Service设施或Tribal Health设施接受护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: But, you'll need to get preauthorization before you receive care, and you may need to pay a copay for your care.
source_blocks.text: 但是，您需要在接受护理前获得预先授权，并且可能需要为您的护理支付共付额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To learn more, email the Indian Health Service and Tribal Health Health Program team or read more about the Indian Health Service and Tribal Health Programs online.
source_blocks.text: 要了解更多信息，请发送电子邮件至Indian Health Service和Tribal Health健康计划团队，或在线阅读更多关于Indian Health Service和Tribal Health计划的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please call us at 877-222-8387. We're here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.Or contact your state s Veterans agency
source_blocks.text: 请致电我们877-222-8387。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00提供服务。或联系您所在州的退伍军人事务机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. If you re signed up for the VA health care program, you can manage your VA health and benefits online:
source_blocks.text: 是的。如果您已注册VA健康护理计划，您可以在线管理您的VA健康和福利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Refill your prescriptionsSend a secure message to your health care team
source_blocks.text: 续配处方 向您的健康护理团队发送安全消息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also check the status of a disability or pension claim online.Check your claim status
source_blocks.text: 您也可以在线查看伤残或养老金申请的状态。查看您的申请状态

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA insurance options and eligibility
source_blocks.text: 关于 VA 保险选项与资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out which VA insurance programs may be right for you as a Veteran, service member, spouse, or dependent child.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为 Veteran、service member、spouse 或 dependent child，哪些 VA 保险计划可能适合您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know which life insurance program I m eligible for?
source_blocks.text: 如何知道我符合哪种人寿保险计划的资格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Different programs cover Veterans (VGLI), service members (SGLI), and family members (FSGLI). You may also be able to get short-term financial coverage through TSGLI to help you recover from a traumatic (severe) injury. And if you re disabled because of an injury or illness caused or made worse by your active service, you may be able to get coverage through S-DVI to continue your life insurance beyond 2 years after you leave the military.
source_blocks.text: 不同的计划覆盖 Veterans (VGLI)、service members (SGLI) 和 family members (FSGLI)。您也可能通过 TSGLI 获得短期财务保障，以帮助您从 traumatic (severe) injury 中恢复。如果您因 active service 导致或加重的 injury 或 illness 而残疾，您可能可以通过 S-DVI 获得保障，以便在离开军队后继续您的 life insurance 超过 2 年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you re ending your military tour of duty soon, you ll need to get new coverage quickly. In some cases, you must act within 120 days of leaving the military to be sure there s no break in your coverage.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您即将结束 military tour of duty，您需要迅速获得新的保障。在某些情况下，您必须在离开军队后的 120 天内采取行动，以确保您的保障没有中断。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA life insurance options
source_blocks.text: VA 人寿保险选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI)
source_blocks.text: Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get group life insurance while you re serving.
source_blocks.text: 在服役期间获得团体人寿保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)
source_blocks.text: Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add coverage for your spouse and dependent children (children who rely on you for financial support).
source_blocks.text: 为您的 spouse 和 dependent children（依赖您提供经济支持的子女）添加保障。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)
source_blocks.text: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get short-term financial support to help you recover from a severe injury.
source_blocks.text: 获得短期财务支持，帮助您从严重伤害中恢复。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)
source_blocks.text: Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get group life insurance once you ve ended your service.
source_blocks.text: 在结束服役后，获取团体人寿保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance (S-DVI)
source_blocks.text: 服务性残疾退伍军人保险（S-DVI）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re disabled because of an injury or illness caused or made worse by your active service, continue your life insurance beyond 2 years after you leave the military.
source_blocks.text: 如果你因现役服务导致或加重的伤病而残疾，可在退伍后2年内继续你的人寿保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI)
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人抵押贷款人寿保险（VMLI）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a severe service-connected disability, get mortgage protection insurance for a home that s been adapted to meet your needs.
source_blocks.text: 如果你有严重的服务相关性残疾，可为已改造以适应你需求的住房获取抵押贷款保护保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Access your VA life insurance policy online
source_blocks.text: 在线访问您的VA人寿保险保单

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have VA life insurance, the easiest way to manage your policy is online. You can use your online portal to:
source_blocks.text: 如果您有VA人寿保险，管理保单的最简单方式是线上操作。您可以使用在线门户来：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your policy s status to make sure it s up to date Pay your premium (the amount you ll pay each month to keep your coverage) Find out about your plan and renewal options. These will depend on which type of plan you have. Update your beneficiary (the person you ve picked to get the money from your policy if you die). You ll want to review your beneficiary information at least once a year to make sure the name and contact information is still correct. You ll also need to review the information and make any changes if you get divorced, have a child, or go through other big life changes.
source_blocks.text: 检查您的保单状态，确保其是最新的 支付保费（您每月为维持保障所需支付的金额） 了解您的计划和续保选项。这些将取决于您拥有的计划类型。 更新您的受益人（您指定在您去世后获得保单赔付的人）。您应至少每年审查一次受益人信息，确保姓名和联系方式仍然正确。如果您离婚、生育子女或经历其他重大生活变化，也需要审查信息并进行任何更改。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access my policy?
source_blocks.text: 如何访问我的保单？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA life insurance policy with a file number that starts with a V, RH, J, RS, K, or W or if you d like to apply for service-disabled life insurance (life insurance for Veterans who have become disabled as a result of serving in the military), access your policy online through VA.Find your policy through VA
source_blocks.text: 如果您拥有文件编号以V、RH、J、RS、K或W开头的VA人寿保险保单，或者您想申请服务性残疾保险（针对因服役致残的退伍军人的寿险），请通过VA在线访问您的保单。通过VA查找您的保单

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI) policy with a VGLI control number, access your policy online through the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance at Prudential Insurance Company of America. Prudential works with us to provide SGLI and VGLI benefits to service members and Veterans. Find your policy through Prudential Insurance Company of America
source_blocks.text: 如果您拥有VGLI控制号的Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)保单，请通过Prudential Insurance Company of America的Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance在线访问您的保单。Prudential与我们合作，为军人和退伍军人提供SGLI和VGLI福利。通过Prudential Insurance Company of America查找您的保单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Enhanced eligibility for returning OEF/OIF/OND combat Veterans
source_blocks.text: Enhanced eligibility for returning OEF/OIF/OND combat Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can receive free VA health care for up to 5 years after discharge or release for any condition related to your service in Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF) in Afghanistan or Operation Iraqi Freedom (OIF) or Operation New Dawn (OND) in Iraq. This is called an enhanced eligibility period.
source_blocks.text: You can receive free VA health care for up to 5 years after discharge or release for any condition related to your service in Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF) in Afghanistan or Operation Iraqi Freedom (OIF) or Operation New Dawn (OND) in Iraq. This is called an enhanced eligibility period.

source_blocks.source_text_en: We encourage you to apply right away
source_blocks.text: We encourage you to apply right away

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you wait to apply for VA health care until after your enhanced eligibility period ends, we won t factor your OEF/OIF/OND combat Veteran status into our decision on your enrollment. Instead, we ll base your eligibility on factors such as your income and VA disability rating. So even if you don t think you need medical care right now, we encourage you to apply for VA health care right away to take advantage of this enhanced eligibility period.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran who's recently separated from active duty, including active National Guard or Reserve duty, you may be eligible for VA health care for all or some of your health care needs. We ll determine your eligibility based on your service history, VA disability rating, income, and other factors. If you had active-duty status for training purposes only, you don t qualify for VA health care.Learn more about VA health care eligibility Find out how to apply for VA health care

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I apply for VA health care before I ve ended my service?
source_blocks.text: Can I apply for VA health care before I ve ended my service?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can apply as soon as you ve received your separation or retirement papers. If we determine you re eligible, you ll be enrolled once you ve separated or retired.
source_blocks.text: Yes. You can apply as soon as you ve received your separation or retirement papers. If we determine you re eligible, you ll be enrolled once you ve separated or retired.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I use VA health care while I m still on active duty?
source_blocks.text: Can I use VA health care while I m still on active duty?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to use VA health care if:
source_blocks.text: You may be able to use VA health care if:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You need emergency or urgent care. We ll provide care first, and then get TRICARE authorization for care once we ve stabilized your health. You need routine care and you have a valid TRICARE referral or authorization. The VA health facility you re visiting has a VA/DoD sharing agreement that allows us to provide care without referrals. For more information about this, please contact your local military hospital or clinic (also called a military treatment facility) or TRICARE office. Find a military treatment facility Contact TRICARE

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I ve just separated and I don t know where to start?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We can help you learn about and apply for VA health care benefits. A member of our Concierge for Care (C4C) team will call you soon after your separation from military service. We can answer any questions you may have, process your application over the phone, and help you schedule your first VA medical appointment.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add Dependents To Your VA Disability Benefits | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 将家属添加到您的VA残疾福利中 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add dependents to your VA disability benefits
source_blocks.text: 将家属添加到您的VA残疾福利中

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to add a dependent spouse, child, and/or parent to your VA disability benefits for additional compensation.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何将受抚养配偶、子女和/或父母添加到您的VA残疾福利中，以获得额外补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for additional VA disability compensation for my dependent(s)?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格为我的家属获得额外的VA残疾补偿？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for additional disability compensation for a spouse, child, and/or parent if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两项要求，您可能有资格为配偶、子女和/或父母获得额外的残疾补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 这两项都必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are eligible for VA disability compensation, and Have a combined disability rating of at least 30%
source_blocks.text: 有资格获得VA残疾补偿，并且 合并残疾评级至少为30%

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adding a dependent may make you eligible to receive a higher compensation payment (also called a benefit rate).
source_blocks.text: 添加家属可能使您有资格获得更高的补偿金（也称为福利费率）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who does VA consider a dependent?
source_blocks.text: VA认为谁是家属？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A dependent is:
source_blocks.text: 家属是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A spouse (Note: we recognize same-sex and common-law marriages) A parent, if you re directly caring for them and their income and net worth are below a certain amount An unmarried child (including an adopted child or stepchild) who meets one of the eligibility requirements listed below
source_blocks.text: 配偶（注意：我们承认同性婚姻和普通法婚姻） 父母，如果您直接照顾他们，且他们的收入和净资产低于一定金额 未婚子女（包括收养子女或继子女），且满足以下列出的资格要求之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: To be considered a dependent, one of these must be true of an unmarried child. They:
source_blocks.text: 要被视为家属，未婚子女必须满足以下条件之一。他们：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are under 18 years old, or Are between the ages of 18 and 23 years old and enrolled in school full time, or Became permanently disabled before they turned 18
source_blocks.text: 未满18岁，或 年龄在18至23岁之间，并且全日制就读于学校，或 在年满18岁之前成为永久残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: When should I add a dependent to my benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我应该何时将家属添加到我的福利中？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on where you are in the process of filing for disability compensation.
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您在申请残疾补偿过程中的阶段。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you haven t yet filed a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未提交残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a claim for additional compensation for a dependent at the same time as you file your original claim for disability compensation.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在提交原始残疾补偿申请的同时，为家属提交额外补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive a combined disability rating of at least 30%, we ll automatically consider your eligibility for additional compensation for your dependent.
source_blocks.text: 如果您获得至少30%的合并残疾评级，我们将自动考虑您为家属获得额外补偿的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 了解如何为残疾补偿提交申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have one or more dependents, but you didn t claim them when you originally filed for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 如果你有一个或多个受抚养人，但在最初提交残疾补偿申请时没有申报他们

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a combined disability rating of at least 30%, you can file a claim for additional disability compensation now.
source_blocks.text: 如果你的综合残疾评级至少为30%，你现在可以提交额外残疾补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If something changes in your family status after you received a combined disability rating of at least 30%
source_blocks.text: 如果在获得至少30%的综合残疾评级后，你的家庭状况发生变化

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a claim for additional disability compensation whenever you add a dependent.
source_blocks.text: 每当你增加一名受抚养人时，你都可以提交额外残疾补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can add a dependent if:
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，你可以增加受抚养人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You get married You have or adopt a child Your child is between 18 and 23 years old and enrolled in school full time We determine that your child, who is at least 18 years old, became permanently disabled before turning 18 You become the caregiver for a parent whose income and net worth is below a certain amount
source_blocks.text: 你结婚 你生育或收养子女 你的子女年龄在18至23岁之间，且全日制在校就读 我们确定你的子女（年满18岁）在年满18岁之前成为永久性残疾 你成为收入及净资产低于一定数额的父母的照护者

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I add a dependent to my benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何在我的福利中添加受抚养人？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To file a claim for additional disability compensation for a child or spouse
source_blocks.text: 为子女或配偶提交额外残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a claim for additional compensation for a child or spouse online right now through our eBenefits website.
source_blocks.text: 你现在可以通过我们的eBenefits网站在线为子女或配偶提交额外补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You may need to provide more information or forms along with your claim.
source_blocks.text: 注意：你可能需要随申请提供更多信息或表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to add a dependent child or spouse
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits添加受抚养子女或配偶

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re claiming your child who became permanently disabled before they turned 18, you ll need to turn in all private medical records relating to the child s disabilities with your application.
source_blocks.text: 如果你申报的子女在年满18岁前成为永久性残疾，你需要随申请提交与该子女残疾相关的所有私人医疗记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your dependent is a child who s between 18 and 23 years old and attending school full time, you ll also need to submit a Request for Approval of School Attendance (VA Form 21-674) with your application.
source_blocks.text: 如果你的受抚养人是年龄在18至23岁之间且全日制就读的子女，你还需要随申请提交《学校出勤批准请求》（VA Form 21-674）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 21-674 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载VA Form 21-674（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: To file a claim for additional disability compensation for a dependent parent
source_blocks.text: 为受抚养父母提交额外残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to fill out and submit a Statement of Dependency of Parent(s) (VA Form 21P-509) by mail or fax. Download VA Form 21P-509 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 你需要填写并邮寄或传真《父母受抚养声明》（VA Form 21P-509）。下载VA Form 21P-509（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please send all correspondence related to compensation claims to this address:
source_blocks.text: 请将所有与补偿申请相关的信函发送至以下地址：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Veterans Affairs Evidence Intake Center PO Box 4444 Janesville, WI 53547-4444
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部证据接收中心 PO Box 4444 Janesville, WI 53547-4444

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or fax it to:
source_blocks.text: 或传真至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 844-531-7817 if you live in the U.S., or +1-248-524-4260 if you live outside of the U.S.
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在美国，请拨打 844-531-7817；如果您居住在美国境外，请拨打 +1-248-524-4260。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help with my claim?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can work with an accredited Veterans Service Officer (VSO). We trust these professionals because they re trained and certified in the VA claims and appeals process. A VSO can answer your questions or even file your claim for you.Get help filing your claim
source_blocks.text: 您可以与经认证的退伍军人服务官员 (VSO) 合作。我们信任这些专业人士，因为他们经过 VA 索赔和上诉流程的培训和认证。VSO 可以回答您的问题，甚至代您提交索赔。获取提交索赔的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: More questions about adding a dependent to your VA disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 关于向您的 VA 伤残补偿中添加受抚养人的更多问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, but we encourage you to file online. The online process is simple, and you can upload your supporting documents along with your claim.
source_blocks.text: 可以，但我们鼓励您在线提交。在线流程简单，您可以随索赔一起上传支持文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you file your claim online, we recognize the day you start the online claim process as the date VA received your claim. This means that if we decide you re eligible for additional disability compensation, we ll pay you back to this date.
source_blocks.text: 当您在线提交索赔时，我们将您开始在线索赔流程的日期视为 VA 收到您的索赔的日期。这意味着，如果我们确定您有资格获得额外伤残补偿，我们将从该日期起向您补发款项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you can t, or don t want to file online, you can file a claim for additional disability compensation by mail or fax using the forms below:
source_blocks.text: 如果您不能或不想在线提交，您可以使用以下表格通过邮寄或传真提交额外伤残补偿索赔：

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a spouse or a child under 18 years of age, you ll need to fill out a Declaration of Status of Dependents (VA Form 21-686c). Download VA Form 21-686c (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 对于配偶或未满 18 岁的子女，您需要填写《受抚养人身份声明》（VA 表格 21-686c）。下载 VA 表格 21-686c (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a child who s between 18 and 23 years old and attending school full time, you ll need to fill out both VA Form 21-686c and a Request for Approval of School Attendance (VA Form 21-674). Download VA Form 21-686c (PDF) Download VA Form 21-674 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 对于年龄在 18 至 23 岁之间且全日制就读的子女，您需要同时填写 VA 表格 21-686c 和《入学批准申请》（VA 表格 21-674）。下载 VA 表格 21-686c (PDF) 下载 VA 表格 21-674 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: For a dependent parent, you ll need to fill out a Statement of Dependency of Parent(s) (VA Form 21P-509). Download VA Form 21P-509 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 对于受抚养的父母，您需要填写《父母受抚养声明》（VA 表格 21P-509）。下载 VA 表格 21P-509 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail your completed form(s) to:
source_blocks.text: 将填写完整的表格邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Veterans Affairs Evidence Intake Center PO Box 4444 Janesville, WI 53547-4444
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部证据接收中心 PO Box 4444 Janesville, WI 53547-4444

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or fax them to:
source_blocks.text: 或传真至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 844-531-7817 if you live in the U.S., or +1-248-524-4260 if you live outside of the U.S.
source_blocks.text: 如果您居住在美国，请拨打 844-531-7817；如果您居住在美国境外，请拨打 +1-248-524-4260。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file your claim again online for a faster decision. If we award you additional disability compensation, we ll give you back pay from the original date we received your paper form.
source_blocks.text: 您可以再次在线提交索赔，以获得更快的决定。如果我们批准您获得额外伤残补偿，我们将从我们收到您的纸质表格的原始日期起向您补发款项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may pay you back to the date of your marriage or the birth or adoption of your child if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下所有要求，我们可能会从您的婚姻日期或子女出生或收养日期起向您补发款项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 所有这些条件都必须满足。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Had already received a combined disability rating of at least 30% at the time of the marriage, birth, or adoption, and - File your claim for additional disability compensation for the dependent within a year of the marriage, birth, or adoption, and - Respond within a year to our request for any more information or evidence needed to confirm your claim
source_blocks.text: 在结婚、生育或收养时，已经获得了至少30%的综合伤残评级，并且 - 在结婚、生育或收养后的一年内，为受抚养人提交额外伤残补偿申请，并且 - 在我们要求提供更多信息或证据以确认您的申请时，一年内作出回应

source_blocks.source_text_en: If it s been more than one year since you got married or had or adopted a child, we may not pay you back to the date of the marriage, birth, or adoption. Instead, we may pay you back only to the date we received your claim for additional disability for the dependent or, in some cases, up to a year before before this date.
source_blocks.text: 如果自您结婚、生育或收养子女以来已超过一年，我们可能不会将补偿追溯至结婚、生育或收养之日。相反，我们可能只会追溯至我们收到您为受抚养人提交的额外伤残补偿申请之日，或者在某些情况下，追溯至该日期前最多一年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll begin paying you within 2 weeks after we approve your claim.
source_blocks.text: 我们将在批准您的申请后2周内开始向您支付。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can check this through your eBenefits account.
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过eBenefits账户查看此信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then click the Dependents link under the My Profile section.
source_blocks.text: 然后点击“My Profile”部分下的“Dependents”链接。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you see your dependent(s) listed there, you should be eligible for additional compensation for them. If they re not listed, you should file a claim for the additional benefit. Go to eBenefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您在那里看到您的受抚养人，您应该有资格获得他们的额外补偿。如果未列出，您应提交额外福利申请。前往eBenefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: Questions about adding or removing certain kinds of dependents
source_blocks.text: 关于添加或移除某些类型受抚养人的问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you and your spouse are both Veterans with a combined disability rating of at least 30%, you can both receive additional disability compensation for each other and for your children.
source_blocks.text: 如果您和您的配偶都是退伍军人，且综合伤残评级至少为30%，你们双方都可以为彼此和子女获得额外伤残补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You should know: It ll take us longer to process your claim if your spouse is also a Veteran. But if you file your claim online, and we decide you re eligible for additional disability compensation for your dependent(s), we ll pay you back to the date you started the online claim process.
source_blocks.text: 您应该知道：如果您的配偶也是退伍军人，我们处理您的申请需要更长时间。但如果您在线提交申请，并且我们确定您有资格为您的受抚养人获得额外伤残补偿，我们将追溯至您开始在线申请流程之日向您支付。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can submit a request through eBenefits asking us to stop paying additional disability compensation for a spouse or child. We ll need more time to process a request that involves a child than a request that involves a spouse, but the online process is still much faster than submitting a paper request.
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过eBenefits提交请求，要求我们停止为配偶或子女支付额外伤残补偿。处理涉及子女的请求比涉及配偶的请求需要更多时间，但在线流程仍然比提交纸质请求快得多。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get divorced, you ll want to notify us right away. You don t need to send or upload supporting documents to eBenefits in this case.
source_blocks.text: 如果您离婚，您需要立即通知我们。在这种情况下，您无需向eBenefits发送或上传支持文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This will help to make sure we don t continue paying you additional disability compensation for your former spouse and, if applicable, stepchildren after the divorce. If we continue paying you benefits that you re not eligible for, we may withhold money from future payments until you ve paid us back. Go to eBenefits
source_blocks.text: 这将有助于确保我们在离婚后不会继续向您的前配偶以及（如果适用）继子女支付额外伤残补偿。如果我们继续向您支付您不符合资格的福利，我们可能会从未来的付款中扣留资金，直到您偿还我们。前往eBenefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to update your child s school information in eBenefits.
source_blocks.text: 您需要在eBenefits中更新您子女的学校信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Add or Remove Dependents (you ll find it under the Apply section on the homepage).
source_blocks.text: 点击“Add or Remove Dependents”（您可以在首页的“Apply”部分找到它）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then select Update Dependents. Go to eBenefits
source_blocks.text: 然后选择“Update Dependents”。前往eBenefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. We ll track your child s age based on the date of birth you give us when you submit your claim. When your child turns 18, we ll stop paying additional disability compensation for them unless you let us know they re enrolled in school full time.
source_blocks.text: 不会。我们将根据您提交索赔时提供的出生日期来跟踪您孩子的年龄。当您的孩子年满18岁时，我们将停止为其支付额外的残疾补偿，除非您告知我们他们正在全日制学校就读。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) and your VA health care coverage
source_blocks.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) and your VA health care coverage

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) also known as the health care law was created to expand access to coverage, control health care costs, and improve health care quality and care coordination. Find out what you need to know about the ACA and your health coverage.
source_blocks.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) also known as the health care law was created to expand access to coverage, control health care costs, and improve health care quality and care coordination. Find out what you need to know about the ACA and your health coverage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I still have to pay a penalty if I don t have health insurance?
source_blocks.text: Do I still have to pay a penalty if I don t have health insurance?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t have to pay a penalty if you don t have health insurance in 2019 or any year after that.
source_blocks.text: You don t have to pay a penalty if you don t have health insurance in 2019 or any year after that.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Through the end of 2018, the ACA required all U.S. taxpayers to have health coverage that met a minimum standard (called the minimum essential coverage requirement) unless they qualified for an exemption due to certain life events, financial status, or other factors. This meant that if you had affordable health coverage options, but chose not to buy health insurance, you would have to pay a fee when filing your taxes. This fee was known as an individual shared responsibility payment. It was also sometimes called the penalty, fine, or individual mandate.
source_blocks.text: Through the end of 2018, the ACA required all U.S. taxpayers to have health coverage that met a minimum standard (called the minimum essential coverage requirement) unless they qualified for an exemption due to certain life events, financial status, or other factors. This meant that if you had affordable health coverage options, but chose not to buy health insurance, you would have to pay a fee when filing your taxes. This fee was known as an individual shared responsibility payment. It was also sometimes called the penalty, fine, or individual mandate.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Congress changed this part of the law for plans starting in 2019 and after. The individual shared responsibility payment no longer applies starting in plan year 2019 (for which you ll file taxes in April 2020).
source_blocks.text: Congress changed this part of the law for plans starting in 2019 and after. The individual shared responsibility payment no longer applies starting in plan year 2019 (for which you ll file taxes in April 2020).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you didn t have coverage or an exemption in 2018, you may still have to pay a fee when you file your 2018 taxes in April 2019.Go to HealthCare.gov to learn more about exemptions
source_blocks.text: Note: If you didn t have coverage or an exemption in 2018, you may still have to pay a fee when you file your 2018 taxes in April 2019.Go to HealthCare.gov to learn more about exemptions

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does my health coverage through VA meet the ACA s minimum essential coverage requirement for 2018?
source_blocks.text: Does my health coverage through VA meet the ACA s minimum essential coverage requirement for 2018?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your health coverage meets the minimum essential coverage requirement for 2018 if you were signed up for one of the programs listed below. If you were covered under one of these programs in 2018, you won t have to pay the fee when you file your 2018 taxes.
source_blocks.text: Your health coverage meets the minimum essential coverage requirement for 2018 if you were signed up for one of the programs listed below. If you were covered under one of these programs in 2018, you won t have to pay the fee when you file your 2018 taxes.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To qualify, you must have been enrolled in one of these programs:
source_blocks.text: To qualify, you must have been enrolled in one of these programs:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VA health care program, or
source_blocks.text: The VA health care program, or

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Civilian Health and Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs (CHAMPVA), or
source_blocks.text: The Civilian Health and Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs (CHAMPVA), or

source_blocks.source_text_en: CHAMPVA through the Program of Comprehensive Assistance to Family Caregivers, or
source_blocks.text: CHAMPVA through the Program of Comprehensive Assistance to Family Caregivers, or

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Spina Bifida Health Care Benefits Program, or
source_blocks.text: The Spina Bifida Health Care Benefits Program, or

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Department of Defense TRICARE plan that provides minimum essential coverage
source_blocks.text: A Department of Defense TRICARE plan that provides minimum essential coverage

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does the ACA change my VA health benefits?
source_blocks.text: Does the ACA change my VA health benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. The health care law doesn t change your VA health benefits or your out-of-pocket costs.
source_blocks.text: No. The health care law doesn t change your VA health benefits or your out-of-pocket costs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I m not signed up for a VA or Department of Defense health care program, how do I get health coverage for 2019?
source_blocks.text: If I m not signed up for a VA or Department of Defense health care program, how do I get health coverage for 2019?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get coverage through the Health Insurance Marketplace. Open enrollment for 2019 is over. But you can still enroll or change plans if you have certain life changes or qualify for free or low-cost coverage through Medicaid or the Children s Health Insurance Program (CHIP). Go to HealthCare.gov to find out if you can enroll or change your plan

But you can still enroll or change plans if you have certain life changes or qualify for free or low-cost coverage through Medicaid or the Children s Health Insurance Program (CHIP). Go to HealthCare.gov to find out if you can enroll or change your plan

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you apply for an eligibility determination
source_blocks.text: After you apply for an eligibility determination

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens after you apply for a pre-need eligibility determination for burial in a VA national cemetery.
source_blocks.text: Find out what happens after you apply for a pre-need eligibility determination for burial in a VA national cemetery.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long does it take VA to make a decision?
source_blocks.text: How long does it take VA to make a decision?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount of time it takes to review your application depends on:
source_blocks.text: The amount of time it takes to review your application depends on:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The number of applications we re reviewing, and How much information you provided in your application, and Whether you provided your (or your sponsor s) DD214 or other separation documents along with your application
source_blocks.text: The number of applications we re reviewing, and How much information you provided in your application, and Whether you provided your (or your sponsor s) DD214 or other separation documents along with your application

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We ve received a large number of pre-need eligibility applications, and it s slowing down our approval process. We ll let you know when we ve received your application and how long we think it ll take to make a decision. We re sorry for the delay.
source_blocks.text: Note: We ve received a large number of pre-need eligibility applications, and it s slowing down our approval process. We ll let you know when we ve received your application and how long we think it ll take to make a decision. We re sorry for the delay.

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information, you can call 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. Please wait to hear back about your application rather than applying again. You don t need to do anything while you wait. We ll contact you if we need more information to make a decision.
source_blocks.text: For more information, you can call 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. Please wait to hear back about your application rather than applying again. You don t need to do anything while you wait. We ll contact you if we need more information to make a decision.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for burial benefits
source_blocks.text: If you qualify for burial benefits

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll receive a VA burial and memorial benefits folder from us in the mail.
source_blocks.text: You ll receive a VA burial and memorial benefits folder from us in the mail.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your folder will include:
source_blocks.text: Your folder will include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: A letter telling you if you can be buried in a VA national cemetery. This is called your pre-need decision letter. A National Cemetery Administration brochure and a burial benefits information sheet. These will tell you more about the benefits you ll receive. A copy of the supporting documents you submitted with your application
source_blocks.text: A letter telling you if you can be buried in a VA national cemetery. This is called your pre-need decision letter. A National Cemetery Administration brochure and a burial benefits information sheet. These will tell you more about the benefits you ll receive. A copy of the supporting documents you submitted with your application

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do after I receive my pre-need decision letter and folder?
source_blocks.text: What should I do after I receive my pre-need decision letter and folder?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keep your pre-need decision letter and folder in a safe place. Talk to your family members or authorized representative about your burial wishes including any memorialization requests and inscriptions and make sure they know where your benefits folder is located. They ll need this information to request your burial at the time of need.
source_blocks.text: Keep your pre-need decision letter and folder in a safe place. Talk to your family members or authorized representative about your burial wishes including any memorialization requests and inscriptions and make sure they know where your benefits folder is located. source_blocks.source_text_en: What do my family members need to do to request my burial at the time of need?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Agent Orange exposure from C-123 aircraft
source_blocks.text: Agent Orange exposure from C-123 aircraft

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you flew on or worked with C-123 aircraft in Vietnam or other locations, you may have had contact with Agent Orange. The U.S. military used this herbicide to clear trees and plants during the Vietnam War. C-123 aircraft sprayed Agent Orange during the war, and the planes still had traces of the chemical in them afterward while they were being used, up until 1986. Find out if you can get disability compensation and other benefits for illnesses we believe are caused by contact with Agent Orange.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Agent Orange exposure in Vietnam or Korea
source_blocks.text: 在越南或韩国接触橙剂

source_blocks.source_text_en: Did you serve in Vietnam, including aboard a vessel on the inland waterways or within the 12-mile territorial seas? Did you serve in or near the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) during the Vietnam Era?
source_blocks.text: 您是否曾在越南服役，包括在内陆水道上的船只上或在12海里领海内服役？您是否在越南战争期间在韩国非军事区（DMZ）内或附近服役？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served in either of these locations, you may have had contact with Agent Orange, an herbicide the U.S. military used to clear plants and trees during the war. We refer to this as having a presumption of contact. Find out if you can get disability compensation and other benefits for illnesses we believe are caused by Agent Orange.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在上述任一地点服役，您可能接触过橙剂，这是美军在战争期间用于清除植物和树木的除草剂。我们称此为推定接触。了解您是否能因我们认为由橙剂引起的疾病获得残疾补偿和其他福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能从VA获得残疾福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if the below descriptions are true for you.
source_blocks.text: 如果以下描述适用于您，您可能能够获得残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况必须属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange (called a presumptive disease)
source_blocks.text: 您患有我们认为由橙剂引起的疾病（称为推定疾病）

source_blocks.source_text_en: And at least one of these must also be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 并且以下至少一项也必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Came into contact with Agent Orange while serving in the military, or Served in or near the DMZ for any length of time between September 1, 1967, and August 31, 1971, or Served in the Republic of Vietnam for any length of time between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975. This may include serving aboard a vessel on the inland waterways, or on a vessel operating not more than 12 nautical miles seaward from the demarcation line of the waters of Vietnam and Cambodia (as detailed in Public Law 116-23, the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act of 2019).

source_blocks.source_text_en: The U.S. military used Agent Orange to clear plants and trees during the Vietnam War. If you served in Vietnam or in or near the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) during the Vietnam Era or in certain related jobs you may have had contact with this herbicide. We refer to this as having a presumption of contact. Find out if you can get disability compensation and other benefits for illnesses we believe are caused by Agent Orange.

This may include serving aboard a vessel on the inland waterways, or on a vessel operating not more than 12 nautical miles seaward from the demarcation line of the waters of Vietnam and Cambodia (as detailed in Public Law 116-23, the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act of 2019).

source_blocks.text: 提供科学和医学证据，证明该疾病与接触Agent Orange有关，或 证明该问题是在服役期间开始或因服役而加重

source_blocks.source_text_en: Scientific proof may include an article from a medical journal or a published research study.
source_blocks.text: 科学证据可能包括医学期刊上的文章或已发表的研究。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you file your claim, you'll need to submit a medical record that shows: - You have a current disability, and - There's a connection between Agent Orange exposure and your current disability
source_blocks.text: 当你提交索赔时，你需要提交一份医疗记录，显示： - 你目前有残疾，并且 - Agent Orange暴露与你的当前残疾之间存在联系

source_blocks.source_text_en: And you'll need to submit a military record that shows you: - Served in the Republic of Vietnam for any length of time between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975, or - Served in or near the Korean Demilitarized Zone for any length of time between September 1, 1967, and August 31, 1971, or - Came into contact with Agent Orange in a location other than Vietnam or the Korean Demilitarized Zone
source_blocks.text: 并且你需要提交一份军事记录，显示你： - 在1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间，曾在越南共和国服役任意时长，或 - 在1967年9月1日至1971年8月31日期间，曾在朝鲜非军事区（Korean Demilitarized Zone）内或附近服役任意时长，或 - 曾在越南或朝鲜非军事区以外的地点接触过Agent Orange

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿索赔

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review the Veterans compensation benefits rate tables
source_blocks.text: 查看Veterans补偿福利费率表

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact us if you have questions:
source_blocks.text: 如有疑问，请联系我们：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the Agent Orange help line at 800-749-8387, or Send an email to GW/AOHelpline@vba.va.gov
source_blocks.text: 拨打Agent Orange帮助热线800-749-8387，或 发送电子邮件至GW/AOHelpline@vba.va.gov

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Please be ready to give us your name, email address, telephone number, and VA file number or Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 注意：请准备好提供您的姓名、电子邮件地址、电话号码以及VA档案号或社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you think you may have had contact with Agent Orange or other herbicides while serving in the military, you can request a health exam.Get an Agent Orange Registry health exam
source_blocks.text: 如果您认为在服役期间可能接触过Agent Orange或其他除草剂，您可以申请健康检查。获取Agent Orange Registry健康检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may have had contact with Agent Orange if you served in any of these ways
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾以下列方式服役，您可能接触过Agent Orange

source_blocks.source_text_en: In Vietnam or Korea
source_blocks.text: 在越南或韩国

source_blocks.source_text_en: Between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975, in Vietnam, or between September 1, 1967, and August 31, 1971, in or near the DMZ
source_blocks.text: 1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间，在越南；或1967年9月1日至1971年8月31日期间，在DMZ内或附近

source_blocks.source_text_en: On U.S. Navy and Coast Guard ships or other vessels in or near Vietnam
source_blocks.text: 在美国海军和海岸警卫队舰船或其他在越南境内或附近的船只上

source_blocks.source_text_en: Between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975
source_blocks.text: 1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间

source_blocks.source_text_en: On Thailand military bases
source_blocks.text: 在泰国军事基地

source_blocks.source_text_en: Between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975
source_blocks.text: 1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间

source_blocks.source_text_en: On C-123 airplanes
source_blocks.text: 在C-123飞机上

source_blocks.source_text_en: Between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975
source_blocks.text: 1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间

source_blocks.source_text_en: In testing and storage areas outside of Vietnam
source_blocks.text: 在越南境外的测试和储存区域

source_blocks.source_text_en: Between 1944 and a yet-to-be-determined date
source_blocks.text: 1944年至待定日期

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Aid and Attendance benefits and Housebound allowance
source_blocks.text: VA Aid and Attendance benefits and Housebound allowance

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits provide monthly payments added to the amount of a monthly VA pension for qualified Veterans and survivors. If you need help with daily activities, or you re housebound, find out if you qualify.
source_blocks.text: VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits provide monthly payments added to the amount of a monthly VA pension for qualified Veterans and survivors. If you need help with daily activities, or you re housebound, find out if you qualify.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits as a Veteran or survivor?
source_blocks.text: Am I eligible for VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits as a Veteran or survivor?

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Aid and Attendance eligibility
source_blocks.text: VA Aid and Attendance eligibility

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get a VA pension and you meet at least one of the requirements listed below, you may be eligible for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: If you get a VA pension and you meet at least one of the requirements listed below, you may be eligible for this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: At least one of these must be true:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You need another person to help you perform daily activities, like bathing, feeding, and dressing, or You have to stay in bed or spend a large portion of the day in bed because of illness, or You are a patient in a nursing home due to the loss of mental or physical abilities related to a disability, or Your eyesight is limited (even with glasses or contact lenses you have only 5/200 or less in both eyes; or concentric contraction of the visual field to 5 degrees or less)
source_blocks.text: You need another person to help you perform daily activities, like bathing, feeding, and dressing, or You have to stay in bed or spend a large portion of the day in bed because of illness, or You are a patient in a nursing home due to the loss of mental or physical abilities related to a disability, or Your eyesight is limited (even with glasses or contact lenses you have only 5/200 or less in both eyes; or concentric contraction of the visual field to 5 degrees or less)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Housebound benefits eligibility
source_blocks.text: Housebound benefits eligibility

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get a VA pension and you spend most of your time in your home because of a permanent disability (a disability that doesn t go away), you may be eligible for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: If you get a VA pension and you spend most of your time in your home because of a permanent disability (a disability that doesn t go away), you may be eligible for this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You can t get Aid and Attendance benefits and Housebound benefits at the same time.
source_blocks.text: Note: You can t get Aid and Attendance benefits and Housebound benefits at the same time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get this benefit?
source_blocks.text: How do I get this benefit?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits in one of these ways:
source_blocks.text: You can apply for VA Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits in one of these ways:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send a completed VA form to your pension management center (PMC)
source_blocks.text: Send a completed VA form to your pension management center (PMC)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out VA Form 21-2680 (Examination for Housebound Status or Permanent Need for Regular Aid and Attendance) and mail it to the PMC for your state. You can have your doctor fill out the examination information section.
source_blocks.text: Fill out VA Form 21-2680 (Examination for Housebound Status or Permanent Need for Regular Aid and Attendance) and mail it to the PMC for your state. You can have your doctor fill out the examination information section.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 21-2680 (PDF)Find your PMC
source_blocks.text: Download VA Form 21-2680 (PDF)Find your PMC

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also include with your VA form:
source_blocks.text: You can also include with your VA form:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other evidence, like a doctor s report, that shows you need Aid and Attendance or Housebound care Details about what you normally do during the day and how you get to places Details that help show what kind of illness, injury, or mental or physical disability affects your ability to do things, like take a bath, on your own
source_blocks.text: Other evidence, like a doctor s report, that shows you need Aid and Attendance or Housebound care Details about what you normally do during the day and how you get to places Details that help show what kind of illness, injury, or mental or physical disability affects your ability to do things, like take a bath, on your own

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re in a nursing home, you ll also need to fill out a Request for Nursing Home Information in Connection with Claim for Aid and Attendance (VA Form 21-0779).Download VA Form 21-0779 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: If you re in a nursing home, you ll also need to fill out a Request for Nursing Home Information in Connection with Claim for Aid and Attendance (VA Form 21-0779).Download VA Form 21-0779 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can bring your information to a VA regional office near you.Find your nearest VA regional office
