source_blocks.text: 配偶和受抚养人的福利（VA DIC）| Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits for spouses and dependents (VA DIC)
source_blocks.text: 配偶和受抚养人的福利（VA DIC）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the surviving spouse, child, or parent of a service member who died in the line of duty, or the survivor of a Veteran who died from a service-related injury or illness, you may be able to get a tax-free monetary benefit called VA Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (VA DIC). Find out if you can get VA benefits or compensation.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是在执行任务中牺牲的军人的未亡配偶、子女或父母，或是因服役相关伤病去世的老兵的遗属，您可能有资格获得一项免税的金钱福利，称为VA Dependency and Indemnity Compensation（VA DIC）。了解您是否有资格获得VA福利或补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: DIC eligibility for survivors of Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans
source_blocks.text: 蓝水海军越南老兵遗属的DIC资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we denied your Blue Water Navy Veteran s service-connected disability claim in the past, you may be eligible for DIC benefits based on the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act of 2019.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们过去拒绝了您的蓝水海军退伍军人的服役相关残疾索赔，您可能根据2019年《蓝水海军越南退伍军人法案》有资格获得DIC福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See DIC eligibility information and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 查看DIC资格信息以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans who served on a Blue Water Navy vessel offshore of the Republic of Vietnam, or on another U.S. Navy or Coast Guard ship operating in the coastal waterways of Vietnam between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975, are now entitled to a presumption of service connection for illnesses related to Agent Orange exposure. This is a result of Public Law 116-23, also known as the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act of 2019.
source_blocks.text: 在1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间，在越南共和国近海蓝水海军舰艇上服役，或在美国海军或海岸警卫队船只上在越南沿海水域作业的退伍军人，现在被推定其疾病与接触橙剂有关。这是Public Law 116-23（即2019年《蓝水海军越南退伍军人法案》）的结果。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for VA DIC as a surviving spouse or dependent?
source_blocks.text: 作为未亡配偶或受抚养人，我是否有资格获得VA DIC？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for VA benefits or compensation for surviving spouses if you meet the requirements listed below. You ll also need to provide evidence with your claim showing that one of the descriptions below is true for the Veteran or service member. Evidence may include documents like military service records, doctor s reports, and medical test results.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下列出的要求，您可能有资格获得针对未亡配偶的VA福利或补偿。您还需要在索赔中提供证据，证明以下描述之一对退伍军人或服役人员属实。证据可能包括军事服役记录、医生报告和医学检测结果等文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Married the Veteran or service member before January 1, 1957, or - Married the Veteran or service member within 15 years of their discharge from the period of military service during which the qualifying illness or injury started or got worse, or - Were married to the Veteran or service member for at least 1 year, or - Had a child with the Veteran or service member, aren t currently remarried, and either lived with the Veteran or service member without a break until their death or, if separated, weren t at fault for the separation
source_blocks.text: 在1957年1月1日之前与退伍军人或服役人员结婚，或 - 在导致合格疾病或伤害开始或恶化的军事服役期间退伍后的15年内与其结婚，或 - 与退伍军人或服役人员结婚至少1年，或 - 与退伍军人或服役人员育有子女，目前未再婚，并且要么在退伍军人或服役人员去世前与其连续同居，要么如果分居，则分居并非您的过错

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you remarried on or after December 16, 2003, and you were 57 years of age or older at the time you remarried, you can still continue to receive compensation.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您在2003年12月16日或之后再婚，且再婚时年满57岁，您仍可继续领取补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need to provide evidence showing that one of these descriptions is true for the Veteran or service member:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要提供证据，证明以下描述之一对退伍军人或服役人员属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The service member died while on active duty, active duty for training, or inactive-duty training, or - The Veteran died from a service-connected illness or injury, or - The Veteran didn t die from a service-connected illness or injury, but was eligible to receive VA compensation for a service-connected disability rated as totally disabling for a certain period of time
source_blocks.text: 服役人员在现役、现役训练或非现役训练期间死亡，或 - 退伍军人因服役相关疾病或伤害死亡，或 - 退伍军人并非因服役相关疾病或伤害死亡，但在一段时间内有资格获得因服役相关残疾而被评定为完全残疾的VA补偿

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Veteran s eligibility was due to a rating of totally disabling, they must have had this rating:
source_blocks.text: 如果退伍军人的资格是由于完全残疾的评定，则他们必须具有此评定：

source_blocks.source_text_en: For at least 10 years before their death, or - Since their release from active duty and for at least 5 years immediately before their death, or - For at least 1 year before their death if they were a former prisoner of war who died after September 30, 1999
source_blocks.text: 在去世前至少10年，或 - 自其从现役退伍起，并在去世前至少5年，或 - 如果他们是1999年9月30日之后去世的前战俘，则在去世前至少1年

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Totally disabling means the Veteran s injuries made it impossible for them to work.
source_blocks.text: 注意：完全残疾意味着退伍军人的伤病使其无法工作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get compensation as a surviving child if you meet the requirements listed below. You ll also need to provide evidence with your claim showing that one of the descriptions below is true for the Veteran or service member. Evidence may include documents like military service records, doctor s reports, and medical test results.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下列出的要求，您可能有资格作为未亡子女获得补偿。您还需要在索赔中提供证据，证明以下描述之一对退伍军人或服役人员属实。证据可能包括军事服役记录、医生报告和医学检测结果等文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 所有这些条件都必须满足。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Aren t married, and - Aren t included on the surviving spouse s compensation, and - Are under the age of 18 (or under the age of 23 if attending school)
source_blocks.text: 未婚，且 - 未被纳入未亡配偶的补偿中，且 - 年龄在18岁以下（或如果在上学，则年龄在23岁以下）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you were adopted out of the Veteran s or service member s family, but meet all other eligibility criteria, you still qualify for compensation.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您被从退伍军人或服役人员的家庭中收养出去，但满足所有其他资格标准，您仍然有资格获得补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need to provide evidence that one of these descriptions is true for the Veteran or service member:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要提供证据，证明以下关于退伍军人或服役人员的描述之一属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The service member died while on active duty, active duty for training, or inactive-duty training, or - The Veteran died from a service-connected illness or injury, or - The Veteran didn t die from a service-connected illness or injury, but was eligible to receive VA compensation for a service-connected disability that was rated as totally disabling for a certain period of time
source_blocks.text: 服役人员在现役、现役训练或非现役训练期间死亡，或 - 退伍军人死于与服务相关的疾病或伤害，或 - 退伍军人并非死于与服务相关的疾病或伤害，但有资格获得VA补偿，该补偿针对被评定为完全残疾的服务相关残疾，且持续了一段时间

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Veteran s eligibility was due to a service-connected disability rated as totally disabling, they must have had this rating:
source_blocks.text: 如果退伍军人的资格是由于被评定为完全残疾的服务相关残疾，则他们必须具有此评级：

source_blocks.source_text_en: For at least 10 years before their death, or - Since their release from active duty and for at least 5 years immediately before their death, or - For at least 1 year before their death if they were a former prisoner of war who died after September 30, 1999
source_blocks.text: 在去世前至少10年，或 - 自他们从现役释放以来，且在去世前至少5年，或 - 如果他们是1999年9月30日之后去世的前战俘，则在去世前至少1年

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Totally disabling means the Veteran s injuries make it impossible for them to work.
source_blocks.text: 注意：完全残疾意味着退伍军人的伤害使他们无法工作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get compensation as a surviving parent if both of the descriptions below are true for you. You ll also need to provide evidence with your claim showing that one of the descriptions below is true for the Veteran or service member. Evidence may include documents like military service records, doctor s reports, and medical test results.
source_blocks.text: 如果以下两个描述对您都属实，您可能作为未亡父母获得补偿。您还需要在索赔中提供证据，证明以下关于退伍军人或服役人员的描述之一属实。证据可能包括军事服役记录、医生报告和医学检测结果等文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两个条件都必须满足：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re the biological, adoptive, or foster parent of the Veteran or service member, and - Your income is below a certain amount View the parents DIC rate table
source_blocks.text: 您是退伍军人或服役人员的亲生父母、养父母或寄养父母，且 - 您的收入低于一定金额 查看父母DIC费率表

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We define a foster parent as someone who served in the role of a parent to the Veteran or service member before their last entry into active service.
source_blocks.text: 注意：我们将寄养父母定义为在退伍军人或服役人员最后一次进入现役之前，扮演其父母角色的人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need to provide evidence that one of these descriptions is true for the Veteran or service member:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要提供证据，证明以下关于退伍军人或服役人员的描述之一属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The service member died from an injury or illness while on active duty or in the line of duty while on active duty for training, or
source_blocks.text: 服役人员在现役期间或现役训练期间因公殉职，或因伤病在现役训练期间死亡，或

source_blocks.source_text_en: The service member died from an injury or certain illnesses in the line of duty while on inactive training, or
source_blocks.text: 服役人员因伤病在非现役训练期间因公殉职，或

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veteran died from a service-connected illness or injury
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人死于与服务相关的疾病或伤害

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tax-free monetary benefits
source_blocks.text: 免税货币福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for compensation?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请补偿？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First you ll need to fill out an application for benefits. The application you fill out will depend on your survivor status.
source_blocks.text: 首先，您需要填写一份福利申请表。您填写的申请表将取决于您的遗属身份。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the surviving spouse or child of a service member who died while on active duty, your military casualty assistance officer will help you to complete an Application for DIC, Death Pension, and/or Accrued Benefits by a Surviving Spouse or Child (VA Form 21P-534a). The officer will help you mail the form to the correct VA regional benefit office.Download VA Form 21P-534a (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 如果您是在服役期间死亡的军人的遗属配偶或子女，您的军人伤亡援助官员将帮助您完成《遗属配偶或子女的DIC、死亡抚恤金和/或应计福利申请表》（VA Form 21P-534a）。该官员将帮助您将表格邮寄至正确的VA区域福利办公室。下载VA Form 21P-534a (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the surviving spouse or child of a Veteran, fill out an Application for DIC, Death Pension, and/or Accrued Benefits (VA Form 21P-534EZ). Download VA Form 21P-534EZ (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人的遗属配偶或子女，请填写《DIC、死亡抚恤金和/或应计福利申请表》（VA Form 21P-534EZ）。下载VA Form 21P-534EZ (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a surviving parent, fill out an Application for Dependency and Indemnity Compensation by Parent(s) (VA Form 21P-535). Download VA Form 21P-535 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 如果您是遗属父母，请填写《父母依赖和赔偿补偿申请表》（VA Form 21P-535）。下载VA Form 21P-535 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for this benefit in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下任一方式申请此福利：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the form to the Pension Management Center (PMC) for your state. Find your PMC
source_blocks.text: 将表格邮寄至您所在州的Pension Management Center (PMC)。查找您的PMC

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work with an accredited representative. Get help filing your claim
source_blocks.text: 与认可的代理人合作。获取申请帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to a VA regional benefit office and get help from a VA employee. Find a VA regional benefit office near you
source_blocks.text: 前往VA区域福利办公室，获得VA员工的帮助。查找附近的VA区域福利办公室

documents.title: 与退伍军人法律法官举行的委员会听证会 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 与退伍军人法律法官举行的委员会听证会 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge
source_blocks.text: 与退伍军人法律法官举行的委员会听证会

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens at a Board of Veterans Appeals hearing and how to request one if you want to discuss your appeal with a Veterans Law Judge.
source_blocks.text: 了解退伍军人上诉委员会听证会的情况，以及如果您想与退伍军人法律法官讨论您的上诉，如何申请听证会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The process for Board hearings has changed
source_blocks.text: 委员会听证会的流程已更改

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're appealing a VA decision under the new process, keep reading below to learn how to request and prepare for a hearing. You'll follow the new process if you're:
source_blocks.text: 如果您根据新流程对退伍军人事务部的决定提出上诉，请继续阅读下文，了解如何申请和准备听证会。如果您符合以下情况，您将遵循新流程：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appealing a VA decision you received on or after February 19, 2019 Participating in the Rapid Appeals Modernization Program Opting into the new process using VA Form 10182
source_blocks.text: 对2019年2月19日或之后收到的退伍军人事务部决定提出上诉 参与快速上诉现代化计划 使用VA表格10182选择加入新流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re using VA Form 9 to appeal a VA decision you received before February 19, 2019, go to the Board of Veterans' Appeals (BVA) Hearing page
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用VA表格9对2019年2月19日之前收到的退伍军人事务部决定提出上诉，请前往退伍军人上诉委员会（BVA）听证会页面

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why should I consider requesting a Board hearing?
source_blocks.text: 为什么我应该考虑申请委员会听证会？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a video conference hearing if you want to provide testimony to a judge about your appeal. The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file.
source_blocks.text: 如果您想就您的上诉向法官提供证词，您可以申请视频会议听证会。听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉档案中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I required to have a Board hearing?
source_blocks.text: 我是否必须参加委员会听证会？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You aren t required to have a hearing. A Board hearing is always optional.
source_blocks.text: 您不必参加听证会。委员会听证会始终是可选的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about Board hearings
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于委员会听证会的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a Board hearing Prepare for your Board hearing Find out what to expect at your Board hearing Reschedule or withdraw your Board hearing request
source_blocks.text: 申请委员会听证会 准备您的委员会听证会 了解在您的委员会听证会上会发生什么 重新安排或撤回您的委员会听证会申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a Board hearing
source_blocks.text: 申请委员会听证会

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I request a Board hearing?
source_blocks.text: 我如何申请委员会听证会？

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182), select block 11c, Hearing with a Veterans Law Judge." Download VA Form 10182 (PDF) Learn more about requesting a Board Appeal
source_blocks.text: 当您填写决定审查请求：委员会上诉（VA表格10182）时，请选择第11c项，与退伍军人法律法官举行听证会。" 下载VA表格10182（PDF） 了解更多关于申请委员会上诉的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: How will I know when my hearing is scheduled?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道我的听证会何时安排？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Board of Veterans Appeals schedules hearings in docket order (the order in which they receive requests). You ll get a notice in the mail at least 30 days before your hearing is scheduled. It will let you know the date and time of the hearing and where it s located.
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人上诉委员会按案卷顺序（收到请求的顺序）安排听证会。您将在听证会安排前至少30天收到邮件通知。通知将告知您听证会的日期、时间和地点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prepare for your Board hearing
source_blocks.text: 为你的委员会听证会做准备

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I bring evidence to my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 我可以在听证会上提交证据吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, you can bring new and relevant evidence to your hearing to share with the judge. You also have 90 days after the day of your hearing to submit new evidence for the judge s review. Please don t submit new evidence prior to your hearing.
source_blocks.text: 可以，你可以携带新的且相关的证据到听证会上与法官分享。听证会结束后，你还有90天时间提交新证据供法官审查。请不要在听证会前提交新证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who can help me prepare for my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 谁能帮我准备听证会？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A representative who s trained in the appeals process can help you prepare for your hearing and for the conversation with the judge. Your representative must be a VA-accredited lawyer, claims agent, or someone from a Veterans Service Organization (VSO).
source_blocks.text: 受过上诉程序培训的代表可以帮助你准备听证会以及与法官的对话。你的代表必须是经VA认证的律师、索赔代理人或退伍军人服务组织（VSO）的成员。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help preparing for your hearing
source_blocks.text: 获取听证会准备帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what to expect at your Board hearing
source_blocks.text: 了解委员会听证会的预期情况

source_blocks.source_text_en: What will happen at my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 听证会上会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To start, the judge will swear you in, asking you to take an oath that you ll tell the truth during the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 开始时，法官会让你宣誓，要求你承诺在听证期间所说的话都是真实的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony and may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 你和法官会进行对话。法官会听取你的证词，并可能问你一些问题。如果你有代表，他们可能会在听证会上帮助你。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll then:
source_blocks.text: 然后你将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tell the judge why you think you qualify for the VA benefits in your appeal Answer any questions the judge has about your appeal Share any new evidence with the judge
source_blocks.text: 告诉法官为什么你认为自己符合上诉中VA福利的资格 回答法官关于你上诉的任何问题 与法官分享任何新证据

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hearings usually last 30 minutes.
source_blocks.text: 听证会通常持续30分钟。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When will the judge make a decision on my appeal?
source_blocks.text: 法官何时会对我的上诉做出决定？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You ll be asked if you d like a copy of the transcript for your personal records. The judge will review the hearing and the other evidence in your appeal file before making a decision.
source_blocks.text: 你的听证会将被记录并添加到你的上诉档案中。你会被询问是否需要一份记录副本供个人保存。法官将在做出决定前审查听证会内容及上诉档案中的其他证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When the 90-day time period for submitting new evidence closes, your case will be placed on the docket for a decision by a judge. If you don t have new evidence to submit, you can waive the 90-day time period that s automatically added to your appeal. Some Veterans Service Organizations will ask for time to make additional arguments in support of your case, so contact your representative first if you re thinking of waiving this time period.
source_blocks.text: 当提交新证据的90天期限结束时，你的案件将被列入法官决策的日程。如果你没有新证据要提交，你可以放弃自动添加到上诉中的90天期限。一些退伍军人服务组织会要求时间就你的案件提出额外论点，因此如果你考虑放弃这段时间，请先联系你的代表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reschedule or withdraw your Board hearing request
source_blocks.text: 重新安排或撤回你的委员会听证会请求

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need to reschedule my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要重新安排听证会怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to send a written request to the Board of Veterans Appeals providing good cause to reschedule your hearing at least 2 weeks before your hearing. Include your name, the VA file number for your appeal, and the reason why you need a new hearing date. Send your written request to the Board. Use the address or fax number listed below
source_blocks.text: 您需要在听证会至少2周前，向退伍军人上诉委员会发送书面请求，说明重新安排听证会的充分理由。请包含您的姓名、您的上诉的VA档案编号，以及您需要新听证日期的原因。将您的书面请求发送至委员会。请使用下方列出的地址或传真号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your hearing is less than 2 weeks away, you ll need to file a motion explaining why you need to reschedule.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的听证会距离现在不足2周，您需要提交动议，说明需要重新安排的原因。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Examples of good cause for rescheduling would include if you, your representative, or a witness are sick or you had trouble getting records. A judge will review your request, and you ll receive a notice in the mail when the judge decides if the hearing can be rescheduled.
source_blocks.text: 重新安排的充分理由示例包括：您、您的代表或证人患病，或者您在获取记录方面遇到困难。法官将审核您的请求，当法官决定是否可以重新安排听证会时，您将通过邮件收到通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will I lose my place in line if I reschedule my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 如果我重新安排听证会，会失去排队位置吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You won t lose your place in line. The Board of Veterans Appeals schedules hearings in docket order (the order in which they receive requests). You ll keep the same docket date, and your hearing will be rescheduled to the earliest date possible.
source_blocks.text: 您不会失去排队位置。退伍军人上诉委员会按案卷顺序（即收到请求的顺序）安排听证会。您将保留相同的案卷日期，您的听证会将重新安排到尽可能最早的日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need to withdraw my hearing?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要撤回听证会怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you change your mind about having a hearing, you can write to the Board to withdraw (cancel) your hearing request. This won t speed up your appeal unless you also switch to the Direct Review appeal option, which can only be done at certain times.
source_blocks.text: 如果您改变主意不想举行听证会，您可以写信给委员会撤回（取消）您的听证会请求。这不会加快您的上诉进度，除非您同时切换到直接审查上诉选项，而该选项只能在特定时间进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you switch to a different appeal option, you ll keep the same docket date and your appeal will be decided at the same time as other appeals with the same date. However, the time it takes to get a decision is different on each docket.
source_blocks.text: 如果您切换到不同的上诉选项，您将保留相同的案卷日期，您的上诉将与具有相同日期的其他上诉同时裁决。但是，每个案卷获得裁决所需的时间不同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need to withdraw your hearing request, you or your representative should send a written request at least 2 weeks before your hearing. Include your name, the VA file number for your appeal, and the reason you re withdrawing the appeal. You still have the option to submit new evidence, as long as you send it to the Board within 90 days of withdrawing your hearing request. Send your written request to the Board using the address or fax number listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要撤回听证会请求，您或您的代表应在听证会至少2周前发送书面请求。请包含您的姓名、您的上诉的VA档案编号，以及您撤回上诉的原因。您仍然可以选择提交新证据，只要您在撤回听证会请求后90天内将其发送至委员会。请使用下方列出的地址或传真号码将您的书面请求发送至委员会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where do I send the Board a written request or new evidence?
source_blocks.text: 我应该将书面请求或新证据发送至委员会的哪个地址？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can mail or fax a written request to reschedule or withdraw your Board hearing. You can also submit new evidence for the judge to review within 90 days of the day of your hearing.
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过邮寄或传真发送书面请求，以重新安排或撤回您的委员会听证会。您也可以在听证会之日起90天内提交新证据供法官审核。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038
source_blocks.text: Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038

source_blocks.source_text_en: By fax
source_blocks.text: 通过传真

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fax your request to 844-678-8979.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Camp Lejeune water contamination health issues
source_blocks.text: Camp Lejeune water contamination health issues

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served at Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune or Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) New River in North Carolina, you may have had contact with contaminants in the drinking water there. Scientific and medical evidence has shown an association between exposure to these contaminants during military service and development of certain diseases later on. If you have qualifying service at Camp Lejeune and a current diagnosis of one of the conditions listed below, you may be able to get disability benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Careers And Employment | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 职业与就业 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Careers and employment
source_blocks.text: 职业与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer the help you need to build your career and find the opportunities that are right for you.
source_blocks.text: 我们提供您所需的帮助，助您打造职业生涯并找到适合您的机会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get career and employment assistance Manage your career More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 获取职业与就业援助 管理您的职业生涯 更多信息与资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get help if I'm homeless or at risk of becoming homeless?
source_blocks.text: 如果我无家可归或有成为无家可归者的风险，如何获得帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may be able to help
source_blocks.text: 我们或许能提供帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer many programs and services that may help including free health care and, in some cases, free limited dental care. We can also help you connect with resources in your community, like homeless shelters or faith-based organizations.
source_blocks.text: 我们提供许多可能有所帮助的项目和服务，包括免费医疗保健，在某些情况下还包括免费的有限牙科护理。我们还可以帮助您联系社区中的资源，如无家可归者收容所或信仰组织。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find the support you need:
source_blocks.text: 找到您需要的支持：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at (877-424-3838) for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You ll talk privately with a trained VA counselor for free. Contact your nearest VA medical center and ask to talk with the VA social worker. If you're a female Veteran, ask for the Women Veterans Program Manager.Find the nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心电话 (877-424-3838)，每周7天、每天24小时获得帮助。您将免费与训练有素的VA顾问进行私下交谈。 联系最近的VA医疗中心，并要求与VA社会工作者交谈。如果您是女性退伍军人，请要求联系女性退伍军人项目经理。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Talk with someone right now:
source_blocks.text: 立即与他人交谈：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.Chat online with a trained VA staff member
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们关怀备至、经验丰富的退伍军人危机热线接线员联系，获得保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候可用。与训练有素的VA工作人员在线聊天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get career and employment assistance
source_blocks.text: 获取职业与就业援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: About Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (Chapter 31) programs
source_blocks.text: 关于职业康复与就业（第31章）项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore support-and-services program tracks for Veterans and service members with service-connected disabilities. Our programs can help you learn new skills, find a new job, start a new business, get educational counseling, or return to your former job.
source_blocks.text: 探索为有服务相关残疾的退伍军人和服役人员提供的支持与服务项目轨道。我们的项目可以帮助您学习新技能、找到新工作、创业、获得教育咨询或重返原工作岗位。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, find out if you're eligible for vocational rehab.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有服务相关残疾，限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，请了解您是否有资格获得职业康复。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get step-by-step instructions on how to apply for vocational rehab benefits.
source_blocks.text: 获取关于如何申请职业康复福利的分步说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational and Career Counseling (Chapter 36)
source_blocks.text: 教育与职业咨询（第36章）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get free educational and career counseling as a recently discharged Veteran or a dependent family member.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为近期退伍的退伍军人或家属，如何获得免费的教育与职业咨询。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Support for your Veteran-Owned Small Business
source_blocks.text: 支持你的退伍军人创办的小型企业

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register to do business with VA and get support for your Veteran-Owned Small Business.
source_blocks.text: 注册与VA开展业务，并获得对你退伍军人创办的小型企业的支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Support for dependent family members
source_blocks.text: 对家属的支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you're eligible for educational and vocational counseling as the dependent spouse or child of a Veteran or service member.
source_blocks.text: 查看你是否符合作为退伍军人或军人的受抚养配偶或子女获得教育与职业咨询的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manage your career
source_blocks.text: 管理你的职业生涯

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA transition assistance
source_blocks.text: VA过渡援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: As you separate from the military, explore your career options by attending a Transition Assistance Program (TAP) briefing.
source_blocks.text: 当你从军队退役时，通过参加过渡援助计划（TAP）简报会来探索你的职业选择。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Match your interests and skills to a career with a CareerScope assessment
source_blocks.text: 通过CareerScope评估将你的兴趣和技能与职业匹配

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use this online tool to get recommendations for careers you may enjoy and succeed in, and training programs to help you get started.
source_blocks.text: 使用此在线工具获取你可能喜欢并成功的职业建议，以及帮助你起步的培训项目。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a job (Department of Labor)
source_blocks.text: 找工作（劳工部）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Search for jobs, get help translating your military skills and experience to civilian jobs, and access other career resources.
source_blocks.text: 搜索工作，获取将你的军事技能和经验转化为文职工作的帮助，并访问其他职业资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find VA careers and support
source_blocks.text: 寻找VA职业和支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get support for starting or advancing your career at VA or other federal government departments.
source_blocks.text: 获取在VA或其他联邦政府部门开始或提升职业生涯的支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print your Civil Service Preference Letter
source_blocks.text: 打印你的公务员优先选择信

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print your Civil Service Preference Letter to verify your hiring preference for federal jobs.
source_blocks.text: 打印你的公务员优先选择信，以验证你在联邦工作中的招聘优先权。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get free classes for a year (LinkedIn)
source_blocks.text: 免费获得一年课程（LinkedIn）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get one year of free access to LinkedIn Premium and LinkedIn Learning.
source_blocks.text: 获得一年免费访问 LinkedIn Premium 和 LinkedIn Learning 的权限。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Subsistence allowance rates
source_blocks.text: 生活津贴标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: View the current subsistence allowance rates to find out the amount we'll provide to help you pay for basic needs (like food and clothing) if you're an eligible Veteran participating in the Voc Rehab program.
source_blocks.text: 查看当前的生活津贴标准，了解如果您是符合条件的参加 Voc Rehab 项目的退伍军人，我们将提供多少金额来帮助您支付基本需求（如食物和衣物）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VetSuccess on Campus
source_blocks.text: VetSuccess on Campus

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if our counselors can help you transition from military to college life.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们的顾问是否能帮助您从军队过渡到大学生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Voc Rehab and Employment glossary
source_blocks.text: Voc Rehab 和就业术语表

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the definitions of our programs and other common terms you may read when learning about Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment benefits.
source_blocks.text: 查看我们项目的定义以及您在了解 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment 福利时可能遇到的其他常用术语。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Voc Rehab success stories
source_blocks.text: Voc Rehab 成功案例

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read Veterans' stories of how Voc Rehab counselors and services helped them overcome challenges, find new opportunities, and achieve greater goals.
source_blocks.text: 阅读退伍军人的故事，了解 Voc Rehab 顾问和服务如何帮助他们克服挑战、发现新机会并实现更大的目标。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Resources for Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get links to more resources outside of VA that can help you in your job search.
source_blocks.text: 获取 VA 之外更多可以帮助您求职的资源的链接。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Resources for family members
source_blocks.text: 家庭成员资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Access valuable career resources for spouses and other family members of Veterans and service members.
source_blocks.text: 为退伍军人和军人的配偶及其他家庭成员获取宝贵的职业资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 其他 VA 福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: GI Bill 福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore options for using GI Bill benefits to help pay for school or training, and find out what benefits you can get.
source_blocks.text: 探索使用 GI Bill 福利来帮助支付学费或培训费用的选项，并了解您可以获得哪些福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other educational assistance programs
source_blocks.text: 其他教育援助项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran, Reservist, or National Guard Soldier who doesn t qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, see if you can get education benefits through other VA programs.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人、预备役人员或国民警卫队士兵，且不符合Post-9/11 GI Bill资格，请查看您是否可以通过其他VA项目获得教育福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Home loans
source_blocks.text: 住房贷款

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for a Certificate of Eligibility for a VA direct or VA-backed home loan to build, buy, improve, or refinance a home.
source_blocks.text: 申请VA直接或VA担保住房贷款的资格证明，以建造、购买、改善或再融资房屋。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance
source_blocks.text: 人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore your life insurance options and find out how to apply as a service member, Veteran, or family member.
source_blocks.text: 探索您的人寿保险选项，并了解作为军人、退伍军人或家庭成员如何申请。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.text: VA for Vets

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help transitioning to a civilian career and matching your skills and experiences to VA job opportunities.
source_blocks.text: 获取过渡到平民职业的帮助，并将您的技能和经验与VA工作机会匹配。

source_blocks.text: #### 给我们发消息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask a question online
source_blocks.text: 在线提问

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call us
source_blocks.text: 给我们打电话

source_blocks.text: VA福利热线：800-827-1000 - eBenefits技术支持：800-983-0937 - 拨打MyVA311寻求帮助：844-698-2311 - 如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：711。

source_blocks.source_text_en: CHAMPVA Benefits | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: CHAMPVA 福利 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: CHAMPVA benefits
source_blocks.text: CHAMPVA 福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you the spouse or surviving spouse of or a child of a Veteran with disabilities or a Veteran who has died? If you don t qualify for TRICARE (the Department of Defense s health care program for active-duty and retired service members and their families), you may be able to get health insurance through the Civilian Health and Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs (CHAMPVA). Through this program, we cover the cost of some of your health care services and supplies. This is called cost sharing. Find out if you qualify for CHAMPVA and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 您是否是因残疾或已故退伍军人的配偶、在世配偶或子女？如果您不符合 TRICARE（国防部为现役和退役军人家属提供的医疗保健计划）的资格，您或许可以通过退伍军人事务部民事健康与医疗计划（CHAMPVA）获得健康保险。通过该计划，我们承担您部分医疗保健服务和用品的费用。这称为费用分摊。了解您是否符合 CHAMPVA 资格以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get health care through CHAMPVA?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过 CHAMPVA 获得医疗保健？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can only get health care through CHAMPVA if you don t qualify for TRICARE and at least one of the descriptions below is true for you.
source_blocks.text: 只有您不符合 TRICARE 资格，并且以下描述中至少有一项适用于您，您才能通过 CHAMPVA 获得医疗保健。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须属实。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The spouse or child of a Veteran who s been rated permanently and totally disabled for a service-connected disability by a VA regional benefit office, or The surviving spouse or child of a Veteran who died from a VA-rated service-connected disability, or The surviving spouse or child of a Veteran who was at the time of death rated permanently and totally disabled from a service-connected disability, or The surviving spouse or child of a service member who died in the line of duty, not due to misconduct (in most of these cases, family members qualify for TRICARE, not CHAMPVA).
source_blocks.text: 由 VA 地区福利办公室评定为因服役相关残疾而完全且永久残疾的退伍军人的配偶或子女，或 因 VA 评定的服役相关残疾去世的退伍军人的在世配偶或子女，或 去世时被评定为因服役相关残疾而完全且永久残疾的退伍军人的在世配偶或子女，或 在执行任务中因非不当行为去世的军人的在世配偶或子女（在大多数此类情况下，家庭成员符合 TRICARE 资格，而非 CHAMPVA）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A service-connected disability is a disability that we ve concluded was caused or made worse by the Veteran s active-duty service. A permanent disability is one that s not expected to improve.
source_blocks.text: 服役相关残疾是指我们认定由退伍军人的现役服役引起或加重的残疾。永久残疾是指预计不会改善的残疾。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: A Veteran who s the qualifying CHAMPVA sponsor for their family may also qualify for the VA health care program based on their own Veteran status. If 2 spouses are both Veterans who qualify as CHAMPVA sponsors for their family, they both may now qualify for CHAMPVA benefits. Each time they need medical care, they may choose to get care through the VA health care program or using their CHAMPVA coverage.
source_blocks.text: 注意：作为家庭合格 CHAMPVA 赞助人的退伍军人也可能根据其自身的退伍军人身份符合 VA 医疗保健计划的资格。如果两位配偶都是退伍军人，且均符合作为家庭 CHAMPVA 赞助人的资格，那么他们现在都可能符合 CHAMPVA 福利的资格。每次他们需要医疗护理时，可以选择通过 VA 医疗保健计划或使用其 CHAMPVA 保险获得护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What else might affect whether I can get CHAMPVA benefits for myself or a family member?
source_blocks.text: 还有哪些因素可能影响我或家人获得 CHAMPVA 福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are other factors that may affect whether you or other family members qualify for CHAMPVA. Please click on the description that matches your status to learn more:
source_blocks.text: 还有其他因素可能影响您或其他家庭成员是否符合 CHAMPVA 资格。请点击与您情况相符的描述以了解更多：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re expecting a baby, you ll need to take the 2 steps listed below before you can apply for CHAMPVA for your newborn.
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在期待宝宝出生，您需要在为新生儿申请 CHAMPVA 之前完成以下两个步骤。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to:
source_blocks.text: 您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a Social Security number for your baby by applying at the nearest Social Security Administration office, and - Set up the baby s status as a dependent of the Veteran sponsor by contacting your nearest VA regional benefit office.
source_blocks.text: 前往最近的社保管理局办公室为您的宝宝申请社会安全号码，并且 - 联系最近的 VA 地区福利办公室，将宝宝的身份设置为退伍军人赞助人的受抚养人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical claims can t be paid until you sign your baby up under CHAMPVA, so please get them a Social Security number and set their status as a dependent as soon as possible.
source_blocks.text: 在您将宝宝加入 CHAMPVA 之前，医疗索赔无法支付，因此请尽快为宝宝获取社会安全号码并将其身份设置为受抚养人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a Social Security office near youFind a VA regional benefit office near you
source_blocks.text: 查找附近的社保管理局办公室查找附近的 VA 地区福利办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the surviving spouse of a qualifying CHAMPVA sponsor and you remarry before age 55, you no longer qualify for CHAMPVA as of midnight on the date of your remarriage.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是合格 CHAMPVA 赞助人的在世配偶，并且在 55 岁之前再婚，您将从再婚日期午夜起不再符合 CHAMPVA 资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you remarry on or after your 55th birthday, you can keep your CHAMPVA benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在 55 岁生日当天或之后再婚，您可以保留您的 CHAMPVA 福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the surviving spouse of a qualifying CHAMPVA sponsor and you remarry, but the remarriage ends by death, divorce, or annulment, you may qualify again for CHAMPVA.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是符合资格的 CHAMPVA 赞助人的未再婚配偶，并且您再婚，但再婚因死亡、离婚或宣告无效而结束，您可能再次符合 CHAMPVA 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The first date that you qualify again is the first day of the month after your remarriage ends or December 1, 1999 whichever date is later. You ll need to provide us with copies of your marriage certificate and death, divorce, or annulment documents (as appropriate).
source_blocks.text: 您再次符合资格的第一个日期是您再婚结束后的下个月第一天或 1999 年 12 月 1 日，以较晚者为准。您需要向我们提供您的结婚证书以及死亡、离婚或宣告无效文件的副本（视情况而定）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re covered under CHAMPVA and you turn 18 years old, you ll need to send us proof that you re enrolled full time in college or another educational institution to keep getting benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在 CHAMPVA 保障范围内且年满 18 岁，您需要向我们发送您全日制就读于大学或其他教育机构的证明，以继续获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download our fact sheet on school enrollment certification requirements for CHAMPVA benefits (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载我们关于 CHAMPVA 福利的学校注册认证要求的情况说明书（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were covered under CHAMPVA as the stepchild of a Veteran, and you leave the Veteran s household because of a divorce or remarriage, you no longer qualify for CHAMPVA.
source_blocks.text: 如果您作为退伍军人的继子女在 CHAMPVA 保障范围内，并且您因离婚或再婚而离开退伍军人的家庭，您将不再符合 CHAMPVA 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a family member caring for a Veteran with disabilities, and you re not entitled to care or services through another health plan, you may qualify for CHAMPVA.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是照顾残疾退伍军人的家庭成员，并且您无权通过其他健康计划获得护理或服务，您可能符合 CHAMPVA 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download a fact sheet on CHAMPVA for primary family caregivers (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载关于主要家庭照顾者的 CHAMPVA 情况说明书（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information about CHAMPVA for primary family caregivers
source_blocks.text: 获取更多关于主要家庭照顾者的 CHAMPVA 信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Veteran you re caring for was seriously injured in the line of duty on or after September 11, 2001, you may qualify for health care benefits and other caregiver support through the Program of Comprehensive Assistance to Family Caregivers.
source_blocks.text: 如果您所照顾的退伍军人在 2001 年 9 月 11 日或之后在执行任务时受重伤，您可能通过综合家庭照顾者援助计划获得医疗保健福利和其他照顾者支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for this program and how to apply
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合此计划的资格以及如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: CHAMPVA is always the second payer to Medicare. Here are some requirements you need to know:
source_blocks.text: CHAMPVA 始终是 Medicare 的第二支付方。以下是您需要了解的一些要求：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re under 65 years old, you re eligible for CHAMPVA if you meet both of the requirements below.Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 如果您未满 65 岁，并且满足以下两项要求，您就有资格获得 CHAMPVA。以下两项都必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have both Medicare Parts A and B, and - Are otherwise eligible for CHAMPVA
source_blocks.text: 同时拥有 Medicare A 部分和 B 部分，并且 - 在其他方面符合 CHAMPVA 的资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re 65 years old or older, you re eligible for CHAMPVA if you re eligible for Medicare. If you turned 65 before June 5, 2001, and you re entitled to either Medicare Part A or B, you ll also need to enroll in Medicare Part B to be eligible for CHAMPVA.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满 65 岁或以上，并且有资格获得 Medicare，您就有资格获得 CHAMPVA。如果您在 2001 年 6 月 5 日之前年满 65 岁，并且您有权享受 Medicare A 部分或 B 部分，您还需要注册 Medicare B 部分才能符合 CHAMPVA 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You don t need to enroll in Medicare Part D to qualify for CHAMPVA.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您无需注册 Medicare D 部分即可符合 CHAMPVA 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download a fact sheet on Medicare and CHAMPVA (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载关于 Medicare 和 CHAMPVA 的情况说明书（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits do I get with CHAMPVA?
source_blocks.text: 通过 CHAMPVA 我能获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: With CHAMPVA, you ll be covered for services and supplies when we determine they are medically necessary and were received from an authorized provider. When providers are performing services within the scope of their license or certification, we consider them to be authorized.
source_blocks.text: 通过 CHAMPVA，当我们确定服务或用品在医学上是必要的并且由授权提供者提供时，您将获得保障。当提供者在其执照或认证范围内提供服务时，我们认为他们是授权的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Covered services include:
source_blocks.text: 承保服务包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ambulance service Ambulatory surgery Durable medical equipment (DME) Family planning and maternity Hospice Inpatient services Mental health services Outpatient services Pharmacy (prescription medicines) Skilled nursing care Transplants
source_blocks.text: 救护车服务 门诊手术 耐用医疗设备（DME） 计划生育和孕产 临终关怀 住院服务 心理健康服务 门诊服务 药房（处方药） 专业护理 器官移植

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you re signed up for CHAMPVA, you ll get a copy of the CHAMPVA Program Guide. This guide will tell you more about covered and non-covered services and supplies.
source_blocks.text: 当您注册CHAMPVA后，您将收到一份CHAMPVA计划指南。该指南将向您详细介绍承保和不承保的服务及用品。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download the CHAMPVA Program Guide (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载CHAMPVA计划指南（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See a complete list of non-covered services and supplies in the CHAMPVA Policy Manual
source_blocks.text: 查看CHAMPVA政策手册中不承保的服务和用品的完整列表

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download fact sheets on CHAMPVA benefits
source_blocks.text: 下载关于CHAMPVA福利的情况说明书

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get CHAMPVA benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得CHAMPVA福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for these benefits.
source_blocks.text: 您需要申请这些福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply, submit these required documents:
source_blocks.text: 要申请，请提交以下所需文件：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Application for CHAMPVA Benefits (VA Form 10-10d) (PDF), and
source_blocks.text: CHAMPVA福利申请表（VA表格10-10d）（PDF），以及

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other Health Insurance Certification (VA Form 10-7959c), and
source_blocks.text: 其他健康保险认证（VA表格10-7959c），以及

source_blocks.source_text_en: Documents related to your Medicare status:
source_blocks.text: 与您的Medicare状态相关的文件：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for Medicare for any reason, you ll need to submit a copy of your Medicare card.
source_blocks.text: 如果您因任何原因符合Medicare资格，您需要提交您的Medicare卡副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re 65 years old or older and don t qualify for Medicare, you ll need to send us documentation from the Social Security Administration that confirms you don t qualify for Medicare benefits under anyone s Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 如果您年满65岁或以上且不符合Medicare资格，您需要向我们发送社会保障管理局的文件，确认您不符合任何人社会保障号下的Medicare福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To speed up the processing of your application, you can also send copies ( originals) of these optional documents:
source_blocks.text: 为加快您的申请处理，您还可以发送这些可选文件的副本（非原件）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The page from the VBA rating decision showing your Veteran is permanently and totally disabled (or the death rating if you re a survivor) Your Veteran s DD214 (Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty) or, if the Veteran was a World War II or Korean War Veteran, the Report of Separation. If you don t have a copy of the necessary form, you can request it by submitting a Standard Form 180, Request Pertaining to Military Records, from the National Archives.Find out how to request military service records online, by mail, or by fax Documents related to any dependent children you re including in your application: - A copy of each child s birth certificate or adoption papers - School certification of full-time enrollment for children ages 18-23.Download our fact sheet on school enrollment certification requirements (PDF)
source_blocks.text: VBA评级决定中显示您的退伍军人完全且永久残疾（或如果您是遗属，则为死亡评级）的页面 您的退伍军人的DD214（现役释放或退伍证书），或者如果退伍军人是二战或朝鲜战争退伍军人，则为分离报告。如果您没有所需表格的副本，您可以通过向国家档案馆提交标准表格180（军事记录请求）来索取。了解如何通过在线、邮寄或传真方式请求军事服务记录 与您申请中包括的任何受抚养子女相关的文件： - 每个子女的出生证明或收养文件副本 - 18-23岁子女的全日制入学学校证明。下载我们关于学校入学认证要求的情况说明书（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a surviving spouse who remarried but is once again single, also send a copy of the legal document that ended your marriage. This may be a divorce decree, death certificate, or annulment decree.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是再婚但再次单身的未亡配偶，还请发送结束您婚姻的法律文件副本。这可能是离婚判决书、死亡证明或宣告婚姻无效的判决书。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be sure to sign and date your application. If your Veteran is applying for you as a spouse, be sure to also include the date of the marriage on the application.
source_blocks.text: 请务必在您的申请上签名并注明日期。如果您的退伍军人代表您作为配偶申请，请务必在申请中注明结婚日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail your application to:
source_blocks.text: 将您的申请邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VHA Office of Community Care CHAMPVA Eligibility PO Box 469028 Denver, CO 80246-9028
source_blocks.text: VHA 社区护理办公室 CHAMPVA 资格认证 邮政信箱 469028 丹佛，CO 80246-9028

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or fax it to: 303-331-7809
What happens after I apply?
source_blocks.text: 提交申请后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once we get your application, we ll review it to be sure it s complete and includes all required forms. If it s not complete, we ll return it to you with more instructions.Download application instructions (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 收到您的申请后，我们会进行审核，以确保其完整并包含所有必需表格。如果申请不完整，我们会将其退回给您，并附上更多说明。下载申请说明（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long will it take to hear back about my application?
source_blocks.text: 需要多长时间才能收到关于我申请的回复？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you send us all required and optional documents and if your application is complete it ll take about 6 weeks after we get your package until you get your CHAMPVA ID card and related materials.
source_blocks.text: 如果您向我们发送所有必需和可选文件，且您的申请完整，在我们收到您的材料包后，大约需要6周时间，您将收到CHAMPVA身份证及相关材料。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you send us only the required documents, it may take 2 to 8 months since we ll need to confirm your information with other federal agencies.
source_blocks.text: 如果您只发送必需文件，可能需要2到8个月，因为我们需要与其他联邦机构确认您的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: In what situations do I need to request changes to my GI Bill or other VA education benefits?
source_blocks.text: In what situations do I need to request changes to my GI Bill or other VA education benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change Your VA Direct Deposit Information | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 更改您的 VA 直接存款信息 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change your VA direct deposit information
source_blocks.text: 更改您的 VA 直接存款信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change your VA direct deposit information for disability compensation, pension benefits, or education benefits online.
source_blocks.text: 在线更改您的残疾补偿、养老金福利或教育福利的 VA 直接存款信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I change my VA direct deposit information online?
source_blocks.text: 如何在线更改我的 VA 直接存款信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on the type of benefits you're receiving. You can change your information for disability compensation and pension benefits by updating your VA.gov profile. To change your information for GI Bill and other education benefits, you'll need to sign in to eBenefits.
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您正在领取的福利类型。您可以通过更新您的 VA.gov 个人资料来更改残疾补偿和养老金福利的信息。要更改 GI Bill 和其他教育福利的信息，您需要登录 eBenefits。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation and pension benefit payments
source_blocks.text: 残疾补偿和养老金福利支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: We're testing out the direct deposit feature on VA.gov
source_blocks.text: 我们正在 VA.gov 上测试直接存款功能

source_blocks.source_text_en: We're in the process of bringing direct deposit to VA.gov. This feature isn't available to everyone right now. If you see the direct deposit feature in your profile, you can update your direct deposit information from there. If you don t see this feature in your profile, please go to eBenefits and sign in to change your direct deposit information.
source_blocks.text: 我们正在将直接存款功能引入 VA.gov。目前并非所有人都能使用此功能。如果您在个人资料中看到直接存款功能，您可以从那里更新您的直接存款信息。如果您在个人资料中没有看到此功能，请前往 eBenefits 并登录以更改您的直接存款信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You ll need your bank s routing number as well as your account number.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您需要您的银行路由号码以及您的账号。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To cancel your direct deposit payments, switch from paper checks to direct deposit, or change the address on your paper checks
source_blocks.text: 要取消您的直接存款支付、从纸质支票切换到直接存款，或更改您纸质支票上的地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please call us at 800-827-1000. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET. Or go to your nearest VA regional office.
source_blocks.text: 请致电 800-827-1000。我们的服务时间为周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 9:00。或者前往您最近的 VA 地区办事处。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education benefits
source_blocks.text: 教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to sign in to eBenefits to change your VA direct deposit and contact information online.
source_blocks.text: 您需要登录 eBenefits 才能在线更改您的 VA 直接存款和联系信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To use this feature, you'll need a Premium DS Logon account. Your My HealtheVet or ID.me credentials won t work on the eBenefits website. Go to eBenefits to sign in, register, or upgrade your DS Logon account to Premium.Go to eBenefits to change your information
source_blocks.text: 要使用此功能，您需要 Premium DS Logon 账户。您的 My HealtheVet 或 ID.me 凭据在 eBenefits 网站上无效。前往 eBenefits 登录、注册或将您的 DS Logon 账户升级为 Premium。前往 eBenefits 更改您的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You'll need your bank's name, address, phone number, and routing number as well as your account number.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您需要您的银行名称、地址、电话号码和路由号码以及您的账号。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there other ways to change my VA direct deposit or contact information?
source_blocks.text: 还有其他方式更改我的 VA 直接存款或联系信息吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can change your information by mail or phone.
source_blocks.text: 是的。您可以通过邮寄或电话更改您的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out a VA Direct Deposit Enrollment (VA Form 24-0296).Download VA Form 24-0296 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写 VA Direct Deposit Enrollment（VA 表格 24-0296）。下载 VA 表格 24-0296（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the completed form to:
source_blocks.text: 将填写好的表格邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Veterans Affairs 125 S. Main Street, Suite B Muskogee, OK 74401-7004
source_blocks.text: Department of Veterans Affairs 125 S. Main Street, Suite B Muskogee, OK 74401-7004

source_blocks.source_text_en: By phone
source_blocks.text: 通过电话

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 我们周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 9:00 提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change your address through your VA.gov profile
source_blocks.text: 通过您的 VA.gov 个人资料更改地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can sign in to VA.gov and change your address or other contact information in your VA.gov profile. This will update your information across disability compensation, pension benefits, claims and appeals, Vocational Rehabilitation & Employment (VR&E), and VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 您可以登录 VA.gov 并在您的 VA.gov 个人资料中更改地址或其他联系信息。这将更新您在残疾补偿、养老金福利、索赔和上诉、职业康复与就业（VR&E）以及 VA 医疗保健方面的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to change your address on file with VA
source_blocks.text: 了解如何更改您在 VA 存档的地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: Should I contact VA if I have other changes to my information?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的其他信息发生变化，是否应联系 VA？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. It s important to update your information with us if you change your marital status, have a baby, adopt a child, or experience any other life change that could affect your rating or payment.
source_blocks.text: 是的。如果您更改婚姻状况、生育、收养子女或经历任何其他可能影响您的评级或付款的生活变化，请务必更新您的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you move or change your mailing address
source_blocks.text: 如果您搬家或更改邮寄地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure to update your contact information so we send information about your benefits and services as well as any prescriptions, lab test results, or appointment reminders you may need to the right location.
source_blocks.text: 请务必更新您的联系信息，以便我们将有关您的福利和服务的信息以及您可能需要的任何处方、实验室检测结果或预约提醒发送到正确的地点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can change your address and other contact information in your VA.gov profile. This will update your contact information across disability compensation, pension benefits, claims and appeals, Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E), and VA health care.Find out how to change your address on file with VA
source_blocks.text: 您可以在您的 VA.gov 个人资料中更改地址和其他联系信息。这将更新您在残疾补偿、养老金福利、索赔和上诉、职业康复与就业（VR&E）以及 VA 医疗保健方面的联系信息。了解如何更改您在 VA 存档的地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a disability rating of 30% or higher
source_blocks.text: 如果您的残疾评级为 30% 或更高

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to add eligible dependents to your VA disability compensation to get a higher payment (also called a benefit rate ).Find out how to add eligible dependents
source_blocks.text: 您或许可以将符合条件的家属添加到您的 VA 残疾补偿中，以获得更高的付款（也称为福利费率）。了解如何添加符合条件的家属

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your disability gets worse
source_blocks.text: 如果您的残疾恶化

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a claim for an increase in benefits.File for a VA disability increase
source_blocks.text: 您可以提交增加福利的申请。申请 VA 残疾增加

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once I m signed in, how do I check my VA claim or appeal status?
source_blocks.text: Once I m signed in, how do I check my VA claim or appeal status?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to your "My VA" dashboard. You'll find the link for this dashboard in the top right corner of the page once you're signed in. Scroll down to the "Track Claims" section. There, you'll see a summary of the latest status information for any open claims or appeals you may have. Click on the "View Status" button for a specific claim. You'll go to a page with more details about that claim's status and supporting evidence. Evidence may include documents like a doctor's report or medical test results.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Co-op training
source_blocks.text: Co-op training

source_blocks.source_text_en: A college or university co-op training program lets you get full-time work experience in between periods of going to school full time. You may be able to get help paying for some of your costs like books, tuition, and housing if you re part of a co-op. Find out if you can get these education benefits.
source_blocks.text: A college or university co-op training program lets you get full-time work experience in between periods of going to school full time. You may be able to get help paying for some of your costs like books, tuition, and housing if you re part of a co-op. Find out if you can get these education benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get education benefits for co-op training?
source_blocks.text: Can I get education benefits for co-op training?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get money for books, tuition, and housing if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get money for books, tuition, and housing if you meet all of the requirements listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: All of these must be true:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re using VA educational assistance, and You re enrolled at an approved Institution of Higher Learning (IHL), and You re in an educational program that requires part-time study and part-time work or training
source_blocks.text: You re using VA educational assistance, and You re enrolled at an approved Institution of Higher Learning (IHL), and You re in an educational program that requires part-time study and part-time work or training

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will I get if I join a co-op training program?
source_blocks.text: How much will I get if I join a co-op training program?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The amount we cover depends on the benefit you use. View current payment rates

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Post-9/11 GI Bill: If the program is at a public IHL, we pay the actual costs for public in-state tuition and fees. If the program is at a private or foreign IHL, we pay the lesser of the national maximum or the actual costs for in-state tuition and fees. We also pay for some of the cost of housing and books. All other GI Bill programs: We pay a monthly rate that depends on which GI Bill program you qualify for.

source_blocks.text: 退伍军人残疾住房补助金 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability housing grants for Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人残疾住房补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer housing grants for Veterans and service members with certain service-connected disabilities so they can buy or change a home to meet their needs and live more independently. Changing a home might involve installing ramps or widening doorways. Find out if you re eligible for a disability housing grant and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 我们为患有某些与服务相关的残疾的退伍军人和服役人员提供住房补助金，以便他们能够购买或改造住房以满足其需求并更独立地生活。改造住房可能涉及安装坡道或加宽门口。了解您是否有资格获得残疾住房补助金以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a Specially Adapted Housing (SAH) grant and how much funding does this grant offer?
source_blocks.text: 我能否获得特别适应住房（SAH）补助金，该补助金提供多少资金？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get an SAH grant if you re using the grant money to buy, build, or change your permanent home (a home you plan to live in for a long time) and you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用补助金购买、建造或改造您的永久住房（您计划长期居住的住房），并且您满足以下列出的两项要求，您可能能够获得SAH补助金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须都属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Own or will own the home, and Have a qualifying service-connected disability
source_blocks.text: 拥有或将拥有该住房，并且 有符合条件的服务相关残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: Qualifying service-connected disabilities include:
source_blocks.text: 符合条件的服务相关残疾包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The loss or loss of use of more than one limb The loss or loss of use of a lower leg along with the residuals (lasting effects) of an organic (natural) disease or injury Blindness in both eyes (having only light perception) along with the loss or loss of use of a leg Certain severe burns The loss or loss of use of one or both lower extremities (feet or legs) after September 11, 2001, that makes it so you can t balance or walk without the help of braces, crutches, canes, or a wheelchair Note: Only 30 Veterans and service members each fiscal year (FY) can qualify for a grant based on the loss of extremities after September 11, 2001. If you qualify for but don t receive a grant in 2019 because the cap was reached, you may be able to use this benefit in FY 2020 or future years if the law continues to give us the authority to offer these grants and we don t go beyond the new FY cap.
source_blocks.text: 失去或失去使用一个以上肢体 失去或失去使用一条小腿，同时伴有器质性（自然）疾病或损伤的后遗症（持久影响） 双眼失明（仅有光感），同时失去或失去使用一条腿 某些严重烧伤 2001年9月11日之后失去或失去使用一个或两个下肢（脚或腿），导致您在没有支架、拐杖、手杖或轮椅的帮助下无法保持平衡或行走。注意：每个财政年度（FY）只有30名退伍军人和服役人员可以基于2001年9月11日之后的肢体丧失获得补助金。如果您符合资格但在2019年因达到上限而未获得补助金，如果法律继续授权我们提供这些补助金，并且我们未超过新的财政年度上限，您可能能够在2020财政年度或未来几年使用此福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For FY 2019, you may be able to get up to 3 grants for a total of up to \$85,645 through the SAH grant program.
source_blocks.text: 对于2019财政年度，您可能能够通过SAH补助金计划获得最多3笔补助金，总计最高可达\$85,645。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how to apply for a housing grant
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于如何申请住房补助金的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a Special Housing Adaptation (SHA) grant and how much funding does this grant offer?
source_blocks.text: 我能否获得特别住房适应（SHA）补助金，该补助金提供多少资金？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get an SHA grant if you re using the grant money to buy, build, or change your permanent home (a home you plan to live in for a long time) and you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用补助金购买、建造或改造您的永久住房（您计划长期居住的住房），并且您满足以下列出的两项要求，您可能能够获得SHA补助金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须都属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You or a family member own or will own the home, and You have a qualifying service-connected disability
source_blocks.text: 您或家庭成员拥有或将拥有该住房，并且 您有符合条件的服务相关残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: Qualifying service-connected disabilities include:
source_blocks.text: 符合条件的服务相关残疾包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Blindness in both eyes (with 20/200 visual acuity or less) The loss or loss of use of both hands Certain severe burns Certain respiratory or breathing injuries
source_blocks.text: 双眼失明（视力为20/200或更低） 失去或失去使用双手 某些严重烧伤 某些呼吸系统或呼吸损伤

source_blocks.source_text_en: For FY 2019, you may be able to get up to 3 grants for a total of up to \$17,130 through the SHA grant program.
source_blocks.text: 对于2019财政年度，您可能能够通过SHA补助金计划获得最多3笔补助金，总计最高可达\$17,130。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how to apply for a housing grant
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于如何申请住房补助金的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need money to make changes to a family member s home that I m living in for a short period of time?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要资金来改造我短期居住的亲属的房屋，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get a Temporary Residence Adaptation (TRA) grant if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两项要求，您或许可以获得临时居住改造（TRA）补助金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须都属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Qualify for an SAH or SHA grant (see above), and Are living temporarily in a family member s home that needs changes to meet your needs
source_blocks.text: 符合SAH或SHA补助金的资格（见上文），并且 临时居住在亲属的房屋中，该房屋需要进行改造以满足您的需求

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for an SAH grant, you can get up to \$37,597 through the TRA grant program for FY 2019.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合SAH补助金的资格，您可以通过TRA补助金计划在2019财年获得最高\$37,597的补助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for an SHA grant, you can get up to \$6,713 through the TRA grant program for FY 2019.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合SHA补助金的资格，您可以通过TRA补助金计划在2019财年获得最高\$6,713的补助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for an SAH, SHA, or TRA grant
source_blocks.text: 申请SAH、SHA或TRA补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online right now by going to our eBenefits website.
source_blocks.text: 您现在就可以通过访问我们的eBenefits网站在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to sign in to eBenefits with your DS Logon basic or premium account. If you don t have a DS Logon account, you can register for one on the site.
source_blocks.text: 您需要使用您的DS Logon基本或高级账户登录eBenefits。如果您没有DS Logon账户，您可以在网站上注册一个。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational And Career Counseling (VA Chapter 36) | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 教育与职业咨询（VA第36章）| 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational and Career Counseling (VA Chapter 36)
source_blocks.text: 教育与职业咨询（VA第36章）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for VA Chapter 36 benefits to get free Veteran Educational and Career Counseling services. You may be eligible if you re leaving active service soon, if you ve been discharged within the past year, or if you re the dependent of a Veteran.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请VA第36章福利，以免费获得退伍军人教育与职业咨询服务。如果您即将离开现役、在过去一年内退伍，或者是退伍军人的家属，您可能符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s eligible for Educational and Career Counseling?
source_blocks.text: 谁有资格获得教育与职业咨询？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get these services if one of the following is true. You:
source_blocks.text: 如果以下情况之一属实，您可以获得这些服务。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will be discharged from active duty within 6 months, or Separated from active duty not more than one year ago, or Qualify as a Veteran or service member for educational assistance under a VA educational program, or Are currently receiving VA education benefits
source_blocks.text: 将在6个月内从现役退伍，或 从现役退伍不超过一年，或 符合VA教育计划下的退伍军人或军人的教育援助资格，或 目前正在接受VA教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you re the dependent of a Veteran, you may also qualify for Educational and Career Counseling.Learn more about employment benefits for dependents
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您是退伍军人的家属，您也可能有资格获得教育与职业咨询。了解更多关于家属的就业福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Counseling to help you decide which civilian or military jobs you want Educational and Career Counseling to help you find a training program or job Academic and adjustment counseling to help you deal with issues that get in the way of your success in training or employment
source_blocks.text: 帮助您决定想从事的平民或军事工作的咨询 教育与职业咨询，帮助您找到培训计划或工作 学业和适应咨询，帮助您处理妨碍您在培训或就业中成功的問題

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, you ll need to apply for Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment benefits. Then, you ll work with your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC).
source_blocks.text: 首先，您需要申请职业康复与就业福利。然后，您将与您的职业康复顾问（VRC）合作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Follow these steps to apply online now
source_blocks.text: 按照以下步骤在线申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your eBenefits account. Select Apply. Click Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Benefits. Apply for Education and Career Counseling. If you're eligible, we ll invite you to an orientation session at your nearest VA regional benefit office.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的eBenefits账户。 选择“申请”。 点击“职业康复与就业福利”。 申请教育与职业咨询。 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您参加最近VA地区福利办公室的迎新会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also apply by mail
source_blocks.text: 您也可以通过邮寄申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Educational/Vocational Counseling Application (VA Form 28-8832). Download VA Form 28-8832 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写教育与职业咨询申请表（VA表格28-8832）。下载VA表格28-8832（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the completed form to your nearest VA regional benefit office.Find your nearest VA regional benefit office
source_blocks.text: 将填好的表格邮寄至最近的VA地区福利办公室。查找最近的VA地区福利办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify, we ll invite you to an orientation session at a VA regional benefit office near you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您参加附近VA地区福利办公室的迎新会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Watch this video to learn more about VR&E Chapter 36 services
source_blocks.text: 观看此视频，了解VR&E第36章服务的更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use CareerScope to find careers you might enjoy. Learn more about CareerScope
source_blocks.text: 使用CareerScope寻找您可能喜欢的职业。了解更多关于CareerScope的信息

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility For VA Disability Benefits | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 弗吉尼亚州退伍军人事务部残疾福利资格 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility for VA disability benefits
source_blocks.text: 弗吉尼亚州残疾福利资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review VA disability benefits eligibility criteria to find out if you can get disability compensation for an illness or injury that was caused by or got worse because of your active military service. Compensation may include financial support and other benefits like health care.
source_blocks.text: 查看弗吉尼亚州残疾福利资格标准，以确定您是否有资格因现役军事服务导致或加重的疾病或伤害获得残疾补偿。补偿可能包括经济支持和其他福利，如医疗保健。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for VA disability compensation?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格获得弗吉尼亚州残疾补偿？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get VA disability benefits or compensation if you have a current illness or injury (known as a condition) that affects your body or mind and you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您目前患有影响身体或心理的疾病或伤害（称为病症），并且满足以下至少一项要求，您可能能够获得弗吉尼亚州残疾福利或补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须均为真。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Served on active duty, active duty for training, or inactive duty training, and Have a disability rating for your service-connected condition
source_blocks.text: 在现役、现役训练或非现役训练期间服役，并且 因服役相关病症获得残疾评级

source_blocks.source_text_en: And at least one of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 并且以下至少一项必须为真。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Got sick or injured while serving in the military and can link this condition to your illness or injury (called an inservice disability claim), or Had an illness or injury before you joined the military and serving made it worse (called a preservice disability claim), or Have a disability related to your active-duty service that didn t appear until after you ended your service (called a postservice disability claim)
source_blocks.text: 在军队服役期间生病或受伤，并且可以将此病症与您的疾病或伤害联系起来（称为服役期间残疾索赔），或 在入伍前患有疾病或伤害，而服役使其恶化（称为服役前残疾索赔），或 有与现役服务相关的残疾，但在服役结束后才显现（称为服役后残疾索赔）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Presumed disabilities
source_blocks.text: 推定残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: A chronic (long-lasting) illness that appears within one year after discharge, or An illness caused by contact with contaminants (toxic chemicals) or other hazardous materials, or An illness caused by your time spent as a prisoner of war (POW)
source_blocks.text: 出院后一年内出现的慢性（长期）疾病，或 因接触污染物（有毒化学品）或其他危险材料引起的疾病，或 因作为战俘（POW）的时间引起的疾病

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Qualified dependents
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人 合格家属

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?
source_blocks.text: 如果我收到非荣誉、行为不良或不光彩的退伍，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到这些退伍身份之一，您可能没有资格获得弗吉尼亚州残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:
source_blocks.text: 有2种方式可以尝试获得资格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgradeLearn about the VA Character of Discharge review process
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请退伍升级了解弗吉尼亚州退伍性质审查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: Checking your application status. Sorry, this is taking longer than expected.
source_blocks.text: 正在检查您的申请状态。抱歉，这比预期花费的时间更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re sorry. Something went wrong when we tried to load your saved application.Please try refreshing your browser in a few minutes.
source_blocks.text: 抱歉，我们在加载您已保存的申请时遇到了问题。请几分钟后尝试刷新浏览器。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What conditions are covered by these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 这些福利涵盖哪些情况？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get VA disability benefits for conditions such as:
source_blocks.text: 您可能能够获得VA残疾福利，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Chronic (long-lasting) back pain resulting in a current diagnosed back disability Breathing problems resulting from a current lung condition or lung disease Severe hearing loss Scar tissue Loss of range of motion (problems moving your body) Ulcers Cancers caused by contact with toxic chemicals or other dangers
source_blocks.text: 慢性（长期）背痛，导致当前诊断的背部残疾 呼吸问题，由当前肺部状况或肺病引起 严重听力损失 疤痕组织 活动范围受限（身体移动问题） 溃疡 因接触有毒化学品或其他危险物质而导致的癌症

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also be able to get VA disability benefits for:
source_blocks.text: 您也可能能够获得VA残疾福利，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Depression Anxiety
source_blocks.text: 创伤性脑损伤（TBI） 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD） 抑郁症 焦虑症

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information about conditions that may be covered
source_blocks.text: 获取更多关于可能涵盖情况的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Watch our Compensation 101 videos to learn more about how VA disability compensation works:
source_blocks.text: 观看我们的补偿101视频，了解更多关于VA残疾补偿如何运作的信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Compensation 101: What is disability compensation?
source_blocks.text: 补偿101：什么是残疾补偿？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Compensation 101: What is service connection?
source_blocks.text: 补偿101：什么是服役关联？

source_blocks.source_text_en: How VA assigns disability ratings
source_blocks.text: VA如何评定残疾等级

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how we assign severity ratings and how they affect your disability payments.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们如何评定严重程度等级以及它们如何影响您的残疾赔偿金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disabilities that appear within one year after discharge
source_blocks.text: 退役后一年内出现的残疾

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have signs of an illness that started within a year after you were discharged from active service, find out if you can get disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有在现役退役后一年内开始的疾病迹象，请了解您是否有资格获得残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Last updated:
source_blocks.text: 最后更新：
