source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility For VA Health Care | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部医疗保健资格 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility for VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you can get VA health care as a Veteran.
source_blocks.text: 了解您作为退伍军人是否有资格获得VA医疗保健。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA health care benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得VA医疗保健福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get VA health care benefits if you served in the active military, naval, or air service and didn t receive a dishonorable discharge.
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在现役陆军、海军或空军服役，且未受到不名誉退伍处分，您可能有资格获得VA医疗保健福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you enlisted after September 7, 1980, or entered active duty after October 16, 1981, you must have served 24 continuous months or the full period for which you were called to active duty, unless any of the descriptions below are true for you.This minimum duty requirement may not apply if any of these are true. You:
source_blocks.text: 如果您在1980年9月7日之后入伍，或在1981年10月16日之后开始现役，您必须已服役满24个月或完成被征召的全部现役期，除非以下任一情况适用于您。此最低服役要求可能不适用，如果以下任一情况属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Were discharged for a disability that was caused or made worse by your active-duty service, or - Were discharged for a hardship or early out, or - Served prior to September 7, 1980
source_blocks.text: 因现役服役导致或加重的残疾而退伍，或 - 因困难或提前退伍而退伍，或 - 在1980年9月7日之前服役

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a current or former member of the Reserves or National Guard, you must have been called to active duty by a federal order and completed the full period for which you were called or ordered to active duty. If you had or have active-duty status for training purposes only, you don t qualify for VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是预备役或国民警卫队的现任或前任成员，您必须根据联邦命令被征召现役，并完成被征召或命令的整个现役期。如果您仅因训练目的而具有现役身份，则不符合VA医疗保健资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?
source_blocks.text: 如果我收到非荣誉退伍、行为不良退伍或不名誉退伍，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到这些退伍身份之一，您可能不符合VA福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:
source_blocks.text: 有2种方式可以尝试获得资格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgradeLearn about the VA Character of Discharge review process
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请退伍升级了解VA品格退伍审查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is there anything that will make me more likely to get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 有什么因素会增加我获得这些福利的可能性吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You may qualify for enhanced eligibility status (meaning you ll be placed in a higher priority group, which makes you more likely to get benefits) if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 是的。如果您满足以下至少一项要求，您可能有资格获得增强资格状态（意味着您将被置于更高的优先组，从而更有可能获得福利）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Receive financial compensation (payments) from VA for a service-connected disability Were discharged for a disability resulting from something that happened to you in the line of duty Were discharged for a disability that got worse in the line of duty Are a recently discharged combat Veteran Get a VA pension Are a former prisoner of war (POW) Have received a Purple Heart Have received a Medal of Honor Get (or qualify for) Medicaid benefits Served in Vietnam between January 9, 1962, and May 7, 1975 Served in Southwest Asia during the Gulf War between August 2, 1990, and November 11, 1998 Served at least 30 days at Camp Lejeune between August 1, 1953, and December 31, 1987
source_blocks.text: 因服役相关残疾从VA获得经济补偿（付款） 因在服役期间发生的事件导致的残疾而退伍 因在服役期间加重的残疾而退伍 是最近退伍的战斗退伍军人 获得VA养老金 是前战俘（POW） 获得过紫心勋章 获得过荣誉勋章 获得（或符合资格获得）Medicaid福利 在1962年1月9日至1975年5月7日期间在越南服役 在1990年8月2日至1998年11月11日期间在波斯湾战争期间在西南亚服役 在1953年8月1日至1987年12月31日期间在勒琼营服役至少30天

source_blocks.source_text_en: If none of the above apply to you, you may still qualify for care based on your income. Learn more about how the amount of money your family makes can affect whether you qualify for VA benefits.Learn more about income limits
source_blocks.text: 如果以上情况均不适用于您，您仍可能根据您的收入获得护理资格。了解更多关于您的家庭收入如何影响您是否符合VA福利资格的信息。了解更多关于收入限制的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Checking your application status. Sorry, this is taking longer than expected.
source_blocks.text: 正在检查您的申请状态。抱歉，这比预期时间要长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re sorry. Something went wrong when we tried to load your saved application.Please try refreshing your browser in a few minutes.
source_blocks.text: 抱歉。我们在尝试加载您保存的申请时出了点问题。请几分钟后尝试刷新浏览器。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Obtenga instrucciones para esta solicitud en Espa ol.
source_blocks.text: 获取此申请（西班牙语）的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Llene la solicitud para Beneficions de Salud (Forma 10-10EZ).Obtenga la Forma VA 10-10EZ Usted o alguien con poder legal para representarlo tiene que firmar la forma, e incluir la fecha en que fu firmada.
source_blocks.text: 填写健康福利申请表（10-10EZ 表格）。获取 VA 10-10EZ 表格。您或您的合法授权代表必须签署表格，并注明签署日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Si esta usando un poder legal, tendra que incluir una copia de la forma con su solicitud. Si firma con una X, 2 personas que usted conoce tienen que tambien firmar acertando que lo vieron firmar la forma.
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用合法授权，则需随申请附上授权表格副本。 如果您以 X 签名，则需要两位您认识的见证人签名确认他们看到您签署表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Puede mandar su solicitud por correo a esta direcci n:
source_blocks.text: 您可以将申请邮寄至以下地址：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health Eligibility Center 2957 Clairmont Rd., Suite 200 Atlanta, GA 30329
source_blocks.text: Health Eligibility Center 2957 Clairmont Rd., Suite 200 Atlanta, GA 30329

source_blocks.source_text_en: Para llenar su solicitude en persona, encuetre el Centro M dico de Veteranos mas cercano en esta liga:Encuentre el Centro o Cl nica de Veteranos mas cercano a usted O reciba ayuda por medio del Departmaneto de Veteranos de su estado.Encuentre el Departamento de Veteranos de su estado
source_blocks.text: 如需亲自填写申请，请通过此链接查找最近的退伍军人医疗中心：查找离您最近的退伍军人中心或诊所。或通过您所在州的退伍军人事务部获得帮助。查找您所在州的退伍军人事务部。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help filling out my application?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助填写申请怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get help in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下任一方式获得帮助：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call our toll-free hotline at 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 拨打我们的免费热线 877-222-8387，周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 8:00。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help from an accredited representative (a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims).Request a representative
source_blocks.text: 从授权代表（经过培训、可信赖的协助处理 VA 相关索赔的专业人士）处获得帮助。请求代表

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find your state s Veterans agency
source_blocks.text: 查找您所在州的退伍军人事务机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: More about VA health care eligibility
source_blocks.text: 更多关于 VA 医疗保健资格的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you apply for VA health care, you ll be assigned 1 of 8 priority groups. This system helps to make sure that Veterans who need immediate care can get signed up quickly.
source_blocks.text: 当您申请 VA 医疗保健时，您将被分配到 8 个优先组之一。此系统有助于确保需要即时护理的退伍军人能够快速注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your priority group may affect how soon we sign you up for health care benefits. It may also affect how much (if anything) you ll have to pay toward the cost of your care.
source_blocks.text: 您的优先组可能会影响我们为您注册医疗保健福利的速度，也可能影响您需要自付的护理费用（如果有的话）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about priority groups
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于优先组的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Whether or not you have other health insurance coverage doesn t affect the VA health care benefits you can get.Learn more about how VA works with other insurance
source_blocks.text: 不会。无论您是否有其他健康保险，都不会影响您能获得的 VA 医疗保健福利。了解更多关于 VA 与其他保险合作的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re retiring, you re eligible for TRICARE. You may also qualify for certain VA health care benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您即将退休，您有资格享受 TRICARE。您也可能有资格获得某些 VA 医疗保健福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re separating from service due to a service-connected illness or injury, you may be eligible for VA health care benefits and certain TRICARE benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您因服役相关的疾病或伤害而退役，您可能有资格获得VA医疗保健福利和某些TRICARE福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re an OEF/OIF/OND combat Veteran who has just returned from service, you can receive free medical care for any condition related to your service in Iraq or Afghanistan for 5 years after discharge.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是刚从服役归来的OEF/OIF/OND战斗退伍军人，您可以在退役后5年内，就与您在伊拉克或阿富汗服役相关的任何病症，获得免费医疗护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about health care benefits for transitioning service members
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于过渡期服役人员的医疗保健福利信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit healthcare.gov to find out if you qualify for health insurance.Go to healthcare.gov
source_blocks.text: 访问healthcare.gov，了解您是否符合健康保险资格。前往healthcare.gov

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes.
source_blocks.text: 是的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how you may still be able to get care for:
source_blocks.text: 了解您可能仍然能够获得以下护理的方式：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) - Other mental health problems (like depression or substance abuse) - Mental and physical health problems linked to military sexual trauma (MST)
source_blocks.text: 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD） - 其他心理健康问题（如抑郁或物质滥用） - 与军事性创伤（MST）相关的心理和身体健康问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or, call our general VA hotline at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET to find out what your care options may be.
source_blocks.text: 或者，请拨打我们的VA综合热线800-827-1000，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上9:00，以了解您可能有哪些护理选择。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We cover routine eye exams and preventive tests under VA health care benefits. In some cases, you may get coverage for eyeglasses or services for blind or low vision rehabilitation.Learn more about vision care through VA
source_blocks.text: 根据VA医疗保健福利，我们涵盖常规眼科检查和预防性测试。在某些情况下，您可能获得眼镜或盲人或低视力康复服务的保障。了解更多关于通过VA进行的视力护理信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: In certain cases, you may receive dental care as part of your VA health benefits.Find out if you can get dental care through VA
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，您可能会作为VA健康福利的一部分获得牙科护理。了解您是否可以通过VA获得牙科护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have an illness or injury that was caused or made worse by your active-duty service, you may be able to get disability compensation.Find out if you qualify for disability benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您的疾病或伤害是由现役服役引起或加重的，您或许可以获得残疾补偿。了解您是否符合残疾福利的资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: More eligibility information you may need
source_blocks.text: 您可能需要的更多资格信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Priority groups
source_blocks.text: 优先群体

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what VA priority groups are, how they work, and how they may affect you.
source_blocks.text: 了解什么是VA优先群体、它们如何运作以及它们可能如何影响您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Active-duty service members and VA health care
source_blocks.text: 现役服役人员与VA健康护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about your health care options after separation or retirement and how to apply for VA health care when you receive your separation or retirement orders. If you're a combat Veteran, apply right away to take advantage of 5 years of enhanced eligibility.
source_blocks.text: 了解您退役或退休后的健康护理选项，以及在收到退役或退休命令时如何申请VA健康护理。如果您是战斗退伍军人，请立即申请，以利用5年增强资格的优势。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.text: 申请VA职业康复与就业的资格 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility for VA Vocational Rehab and Employment
source_blocks.text: VA职业康复与就业的资格要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review VA Vocational Rehab and Employment (VR&E) eligibility requirements for Veterans and active-duty service members. If you have a disability that was caused or made worse by your active-duty service and that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, you may be able to get employment support or services to help you live as independently as possible.
source_blocks.text: 了解Veterans和现役军人申请VA职业康复与就业（VR&E）的资格要求。如果你的残疾是由现役服役引起或加重的，并且限制了你的工作能力或使你无法工作，你可能可以获得就业支持或服务，以帮助你尽可能独立生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I m a Veteran, am I eligible for Vocational Rehab and Employment?
source_blocks.text: 如果我是退伍军人，我是否有资格申请职业康复与就业？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for VR&E benefits and services if you re a Veteran, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是Veteran，并且满足以下所有要求，你可能符合VR&E福利和服务的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件都必须满足。你：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, and Have a service-connected disability rating of at least 10% from VA, and Apply for VR&E services
source_blocks.text: 没有不光彩的退役记录，并且 拥有VA评定的至少10%的服役相关残疾评级，并且 申请VR&E服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Basic period of eligibility
source_blocks.text: 基本资格期限

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your basic period of eligibility ends 12 years from the date you received notice of your:
source_blocks.text: 你的基本资格期限从你收到以下通知之日起12年结束：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Date of separation from active military service, or First VA service-connected disability rating
source_blocks.text: 现役服役分离日期，或 首次VA服役相关残疾评级

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: The basic period of eligibility may be extended if a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) finds that you have a serious employment handicap (SEH). Having an employment handicap means your service-connected disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests).
source_blocks.text: 请注意：如果职业康复顾问（VRC）认定你有严重就业障碍（SEH），基本资格期限可能会延长。就业障碍意味着你的服役相关残疾限制了你准备、获得和维持合适就业（不会加重你的残疾、稳定且与你的能力、才能和兴趣相匹配的工作）的能力。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I m still on active duty, am I eligible for Vocational Rehab and Employment?
source_blocks.text: 如果我仍在现役，我是否有资格申请职业康复与就业？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for VR&E benefits and services if you re a service member and you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是现役军人，并且满足以下至少一项要求，你可能符合VR&E福利和服务的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真。你：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have a 20% or higher pre-discharge disability rating (memorandum rating) and will soon leave the military, or Are participating in the Integrated Disability Evaluation System (IDES) process or awaiting discharge due to a medical condition resulting from a serious injury or illness that occurred in the line of duty. Learn more about accessing VR&E services through IDES
source_blocks.text: 拥有20%或更高的退役前残疾评级（备忘录评级）并且即将离开军队，或 正在参与综合残疾评估系统（IDES）流程，或因执行任务中发生的严重伤病导致的医疗状况而等待退役。了解更多关于通过IDES获取VR&E服务的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: Severely injured active-duty service members can automatically receive VR&E benefits before VA issues a disability rating, because of Sec. 1631(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act (PL 110-181).
source_blocks.text: 请注意：根据《国防授权法案》（PL 110-181）第1631(b)条，严重受伤的现役军人可以在VA发布残疾评级之前自动获得VR&E福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?
source_blocks.text: 如果我收到了非荣誉退役、行为不良退役或不光彩退役，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果你收到了这些退役状态之一，你可能不符合VA福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:
source_blocks.text: 有2种方式可以尝试获得资格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgrade Learn about the VA Character of Discharge review process
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请 discharge upgrade 了解 VA Character of Discharge 审查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply?
source_blocks.text: 我该如何申请？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online right now.
source_blocks.text: 你现在就可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往 eBenefits 申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how to apply for VR&E Note: You can apply even if you re a service member without a disability rating yet.
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于如何申请 VR&E 的信息 注意：即使你是一名尚未获得伤残评级的现役军人，也可以申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of VR&E services can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些 VR&E 服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Depending on your needs and goals, services may include:
source_blocks.text: 根据你的需求和目标，服务可能包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A complete evaluation to determine your abilities, skills, and interests for employment Vocational counseling and rehabilitation planning for employment services Employment services such as job training, resume development, and other work-readiness support Help finding and keeping a job, including the use of special employer incentives and job accommodations On-the-job training (OJT), apprenticeships, and non-paid work experiences Post-secondary training at a college, vocational, technical, or business school Supportive rehabilitation services including case management, counseling, and medical referrals Independent living services if you re unable to work due to the severity of your disabilities
source_blocks.text: 全面评估以确定你的就业能力、技能和兴趣 职业咨询和康复规划，以促进就业服务 就业服务，如职业培训、简历撰写和其他工作准备支持 帮助寻找和保持工作，包括使用特殊雇主激励措施和工作便利 在职培训（OJT）、学徒制和无薪工作经验 在学院、职业、技术或商业学校接受高等教育培训 支持性康复服务，包括个案管理、咨询和医疗转介 如果你的残疾严重程度导致无法工作，可提供独立生活服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I m eligible for GI Bill benefits, can I get paid the Post-9/11 GI Bill subsistence rate for my VR&E program?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有资格获得 GI Bill 福利，我能否在我的 VR&E 计划中获得 Post-9/11 GI Bill 生活津贴费率？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re participating in a VR&E program and also qualify for Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, you can choose to get paid the GI Bill subsistence rate instead of the Chapter 31 subsistence allowance rate. In most cases the GI Bill rate is higher.
source_blocks.text: 如果你正在参加 VR&E 计划，并且也有资格获得 Post-9/11 GI Bill 福利，你可以选择领取 GI Bill 生活津贴费率，而不是 Chapter 31 生活津贴费率。在大多数情况下，GI Bill 费率更高。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to officially choose the GI Bill subsistence rate. Your VRC can help you with this.Contact your VRC for more informationView the current Chapter 31 subsistence allowance ratesView the current Post-9/11 GI Bill benefit rates
source_blocks.text: 你需要正式选择 GI Bill 生活津贴费率。你的 VRC 可以帮助你处理此事。联系你的 VRC 了解更多信息查看当前的 Chapter 31 生活津贴费率查看当前的 Post-9/11 GI Bill 福利费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veterans Pension program provides monthly payments to wartime Veterans who meet certain age or disability requirements, and who have income and net worth within certain limits. Find out if you re eligible for this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about VA home loan eligibility requirements for a VA direct or VA-backed loan. Find out how to apply for a Certificate of Eligibility (COE) to show your lender that you qualify based on your service history and duty status. Keep in mind that for a VA-backed home loan, you ll also need to meet your lender s credit and income loan requirements to receive financing.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Employment benefits for dependent family members
source_blocks.text: 受抚养家庭成员的就业福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you re eligible and how to apply to get career and educational counseling through VR&E as the dependent family member of a service member or Veteran with a service-connected disability.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合资格以及如何申请，作为因服役致残的军人或退伍军人的受抚养家庭成员，通过VR&E获得职业和教育咨询。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get Educational and Career Counseling services provided by VR&E (also called Chapter 36)?
source_blocks.text: 我能否获得VR&E（也称为第36章）提供的教育和职业咨询服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for Educational and Career Counseling if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您同时满足以下两项要求，您可能有资格获得教育和职业咨询。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须均为真实情况。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The dependent of a Veteran, and Eligible for a VA education benefit, including: - The Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - The Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD, Chapter 30) - The Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve (MGIB-SR, Chapter 1606) - Reserve Education Assistance Program (REAP, Chapter 1607)
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人的受抚养人，并且 有资格获得VA教育福利，包括： - 9/11后退伍军人法案（第33章） - 蒙哥马利军人法案现役（MGIB-AD，第30章） - 蒙哥马利军人法案精选预备役（MGIB-SR，第1606章） - 预备役教育援助计划（REAP，第1607章）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of VR&E benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些VR&E福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get educational and vocational counseling, plus help with:
source_blocks.text: 您可以获得教育和职业咨询，以及以下方面的帮助：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Exploring your abilities and interests Mapping out a path to employment Planning the best use of your VA benefits
source_blocks.text: 探索您的能力和兴趣 规划就业路径 规划如何最佳利用您的VA福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: In certain cases, you may be able to get other education and employment benefits and services for dependents. For example, you may qualify if you re the child of a Vietnam or Korean War Veteran and have certain birth defects, or if you re the dependent child or spouse of a Veteran who has died or is permanently and totally disabled as the result of active service.
source_blocks.text: 注意：在某些情况下，您可能可以获得其他针对受抚养人的教育和就业福利及服务。例如，如果您是越南战争或朝鲜战争退伍军人的子女且患有某些先天缺陷，或者您是因现役而死亡或永久完全残疾的退伍军人的受抚养子女或配偶，您可能有资格获得这些福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about other benefits and services for dependents
source_blocks.text: 了解其他针对受抚养人的福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Follow these steps to apply for Chapter 36 services:
source_blocks.text: 按照以下步骤申请第36章服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Log in to your eBenefits account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的eBenefits账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Additional Benefits on your dashboard.
source_blocks.text: 在您的仪表板上点击“额外福利”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program.
source_blocks.text: 点击“职业康复与就业计划”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for Education and Career Counseling.
source_blocks.text: 申请“教育与职业咨询”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible, we ll invite you to meet with a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC). Your VRC will work with you to map out a career path.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您与职业康复顾问（VRC）会面。您的VRC将与您一起规划职业道路。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online right now.
source_blocks.text: 您现在就可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If the service member or Veteran in your family isn t yet using VR&E benefits and services, they may also apply online through eBenefits.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您家庭中的服役人员或退伍军人尚未使用VR&E福利和服务，他们也可以通过eBenefits在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were a part of chemical and biological warfare testing through Project 112 or Project Shipboard Hazard and Defense (SHAD), you may be at risk for certain illnesses. The Department of Defense s Deseret Test Center in Fort Douglas, Utah, conducted this testing, which took place aboard ships and on land in various locations from 1962 to 1974. Find out if you can get disability compensation or benefits.

Find out if you can get disability compensation or benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Particulate matter or large burn pits in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Djibouti in the Horn of Africa A large sulfur fire at Mishraq State Sulfur Mine near Mosul, Iraq Hexavalent chromium at the Qarmat Ali water treatment plant in Basra, Iraq Pollutants from a waste incinerator near the Naval Air Facility at Atsugi, Japan

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family Group Life Insurance (FSGLI) | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 军人家庭团体人寿保险 (FSGLI) | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)
source_blocks.text: 军人家庭团体人寿保险 (FSGLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family SGLI, also known as Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI), offers coverage for the spouse and dependent children of service members covered under full-time SGLI. Find out how much coverage you may qualify for and how to apply for and manage your benefits.
source_blocks.text: Family SGLI，也称为 Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)，为全职 SGLI 覆盖的军人的配偶和受抚养子女提供保障。了解您可能有资格获得的保额以及如何申请和管理您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for FSGLI?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格获得 FSGLI？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get FSGLI if you re the spouse or dependent child of a service member who meets one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是符合以下条件之一的军人的配偶或受抚养子女，您可能可以获得 FSGLI。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must be true. The service member is:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须属实。该军人必须：

source_blocks.source_text_en: On active duty and covered by full-time SGLI, or A member of the National Guard or Ready Reserve covered by full-time SGLI
source_blocks.text: 在现役且受全职 SGLI 覆盖，或 是国民警卫队或预备役成员且受全职 SGLI 覆盖

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may qualify to get FSGLI as the spouse of someone with SGLI coverage no matter if your own status is active duty, retired, or civilian.
source_blocks.text: 无论您自己的身份是现役、退役军人还是平民，只要您的配偶拥有 SGLI 覆盖，您就可能符合 FSGLI 的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Spouses of service members covered under SGLI Dependent children of service members covered under SGLI
source_blocks.text: 受 SGLI 覆盖的军人的配偶 受 SGLI 覆盖的军人的受抚养子女

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much coverage can I get with Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance?
source_blocks.text: 通过 Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance 我能获得多少保额？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Up to a maximum of \$100,000 of coverage for you as a spouse, not to exceed your service member s SGLI coverage, and \$10,000 for each dependent child. Dependent children get free coverage.
source_blocks.text: 作为配偶，您最高可获得 \$100,000 的保额，但不超过您军人配偶的 SGLI 保额；每个受抚养子女可获得 \$10,000 的保额。受抚养子女的保障是免费的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the civilian spouse of a service member signed up for full-time SGLI
source_blocks.text: 如果您是已注册全职 SGLI 的军人的平民配偶

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll automatically insure you under FSGLI. In this case, we ll automatically take your premium out of your service member s pay.
source_blocks.text: 我们将自动为您提供 FSGLI 保障。在这种情况下，我们会自动从您军人配偶的工资中扣除保费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a military spouse and you were married on or after January 2, 2013
source_blocks.text: 如果您是军人配偶，并且在 2013 年 1 月 2 日或之后结婚

source_blocks.source_text_en: We won t automatically cover you. You ll need to sign up through your service member.
source_blocks.text: 我们不会自动为您提供保障。您需要通过您的军人配偶进行注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service member is a member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, or National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, have them sign you up online through the SGLI Online Enrollment System (SOES).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的军人配偶是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或国家海洋和大气管理局的成员，请让他们通过 SGLI 在线注册系统 (SOES) 为您在线注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To access SOES, have your service member:
source_blocks.text: 要访问SOES，请让您的军人成员：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to milConnect
source_blocks.text: 前往milConnect

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in.
source_blocks.text: 登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to Benefits, Life Insurance SOES- SGLI Online Enrollment System to sign up.
source_blocks.text: 前往Benefits, Life Insurance SOES- SGLI Online Enrollment System进行注册。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your service member can log in with their CAC or DS Logon using Internet Explorer as soon as they receive notice that they can start using SOES.
source_blocks.text: 您的军人成员可以在收到可以开始使用SOES的通知后，使用CAC或DS Logon通过Internet Explorer登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service member is part of the Public Health Service, you ll need to fill out the Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (SGLV 8286A) and have them turn it in to their unit s personnel officer. Download the Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 如果您的军人成员属于Public Health Service，您需要填写Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (SGLV 8286A)，并让他们将其交给所在单位的人事官员。下载Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will my service member pay for spousal coverage and how do the premium payments work?
source_blocks.text: 我的军人成员需要为配偶保险支付多少费用，保费支付如何运作？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your service member will pay a premium for your coverage, which will increase as you age. Choose your age below to view current spousal coverage monthly premium rates based on the amount of insurance coverage you want.
source_blocks.text: 您的军人成员将为您的保险支付保费，该保费会随您的年龄增长而增加。请选择您的年龄以查看基于您所需保险金额的当前配偶保险月保费费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re signed up as a spouse in the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS), we ll automatically deduct the FSGLI premium from your service member s pay. If you aren t signed up in DEERS, your service member will still be responsible for premiums and back payments of unpaid premiums.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已在Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS)中注册为配偶，我们将自动从您的军人成员的工资中扣除FSGLI保费。如果您未在DEERS中注册，您的军人成员仍需负责保费及未付保费的补缴。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can my service member make changes to my coverage?
source_blocks.text: 我的军人成员可以更改我的保险吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. If you have spousal coverage and you want to reduce, turn down, or cancel it:
source_blocks.text: 可以。如果您有配偶保险，并且您想减少、拒绝或取消它：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service member is a member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, or National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, have your service member submit your changes online through the SGLI Online Enrollment System (SOES).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的军人是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或国家海洋与大气管理局的成员，请让您的军人通过SGLI在线注册系统（SOES）在线提交您的变更。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To access SOES, have your service member:
source_blocks.text: 要访问SOES，请让您的军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to milConnect
source_blocks.text: 前往milConnect

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in.
source_blocks.text: 登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to Benefits, Life Insurance SOES- SGLI Online Enrollment System to update.
source_blocks.text: 前往“福利，人寿保险SOES- SGLI在线注册系统”进行更新。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check their coverage and beneficiary info and make any needed updates.
source_blocks.text: 检查他们的保险范围和受益人信息，并进行任何必要的更新。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your service member can log in with their CAC or DS Logon using Internet Explorer as soon as they receive notice that they can start using SOES.
source_blocks.text: 您的军人可以使用他们的CAC或DS Logon，通过Internet Explorer登录，一旦他们收到可以开始使用SOES的通知即可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service member is part of the Public Health Service, you ll need to fill out the Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (SGLV 8286A) and have your service member turn it in to their unit s personnel officer. Download the Spouse Coverage Election and Certificate (PDF) Learn more about SOES
source_blocks.text: 如果您的军人属于公共卫生署，您需要填写配偶保险选择和证明（SGLV 8286A），并让您的军人将其交给所在单位的人事官员。下载配偶保险选择和证明（PDF）了解更多关于SOES的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We automatically cover dependent children. This coverage can t be turned down, reduced, or canceled.
source_blocks.text: 注意：我们自动为受抚养子女提供保险。此保险不能拒绝、减少或取消。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will my service member pay for dependent coverage?
source_blocks.text: 我的军人需要为受抚养人保险支付多少费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Nothing. We provide dependent coverage at no cost until the child is 18 years old, or sometimes longer if the child meets one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 不需要。我们免费提供受抚养人保险，直到孩子年满18岁，或者如果孩子满足以下列出的要求之一，有时可以更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To continue receiving dependent coverage after age 18, one of these must be true. The child:
source_blocks.text: 要在18岁后继续获得受抚养人保险，必须满足以下条件之一。孩子：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is a full-time student, or Becomes permanently and totally disabled before turning 18 and can t support themselves
source_blocks.text: 是全日制学生，或 在18岁前成为永久性完全残疾，且无法自食其力

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can my service member get extended coverage for our dependent child?
source_blocks.text: 我的军人可以为我们的受抚养子女获得延长保险吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, in some cases. Coverage lasts until the child is 18 years old. But, if the child is a full-time student between 18 and 22 years old, we may extend the coverage. Or, if the child becomes permanently and totally disabled before turning 18 and is no longer able to support themselves, we may extend the coverage in some cases indefinitely.
source_blocks.text: 是的，在某些情况下可以。保险持续到孩子年满18岁。但是，如果孩子是18至22岁之间的全日制学生，我们可能会延长保险。或者，如果孩子在18岁前成为永久性完全残疾，且无法再自食其力，我们可能在某些情况下无限期延长保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I convert a spousal FSGLI policy to an individual insurance policy?
source_blocks.text: 我如何将配偶FSGLI保单转换为个人保险保单？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to convert spousal FSGLI coverage to a permanent, individual insurance policy (such as whole life) within 120 days from the date of your service member s:
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择在您的军人以下日期后的120天内，将配偶FSGLI保险转换为永久性个人保险保单（如终身寿险）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Separation from the military Divorce from you Written election to end spousal SGLI coverage Written election to end their SGLI coverage Death
source_blocks.text: 从军队退役 与您离婚 书面选择终止配偶SGLI保险 书面选择终止其SGLI保险 死亡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If any of the events listed above happen, you, as the service member s spouse, become solely responsible for all aspects of the policy, including premium payments.
source_blocks.text: 如果上述任一事件发生，作为军人的配偶，您将全权负责该保单的所有事宜，包括保费支付。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t convert other types of policies such as term, variable, or universal life insurance. And, supplementary policy benefits such as accidental death and dismemberment or a waiver of the premium for disability aren t considered part of the conversion policy.
source_blocks.text: 您不能转换其他类型的保单，如定期寿险、变额寿险或万能寿险。此外，附加保单利益，如意外死亡和肢解保险或残疾保费豁免，不被视为转换保单的一部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you d like to convert FSGLI coverage, you must also:
source_blocks.text: 如果您想转换FSGLI保障，您还必须：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Choose a company from the list of companies that take part in this program. View the companies you can choose from Apply at the local sales office of the company you chose. Give a copy of the most recent Leave and Earnings Statement (LES) to the agent, showing the deduction for spousal SGLI. You ll also have to provide proof of coverage with one of these documents: - The service member s separation document (Form DD214 or NGB-22, or written orders) - The Certificate of Dissolution of Marriage between the spouse and the service member - The service member s FSGLI spousal declination - The service member s SGLI declination - The service member s proof of death (DD1300: Report of Casualty, or a civilian death certificate)
source_blocks.text: 从参与此项目的公司列表中选择一家公司。查看你可以选择的公司 在你选择的公司的当地销售办公室申请。 向代理人提供最近一份 Leave and Earnings Statement (LES) 的副本，显示配偶 SGLI 的扣除。你还需要提供以下文件之一作为保险证明： - 军人的退役文件（DD214 或 NGB-22 表格，或书面命令） - 配偶与军人之间的婚姻解除证明 - 军人的 FSGLI 配偶拒绝声明 - 军人的 SGLI 拒绝声明 - 军人的死亡证明（DD1300：伤亡报告，或民事死亡证明）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Which forms would my service member need?
source_blocks.text: 我的军人需要哪些表格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request an advance insurance payment for a spouse who s terminally ill, a service member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284A).Download SGLV 8284A (PDF) To tell us about the death of a family member covered by the policy, a service member would file a Report of Death of Family Member (SGLV 8700).Download SGLV 8700 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a service member would file a Claim for Family Coverage Death Benefits (SGLV 8283A). Download SGLV 8283A (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要为身患绝症的配偶申请预付保险金，军人需提交 Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284A)。下载 SGLV 8284A (PDF) 要通知我们保单承保的家庭成员死亡，军人需提交 Report of Death of Family Member (SGLV 8700)。下载 SGLV 8700 (PDF) 要在需要时获得保险金，军人需提交 Claim for Family Coverage Death Benefits (SGLV 8283A)。下载 SGLV 8283A (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fiduciary claims
source_blocks.text: Fiduciary claims

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with a VA decision on a fiduciary claim, you can choose one of the following review options to continue your case. If you aren t satisfied with that review, you can try another option.
source_blocks.text: 如果你不同意VA对fiduciary claim的决定，你可以选择以下审查选项之一来继续你的案件。如果你对该审查不满意，你可以尝试另一个选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mark your calendar
source_blocks.text: 标记你的日历

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have 1 year from the date on your decision to request a decision review.
source_blocks.text: 从你的决定日期起，你有1年的时间来请求decision review。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Decision review options
source_blocks.text: Decision review选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add new and relevant evidence
source_blocks.text: 添加新的相关证据

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Supplemental Claim option isn t available for fiduciary claims. You can file a new claim if you have new evidence.
source_blocks.text: Supplemental Claim选项不适用于fiduciary claims。如果你有新证据，你可以提交新的claim。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please choose one of the options below for your next review.
source_blocks.text: 请选择以下选项之一进行你的下一次审查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask for a new look from a senior reviewer
source_blocks.text: 请求高级审查员重新审查

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 20-0996: Higher-Level Review (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载VA Form 20-0996: Higher-Level Review (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose a Higher-Level Review, you re asking for another review of the same evidence. A senior reviewer will take another look at your case and determine whether the decision can be changed based on a difference of opinion or an error. Learn how to request a Higher-Level Review
source_blocks.text: 当你选择Higher-Level Review时，你是在请求对相同证据进行另一次审查。高级审查员将重新审查你的案件，并确定是否可以根据意见分歧或错误来更改决定。了解如何请求Higher-Level Review

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t submit any evidence.
source_blocks.text: 你不能提交任何证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and/or your representative can speak with the reviewer on the phone. You can tell them why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors.
source_blocks.text: 你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: 4-5 months VA s goal for completing Higher-Level Reviews is 125 days. A review may take longer if VA needs to get records or schedule a new exam to correct an error.
source_blocks.text: 4-5个月 VA完成Higher-Level Reviews的目标是125天。如果VA需要获取记录或安排新的考试以纠正错误，审查可能需要更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Higher-Level Review?
source_blocks.text: 我可以请求Higher-Level Review吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Higher-Level Review of an initial claim. This option isn t available after a Higher-Level Review or Board Appeal.
source_blocks.text: 你可以对初始claim请求Higher-Level Review。在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后，此选项不可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appeal to a Veterans Law Judge
source_blocks.text: 向Veterans Law Judge上诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 10182: Board Appeal (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载 VA 表格 10182：委员会上诉（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C., will review your case. Learn more about how to request a Board Appeal
source_blocks.text: 位于华盛顿特区的退伍军人上诉委员会（Board of Veterans Appeals）的一名法官将审查您的案件。了解更多关于如何申请委员会上诉的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.
source_blocks.text: 大约1年 委员会对无新证据且无听证的上诉作出裁决的目标时间约为一年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to add new evidence that a judge will review.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择添加法官将审查的新证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You also have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以选择请求与法官进行听证。视频会议听证将在您附近的 VA 地点进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Longer The Board will take longer to decide your appeal if you add new evidence or request a hearing.
source_blocks.text: 更长 如果您添加新证据或请求听证，委员会将需要更长时间来裁决您的上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Board Appeal?
source_blocks.text: 我可以申请委员会上诉吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Board Appeal after an initial claim or Higher-Level Review decision. You can t request two Board Appeals in a row.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在初次申请或高级审查（Higher-Level Review）决定后申请委员会上诉。您不能连续两次申请委员会上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After a Board decision
source_blocks.text: 委员会决定之后

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with the Board s decision and have new and relevant evidence that supports your case, you can file a Supplemental Claim. You can also appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. Learn more about your options after a Board decision
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意委员会的决定，并且有支持您案件的新且相关的证据，您可以提交补充申请（Supplemental Claim）。您也可以向美国退伍军人上诉法院（U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims）提出上诉。了解更多关于委员会决定后您的选择

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens next?
source_blocks.text: 接下来会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens after you request a decision review
source_blocks.text: 了解您请求决定审查后会发生什么

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to do anything while you wait unless VA sends you a letter asking for more information. If VA schedules exams for you, be sure not to miss them.
source_blocks.text: 在等待期间，您无需做任何事情，除非 VA 向您发送信函要求更多信息。如果 VA 为您安排了检查，请务必不要错过。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of your appeal
source_blocks.text: 跟踪您的上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veterans Service Organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review. Get help requesting a decision review
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人服务组织（Veterans Service Organization）或 VA 认可的律师或代理人可以帮助您请求决定审查。获取请求决定审查的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I have more questions?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get answers to frequently asked questions about decision reviews. Go to FAQs
source_blocks.text: 获取关于决定审查的常见问题解答。前往常见问题解答

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that s relevant to your case or identifying new evidence for review. A reviewer will determine whether the new evidence changes the decision.
source_blocks.text: When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that s relevant to your case or identifying new evidence for review. A reviewer will determine whether the new evidence changes the decision.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I file a Supplemental Claim?
source_blocks.text: Can I file a Supplemental Claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a Supplemental Claim within 1 year of a decision if you have new evidence, unless one of these rare situations applies to you. You have a: Fiduciary claim, or Multiple party claim
source_blocks.text: You can file a Supplemental Claim within 1 year of a decision if you have new evidence, unless one of these rare situations applies to you. You have a: Fiduciary claim, or Multiple party claim

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long does it take VA to make a decision?
source_blocks.text: How long does it take VA to make a decision?

source_blocks.source_text_en: 4-5 months VA s goal for completing Supplemental Claims is 125 days.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What s considered new and relevant evidence?
source_blocks.text: What s considered new and relevant evidence?

source_blocks.source_text_en: New evidence is information that VA didn t have before the last decision. Relevant evidence is information that could prove or disprove something about your case.
source_blocks.text: New evidence is information that VA didn t have before the last decision. Relevant evidence is information that could prove or disprove something about your case.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can submit evidence yourself, or you can ask VA to get evidence, like medical records, that s at a VA medical center or other federal facility. VA can t accept your Supplemental Claim without new and relevant evidence.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plan to study at a foreign school, find out how you can use VA benefits to cover your tuition and fees.
source_blocks.text: If you plan to study at a foreign school, find out how you can use VA benefits to cover your tuition and fees.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA education benefits to study at a foreign school?
source_blocks.text: Can I get VA education benefits to study at a foreign school?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get education benefits if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: You can get education benefits if you meet all of the requirements listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: All of these must be true:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re eligible for or already get VA educational assistance as a Veteran, service member, Reservist, or qualified dependent, and We ve approved your program, and Your program is at an institution of higher learning where you ll earn a standard associate s degree or higher, or a degree of equal value at that foreign school.
source_blocks.text: You re eligible for or already get VA educational assistance as a Veteran, service member, Reservist, or qualified dependent, and We ve approved your program, and Your program is at an institution of higher learning where you ll earn a standard associate s degree or higher, or a degree of equal value at that foreign school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Exception: Family members who qualify for Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance can get VA benefits while in approved postsecondary (after high school) non-college degree programs at training locations in the Philippines.
source_blocks.text: Exception: Family members who qualify for Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance can get VA benefits while in approved postsecondary (after high school) non-college degree programs at training locations in the Philippines.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: What benefits can I get?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Money for school Money for your housing costs during enrollment
source_blocks.text: Money for school Money for your housing costs during enrollment

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I attend any foreign school?
source_blocks.text: Can I attend any foreign school?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll accept degrees from schools in foreign countries that are similar to degrees granted by accredited U.S. colleges and universities. Accredited means that a group of experts has confirmed the school meets certain recognized quality standards. For private schools overseas, the degree must be of equal value to those granted by public colleges and universities in the same country, and the school must have the same entrance requirements. Independent study courses must be accredited by a nationally recognized accrediting association.

For private schools overseas, the degree must be of equal value to those granted by public colleges and universities in the same country, and the school must have the same entrance requirements. source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool to see what benefits you can get at the school you want to attend. Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool
source_blocks.text: Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool to see what benefits you can get at the school you want to attend. Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool

source_blocks.source_text_en: Exception: Programs at schools located in the United States that offer courses in a foreign country through the Department of Defense don t qualify as foreign training. Also, year abroad and similar programs offered by schools in the United States don t qualify as foreign training.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: How do I get these benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Before you enroll, make sure we ve approved your school for education benefits.
source_blocks.text: ### Before you enroll, make sure we ve approved your school for education benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact the school or use the GI Bill Comparison Tool to find out if we ve approved your program for VA educational benefits. Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool
source_blocks.text: Contact the school or use the GI Bill Comparison Tool to find out if we ve approved your program for VA educational benefits. Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you still have questions about the school or program, you can submit a question to us using the GI Bill website. Go to the GI Bill website You can also send us a request for information about your program's approval status by mail. Send your request to:
source_blocks.text: If you still have questions about the school or program, you can submit a question to us using the GI Bill website. Go to the GI Bill website You can also send us a request for information about your program's approval status by mail. Send your request to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Foreign School Approval Group (22-EDU) VA Regional Office 130 S. Elmwood Avenue Suite 601 Buffalo, NY 14202
source_blocks.text: Foreign School Approval Group (22-EDU) VA Regional Office 130 S. Elmwood Avenue Suite 601 Buffalo, NY 14202

source_blocks.source_text_en: You'll need to give us the name of the foreign school, the complete address, and the name of the program you want to enroll in. We ll let you know if your program has already been approved.
source_blocks.text: You'll need to give us the name of the foreign school, the complete address, and the name of the program you want to enroll in. We ll let you know if your program has already been approved.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you or your qualified dependent want to enroll in a program that we haven t approved, you ll need to ask the school to request approval. We can t take any action until an official from your school (not you) requests approval. If we don t approve your program, you ll have to pay all costs at the school, including tuition and fees.

We can t take any action until an official from your school (not you) requests approval. If we don t approve your program, you ll have to pay all costs at the school, including tuition and fees.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Apply for benefits.
source_blocks.text: ### Apply for benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply
source_blocks.text: Find out how to apply

source_blocks.source_text_en: Turn in your application to us at least 90 days before you leave for your new school. We ll decide what benefits you get based on your school s location.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get approved for benefits, turn in your Certificate of Eligibility (COE) to the school s certifying official to show that you qualify for VA benefits. Your school s certifying official will submit your enrollment information with a VA Enrollment Certification (VA Form 22-1999).

Your school s certifying official will submit your enrollment information with a VA Enrollment Certification (VA Form 22-1999).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You won t get payments until we ve received and processed your enrollment information.
source_blocks.text: Note: You won t get payments until we ve received and processed your enrollment information.

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Make arrangements for school and travel.
source_blocks.text: ### Make arrangements for school and travel.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be sure you have enough money to cover all your needs until VA payments begin. - Make arrangements with the school for acceptance, enrollment, payment of tuition and fees, and housing. - Make arrangements for travel including your passport, visa, and vaccinations, as required. - Ask about your school s or host country s requirements for health insurance. This is very important. In some cases, you may not be able to start classes until you ve made health insurance arrangements.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plan to attend the foreign school for more than one year, tell the school within 120 days of when you want to re-enroll for another year. Ask the certifying official to submit an enrollment certification for you. Normally, foreign schools certify their students for one academic year. So you ll need to make sure the school knows your plans for continued enrollment to avoid any delay in getting your benefits.

documents.title: 关于决定复核的常见问题 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Frequently asked questions about decision reviews | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 关于决定复核的常见问题 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Frequently asked questions about decision reviews
source_blocks.text: 关于决定复核的常见问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about the review options and how to request a review. If you need help requesting a review, a Veterans service organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review.
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于复核选项以及如何申请复核的信息。如果您需要帮助申请复核，退伍军人服务组织或VA认可的律师或代理人可以帮助您申请决定复核。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: What s new and relevant evidence? What s Duty to Assist ? What if I miss the deadline for submitting my request? What should I expect if I request a call with a senior reviewer? What should I expect if I request a hearing with a Veterans Law Judge? What if I want to change my review option after submitting a form? How do I opt in if I want my legacy claim or appeal to be considered in the modernized system?
source_blocks.text: 什么是新的且相关的证据？ 什么是“协助义务”？ 如果我错过了提交申请的截止日期怎么办？ 如果我请求与高级审核员通话，会有什么预期？ 如果我请求与退伍军人法律法官举行听证会，会有什么预期？ 如果我提交表格后想更改复核选项怎么办？ 如果我希望我的传统索赔或上诉在现代系统中得到考虑，我该如何选择加入？

source_blocks.source_text_en: What s new and relevant evidence?
source_blocks.text: 什么是新的且相关的证据？

source_blocks.source_text_en: In order to file a Supplemental Claim, you have to add evidence that s both new and relevant. New evidence is information that VA didn t have before the last decision. Relevant evidence is information that could prove or disprove something about your case. VA can t accept a Supplemental Claim without new and relevant evidence. You can either submit the evidence yourself or identify evidence, like medical records, that you d like VA to get for you.
source_blocks.text: 为了提交补充索赔，您必须添加既新又相关的证据。新证据是指VA在最后一次决定之前没有的信息。相关证据是指可能证明或反驳您案件某些方面的信息。没有新的且相关的证据，VA无法接受补充索赔。您可以自己提交证据，或指明您希望VA为您获取的证据，如医疗记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What s Duty to Assist ?
source_blocks.text: 什么是“协助义务”？

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA s Duty to Assist requires VA to assist you in getting evidence, such as medical records, that s needed to support your case. VA s Duty to Assist applies during your initial claim and if you file a Supplemental Claim. If you request a Higher-Level Review or Board Appeal, Duty to Assist doesn t apply. However, the reviewer or judge will look at whether VA met its Duty to Assist during your initial claim or Supplemental Claim, and if not, they ll have VA correct that error. Your review may take longer if this is needed.
source_blocks.text: VA的“协助义务”要求VA协助您获取支持您案件所需的证据，如医疗记录。VA的“协助义务”适用于您的初始索赔以及您提交补充索赔时。如果您请求高级审核或委员会上诉，“协助义务”不适用。但是，审核员或法官将审查VA在您的初始索赔或补充索赔期间是否履行了其“协助义务”，如果没有，他们将让VA纠正该错误。如果需要，您的复核可能会花费更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I miss the deadline for submitting my request?
source_blocks.text: 如果我错过了提交申请的截止日期怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Submitting your request on time will ensure that you receive the maximum benefit if your case is granted. Please check the deadline for each review option and submit your request before that date.
source_blocks.text: 按时提交您的申请将确保如果您的案件获得批准，您能获得最大利益。请检查每个复核选项的截止日期，并在该日期之前提交您的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the deadline has passed, you can either:
source_blocks.text: 如果截止日期已过，您可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add new and relevant evidence and file a Supplemental Claim. Because the deadline has passed, the effective date for benefits will generally be tied to the date VA receives the new request, not the date VA received your initial claim.
source_blocks.text: 添加新的且相关的证据并提交补充索赔。由于截止日期已过，福利的生效日期通常将与VA收到新申请的日期挂钩，而不是VA收到您初始索赔的日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or
source_blocks.text: 或者

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send a letter to VA requesting that it revise the decision based on a Clear and Unmistakable Error (CUE). CUE is a specific and rare kind of error. To prove CUE, you must show that the correct facts, known at the time, were not before VA or that VA incorrectly applied the law as it existed at the time. It must be undebatable that an error occurred and that this error changed the outcome of your case. Misinterpretation of the facts or a failure by VA to meet its Duty to Assist aren t sufficient reasons. Please seek guidance from a qualified representative, as you can only request CUE once per decision.
source_blocks.text: 致信VA，要求其根据“清晰且不可否认的错误”（CUE）修改决定。CUE是一种特定且罕见的错误。要证明CUE，您必须表明当时已知的正确事实未提交给VA，或者VA错误地适用了当时存在的法律。必须无可争议地证明发生了错误，并且该错误改变了您案件的结果。对事实的误解或VA未能履行其“协助义务”不构成充分理由。请寻求合格代表的指导，因为您每项决定只能请求一次CUE。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with a Board decision, your decision will have information on additional ways to address errors.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意委员会的决定，您的决定将包含有关处理错误的其他方式的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I expect if I request a call with a senior reviewer?
source_blocks.text: 如果我请求与高级审核员通话，会有什么预期？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request an informal conference with a senior reviewer on the Higher-Level Review option, they ll call the phone number that you or your representative provided on the Higher-Level Review form to schedule a time to discuss your case with you. The senior reviewer will try to reach you or your representative by phone twice. If no one answers, they ll leave a voice mail.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在高级审核选项下请求与高级审核员进行非正式会议，他们将拨打您或您的代表在高级审核表格上提供的电话号码，以安排时间与您讨论您的案件。高级审核员将尝试通过电话联系您或您的代表两次。如果无人接听，他们将留下语音邮件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: During the call, you and/or your representative can talk about why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors. There won t be transcripts of this call.
source_blocks.text: 通话期间，您和/或您的代表可以谈论为什么您认为决定应被更改，并指出错误。本次通话不会有记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I expect if I request a hearing with a Veterans Law Judge?
source_blocks.text: 如果我请求与退伍军人法律法官举行听证会，我应期待什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择请求与法官举行听证会。视频会议听证会将在您附近的VA地点进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At your hearing, you and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony. The judge may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 在听证会上，您和法官将进行对话。法官会听取您的证词。法官可能会问您几个问题。您的代表（如果有）可以在听证会上帮助您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.
source_blocks.text: 听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉文件中。您可以在听证会后的90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I want to choose a different review option after I ve already submitted a form?
source_blocks.text: 如果我已经提交了表格，但想选择不同的审查选项怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve submitted a form and want to change your review option, you can send in a new decision review request form within 1 year from the date on your VA decision. You must include a letter that says you want to withdraw your existing review and switch to a different option.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已提交表格并想更改审查选项，您可以在VA决定日期起1年内提交新的决策审查请求表。您必须附上一封信，说明您希望撤回现有的审查并切换到不同的选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you requested a Board Appeal and want to switch to a different appeal option, you can send in a new Board Appeal form with a different option selected. You can switch appeal options within 1 year from the date on your VA decision or 60 days from the date you submitted your original form. You can t select a different appeal option if you ve already submitted evidence or had a hearing.
source_blocks.text: 如果您请求了委员会上诉并想切换到不同的上诉选项，您可以提交一份选择了不同选项的新委员会上诉表。您可以在VA决定日期起1年内或您提交原始表格之日起60天内切换上诉选项。如果您已经提交了证据或举行了听证会，则不能选择不同的上诉选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I opt in if I want my legacy claim or appeal to be considered in the modernized system?
source_blocks.text: 如果我希望我的遗留索赔或上诉在现代系统中被考虑，我如何选择加入？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with a VA decision you received before February 19, 2019, you can opt in to the modernized review system after you ve received a VA Statement of the Case (SOC) or Supplemental Statement of the Case (SSOC). To get either a SOC or an SSOC, you must file a Notice of Disagreement (VA Form 21-0958) within 1 year of the date on your decision. Find out how to file a Notice of Disagreement
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意2019年2月19日之前收到的VA决定，在您收到VA案件陈述（SOC）或补充案件陈述（SSOC）后，您可以选择加入现代化审查系统。要获得SOC或SSOC，您必须在决定日期起1年内提交异议通知（VA表格21-0958）。了解如何提交异议通知

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you receive either a SOC or an SSOC on the issue(s) in your Notice of Disagreement, you have 60 days or the remainder of the 1-year period following the decision you appealed, whichever is later, to opt in to the modernized system by submitting one of the following forms (and checking the SOC/SSOC opt-in box):

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about the the Marine Gunnery Sergeant John David Fry Scholarship (Fry Scholarship), a scholarship for children and dependents of Veterans. If your parent or spouse was an active-duty service member who died in the line of duty on or after September 11, 2001, you may qualify for this benefit. Find out if you re eligible for education benefits through this scholarship.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for Fry Scholarship benefits?
source_blocks.text: Am I eligible for Fry Scholarship benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get benefits under the Fry Scholarship if you re the child or surviving spouse of an active-duty service member who died in the line of duty on or after September 11, 2001.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get benefits under the Fry Scholarship if you re the child or surviving spouse of an active-duty service member who died in the line of duty on or after September 11, 2001.

source_blocks.source_text_en: As the child of a service member
source_blocks.text: As the child of a service member

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can be married or unmarried. If you turned 18 or graduated from high school before January 1, 2013, you can get a Fry Scholarship until you re 33 years old. If you turn 18 or graduate from high school after January 1, 2013, you can get a Fry Scholarship at any age over 18 or after you graduate (whichever comes first). If your parent died in the line of duty before August 1, 2011, you may qualify for both the Fry Scholarship and the Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) program. But you can use only one program at a time. source_blocks.source_text_en: Fully developed claim for a VA pension
source_blocks.text: 完全开发的VA养老金索赔

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Fully Developed Claim (FDC) program is the fastest way to get your VA pension claim processed, and there s no risk to your taking part in it. Just send in all your evidence, or supporting documents, when you file your claim. Participation in the FDC program is optional and won t affect your benefits. If you file a claim in the FDC program and we decide that additional documents exist that we need to decide your claim, we ll remove your claim from the FDC program and process it as a standard claim.
source_blocks.text: 完全开发索赔（FDC）计划是处理您的VA养老金索赔最快的方式，参与其中没有任何风险。只需在提交索赔时发送所有证据或支持文件。参与FDC计划是可选的，不会影响您的福利。如果您在FDC计划下提交索赔，而我们确定存在决定您的索赔所需的其他文件，我们会将您的索赔从FDC计划中移除，并按标准索赔处理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about the FDC program
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于FDC计划的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### FDC program
source_blocks.text: ### FDC计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: When turning in your claim under the FDC program, please send us all the supporting documents you have and provide information about supporting documents that you don t have.
source_blocks.text: 在FDC计划下提交索赔时，请发送您拥有的所有支持文件，并提供关于您没有的支持文件的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Application for Pension. Application for Pension (VA Form 21P-527EZ) 2. When you file your claim, turn in: - All necessary income and net-worth information, and - All private medical records you have that are related to your claim, and - Information about any health records that are available at a federal facility, like a VA medical center or clinic 3. Go to any VA medical appointments required to decide your claim.
source_blocks.text: 填写养老金申请表。养老金申请表（VA Form 21P-527EZ） 2. 提交索赔时，请提交： - 所有必要的收入和净值信息，以及 - 您拥有的与索赔相关的所有私人医疗记录，以及 - 关于联邦机构（如VA医疗中心或诊所）可获得的任何健康记录的信息 3. 参加决定您的索赔所需的任何VA医疗预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Standard claim process
source_blocks.text: 标准索赔流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: With a standard claim, you ll give us permission to gather evidence or records for you. You ll need to give us enough information about the evidence so we can request it from the right person or agency.
source_blocks.text: 对于标准索赔，您将允许我们为您收集证据或记录。您需要提供足够的证据信息，以便我们向正确的人或机构索取。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If a person or agency refuses to turn over the evidence, asks for money for the evidence, or can t get the evidence, we ll ask you to try to get the evidence or records. It s your responsibility to make sure we receive all requested records that aren t at a federal agency or office.
source_blocks.text: 如果个人或机构拒绝交出证据、要求支付证据费用或无法获取证据，我们将要求您尝试获取证据或记录。您有责任确保我们收到所有不在联邦机构或办公室的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### If you re claiming non-service-connected pension benefits
source_blocks.text: ### 如果您申请非服务相关的养老金福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: The evidence must show that you meet the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 证据必须表明您满足以下列出的要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况必须属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your net worth and income are within certain limits.
source_blocks.text: 您的净值和收入在一定限额内。

source_blocks.source_text_en: And at least one of these must be true about your service. You:
source_blocks.text: 并且关于您的服务，以下至少一项必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Served on active duty for any length of time during a period of war and were discharged due to a service-connected disability, or - Started on active duty before September 8, 1980, and you served at least 90 days (either all at one time or combined over time) on active duty with at least 1 day being during wartime, or - Started on active duty after September 7, 1980, and you served at least 2 years or the full period for which you were called or ordered to active duty, with at least 1 day being during wartime. Some exceptions may apply to this longer minimum service requirement.
source_blocks.text: 在战争期间服役任何时间，并因服务相关的残疾而退役，或 - 在1980年9月8日之前开始服役，并且至少服役90天（无论是连续还是累计），其中至少1天在战时，或 - 在1980年9月7日之后开始服役，并且至少服役2年或您被征召或命令服役的全部时间，其中至少1天在战时。某些例外情况可能适用于此更长的最低服役要求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: And at least one of these must also be true about your current situation. You:
source_blocks.text: 并且关于您当前的情况，以下至少一项也必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are at least 65 years old, or - Are a patient in a nursing home for long-term care, or - Receive Social Security disability benefits, or - Are unemployable because of a disability that doesn t go away, or - Have a disability that doesn t go away and that makes it impossible for you to work, or - Have a disease or disorder that we determine causes permanent and total disability
source_blocks.text: 至少65岁，或 - 是长期护理疗养院的患者，或 - 领取社会保障残疾福利，或 - 因不会消失的残疾而无法就业，或 - 有不会消失的残疾，使您无法工作，或 - 患有我们确定导致永久和完全残疾的疾病或障碍

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re claiming non-service-connected pension benefits with Aid and Attendance or Housebound benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您申请的是非服务性联系养老金福利，并附带 Aid and Attendance 或 Housebound 福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: The evidence must show that you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 证据必须表明您至少满足以下列出的要求之一。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have corrected vision of 5/200 or less in both eyes, or - Have contraction of the concentric visual field to 5 degrees or less, or - Are a patient in a nursing home due to the loss of mental or physical abilities, or - Need another person to help you with daily activities like bathing, eating, dressing, adjusting prosthetic devices, or protecting you from the hazards of your environment, or - Are bedridden and have to spend most of the day in bed because of your disability
source_blocks.text: 双眼矫正视力为 5/200 或更低，或 - 同心视野收缩至 5 度或更低，或 - 因丧失心理或身体能力而住院于疗养院，或 - 需要他人帮助您进行日常活动，如洗澡、进食、穿衣、调整假肢装置，或保护您免受环境危害，或 - 卧床不起，因残疾而必须大部分时间待在床上

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re claiming increased disability pension benefits based on being housebound
source_blocks.text: 如果您基于被困在家中（housebound）的情况申请增加的残疾养老金福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: The evidence must show that you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 证据必须表明您至少满足以下列出的要求之一。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You have a:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真。您有：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Single permanent disability that s 100% disabling, and you re confined to your home, or - Disability (rated 60% or higher) in addition to the disability that qualifies you for a pension
source_blocks.text: 单一永久性残疾，100% 致残，且您被困在家中，或 - 除使您有资格获得养老金的残疾外，还有另一残疾（评级为 60% 或更高）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re claiming benefits for a disabled child
source_blocks.text: 如果您为残疾子女申请福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: The evidence must show that the child, before turning 18 years old, became unable to support themselves due to a mental or physical disability.
source_blocks.text: 证据必须表明该子女在年满 18 岁之前，因心理或身体残疾而无法自给自足。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### FDC program
source_blocks.text: ### FDC 计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under the FDC program, we ll handle the evidence-gathering steps listed below.
source_blocks.text: 在 FDC 计划下，我们将处理以下列出的证据收集步骤。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll:
source_blocks.text: 我们将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request relevant records that you identify and authorize us to get from a federal facility, like a VA medical center - Schedule a health exam or get a medical opinion for you, if we decide we need it for your claim
source_blocks.text: 请求您识别并授权我们从联邦机构（如 VA 医疗中心）获取的相关记录 - 如果我们认为您的索赔需要，为您安排健康检查或获取医疗意见

source_blocks.source_text_en: Standard claim process
source_blocks.text: 标准索赔流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: With the standard claim process, we ll handle the evidence-gathering steps listed below.
source_blocks.text: 在标准索赔流程中，我们将处理以下列出的证据收集步骤。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll:
source_blocks.text: 我们将：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request relevant records that you identify and authorize us to get from a federal facility, like a VA medical center - Schedule a health exam or get a medical opinion for you, if we decide we need it for your claim - Make every reasonable effort to request relevant records that you authorize us to get that aren t at a federal facility. These may include records from state or local governments, documents from a private doctor, hospital records, or records from current or former employers.
source_blocks.text: 请求您识别并授权我们从联邦机构（如 VA 医疗中心）获取的相关记录 - 如果我们认为您的索赔需要，为您安排健康检查或获取医疗意见 - 尽一切合理努力请求您授权我们获取的非联邦机构的相关记录。这些可能包括州或地方政府的记录、私人医生的文件、医院记录或现任或前任雇主的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### FDC program
source_blocks.text: ### FDC 计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to turn in the information and evidence at the same time as you file your claim.
source_blocks.text: 您需要在提交索赔申请的同时提交信息和证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you turn in additional information or evidence after you send in your fully developed claim, we ll remove your claim from the FDC program and process it as a standard claim. If we decide your claim before 1 year from the date we receive the claim, you ll have the rest of that 1-year period to turn in additional information or evidence to support your claim.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您在提交完整开发的索赔申请后补充提交额外信息或证据，我们将把您的索赔从 FDC 计划中移除，并按标准索赔处理。如果我们在收到索赔之日起 1 年内做出决定，您将拥有该 1 年期间的剩余时间提交额外信息或证据以支持您的索赔。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Standard claim process
source_blocks.text: 标准索赔流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to turn in the information and evidence as soon as you can.
source_blocks.text: 您需要尽快提交信息和证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You have up to 1 year from the date we receive your claim to turn in any information and evidence. If we decide your claim before 1 year from the date we receive the claim, you ll have the rest of the 1-year period to turn in additional information or evidence to support your claim.
source_blocks.text: 注意：自我们收到您的索赔之日起，您有最多 1 年的时间提交任何信息和证据。如果我们在收到索赔之日起 1 年内做出决定，您将拥有该 1 年期间的剩余时间提交额外信息或证据以支持您的索赔。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Application for Pension (VA Form 21P-527EZ) When you file your claim, you ll be able to upload all supporting documents and evidence, like your income information and any medical records related to your claim.
source_blocks.text: 填写养老金申请表（VA Form 21P-527EZ）。提交索赔时，您将能够上传所有支持文件和证据，例如您的收入信息以及与索赔相关的任何医疗记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Special situations
source_blocks.text: 特殊情况

source_blocks.source_text_en: If any of the below situations apply to you, you ll need to turn in the additional forms at the same time as you file your pension claim. If you re:
source_blocks.text: 如果以下任何情况适用于您，您需要在提交养老金索赔的同时提交额外表格。如果您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Claiming non-service-connected pension with Housebound or Aid and Attendance benefits, you and your doctor will need to fill out a form called an Examination for Housebound Status or Permanent Need for Regular Aid and Attendance (VA Form 21-2680).Download VA Form 21-2680Note: If you re in a care facility, please also fill out a Request for Nursing Home Information in Connection with Claim for Aid and Attendance (VA Form 21-0779).Download VA Form 21-0779 Claiming a child in school between the ages of 18 and 23, fill out a Request for Approval of School Attendance (VA Form 21-674).Download VA Form 21-674 Claiming benefits for a seriously disabled child, turn in all private medical records for the child s disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 申请非服务相关的养老金，并附带 Housebound 或 Aid and Attendance 福利，您和您的医生需要填写一份名为 Examination for Housebound Status or Permanent Need for Regular Aid and Attendance（VA Form 21-2680）的表格。下载 VA Form 21-2680。注意：如果您在护理机构中，请同时填写 Request for Nursing Home Information in Connection with Claim for Aid and Attendance（VA Form 21-0779）。下载 VA Form 21-0779 申请 18 至 23 岁在校子女的福利，请填写 Request for Approval of School Attendance（VA Form 21-674）。下载 VA Form 21-674 申请严重残疾子女的福利，请提交子女残疾的所有私人医疗记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get A Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC) | Veterans Affairs
