source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC)
source_blocks.text: 获取退伍军人健康身份证（VHIC）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to get a Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC). Find out what to do if your card is lost or stolen and what to do with any old ID cards you may have used for VA health care in the past.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获取退伍军人健康身份证（VHIC）。了解如果您的卡丢失或被盗该怎么办，以及如何处理您过去可能用于VA医疗保健的任何旧身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What's a Veteran Health Identification Card, and how will I use it?
source_blocks.text: 什么是退伍军人健康身份证，我将如何使用它？

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you re enrolled in VA health care, you ll use your Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC) to check in to your appointments at VA medical centers. This secure ID card keeps your personal information safe while giving us the information we need to easily access your VA health record.
source_blocks.text: 当您加入VA医疗保健后，您将使用您的退伍军人健康身份证（VHIC）在VA医疗中心办理预约登记。这张安全身份证保护您的个人信息，同时为我们提供轻松访问您的VA健康记录所需的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also use this card to get discounts offered to Veterans at many stores, businesses, and restaurants. If you have a VHIC, you don t need to request another type of photo ID card to prove you re a Veteran or to get retail or business discounts.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以使用此卡在许多商店、企业和餐厅享受为退伍军人提供的折扣。如果您有VHIC，则无需再申请另一种类型的带照片身份证来证明您是退伍军人或获得零售或商业折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You can t use your VHIC as a credit card or insurance card. It doesn't pay copays or authorize care at non-VA health facilities.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您不能将VHIC用作信用卡或保险卡。它不支付共付额，也不授权在非VA医疗机构接受护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get my VHIC?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得我的VHIC？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, you ll need to be enrolled in VA health care. If you re not already enrolled, find out how to apply for VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 首先，您需要加入VA医疗保健。如果您尚未加入，请了解如何申请VA医疗保健。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you receive your VA health care welcome call
source_blocks.text: 在您收到VA医疗保健欢迎电话后

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact your nearest VA medical center and ask to speak with the enrollment coordinator. Ask the coordinator to help you arrange to get your picture taken for your new Veteran Health Identification Card.
source_blocks.text: 联系您最近的VA医疗中心，并要求与注册协调员交谈。请协调员帮助您安排拍摄新退伍军人健康身份证的照片。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also ask for help with getting your picture taken at your next VA health care appointment.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以要求在下次VA医疗保健预约时帮助您拍照。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you get your picture taken
source_blocks.text: 当您拍照时

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to show a current form of primary identification.
source_blocks.text: 您需要出示当前的主要身份证明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please bring your current, unexpired:
source_blocks.text: 请携带您当前未过期的：

source_blocks.source_text_en: State-issued driver s license, or U.S. passport or passport card, or Other government ID issued by a federal, state, or local government agency
source_blocks.text: 州颁发的驾驶执照，或 美国护照或护照卡，或 由联邦、州或地方政府机构颁发的其他政府身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: This ID must show your picture and date of birth. If it doesn t also show your address, you ll need to bring a separate document to confirm your address. This may include your electric bill, cable bill, voter registration card, or another mailed document.
source_blocks.text: 注意：此身份证必须显示您的照片和出生日期。如果它没有显示您的地址，您需要携带一份单独的文件来确认您的地址。这可能包括您的电费账单、有线电视账单、选民登记卡或其他邮寄文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After we take your picture
source_blocks.text: 在我们拍摄您的照片后

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll process your VHIC and send it to you by mail. You should receive your card within 10 days.
source_blocks.text: 我们将处理您的VHIC并通过邮件寄送给您。您应在10天内收到您的卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I don t receive my VHIC in the mail?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有通过邮件收到我的VHIC，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If it s been more than 10 days since you ve had your picture taken and you haven t received your card, please call the VA medical center where you had your picture taken. Or call us at 877-222-8387. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 711.
source_blocks.text: 如果您拍照后已超过10天仍未收到卡，请致电您拍照的VA医疗中心。或拨打我们的电话877-222-8387。我们的服务时间为周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00。如果您有听力障碍，请拨打TTY：711。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if my VHIC is lost or stolen?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的VHIC丢失或被盗，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a replacement card at the VA medical center where you had your picture taken. You ll need to bring your driver s license, passport, or other government ID or be able to answer a series of challenge questions so we can verify your identity before we give you a new card.
source_blocks.text: 您可以到您拍照的VA医疗中心申请补办卡。您需要携带驾照、护照或其他政府身份证件，或者能够回答一系列验证问题，以便我们在给您新卡前核实您的身份。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve changed your medical center since getting your original card, you can contact the medical center where you currently receive care. Or, call us at 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. Our staff will need to verify your identity with a series of challenge questions before we can send a new card.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在获得原卡后更换了医疗中心，您可以联系您目前接受护理的医疗中心。或者，拨打我们的电话877-222-8387，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00。我们的工作人员需要通过一系列验证问题核实您的身份，然后才能寄送新卡。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do with my old Veterans identification card?
source_blocks.text: 我应该如何处理我的旧退伍军人身份证？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please destroy it by cutting it up or shredding it. We want all Veterans who are enrolled in VA health care to have the new VHIC. This new card offers even more security to protect your personal information.
source_blocks.text: 请将其剪碎或粉碎销毁。我们希望所有参加VA医疗保健的退伍军人都拥有新的VHIC。这张新卡提供更多安全性，以保护您的个人信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It also offers other helpful new features. These include "VA" printed in braille to help Veterans with low vision to quickly recognize the card as well as a display of your latest branch of service emblem and a list of special awards you may have received.
source_blocks.text: 它还提供其他有用的新功能。这些包括以盲文印刷的“VA”，帮助视力低下的退伍军人快速识别卡片，以及显示您最新的军种徽章和您可能获得的特殊奖项列表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get Help Filing Your Claim Or Appeal | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 获取帮助提交索赔或上诉 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help filing your claim or appeal
source_blocks.text: 获取帮助提交索赔或上诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help filing a claim or appeal, you may want to work with an accredited attorney, a claims agent, or a Veterans Service Officer (VSO). We trust these professionals because they re trained and certified in the VA claims and appeals processes and can help you with VA-related needs.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要帮助提交索赔或上诉，您可能希望与经认证的律师、索赔代理或退伍军人服务官员（VSO）合作。我们信任这些专业人士，因为他们经过VA索赔和上诉流程的培训和认证，可以帮助您处理与VA相关的需求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VSOs work on behalf of Veterans and service members as well as their dependents and survivors. Find out more about accredited representatives and how they can help you.
source_blocks.text: VSO代表退伍军人、服役人员及其家属和遗属工作。了解更多关于经认证的代表以及他们如何帮助您的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What does it take to be an accredited representative or a VSO?
source_blocks.text: 成为经认证的代表或VSO需要什么条件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Accredited representatives and VSOs need to:
source_blocks.text: 经认证的代表和VSO需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pass an exam Pass a background check Take continuing-education courses to make sure they re providing the most up-to-date information
source_blocks.text: 通过考试 通过背景调查 参加继续教育课程，以确保他们提供最新的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Recognized organizations and individuals can legally represent a Veteran, service member, dependent, or survivor before VA. Non-recognized organizations and individuals can provide information, but can t be representatives.
source_blocks.text: 被认可的组织和个人可以在VA面前合法代表退伍军人、服役人员、家属或遗属。未被认可的组织和个人可以提供信息，但不能作为代表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What does an accredited representative or a VSO do?
source_blocks.text: 经认证的代表或VSO做什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Accredited representatives and VSOs can help you understand and apply for VA benefits, like:
source_blocks.text: 经认证的代表和VSO可以帮助您了解和申请VA福利，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Financial support (monthly payments) Education Vocational Rehabilitation & Employment (VR&E) Home loans Life insurance Pension Health care Burial benefits
source_blocks.text: 经济支持（每月付款） 教育 职业康复与就业（VR&E） 住房贷款 人寿保险 养老金 医疗保健 丧葬福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: These trained professionals can also:
source_blocks.text: 这些受过培训的专业人士还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help you gather supporting documents (like a doctor s report or medical test results) File a claim or appeal on your behalf Provide added support, like helping with transportation to medical appointments or emergency funds
source_blocks.text: 帮助您收集支持文件（如医生报告或医学检测结果） 代表您提交索赔或上诉 提供额外支持，如帮助安排前往医疗预约的交通或紧急资金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Veterans Service Officers work for Veterans Service Organizations (both are called VSOs), as well as for local government offices.
source_blocks.text: 注意：退伍军人服务官员为退伍军人服务组织（两者都称为VSO）以及地方政府办公室工作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What does it cost to use an accredited representative or a VSO?
source_blocks.text: 使用经认证的代表或VSO需要多少费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: In general, no individual or organization may charge you a fee to help you file your initial application for benefits. But they may charge you for unusual expenses. It s only after we ve made a decision about your original claim that VA-accredited claims agents and attorneys may charge for their services. Make sure you ask up front what, if any, fees you ll be charged. If you believe a claims agent or attorney charged a fee that s too high, you can challenge it. Find out more in the How to Challenge a Fee guide
source_blocks.text: 一般来说，任何个人或组织不得向您收取帮助您提交初始福利申请的费用。但他们可能会就特殊开支向您收费。只有在我们就您的原始索赔做出决定后，VA认证的索赔代理和律师才可以收取服务费用。请确保您事先询问您将被收取哪些费用（如果有的话）。如果您认为索赔代理或律师收取的费用过高，您可以提出质疑。在“如何质疑费用”指南中了解更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I find an accredited representative or a VSO?
source_blocks.text: 如何找到经认证的代表或VSO？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can find an accredited representative or a VSO in 1 of 2 ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下2种方式之一找到经认证的代表或VSO：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to find a local representative (including a recognized VSO, an attorney, or a claims agent) by state/territory, zip code, or the organization s name. Go to eBenefits Or search the VA Office of the General Counsel s list to find VA-recognized organizations and VA-accredited individuals by name, city, state, or zip code. Search the VA Office of the General Counsel s list
source_blocks.text: 前往 eBenefits 查找当地代表（包括认可的 VSO、律师或索赔代理人），可按州/领地、邮政编码或组织名称搜索。前往 eBenefits 或搜索 VA Office of the General Counsel 的名单，按名称、城市、州或邮政编码查找 VA 认可的组织和 VA 认可的个人。搜索 VA Office of the General Counsel 的名单

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I set up an accredited representative or a VSO to work on my behalf?
source_blocks.text: 如何设立认可的代理人或 VSO 来代表我处理事务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to either use eBenefits or fill out a form and mail it in.
source_blocks.text: 您需要使用 eBenefits 或填写表格并邮寄给我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Choose one of these ways to get set up:
source_blocks.text: 选择以下方式之一进行设立：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use eBenefits to let us know you ll be working with a representative or to change your current representation. Go to eBenefits To have a VSO help you, fill out an Appointment of Veterans Service Organization as Claimant s Representative (VA Form 21-22). Download VA Form 21-22 (PDF) To have a claims agent or attorney help you, fill out an Appointment of Individual as Claimant s Representative (VA Form 21-22a). Download VA Form 21-22a (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 使用 eBenefits 告知我们您将与代理人合作或更改当前代理。前往 eBenefits 若要由 VSO 协助，请填写 Appointment of Veterans Service Organization as Claimant's Representative (VA Form 21-22)。下载 VA Form 21-22 (PDF) 若要由索赔代理人或律师协助，请填写 Appointment of Individual as Claimant's Representative (VA Form 21-22a)。下载 VA Form 21-22a (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re filling out one of the forms, you ll need to mail it to your nearest VA regional office. Please speak to the service organization or representative before you send your request. Find a VA regional office near you
source_blocks.text: 如果您填写其中一份表格，需将其邮寄至最近的 VA 区域办公室。请在发送请求前与服务组织或代理人沟通。查找附近的 VA 区域办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our online tools can help you view, organize, and share your VA medical records and personal health information. Find out if you re eligible and how to sign in to start using these tools.

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Blue Button

source_blocks.source_text_en: More about VA Blue Button
source_blocks.text: More about VA Blue Button

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is VA Blue Button, and how can it help me manage my health care?
source_blocks.text: What is VA Blue Button, and how can it help me manage my health care?

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Blue Button is a feature of the health management portal within My HealtheVet. It lets you view, print, save, download, and share information from your VA medical record and personal health record. With this tool, you can better manage your health needs and communicate with your health care team.

It lets you view, print, save, download, and share information from your VA medical record and personal health record. With this tool, you can better manage your health needs and communicate with your health care team.

source_blocks.source_text_en: With VA Blue Button, you can:
source_blocks.text: With VA Blue Button, you can:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download a customized Blue Button report with information from your VA medical records, personal health record, and in some cases your military service record Download a Health Summary that includes specific information from your VA medical record (like your known allergies, medications, and recent lab results) Build your own personal health record that includes information like your self-entered medical history, emergency contacts, and medicines Monitor your vital signs and track your diet and exercise with our online journals Share a digital copy of the personal health information you entered yourself with your VA health care team through Secure Messaging

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once I m signed in, how do I get to my medical records?
source_blocks.text: Once I m signed in, how do I get to my medical records?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to your Welcome page dashboard, and click on Health Records. You ll go to a new page.
source_blocks.text: Go to your Welcome page dashboard, and click on Health Records. You ll go to a new page.

source_blocks.source_text_en: From here, you can choose to access your VA Blue Button report, your VA Health Summary, or your VA Medical Images and Reports.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you d like to add information to your personal health record, click on Track Health in the blue navigation menu at the top of the page. You ll go to a new page where you can choose to record information like your vital signs, health history, goals, and food and exercise efforts.

source_blocks.text: Will my personal health information be protected?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veterans Health Information Exchange
source_blocks.text: The Veterans Health Information Exchange

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), and how can it help me manage my health care?
source_blocks.text: What is the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), and how can it help me manage my health care?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE) program lets us share your health information with participating community care providers and the Department of Defense. For example, when you leave active-duty service, retire, or leave the Reserves and then get health care at VA or a VA-approved community care provider, your health record would electronically follow you.
source_blocks.text: The Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE) program lets us share your health information with participating community care providers and the Department of Defense. For example, when you leave active-duty service, retire, or leave the Reserves and then get health care at VA or a VA-approved community care provider, your health record would electronically follow you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: This program is voluntary, and you can choose not to share your information. If you choose not to share your information but change your mind later, you can opt back in to sharing your information at any time.
source_blocks.text: This program is voluntary, and you can choose not to share your information. If you choose not to share your information but change your mind later, you can opt back in to sharing your information at any time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: The sharing of health information:
source_blocks.text: The sharing of health information:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Helps your VA and non-VA providers better coordinate your care. Keeps your personal health information more secure. Improves your care by helping your providers make more informed decisions. Ensures your providers have up-to-date information, like your current medications and allergies. Saves you time and money.
source_blocks.text: Helps your VA and non-VA providers better coordinate your care. Keeps your personal health information more secure. Improves your care by helping your providers make more informed decisions. Ensures your providers have up-to-date information, like your current medications and allergies. Saves you time and money.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I opt out of sharing my information?
source_blocks.text: Can I opt out of sharing my information?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can opt out of sharing by mail or in person.
source_blocks.text: Yes. You can opt out of sharing by mail or in person.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To opt out by mail

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out, sign, and date VA Form 10-10164 (Opt Out of Sharing Protected Health Information).

source_blocks.text: GI法案资格 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill and other education benefit eligibility
source_blocks.text: GI法案及其他教育福利资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about GI Bill eligibility requirements and find out if you can get these benefits. VA education benefits can help you pay your tuition, pick out a school, choose a career, and more. If you re an active-duty service member or Veteran, a member of the National Guard or Reserves, or a qualified survivor or dependent, find out if you can get VA education benefits through the GI Bill and other educational assistance programs.
source_blocks.text: 了解GI法案资格要求，并查明您是否有资格获得这些福利。VA教育福利可以帮助您支付学费、选择学校、规划职业等。如果您是现役军人或退伍军人、国民警卫队或预备役成员，或是符合条件的遗属或家属，请了解您是否可以通过GI法案及其他教育援助计划获得VA教育福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA education benefits through the Post-9/11 GI Bill?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过9/11后退伍军人GI法案获得VA教育福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get benefits through the Post-9/11 GI Bill if you ve served on active duty for at least 90 days, whether continuous (all at once) or interrupted (for shorter periods over time), after September 10, 2001. Learn more about the Post-9/11 GI Bill
source_blocks.text: 如果您在2001年9月10日之后服役至少90天，无论是连续服役（一次性）还是间断服役（分阶段累计），您可能有资格通过9/11后退伍军人GI法案获得福利。了解更多关于9/11后退伍军人GI法案的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA education benefits through the Montgomery GI Bill?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过蒙哥马利GI法案获得VA教育福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for benefits through one of our 2 Montgomery GI Bill programs.
source_blocks.text: 您可能有资格通过我们的两个蒙哥马利GI法案计划之一获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD)
source_blocks.text: 蒙哥马利GI法案现役（MGIB-AD）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get benefits through MGIB-AD if you served at least 2 years on active duty and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在现役服役至少2年，并满足以下所有要求，您可以通过MGIB-AD获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须满足。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Were honorably discharged, and Have a high school diploma, GED, or 12 hours of college credit, and Meet other requirements
source_blocks.text: 已光荣退役，且 拥有高中文凭、GED或12个大学学分，且 满足其他要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about MGIB-AD
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于MGIB-AD的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve (MGIB-SR)
source_blocks.text: 蒙哥马利GI法案精选预备役（MGIB-SR）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get benefits through MGIB-SR if you re a member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps or Coast Guard Reserves, Army National Guard, or Air National Guard, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队或海岸警卫队预备役、陆军国民警卫队或空军国民警卫队的成员，并满足以下所有要求，您可以通过MGIB-SR获得福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须满足。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have either a 6-year service obligation (you agreed to serve 6 years) in the Selected Service, or Are an officer in the Selected Reserve who agreed to serve 6 years in addition to your initial service obligation, and Meet other requirements
source_blocks.text: 在精选服役中拥有6年服役义务（您同意服役6年），或 是精选预备役军官，同意在初始服役义务之外再服役6年，且 满足其他要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about MGIB-SR
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于MGIB-SR的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA education benefits through other programs?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过其他计划获得VA教育福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get help paying for school tuition, testing fees, and advanced licensing and certifications through other VA educational assistance programs. You may also be able to get entrepreneurship training to help start or improve a small business.
source_blocks.text: 您或许可以通过其他VA教育援助项目获得学费、考试费用以及高级执照和认证方面的帮助。您也可能获得创业培训，以帮助创办或改善小型企业。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about advanced training and certifications
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于高级培训和认证的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about other educational assistance programs
source_blocks.text: 了解其他教育援助项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get Educational and Career Counseling through VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过VA获得教育和职业咨询？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get Educational and Career Counseling (also called Chapter 36) if you ll be discharged from active duty within 6 months. You may also qualify for these services if you separated from active duty not more than 1 year ago, didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, and qualify as a Veteran for educational assistance under a VA educational program. Learn more about Educational and Career Counseling
source_blocks.text: 如果您将在6个月内从现役退役，您或许可以获得教育和职业咨询（也称为第36章）。如果您在不超过1年前从现役退役，未受到不名誉退役处分，并且符合VA教育项目下作为退伍军人的教育援助资格，您也可能有资格获得这些服务。了解更多关于教育和职业咨询的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there any related benefits I may also be able to get?
source_blocks.text: 是否还有其他我可能也有资格获得的相关福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, you may be eligible for Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment benefits and services like help exploring employment options and getting more training if required.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与服务相关的残疾，限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，您可能有资格获得职业康复与就业福利和服务，例如帮助探索就业选择以及在需要时获得更多培训。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for Vocational Rehab and Employment
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合职业康复与就业的资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?
source_blocks.text: 如果我收到了非荣誉退役、行为不良退役或不名誉退役，我该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到了这些退役状态之一，您可能没有资格获得VA福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:
source_blocks.text: 有2种方式您可以尝试获得资格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgrade Learn about the VA Character of Discharge review process
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请退役升级 了解VA退役性质审查流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can my spouse or dependent children get VA education benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我的配偶或受抚养子女能否获得VA教育福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: In some cases, the dependent or surviving spouse and children of a Veteran can get educational assistance through a GI Bill program. Learn more about Survivors and Dependents Assistance
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，退伍军人的受抚养或遗属配偶和子女可以通过《退伍军人权利法案》项目获得教育援助。了解更多关于遗属和受抚养人援助的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Also, if you haven t used all of your Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, you may be able to transfer up to 36 months of benefits to your spouse or a dependent child. Learn more about transferring benefits
source_blocks.text: 此外，如果您尚未使用完所有《9/11后退伍军人权利法案》福利，您或许可以将最多36个月的福利转移给您的配偶或受抚养子女。了解更多关于转移福利的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, your dependent family members may be eligible for Educational and Career Counseling and other support through the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment program. Learn more about vocational rehab services for dependent family members
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与服务相关的残疾，限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，您的受抚养家庭成员可能有资格通过职业康复与就业项目获得教育和职业咨询及其他支持。了解更多关于为受抚养家庭成员提供的职业康复服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Checking your application status. Sorry, this is taking longer than expected.
source_blocks.text: 正在检查您的申请状态。抱歉，这比预期花费的时间更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re sorry. Something went wrong when we tried to load your saved application.Please try refreshing your browser in a few minutes.
source_blocks.text: 我们很抱歉。在尝试加载您保存的申请时出现了问题。请几分钟后尝试刷新您的浏览器。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how to apply for education benefits
source_blocks.text: 详细了解如何申请教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: To apply for Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment or educational and career counseling benefits and services, you ll need to use a different application.
source_blocks.text: 注意：要申请职业康复与就业或教育与职业咨询福利和服务，您需要使用不同的申请表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for Vocational Rehab and EmploymentLearn more about Educational and Career Counseling
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请职业康复与就业，详细了解教育与职业咨询

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: GI法案 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: About GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 关于GI法案福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill benefits help you pay for college, graduate school, and training programs. Since 1944, the GI Bill has helped qualifying Veterans and their family members get money to cover all or some of the costs for school or training. Learn more about GI Bill benefits below and how to apply for them.
source_blocks.text: GI法案福利帮助您支付大学、研究生院和培训项目的费用。自1944年以来，GI法案帮助符合条件的退伍军人及其家庭成员获得资金，以覆盖部分或全部学校或培训费用。请在下方了解更多关于GI法案福利的信息以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you applied for and were awarded Post-9/11 GI Bill education benefits, your GI Bill Statement of Benefits will show you how much of your benefits you ve used and how much you have left to use. View your GI Bill Statement of Benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已申请并被授予了9/11后退伍军人法案教育福利，您的GI法案福利声明将显示您已使用了多少福利以及还剩多少可用。查看您的GI法案福利声明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The GI Bill Comparison Tool and Veterans Service Organizations can help you explore options and find out what benefits you can get. Find a Veterans service organization.
source_blocks.text: GI法案比较工具和退伍军人服务组织可以帮助您探索选项，并了解您可以获得哪些福利。查找退伍军人服务组织。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool Apply for education benefits
source_blocks.text: 使用GI法案比较工具 申请教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 9/11后退伍军人法案福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Post-9/11 GI Bill
source_blocks.text: 9/11后退伍军人法案

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help paying for school or job training and you ve served on active duty after September 10, 2001, find out if you can get education benefits through the Post-9/11 GI Bill.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要帮助支付学校或职业培训费用，并且您在2001年9月10日之后服役于现役，请了解您是否可以通过9/11后退伍军人法案获得教育福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transfer your Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits to your spouse and dependents
source_blocks.text: 将您的9/11后退伍军人法案福利转移给您的配偶和家属

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have unused Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, find out if you can transfer your benefits to your spouse or dependent children.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有未使用的9/11后退伍军人法案福利，请了解您是否可以将您的福利转移给您的配偶或受抚养子女。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefit rates and ways you can use your benefits
source_blocks.text: 福利费率和您可以使用福利的方式

source_blocks.source_text_en: Rates
source_blocks.text: 费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about education benefit rates for tuition and books for qualifying Veterans and their family members.
source_blocks.text: 了解符合条件的退伍军人及其家庭成员在学费和书本费方面的教育福利费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Foreign programs
source_blocks.text: 外国项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you plan to study at a foreign school, find out how you can use VA benefits to cover your tuition and fees.
source_blocks.text: 如果你计划在国外学校学习，了解如何利用VA福利来支付你的学费和杂费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Undergraduate and graduate degrees from institutions of higher learning
source_blocks.text: 高等院校的本科和研究生学位

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re looking to earn an undergraduate or graduate degree, find out if you can get VA benefits to help pay for courses.
source_blocks.text: 如果你想获得本科或研究生学位，了解你是否可以获得VA福利来帮助支付课程费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other GI Bill programs you may qualify for
source_blocks.text: 你可能符合资格的其他GI法案项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD)
source_blocks.text: 蒙哥马利GI法案现役（MGIB-AD）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served at least 2 years on active duty, find out if you qualify for benefits under the Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty program.
source_blocks.text: 如果你在现役服役至少2年，了解你是否符合蒙哥马利GI法案现役项目的福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve (MGIB-SR)
source_blocks.text: 蒙哥马利GI法案精选预备役（MGIB-SR）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps or Coast Guard Reserve, Army National Guard, or Air National Guard, find out if you qualify for education benefits under the Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve program.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队或海岸警卫队预备役、陆军国民警卫队或空军国民警卫队的成员，了解你是否符合蒙哥马利GI法案精选预备役项目的教育福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Survivors and dependents assistance
source_blocks.text: 幸存者和家属援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a dependent spouse or child of a Veteran, find out if you qualify for education benefits or job training.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是退伍军人的受抚养配偶或子女，了解你是否符合教育福利或职业培训的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More GI Bill benefits and information
source_blocks.text: 更多GI法案福利和信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yellow Ribbon Program
source_blocks.text: 黄丝带项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if your school participates in the Yellow Ribbon Program, which can help pay tuition costs that the Post-9/11 GI Bill doesn t cover.
source_blocks.text: 了解您的学校是否参与黄丝带计划，该计划可以帮助支付后9/11 GI法案未涵盖的学费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tuition Assistance Top-Up
source_blocks.text: 学费补助补足

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your college tuition costs more than what s covered by the Tuition Assistance program, find out if you can get more money to cover tuition costs.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的大学学费超过学费补助计划所涵盖的金额，请了解您是否可以获得更多资金来支付学费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: \$600 Buy-Up program
source_blocks.text: \$600 买断计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how you can get more money each month through your GI Bill monthly payments.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何通过GI法案每月付款获得更多资金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tutorial assistance
source_blocks.text: 辅导援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re using VA educational benefits and you're struggling with the coursework, find out if you can get help paying for a tutor.
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在使用VA教育福利并且在课程学习上遇到困难，请了解您是否可以获得帮助支付辅导费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill School Feedback Tool
source_blocks.text: GI法案学校反馈工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any concerns about your GI Bill school, you can submit them to us through our GI Bill School Feedback Tool. Find out how to submit feedback about your school.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对您的GI法案学校有任何疑虑，您可以通过我们的GI法案学校反馈工具提交给我们。了解如何提交关于您学校的反馈。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Opt out of sharing VA education benefits information
source_blocks.text: 选择不共享VA教育福利信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Harry W. Colmery Veterans Educational Assistance Act (also called the Forever GI Bill ) requires us to share certain information about your eligibility and benefits with schools, unless you ask us not to. Find out how to opt out of information sharing.
source_blocks.text: 《哈里·W·科尔默里退伍军人教育援助法案》（也称为《永久GI法案》）要求我们与学校共享有关您资格和福利的某些信息，除非您要求我们不这样做。了解如何选择不共享信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health needs and conditions
source_blocks.text: Health needs and conditions

source_blocks.source_text_en: At VA, we offer many services and programs for Veterans with specific needs like women Veterans, Veterans with mental health problems, and elderly or disabled Veterans. We cover the cost of many of these services under the VA health care program. You may be able to get help paying for other services like dental care if you qualify for them as an added benefit. Find out how to access services for your specific needs.
source_blocks.text: At VA, we offer many services and programs for Veterans with specific needs like women Veterans, Veterans with mental health problems, and elderly or disabled Veterans. We cover the cost of many of these services under the VA health care program. You may be able to get help paying for other services like dental care if you qualify for them as an added benefit. source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there any health concerns I should be aware of based on my service history?

source_blocks.source_text_en: How To Apply For A VA Home Loan COE | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 如何申请VA住房贷款COE | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply for a VA home loan Certificate of Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 如何申请VA住房贷款资格证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to apply for a VA home loan Certificate of Eligibility (COE). This is the first step in getting a VA direct or VA-backed home loan. It confirms for your lender that you qualify for the VA home loan benefit. Then, choose your loan type and learn about the rest of the loan application process.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请VA住房贷款资格证明（COE）。这是获得VA直接或VA支持住房贷款的第一步。它向您的贷款机构确认您有资格享受VA住房贷款福利。然后，选择您的贷款类型并了解贷款申请流程的其余部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I prepare before starting my application?
source_blocks.text: 在开始申请之前，我该如何准备？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Gather the information you ll need to apply for your COE. Click on the description below that matches you best to find out what you ll need:
source_blocks.text: 收集申请COE所需的信息。请点击下面最符合您情况的描述，了解您需要准备什么：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran, you ll need a copy of your discharge or separation papers (DD214).
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人，您需要一份您的退伍或退役文件（DD214）的副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re an active-duty Servicemember, you ll need:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是现役军人，您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A statement of service signed by your commander, adjutant, or personnel officer showing this information: - Your full name - Your Social Security number - Your date of birth - The date you entered duty - The duration of any lost time - The name of the command providing the information
source_blocks.text: 一份由您的指挥官、副官或人事官员签署的服役证明，显示以下信息： - 您的全名 - 您的社会安全号码 - 您的出生日期 - 您入伍的日期 - 任何损失时间的时长 - 提供信息的指挥单位名称

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a current or former activated National Guard or Reserve member, you ll need a copy of your discharge or separation papers (DD214).
source_blocks.text: 如果您是当前或曾经的现役国民警卫队或预备役成员，您需要一份您的退伍或退役文件（DD214）的副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a current member of the National Guard or Reserves, and have never been activated, you ll need:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是国民警卫队或预备役的现任成员，且从未被激活，您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A statement of service signed by your commander, adjutant, or personnel officer showing this information: - Your full name - Your Social Security number - Your date of birth - The date you entered duty - Your total number of creditable years of service - The duration of any lost time - The name of the command providing the information
source_blocks.text: 一份由您的指挥官、副官或人事官员签署的服役证明，显示以下信息： - 您的全名 - 您的社会安全号码 - 您的出生日期 - 您入伍的日期 - 您的总可计入服役年限 - 任何损失时间的时长 - 提供信息的指挥单位名称

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a discharged member of the National Guard and were never activated, you ll need:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是已退役的国民警卫队成员且从未被激活，您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Report of Separation and Record of Service (NGB Form 22) for each period of National Guard service, and - Your Retirement Points Statement (NGB Form 23) and proof of the character of service
source_blocks.text: 您每段国民警卫队服役期的《服役分离与服役记录报告》（NGB表格22），以及 - 您的《退休积分报表》（NGB表格23）和服役性质的证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a discharged member of the Reserves and were never activated, you ll need:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是已退役的预备役成员且从未被激活，您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A copy of your latest annual retirement points, and - Proof of your honorable service
source_blocks.text: 您最新的年度退休积分副本，以及 - 您的光荣服役证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a COE as a surviving spouse
source_blocks.text: 了解作为未亡配偶如何申请COE

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for my VA home loan Certificate of Eligibility?
source_blocks.text: 我如何申请我的VA住房贷款资格证明？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online right now.
source_blocks.text: 您现在就可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also apply:
source_blocks.text: 您也可以申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Through our Web LGY system
source_blocks.text: 通过我们的Web LGY系统

source_blocks.source_text_en: In some cases, you can get your COE through your lender using our Web LGY system. Ask your lender about this option.
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，您可以通过我们的Web LGY系统从您的贷款机构获得COE。请向您的贷款机构咨询此选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply by mail, fill out a Request for a Certificate of Eligibility (VA Form 26-1880) and mail it to the address listed on the form. Please keep in mind that this may take longer than applying online or through our Web LGY system. Download VA Form 26-1880.
source_blocks.text: 要通过邮寄申请，请填写《资格证明申请表》（VA表格26-1880）并邮寄至表格上所列地址。请注意，这可能比在线申请或通过我们的Web LGY系统申请耗时更长。下载VA表格26-1880。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Next steps for getting a VA direct or VA-backed home loan
source_blocks.text: 获得VA直接或VA担保住房贷款的后续步骤

source_blocks.source_text_en: Applying for your COE is only one part of the process for getting a VA direct or VA-backed home loan. Your next steps will depend on the type of loan you re looking to get and on your lender. For most loans, the lender will be a private bank or mortgage company. For the Native American Direct Loan, we ll be your lender.
source_blocks.text: 申请您的COE只是获得VA直接或VA担保住房贷款过程的一部分。您的后续步骤将取决于您想要获得的贷款类型以及您的贷款机构。对于大多数贷款，贷款机构将是私人银行或抵押贷款公司。对于美洲原住民直接贷款，我们将是您的贷款机构。

source_blocks.text: 如何申请退伍军人身份证 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply for a Veteran ID Card
source_blocks.text: 如何申请退伍军人身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veteran ID Card (VIC) is a form of photo ID you can use to get discounts offered to Veterans at many restaurants, hotels, stores, and other businesses. Find out if you re eligible for a Veteran ID Card and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人身份证（VIC）是一种带照片的身份证件，您可以用它来享受许多餐厅、酒店、商店和其他企业向退伍军人提供的折扣。了解您是否有资格获得退伍军人身份证以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for a Veteran ID Card?
source_blocks.text: 我有资格获得退伍军人身份证吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两项要求，您可能有资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须都属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Served on active duty, in the Reserves, or in the National Guard (including the Coast Guard), and Received an honorable or general discharge (under honorable conditions)
source_blocks.text: 曾在现役、预备役或国民警卫队（包括海岸警卫队）服役，并且 获得荣誉退伍或一般退伍（在荣誉条件下）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable character of discharge, you re not eligible for a Veteran ID Card. If you have an uncharacterized or unknown discharge status, we ll have to verify your eligibility before we approve your application.
source_blocks.text: 如果您获得的退伍性质为不荣誉、行为不良或品行不端，则您没有资格获得退伍军人身份证。如果您的退伍状态未定性或未知，我们需要在批准您的申请前核实您的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to provide a copy of your discharge papers when you apply for a VIC to prove your character of discharge.
source_blocks.text: 申请VIC时，您需要提供退伍文件的副本，以证明您的退伍性质。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: Retail vendors volunteer to take part in this discount program. If a business decides to provide discounts to Veterans, it doesn t mean that we re recommending or favoring that business.
source_blocks.text: 请注意：零售商家自愿参与此折扣计划。如果企业决定向退伍军人提供折扣，这并不意味着我们推荐或偏袒该企业。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for a Veteran ID Card?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请退伍军人身份证？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online now.
source_blocks.text: 您现在可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need this information
source_blocks.text: 您需要以下信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you apply, be sure to have these on hand:
source_blocks.text: 申请时，请确保手头有以下材料：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Social Security number A digital copy of your DD214, DD256, DD257, or NGB22 that you can upload. This could be in a .pdf, .jpeg, or .png file format. A copy of a current and valid government-issued ID, such as a driver s license, passport, or state-issued identification card.
source_blocks.text: 您的社会安全号码 可上传的DD214、DD256、DD257或NGB22的数字副本。文件格式可为.pdf、.jpeg或.png。 当前有效的政府签发身份证件副本，如驾照、护照或州签发的身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need a digital color photo of yourself from the shoulders up. The photo should follow all these standards:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要一张从肩膀以上拍摄的数码彩色照片。照片应符合以下所有标准：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Show a full front view of your face and neck (with no hat, head covering, or headphones covering or casting shadows on your hairline or face), and Be cropped from your shoulders up (much like a passport photo), and Show you with your eyes open and a neutral expression, and Be taken in clothing you d wear for a driver s license photo, and Be a square size and have a white or plain-color background (with no scenery or other people in the photo), and Show what you look like now (a photo taken sometime in the last 10 years), and Be uploaded as a .jpeg, .png, .bmp, or .tiff file
source_blocks.text: 显示您面部和颈部的全正面视图（不得戴帽子、头巾或耳机遮挡或投射阴影在您的发际线或面部），并且 从肩膀以上裁剪（很像护照照片），并且 显示您睁着眼睛，表情自然，并且 穿着适合驾照照片的服装拍摄，并且 为正方形尺寸，背景为白色或纯色（照片中不得有风景或其他人物），并且 显示您现在的样子（在过去10年内拍摄的照片），并且 以.jpeg、.png、.bmp或.tiff文件格式上传

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I apply for a Veteran ID Card?
source_blocks.text: 申请退伍军人身份证后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you ve submitted your VIC application, we ll check your eligibility and verify that:
source_blocks.text: 提交VIC申请后，我们将检查您的资格并核实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your character of discharge meets eligibility requirements, and The ID you submitted (driver s license or passport) is valid, and The image you ve chosen to appear on the card meets the photo requirements
source_blocks.text: 您的退役性质是否符合资格要求，以及 您提交的身份证件（驾照或护照）是否有效，以及 您选择印在卡上的照片是否符合照片要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: After we ve verified your eligibility, we ll send you an email letting you know the status of your application. If you have an unknown or uncharacterized discharge status, your application will take more time to process while we verify your eligibility. (We may need to request your records from the National Personnel Records Center.)
source_blocks.text: 核实您的资格后，我们会向您发送电子邮件，告知申请状态。如果您的退役状态未知或未明确，处理申请将需要更多时间，以便我们核实您的资格。（我们可能需要向国家人事记录中心调取您的记录。）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you receive an email from us asking for additional information or evidence to process your application, you ll need to sign in to AccessVA and update your application with the information we ask for.
source_blocks.text: 如果您收到我们要求提供额外信息或证据以处理申请的电子邮件，您需要登录AccessVA并按照我们要求的信息更新您的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check the status of your application after you apply
source_blocks.text: 申请后查看申请状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can sign in to your AccessVA account to check the status of your VIC application.Sign in to your AccessVA account
source_blocks.text: 您可以登录AccessVA账户查看VIC申请状态。登录您的AccessVA账户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replace your Veteran ID Card if it gets lost or stolen
source_blocks.text: 如果您的退伍军人身份证丢失或被盗，请申请补办

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request a new card, please send us an email. Email us at vic@va.gov
source_blocks.text: 如需申请新卡，请发送电子邮件至vic@va.gov联系我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help with your application
source_blocks.text: 申请帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any questions or need help, please send us an email. Email us at vic@va.gov
source_blocks.text: 如有任何疑问或需要帮助，请发送电子邮件至vic@va.gov联系我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how the Veteran ID Card works
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于退伍军人身份证的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Your Veteran ID Card won t replace your Veteran Health Identification Card or your Department of Defense ID Card.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。您的退伍军人身份证不能替代您的退伍军人健康身份证或国防部身份证。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use any of these forms of ID to get the same discounts:
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用以下任何一种身份证件获得相同的折扣：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC), or - A Department of Defense (DoD) Identification Card either a Common Access Card (CAC) or Uniformed Services ID Card, or - A state-issued driver s license or ID with a Veterans designation Note: If you already have one of these, you don t need a Veteran ID Card, but you can still apply for it if you d like.
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人健康身份证（VHIC），或 - 国防部（DoD）身份证，包括通用访问卡（CAC）或军种身份证，或 - 州政府颁发的带有退伍军人标识的驾照或身份证 注意：如果您已拥有其中一种，则无需退伍军人身份证，但如果您愿意，仍可申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t use your Veteran ID Card to:
source_blocks.text: 您不能使用退伍军人身份证进行以下操作：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Prove your eligibility for any federal benefits, or - Access military bases or installations, or - Access military commissaries or exchanges, or - Present as a form of identification at the airport, or - Check into a VA hospital, or - Show as proof of retirement from the Armed Forces, or - Show as proof of wartime service to get a special license plate from the Department of Motor Vehicles

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I m a service member who hasn t yet received a service-connected disability rating?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to wait for a rating. Instead, please fill out VA Vocational Rehabilitation - Getting Ahead After You Get Out (VA Form 28-0588). Download VA Form 28-0588 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: You don t need to wait for a rating. Instead, please fill out VA Vocational Rehabilitation - Getting Ahead After You Get Out (VA Form 28-0588). Download VA Form 28-0588 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for VR&E benefits and services if you re in at least one of the below situations.
source_blocks.text: You may be eligible for VR&E benefits and services if you re in at least one of the below situations.

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: At least one of these must be true. You re:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Going through the Physical Evaluation Board process, or Expecting an other than dishonorable discharge and have a VA memorandum rating of 20% or more, or Entered in the Integrated Disability Evaluation System (IDES). Learn more about accessing VR&E services through IDES
source_blocks.text: Going through the Physical Evaluation Board process, or Expecting an other than dishonorable discharge and have a VA memorandum rating of 20% or more, or Entered in the Integrated Disability Evaluation System (IDES). Learn more about accessing VR&E services through IDES

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: Severely injured active-duty service members can automatically receive VR&E benefits before VA issues a disability rating, because of Sec. 1631(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act (PL 110-181). The sunset date of that law has been extended to September 30, 2018, through Sec. 724 of Public Law 113-291.
source_blocks.text: Please note: Severely injured active-duty service members can automatically receive VR&E benefits before VA issues a disability rating, because of Sec. 1631(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act (PL 110-181). The sunset date of that law has been extended to September 30, 2018, through Sec. 724 of Public Law 113-291.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I apply?
source_blocks.text: What happens after I apply?

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you apply, we ll schedule a meeting for you with a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) to find out if you have an employment handicap and if you re eligible for VR&E benefits and services. You have an employment handicap if your service-connected disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests).
source_blocks.text: After you apply, we ll schedule a meeting for you with a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) to find out if you have an employment handicap and if you re eligible for VR&E benefits and services. You have an employment handicap if your service-connected disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests).

source_blocks.source_text_en: After we make an entitlement decision, you and your counselor will work together to develop a rehabilitation plan. This plan outlines the rehabilitation and other services that VR&E will provide.
source_blocks.text: After we make an entitlement decision, you and your counselor will work together to develop a rehabilitation plan. This plan outlines the rehabilitation and other services that VR&E will provide.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also meet with VRCs called VetSuccess on Campus (VSOC) counselors at schools participating in the VetSuccess on Campus (VSOC) program.
source_blocks.text: You can also meet with VRCs called VetSuccess on Campus (VSOC) counselors at schools participating in the VetSuccess on Campus (VSOC) program.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VetSuccess on Campus
source_blocks.text: Learn more about VetSuccess on Campus

source_blocks.source_text_en: What s included in a rehabilitation plan?
source_blocks.text: What s included in a rehabilitation plan?

source_blocks.source_text_en: A rehabilitation plan is a written plan that outlines the resources we ll use to help you find employment. Depending on your situation, your VRC will work with you to choose one of the following support-and-services tracks to help you find and keep a job, and live as independently as possible:
source_blocks.text: A rehabilitation plan is a written plan that outlines the resources we ll use to help you find employment. Depending on your situation, your VRC will work with you to choose one of the following support-and-services tracks to help you find and keep a job, and live as independently as possible:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reemployment with a former employer Job placement and counseling services for new employment Help with starting your own business Long-term training or services to help you find work in a different field that better suits your abilities and interests Independent living services if you can t return to work right away
source_blocks.text: Reemployment with a former employer Job placement and counseling services for new employment Help with starting your own business Long-term training or services to help you find work in a different field that better suits your abilities and interests Independent living services if you can t return to work right away

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after my VRC creates my rehabilitation plan?
source_blocks.text: What happens after my VRC creates my rehabilitation plan?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your VRC will help you put your plan into action. They ll also provide ongoing counseling and help you get tutorial assistance, job training, work-readiness support, and medical referrals.
source_blocks.text: Your VRC will help you put your plan into action. They ll also provide ongoing counseling and help you get tutorial assistance, job training, work-readiness support, and medical referrals.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Did you spend time in a VA hospital or a VA-approved hospital for a disability related to your military service (called a service-connected disability)? If you did, you may be able to get added disability compensation or benefits with a temporary 100% disability rating for the time you spent in the hospital. Find out if you can get this benefit.
source_blocks.text: 你是否曾在VA医院或VA批准的医院因与兵役相关的伤残（称为service-connected disability）住院？如果是，你可能可以获得额外的伤残补偿或福利，在住院期间获得temporary 100% disability rating。了解你是否能获得此福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能从VA获得伤残福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if one of the situations below describes your experience.
source_blocks.text: 如果以下情况之一描述了你的经历，你可能可以获得伤残福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You spent more than 21 days in a VA hospital or other approved hospital for a service-connected disability, or You were under hospital observation for more than 21 days at our expense for a service-connected disability
source_blocks.text: 你因service-connected disability在VA医院或其他批准的医院住院超过21天，或 你因service-connected disability在我们承担费用的情况下接受医院观察超过21天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁符合条件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of disability benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得什么样的伤残福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Increased compensation (payments) for the time you spent in the hospital
source_blocks.text: Health care 住院期间的increased compensation（付款）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 你需要提交伤残补偿申请。了解如何提交伤残补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you weren t in a VA hospital, when filing your claim you ll need to give us your hospital discharge summary showing the length and cause of your hospital stay.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果你不在VA医院，提交申请时需提供医院出院摘要，显示住院时长和原因。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Example: A Veteran with a 40% service-connected disability rating for diabetes had to stay in a VA hospital after going into a diabetic coma. He needed to stay in the hospital for 25 days because of the coma and related infections. We raised his rating to 100% during his hospital stay. After he got out of the hospital, his disability rating went back to 40%.
source_blocks.text: 示例：一位因糖尿病获得40% service-connected disability rating的Veteran，在糖尿病昏迷后不得不住进VA医院。由于昏迷及相关感染，他需要住院25天。我们在其住院期间将其评级提高至100%。出院后，其伤残评级恢复为40%。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add new and relevant evidence

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that supports your case or identifying evidence for review. A reviewer will determine whether the new evidence changes the decision. Learn how to file a Supplemental Claim
source_blocks.text: When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that supports your case or identifying evidence for review. A reviewer will determine whether the new evidence changes the decision. Learn how to file a Supplemental Claim

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must add evidence that VA didn t have before that supports your case.

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose to request a Higher-Level Review, you re asking for another review of the same evidence. source_blocks.source_text_en: Ionizing radiation exposure
source_blocks.text: 电离辐射暴露

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you can get disability compensation or benefits for illnesses including some cancers believed to be caused by contact with radiation during military service.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得因军事服役期间接触辐射而引发的疾病（包括某些癌症）的残疾补偿或福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if you didn t receive a dishonorable discharge and you meet the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有不名誉退伍，并且满足以下列出的要求，您可能可以获得残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两点必须同时满足：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have an illness that s on our list of illnesses believed to be caused by radiation or that doctors say may be caused by radiation, and Your illness started within a certain period of time (as shown along with the list of illnesses)
source_blocks.text: 您患有我们列出的被认为由辐射引起的疾病，或医生认为可能由辐射引起的疾病，并且 您的疾病在特定时间内开始（如疾病列表所示）

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the list of radiation-related illnesses
source_blocks.text: 查看与辐射相关的疾病列表

source_blocks.source_text_en: And you must have had contact with ionizing radiation in one of these ways while serving in the military. You:
source_blocks.text: 并且您在军队服役期间必须以下列方式之一接触过电离辐射。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Were part of atmospheric nuclear weapons testing, or Served in the postwar occupation of Hiroshima or Nagasaki, or Were a prisoner of war (POW) in Japan, or Worked as an x-ray technician, in a reactor plant, or in nuclear medicine or radiography (while on active duty or during active or inactive duty for training in the Reserves), or Did tasks like those of a Department of Energy (DOE) employee that make them a member of the Special Exposure Cohort (See 42 U.S.C. 7384L(14))
source_blocks.text: 参与了大气层核武器试验，或 在广岛或长崎战后占领期间服役，或 曾是日本的战俘（POW），或 担任X光技师、在反应堆工厂工作，或从事核医学或放射摄影工作（在现役期间或在预备役训练期间），或 执行了类似于能源部（DOE）员工的任务，使其成为特殊暴露队列（Special Exposure Cohort）成员（参见 42 U.S.C. 7384L(14)）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also qualify for disability benefits if you served in at least one of the below locations and capacities. You were:
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在以下至少一个地点和身份服役，您也可能有资格获得残疾福利。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Part of underground nuclear weapons testing at Amchitka Island, Alaska, or Assigned to a gaseous diffusion plant at Paducah, Kentucky, or Assigned to a gaseous diffusion plant at Portsmouth, Ohio, or Assigned to a gaseous diffusion plant at Area K-25 at Oak Ridge, Tennessee
source_blocks.text: 参与了阿拉斯加阿姆奇特卡岛的地下核武器试验，或 被分配到肯塔基州帕迪尤卡的气体扩散工厂，或 被分配到俄亥俄州朴茨茅斯的气体扩散工厂，或 被分配到田纳西州橡树岭K-25区域的气体扩散工厂

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁有资格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of disability benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得哪些残疾福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Compensation (payments)
source_blocks.text: 医疗保健 补偿（付款）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation and provide the evidence (supporting documents) listed below:
source_blocks.text: 您需要提交残疾补偿申请，并提供以下列出的证据（支持文件）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical records showing that you ve been diagnosed with one of the illnesses on our list of those believed to be caused by radiation or that your doctor states may be caused by radiation exposure, and Service records showing that you were part of one of the radiation risk activities described above
source_blocks.text: 医疗记录，显示您已被诊断患有我们列表中认为由辐射引起的疾病之一，或者您的医生声明这些疾病可能是由辐射暴露引起的，以及 服役记录，显示您参与了上述描述的辐射风险活动之一

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: When you file your claim, we ll ask the military branch that you served with (or the Defense Threat Reduction Agency) to give us a range of how much radiation they think you may have come into contact with. We ll use the highest level of the range they report to decide on your benefits.
source_blocks.text: 注意：当您提交索赔时，我们会要求您服役的军种（或国防威胁降低局）提供他们认为您可能接触到的辐射剂量范围。我们将使用他们报告的最高水平来决定您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Military sexual trauma (MST)
source_blocks.text: Military sexual trauma (MST)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Military sexual trauma (MST) refers to sexual assault or repeated, threatening sexual harassment that happened while a Veteran was in the military. This can happen to both women and men. If you were involved in any sexual act against your will during your time in the military, you may have experienced MST. Find out how to access our free services that can help you recover.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?

source_blocks.source_text_en: What services does VA provide for Veterans who ve experienced MST?
source_blocks.text: What services does VA provide for Veterans who ve experienced MST?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We provide free, confidential (private) counseling and treatment to male and female Veterans for both mental and physical health problems linked to MST.
source_blocks.text: We provide free, confidential (private) counseling and treatment to male and female Veterans for both mental and physical health problems linked to MST.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our services include:
source_blocks.text: Our services include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: MST-related treatment and support at every VA medical center, and providers knowledgeable about treating the aftereffects of MST at each facility Specialized outpatient mental health services focused on sexual trauma at many VA locations Counseling with professionals who are specially trained to treat conditions related to sexual trauma at Vet Centers across the country Specialized MST treatment in a residential (live-in) or inpatient setting including gender-specific programs for Veterans who need more intensive care Treatment and support for health conditions linked to MST, like: - Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) - Depression - Substance use problems

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access VA services for MST?
source_blocks.text: How do I access VA services for MST?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran who has experienced MST, you can get help through VA. You don t need to have a service-connected disability rating, and you may be able to get MST-related care even if you don t qualify for other VA services. You also don t need to have reported the MST or have other proof that it happened.
source_blocks.text: If you re a Veteran who has experienced MST, you can get help through VA. You don t need to have a service-connected disability rating, and you may be able to get MST-related care even if you don t qualify for other VA services. source_blocks.source_text_en: Here s how to access VA services for MST:
source_blocks.text: Here s how to access VA services for MST:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA primary care provider, talk to that professional about what you ve been through. All our primary care providers are trained in MST and can help you figure out if you have related issues, like PTSD or depression. Your provider will offer treatment and support as needed. If you don t have a VA primary care provider, call your nearest VA medical center and ask to speak to the MST coordinator. You should feel free to ask for a provider of a specific gender if that makes you feel more comfortable.Find a VA medical center near you If you d prefer to receive MST-related care outside of a medical setting, get free confidential counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless: - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential. - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. source_blocks.source_text_en: If you had contact with mustard gas (also known as sulfur mustard, yperite, or nitrogen mustard) or lewisite, a natural compound that contains the poison arsenic, you may have certain related long-term illnesses. Find out if you can get disability compensation or benefits.

source_blocks.text: 我能从退伍军人事务部获得残疾福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bari, Italy Camp Lejeune, NC Charleston, SC Great Lakes Naval Training Center, IL Hart s Island, NY Naval Training Center, Bainbridge, MD Naval Research Laboratory, VA Naval Research Laboratory, Washington, DC USS Eagle Boat 58

source_blocks.source_text_en: Some service members who took part in testing in these places:
source_blocks.text: 一些曾参与以下地点测试的服役人员：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Finschhafen, New Guinea Porton Down, England
source_blocks.text: 新几内亚芬什港 英格兰波顿当

source_blocks.source_text_en: Select merchant seamen were also exposed at Bari, Italy.
source_blocks.text: 部分商船海员也在意大利巴里暴露于这些物质。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of disability benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得哪种残疾福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Compensation (payments)
source_blocks.text: 医疗保健 补偿（付款）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation.
source_blocks.text: 您需要提交残疾补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have to claim an actual disease or disability. It s not enough to state that you were exposed to mustard gas or lewisite during service. You ll need to apply based on the illnesses believed to be caused by your contact with one of these chemicals. When you send in your claim, be sure to share any military records that show you had contact with blistering agents.
source_blocks.text: 您必须申报实际的疾病或残疾。仅说明您在服役期间接触过芥子气或路易氏剂是不够的。您需要根据据信因接触这些化学物质之一而导致的疾病来申请。提交申请时，请务必提供任何显示您接触过起疱剂的军事记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help filing my disability claim?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助提交残疾申请怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about benefits related to mustard gas exposure, you can contact us via email.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对与芥子气暴露相关的福利有疑问，您可以通过电子邮件联系我们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Email us at mustardgas@vba.va.gov
source_blocks.text: 发送电子邮件至 mustardgas@vba.va.gov

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also get help from a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以从受过培训、可信赖的专业人士那里获得帮助，他们可以协助处理与VA相关的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help filing your claim
source_blocks.text: 获取提交申请的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get benefits if I volunteered for research involving chemical and biological testing?
source_blocks.text: 如果我自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，我能获得福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: As many as 60,000 Veterans volunteered for medical research for the U.S. Biological and Chemical Programs. If you were involved in this research, you can get medical care through the U.S. Army if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 多达60,000名退伍军人自愿参加了美国生物和化学项目的医学研究。如果您参与了这项研究，如果您满足以下两项要求，您可以通过美国陆军获得医疗护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须均为真实情况。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Volunteered for research involving chemical and biological testing between 1942 and 1975, and Have an injury or disease directly caused by your participation in this testing
source_blocks.text: 在1942年至1975年间自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，并且 有直接由参与这些测试造成的伤害或疾病

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions or need help getting medical care:
source_blocks.text: 如果您有疑问或需要获得医疗护理的帮助：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the U.S. Army web page, or Call 800-984-8523
source_blocks.text: 访问美国陆军网页，或 致电800-984-8523

source_blocks.source_text_en: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 国家召唤服役计划 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: National Call to Service program
source_blocks.text: 国家召唤服役计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you performed a period of national service, you may qualify for the National Call to Service program, which allows you to choose an education benefit as an alternative to the Montgomery GI Bill (MGIB). Find out if you qualify.
source_blocks.text: 如果您完成了一段国家服役期，您可能有资格参加国家召唤服役计划，该计划允许您选择一项教育福利，作为蒙哥马利军人法案（MGIB）的替代方案。了解您是否符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for this benefit?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格享受此福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You qualify for the National Call to Service program if you meet the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下列出的要求，您就有资格参加国家召唤服役计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须均为属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You completed your initial entry training and then continued to serve on active duty for 15 months in a military occupational specialty designated by the Secretary of Defense, and
source_blocks.text: 您完成了初始入伍训练，随后在国防部长指定的军事职业专业中继续服役15个月，并且

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then, without a break in service, you served either an additional period of active duty as determined by the Secretary of Defense or a period of 24 months in active status in the Selected Reserve
source_blocks.text: 然后，在没有服役中断的情况下，您要么按照国防部长的决定再服役一段额外的现役期，要么在选定的预备役部队中保持现役状态24个月

source_blocks.source_text_en: And one of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下其中一项必须属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Without a break in service, you then spent the rest of your obligated service:
source_blocks.text: 在没有服役中断的情况下，您随后完成了剩余的服役义务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: On active duty in the Armed Forces, or In the Selected Reserve, or In the Individual Ready Reserve, or In AmeriCorps, or another domestic national service program jointly designated by the Secretary of Defense
source_blocks.text: 在武装部队中服现役，或 在选定预备役部队中服役，或 在个人待命预备役中服役，或 在美国志愿队或国防部长联合指定的其他国内国家服务计划中服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may choose one of these:
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择以下其中一项：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A cash bonus of \$5,000, or Repayment of a qualifying student loan not more than \$18,000, or Educational assistance equal to the 3-year monthly MGIB rate for 12 months, or Educational assistance equal to 50% of the less-than-3-year monthly MGIB rate for 36 months
source_blocks.text: 5,000美元的现金奖励，或 偿还符合条件的学贷，金额不超过18,000美元，或 相当于3年期月度MGIB标准12个月的教育援助，或 相当于不足3年期月度MGIB标准50%的36个月教育援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply online now
source_blocks.text: 立即在线申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you enlist under the National Call to Service program, you don t qualify for MGIB, unless you reenlist at a later date for an additional period of service. Contact your recruiter to see if you qualify and to enroll in the National Call to Service program. This benefit affects your service contract.
source_blocks.text: 如果您根据国家征召服役计划入伍，除非您日后重新入伍并额外服役一段时间，否则您不符合《蒙哥马利军人法案》（MGIB）的资格。请联系您的招募人员，了解您是否符合资格并注册国家征召服役计划。此福利会影响您的服役合同。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: National Call to Service program pamphlet (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 国家征召服役计划手册（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: This program is administered by VA for the Department of Defense.
source_blocks.text: 该计划由退伍军人事务部（VA）代表国防部管理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) helps you pay for school or job training. If you ve served on active duty after September 10, 2001, you may qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33). Find out if you can get this education benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can receive up to 36 months of benefits, including:
source_blocks.text: You can receive up to 36 months of benefits, including:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tuition and fees. If you qualify for the maximum benefit, we ll cover the full cost of public, in-state tuition and fees. We cap the rates for private and foreign schools, and update those rates each year. View current rates Money for housing (if you re in school more than half time). We ll base your monthly housing allowance on the cost of living where your school is located. Money for books and supplies. You can receive up to \$1,000 per school year. Money to help you move from a rural area to go to school. You may qualify for this one-time payment of \$500 if you live in a county with 6 or fewer people per square mile and you re either moving at least 500 miles to go to school or have no other option but to fly by plane to get to your school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Here s how we ll determine how much of the benefit you ll qualify for:
source_blocks.text: Here s how we ll determine how much of the benefit you ll qualify for:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The specific amount you ll receive will depend on how much active service you ve had since September 10, 2001. We ll calculate this amount based on a percentage of the maximum benefit.
source_blocks.text: The specific amount you ll receive will depend on how much active service you ve had since September 10, 2001. We ll calculate this amount based on a percentage of the maximum benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example: If you had 90 days of active service since September 10, 2001, you would qualify for 40% of the maximum amount. If you served for 3 years, you would qualify for 100% of the benefit. So if your school charges \$22,000 for in-state tuition and fees, you would receive \$8,800 if you had 90 days of active service and the full \$22,000 if you had 3 years of active service.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do these benefits expire?

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on when you were discharged from active duty.
source_blocks.text: This depends on when you were discharged from active duty.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service ended before January 1, 2013, your Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) benefits will expire 15 years after your last separation date from active service. You must use all of your benefits by that time or you ll lose whatever s left.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is the Location-Based Housing Allowance (Section 107)?
source_blocks.text: What is the Location-Based Housing Allowance (Section 107)?

source_blocks.source_text_en: What is Section 107 (Location-Based Housing Allowance)? Previously, GI Bill beneficiaries were paid Monthly Housing Allowance (MHA) based on the main or branch campus of the school they were enrolled. If a student attended classes at more than one location, they were paid the rate that was most advantageous.
source_blocks.text: What is Section 107 (Location-Based Housing Allowance)? Previously, GI Bill beneficiaries were paid Monthly Housing Allowance (MHA) based on the main or branch campus of the school they were enrolled. If a student attended classes at more than one location, they were paid the rate that was most advantageous.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Now, MHA is based on the campus location where the student physically attends the majority of their classes.

Extension campus: A location that is from the main or branch campus but is on that campus for the performance of administrative tasks.
