source_blocks.source_text_en: Pre-need eligibility for burial in a VA cemetery
source_blocks.text: 在VA公墓安葬的预先资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply to find out in advance if you can be buried in a VA national cemetery. This is called a pre-need determination of eligibility and it can help make the burial planning process easier for your family members in their time of need. Follow the steps below to apply.
source_blocks.text: 您可以申请提前了解自己是否可以在VA国家公墓安葬。这被称为预先资格认定，它可以帮助您的家人在需要时更轻松地安排葬礼。请按照以下步骤申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: Pre-need means before the time of need. This application is for planning for your own burial in advance. Please don t complete this form if you re requesting burial at the time of need.Find out how to schedule a burial
source_blocks.text: 请注意：预先是指在需要之前。此申请用于提前规划您自己的安葬事宜。如果您是在需要时请求安葬，请不要填写此表格。了解如何安排安葬

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I prepare before starting my application?
source_blocks.text: 在开始申请前，我该如何准备？

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Find out if you re eligible. One of these must describe you:
source_blocks.text: ### 了解您是否符合资格。您必须符合以下条件之一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veteran who didn t receive a dishonorable discharge when you separated from the military, or - The spouse or dependent child of a service member or Veteran, even if the service member or Veteran has already passed away, or - In some cases, the adult dependent child of a service member or Veteran (if you aren t married)
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人，且在离开军队时未受到不名誉退伍处分，或 - 军人或退伍军人的配偶或未成年子女，即使军人或退伍军人已经去世，或 - 在某些情况下，军人或退伍军人的成年受抚养子女（如果您未婚）

source_blocks.source_text_en: We base our decision of whether or not you qualify for burial in a VA national cemetery on your service history or the service history of the Veteran or service member who s sponsoring your application for burial as a spouse, surviving spouse, or unmarried adult child.Get more details about eligibility
source_blocks.text: 我们根据您的服役记录或作为配偶、未亡配偶或未婚成年子女赞助您安葬申请的退伍军人或军人的服役记录，来决定您是否有资格在VA国家公墓安葬。了解更多关于资格的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If a service member dies on active duty, they re eligible for burial without a pre-need decision letter.
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果军人在现役期间去世，他们无需预先资格认定信即可安葬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Choose the VA national cemetery where you d prefer to be buried.
source_blocks.text: ### 选择您希望安葬的VA国家公墓。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a VA national cemetery
source_blocks.text: 查找VA国家公墓

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note:
source_blocks.text: 请注意：

source_blocks.source_text_en: This application is only for VA national cemeteries. If you d like to be buried in a state or tribal Veterans cemetery, contact that specific cemetery ahead of time to find out about their pre-need program. Some state Veterans cemeteries require that you live in that state or have other rules around eligibility. You can apply for a pre-need determination of eligibility from VA and also from a state or tribal Veterans cemetery.Find a state Veterans cemetery
source_blocks.text: 此申请仅适用于VA国家公墓。如果您希望安葬在州或部落退伍军人公墓，请提前联系该公墓了解其预先计划。一些州退伍军人公墓要求您居住在该州或有其他资格规定。您可以向VA以及州或部落退伍军人公墓申请预先资格认定。查找州退伍军人公墓

source_blocks.source_text_en: This application doesn t apply to Arlington National Cemetery or the United States Soldiers and Airmen s Home National Cemetery. If you d like to be buried in either of these Department of the Army cemeteries, please call 877-907-8585. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET, and Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 此申请不适用于阿灵顿国家公墓或美国士兵和飞行员之家国家公墓。如果您希望安葬在这两个陆军部公墓之一，请致电877-907-8585。我们周一至周五上午8:00至下午5:30（东部时间）以及周六上午9:00至下午1:00（东部时间）提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Getting a pre-need determination of eligibility doesn t guarantee you ll be buried in a specific VA national cemetery. We don t take reservations at any VA national cemetery. However, we ask where you prefer to be buried so we can try to help fulfill your final wishes.
source_blocks.text: 获得预先资格认定并不保证您会安葬在特定的VA国家公墓。我们不接受任何VA国家公墓的预订。但是，我们会询问您希望安葬的地点，以便我们尽力帮助实现您的最终愿望。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Gather the supporting documents and information you ll need to fill out the application.
source_blocks.text: ### 收集填写申请所需的支持文件和信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please see the list below. If you don t have everything on the list, you can still apply and we ll help by finding the supporting documents we need. Just keep in mind that the more information you can give us when you apply, the faster we can review your application and give you a decision. We ll contact you if we need you to provide additional information.
source_blocks.text: 请参阅以下列表。如果您没有列表中的所有内容，您仍然可以申请，我们将帮助查找所需的支持文件。请记住，您在申请时提供的信息越多，我们就能越快审核您的申请并给您决定。如果需要您提供额外信息，我们会与您联系。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Be sure to fill out an application for each person requesting a pre-need eligibility determination.
source_blocks.text: ### 确保为每位请求预先资格认定的人填写一份申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If both you and your spouse are applying, you ll each need to fill out your own application.
source_blocks.text: 如果您和您的配偶都在申请，你们每个人都需要填写自己的申请表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What information do I need to apply?
source_blocks.text: 申请需要提供哪些信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply, you ll need your (or your sponsor s):
source_blocks.text: 申请时，您需要提供（或您的担保人的）：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Social Security number Date and place of birth Military status and service history (like service dates, discharge character, and rank commonly found on the DD214 or other separation documents) Discharge papers (DD214 or other separation documents)Note: If you don t have discharge papers, find out how to request the DD214.
source_blocks.text: 社会安全号码 出生日期和地点 兵役状况和服役历史（如服役日期、退伍性质、军衔，这些通常可在DD214或其他退役文件上找到） 退役文件（DD214或其他退役文件）注意：如果您没有退役文件，请了解如何申请DD214。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re applying as a spouse, surviving spouse, or unmarried adult child, you ll also need your personal information, including your Social Security number.
source_blocks.text: 如果您作为配偶、未再婚的遗孀或鳏夫，或未婚成年子女申请，您还需要提供您的个人信息，包括社会安全号码。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re applying on behalf of someone else, you ll also need supporting documents showing you have the authority to apply for that person. You ll need to fill out one of these forms:
source_blocks.text: 如果您代表他人申请，您还需要提供证明您有权为该人申请的支持性文件。您需要填写以下表格之一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appointment of Veterans Service Organization as Claimant s Representative (VA Form 21-22)Download VA Form 21-22 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 指定退伍军人服务组织为申请人代表（VA表格21-22）下载VA表格21-22（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or
source_blocks.text: 或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appointment of Individual as Claimant s Representative (VA Form 21-22a)Download VA Form 21-22a (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 指定个人为申请人代表（VA表格21-22a）下载VA表格21-22a（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re applying for an unmarried adult child of a Veteran or service member, you ll also need to provide supporting documents with information about the child s disability. The Veteran or guardian of the child should also ask the child s current doctor to verify the documents. These documents should include all of the following information:
source_blocks.text: 如果您为退伍军人或军人的未婚成年子女申请，您还需要提供包含该子女残疾信息的支持性文件。退伍军人或监护人还应请该子女的现任医生核实这些文件。这些文件应包括以下所有信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The date of the disability's onset, and A description of the disability, mental or physical, and A description of how dependent the disabled child is on the Veteran, and The marital status of the child
source_blocks.text: 残疾开始的日期，以及 对残疾（精神或身体）的描述，以及 对残疾子女依赖退伍军人程度的描述，以及 子女的婚姻状况

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online right now.
source_blocks.text: 您现在就可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for pre-need eligibility
source_blocks.text: 申请预先资格认定

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also apply:
source_blocks.text: 您也可以通过以下方式申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Application for Pre-need Determination of Eligibility for Burial in a VA National Cemetery (VA Form 40-10007).Download VA Form 40-10007 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写《申请预先确定在VA国家公墓安葬资格》（VA表格40-10007）。下载VA表格40-10007（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: The person applying for a pre-need determination must sign the form. If that person is under 18 years old, mentally unable to make decisions for themselves (sometimes called mentally incompetent), or physically unable to sign the form, a spouse, parent, or court-appointed representative may sign the form.
source_blocks.text: 申请预先资格认定的人必须在表格上签名。如果该人未满18岁、精神上无法为自己做决定（有时称为精神无行为能力），或身体上无法签署表格，则其配偶、父母或法院指定的代表可以代签。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re signing the form on behalf of someone else, you ll need to:
source_blocks.text: 如果您代他人签署此表格，您需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Select box 33B on the form and provide your name, address, phone number, and email address in blocks 34 through 37 Provide supporting documents that show why the person applying can t sign Provide supporting documents that show your relationship to the person applying
source_blocks.text: 在表格上勾选33B框，并在第34至37栏中提供您的姓名、地址、电话号码和电子邮件地址 提供支持文件，说明申请人为何无法签署 提供支持文件，证明您与申请人的关系

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send your completed application (with copies of your supporting documents) to:
source_blocks.text: 将您填好的申请（连同支持文件的副本）寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: National Cemetery Scheduling Office PO Box 510543 St. Louis, MO 63151
source_blocks.text: National Cemetery Scheduling Office PO Box 510543 St. Louis, MO 63151

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please don t send us the originals of your DD214 and other supporting documents since we can t return them. Send copies only.
source_blocks.text: 请不要寄送DD214及其他支持文件的原件，因为我们无法退还。请仅寄送副本。

source_blocks.source_text_en: By fax
source_blocks.text: 通过传真

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can fax your application to us at 855-840-8299.
source_blocks.text: 您可以将申请传真至 855-840-8299。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help filling out my application?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助填写申请怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call our toll-free hotline at 877-222-8387. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 请拨打我们的免费热线 877-222-8387。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上8:00提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help from a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims, like an accredited representative or Veterans Service Officer (VSO).Find a representativeFind your state s Veterans agency
source_blocks.text: 获取受信任的、经过培训的专业人士的帮助，他们可协助处理与VA相关的索赔，例如认证代表或退伍军人服务官（VSO）。查找代表查找您所在州的退伍军人事务机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: These services are free. No one should ever ask you to pay them to help you fill out VA Form 40-10007 or file your request.
source_blocks.text: 注意：这些服务是免费的。任何人都不应要求您付费以帮助您填写VA Form 40-10007或提交申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I apply?
source_blocks.text: 申请后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens after you apply for a pre-need eligibility determination
source_blocks.text: 了解申请预先资格认定后会发生什么

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We ve received a large number of pre-need eligibility applications, and it s slowing down our approval process. We ll let you know when we ve received your application and how long we think it ll take to make a decision. We re sorry for the delay.
source_blocks.text: 注意：我们收到了大量预先资格认定申请，这减缓了我们的审批流程。我们会在收到您的申请后通知您，并告知预计需要多长时间做出决定。对于延误，我们深表歉意。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information, you can call 877-222-8387. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. Please wait to hear back about your application rather than applying again.
source_blocks.text: 如需更多信息，您可以拨打 877-222-8387。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上8:00提供服务。请等待我们的回复，而不要重复申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Last updated:
source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

documents.title: 打印您的 VA Welcome Kit | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print Out Your VA Welcome Kit | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 打印您的 VA Welcome Kit | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Print out your VA Welcome Kit
source_blocks.text: 打印您的 VA Welcome Kit

source_blocks.source_text_en: Whether you re just getting out of the service or you ve been a civilian for years now, the VA Welcome Kit can help guide you to the benefits and services you ve earned. Based on where you are in life, your VA benefits and services can support you in different ways. Keep your welcome kit handy so you can turn to it throughout your life like when it s time to go to school, get a job, buy a house, get health care, retire, or make plans for your care as you age.
source_blocks.text: 无论您是刚刚退役，还是已经退伍多年，VA Welcome Kit 都能帮助您了解您应得的福利和服务。根据您所处的人生阶段，您的 VA 福利和服务可以以不同方式为您提供支持。请将您的 welcome kit 放在手边，以便在人生各个阶段随时查阅，例如上学、找工作、买房、获得医疗保健、退休或为年老时的护理做计划时。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download your VA Welcome Kit
source_blocks.text: 下载您的 VA Welcome Kit

source_blocks.source_text_en: Feel free to share this guide with friends or family members who need help with their benefits too. You can print out copies for yourself and others:
source_blocks.text: 欢迎与需要福利帮助的朋友或家人分享本指南。您也可以为自己和他人打印副本：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your VA Welcome Kit in black and white (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 您的 VA Welcome Kit 黑白版 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your VA Welcome Kit in color (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 您的 VA Welcome Kit 彩色版 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download our guides to VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 下载我们的 VA 福利和服务指南

source_blocks.source_text_en: For Veterans
source_blocks.text: 面向 Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for VA health care (PDF)Get started with mental health services (PDF)Apply for a disability rating (PDF)Apply for education benefits (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 申请 VA 医疗保健 (PDF)开始使用心理健康服务 (PDF)申请伤残评级 (PDF)申请教育福利 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: For family members
source_blocks.text: 面向家庭成员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get started with caregiver benefits (PDF)Apply for survivor benefits (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 开始使用照护者福利 (PDF)申请遗属福利 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore VA.gov to learn about your benefits
source_blocks.text: 探索 VA.gov 了解您的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability
source_blocks.text: Disability

source_blocks.source_text_en: File a claim for disability compensation for conditions related to your military service, and manage your benefits over time.
source_blocks.text: 为与您的兵役相关的疾病提交伤残补偿申请，并随时间管理您的福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care
source_blocks.text: Health care

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for VA health care, find out how to access services, and manage your health and benefits online.
source_blocks.text: 申请VA医疗保健，了解如何获取服务，并在线管理您的健康和福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education and training
source_blocks.text: 教育与培训

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for and manage your GI Bill and other education benefits to help pay for college and training programs.
source_blocks.text: 申请并管理您的GI Bill和其他教育福利，以帮助支付大学和培训项目的费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Housing assistance
source_blocks.text: 住房援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you're eligible for VA home loan programs to help you buy, build, repair, or keep a home. If you have a service-connected disability, see if you qualify for a housing grant to help you live more independently.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合VA房屋贷款项目的资格，以帮助您购买、建造、维修或保留住房。如果您有与服务相关的残疾，请查看您是否有资格获得住房补助金，以帮助您更独立地生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Careers and employment
source_blocks.text: 职业与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for vocational rehabilitation services, get support for your Veteran-owned small business, and access other career resources.
source_blocks.text: 申请职业康复服务，为您的Veteran-owned小企业获得支持，并获取其他职业资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance
source_blocks.text: 人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore VA life insurance options for Veterans, service members, and families. Manage your policy online, file claims for benefits, and access helpful resources.
source_blocks.text: 探索为Veterans、现役军人及其家庭提供的VA人寿保险选项。在线管理您的保单，提交福利索赔，并获取有用的资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pension
source_blocks.text: 养老金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for monthly payments for wartime Veterans and survivors with limited or no income who meet certain age and disability requirements.
source_blocks.text: 为收入有限或无收入且符合特定年龄和残疾要求的战时Veterans和遗属申请每月付款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Burials and memorials
source_blocks.text: 葬礼与纪念

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help planning a burial in a VA national cemetery, order a headstone or other memorial item to honor a Veteran's service, and apply for survivor and dependent benefits.
source_blocks.text: 获取有关在VA国家公墓规划葬礼的帮助，订购墓碑或其他纪念物品以纪念退伍军人的服役，并申请遗属和受抚养人福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Records
source_blocks.text: 记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for a printed Veteran ID card, get your VA benefit letters and medical records, and learn how to apply for a discharge upgrade.
source_blocks.text: 申请打印的退伍军人身份证，获取您的VA福利信函和医疗记录，并了解如何申请退役升级。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Benefits for spouses, dependents, survivors, and family caregivers
source_blocks.text: 配偶、受抚养人、遗属和家庭照护者的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about benefits for spouses and dependents of a Veteran or service member, including added support if you're caring for a Veteran with a service-connected disability.
source_blocks.text: 了解退伍军人或服役人员配偶和受抚养人的福利，包括如果您正在照护有服役相关残疾的退伍军人时的额外支持。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

documents.source_title_en: PTSD Treatment | Veterans Affairs
documents.title: PTSD 治疗 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: PTSD Treatment | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: PTSD 治疗 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: PTSD treatment
source_blocks.text: PTSD 治疗

source_blocks.source_text_en: Whether you just returned from a deployment or have been home for 40 years, it s never too late to get help for PTSD (posttraumatic stress disorder). Getting counseling or treatment can help you manage your symptoms and keep them from getting worse.
source_blocks.text: 无论您是刚从部署归来，还是已经回家40年，寻求 PTSD（创伤后应激障碍）帮助永远都不晚。接受咨询或治疗可以帮助您管理症状并防止其恶化。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our National Center for PTSD is the world leader in PTSD research, education, and treatment. Find out how to access PTSD health services through VA.
source_blocks.text: 我们的 National Center for PTSD 是 PTSD 研究、教育和治疗领域的全球领导者。了解如何通过 VA 获取 PTSD 健康服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: 我现在如何与人交谈？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何白天或夜晚随时获得支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是一位处于危机中的退伍军人，或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们关怀备至、经验丰富的Veterans Crisis Line responders联系，获取保密帮助。他们中许多人本身就是退伍军人。此服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候24/7可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: 要随时与Veterans Crisis Line responder联系，白天或夜晚：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: 拨打800-273-8255，然后选择1。 开始一次保密的Veterans聊天。 发送短信至838255。 如果您有听力障碍，请拨打TTY：800-799-4889。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打911。 前往最近的急诊室。 直接前往最近的VA医疗中心。无论您的退役身份如何，或是否已加入VA医疗保健，都可以。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: What services does VA provide for PTSD?
source_blocks.text: VA为PTSD提供哪些服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We have almost 200 PTSD treatment programs across the country that offer:
source_blocks.text: 我们在全国有近200个PTSD治疗项目，提供：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1-to-1 mental health assessment and testing to figure out if you have PTSD Medicine proven to work for treating PTSD 1-to-1 psychotherapy (also called talk therapy). This includes proven methods like Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT). 1-to-1 family therapy Group therapy for special needs, like anger or stress management, or combat support Group therapy for Veterans who served in certain combat zones or who ve been through similar traumas
source_blocks.text: 一对一心理健康评估和测试，以确定您是否患有PTSD 经证明对治疗PTSD有效的药物 一对一心理治疗（也称为谈话疗法）。这包括如认知处理疗法（CPT）等经过验证的方法。 一对一家庭治疗 针对特殊需求的团体治疗，如愤怒或压力管理，或战斗支持 为曾在特定战区服役或经历过类似创伤的退伍军人提供团体治疗

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also offer other forms of treatment and support:
source_blocks.text: 我们还提供其他形式的治疗和支持：

source_blocks.source_text_en: PTSD specialists provide regular outpatient care to Veterans with PTSD in each VA medical center across the U.S. Special residential (live-in) or inpatient care programs found in each region of the U.S. help Veterans with severe PTSD symptoms who have trouble doing normal daily activities (like going to work). Providers offer added PTSD care in some of our large community-based outpatient clinics.
source_blocks.text: PTSD专家在美国各地的每个VA医疗中心为患有PTSD的退伍军人提供常规门诊护理。 美国各地区设有专门的住院（住宿）或住院护理项目，帮助有严重PTSD症状且难以进行正常日常活动（如上班）的退伍军人。 提供商在我们一些大型社区门诊诊所提供额外的PTSD护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a VA medical center or clinic near you
source_blocks.text: 查找您附近的VA医疗中心或诊所

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: If you don t live near a VA medical center or clinic, our mental health providers can counsel you over the phone (called telemental health care). Or, we can refer you to a Vet Center or health care provider near you.
source_blocks.text: 请注意：如果您不住在VA医疗中心或诊所附近，我们的心理健康提供者可以通过电话为您提供咨询（称为远程心理健康护理）。或者，我们可以将您转介到附近的Vet Center或医疗保健提供者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access VA services for PTSD?
source_blocks.text: 如何获取VA针对PTSD的服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VA health care program covers PTSD health services. To access these services, first apply for VA health care.Apply for health care
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健计划涵盖PTSD健康服务。要获取这些服务，首先申请VA医疗保健。申请医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you ve signed up:
source_blocks.text: 一旦您注册：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA primary care provider, talk to them about your concerns. Your provider can help you figure out if you have PTSD and can offer treatment and support as needed. If you don t have a VA primary care provider or have never been seen in a VA hospital or clinic: - Call our general information hotline at 800-827-1000, or - Contact your local VA medical center, or - Contact a VA PTSD program near you
source_blocks.text: 如果您有VA初级保健提供者，请与他们谈论您的担忧。您的提供者可以帮助您确定是否患有PTSD，并根据需要提供治疗和支持。 如果您没有VA初级保健提供者，或从未在VA医院或诊所就诊过： - 拨打我们的综合信息热线800-827-1000，或 - 联系您当地的VA医疗中心，或 - 联系您附近的VA PTSD项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I don t have VA health benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有VA健康福利怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may still be able to get care:
source_blocks.text: 您可能仍然能够获得护理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve served in a combat zone, get free private counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless: - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential (private). - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在战区服役，可在我们300个社区Vet Centers之一获得免费私人咨询、酒精和药物评估以及其他支持。查找您附近的Vet Center 如果您无家可归或有成为无家可归者的风险： - 访问我们的网站，了解针对无家可归退伍军人的VA项目。了解我们的无家可归者项目 - 拨打全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心877-424-3838，每周7天、每天24小时获得帮助。训练有素的VA顾问将提供有关您所在地区VA无家可归者项目、医疗保健和其他服务的信息。该电话免费且保密（私密）。 - 致电或访问您当地的VA社区资源和转介中心。即使您不符合VA医疗保健资格，我们的工作人员也可以帮助您找到您所在社区中可能符合资格的非VA资源。查找您当地的社区资源和转介中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability compensation (monthly payments) or other benefits from VA if I think I have PTSD linked to military service?
source_blocks.text: 如果我认为我的PTSD与兵役有关，我能获得VA的残疾补偿（每月付款）或其他福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have symptoms of PTSD and suffered a serious injury, personal trauma, sexual trauma, or were threatened with injury, sexual assault, or death while serving in the military, you may be able to get disability compensation or benefits.Find out if you can get disability benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您有PTSD症状，并且在服役期间遭受严重伤害、个人创伤、性创伤，或受到伤害、性侵犯或死亡的威胁，您可能能够获得残疾补偿或福利。了解您是否有资格获得残疾福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where can I find more information and support?
source_blocks.text: 我在哪里可以找到更多信息和支持？

source_blocks.source_text_en: See our Understanding PTSD and PTSD Treatment booklet for more about PTSD symptoms and treatment.Read the booklet (PDF) Go to our National Center for PTSD website for information about PTSD treatment and support.Visit the National Center for PTSD Go to these websites for resources and stories of Veterans who ve overcome PTSD and other mental health challenges: - Visit Make the Connection - Visit About Face Use our PTSD Coach Online to help manage stress.Visit PTSD Coach Online See our self-help resources guide for books, web resources, and mobile applications recommended by VA experts.Get self-help resources Call the VA general information hotline at 800-827-1000.
source_blocks.text: 查看我们的《了解PTSD和PTSD治疗》手册，了解更多关于PTSD症状和治疗的信息。阅读手册（PDF） 访问我们的国家PTSD中心网站，获取有关PTSD治疗和支持的信息。访问国家PTSD中心 访问这些网站，获取克服PTSD和其他心理健康挑战的退伍军人的资源和故事： - 访问Make the Connection - 访问About Face 使用我们的PTSD Coach Online帮助管理压力。访问PTSD Coach Online 查看我们的自助资源指南，获取VA专家推荐的书籍、网络资源和移动应用程序。获取自助资源 拨打VA综合信息热线800-827-1000。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reconstruct military records destroyed in NPRC fire
source_blocks.text: Reconstruct military records destroyed in NPRC fire

source_blocks.source_text_en: In 1973, a fire at the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC) in St. Louis, Missouri, destroyed the records held for Veterans who were discharged from the Army and Air Force during certain periods of time. Find out if your records may have been destroyed in this fire, and how to reconstruct your records to support a VA disability compensation claim.
source_blocks.text: In 1973, a fire at the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC) in St. Louis, Missouri, destroyed the records held for Veterans who were discharged from the Army and Air Force during certain periods of time. Find out if your records may have been destroyed in this fire, and how to reconstruct your records to support a VA disability compensation claim.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Were my records destroyed in the 1973 NPRC fire in St. Louis?
source_blocks.text: Were my records destroyed in the 1973 NPRC fire in St. Louis?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your records may have been destroyed in the fire if you were discharged from either:
source_blocks.text: Your records may have been destroyed in the fire if you were discharged from either:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Army between November 1, 1912, and January 1, 1960. The fire destroyed 80% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Army during this time period. The fire didn't involve records for retirees and Reservists who were alive on July 12, 1973. Or the Air Force between September 25, 1947, and January 1, 1964. The fire destroyed 75% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Air Force during this time period with surnames beginning with Hubbard and running through the end of the alphabet.
source_blocks.text: The Army between November 1, 1912, and January 1, 1960. The fire destroyed 80% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Army during this time period. The fire didn't involve records for retirees and Reservists who were alive on July 12, 1973. Or the Air Force between September 25, 1947, and January 1, 1964. The fire destroyed 75% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Air Force during this time period with surnames beginning with Hubbard and running through the end of the alphabet.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about the 1973 NPRC fire
source_blocks.text: Learn more about the 1973 NPRC fire

source_blocks.source_text_en: Reconstructing your records
source_blocks.text: Reconstructing your records

source_blocks.source_text_en: How does VA reconstruct my records?
source_blocks.text: How does VA reconstruct my records?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We submit a specific request to the NPRC for any additional service records they may have or can find for you.
source_blocks.text: We submit a specific request to the NPRC for any additional service records they may have or can find for you.

source_blocks.source_text_en: With the information we provide, the NPRC searches for documents that may help to reconstruct your records. They may also reach out to other government agencies. For example, they may try to reconstruct portions of your service treatment records by reviewing unit records, morning reports, and hospital admission records from the surgeon general's office.
source_blocks.text: With the information we provide, the NPRC searches for documents that may help to reconstruct your records. They may also reach out to other government agencies. For example, they may try to reconstruct portions of your service treatment records by reviewing unit records, morning reports, and hospital admission records from the surgeon general's office.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I get the records I need to support my VA disability compensation claim?
source_blocks.text: How can I get the records I need to support my VA disability compensation claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're filing a VA disability compensation claim, follow the steps below to get the records you need.
source_blocks.text: If you're filing a VA disability compensation claim, follow the steps below to get the records you need.

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Fill out the National Archives request for information form
source_blocks.text: #### Fill out the National Archives request for information form

source_blocks.source_text_en: You'll need to fill out a Request for Information Needed to Reconstruct Medical Data (NA Form 13055). We'll use this form as our request to the NPRC to reconstruct your records.
source_blocks.text: You'll need to fill out a Request for Information Needed to Reconstruct Medical Data (NA Form 13055). We'll use this form as our request to the NPRC to reconstruct your records.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please give us as much information as you can about your assignments during service, including any of the below that apply to you:
source_blocks.text: Please give us as much information as you can about your assignments during service, including any of the below that apply to you:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Unit - Company - Battalion - Regiment - Squadron - Group - Wing
source_blocks.text: Unit - Company - Battalion - Regiment - Squadron - Group - Wing

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download NA Form 13055 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: Download NA Form 13055 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Gather or request other records or documents
source_blocks.text: #### Gather or request other records or documents

source_blocks.source_text_en: We'll also look at other records or documents (called supplemental records ) to help decide your claim. You can provide these records or ask us to help you find them.
source_blocks.text: We'll also look at other records or documents (called supplemental records ) to help decide your claim. You can provide these records or ask us to help you find them.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please send us any of these documents you may have:
source_blocks.text: Please send us any of these documents you may have:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Statements from service medical personnel - Certified buddy statements or affidavits from fellow service members who witnessed your injury or illness - Military accident and police reports - Examination reports related to employment or insurance - Letters or photographs from your time in the service - Prescription records - Photocopies of any service treatment records or medical reports from any private hospitals, clinics, or doctors who treated you during service or shortly after separation
source_blocks.text: Statements from service medical personnel - Certified buddy statements or affidavits from fellow service members who witnessed your injury or illness - Military accident and police reports - Examination reports related to employment or insurance - Letters or photographs from your time in the service - Prescription records - Photocopies of any service treatment records or medical reports from any private hospitals, clinics, or doctors who treated you during service or shortly after separation

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Submit your disability compensation claim, NA Form 13055, and any supporting documents
source_blocks.text: #### Submit your disability compensation claim, NA Form 13055, and any supporting documents

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file your claim online, by mail, in person, or with the help of a trained professional. For claims involving the reconstruction of records, we encourage you to work with a professional, such as an accredited attorney, claims agent, or Veterans Service Officer (VSO).
source_blocks.text: You can file your claim online, by mail, in person, or with the help of a trained professional. For claims involving the reconstruction of records, we encourage you to work with a professional, such as an accredited attorney, claims agent, or Veterans Service Officer (VSO).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure to include your NA Form 13055 (PDF) and any supplemental records or other documents you may have with your claim.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a Board Appeal
source_blocks.text: Request a Board Appeal

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose this option, you re appealing to a Veterans Law Judge at the Board of Veterans' Appeals in Washington, D.C. A judge who s an expert in Veterans law will review your case.
source_blocks.text: 选择此选项时，您将向位于华盛顿特区的Veterans' Appeals委员会的Veterans Law Judge提出上诉。熟悉Veterans法律的法官将审查您的案件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to add new evidence that a judge will review.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择添加法官将审查的新证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You also have the option to request a hearing with a judge, either in person in Washington, D.C., or by video conference at a VA location near you.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以选择请求与法官举行听证会，可以在华盛顿特区亲自出席，或通过视频会议在您附近的VA地点进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Board Appeal?
source_blocks.text: 我可以请求Board Appeal吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Board Appeal after an initial claim, Supplemental Claim, or Higher-Level Review decision. You can t request two Board Appeals in a row.
source_blocks.text: 在初始索赔、Supplemental Claim或Higher-Level Review决定之后，您可以请求Board Appeal。您不能连续请求两次Board Appeal。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I add new evidence?
source_blocks.text: 我可以添加新证据吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to add new evidence for a judge to review. You ll have to submit this evidence within 90 days from the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择添加新证据供法官审查。您需要在VA收到您的Board Appeal表格之日起90天内提交此证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This option will take longer.
source_blocks.text: 此选项将花费更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a hearing?
source_blocks.text: 我可以请求听证会吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择请求与法官举行听证会。视频会议听证会将在您附近的VA地点进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: This option will take longer.
source_blocks.text: 此选项将花费更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens at a hearing?
source_blocks.text: 听证会上会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony and may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.
source_blocks.text: 您和法官将进行对话。法官将听取您的证词，并可能问您几个问题。如果您有代表，您的代表可以在听证会上帮助您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.
source_blocks.text: 听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉文件中。您可以在听证会后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I request a Board Appeal?
source_blocks.text: 如何请求Board Appeal？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request a Board Appeal, fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182). Download VA Form 10182 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要请求Board Appeal，请填写Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载VA Form 10182 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Choose one of 3 options to appeal to a Veterans Law Judge
source_blocks.text: ### 从3个选项中选择1个，向 Veterans Law Judge 提出上诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: Direct Review If you want a Veterans Law Judge to review your case as quickly as possible, choose a Direct Review.
source_blocks.text: Direct Review 如果你希望 Veterans Law Judge 尽快审查你的案件，请选择 Direct Review。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t submit any evidence.
source_blocks.text: 你不能提交任何证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.
source_blocks.text: 约1年 Board 对无新证据且无听证的上诉作出裁决的目标时间约为一年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Evidence Submission If you have additional evidence for a Veterans Law Judge to review, choose Evidence Submission.
source_blocks.text: Evidence Submission 如果你有其他证据供 Veterans Law Judge 审查，请选择 Evidence Submission。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit evidence within 90 days of the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.
source_blocks.text: 你必须在 VA 收到你的 Board Appeal 表格之日起90天内提交证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Longer If you add new evidence, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.
source_blocks.text: 更长 如果你添加新证据，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hearing Request If you want a video conference hearing with a Veterans Law Judge at a nearby VA location, choose a Hearing Request.
source_blocks.text: Hearing Request 如果你希望在附近的 VA 地点与 Veterans Law Judge 进行视频会议听证，请选择 Hearing Request。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At your hearing, you and a Veterans Law Judge will have a conversation, and they ll ask you questions about your appeal. Your hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. Learn more about hearings and how to request one
source_blocks.text: 在听证会上，你和 Veterans Law Judge 将进行对话，他们会询问你关于上诉的问题。你的听证将被记录并添加到你的上诉档案中。了解更多关于听证会以及如何申请的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.
source_blocks.text: 你可以在听证后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Longer If you request a hearing, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.
source_blocks.text: 更长 如果你要求听证，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### List the issue(s) you want to appeal in Part III
source_blocks.text: ### 在 Part III 中列出你希望上诉的问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can include all or just some of the issues VA decided. You ll need to list the issue(s) you disagree with and the VA decision date for each.
source_blocks.text: 你可以包括 VA 已决定的所有或部分问题。你需要列出你不同意的每个问题及对应的 VA 决定日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Apply
source_blocks.text: ### 申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182). Download VA Form 10182 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写 Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载 VA Form 10182 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send the completed form to this address:
source_blocks.text: 将填写完整的表格发送至以下地址：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038
source_blocks.text: Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038

source_blocks.source_text_en: In person
source_blocks.text: 亲自办理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring your completed form to a regional benefit office. Find a regional benefit office near you
source_blocks.text: 将填写完毕的表格带到地区福利办公室。查找离您最近的地区福利办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: By fax
source_blocks.text: 传真办理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fax your completed form to 844-678-8979.
source_blocks.text: 将填写完毕的表格传真至 844-678-8979。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also ask a regional benefit office for a copy of this form to fill out. Or you can call the VA toll-free hotline at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. ET, to request a form.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以向地区福利办公室索取此表格的副本进行填写。或者，您可以拨打 VA 免费热线 800-827-1000（周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 9:00）索取表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mark your calendar
source_blocks.text: 标记您的日历

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have 1 year from the date on your decision to request a Board Appeal. If you re one of multiple people claiming the same benefit (this is rare), you have 60 days.
source_blocks.text: 您有 1 年的时间（自决定日期起）来申请 Board Appeal。如果您是共同申领同一福利的多人之一（这种情况很少见），则您有 60 天的时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After a Board decision
source_blocks.text: Board 决定之后

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with the Board s decision and have new and relevant evidence that supports your case, you can file a Supplemental Claim. You can also appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. Learn more about your options after a Board decision
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意 Board 的决定，并且有支持您案件的新且相关的证据，您可以提交 Supplemental Claim。您也可以向 U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims 提出上诉。了解 Board 决定后您的更多选择

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens next?
source_blocks.text: 接下来会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens after you request a decision review
source_blocks.text: 了解您申请 decision review 后会发生什么

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to do anything while you wait unless VA sends you a letter asking for more information. If VA schedules exams for you, be sure not to miss them.
source_blocks.text: 在等待期间，您无需做任何事情，除非 VA 向您发送信函要求提供更多信息。如果 VA 为您安排了考试，请务必不要错过。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of your appeal
source_blocks.text: 跟踪您的上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veterans Service Organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review. Get help requesting a decision review
source_blocks.text: Veterans Service Organization 或 VA 认可的律师或代理人可以帮助您申请 decision review。获取申请 decision review 的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I have more questions?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get answers to frequently asked questions about decision reviews. Go to FAQs
source_blocks.text: 获取有关 decision reviews 的常见问题解答。前往 FAQs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a Higher-Level Review | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: Request a Higher-Level Review | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a Higher-Level Review
source_blocks.text: Request a Higher-Level Review

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with VA s decision, you can request to have a senior reviewer take a new look at your case. The reviewer will determine whether the decision can be changed based on a difference of opinion or an error.
source_blocks.text: 如果你不同意VA的决定，你可以要求一位高级审查员重新审视你的案件。审查员将根据意见分歧或错误来判断是否可以更改决定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t submit any evidence.
source_blocks.text: 你不能提交任何证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and/or your representative can speak with the reviewer on the phone. You can tell them why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors.
source_blocks.text: 你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Higher-Level Review?
source_blocks.text: 我可以请求Higher-Level Review吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Higher-Level Review of an initial claim or Supplemental Claim decision. This option isn t available after a Higher-Level Review or Board Appeal. It s also not available if you re one of multiple people claiming the same benefit (this is rare).
source_blocks.text: 你可以对初始申请或Supplemental Claim的决定请求Higher-Level Review。此选项在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后不可用。如果你是多位申请同一福利的人之一（这种情况很少见），也不可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long does it take VA to make a decision?
source_blocks.text: VA做出决定需要多长时间？

source_blocks.source_text_en: 4-5 months VA s goal for completing Higher-Level Reviews is 125 days. A review may take longer if VA needs to get records or schedule a new exam to correct an error.
source_blocks.text: 4-5个月 VA完成Higher-Level Reviews的目标是125天。如果VA需要获取记录或安排新的考试以纠正错误，审查可能需要更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I expect if I request a call with a senior reviewer?
source_blocks.text: 如果我请求与高级审查员通话，我应该期待什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you request an informal conference with a senior reviewer, they ll call the phone number that you or your representative provided on the Higher-Level Review form to schedule a time to discuss your case with you. The senior reviewer will try to reach you or your representative by phone twice. If no one answers, they ll leave a voice mail.
source_blocks.text: 如果你请求与高级审查员进行非正式会议，他们会拨打你或你的代表在Higher-Level Review表格上提供的电话号码，以安排时间讨论你的案件。高级审查员会尝试通过电话联系你或你的代表两次。如果无人接听，他们会留下语音邮件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: During the call, you and/or your representative can talk about why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors. There won t be transcripts of this call.
source_blocks.text: 在通话期间，你和/或你的代表可以讨论你认为决定应该更改的原因并指出错误。这次通话不会有记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I request a Higher-Level Review?
source_blocks.text: 我如何请求Higher-Level Review？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request a Higher-Level Review, fill out the Decision Review Request: Higher-Level Review (VA Form 20-0996). Download VA Form 20-0996 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要请求Higher-Level Review，请填写Decision Review Request: Higher-Level Review (VA Form 20-0996)。下载VA Form 20-0996 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Select a benefit type in Part I of the form
source_blocks.text: ### 在表格第一部分选择福利类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: The most common benefit type is compensation, but if you re unsure, check your VA decision. You can t select multiple benefit types. You have to complete a separate form for each type.
source_blocks.text: 最常见的福利类型是compensation，但如果你不确定，请查看你的VA决定。你不能选择多种福利类型。每种类型你必须填写单独的表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Optional: Request a call (informal conference) with the reviewer
source_blocks.text: ### 可选：请求与审查员通话（非正式会议）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and/or your representative can speak with the reviewer on the phone. You can tell them why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors.
source_blocks.text: 你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To schedule an informal conference, select times and list a phone number in Part II of the form. A reviewer will call 2-4 weeks after VA processes your request.
source_blocks.text: 要安排非正式会议，请在表格第二部分选择时间并填写电话号码。审核员将在VA处理您的请求后2-4周内致电给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### List the issue(s) you want reviewed in Part III of the form
source_blocks.text: ### 在表格第三部分列出您希望审核的问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can include all or just some of the issues VA has decided. You ll need to list the issue(s) you disagree with and the VA decision date for each.
source_blocks.text: 您可以包含VA已决定的所有或部分问题。您需要列出您不同意的每个问题及对应的VA决定日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t submit any evidence.
source_blocks.text: 您不能提交任何证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I have new and relevant evidence? If you have evidence to submit, please select another review option. Learn more about the review options
source_blocks.text: 如果我有新的且相关的证据怎么办？如果您有证据要提交，请选择其他审核选项。了解更多关于审核选项的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: ### Apply
source_blocks.text: ### 申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out the Decision Review Request: Higher-Level Review (VA Form 20-0996). Download VA Form 20-0996 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写《Decision Review Request: Higher-Level Review》（VA Form 20-0996）。下载VA Form 20-0996（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 通过邮寄

source_blocks.source_text_en: Send the completed form to the benefit office that matches the benefit type you selected on the form.
source_blocks.text: 将填写完整的表格寄送至与您在表格上选择的福利类型相匹配的福利办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request Your Military Service Records | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 申请你的军人服务记录 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request your military service records (including DD214)
source_blocks.text: 申请你的军人服务记录（包括 DD214）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Submit a military records request to get your DD214 or other military service records through the milConnect website.
source_blocks.text: 通过 milConnect 网站提交军人记录申请，以获取你的 DD214 或其他军人服务记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to sign in to milConnect to get your military service records
source_blocks.text: 你需要登录 milConnect 才能获取你的军人服务记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: To use this feature, you'll need a Premium DS Logon account. Your My HealtheVet or ID.me credentials won t work on the milConnect website. Go to milConnect to sign in, register, or upgrade your DS Logon account to Premium.Go to milConnect
source_blocks.text: 要使用此功能，你需要一个 Premium DS Logon 账户。你的 My HealtheVet 或 ID.me 凭据在 milConnect 网站上无法使用。前往 milConnect 登录、注册或将你的 DS Logon 账户升级为 Premium。前往 milConnect

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once I ve signed in to milConnect, how do I request my DD214 or other military records?
source_blocks.text: 登录 milConnect 后，我如何申请我的 DD214 或其他军人记录？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Follow the steps below to submit a military records request.
source_blocks.text: 按照以下步骤提交军人记录申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: From your signed-in homepage, click or tap on Correspondence/ Documentation. Then select Defense Personnel Records Information (DPRIS) from the drop-down menu. Choose the Personnel File tab. Select Request My Personnel File. Fill out the form. In the Document Index section, check the boxes next to the document(s) you'd like to request. Click or tap on the Create and Send Request button.
source_blocks.text: 从已登录的主页，点击或轻触 Correspondence/ Documentation。然后从下拉菜单中选择 Defense Personnel Records Information (DPRIS)。 选择 Personnel File 选项卡。 选择 Request My Personnel File。 填写表格。在 Document Index 部分，勾选你想要申请的文档旁边的复选框。 点击或轻触 Create and Send Request 按钮。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What types of records can I request with this tool?
source_blocks.text: 我可以使用此工具申请哪些类型的记录？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request documents from your Official Military Personnel File to view and download.
source_blocks.text: 您可以从您的官方军事人事档案（Official Military Personnel File）中请求文件以查看和下载。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request your:
source_blocks.text: 您可以请求：

source_blocks.source_text_en: DD214 DD215 Report of Separation Other release papers
source_blocks.text: DD214 DD215 退役报告（Report of Separation） 其他退役文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also request documents with information about your service, such as your:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以请求包含您服役信息的文件，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Orders and endorsements Performance reports Awards and decorations (commendatory items) Qualifications, licenses, and certificates Security clearance
source_blocks.text: 命令和背书（Orders and endorsements） 绩效报告（Performance reports） 奖项和勋章（嘉奖物品） 资格、执照和证书 安全许可（Security clearance）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens after I request my military records?
source_blocks.text: 请求我的军事记录后会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll receive an email letting you know we re processing your request. You ll receive a second email when your request is complete and your files are ready for you to view and download.
source_blocks.text: 您将收到一封电子邮件，告知我们正在处理您的请求。当您的请求完成且文件准备好供您查看和下载时，您将收到第二封电子邮件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also check the status of your military records request by signing in to milConnect and going to the Personnel File tab within the Defense Personnel Records Information (DPRIS) section. This is also where you ll view and download your files once they re ready.
source_blocks.text: 您还可以通过登录milConnect并转到国防人事记录信息（DPRIS）部分内的“人事档案”选项卡来检查您的军事记录请求状态。这也是文件准备好后您查看和下载文件的地方。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are there other ways to get my military records?
source_blocks.text: 还有其他方式获取我的军事记录吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes.
source_blocks.text: 是的。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request your military records in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下任一方式申请您的军事记录：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail or fax a Request Pertaining to Military Records (Standard Form SF 180) to the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC).Download Form SF 180 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 邮寄或传真《军事记录申请》（标准表格 SF 180）至国家人事记录中心（NPRC）。下载 SF 180 表格（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Write a letter to the NPRC. Send it to:
source_blocks.text: 写信给 NPRC。寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138
source_blocks.text: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the NPRC in person
source_blocks.text: 亲自前往 NPRC

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact your state or county Veterans agency
source_blocks.text: 联系您所在州或县的退伍军人事务机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hire an independent researcher
source_blocks.text: 聘请独立研究员

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I request someone else s military records?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请他人的军事记录？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a family member planning a burial for a Veteran in a VA national cemetery
source_blocks.text: 如果您是家属，计划将退伍军人安葬在 VA 国家公墓

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call our National Cemetery Scheduling Office at 800-535-1117. We can help you get the Veteran s DD214 or other discharge documents you may need. Get more information about planning a burial
source_blocks.text: 请致电我们的国家公墓调度办公室：800-535-1117。我们可以帮助您获取可能需要的退伍军人 DD214 或其他退役文件。了解更多关于安排葬礼的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the next of kin of a Veteran who has passed away
source_blocks.text: 如果您是已故退伍军人的近亲

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a copy of the Veteran s military records in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下任一方式申请该退伍军人军事记录的副本：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail or fax a Request Pertaining to Military Records (Standard Form SF 180) to the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC).Download Form SF 180 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 邮寄或传真《军事记录申请》（标准表格 SF 180）至国家人事记录中心（NPRC）。下载 SF 180 表格（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Write a letter to the NPRC. Send it to:
source_blocks.text: 写信给 NPRC。寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138
source_blocks.text: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the NPRC in person
source_blocks.text: 亲自前往 NPRC

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact your state or county Veterans agency
source_blocks.text: 联系您所在州或县的退伍军人事务机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hire an independent researcher
source_blocks.text: 聘请一位独立研究员

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be considered the next of kin if you re related to the Veteran in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 如果您与退伍军人在以下任何方面存在亲属关系，您可能被视为其近亲：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Surviving spouse who hasn't remarried, or Parent, or Child, or Sibling
source_blocks.text: 未再婚的未亡配偶，或 父母，或 子女，或 兄弟姐妹

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re not the Veteran s next of kin
source_blocks.text: 如果您不是退伍军人的近亲

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Veteran was discharged more than 62 years ago, you can order a copy of their military records. The National Archives opens all records to the public 62 years after discharge. Learn how to access archived records
source_blocks.text: 如果退伍军人退役超过62年，您可以申请获取其军事记录的副本。国家档案馆（National Archives）在退役62年后向公众开放所有记录。了解如何访问存档记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the Veteran was discharged less than 62 years ago, you may be able to request limited information from their Military Personnel File. Find out about general public access to military records
source_blocks.text: 如果退伍军人退役不足62年，您或许可以申请获取其军事人事档案（Military Personnel File）中的有限信息。了解公众获取军事记录的一般途径

documents.source_title_en: Schedule A Burial For A Veteran Or Family Member | Veterans Affairs
documents.title: 为退伍军人或家属安排安葬 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule A Burial For A Veteran Or Family Member | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 为退伍军人或家属安排安葬 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule a burial for a Veteran or family member
source_blocks.text: 为退伍军人或家属安排安葬

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to make burial plans for a Veteran, spouse, or dependent family member.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何为退伍军人、配偶或受抚养家属制定安葬计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I schedule a burial for a Veteran or other family member?
source_blocks.text: 如何为退伍军人或其他家属安排安葬？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a pre-need decision letter that confirms eligibility
source_blocks.text: 如果您有确认资格的预先决定信

source_blocks.source_text_en: To start, you may want to choose a funeral director to help you plan the burial. Then either you or the funeral director can call the National Cemetery Scheduling Office at 800-535-1117 to request a burial.
source_blocks.text: 首先，您可能需要选择一位殡葬承办人来帮助您规划安葬事宜。然后，您或殡葬承办人可以拨打国家公墓调度办公室电话 800-535-1117 申请安葬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keep in mind that the pre-need decision letter doesn t identify a specific cemetery or gravesite, since it s not possible to reserve these in advance. In some cases, we may review your eligibility again at your time of death, as laws and circumstances may have changed since your pre-need application.
source_blocks.text: 请记住，预先决定信并不指定特定的公墓或墓地，因为无法提前预订这些。在某些情况下，我们可能会在您去世时重新审查您的资格，因为自您提交预先申请以来，法律和情况可能已发生变化。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to do anything else except prepare yourself and your family for the funeral.Find out what to expect at a military funeral or memorial service
source_blocks.text: 您无需做其他任何事情，只需为自己和家人做好葬礼准备。了解军事葬礼或追悼会的预期安排

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have a pre-need decision letter
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有预先决定信

source_blocks.source_text_en: To start, you may want to choose a funeral director to help you plan the burial. Then either you or the funeral director will need to take these 3 steps to schedule the burial.
source_blocks.text: 首先，您可能需要选择一位殡葬承办人来帮助您规划安葬事宜。然后，您或殡葬承办人需要采取以下 3 个步骤来安排安葬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Gather the information and documents you ll need to identify the deceased when you call the National Cemetery Scheduling Office
source_blocks.text: #### 收集您在致电国家公墓调度办公室时需要用来确认逝者身份的信息和文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need the DD214 or other discharge documents of the Veteran or service member whose military serviced will be used to determine eligibility for burial in a VA national cemetery. Their discharge from service needs to have been under conditions other than dishonorable.
source_blocks.text: 您需要退伍军人或军人的 DD214 或其他退役文件，其军事服役将用于确定是否有资格安葬在 VA 国家公墓。他们的退役条件必须不是不光彩退役。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may also need other documents to verify a relationship to a Veteran or the status of a dependent. These may include a death certificate, letters from your doctor, a divorce decree, a statement from the Social Security Administration, or other documents to support your claim.
source_blocks.text: 我们可能还需要其他文件来核实与退伍军人的关系或受抚养家属的身份。这些文件可能包括死亡证明、医生证明信、离婚判决书、社会保障管理局的声明或其他支持您申请的文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out which discharge documents we accept along with your applicationFind out how to request the Veteran s DD214
source_blocks.text: 了解我们接受哪些退役文件以及您的申请了解如何申请退伍军人的 DD214

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you can t find these documents, please ask for our help when you call. It may take us 48 hours or more to check eligibility if you don t have discharge documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果您找不到这些文件，请在致电时请求我们的帮助。如果您没有退役文件，我们可能需要 48 小时或更长时间来核实资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Discharge documents aren t usually needed for scheduling when a Veteran or eligible dependent is already interred in a national cemetery.
source_blocks.text: 注意：当退伍军人或符合条件的受抚养家属已安葬在国家公墓时，通常不需要退役文件来安排安葬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need this information about the deceased:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要以下关于逝者的信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name - Gender - Social Security number or Military Service number (Veteran ID) - Date of birth - Relationship to the service member or Veteran whose military service will be used to decide eligibility - Marital status - Date of death (and zip code and county at the time of death)
source_blocks.text: 姓名 - 性别 - 社会安全号码或兵役号码（退伍军人身份证） - 出生日期 - 与将用于决定资格的军人或退伍军人的关系 - 婚姻状况 - 死亡日期（以及死亡时的邮政编码和县）

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need this information about the next-of-kin (the closest living relative of the deceased):
source_blocks.text: 您需要提供以下关于近亲（逝者最亲近的在世亲属）的信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Name - Relationship to the deceased - Social Security number - Phone number - Address
source_blocks.text: 姓名 - 与逝者的关系 - 社会安全号码 - 电话号码 - 地址

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also need more information in certain cases:
source_blocks.text: 在某些情况下，您可能还需要更多信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the person was married, you ll also need the surviving spouse s status as Veteran, service member, or family member. - If the person has any children with disabilities, you ll need the status and detailed information for any disabled children who may be buried in the future in a national cemetery. - If the person s spouse passed away previously and was buried in a VA national cemetery, you ll need the full name of the spouse as well as the cemetery section and site number where they re buried.
source_blocks.text: 如果逝者已婚，您还需要提供尚存配偶作为退伍军人、服役人员或家庭成员的身份。 - 如果逝者有残疾子女，您需要提供未来可能安葬在国家公墓的残疾子女的身份和详细信息。 - 如果逝者的配偶此前已去世并安葬在VA国家公墓，您需要提供配偶的全名以及其安葬的公墓区和墓穴编号。

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Decide on the burial details and gather all related information
source_blocks.text: #### 决定安葬细节并收集所有相关信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to tell us:
source_blocks.text: 您需要告知我们：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The cemetery where you d prefer the Veteran, spouse, or dependent family member be buriedFind a VA national cemeteryFind a state Veterans cemetery - The type of burial you d like for the person (casket or cremation) and the size of the casket or cremation urn - The type of gravesite memorial you d like. This may be a headstone, grave marker, niche cover, or medallion. - Any religious emblem or optional inscription that you d like on the headstone or marker
source_blocks.text: 您希望退伍军人、配偶或受抚养家庭成员安葬的公墓查找VA国家公墓查找州退伍军人公墓 - 您希望为逝者选择的安葬类型（棺葬或火葬）以及棺木或骨灰瓮的尺寸 - 您希望的墓地纪念物类型。这可以是墓碑、墓标、壁龛盖或奖章。 - 您希望在墓碑或墓标上添加的任何宗教标志或可选铭文。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the person is a Veteran or Reservist, you ll also need to tell us if you d like burial honors or memorial items, such as:
source_blocks.text: 如果逝者是退伍军人或预备役人员，您还需要告知我们您是否希望获得安葬荣誉或纪念物品，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A burial flag - A Presidential Memorial Certificate - Other possible military honors beyond the playing of Taps and flag folding and presentation
source_blocks.text: 安葬旗帜 - 总统纪念证书 - 除播放《熄灯号》和折叠并呈递旗帜之外的其他可能的军事荣誉

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request gravesite memorials and burial honorsLearn more about military funeral honors
source_blocks.text: 申请墓地纪念物和安葬荣誉了解更多关于军事葬礼荣誉的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Contact the National Cemetery Scheduling Office
source_blocks.text: #### 联系国家公墓调度办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: The funeral director you ve chosen can help you with these steps too:
source_blocks.text: 您选择的殡仪馆馆长也可以帮助您完成这些步骤：

source_blocks.source_text_en: For burial in a national cemetery, fax any discharge papers to the National Cemetery Scheduling Office at 866-900-6417. Or scan and email the papers to NCA.Scheduling@va.gov with the person s name you re requesting burial benefits for in the subject line.
source_blocks.text: 对于在国家公墓的安葬，请将任何退役文件传真至国家公墓调度办公室，号码为866-900-6417。或者将文件扫描并通过电子邮件发送至NCA.Scheduling@va.gov，并在主题行中注明您为其申请安葬福利的人员姓名。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then call 800-535-1117 to confirm the burial application. Be sure to have all the information handy that s listed above in the Prepare section.
source_blocks.text: 然后致电800-535-1117确认安葬申请。请确保手头有上述“准备”部分列出的所有信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The National Cemetery Scheduling Office is open every day from 8:00 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET. The office is closed Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year s Day. Burials at national cemeteries take place Monday through Friday. When there s a federal holiday on a Monday or Friday, cemeteries may schedule burials either on the actual holiday or on one of the days over the holiday weekend. The National Cemetery Scheduling Office can tell you the available burial times for each cemetery.
source_blocks.text: 国家公墓调度办公室每天从东部时间上午8:00至晚上7:30开放。该办公室在感恩节、圣诞节和元旦关闭。国家公墓的安葬时间为周一至周五。当周一或周五遇到联邦假日时，公墓可能会在假日当天或假日周末的某一天安排安葬。国家公墓调度办公室可以告知您每个公墓可用的安葬时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Would I ever need to contact a national cemetery directly?
source_blocks.text: 我是否需要直接联系国家公墓？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, you should contact a national cemetery directly in these cases. To:
source_blocks.text: 是的，在以下情况下您应该直接联系国家公墓。为了：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule a burial for an active-duty service member Cancel or reschedule a burial Change any information you already provided to the scheduling office Request a disinterment and/or relocation to another national cemetery Get information that s specific to a cemetery, like what can be inscribed on a headstone, the policy for flowers, and the hours of operation
source_blocks.text: 为现役军人安排安葬 取消或重新安排安葬 更改您已提供给调度办公室的任何信息 申请挖掘和/或迁移至另一个国家公墓 获取特定于公墓的信息，例如墓碑上可以刻什么、鲜花政策以及开放时间

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get information about the Burial at Sea program?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得关于海葬计划的信息吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about the Burial at Sea program, please contact the United States Navy Mortuary Affairs office toll-free at 866-787-0081. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET. Get more information about the Burial at Sea program
source_blocks.text: 如果您对海葬计划有疑问，请拨打美国海军丧葬事务办公室的免费电话866-787-0081。我们的服务时间为周一至周五，东部时间上午8:30至下午5:00。获取更多关于海葬计划的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get help paying for burial costs?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得丧葬费用方面的帮助吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the spouse of record (the legally recognized spouse) or a designated (legally chosen) family member of a Veteran, you may be able to get financial help for burial and funeral costs. Find out how to apply for a Veterans burial allowance
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人的在册配偶（法律承认的配偶）或指定（合法选择的）家庭成员，您或许可以获得丧葬和葬礼费用的经济援助。了解如何申请退伍军人丧葬津贴

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule And View VA Appointments Online | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 在线安排和查看VA预约 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule and view VA appointments online
source_blocks.text: 在线安排和查看VA预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: With our VA Appointments tools, you can schedule some VA health care appointments online. You can also view details about upcoming appointments and organize your health calendar. Find out if you re eligible, and how to sign up to begin using these tools on our My HealtheVet health management portal.
source_blocks.text: 通过我们的VA预约工具，您可以在线安排部分VA医疗预约。您还可以查看即将到来的预约详情并管理您的健康日历。了解您是否符合资格，以及如何在我们的My HealtheVet健康管理门户上注册开始使用这些工具。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: 我如何立即与人交谈？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何随时获得支持，无论白天还是夜晚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们富有爱心、经验丰富的Veterans Crisis Line responders联系，获取保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。此服务是私密的、免费的，并且24/7可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: 要随时联系Veterans Crisis Line responder，无论白天还是夜晚：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: 拨打800-273-8255，然后选择1。 开始一次保密的Veterans聊天。 发送短信至838255。 如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：800-799-4889。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打911。 前往最近的急诊室。 直接前往最近的VA医疗中心。无论您的退役身份如何，或者您是否已加入VA医疗保健，都没关系。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: The fastest way to make all your VA appointments is usually to call the VA health facility where you want to receive care. If you can t keep an existing appointment, please contact the facility as soon as possible to reschedule or cancel.Find your VA health facility s phone number
source_blocks.text: 请注意：通常，进行所有VA预约的最快方式是致电您希望接受护理的VA医疗机构。如果您无法赴约，请尽快联系该机构以重新安排或取消。查找您的VA医疗机构电话号码

source_blocks.source_text_en: View your VA appointments online
source_blocks.text: 在线查看您的VA预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule or cancel a VA appointment online
source_blocks.text: 在线安排或取消VA预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can VA Appointments tools help me manage my health care?
source_blocks.text: VA预约工具如何帮助我管理我的医疗保健？

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Appointments tools offer a secure, web-based way to schedule, view, and organize your VA appointments online.
source_blocks.text: VA预约工具提供了一种安全的、基于网络的方式，用于在线安排、查看和组织您的VA预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use these tools to:
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用这些工具来：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule some of your VA medical appointments online Reschedule and cancel appointments made online View appointments on your health calendar Find the location of the VA facility for your appointments Set up email reminders for upcoming appointments Print a list of your future appointments Look up past appointments from the last 2 years Add non-VA appointments to your health calendar
source_blocks.text: 在线安排部分VA医疗预约 重新安排和取消在线进行的预约 在您的健康日历上查看预约 查找您预约的VA设施的位置 为即将到来的预约设置电子邮件提醒 打印您未来预约的列表 查找过去2年的历史预约 将非VA预约添加到您的健康日历

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible to use the VA Appointments tools?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格使用VA预约工具？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use these tools if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下列出的所有要求，您可以使用这些工具。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件都必须满足。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are enrolled in VA health care, and Are scheduling your appointment with a VA health facility that uses online scheduling, and Have had an appointment at that VA health facility within the last 2 years
source_blocks.text: 已注册VA健康护理，并且 正在预约使用在线预约的VA健康机构，并且 在过去2年内曾在该VA健康机构有过预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for VA health care
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请VA健康护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: And, you must have one of these free accounts:
source_blocks.text: 并且，您必须拥有以下免费账户之一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Premium My HealtheVet account, or A Premium DS Logon account (used for eBenefits and milConnect), or A verified ID.me account that you can create here on VA.gov
source_blocks.text: 一个Premium My HealtheVet账户，或 一个Premium DS Logon账户（用于eBenefits和milConnect），或 一个已验证的ID.me账户，您可以在VA.gov上创建

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about the 3 different My HealtheVet account types
source_blocks.text: 了解3种不同的My HealtheVet账户类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know if my VA health facility uses online scheduling?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道我的VA健康机构是否使用在线预约？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can check our list of VA facilities that are currently using the online scheduling tool. We hope to expand the number of VA facilities and types of appointments in the future.
source_blocks.text: 您可以查看我们目前使用在线预约工具的VA机构列表。我们希望未来能扩大VA机构和预约类型的数量。

source_blocks.source_text_en: View a list of VA facilities currently using online scheduling
source_blocks.text: 查看目前使用在线预约的VA机构列表

source_blocks.source_text_en: What types of VA medical appointments can I schedule online?
source_blocks.text: 我可以在线预约哪些类型的VA医疗预约？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This will depend on the VA health facility where you re receiving care.
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您接受护理的VA健康机构。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to schedule outpatient appointments for:
source_blocks.text: 您或许可以预约以下门诊预约：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Primary care Mental health Optometry Audiology
source_blocks.text: 初级护理 心理健康 验光 听力

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check with the specific facility where you re receiving care to ask about scheduling appointments online.See which VA facilities currently use online schedulingFind a VA health facility
source_blocks.text: 请与您接受护理的具体机构核实，询问在线预约事宜。查看目前使用在线预约的VA机构查找VA健康机构

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I use this tool to schedule non-VA appointments?
source_blocks.text: 我可以使用此工具预约非VA预约吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Learn more about getting care from non-VA providers.
source_blocks.text: 不可以。了解更多关于从非VA提供者获得护理的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I schedule appointments through VA Secure Messaging?
source_blocks.text: 我可以通过VA安全消息安排预约吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you use Secure Messaging with your VA health care team, you may be able to use this service to schedule and cancel appointments.Learn more about Secure Messaging
source_blocks.text: 如果您与VA医疗团队使用Secure Messaging，您或许可以通过此服务来安排和取消预约。了解更多关于Secure Messaging的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will my personal health information be protected?
source_blocks.text: 我的个人健康信息会受到保护吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. This is a secure website. We follow strict security policies and practices to protect your personal health information. And only you and your VA health care team will have access to your secure messages.
source_blocks.text: 是的。这是一个安全的网站。我们遵循严格的安全政策和实践来保护您的个人健康信息。并且只有您和您的VA医疗团队能够访问您的安全消息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you print or download any messages, you ll need to take responsibility for protecting that information.Get tips for protecting your personal health information
source_blocks.text: 如果您打印或下载任何消息，您需要负责保护这些信息。获取保护个人健康信息的提示

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I have more questions?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get answers to your questions about these tools within our My HealtheVet web portal.Read VA Appointments FAQs
source_blocks.text: 您可以在我们的My HealtheVet门户网站中找到关于这些工具的答案。阅读VA预约常见问题解答

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also contact the My HealtheVet Help Desk.Find out how to contact us online
source_blocks.text: 您也可以联系My HealtheVet帮助台。了解如何在线联系我们

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or call us at 877-327-0022 (TTY: 800-877-8339). We re here Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. CT.
source_blocks.text: 或致电我们：877-327-0022（TTY：800-877-8339）。我们的服务时间为周一至周五，上午7:00至下午7:00（中部时间）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Last updated:
source_blocks.text: 最后更新：
