source_blocks.source_text_en: Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI)
source_blocks.text: Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI) provides low-cost coverage to eligible service members. If you have a service-connected disability, find out how to apply for S-DVI online or by mail.
source_blocks.text: Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI) provides low-cost coverage to eligible service members. If you have a service-connected disability, find out how to apply for S-DVI online or by mail.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I apply for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?
source_blocks.text: Can I apply for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply for S-DVI if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: You can apply for S-DVI if you meet all of the requirements listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: All of these must be true. You:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Were released from active duty on or after April 25, 1951, and didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, and Were rated for a service-connected disability (even if only 0%), and Are in good health except for any service-connected conditions, and Apply within 2 years from the date we grant your new service-connected disability
source_blocks.text: Were released from active duty on or after April 25, 1951, and didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, and Were rated for a service-connected disability (even if only 0%), and Are in good health except for any service-connected conditions, and Apply within 2 years from the date we grant your new service-connected disability

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: An increase of a rating you had before or a rating of Individual Unemployability, meaning you can t work doesn t qualify you for S-DVI. Watch our video about the benefits of S-DVI
source_blocks.text: Note: An increase of a rating you had before or a rating of Individual Unemployability, meaning you can t work doesn t qualify you for S-DVI. Watch our video about the benefits of S-DVI

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get more life insurance coverage if I need it?
source_blocks.text: Can I get more life insurance coverage if I need it?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you carry the basic S-DVI coverage and become totally disabled and unable to work, you can apply to get up to \$30,000 more in coverage. This is called supplemental S-DVI coverage.
source_blocks.text: If you carry the basic S-DVI coverage and become totally disabled and unable to work, you can apply to get up to \$30,000 more in coverage. This is called supplemental S-DVI coverage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get \$30,000 of supplemental coverage if you qualify for a premiums waiver, and you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get \$30,000 of supplemental coverage if you qualify for a premiums waiver, and you meet both of the requirements listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: Both of these must be true. You:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for the coverage within 1 year from the date you get notice of the grant of waiver, and Are younger than age 65
source_blocks.text: Apply for the coverage within 1 year from the date you get notice of the grant of waiver, and Are younger than age 65

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about premium waivers
source_blocks.text: Learn more about premium waivers

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: Who s covered?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?
source_blocks.text: What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:
source_blocks.text: There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgradeLearn about the VA Character of Discharge review process
source_blocks.text: Find out how to apply for a discharge upgradeLearn about the VA Character of Discharge review process

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of life insurance benefits can I get with Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?
source_blocks.text: What kind of life insurance benefits can I get with Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Up to \$10,000 of coverage Up to \$30,000 of supplemental coverage
source_blocks.text: Up to \$10,000 of coverage Up to \$30,000 of supplemental coverage

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: How do I get these benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for benefits in 1 of 2 ways:
source_blocks.text: You ll need to apply for benefits in 1 of 2 ways:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for basic S-DVI online, or
source_blocks.text: Apply for basic S-DVI online, or

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Application for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (VA Form 29-4364). Download VA Form 29-4364 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: Fill out an Application for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (VA Form 29-4364). Download VA Form 29-4364 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fax it to 888-748-5822, or mail it to:
source_blocks.text: Fax it to 888-748-5822, or mail it to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Veterans Affairs Regional Office and Insurance Center (RH) PO Box 7208 Philadelphia, PA 19101
source_blocks.text: Department of Veterans Affairs Regional Office and Insurance Center (RH) PO Box 7208 Philadelphia, PA 19101

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you want to apply for supplemental S-DVI, you must have already applied for and been granted a waiver of premiums. (See our information below about getting a waiver.) To apply for supplemental S-DVI, file an Application for Supplemental Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance (VA Form 29-0188) or send a letter requesting this insurance over your signature. You must apply for the coverage within one year from the date you receive notice of the grant of waiver of premiums.Download VA Form 29-0188 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: If you want to apply for supplemental S-DVI, you must have already applied for and been granted a waiver of premiums. (See our information below about getting a waiver.) To apply for supplemental S-DVI, file an Application for Supplemental Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance (VA Form 29-0188) or send a letter requesting this insurance over your signature. You must apply for the coverage within one year from the date you receive notice of the grant of waiver of premiums.Download VA Form 29-0188 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will I pay for these benefits?
source_blocks.text: How much will I pay for these benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your premium rate (the amount you ll pay each month for your coverage) depends on all of the factors listed below.
source_blocks.text: Your premium rate (the amount you ll pay each month for your coverage) depends on all of the factors listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your premium rate depends on:
source_blocks.text: Your premium rate depends on:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your age, and The amount of insurance you want, and The coverage plan requested
source_blocks.text: Your age, and The amount of insurance you want, and The coverage plan requested

source_blocks.source_text_en: See the premium rates and a description of the plan options. Download Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance RH Information and Premium Rates (VA pamphlet 29-9)
source_blocks.text: See the premium rates and a description of the plan options. Download Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance RH Information and Premium Rates (VA pamphlet 29-9)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a waiver so I don t have to pay the premiums?
source_blocks.text: Can I get a waiver so I don t have to pay the premiums?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes, in some cases. Under certain conditions, the basic S-DVI policy provides for a waiver of premiums for Veterans who are totally disabled.Learn more about premium waivers
source_blocks.text: Yes, in some cases. Under certain conditions, the basic S-DVI policy provides for a waiver of premiums for Veterans who are totally disabled.Learn more about premium waivers

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must pay your premiums for supplemental S-DVI.
source_blocks.text: You must pay your premiums for supplemental S-DVI.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help with my claim?
source_blocks.text: What if I need help with my claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance or a VA life insurance policy that starts with a V, RH, J, RS, K, or W, you can call the VA Life Insurance Center at 800-669-8477. We re here from 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: If you have questions about Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance or a VA life insurance policy that starts with a V, RH, J, RS, K, or W, you can call the VA Life Insurance Center at 800-669-8477. We re here from 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI)
source_blocks.text: Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a severe service-connected disability that we ve concluded was caused or made worse by your service, you may be able to get Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI). In the event of your death, this mortgage protection insurance can help your family pay off the home mortgage on a home that s been adapted to meet your needs.
source_blocks.text: If you have a severe service-connected disability that we ve concluded was caused or made worse by your service, you may be able to get Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI). In the event of your death, this mortgage protection insurance can help your family pay off the home mortgage on a home that s been adapted to meet your needs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get VMLI, you ll need to apply for our Specially Adapted Housing (SAH) Grant. The SAH grant can help you buy, build, or make changes (like installing ramps or widening doorways) to a home so you can live more independently. When you receive an SAH grant, your Loan Guaranty agent will tell you if you qualify for VMLI and will help you apply.Find out if you qualify for an SAH grant and how to applyFind out if you qualify for VMLI and how to apply

source_blocks.source_text_en: Servicemembers’ Group Life Insurance (SGLI) | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 军人团体人寿保险（SGLI） | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI)
source_blocks.text: 军人团体人寿保险（SGLI）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) offers low-cost term coverage to eligible service members. If you re a service member who meets certain criteria, we ll automatically sign you up. Find out if you re eligible and learn how to manage your SGLI coverage.
source_blocks.text: 军人团体人寿保险（SGLI）为符合条件的服役人员提供低成本定期保险。如果您是符合特定标准的服役人员，我们将自动为您注册。了解您是否符合资格，并学习如何管理您的SGLI保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for SGLI?
source_blocks.text: 我是否符合SGLI资格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get full-time SGLI coverage if any of the descriptions below are true for you.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合以下任何一项描述，您可能有资格获得全职SGLI保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: 至少以下一项必须属实。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: An active-duty member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, or Coast Guard, or A commissioned member of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) or the U.S. Public Health Service (USPHS), or A cadet or midshipman of the U.S. military academies, or A member, cadet, or midshipman of the Reserve Officers Training Corps (ROTC) engaged in authorized training and practice cruises, or A member of the Ready Reserve or National Guard, assigned to a unit, and scheduled to perform at least 12 periods of inactive training per year, or A volunteer in an Individual Ready Reserve (IRR) mobilization category
source_blocks.text: 陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队或海岸警卫队的现役成员，或 国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）或美国公共卫生服务局（USPHS）的委任成员，或 美国军事学院的学员或海军学校学员，或 参与授权训练和实习航行的后备军官训练团（ROTC）成员、学员或海军学校学员，或 预备役或国民警卫队的成员，被分配到某个单位，并计划每年至少进行12次非现役训练，或 个人预备役（IRR）动员类别的志愿者

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re in nonpay status with the Ready Reserve or National Guard
source_blocks.text: 如果您处于预备役或国民警卫队的无薪状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get full-time SGLI coverage if you meet both of the requirements below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两项要求，您可能有资格获得全职SGLI保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须都属实。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Scheduled for 12 periods of inactive training for the year, and Drilling for points rather than pay
source_blocks.text: 计划当年进行12次非现役训练，且 为积分而非薪水进行训练

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You must pay your premiums directly.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您必须直接支付保费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Service members
source_blocks.text: 服役人员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Accessing and managing SGLI while you re serving
source_blocks.text: 在服役期间访问和管理SGLI

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of life insurance benefits can I get with SGLI?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些类型的人寿保险福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get:
source_blocks.text: 您可以获得：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Coverage up to the top limit of \$400,000 in \$50,000 increments 120 days of free coverage from the date you left the military Extension of free coverage for up to 2 years (if you re totally disabled) when you leave the military.See below for information on the SGLI-Disability Extension Part-time coverage (if you re a Reserve member who doesn t qualify for full-time coverage)
source_blocks.text: 最高限额为400,000美元，以50,000美元为增量递增的保险 从您离开军队之日起120天的免费保险 当您离开军队时，如果您完全残疾，免费保险可延长至多2年。请参阅下方关于SGLI残疾延期的信息 兼职保险（如果您是不符合全职保险资格的预备役成员）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for SGLI, we ll automatically sign you up through your service branch. See your unit s personnel office for more information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合SGLI的资格，我们将通过您的军种自动为您注册。详情请咨询您所在单位的人事办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I make changes to my benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我可以更改我的福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You can choose your level of coverage or even refuse coverage completely. You can also choose your beneficiaries (the people you pick to get the money from your life insurance policy if you die) and change them as needed.
source_blocks.text: 可以。您可以选择您的保险金额，甚至完全拒绝保险。您也可以选择您的受益人（您指定在您去世后从人寿保险单中获得保险金的人），并根据需要更改他们。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to change your beneficiaries or reduce, turn down, or restore your SGLI coverage
source_blocks.text: 如何更改您的受益人或减少、拒绝或恢复您的SGLI保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a member of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, or National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, please submit your changes online through the SGLI Online Enrollment System (SOES). To access SOES:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或国家海洋和大气管理局的成员，请通过SGLI在线注册系统（SOES）在线提交您的更改。要访问SOES：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to milConnect
source_blocks.text: 前往milConnect

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in.
source_blocks.text: 登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to Benefits, Life Insurance SOES-SGLI Online Enrollment System.
source_blocks.text: 前往福利，人寿保险SOES-SGLI在线注册系统。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your coverage and beneficiary information and make any needed updates.
source_blocks.text: 检查您的保险和受益人信息，并进行任何必要的更新。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can log in with your CAC or DS Logon using Internet Explorer as soon as you receive a notice that you can start using SOES.
source_blocks.text: 一旦您收到可以开始使用SOES的通知，您就可以使用CAC或DS Logon通过Internet Explorer登录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a member of the Public Health Service, please submit your changes by filling out the Servicemembers Group Life Insurance Election and Certificate (SGLV 8286) and giving it to your unit s personnel officer.Download SGLV 8286 (PDF)Learn more about SOES
source_blocks.text: 如果您是公共卫生署的成员，请填写《军人团体人寿保险选择和证明》（SGLV 8286）并将其交给您单位的人事官员来提交您的更改。下载SGLV 8286（PDF）了解更多关于SOES的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will I pay for these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我将为这些福利支付多少费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have SGLI coverage, you ll pay a monthly premium that ll be automatically taken out of your base pay. The current basic SGLI premium rate is 7 cents per \$1,000 of insurance coverage. The premium includes an additional \$1 per month for Traumatic Injury Protection coverage (TSGLI). Learn more about TSGLI
source_blocks.text: 如果您有SGLI保险，您将每月支付保险费，该费用将自动从您的基本工资中扣除。当前基本SGLI保险费率为每\$1,000保险金额7美分。保险费包括每月额外\$1的创伤性损伤保护保险（TSGLI）。了解更多关于TSGLI的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: These are the SGLI premium rates effective July 1, 2014:
source_blocks.text: 以下是自2014年7月1日起生效的SGLI保险费率：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Applying for VGLI when you separate or retire
source_blocks.text: 在您退役或退休时申请VGLI

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for VGLI when I leave the military?
source_blocks.text: 当我离开军队时如何申请VGLI？

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you leave the military, you can apply for Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI) within 1 year and 120 days from your discharge for up to the amount of coverage you had through SGLI. Learn more about VGLI
source_blocks.text: 当您离开军队时，您可以在退伍后1年零120天内申请退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI），最高保额为您通过SGLI拥有的保险金额。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also convert your SGLI policy into a civilian policy within 120 days from the date you left the military. Learn how to convert your SGLI coverage to an individual policy (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 您还可以在离开军队之日起120天内将您的SGLI保单转换为 civilian 保单。了解如何将您的SGLI保障转换为个人保单（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a free extension of my SGLI coverage if I m disabled when I leave the military?
source_blocks.text: 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保障吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to keep your coverage for up to 2 years after the date you left the military if you re within 2 years of your separation date and you meet either of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在离军日期后2年内，并且满足以下任一要求，您可能可以在离开军队之日起保留保障最多2年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re totally disabled at the time of your discharge and unable to work, or No matter your work status, you ve had one of the following: - Total loss of hearing in both ears - Loss of speech that leaves you unable to talk even in a whisper without the help of an artificial device - Permanent (long-lasting) loss of use of both of your hands, feet, or eyes, or one hand and one foot, or one hand or foot and one eye
source_blocks.text: 您在退伍时完全残疾且无法工作，或 无论您的工作状况如何，您已患有以下情况之一： - 双耳完全失聪 - 丧失言语能力，即使借助人工设备也无法低声说话 - 双手、双脚或双眼，或一只手和一只脚，或一只手或一只脚和一只眼睛永久（长期）丧失功能

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for an SGLI Disability Extension?
source_blocks.text: 我如何申请SGLI残疾延长？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for the Servicemembers Group Life Insurance Disability Extension (SGLI-DE).
source_blocks.text: 您需要申请军人团体人寿保险残疾延长（SGLI-DE）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply, fill out the SGLI Disability Extension Application (SGLV 8715) and send it to the OSGLI address listed on the application. Download SGLV 8715 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要申请，请填写SGLI残疾延长申请表（SGLV 8715）并将其发送至申请表上列出的OSGLI地址。下载SGLV 8715（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you get approved, you ll receive a notice 20 months after your separation date letting you know that your SGLI-DE will end and that you now have the option to pay a premium for Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI).
source_blocks.text: 如果您的申请获得批准，您将在离军日期后20个月收到通知，告知您的SGLI-DE即将结束，并且您现在可以选择支付保费以参加退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you pay the premium, you ll be able to keep your life insurance coverage for as long as you keep paying the premiums. Learn more about VGLI
source_blocks.text: 如果您支付保费，只要您持续支付保费，您就可以保留您的人寿保险保障。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help with my claim?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about Servicemembers or Veterans Group Life Insurance, you can call the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI) at 800-419-1473, or email the Prudential Insurance Company.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对军人或退伍军人团体人寿保险有疑问，您可以拨打军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）电话800-419-1473，或发送电子邮件至保德信保险公司。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Which forms would my family member need?
source_blocks.text: 我的家人需要哪些表格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: To request an advance insurance payment for a service member who s terminally ill, a family member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284).Download SGLV 8284 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a family member would file a Claim for Death Benefits (SGLV 8283).Download SGLV 8283 (PDF) To help a service member get short-term financial support while recovering from a traumatic injury, a family member would work with the service member to file an Application for TSGLI Benefits (SGLV 8600).Download SGLV 8600 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要为患有绝症的军人申请预付保险金，家属需提交加速给付索赔表（SGLV 8284）。下载SGLV 8284（PDF） 要在需要时获得保险金，家属需提交死亡抚恤金索赔表（SGLV 8283）。下载SGLV 8283（PDF） 要帮助军人在创伤性损伤恢复期间获得短期经济支持，家属需与军人共同提交TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600）。下载SGLV 8600（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Special claims
source_blocks.text: Special claims

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do you have a disability that isn t listed on this site as being linked to military service? You may still be able to get disability compensation (payments) or other benefits. If you re a Veteran with a disability we ve concluded is the result of an illness or injury caused or made worse by your active-duty service (called a service-connected disability), you may be able to get special compensation to help with disabilities like the ones listed below.
source_blocks.text: Do you have a disability that isn t listed on this site as being linked to military service? You may still be able to get disability compensation (payments) or other benefits. If you re a Veteran with a disability we ve concluded is the result of an illness or injury caused or made worse by your active-duty service (called a service-connected disability), you may be able to get special compensation to help with disabilities like the ones listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Automobile allowance and adaptive equipment
source_blocks.text: Automobile allowance and adaptive equipment

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service-connected disability prevents you from driving, find out if you can get money to help buy a specially equipped vehicle or make needed changes to your existing vehicle.
source_blocks.text: If your service-connected disability prevents you from driving, find out if you can get money to help buy a specially equipped vehicle or make needed changes to your existing vehicle.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Birth defects linked to Agent Orange
source_blocks.text: Birth defects linked to Agent Orange

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were exposed to specific chemicals while serving in Vietnam, Thailand, or the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and your child has spina bifida or other birth defects, your child may be eligible for disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you were exposed to specific chemicals while serving in Vietnam, Thailand, or the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and your child has spina bifida or other birth defects, your child may be eligible for disability benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Replacing damaged clothing
source_blocks.text: Replacing damaged clothing

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your clothing s been damaged by your prosthetic or orthopedic device or by medicine you re taking for a skin condition find out if you can get money to help buy new clothes.
source_blocks.text: If your clothing s been damaged by your prosthetic or orthopedic device or by medicine you re taking for a skin condition find out if you can get money to help buy new clothes.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Recovery from surgery or an immobilizing disability (convalescence)
source_blocks.text: Recovery from surgery or an immobilizing disability (convalescence)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re recovering from surgery or other treatment that s left you unable to move, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits.
source_blocks.text: If you re recovering from surgery or other treatment that s left you unable to move, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Dental care
source_blocks.text: Dental care

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran, find out if you can get dental care through VA.
source_blocks.text: If you re a Veteran, find out if you can get dental care through VA.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Time spent in a hospital
source_blocks.text: Time spent in a hospital

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you spent time in a VA or VA-approved hospital for a service-connected disability, find out if you can get benefits like disability payments for that time.
source_blocks.text: If you spent time in a VA or VA-approved hospital for a service-connected disability, find out if you can get benefits like disability payments for that time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Being unable to work (Individual Unemployability)
source_blocks.text: Being unable to work (Individual Unemployability)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you can t work because of your service-connected disability, find out if you can get increased disability payments.
source_blocks.text: If you can t work because of your service-connected disability, find out if you can get increased disability payments.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Title 38 U.S.C. 1151 disabilities
source_blocks.text: Title 38 U.S.C. 1151 disabilities

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you suffered an added disability while getting VA medical care or taking part in a VA program designed to help you find, get, or keep a job, find out if you can get disability payments.
source_blocks.text: If you suffered an added disability while getting VA medical care or taking part in a VA program designed to help you find, get, or keep a job, find out if you can get disability payments.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Immediate help for temporary disability needs (prestabilization)
source_blocks.text: Immediate help for temporary disability needs (prestabilization)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you recently ended your active military service and you have a service-connected disability, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits right away.
source_blocks.text: If you recently ended your active military service and you have a service-connected disability, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits right away.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Substance use treatment for Veterans
source_blocks.text: Substance use treatment for Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re struggling with substance use problems, you re not alone. Many Veterans have problems with the use of alcohol, tobacco, street drugs, and prescription medicines. We re here to help. Find out how to get support for substance use problems through VA.
source_blocks.text: If you re struggling with substance use problems, you re not alone. Many Veterans have problems with the use of alcohol, tobacco, street drugs, and prescription medicines. We re here to help. Find out how to get support for substance use problems through VA.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: How do I talk to someone right now?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: You can also:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center

source_blocks.source_text_en: What services does VA provide for Veterans with substance use problems?
source_blocks.text: What services does VA provide for Veterans with substance use problems?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We provide many options for Veterans seeking treatment for substance use problems ranging from unhealthy alcohol use to life-threatening addiction. The services we offer you depend on your specific needs.
source_blocks.text: We provide many options for Veterans seeking treatment for substance use problems ranging from unhealthy alcohol use to life-threatening addiction. The services we offer you depend on your specific needs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer proven medication options, like:
source_blocks.text: We offer proven medication options, like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medically managed detoxification to stop substance use safely, and services to get stable Drug substitution therapies and newer medicines to reduce cravings (like methadone and buprenorphine for opiate addiction) Nicotine replacement or other medicines for stopping tobacco use
source_blocks.text: Medically managed detoxification to stop substance use safely, and services to get stable Drug substitution therapies and newer medicines to reduce cravings (like methadone and buprenorphine for opiate addiction) Nicotine replacement or other medicines for stopping tobacco use

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer counseling and other therapy options, like:
source_blocks.text: We offer counseling and other therapy options, like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Short-term outpatient counseling Intensive outpatient treatment Marriage and family counseling Self-help groups Residential (live-in) care Continuing care and relapse prevention (making sure you don t slip back into the same substance use problems) Special programs for Veterans with specific concerns (like women Veterans, returning combat Veterans, and homeless Veterans)
source_blocks.text: Short-term outpatient counseling Intensive outpatient treatment Marriage and family counseling Self-help groups Residential (live-in) care Continuing care and relapse prevention (making sure you don t slip back into the same substance use problems) Special programs for Veterans with specific concerns (like women Veterans, returning combat Veterans, and homeless Veterans)

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also offer treatment and support for health conditions that can be related to substance use problems, like:
source_blocks.text: We also offer treatment and support for health conditions that can be related to substance use problems, like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Depression
source_blocks.text: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Depression

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about treatment programs for substance use problems
source_blocks.text: Learn more about treatment programs for substance use problems

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access VA services for substance use problems?
source_blocks.text: How do I access VA services for substance use problems?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VA health care program covers services to treat substance use problems. To access these services, first apply for VA health care.Apply for VA health care
source_blocks.text: The VA health care program covers services to treat substance use problems. To access these services, first apply for VA health care.Apply for VA health care

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you ve signed up:
source_blocks.text: Once you ve signed up:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA primary care provider, talk to them about your substance use. Your provider can help you get screened for substance use problems and related issues (like PTSD or depression) and can offer treatment and support as needed. If you don t have a VA primary care provider or have never been seen in a VA hospital or clinic: - Find a Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program near you, or - Call our general information hotline at 800-827-1000, or - Contact your local VA medical center.Find a VA medical center near you If you served in Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF), Operation Iraqi Freedom (OIF), or Operation New Dawn (OND), call your local VA medical center, and ask to speak to the OEF/OIF/OND coordinator.Find a VA medical center near you

Your provider can help you get screened for substance use problems and related issues (like PTSD or depression) and can offer treatment and support as needed. If you don t have a VA primary care provider or have never been seen in a VA hospital or clinic: - Find a Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program near you, or - Call our general information hotline at 800-827-1000, or - Contact your local VA medical center.Find a VA medical center near you If you served in Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF), Operation Iraqi Freedom (OIF), or Operation New Dawn (OND), call your local VA medical center, and ask to speak to the OEF/OIF/OND coordinator.Find a VA medical center near you

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I don t have VA health care benefits?
source_blocks.text: What if I don t have VA health care benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may still be able to get care:
source_blocks.text: You may still be able to get care:

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve served in a combat zone, get free private counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless: - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential (private). - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where can I find more information and support?
source_blocks.text: Where can I find more information and support?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download our Guide to VA Mental Health Services (PDF). Go to our Make the Connection website to hear stories from Veterans about their own experiences with overcoming drug and alcohol problems, and to get access to more resources and support.Visit Make the Connection Visit our self-help resources guide to get links to books, web resources, and mobile applications that have been reviewed and recommended by VA experts.Get self-help resources Visit the resources section of our VA website to find more trusted resources outside VA that can offer information and support.Find resources Download our Stay Quit Coach mobile app designed to help Veterans with PTSD quit smoking. It includes tools to control cravings and manage smoking triggers, messages to keep you going, medication reminders, and more.Get the Stay Quit Coach app

source_blocks.source_text_en: Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance
source_blocks.text: Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about the Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) program. If you re the child or spouse of a Veteran or service member who has died, is captured or missing, or has disabilities, you may be able to get help paying for school or job training through the DEA program also called Chapter 35. Find out if you re eligible for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: Learn about the Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) program. If you re the child or spouse of a Veteran or service member who has died, is captured or missing, or has disabilities, you may be able to get help paying for school or job training through the DEA program also called Chapter 35. Find out if you re eligible for this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for education benefits through the DEA program?
source_blocks.text: Am I eligible for education benefits through the DEA program?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get these benefits if both you and the Veteran or service member meet certain eligibility requirements.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get these benefits if both you and the Veteran or service member meet certain eligibility requirements.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Temporary disability rating after surgery or cast
source_blocks.text: Temporary disability rating after surgery or cast

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are you recovering from surgery or a disability related to your military service that s left you unable to move? You may be able to get a temporary 100% disability rating and disability compensation or benefits if you have this kind of immobilizing disability. Find out if you can get this benefit.
source_blocks.text: Are you recovering from surgery or a disability related to your military service that s left you unable to move? You may be able to get a temporary 100% disability rating and disability compensation or benefits if you have this kind of immobilizing disability. Find out if you can get this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: Can I get disability benefits from VA?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if you ve had surgery or received other treatment at a VA hospital, approved hospital, or outpatient center for a disability related to your military service (called a service-connected disability).
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get disability benefits if you ve had surgery or received other treatment at a VA hospital, approved hospital, or outpatient center for a disability related to your military service (called a service-connected disability).

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you had surgery, both of these must be true for you:
source_blocks.text: If you had surgery, both of these must be true for you:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The surgery required a recovery time of at least one month or reports show that the surgery or treatment was for a service-connected disability, and The surgery resulted in severe issues, like: - Surgical wounds that haven t totally healed - Stumps of recent amputations - Being unable to move due to being put in splints or casts to help with healing (known as therapeutic immobilizations) - Being unable to leave your house (known as house confinement) - Being required to use a wheelchair or crutches
source_blocks.text: The surgery required a recovery time of at least one month or reports show that the surgery or treatment was for a service-connected disability, and The surgery resulted in severe issues, like: - Surgical wounds that haven t totally healed - Stumps of recent amputations - Being unable to move due to being put in splints or casts to help with healing (known as therapeutic immobilizations) - Being unable to leave your house (known as house confinement) - Being required to use a wheelchair or crutches

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you didn t have surgery, this must be true:
source_blocks.text: If you didn t have surgery, this must be true:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You had one or more major joints immobilized by a cast.
source_blocks.text: You had one or more major joints immobilized by a cast.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: Who s covered?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of disability benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: What kind of disability benefits can I get?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Added compensation (payments) while you recover A temporary 100% disability rating
source_blocks.text: Health care Added compensation (payments) while you recover A temporary 100% disability rating

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: How do I get these benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation

source_blocks.source_text_en: Recovery time from either a surgery or the immobilization of a joint by a cast without surgery requires a temporary 100% disability rating for a service-connected disability. The temporary 100% rating may continue for 1 to 3 months depending on your unique case. You may be able to get an extension for up to 3 more months if your case is severe.
source_blocks.text: Recovery time from either a surgery or the immobilization of a joint by a cast without surgery requires a temporary 100% disability rating for a service-connected disability. The temporary 100% rating may continue for 1 to 3 months depending on your unique case. You may be able to get an extension for up to 3 more months if your case is severe.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Example: A Veteran had a left knee injury that resulted in a 30% disability rating. As the knee problem got worse, the Veteran s VA doctor recommended surgery to stop more damage from happening. Since the doctor wouldn t know if the surgery was successful until 3 months after the Veteran s 1-week stay in the hospital, we granted the Veteran a temporary 100% disability rating for 3 months.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Totally Disabled Or Terminally Ill Policyholders | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 完全残疾或身患绝症的投保人 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Totally disabled or terminally ill policyholders
source_blocks.text: 完全残疾或身患绝症的投保人

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have VA life insurance coverage and you become totally disabled or terminally ill, you may be eligible for certain benefit options. Your spouse may also be eligible for certain options if diagnosed with a terminal illness. Learn more about these options and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 如果您拥有VA人寿保险，并且您完全残疾或身患绝症，您可能有资格获得某些福利选项。如果您的配偶被诊断患有绝症，也可能有资格获得某些选项。了解这些选项以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: SGLI extension for policyholders who become disabled Waiver of premiums for policyholders who become totally disabled Accelerated benefits for terminally ill policyholders
source_blocks.text: 针对残疾投保人的SGLI延期 针对完全残疾投保人的保费豁免 针对身患绝症投保人的加速福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: SGLI extension for policyholders who become disabled
source_blocks.text: 针对残疾投保人的SGLI延期

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a free extension of my SGLI coverage if I m disabled when I leave the military?
source_blocks.text: 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保险吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to keep your coverage for up to 2 years after the date you left the military if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两个要求，您可能能够在离开军队之日起最多2年内保留您的保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You re:
source_blocks.text: 以下两点必须都满足。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Within 2 years of your separation date, and Totally disabled or have certain conditions
source_blocks.text: 在您退役日期后的2年内，并且 完全残疾或患有某些疾病

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for the SGLI Disability Extension and how to apply
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合SGLI残疾延期的资格以及如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Waiver of premiums for policyholders who become totally disabled
source_blocks.text: 针对完全残疾投保人的保费豁免

source_blocks.source_text_en: A waiver of premiums means you won t have to pay your life insurance premiums (the monthly payments you make to hold your policy). In most cases, premiums can only be waived up to one year prior to receipt of a claim.
source_blocks.text: 保费豁免意味着您不必支付人寿保险费（您为持有保单而支付的每月款项）。在大多数情况下，保费只能追溯到收到索赔前一年内豁免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get a waiver of your life insurance premiums if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下所有要求，您可能能够获得人寿保险费的豁免。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须都满足：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have a mental or physical disability that prevents you from being able to hold a job, and - You re covered under Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI), and - Your total disability happens before you re 65 years old but after the effective date of your life insurance policy, and - Your total disability continues for at least 6 months in a row
source_blocks.text: 您有精神或身体残疾，使您无法工作，并且 - 您投保了退伍军人服务残疾保险（S-DVI），并且 - 您的完全残疾发生在65岁之前但在您的人寿保险保单生效日期之后，并且 - 您的完全残疾持续至少连续6个月

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are certain exceptions to the above conditions. But if you think you re entitled to a waiver of premiums, you should apply as soon as possible and we ll let you know if you qualify.
source_blocks.text: 上述条件有某些例外。但如果您认为自己有权获得保费豁免，您应尽快申请，我们将告知您是否符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for these benefits as soon as possible after becoming totally disabled. We ll decide if you qualify, and we ll notify you of the decision.
source_blocks.text: 您需要在完全残疾后尽快申请这些福利。我们将决定您是否符合资格，并通知您决定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To apply, fill out and sign a Claim for Disability Insurance (VA Form 29-357). Mail it to the address listed on the form.
source_blocks.text: 如需申请，请填写并签署《残疾保险索赔表》（VA表格29-357），然后邮寄至表格上所列地址。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 29-357 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载VA表格29-357（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Accelerated benefits for terminally ill policyholders
source_blocks.text: 为临终投保人提供的加速给付

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligible Veterans, service members, and covered spouses of service members can get accelerated benefits. With accelerated benefits, you can get up to 50% of the face value of your coverage in increments of \$5,000 paid to you before death.
source_blocks.text: 符合条件的退伍军人、服役人员及其受保配偶可获得加速给付。通过加速给付，您可以在去世前获得保额面值的最高50%，以每次5,000美元的增量支付给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You or your spouse may be able to get benefits early if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您同时满足以下两项要求，您或您的配偶可能可以提前获得给付。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项必须均为属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have SGLI, Family SGLI, or VGLI life insurance, and - You or your covered spouse has a written statement from a doctor saying you have (or your spouse has) 9 months or less to live
source_blocks.text: 您拥有SGLI、家庭SGLI或VGLI人寿保险，并且 - 您或您受保的配偶持有医生出具的书面证明，表明您（或您的配偶）预期寿命为9个月或更短

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Only the insured service member or Veteran may apply for accelerated benefits. No one may apply on their behalf. In the case of a terminally ill spouse, only the insured may apply.
source_blocks.text: 注意：只有受保的服役人员或退伍军人本人可以申请加速给付。任何人均不得代其申请。若配偶为临终患者，则只有受保人本人可以申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Only the insured service member or Veteran may apply for accelerated benefits. No one may apply on their behalf. In the case of a terminally ill spouse, only the insured may apply.
source_blocks.text: 只有受保的服役人员或退伍军人本人可以申请加速给付。任何人均不得代其申请。若配偶为临终患者，则只有受保人本人可以申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use the application form for the type of coverage you have:
source_blocks.text: 请根据您所持保险类型使用相应的申请表：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re an SGLI or VGLI policyholder, fill out a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284). Download the Claim for Accelerated Benefits form
source_blocks.text: 如果您是SGLI或VGLI投保人，请填写《加速给付索赔表》（SGLV 8284）。下载《加速给付索赔表》

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re still on active duty or you re a Reservist, turn in the form to your service branch. They will need to fill out part of the form.
source_blocks.text: 如果您仍在服役或您是预备役人员，请将表格提交给您的军种部门。他们将需要填写表格的一部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran, have your doctor fill out their part of the form, then send the completed form to:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人，请让您的医生填写其部分，然后将填好的表格发送至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Prudential Insurance Company of America PO Box 70173 Philadelphia, PA 19176-0173
source_blocks.text: 美国保德信保险公司 邮政信箱70173 费城，宾夕法尼亚州 19176-0173

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or, fax the form to 877-832-4943.
If you re covered under Family SGLI, fill out a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284A). Download the Claim for Accelerated Benefits form
source_blocks.text: 如果您受家庭SGLI保障，请填写《加速给付索赔表》（SGLV 8284A）。下载《加速给付索赔表》

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to fill out one part of the application, and your doctor will need to fill out another part of it.
source_blocks.text: 您需要填写申请表的一部分，您的医生需要填写另一部分。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We pay the remaining amount of the face value of the insurance policy to your designated beneficiary or beneficiaries (the people you ve picked to get the money from your policy) upon your death. In the case of a terminally ill spouse, we pay the rest of the insurance policy to you upon your spouse s death.
source_blocks.text: 在您去世时，我们将保险单面值的剩余金额支付给您指定的受益人（您选择的从保单中获得款项的人）。若配偶为临终患者，则在您的配偶去世时，我们将保险单的剩余部分支付给您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VA life insurance
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于VA人寿保险的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read chapter 5 of the Servicemembers and Veterans Group Life Insurance HandbookContact the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI)
source_blocks.text: 阅读《军人和退伍军人团体人寿保险手册》第5章联系军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 创伤性损伤保护（TSGLI）| 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)
source_blocks.text: 创伤性损伤保护（TSGLI）

source_blocks.source_text_en: TSGLI (also known as Servicemembers Group Life Insurance Traumatic Injury Protection) provides short-term financial support to help eligible service members recover from a severe injury. If you were covered by SGLI and experienced a traumatic injury while serving in the military, find out how to file a claim for TSGLI or appeal a past decision.
source_blocks.text: TSGLI（也称为军人团体人寿保险创伤性损伤保护）提供短期经济支持，帮助符合条件的服役人员从严重伤害中恢复。如果您在服役期间投保了SGLI并遭受了创伤性损伤，请了解如何提交TSGLI索赔或对先前的决定提出上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
source_blocks.text: 我是否符合TSGLI资格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get TSGLI if you were insured by SGLI when you experienced a traumatic injury, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在遭受创伤性损伤时已投保SGLI，并且满足以下列出的所有要求，您可能可以获得TSGLI。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须成立。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have a scheduled loss that is a direct result of the traumatic injury, and Suffered the traumatic injury before midnight on the day that you left the military, and Suffered a scheduled loss within 2 years (730 days) of the traumatic injury, and Have survived for a period of not less than 7 full days from the date of the traumatic injury (the 7-day period begins on the date and time of the traumatic injury and ends 168 full hours later), and Were an active-duty military member, a Reservist, a National Guard member, on funeral-honors duty, or on 1-day muster duty
source_blocks.text: 有因创伤性损伤直接导致的计划内损失，并且 在离开军队的当天午夜之前遭受了创伤性损伤，并且 在创伤性损伤后2年（730天）内遭受了计划内损失，并且 自创伤性损伤之日起存活了至少7整天（7天期限从创伤性损伤的日期和时间开始，至168整小时后结束），并且 是现役军人、预备役人员、国民警卫队成员、执行葬礼荣誉任务或参加1天召集任务的人员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
source_blocks.text: 是否有任何损伤被排除在TSGLI之外？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. To qualify for TSGLI, none of the descriptions below can be true of your injury.
source_blocks.text: 是的。要符合TSGLI资格，您的损伤不能符合以下任何描述。

source_blocks.source_text_en: None of these can be true. Your injury can t:
source_blocks.text: 以下任何情况都不能成立。您的损伤不能：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be self-inflicted on purpose or the result of an attempt at self-injury, or Involve the use of an illegal drug or a controlled substance that was given or taken without the advice of a medical doctor, or Be the result of medical or surgical treatment of an illness or disease, or Occur while you re committing or trying to commit a felony, or Be the result of a physical or mental illness or disease (not including illness or disease caused by a wound infection; a chemical, biological, or radiological weapon; or accidentally swallowing a contaminated substance)
source_blocks.text: 是故意自残或企图自残的结果，或 涉及使用未经医生建议而给予或服用的非法药物或受控物质，或 是疾病或病症的医疗或手术治疗结果，或 在实施或试图实施重罪时发生，或 是身体或精神疾病或病症的结果（不包括由伤口感染；化学、生物或放射性武器；或意外摄入受污染物质引起的疾病或病症）

source_blocks.source_text_en: View TSGLI loss standards
source_blocks.text: 查看TSGLI损失标准

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get retroactive TSGLI for a past injury?
source_blocks.text: 我能否为过去的损伤获得追溯性TSGLI？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get retroactive TSGLI (meaning that it takes effect starting from a date in the past) if you were injured between October 7, 2001, and November 30, 2005, and you meet all of the TSGLI qualifications listed above.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在2001年10月7日至2005年11月30日期间受伤，并且满足上述所有TSGLI资格条件，您可能可以获得追溯性TSGLI（意味着从过去的某个日期开始生效）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use this benefit no matter where the injury happened whether you were on or off duty and no matter if your SGLI coverage was in effect when you got injured.
source_blocks.text: 无论损伤发生在何处，无论您是否在执行任务，也无论您受伤时SGLI保险是否有效，您都可以使用此福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We ve removed the previous requirement that you must have been injured during Operations Enduring or Iraqi Freedom (OEF or OIF). Find out if you qualify for retroactive benefits
source_blocks.text: 注意：我们已取消了您必须在“持久自由行动”或“伊拉克自由行动”（OEF或OIF）期间受伤的先前要求。了解您是否符合追溯性福利的资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Service members covered by SGLI
source_blocks.text: 受SGLI保障的服役人员

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of life insurance benefits can I get through TSGLI?
source_blocks.text: 通过TSGLI我可以获得哪些类型的人寿保险福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may get \$25,000 to \$100,000 in short-term financial support to help in your recovery from a traumatic injury.
source_blocks.text: 您可能会获得25,000美元至100,000美元的短期经济支持，以帮助您从创伤性损伤中恢复。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re automatically covered through TSGLI if you re signed up for full-time SGLI. This insurance covers you even if your injury happened while you were off duty.
source_blocks.text: 如果您注册了全职SGLI，您将自动获得TSGLI的保障。即使您的伤害发生在非执勤期间，这项保险也会覆盖您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get payments including retroactive TSGLI payments you ll need to apply. To file a claim, fill out the Application for TSGLI Benefits (SGLV 8600), and fax, email, or mail it to us. Look for the address of your service branch on the front page of the form.Download the Application for TSGLI Benefits (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 要获得包括追溯性TSGLI付款在内的款项，您需要提出申请。要提交索赔，请填写TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600），并通过传真、电子邮件或邮寄方式发送给我们。请查看表格首页上您所在军种的地址。下载TSGLI福利申请表（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I appeal a decision if I m denied benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如果我的福利申请被拒绝，我该如何提出上诉？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, look at the denial letter you received from your branch of service. Your letter will tell you if you should use the TSGLI Appeal Request Form (SGLV 8600A) and how long you ll have to submit your appeal.
source_blocks.text: 首先，查看您从所属军种收到的拒绝信。您的信件会告知您是否应使用TSGLI上诉请求表（SGLV 8600A），以及您需要在上诉提交期限内完成。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your letter says to complete this form, fill it out and submit it to your branch of service.Download the TSGLI Appeal Request Form (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 如果您的信件要求您填写此表格，请填写并提交给您所属的军种。下载TSGLI上诉请求表（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will I pay for these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我需要为这些福利支付多少费用？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have SGLI coverage, your SGLI premium (which is automatically deducted from your base pay) includes a \$1-per-month flat-rate premium for TSGLI. This is all you ll pay for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有SGLI保险，您的SGLI保费（会自动从基本工资中扣除）中包含每月1美元的TSGLI固定费率保费。这就是您为此福利需要支付的全部费用。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does your college tuition cost more than what s covered by the Tuition Assistance (TA) program? Find out if you can get more money to help pay for school through the Tuition Assistance Top-Up program.
source_blocks.text: Does your college tuition cost more than what s covered by the Tuition Assistance (TA) program? Find out if you can get more money to help pay for school through the Tuition Assistance Top-Up program.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tutorial Assistance | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: Tutorial assistance
source_blocks.text: 教程援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re using VA educational assistance, and you re struggling with the coursework, we may help you pay for a tutor. Find out how it works.
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在使用VA教育援助，并且在课程学习上遇到困难，我们可能帮助您支付辅导费用。了解其运作方式。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for this benefit?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格获得此福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get this benefit if you re using VA educational assistance and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在使用VA教育援助，并且满足以下列出的所有要求，您就可以获得此福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re enrolled in an educational program for half-time or more, and You re taking a course that s difficult, and You have to take the course as part of your educational program
source_blocks.text: 您注册了半日制或以上的教育项目，并且 您正在修读一门困难的课程，并且 您必须将该课程作为您教育项目的一部分

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Money to pay for a tutor
source_blocks.text: 用于支付辅导费用的资金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: We won t pay more than \$100 per month for tutoring, and we won t pay more than \$1,200 total.
source_blocks.text: 注意：我们每月支付的辅导费用不会超过100美元，且总金额不会超过1,200美元。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get this benefit?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得此福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your course instructor (or teacher) at your school must agree that you need a tutor and write a letter on your behalf. The instructor should send the letter to your school s certifying official and add a copy to your VA student file. If your school approves your need for a tutor, it will assign you a tutor and confirm the tutor s hourly pay. After you get tutoring, you, your tutor, and your school s certifying official must fill out and sign an Application for Individualized Tutorial Assistance (VA Form 22-1990t). If you re using the Post-9/11 GI Bill, your instructor must also sign section 18 of this form. Download VA Form 22-1990t (PDF) The form must be signed and dated on or after the date of the last certified tutoring session (item 12b on the form).
source_blocks.text: 您所在学校的课程讲师（或教师）必须同意您需要辅导，并代表您写一封信。讲师应将信发送给您学校的认证官员，并将副本添加到您的VA学生档案中。 如果您的学校批准您需要辅导，它将为您指派一名辅导员，并确认辅导员的时薪。 在接受辅导后，您、您的辅导员和您学校的认证官员必须填写并签署个性化教程援助申请表（VA表格22-1990t）。如果您使用的是Post-9/11 GI Bill，您的讲师还必须签署此表格的第18部分。下载VA表格22-1990t（PDF） 表格必须在最后一次认证辅导课程日期（表格上的第12b项）当天或之后签署并注明日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re using the Montgomery GI Bill (MGIB), you can get up to \$600 before we charge your benefits. If you re using the Post-9/11 GI Bill or Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA), we won t charge your GI Bill benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您使用的是蒙哥马利GI法案（MGIB），在从您的福利中扣除之前，您最多可以获得600美元。如果您使用的是Post-9/11 GI Bill或受抚养人教育援助（DEA），我们不会从您的GI Bill福利中扣除。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Reservists using the Reserve Educational Assistance Program (REAP) benefit can t also get tutorial assistance.
source_blocks.text: 注意：使用预备役教育援助计划（REAP）福利的预备役人员不能同时获得教程援助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Types of Veteran ID cards
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人身份证类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are many types of identification cards you can use to show you re a Veteran. You only need to have one of them for this purpose. Learn about the different types of VA ID cards and other Veteran ID options.
source_blocks.text: 有许多种身份证件可以用来证明您是退伍军人。为此目的，您只需拥有其中一种即可。了解不同类型的VA身份证和其他退伍军人身份证选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Department of Defense Identification Card
source_blocks.text: 国防部身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Department of Defense (DoD) Identification Card is used to show your military status and to get access to services at military bases. You may also use this card to get discounts offered to Veterans at many stores, businesses, and restaurants. If you have a DoD Identification Card, you don t need to request another type of photo ID card to prove you re a Veteran or to get retail or business discounts.
source_blocks.text: 国防部（DoD）身份证用于显示您的军人身份，并用于获得军事基地的服务。您也可以使用此卡在众多商店、企业和餐馆获得提供给退伍军人的折扣。如果您持有国防部身份证，则无需申请另一种带照片的身份证来证明您是退伍军人或获得零售或商业折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible if one of the descriptions below is true for you.
source_blocks.text: 如果以下描述之一适用于您，您可能符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must describe you. You re:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须适用于您。您是：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Retired from the military, or - On active duty, or - In the National Guard, the Reserves, the Selected Reserves, or Inactive Ready Reserve
source_blocks.text: 从军队退役，或 - 现役，或 - 国民警卫队、预备役、精选预备役或非现役预备役成员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Depending on your status, the DoD issues either a Common Access Card (CAC) or a Uniformed Services ID Card (USID). For both types of DoD cards, you ll need to either be a sponsor or have a sponsor.
source_blocks.text: 注意：根据您的身份，国防部发放通用访问卡（CAC）或军种身份证（USID）。对于这两种类型的国防部卡，您需要是担保人或拥有担保人。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to fill out an Application for Identification Card/DEERS Enrollment (DD Form 1172-2).Download DD Form 1172-2 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 您需要填写身份证/DEERS注册申请表（DD表格1172-2）。下载DD表格1172-2（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Then turn in your completed application to a Real-Time Automated Personnel Identification System (RAPIDS) office for processing.
source_blocks.text: 然后将填写完整的申请表提交至实时自动化人员识别系统（RAPIDS）办公室进行处理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about how to apply for a DoD Identification Card
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于如何申请国防部身份证的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran Health Identification Card
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人健康身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you re enrolled in VA health care, you get a Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC) that you use to check in to your appointments at VA medical centers. You may also use this card to get discounts offered to Veterans at many stores, businesses, and restaurants. If you have a VHIC, you don t need to request another type of photo ID card to prove you re a Veteran or to get retail or business discounts.
source_blocks.text: 当您加入VA医疗保健后，您会获得一张退伍军人健康身份证（VHIC），用于在VA医疗中心预约时签到。您也可以使用此卡在众多商店、企业和餐馆获得提供给退伍军人的折扣。如果您持有VHIC，则无需申请另一种带照片的身份证来证明您是退伍军人或获得零售或商业折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You need to be enrolled in VA health care to receive a Veteran Health Identification Card. If you aren t signed up for VA health care, you can apply online now.
source_blocks.text: 您需要加入VA医疗保健才能获得退伍军人健康身份证。如果您尚未注册VA医疗保健，您现在可以在线申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for VA health care - Learn more about the VHIC
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请VA医疗保健 - 了解更多关于VHIC的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran ID Card
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人身份证

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veteran ID Card (VIC) is a form of photo ID you can use to get discounts offered to Veterans at many stores, businesses, and restaurants. When you have this card, you won t need to carry around your military discharge papers or share sensitive personal information to receive discounts. If you have a VIC, you don t need to request another type of photo ID card to prove you re a Veteran or to get retail or business discounts.
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人身份证（VIC）是一种带照片的身份证，您可以使用它在众多商店、企业和餐馆获得提供给退伍军人的折扣。当您持有此卡时，您无需随身携带军人退役文件或分享敏感的个人信息即可获得折扣。如果您持有VIC，则无需申请另一种带照片的身份证来证明您是退伍军人或获得零售或商业折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您满足以下两项要求，您可能符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项都必须属实。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Served on active duty, in the Reserves, or in the National Guard (including the Coast Guard), and - Received an honorable or general discharge (under honorable conditions)
source_blocks.text: 曾在现役、预备役或国民警卫队（包括海岸警卫队）服役，并且 - 获得荣誉退伍或一般退伍（在荣誉条件下）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable character of discharge, you re not eligible for a Veteran ID Card. If you have an uncharacterized or unknown discharge status, we ll have to verify your eligibility before we approve your application.
source_blocks.text: 如果您获得的退伍类型为不荣誉、行为不良或不光彩退伍，则您不符合 Veteran ID Card 的资格。如果您的退伍状态未明确或未知，我们需要在批准您的申请前核实您的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply online now.Learn more about how to apply for a VIC
source_blocks.text: 您现在可以在线申请。了解更多关于如何申请 VIC 的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran s designation on a state-issued driver s license or ID
source_blocks.text: 州颁发的驾驶执照或身份证上的退伍军人标识

source_blocks.source_text_en: At this time, all 50 states and Puerto Rico offer a Veteran designation (an identifying mark) printed on state-issued driver s licenses or IDs. The type of Veteran designation may vary from state to state. If you have a Veteran s designation, you may be able to get discounts offered to Veterans at many stores, businesses, and restaurants.
source_blocks.text: 目前，所有 50 个州和波多黎各都提供在州颁发的驾驶执照或身份证上打印退伍军人标识（一种识别标记）。退伍军人标识的类型可能因州而异。如果您有退伍军人标识，您可能能够在许多商店、企业和餐厅获得提供给退伍军人的折扣。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Most states ask you to provide a copy of your discharge papers (DD214 or other separation documents). Some states may require additional documents.
source_blocks.text: 大多数州要求您提供退伍文件（DD214 或其他分离文件）的副本。有些州可能要求额外的文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please check with your state s Department of Motor Vehicles about what you need to apply for a Veteran s designation for your state.
source_blocks.text: 请咨询您所在州的机动车管理局，了解您申请州退伍军人标识所需的条件。

source_blocks.text: Undergraduate and graduate degrees

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you can use GI Bill benefits for college as a Veteran, service member, or qualified dependent. Learn about payment rates for undergraduate and graduate degree courses at institutions of higher learning like a 4-year university, community college, or graduate school.
source_blocks.text: Find out if you can use GI Bill benefits for college as a Veteran, service member, or qualified dependent. Learn about payment rates for undergraduate and graduate degree courses at institutions of higher learning like a 4-year university, community college, or graduate school.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do you decide what my payments will be?
source_blocks.text: How do you decide what my payments will be?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We decide your payment amounts based on the number of classes you go to and the hours spent in those classes. For example, for most undergraduate degrees, a college considers:
source_blocks.text: We decide your payment amounts based on the number of classes you go to and the hours spent in those classes. For example, for most undergraduate degrees, a college considers:

source_blocks.source_text_en: 12 or more hours full time Between 9 and 11 hours three-quarter time Between 6 and 8 hours half time Less than 6 hours reimbursable at a rate that s no more than the tuition and fees charged for the course

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much does VA cover for graduate-level programs?
source_blocks.text: How much does VA cover for graduate-level programs?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The school decides how to rate each hour. For example, if a graduate program at your school considers a 2-hour class full time, we ll pay you the full-time rate.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I take classes at more than one school at a time?
source_blocks.text: Can I take classes at more than one school at a time?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can take classes at more than one school under the GI Bill as long as:
source_blocks.text: You can take classes at more than one school under the GI Bill as long as:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The classes at both schools count toward your degree, and The school granting your degree considers the classes at the second school to be required in order to get your degree

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: The GI Bill won t pay you to take the same class twice unless you get a failing grade in a class that the school requires for graduation.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I use the GI Bill to pay for classes toward more than one degree?
source_blocks.text: Can I use the GI Bill to pay for classes toward more than one degree?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. After earning your first degree, you can use any GI Bill benefits you have left over to pay for classes for another degree.
source_blocks.text: Yes. After earning your first degree, you can use any GI Bill benefits you have left over to pay for classes for another degree.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How does VA make the payments?
source_blocks.text: How does VA make the payments?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We issue payments after each month s classes. For example, you ll get the payment for November classes in December.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve filed a claim for disability compensation, you can continue uploading more evidence for up to one year to support your claim. Evidence may include supporting documents like medical test results, doctor s reports, and other records. Upload your evidence online now.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I upload evidence online to support my disability claim?
source_blocks.text: How do I upload evidence online to support my disability claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can upload evidence to support your disability claim through our claim tracking tool. This tool also helps you check the status of your claim.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I filed a standard disability claim, when should I upload evidence?
source_blocks.text: If I filed a standard disability claim, when should I upload evidence?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Upload your evidence as soon as you can.
source_blocks.text: Upload your evidence as soon as you can.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can continue uploading documents for up to one year from the date we receive your claim. But, if you don t provide any evidence or give us the information we need to help you get evidence within 30 days, we may make a decision on your claim earlier.
source_blocks.text: You can continue uploading documents for up to one year from the date we receive your claim. But, if you don t provide any evidence or give us the information we need to help you get evidence within 30 days, we may make a decision on your claim earlier.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we decide your claim early, you ll still have the rest of the one-year period to provide more information or evidence.
source_blocks.text: If we decide your claim early, you ll still have the rest of the one-year period to provide more information or evidence.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens if I upload more evidence after I ve submitted a fully developed claim?
source_blocks.text: What happens if I upload more evidence after I ve submitted a fully developed claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll remove your disability claim from the Fully Developed Claims program and process it as a standard claim.
source_blocks.text: We ll remove your disability claim from the Fully Developed Claims program and process it as a standard claim.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we decide your claim earlier than one year from the date we received the claim, you ll still have the rest of the year to provide any additional information or evidence.
source_blocks.text: If we decide your claim earlier than one year from the date we received the claim, you ll still have the rest of the year to provide any additional information or evidence.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kinds of documents should I upload to support my disability claim?
source_blocks.text: What kinds of documents should I upload to support my disability claim?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Federal and state records
source_blocks.text: Federal and state records

source_blocks.source_text_en: These include copies of:
source_blocks.text: These include copies of:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your military medical records Your military personnel records Any Social Security Administration or other federal or state medical treatment records Any treatment or personnel records from your National Guard or Reserve unit that support your claim (if you ve served in either of these branches)
source_blocks.text: Your military medical records Your military personnel records Any Social Security Administration or other federal or state medical treatment records Any treatment or personnel records from your National Guard or Reserve unit that support your claim (if you ve served in either of these branches)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have copies of these records, you can ask us to request them for you as part of the claim process.
source_blocks.text: If you don t have copies of these records, you can ask us to request them for you as part of the claim process.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Private medical treatment records
source_blocks.text: Private medical treatment records

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you ve seen a non-VA health care provider for diagnosis or treatment, you ll need to upload copies of all medical records that can provide information about the disability you re claiming.
source_blocks.text: If you ve seen a non-VA health care provider for diagnosis or treatment, you ll need to upload copies of all medical records that can provide information about the disability you re claiming.

source_blocks.source_text_en: These may include evidence like:
source_blocks.text: These may include evidence like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Doctor s reports X-rays Medical lab or test results

source_blocks.source_text_en: Supporting statements
source_blocks.text: Supporting statements

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re claiming a disability for an injury or illness that you don t think we have in your military records, you ll also want to upload statements that support your claim. These statements should be from people who know about, or who you ve talked to about, your claimed medical condition and how and when it occurred.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can ask for supporting statements from people like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Benefits Questionnaires (DBQs)
source_blocks.text: Disability Benefits Questionnaires (DBQs)

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can help speed up your claim by using Disability Benefits Questionnaires (DBQs). These forms ask for specific information we need to determine a disability rating for different medical conditions. You can help to make sure that our ratings specialists have exactly what they need to make a decision on your claim by asking your VA or non-VA community health care provider to fill out one or more DBQs.
source_blocks.text: You can help speed up your claim by using Disability Benefits Questionnaires (DBQs). These forms ask for specific information we need to determine a disability rating for different medical conditions. You can help to make sure that our ratings specialists have exactly what they need to make a decision on your claim by asking your VA or non-VA community health care provider to fill out one or more DBQs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can search for DBQs to download by form name or by symptom. Find VA DBQs to take to your health care provider

source_blocks.source_text_en: Any additional forms needed to support your claim
source_blocks.text: Any additional forms needed to support your claim

source_blocks.source_text_en: In some cases, you may need to turn in one or more additional forms to support your disability claim. See if you need to complete any additional forms
source_blocks.text: In some cases, you may need to turn in one or more additional forms to support your disability claim. See if you need to complete any additional forms

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I upload evidence to support an appeal?
source_blocks.text: Can I upload evidence to support an appeal?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. You can only upload evidence to support your initial disability claim. Learn more about filing an appeal
