source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Agent Orange Registry exam
source_blocks.text: VA Agent Orange Registry exam

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you think you had contact with Agent Orange, an herbicide used to clear trees and plants during the Vietnam War, or other herbicides while serving in the military, you can request a VA Agent Orange Registry health exam. Even if you don t have a known illness, the exam could alert you to illnesses that may be related to contact with herbicides. By being part of this registry, you re also helping your fellow Veterans by giving us information so we can better understand and serve those affected by Agent Orange related illnesses.
source_blocks.text: If you think you had contact with Agent Orange, an herbicide used to clear trees and plants during the Vietnam War, or other herbicides while serving in the military, you can request a VA Agent Orange Registry health exam. Even if you don t have a known illness, the exam could alert you to illnesses that may be related to contact with herbicides. By being part of this registry, you re also helping your fellow Veterans by giving us information so we can better understand and serve those affected by Agent Orange related illnesses.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get an Agent Orange Registry health exam?
source_blocks.text: Can I get an Agent Orange Registry health exam?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get an Agent Orange Registry health exam if you served in any of the ways listed below.
source_blocks.text: You can get an Agent Orange Registry health exam if you served in any of the ways listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must have served in one of these ways:
source_blocks.text: You must have served in one of these ways:

source_blocks.source_text_en: In Vietnam between 1962 and 1975 for any length of time, including in the inland waterways (Brown Water Navy) and within the 12-mile territorial seas (Blue Water Navy), or In Korea in a unit in or near the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) anytime between April 1, 1968, and August 31, 1971, or In Thailand (U.S. Air Force Veterans) on Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) bases near U-Tapao, Ubon, Nakhon Phanom, Udorn, Takhli, Korat, and Don Muang near the air base perimeter anytime between February 28, 1961, and May 7, 1975, or In Thailand (U.S. Army Veterans) as perimeter security personnel on RTAF bases in Thailand anytime between February 28, 1961, and May 7, 1975, or In Thailand (U.S. Army Veterans) on some small Army installations in Thailand anytime between February 28, 1961, and May 7, 1975 if you were a member of a military police (MP) unit or assigned a job with duty placing you at or near the base perimeter, or In other locations, but you had contact with herbicides during a military operation or while testing, transporting, or spraying herbicides for military purposes

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: How do I get these benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: To schedule your exam, contact your local VA environmental health coordinator. If you qualify, you won t have to pay anything for this exam. It s free for qualified Veterans. Find a VA environmental health coordinator near you
source_blocks.text: To schedule your exam, contact your local VA environmental health coordinator. If you qualify, you won t have to pay anything for this exam. It s free for qualified Veterans. Find a VA environmental health coordinator near you

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I expect at the exam?
source_blocks.text: What should I expect at the exam?

source_blocks.source_text_en: The exam will include:
source_blocks.text: The exam will include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your history of contact with Agent Orange and other herbicides Your health history (including any major illnesses or surgeries you may have had) A physical exam Medical tests that may be needed (like blood tests, X-rays, or other imaging tests)
source_blocks.text: Your history of contact with Agent Orange and other herbicides Your health history (including any major illnesses or surgeries you may have had) A physical exam Medical tests that may be needed (like blood tests, X-rays, or other imaging tests)

source_blocks.source_text_en: A VA health care provider will go over your exam and test results with you. You ll also get a letter with the details of your results.

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Benefits For Service Members | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 军人退伍军人福利 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA benefits for service members
source_blocks.text: 军人退伍军人福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're serving on active duty in the United States uniformed services, including active National Guard and Reserve with federal pay, you may be eligible for VA benefits both during service and after separation or retirement. If you're a traditional or technical member of the National Guard and Reserve, you may also be eligible for some VA benefits. Find out which benefits you may qualify for and when to apply. You'll also learn about these benefits in your required Transition Assistance Program (TAP) briefing.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在美国统一军种中现役服役，包括有联邦薪金的现役国民警卫队和预备役，您在服役期间以及退役或退休后可能有资格获得退伍军人事务部福利。如果您是国民警卫队和预备役的传统或技术成员，您也可能有资格获得一些退伍军人事务部福利。了解您可能有资格获得哪些福利以及何时申请。您还将在必需的过渡援助计划（TAP）简报中了解这些福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA benefits you can use during and after service Time-sensitive VA benefits to consider when separating or retiring Other VA benefits to consider as a Veteran
source_blocks.text: 您在服役期间和服役后可以使用的退伍军人事务部福利 分离或退休时需要考虑的有时限的退伍军人事务部福利 作为退伍军人需要考虑的其他退伍军人事务部福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get free mental health care for a year after separation no matter your discharge status, service history, or eligibility for VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 无论您的退役状态、服役历史或是否有资格获得退伍军人事务部医疗保健，在退役后一年内获得免费的心理健康护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get care now
source_blocks.text: 立即获得护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need support for a specific mental health problem or if you re having problems sleeping, controlling your anger, or readjusting to civilian life you are not alone. And we can help.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要针对特定心理健康问题的支持，或者您睡眠困难、控制愤怒困难或难以重新适应平民生活，您并不孤单。我们可以提供帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To access free VA mental health services right away:
source_blocks.text: 要立即获得免费的退伍军人事务部心理健康服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call or walk in to any VA medical center anytime, day or night.Find your nearest VA health facility Call or walk in to any Vet Center during clinic hours.Find your nearest Vet Center Call us at 1-877-222-VETS (1-877-222-8387). We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 1-800-877-8339.
source_blocks.text: 随时（白天或夜晚）致电或走进任何退伍军人事务部医疗中心。查找离您最近的退伍军人事务部卫生机构 在诊所营业时间内致电或走进任何退伍军人中心。查找离您最近的退伍军人中心 致电我们：1-877-222-VETS (1-877-222-8387)。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00提供服务。如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：1-800-877-8339。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to be enrolled in VA health care to get care.Learn more about accessing VA mental health services
source_blocks.text: 您无需注册退伍军人事务部医疗保健即可获得护理。了解更多关于获取退伍军人事务部心理健康服务的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with other resources for Veterans and transitioning service members:
source_blocks.text: 要联系其他面向退伍军人和过渡期军人的资源：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the Department of Defense (DoD) Military OneSource website Visit our mental health site for transitioning service members Read about our commitment to supporting transitioning Veterans
source_blocks.text: 访问国防部（DoD）军事一号来源网站 访问我们为过渡期军人提供的心理健康网站 阅读我们关于支持过渡期退伍军人的承诺

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA benefits you can use during and after service
source_blocks.text: 您在服役期间和服役后可以使用的退伍军人事务部福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill and other education benefits
source_blocks.text: GI法案和其他教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for VA education benefits to help pay for school or training. If you qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, learn how to transfer your unused benefits to your spouse or dependent children. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得退伍军人事务部教育福利，以帮助支付学校或培训费用。如果您符合9/11后退伍军人法案的资格，了解如何将未使用的福利转移给您的配偶或受抚养子女。面向军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）和退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Certificate of Eligibility for a VA-backed home loan
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部支持住房贷款的资格证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review the requirements for getting a Certificate of Eligibility (COE) to buy, build, improve, or refinance a home. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 查看获得资格证明（COE）以购买、建造、改善或再融资房屋的要求。面向军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）和退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance for you and your family
source_blocks.text: 为您和您的家人提供人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for and how to manage your SGLI coverage, and learn about coverage options for you and your family after separation or retirement. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合SGLI保险的资格以及如何管理您的SGLI保险，并了解您和您的家人在退役或退休后的保险选择。适用于军人和退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Time-sensitive VA benefits to consider when separating or retiring
source_blocks.text: 分离或退休时需要考虑的具有时效性的VA福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pre-discharge disability claim
source_blocks.text: 退役前残疾索赔

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have an illness or injury that you believe was caused or made worse by your service, learn how to file a disability claim through the Benefits Delivery at Discharge program. This may help speed up your claim so you can get your benefits sooner. You'll need to file 180 to 90 days before separation. Open to active-duty service members, Guard members, and Reservists
source_blocks.text: 如果您认为某种疾病或伤害是由您的服役引起或加重的，请了解如何通过“退役时福利交付”计划提交残疾索赔。这可能有助于加快您的索赔，使您更快获得福利。您需要在退役前180至90天内提交。适用于现役军人、国民警卫队成员和预备役人员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Converting your life insurance after separation
source_blocks.text: 退役后转换人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to convert your SGLI coverage to a Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) or commercial policy. Learn about other options for coverage if you have service-connected disabilities. In some cases, you must act within 120 days of separation to ensure no lapse in coverage. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解如何将您的SGLI保险转换为退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）或商业保单。如果您有与服务相关的残疾，请了解其他保险选项。在某些情况下，您必须在退役后120天内采取行动，以确保保险不中断。适用于军人和退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational and career counseling
source_blocks.text: 教育和职业咨询

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get support transitioning to a civilian career with free educational and career counseling (also called Chapter 36). You'll need to apply between 6 months before and 1 year after separation. Open to active-duty service members and Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 通过免费的教育和职业咨询（也称为第36章）获得向平民职业过渡的支持。您需要在退役前6个月至退役后1年之间申请。仅适用于现役军人和退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Active-duty service members and VA health care
source_blocks.text: 现役军人及VA医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about your health care options after separation or retirement and how to apply for VA health care when you receive your separation or retirement orders. If you're a combat Veteran, apply right away to take advantage of 5 years of enhanced eligibility. Open to active-duty service members and Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 了解您退役或退休后的医疗保健选项，以及在收到退役或退休命令后如何申请VA医疗保健。如果您是战斗退伍军人，请立即申请以利用5年的增强资格。仅适用于现役军人和退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment
source_blocks.text: 职业康复与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, find out how to apply for vocational rehab. You can apply up to 12 years from when you receive your notice of separation or your first VA disability rating. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与服务相关的残疾，限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，请了解如何申请职业康复。您可以在收到退役通知或首次VA残疾评定之日起12年内申请。适用于军人和退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits to consider as a Veteran
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人需要考虑的其他VA福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 残疾补偿

source_blocks.source_text_en: File a claim for disability compensation for conditions related to your military service, and manage your benefits over time. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 为与您的军事服务相关的状况提交残疾补偿索赔，并随时间管理您的福利。适用于退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Support for Veteran-owned small businesses
source_blocks.text: 对退伍军人拥有的小企业的支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served on active duty, register to do business with VA and get support for your Veteran-owned small business. If you have a service-connected disability related to active-duty service or training, you may qualify to register as a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在现役服役，请注册与VA开展业务，并获得对您退伍军人拥有的小企业的支持。如果您有与现役服役或训练相关的服务相关残疾，您可能有资格注册为服务残疾退伍军人拥有的小企业。适用于退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Pension program
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人养老金计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served on active duty during wartime, are at least 65 years old or have a service-connected disability, and have limited or no income, find out if you qualify for Veterans Pension benefits. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 如果您在战时服过现役，年满65岁或患有与服务相关的残疾，且收入有限或没有收入，请了解您是否有资格获得退伍军人养老金福利。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Aid and attendance or housebound allowance
source_blocks.text: 援助和出勤或居家津贴

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help with your daily activities or you re housebound, check whether you're eligible to have increased aid added to your monthly Veterans Pension payments. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 如果您在日常活动中需要帮助，或者您被困在家中，请检查您是否有资格在每月的退伍军人养老金支付中增加援助。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability housing grants
source_blocks.text: 残疾住房补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability, find out how to apply for a housing grant to make changes to your home so you can live more independently. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与服务相关的残疾，请了解如何申请住房补助金，以便对您的房屋进行改造，使您能够更独立地生活。面向退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: More life insurance options
source_blocks.text: 更多人寿保险选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore life insurance coverage options and services for you and your family, and manage your policy online. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 探索为您和您的家人提供的寿险保障选项和服务，并在线管理您的保单。面向退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pre-need eligibility determination for burial in a VA national cemetery
source_blocks.text: 预先确定是否符合在VA国家公墓安葬的资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for a pre-need eligibility decision letter to confirm that you qualify for burial in a VA national cemetery. This can help you pre-plan, and it can make the process easier for your family members in their time of need. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 申请预先确定资格决定信，以确认您有资格在VA国家公墓安葬。这可以帮助您提前规划，并可以在您的家人需要时使流程更加简便。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for VA education benefits to help pay for school or training. If you qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, learn how to transfer your unused benefits to your spouse or dependent children. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得VA教育福利，以帮助支付学费或培训费用。如果您符合Post-9/11 GI Bill的资格，了解如何将未使用的福利转移给您的配偶或受抚养子女。面向服役人员和退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Certificate of Eligibility for a VA-backed home loan
source_blocks.text: VA支持住房贷款的资格证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review the requirements for getting a Certificate of Eligibility (COE) to buy, build, improve, or refinance a home. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 查看获得Certificate of Eligibility (COE)的要求，以购买、建造、改善或再融资房屋。面向服役人员和退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance for you and your family
source_blocks.text: 为您和您的家人提供人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for and how to manage your SGLI coverage, and learn about coverage options for you and your family after separation or retirement. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合SGLI保险的资格以及如何管理您的SGLI保险，并了解您或家人在退役或退休后的保险选项。适用于军人及退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Time-sensitive VA benefits to consider when separating or retiring
source_blocks.text: 退役或退休时需考虑的时效性VA福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pre-discharge disability claim
source_blocks.text: 退役前残疾索赔

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have an illness or injury that you believe was caused or made worse by your service, learn how to file a disability claim through the Benefits Delivery at Discharge program. This may help speed up your claim so you can get your benefits sooner. You'll need to file 180 to 90 days before separation. Open to active-duty service members, Guard members, and Reservists
source_blocks.text: 如果您认为某种疾病或伤害是由服役引起或加重的，请了解如何通过Benefits Delivery at Discharge计划提交残疾索赔。这可能有助于加快您的索赔进程，使您更快获得福利。您需要在退役前180至90天内提交。适用于现役军人、国民警卫队成员和预备役人员

source_blocks.source_text_en: Converting your life insurance after separation
source_blocks.text: 退役后转换人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to convert your SGLI coverage to a Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) or commercial policy. Learn about other options for coverage if you have service-connected disabilities. In some cases, you must act within 120 days of separation to ensure no lapse in coverage. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 了解如何将您的SGLI保险转换为Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)或商业保单。了解如果您有与服务相关的残疾，其他保险选项。在某些情况下，您必须在退役后120天内采取行动，以确保保险不中断。适用于军人及退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational and career counseling
source_blocks.text: 教育和职业咨询

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get support transitioning to a civilian career with free educational and career counseling (also called Chapter 36). You'll need to apply between 6 months before and 1 year after separation. Open to active-duty service members and Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 通过免费的教育和职业咨询（也称为Chapter 36）获得向平民职业过渡的支持。您需要在退役前6个月至退役后1年内申请。仅适用于现役军人和退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Active-duty service members and VA health care
source_blocks.text: 现役军人及VA医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about your health care options after separation or retirement and how to apply for VA health care when you receive your separation or retirement orders. If you're a combat Veteran, apply right away to take advantage of 5 years of enhanced eligibility. Open to active-duty service members and Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 了解您退役或退休后的医疗保健选项，以及在收到退役或退休命令后如何申请VA医疗保健。如果您是战斗退伍军人，请立即申请，以利用5年的增强资格。仅适用于现役军人和退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment
source_blocks.text: 职业康复与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, find out how to apply for vocational rehab. You can apply up to 12 years from when you receive your notice of separation or your first VA disability rating. Open to service members and Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与服务相关的残疾，限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，请了解如何申请职业康复。您可以在收到退役通知或首次VA残疾评定之日起12年内申请。适用于军人及退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits to consider as a Veteran
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人需考虑的其他VA福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 残疾补偿

source_blocks.source_text_en: File a claim for disability compensation for conditions related to your military service, and manage your benefits over time. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 为与您的军事服务相关的状况提交残疾补偿索赔，并随时间管理您的福利。适用于退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Support for Veteran-owned small businesses
source_blocks.text: 对退伍军人拥有的小企业的支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served on active duty, register to do business with VA and get support for your Veteran-owned small business. If you have a service-connected disability related to active-duty service or training, you may qualify to register as a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果您曾在现役服役，请注册与VA开展业务，并获得对您退伍军人拥有的小企业的支持。如果您有与现役服役或训练相关的服务相关残疾，您可能有资格注册为服务残疾退伍军人拥有的小企业。适用于退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Pension program
source_blocks.text: Veterans Pension 计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served on active duty during wartime, are at least 65 years old or have a service-connected disability, and have limited or no income, find out if you qualify for Veterans Pension benefits. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 如果你在战时服役于现役，年满65岁或拥有与服务相关的残疾，且收入有限或没有收入，请了解你是否有资格获得 Veterans Pension 福利。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Aid and attendance or housebound allowance
source_blocks.text: 援助和出勤或居家津贴

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help with your daily activities or you re housebound, check whether you're eligible to have increased aid added to your monthly Veterans Pension payments. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 如果你在日常活动中需要帮助或居家，请检查你是否有资格在每月的 Veterans Pension 付款中增加援助。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability housing grants
source_blocks.text: 残疾住房补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability, find out how to apply for a housing grant to make changes to your home so you can live more independently. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 如果你有与服务相关的残疾，请了解如何申请住房补助金，以对你的房屋进行改造，使你能够更独立地生活。面向退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: More life insurance options
source_blocks.text: 更多人寿保险选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore life insurance coverage options and services for you and your family, and manage your policy online. Open to Veterans (active duty, Guard, and Reserve)
source_blocks.text: 探索为你和你的家人提供的人寿保险覆盖选项和服务，并在线管理你的保单。面向退伍军人（现役、国民警卫队和预备役）开放

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pre-need eligibility determination for burial in a VA national cemetery
source_blocks.text: 预先资格确定：VA 国家公墓安葬

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for a pre-need eligibility decision letter to confirm that you qualify for burial in a VA national cemetery. This can help you pre-plan, and it can make the process easier for your family members in their time of need. Open to active-duty Veterans only
source_blocks.text: 申请预先资格决定信，以确认你有资格在 VA 国家公墓安葬。这可以帮助你提前规划，并可以在你的家人需要时简化流程。仅面向现役退伍军人开放

documents.title: VA 索赔检查（C&P 检查）| 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA claim exam (C&P exam) | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA 索赔检查（C&P 检查）| 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA claim exam (C&P exam)
source_blocks.text: VA 索赔检查（C&P 检查）

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you file your disability benefits claim, we may ask you to have a claim exam (also known as a compensation and pension, or C&P, exam). Get answers to commonly asked questions about the VA claim exam below.
source_blocks.text: 提交残疾福利索赔后，我们可能会要求您进行索赔检查（也称为补偿和养老金检查，或 C&P 检查）。在下方获取关于 VA 索赔检查常见问题的解答。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Be sure not to miss your scheduled exam.
source_blocks.text: 务必不要错过您预定的检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you miss your exam, we may not be able to reschedule you right away, and your claim may be delayed while you wait for a new appointment. Or we may need to rate your claim as-is. This means we ll base our decision about your disability benefits only on the evidence we have in your file, which may not be enough.
source_blocks.text: 如果您错过了检查，我们可能无法立即为您重新安排，您的索赔可能会在等待新预约期间被延迟。或者我们可能需要按现状评定您的索赔。这意味着我们将仅根据您档案中已有的证据来决定您的残疾福利，而这些证据可能不足。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why might I need a VA claim exam?
source_blocks.text: 为什么我可能需要进行 VA 索赔检查？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This exam will help us rate your disability. Your rating will be based on how severe your disability is and will affect how much disability compensation you ll receive. Compensation may include things like monthly payments and enrollment in the VA health care program.
source_blocks.text: 此检查将帮助我们评定您的残疾等级。您的等级将基于您残疾的严重程度，并会影响您将获得的残疾补偿金额。补偿可能包括每月付款和加入 VA 医疗保健计划等。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does everyone who files a claim need to have a VA claim exam?
source_blocks.text: 是否每个提交索赔的人都需要进行 VA 索赔检查？

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. We ll ask you to have a claim exam only if we need more information to decide your claim.
source_blocks.text: 不需要。只有当我们需要更多信息来决定您的索赔时，我们才会要求您进行索赔检查。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have enough medical evidence in your file to support your claim, we won t ask you to have a claim exam. Medical evidence may include doctor and hospital reports, test results, and other documents.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的档案中有足够的医疗证据支持您的索赔，我们不会要求您进行索赔检查。医疗证据可能包括医生和医院报告、检查结果和其他文件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to schedule your VA claim exam
source_blocks.text: 如何安排您的 VA 索赔检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: The staff at your local VA medical center or a local doctor s office that we partner with will contact you. They ll either send you a letter by mail with the date and time of your exam, or call you to find a time that works for you.
source_blocks.text: 您当地 VA 医疗中心或我们合作的当地医生办公室的工作人员将与您联系。他们要么通过邮件向您发送包含检查日期和时间的信件，要么给您打电话以找到适合您的时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Make sure both the VA regional office and the VA medical center nearest you have your up-to-date address, phone number, and email address so you get your exam notice in time.
source_blocks.text: 确保离您最近的 VA 地区办公室和 VA 医疗中心都有您最新的地址、电话号码和电子邮件地址，以便您及时收到检查通知。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the number provided right away to confirm the time and location of your exam. It s important not to miss your scheduled exam, so you ll want to double check that you have the right place and time.
source_blocks.text: 立即拨打提供的号码以确认您检查的时间和地点。重要的是不要错过您预定的检查，因此您需要仔细核对地点和时间是否正确。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you can t make it to your appointment, let us know right away. You can most likely reschedule, but this may delay your claim.
source_blocks.text: 如果您无法赴约，请立即告知我们。您很可能可以重新安排，但这可能会延迟您的索赔。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To reschedule your appointment:
source_blocks.text: 要重新安排您的预约：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-827-1000, or - Go to your nearest VA regional benefit office. Find a VA regional benefit office near you
source_blocks.text: 拨打 800-827-1000，或 - 前往最近的 VA 地区福利办公室。查找您附近的 VA 地区福利办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to expect at your VA claim exam
source_blocks.text: VA 索赔检查的预期情况

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to bring anything to your exam. If you have any new non-VA medical records (like records from a recent surgery or illness), please be sure to submit them before your appointment. The health care provider can t review new information during the exam.
source_blocks.text: 你不需要为考试携带任何物品。如果你有任何新的非VA医疗记录（如近期手术或疾病的记录），请务必在预约前提交。医疗提供者在考试期间无法审查新信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have children, you ll need to plan ahead for childcare during your exam. Because you and the doctor may discuss sensitive topics, children shouldn t be in the room with you.
source_blocks.text: 如果你有孩子，你需要提前为考试期间的托儿服务做计划。因为你和医生可能会讨论敏感话题，孩子不应与你同处一室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On the day of the exam, you ll want to wear comfortable clothes so you can move freely while the doctor exams you.
source_blocks.text: 考试当天，你应穿着舒适的衣服，以便医生检查时你能自由活动。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A VA claim exam isn t like a normal medical exam or other VA health care visits. The doctor won t treat you for any illness or injury, give you referrals to other health care providers, or prescribe medicine. That s because the purpose of the exam is to gather information that will help us make a decision on your claim. Each exam is different, depending on the information we need.
source_blocks.text: VA索赔考试不同于普通医疗考试或其他VA医疗就诊。医生不会治疗你的任何疾病或伤害，不会给你转诊给其他医疗提供者，也不会开药。这是因为考试的目的是收集信息，以帮助我们对你的索赔做出决定。每次考试都不同，取决于我们需要的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: During your exam, the doctor may do any or all of these things:
source_blocks.text: 在考试期间，医生可能会进行以下任何或全部操作：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Review your claim file with you - Ask you questions based on the medical records in your claim file. These may include questions from the Disability Benefits Questionnaire for each service-connected condition you re claiming. Take a look at the Disability Benefits Questionnaires (DBQs) - Perform a basic physical exam - Ask you to get other tests like X-rays or blood work if needed
source_blocks.text: 与你一起审查你的索赔文件 - 根据你索赔文件中的医疗记录向你提问。这些问题可能包括针对你声称的每个服务相关状况的《伤残福利问卷》中的问题。查看《伤残福利问卷》（DBQs） - 进行基本体格检查 - 如有需要，要求你进行其他检查，如X光或血液检查

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any questions about what s happening during your exam, feel free to ask the doctor. But keep in mind that the doctor s job is to examine you, not to make any decisions about your claim. They won t be able to answer questions about the claims process.
source_blocks.text: 如果你对考试期间发生的事情有任何疑问，请随时询问医生。但请记住，医生的职责是检查你，而不是对你的索赔做出任何决定。他们无法回答有关索赔流程的问题。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After your exam, the doctor will write up a report and send it to a VA claims processor to be added to your claim file.
source_blocks.text: 考试结束后，医生将撰写报告并发送给VA索赔处理人员，以添加到你的索赔文件中。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your exam may be very short, or it may last an hour or more. It all depends on the conditions you ve claimed and whether we need more information to make a decision.
source_blocks.text: 你的考试可能非常短，也可能持续一个小时或更长时间。这完全取决于你声称的状况以及我们是否需要更多信息来做出决定。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example, the required questions the doctor asks about a knee injury may take only a few minutes. But the questions for a more complex illness or injury could take much longer. A mental health evaluation usually lasts 2 to 4 hours.
source_blocks.text: 例如，医生关于膝盖受伤的必问问题可能只需几分钟。但对于更复杂的疾病或伤害，问题可能需要更长时间。心理健康评估通常持续2至4小时。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It s important to remember that your in-person visit is only one part of the claim review process. The doctor will also spend time outside the exam carefully reviewing your records.
source_blocks.text: 重要的是要记住，你的面对面访问只是索赔审查过程的一部分。医生还会在考试之外花时间仔细审查你的记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Either a VA doctor or a non-VA doctor who we ve contracted with will do the exam. You can also have your own doctor examine you and fill out the necessary forms. Get instructions for your doctor to fill out VA claim exam forms
source_blocks.text: 考试将由VA医生或我们签约的非VA医生进行。你也可以让您自己的医生检查你并填写必要的表格。获取你的医生填写VA索赔考试表格的说明

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. The doctor will give the exam results to our VA claims processors. Our claims processors will decide your claim based on these results, plus your other medical and military records.
source_blocks.text: 不。医生会将考试结果交给我们的VA索赔处理人员。我们的索赔处理人员将根据这些结果以及你的其他医疗和军事记录来决定你的索赔。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about the claims process, call your nearest VA regional benefit office. Find contact information for your nearest VA regional benefit office
source_blocks.text: 如果你对索赔流程有疑问，请致电最近的VA区域福利办公室。查找最近的VA区域福利办公室的联系信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you miss your claim exam, contact us right away to let us know why you didn t make it. We can help you figure out what to do next.
source_blocks.text: 如果你错过了索赔考试，请立即联系我们，告知我们你未能参加的原因。我们可以帮助你确定下一步该怎么做。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have what we consider to be a good reason for missing your exam (called good cause ), we ll work with you to reschedule your exam. Examples of good cause might be an illness or the death of someone in your immediate family.
source_blocks.text: 如果你有我们认为的错过考试的正当理由（称为“正当理由”），我们将与你合作重新安排考试。正当理由的例子可能包括生病或直系亲属去世。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find contact information for your nearest VA regional benefit office
source_blocks.text: 查找最近的VA区域福利办公室的联系信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: After your VA claim exam
source_blocks.text: 在你的VA索赔考试之后

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll review all the evidence in your file, assign your disability rating, and send you a decision notice (a letter letting you know your disability rating).
source_blocks.text: 我们将审查您文件中的所有证据，为您分配伤残等级，并向您发送决定通知（告知您伤残等级的信函）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Each claim is different, but it usually takes us about 3 to 4 months to process a claim from start to finish. The processing time for your claim depends on how complex your claim is and how many conditions you ve claimed.
source_blocks.text: 每个申请都不同，但通常从开始到结束处理一个申请大约需要3到4个月。您的申请处理时间取决于申请的复杂程度以及您申请的疾病数量。

source_blocks.source_text_en: See our most recent estimate for the average number of days to complete a claim
source_blocks.text: 查看我们关于完成申请平均天数的最新估算

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to track your claim
source_blocks.text: 登录以跟踪您的申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. To get a copy of the final report from your exam, you can:
source_blocks.text: 是的。要获取考试最终报告的副本，您可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact your nearest VA regional benefit office, or - Call us at 800-827-1000 and request an appointment to view your file
source_blocks.text: 联系最近的VA区域办事处，或 - 致电800-827-1000并预约查看您的文件

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our VA claims processors will review:
source_blocks.text: 我们的VA申请处理人员将审查：

source_blocks.text: VA clothing allowance

source_blocks.source_text_en: Has your clothing been damaged by your prosthetic or orthopedic device (such as a wheelchair) or by the medicine you re taking for a skin condition? If it has, you may be able to get money each year to help you buy new clothes. This is a disability compensation benefit known as an annual clothing allowance. Find out if you can get this benefit.

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA decision reviews and appeals | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA 决策复核与上诉 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA decision reviews and appeals
source_blocks.text: VA 决策复核与上诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with a VA decision, you can choose one of the following review options to continue your case. If you aren't satisfied with that review, you can try another option.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意 VA 的决策，您可以选择以下复核选项之一来继续您的案件。如果您对该复核结果不满意，您可以尝试另一个选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mark your calendar
source_blocks.text: 标记您的日历

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have 1 year from the date on your decision to request a decision review, unless you have a fiduciary claim or a multiple party claim. See if one of these rare situations applies to you
source_blocks.text: 您有自决策日期起 1 年的时间来请求决策复核，除非您有 fiduciary claim 或 multiple party claim。请查看这些罕见情况是否适用于您

source_blocks.source_text_en: Decision review options
source_blocks.text: 决策复核选项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add new and relevant evidence (file a Supplemental Claim) Ask for a new look from a senior reviewer (request a Higher-Level Review) Appeal to a Veterans Law Judge (request a Board Appeal)
source_blocks.text: 添加新的且相关的证据（提交 Supplemental Claim） 请求高级审阅员重新审查（请求 Higher-Level Review） 向 Veterans Law Judge 上诉（请求 Board Appeal）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Add new and relevant evidence
source_blocks.text: 添加新的且相关的证据

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 20-0995: Supplemental Claim (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载 VA Form 20-0995：Supplemental Claim（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that supports your case or identifying evidence for review. A reviewer will look at all the evidence and determine whether it changes the decision. Learn how to file a Supplemental Claim
source_blocks.text: 当您选择提交 Supplemental Claim 时，您是在添加支持您案件的新证据或指明需要审查的证据。审阅员将查看所有证据并确定是否改变决策。了解如何提交 Supplemental Claim

source_blocks.source_text_en: You must submit evidence that VA didn't have before that supports your case.
source_blocks.text: 您必须提交 VA 之前没有的、支持您案件的证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: 4-5 months VA s goal for completing Supplemental Claims is 125 days.
source_blocks.text: 4-5 个月 VA 完成 Supplemental Claims 的目标是 125 天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I file a Supplemental Claim?
source_blocks.text: 我可以提交 Supplemental Claim 吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can file a Supplemental Claim within 1 year of a decision if you have new evidence.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有新证据，您可以在决策后 1 年内提交 Supplemental Claim。

source_blocks.source_text_en: But you can t file a Supplemental Claim if you have a fiduciary claim or you re one of multiple people claiming the same benefit (this is rare). See if one of these rare situations applies to you
source_blocks.text: 但如果您有 fiduciary claim 或您是多个声称同一福利的人之一（这种情况很少见），则不能提交 Supplemental Claim。请查看这些罕见情况是否适用于您

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask for a new look from a senior reviewer
source_blocks.text: 请求高级审阅员重新审查

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 20-0996: Higher-Level Review (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载 VA Form 20-0996：Higher-Level Review（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you choose to request a Higher-Level Review, you re asking for another review of the same evidence. A senior reviewer will take another look at your case and determine whether the decision can be changed based on a difference of opinion or an error that VA made. Learn how to request a Higher-Level Review
source_blocks.text: 当您选择请求 Higher-Level Review 时，您是在请求对相同证据进行另一次审查。高级审阅员将重新审查您的案件，并确定是否可以根据意见分歧或 VA 犯下的错误来更改决策。了解如何请求 Higher-Level Review

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t submit any evidence.
source_blocks.text: 您无法提交任何证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You and/or your representative can speak with the reviewer on the phone. You can tell them why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors.
source_blocks.text: 您和/或您的代表可以通过电话与审核员沟通。您可以告诉他们为什么您认为决定应被更改，并指出错误。

source_blocks.source_text_en: 4-5 months VA s goal for completing Higher-Level Reviews is 125 days. A review may take longer if VA needs to get records or schedule a new exam to correct an error.
source_blocks.text: 4-5个月 VA完成Higher-Level Reviews的目标是125天。如果VA需要获取记录或安排新的考试以纠正错误，审核可能需要更长时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Higher-Level Review?
source_blocks.text: 我可以申请Higher-Level Review吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Higher-Level Review of an initial claim or Supplemental Claim decision. This option isn t available after a Higher-Level Review or Board Appeal.
source_blocks.text: 您可以对初始申请或Supplemental Claim决定申请Higher-Level Review。在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后，此选项不可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Appeal to a Veterans Law Judge
source_blocks.text: 向Veterans Law Judge上诉

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 10182: Board Appeal (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载VA Form 10182: Board Appeal (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: A judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C., will review your case. Learn more about how to request a Board Appeal
source_blocks.text: 位于华盛顿特区的Board of Veterans Appeals的法官将审核您的案件。了解更多关于如何申请Board Appeal的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.
source_blocks.text: 约1年 Board对无新证据且无听证的上诉作出决定的目标时间约为一年。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have the option to add new evidence that a judge will review.
source_blocks.text: 您可以选择添加法官将审核的新证据。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You also have the option to request a hearing with a judge, either in person in Washington, D.C., or by video conference at a VA location near you.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以选择请求与法官进行听证，可以在华盛顿特区亲自进行，或通过视频会议在您附近的VA地点进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Longer The Board will take longer to decide your appeal if you submit new evidence or request a hearing.
source_blocks.text: 更长 如果您提交新证据或请求听证，Board将需要更长时间来决定您的上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I request a Board Appeal?
source_blocks.text: 我可以申请Board Appeal吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can request a Board Appeal after an initial claim, Supplemental Claim, or Higher-Level Review decision. You can t request 2 Board Appeals in a row.
source_blocks.text: 您可以在初始申请、Supplemental Claim或Higher-Level Review决定后申请Board Appeal。您不能连续两次申请Board Appeal。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After a Board decision
source_blocks.text: Board决定之后

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with the Board s decision and have new and relevant evidence that supports your case, you can file a Supplemental Claim. You can also appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. Learn more about your options after a Board decision
source_blocks.text: 如果您不同意Board的决定，并且有支持您案件的新且相关的证据，您可以提交Supplemental Claim。您也可以向U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims提出上诉。了解更多关于Board决定后您的选择

source_blocks.source_text_en: What happens next?
source_blocks.text: 接下来会发生什么？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what happens after you request a decision review
source_blocks.text: 了解您请求decision review后会发生什么

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to do anything while you wait unless VA sends you a letter asking for more information. If VA schedules exams for you, be sure not to miss them.
source_blocks.text: 等待期间您无需做任何操作，除非VA寄信要求您提供更多信息。如果VA为您安排了检查，请务必不要错过。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of your claim or appeal
source_blocks.text: 跟踪您的索赔或上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I need help?
source_blocks.text: 如果我需要帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Veterans Service Organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review. Get help requesting a decision review
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人服务组织或VA认证的律师或代理人可以帮助您请求决策审查。获取请求决策审查的帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I have more questions?
source_blocks.text: 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get answers to frequently asked questions about decision reviews. Go to FAQs
source_blocks.text: 获取关于决策审查的常见问题解答。前往FAQs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA disability compensation for PTSD
source_blocks.text: VA 创伤后应激障碍残疾补偿

source_blocks.source_text_en: Posttraumatic stress can happen after someone goes through a traumatic event such as combat, an assault, or a disaster. Most people have some stress reactions following trauma. But if the reactions don t go away over time or they disrupt your life, you may have posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Find out if you can get disability compensation or benefits if you have symptoms of PTSD.
source_blocks.text: 创伤后应激可能发生在某人经历创伤事件之后，例如战斗、袭击或灾难。大多数人在创伤后会有一些应激反应。但如果这些反应随时间没有消失或干扰了你的生活，你可能患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）。了解如果你有PTSD症状，是否可以获得残疾补偿或福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about PTSD
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于PTSD的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: 我现在如何与他人交谈？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何白天或夜晚随时获得支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是一位处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请联系我们关怀备至、经验丰富的退伍军人危机热线应答者，获取保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: 要随时联系退伍军人危机热线应答者：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: 拨打 800-273-8255，然后选择 1。 开始保密退伍军人聊天。 发送短信至 838255。 如果您有听力损失，请拨打 TTY：800-799-4889。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打 911。 前往最近的急诊室。 直接前往最近的 VA 医疗中心。无论您的退伍身份如何或是否已加入 VA 医疗保健，都没关系。查找最近的 VA 医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if you have symptoms related to a traumatic event (the stressor ) or your experience with the stressor is related to the PTSD symptoms, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有与创伤事件（应激源）相关的症状，或者您对应激源的经历与 PTSD 症状相关，并且您满足以下列出的所有要求，您可能能够获得残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有情况都必须属实：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The stressor happened during your service, and You can t function as well as you once could because of your symptoms, and A doctor has diagnosed you with PTSD
source_blocks.text: 应激源发生在您服役期间，并且 由于您的症状，您无法像以前一样正常生活，并且 医生已诊断您患有 PTSD

source_blocks.source_text_en: What does VA consider to be a traumatic event?
source_blocks.text: VA 认为什么是创伤事件？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We consider any of these to be a traumatic event:
source_blocks.text: 我们认为以下任何情况都是创伤事件：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You suffered a serious injury, personal or sexual trauma, or sexual violation, or You were threatened with injury, sexual assault, or death
source_blocks.text: 您遭受了严重伤害、人身或性创伤，或性侵犯，或 您受到伤害、性侵犯或死亡的威胁

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁符合资格？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of disability benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得哪种残疾福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Compensation (payments) Treatment for PTSD
source_blocks.text: 医疗保健 补偿（付款） 创伤后应激障碍治疗

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation.
source_blocks.text: 您需要提交一份残疾补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you file a disability claim, you ll also need to fill out one of these additional forms:
source_blocks.text: 当您提交残疾申请时，您还需要填写以下附加表格之一：

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Statement in Support of Claim for Service Connection for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (VA Form 21-0781).Download VA Form 21-0781 (PDF)or A Statement in Support of Claim for Service Connection for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder Secondary to Personal Assault (VA Form 21-0781a).Download VA Form 21-0781a (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 一份支持服役期间创伤后应激障碍索赔的声明（VA表格21-0781）。下载VA表格21-0781（PDF）或 一份支持因个人侵犯导致的创伤后应激障碍索赔的声明（VA表格21-0781a）。下载VA表格21-0781a（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: In our screening process, we ll focus on getting a full understanding of your PTSD to help determine your eligibility for disability benefits. We won t offer you treatment during this process.
source_blocks.text: 注意：在我们的筛查过程中，我们将重点全面了解您的创伤后应激障碍，以帮助确定您是否有资格获得残疾福利。在此过程中，我们不会为您提供治疗。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re looking for treatment options, please talk with your health care provider or learn more about accessing VA services for PTSD.Find out how to access VA services for PTSD
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在寻找治疗方案，请与您的医疗保健提供者交谈，或了解更多关于获取VA创伤后应激障碍服务的信息。了解如何获取VA创伤后应激障碍服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re in crisis and need to talk with someone right now, you can connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder any time, day or night.Find out how to get support now
source_blocks.text: 如果您处于危机中，需要立即与人交谈，您可以随时联系退伍军人危机热线应答者，无论白天还是夜晚。了解如何立即获得支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ve made great progress in treating PTSD and have brought more mental health providers to VA medical centers to help give the best care to Veterans with PTSD.Learn about our PTSD programs
source_blocks.text: 我们在治疗创伤后应激障碍方面取得了巨大进展，并已将更多心理健康服务提供者引入VA医疗中心，以帮助为患有创伤后应激障碍的退伍军人提供最佳护理。了解我们的创伤后应激障碍项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA disability compensation

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA disability compensation (pay) offers a monthly tax-free payment to Veterans who got sick or injured while serving in the military and to Veterans whose service made an existing condition worse. You may qualify for VA disability benefits for physical conditions (like a chronic illness or injury) and mental health conditions (like PTSD) that developed before, during, or after service. Find out how to apply for and manage the Veterans disability benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: VA残疾补偿（付款）为在服役期间生病或受伤的退伍军人，以及因服役导致原有状况恶化的退伍军人提供每月免税付款。您可能有资格获得VA残疾福利，适用于在服役前、服役期间或服役后发展的身体状况（如慢性疾病或伤害）和心理健康状况（如PTSD）。了解如何申请和管理您应得的退伍军人残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA disability compensation
source_blocks.text: VA残疾补偿

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA disability compensation (pay) offers a monthly tax-free payment to Veterans who got sick or injured while serving in the military and to Veterans whose service made an existing condition worse. You may qualify for VA disability benefits for physical conditions (like a chronic illness or injury) and mental health conditions (like PTSD) that developed before, during, or after service. Find out how to apply for and manage the Veterans disability benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: VA残疾补偿（付款）为在服役期间生病或受伤的退伍军人，以及因服役导致原有状况恶化的退伍军人提供每月免税付款。您可能有资格获得VA残疾福利，涵盖服役前、服役期间或服役后出现的身体疾病（如慢性疾病或伤害）和心理健康状况（如PTSD）。了解如何申请和管理您应得的退伍军人残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Education Benefits For Survivors And Dependents | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA教育福利：为遗属和受抚养人 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA education benefits for survivors and dependents
source_blocks.text: VA教育福利：为遗属和受抚养人

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you re eligible for VA education benefits for dependents and survivors (also called Chapter 35 benefits). If you re a dependent spouse or child or the surviving spouse or child of a Veteran, you may qualify for Chapter 35 benefits or job training through a GI Bill program.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得针对受抚养人和遗属的VA教育福利（也称为Chapter 35福利）。如果您是退伍军人的受抚养配偶或子女，或是其遗属配偶或子女，您可能有资格通过GI Bill计划获得Chapter 35福利或职业培训。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for education benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我是否有资格获得教育福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may qualify for VA education benefits (Chapter 35 benefits) if you re the child or spouse of a service member and one of the below descriptions is true of the service member.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是军人的子女或配偶，且以下关于该军人的描述之一属实，您可能有资格获得VA教育福利（Chapter 35福利）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must be true. The service member:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须属实。该军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Died in the line of duty after September 10, 2001, or Is missing in action or was captured in the line of duty by a hostile force, or Was detained (held) by force while in the line of duty by a foreign government or power, or Is in the hospital or getting outpatient treatment for a service-connected permanent and total disability, and is likely to be discharged for that disability. A service-connected permanent and total disability is a disability resulting from your service that doesn t go away.
source_blocks.text: 于2001年9月10日之后在执行任务中死亡，或 在执行任务中失踪或被敌对势力俘虏，或 在执行任务中被外国政府或势力强行拘留（扣押），或 因与服务相关的永久性完全残疾而在医院接受治疗或接受门诊治疗，并可能因此残疾而被退伍。服务相关的永久性完全残疾是指由您的服务导致的、不会消失的残疾。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may qualify for VA education benefits (Chapter 35 benefits) if you re the child or spouse of a Veteran and one of the below descriptions is true of the Veteran.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人的子女或配偶，且以下关于该退伍军人的描述之一属实，您可能有资格获得VA教育福利（Chapter 35福利）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: One of these must be true. The Veteran:
source_blocks.text: 以下情况之一必须属实。该退伍军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is permanently and totally disabled due to a service-connected disability, or Died while on active duty or as a result of a service-connected disability
source_blocks.text: 因服务相关的残疾而永久性完全残疾，或 在现役期间死亡或因服务相关的残疾而死亡

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a dependent who doesn t meet the above criteria, you may still qualify for VA education benefits if the Veteran or service member transferred some or all of their Post-9/11 GI Bill entitlement to you while they were on active duty.Learn about transferred benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您是不符合上述标准的受抚养人，如果退伍军人或军人在现役期间将部分或全部Post-9/11 GI Bill权利转移给您，您仍可能有资格获得VA教育福利。了解转移的福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education and training Money for tuition Money for housing Money for books and supplies
source_blocks.text: 教育和培训 学费资金 住房资金 书籍和用品资金

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply.Apply for VA education benefits (Chapter 35 benefits).
source_blocks.text: 您需要申请。申请VA教育福利（Chapter 35福利）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 2 main GI Bill programs offering educational assistance to survivors and dependents of Veterans:
source_blocks.text: 有2个主要的GI Bill计划为退伍军人的遗属和受抚养人提供教育援助：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Marine Gunnery Sergeant John David Fry Scholarship (Fry Scholarship) is for children and spouses of service members who died in the line of duty after September 10, 2001.Get more information about the Fry Scholarship The Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) program offers education and training to qualified dependents of Veterans who are permanently and totally disabled because of a service-related condition or who died while on active duty or as a result of a service-related condition.Get more information about the DEA program
source_blocks.text: Marine Gunnery Sergeant John David Fry Scholarship（Fry Scholarship）适用于2001年9月10日之后在执行任务中死亡的军人的子女和配偶。获取有关Fry Scholarship的更多信息 Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance（DEA）计划为因服务相关状况而永久性完全残疾或在现役期间或因此类状况死亡的退伍军人的合格受抚养人提供教育和培训。获取有关DEA计划的更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: You may qualify for both the Fry Scholarship and the DEA program, but you can use only one of them. You ll have to pick one when you apply. Once you ve made this decision, you can t switch to the other program.
source_blocks.text: 注意：您可能有资格同时获得Fry Scholarship和DEA计划，但您只能使用其中一个。您在申请时必须选择一个。一旦做出此决定，您就不能切换到另一个计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Education Benefits | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA教育福利 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA education and training benefits
source_blocks.text: VA教育和培训福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA education benefits help Veterans, service members, and their qualified family members with needs like paying college tuition, finding the right school or training program, and getting career counseling. Learn how to apply for and manage the education and training benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: VA教育福利帮助退伍军人、服役人员及其符合条件的家庭成员满足诸如支付大学学费、找到合适的学校或培训项目以及获得职业咨询等需求。了解如何申请和管理您已获得的教育和培训福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get GI Bill and other education benefits Manage your Veterans education benefits More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 获取GI法案及其他教育福利 管理您的退伍军人教育福利 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get GI Bill and other education benefits
source_blocks.text: 获取GI法案及其他教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: About GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 关于GI法案福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how the GI Bill works and explore your options to pay for school or training.
source_blocks.text: 了解GI法案如何运作，并探索您支付学费或培训费用的选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 资格条件

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you're eligible for GI Bill or other VA education benefits.
source_blocks.text: 查看您是否符合GI法案或其他VA教育福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to prepare and apply for the GI Bill or other VA education and training benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何准备并申请GI法案或其他VA教育和培训福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you apply
source_blocks.text: 申请后

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out when to expect a decision from us on your application and what to do next.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们何时会对您的申请做出决定，以及接下来该怎么做。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment
source_blocks.text: 职业康复与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you qualify for help exploring employment options, any training you may need, and other voc rehab services.
source_blocks.text: 查看您是否有资格获得探索就业选择、可能需要的任何培训以及其他职业康复服务的帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Educational and Career Counseling (Chapter 36)
source_blocks.text: 教育与职业咨询（第36章）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get free educational and career counseling as a recently discharged Veteran or a dependent family member.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为近期退役的退伍军人或受抚养家庭成员，如何获得免费的教育和职业咨询。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA education benefits for dependents and survivors
source_blocks.text: 针对家属和遗属的VA教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you're eligible for Veteran dependent or survivor education benefits through a GI Bill program.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否符合通过GI Bill计划获得退伍军人家属或遗属教育福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other educational assistance programs
source_blocks.text: 其他教育援助计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Guardsman, Reservist, or Veteran who doesn't qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, see if you're eligible for other VA education benefits.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是国民警卫队成员、预备役人员或不符合9/11后退伍军人GI Bill资格的退伍军人，请查看您是否符合其他VA教育福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manage your Veterans education benefits
source_blocks.text: 管理您的退伍军人教育福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: View your VA payment history
source_blocks.text: 查看您的VA付款历史

source_blocks.source_text_en: See your payment history for VA education and other benefits you may have like disability compensation and pension.
source_blocks.text: 查看您的VA教育付款历史以及您可能享有的其他福利，如残疾补偿和养老金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 检查您的9/11后退伍军人GI Bill福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: See how much of your GI Bill benefits you have left to help pay for school or training.
source_blocks.text: 查看您剩余的GI Bill福利金额，以帮助支付学费或培训费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transfer Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 转移9/11后退伍军人GI Bill福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Transfer your unused Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits to your spouse or other dependents.
source_blocks.text: 将您未使用的9/11后退伍军人GI Bill福利转移给您的配偶或其他家属。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change your GI Bill school or program
source_blocks.text: 更改您的GI Bill学校或计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: Request a change to use a different GI Bill program or to transfer your benefits to a new school or training program.
source_blocks.text: 请求更改以使用不同的GI Bill计划或将您的福利转移到新的学校或培训计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Change your VA direct deposit information
source_blocks.text: 更改您的VA直接存款信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to change your GI Bill direct deposit and contact information.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何更改您的GI Bill直接存款和联系信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your VA appeal status
source_blocks.text: 查看您的VA上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of your VA education benefits appeal.
source_blocks.text: 跟踪您的VA教育福利上诉状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Verify your school enrollment
source_blocks.text: 验证您的学校注册

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our online verification system (called "WAVE") to confirm you're enrolled in an approved school or training program so you keep receiving your education benefits.
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的在线验证系统（称为“WAVE”）来确认您已注册到经批准的学校或培训计划，以便您继续领取教育福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply to restore your GI Bill benefits
source_blocks.text: 申请恢复您的GI Bill福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your school closed or your program ended because of a change in VA regulations or a new law, apply to have your GI Bill benefits restored.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的学校关闭，或者您的计划因VA法规变更或新法律而终止，请申请恢复您的GI Bill福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill Comparison Tool
source_blocks.text: GI Bill比较工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about VA education benefits programs and compare GI Bill benefits by school.
source_blocks.text: 了解VA教育福利计划，并按学校比较GI Bill福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Post-9/11 GI Bill and other VA education benefits rates
source_blocks.text: 9/11后退伍军人GI Bill及其他VA教育福利费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: View rate tables for the Post-9/11 GI Bill and other Veterans education benefits programs.
source_blocks.text: 查看9/11后退伍军人GI Bill及其他退伍军人教育福利计划的费率表。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to choose GI Bill approved schools
source_blocks.text: 如何选择GI Bill批准的学校

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get links to VA and non-VA resources for guidance in choosing a college or training program.
source_blocks.text: 获取VA和非VA资源链接，以指导您选择大学或培训计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: CareerScope assessment
source_blocks.text: CareerScope评估

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get a CareerScope assessment to help you figure out your career path when transitioning to civilian life.
source_blocks.text: 进行CareerScope评估，帮助您在过渡到平民生活时确定职业道路。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA education debt and GI Bill overpayment
source_blocks.text: VA教育债务和GI Bill多付款项

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get answers to frequently asked questions about GI Bill overpayments and VA education debt management.
source_blocks.text: 获取关于GI Bill多付款项和VA教育债务管理的常见问题解答。

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill questions and customer help
source_blocks.text: GI Bill问题和客户帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact us to ask questions and get help with your benefits online or by phone.
source_blocks.text: 联系我们，通过在线或电话咨询问题并获取福利帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: GI Bill School Feedback Tool
source_blocks.text: GI Bill学校反馈工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to give us feedback about your GI Bill school.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何向我们就您的GI Bill学校提供反馈。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education forms and resources
source_blocks.text: 教育表格和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA education benefits forms, fact sheets, and other resources.
source_blocks.text: 下载VA教育福利表格、情况说明书和其他资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: My Story how Veterans and service members use the GI Bill
source_blocks.text: 我的故事：退伍军人和服役人员如何使用GI法案

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hear inspiring stories from Veterans and service members who ve advanced their education and training with the Post-9/11 GI Bill.
source_blocks.text: 聆听退伍军人和服役人员通过《9/11后退伍军人法案》提升教育和培训的鼓舞人心的故事。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other helpful education resources
source_blocks.text: 其他有用的教育资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get links to non-VA resources and websites that may be useful to student Veterans and those who support them.
source_blocks.text: 获取非VA资源和网站的链接，这些可能对学生退伍军人及其支持者有用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 其他VA福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA transition assistance
source_blocks.text: VA过渡援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about VA benefits available to you and your family as you transition out of active-duty, National Guard, or Reserve service.
source_blocks.text: 了解您在从现役、国民警卫队或预备役过渡期间及家庭可获得的VA福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment
source_blocks.text: 职业康复与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you qualify for help exploring employment options, any training you may need, and other voc rehab services.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得探索就业选择、可能需要的培训以及其他职业康复服务的帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Home loan benefits
source_blocks.text: 住房贷款福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore options for Veterans home loans, apply for your Certificate of Eligibility (COE), and get help if you're having trouble making your mortgage payments.
source_blocks.text: 探索退伍军人住房贷款选项，申请您的资格证明（COE），并在支付抵押贷款遇到困难时获得帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veteran-owned small business support
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人拥有的小企业支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: Register to do business with VA and get support for your Veteran-owned small business.
source_blocks.text: 注册与VA开展业务，并为您的退伍军人拥有的小企业获得支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Jobs for Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help from the U.S. Department of Labor to find a job, get training, or explore career options.
source_blocks.text: 从美国劳工部获得帮助，寻找工作、接受培训或探索职业选择。

source_blocks.text: VA 家庭照护者援助计划 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers
source_blocks.text: 家庭照护者综合援助计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a family member caring for a Veteran with disabilities, we want to support you. We recognize that family caregivers enhance the health and well-being of Veterans they care for in their home. Find out if you qualify for the Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是照顾残疾退伍军人的家庭成员，我们希望支持您。我们认识到家庭照护者能增进他们在家里所照顾的退伍军人的健康与福祉。了解您是否符合家庭照护者综合援助计划的资格以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re working to give more family caregivers access to this program
source_blocks.text: 我们正在努力让更多家庭照护者能够使用此计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about this change and how it may affect you
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于这一变化及其可能对您产生的影响

source_blocks.source_text_en: As part of the VA MISSION Act, we re working to give more family caregivers access to this program so we can support them as they care for Veterans of all eras. We re in the process of putting in place the technology we need to support this expanded access. Then, the expansion will happen in 2 phases.
source_blocks.text: 作为 VA MISSION 法案的一部分，我们正在努力让更多家庭照护者能够使用此计划，以便在他们照顾各个时代的退伍军人时为他们提供支持。我们正在逐步落实支持这一扩展访问所需的技术。然后，扩展将分两个阶段进行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, family caregivers of Veterans who were seriously injured in the line of duty on or before May 7, 1975, will become eligible for this program. After 2 years, family caregivers of Veterans who were seriously injured in the line of duty between May 7, 1975, and September 10, 2001, will become eligible.
source_blocks.text: 首先，在 1975 年 5 月 7 日或之前因公严重受伤的退伍军人的家庭照护者将有资格参加此计划。两年后，在 1975 年 5 月 7 日至 2001 年 9 月 10 日期间因公严重受伤的退伍军人的家庭照护者将有资格参加。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please check our MISSION Act website for ongoing updates. You can also call our caregiver support line at 855-260-3274 to learn about the many support services you can access now. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 请查看我们的 MISSION 法案网站以获取持续更新。您也可以拨打我们的照护者支持热线 855-260-3274，了解您现在可以获得的各种支持服务。我们周一至周五上午 8:00 至晚上 8:00（东部时间）为您服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get benefits through the Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过家庭照护者综合援助计划获得福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll qualify for this program based on your Veteran s qualifications. You may be eligible if the Veteran you re caring for meets both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 您是否符合此计划的资格将取决于您所照顾的退伍军人的资格。如果您所照顾的退伍军人满足以下两项要求，您可能符合资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true. The Veteran you re caring for:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项都必须属实。您所照顾的退伍军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Has a serious injury including traumatic brain injury, psychological trauma, or other mental disorder that was caused or made worse by their active-duty service on or after September 11, 2001, and Needs personal care services because they can t perform one or more activities of daily living and/or needs supervision or protection based on symptoms of lasting neurological damage or injury
source_blocks.text: 患有严重损伤，包括创伤性脑损伤、心理创伤或其他精神障碍，这些损伤是由其在 2001 年 9 月 11 日或之后服役期间造成的或加重的，并且 需要个人护理服务，因为他们无法进行一项或多项日常生活活动和/或需要基于持久性神经损伤或伤害症状的监督或保护

source_blocks.source_text_en: Answer a few questions to find out if you meet the criteria for this program.Find out if you qualify and download an applicationDownload our fact sheet for more eligibility information (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 回答几个问题，了解您是否符合此计划的标准。了解您是否符合资格并下载申请表下载我们的情况说明书以获取更多资格信息 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: What benefits can I get with this program?
source_blocks.text: 通过此计划我可以获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Veteran can appoint 1 primary (main) caregiver and up to 2 secondary caregivers (people who serve as backup support to the primary caregiver when needed). Your benefits will depend on whether you re the primary caregiver or a secondary caregiver.
source_blocks.text: 您的退伍军人可以指定 1 名主要（主要）照护者和最多 2 名次要照护者（在需要时作为主要照护者的后备支持人员）。您的福利将取决于您是主要照护者还是次要照护者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re the primary caregiver, you may receive:
source_blocks.text: 如果您是主要照护者，您可能获得：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Caregiver education and training A monthly stipend (payment) Travel, lodging, and financial assistance when traveling with the Veteran to receive care Access to health care benefits through the Civilian Health and Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs (CHAMPVA) if you don t already qualify for care or services under another health care plan.Learn more about CHAMPVA Mental health services and counseling Up to 30 days per year of respite care
source_blocks.text: 照护者教育和培训 每月津贴（付款） 陪同退伍军人接受护理时的旅行、住宿和经济援助 如果您尚未符合其他医疗保健计划下的护理或服务资格，则可通过退伍军人事务部平民健康与医疗计划 (CHAMPVA) 获得医疗保健福利。了解更多关于 CHAMPVA 的信息 心理健康服务和咨询 每年最多 30 天的临时护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for these benefits. To apply, fill out an Application for the Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers (VA Form 10-10CG). You ll need identification and health coverage information for both you and your Veteran and you ll both need to sign and date the form.
source_blocks.text: 您需要申请这些福利。要申请，请填写《家庭照护者综合援助计划申请表》（VA表格10-10CG）。您和您的退伍军人都需要提供身份证明和健康保险信息，并且双方都需在表格上签名并注明日期。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download VA Form 10-10CG (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 下载VA表格10-10CG（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail the form and any supporting documents to:
source_blocks.text: 将表格及任何支持文件邮寄至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers Health Eligibility Center 2957 Clairmont Road NE, Ste 200 Atlanta, GA 30329-1647
source_blocks.text: 家庭照护者综合援助计划健康资格中心 2957 Clairmont Road NE, Ste 200 Atlanta, GA 30329-1647

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or apply in person by bringing the application to your local VA medical center caregiver support coordinator.
source_blocks.text: 或亲自前往当地VA医疗中心的照护者支持协调员处提交申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To find the name of your local coordinator:
source_blocks.text: 要查找当地协调员的姓名：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact the Caregiver Support Line at 855-260-3274, or
source_blocks.text: 拨打照护者支持热线855-260-3274，或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our online caregiver support coordinator search tool
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的在线照护者支持协调员搜索工具

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need help filling out the form, you can contact your local coordinator, or call our main VA information line at 877-222-8387.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在填写表格时需要帮助，可以联系当地协调员，或拨打我们的VA主要信息热线877-222-8387。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have other forms of health care coverage (like a private insurance plan, Medicare, Medicaid, or TRICARE), you can use VA health care benefits along with these plans. Learn more about how VA works with other health insurance.
source_blocks.text: If you have other forms of health care coverage (like a private insurance plan, Medicare, Medicaid, or TRICARE), you can use VA health care benefits along with these plans. Learn more about how VA works with other health insurance.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Why does VA require me to provide information on my health insurance coverage (including coverage under a spouse s plan)?
source_blocks.text: Why does VA require me to provide information on my health insurance coverage (including coverage under a spouse s plan)?

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ask for this information because we have to bill your private health insurance provider for any care, supplies, or medicine we provide to treat your non-service-connected conditions (illnesses or injuries that aren t related to your military service).
source_blocks.text: We ask for this information because we have to bill your private health insurance provider for any care, supplies, or medicine we provide to treat your non-service-connected conditions (illnesses or injuries that aren t related to your military service).

source_blocks.source_text_en: We don t bill Medicare or Medicaid, but we may bill Medicare supplemental health insurance for covered services.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if my health insurance provider doesn t cover all the non-service-connected care that VA bills them for?
source_blocks.text: What if my health insurance provider doesn t cover all the non-service-connected care that VA bills them for?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You won t have to pay any unpaid balance not covered by your health insurance provider. But, depending on your assigned priority group, you may have a copay for non-service-connected care.Learn more about eligibility priority groups
source_blocks.text: You won t have to pay any unpaid balance not covered by your health insurance provider. But, depending on your assigned priority group, you may have a copay for non-service-connected care.Learn more about eligibility priority groups

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does it help me in any way to give VA my health insurance information?
source_blocks.text: Does it help me in any way to give VA my health insurance information?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Giving us your health insurance information helps you because:
source_blocks.text: Yes. Giving us your health insurance information helps you because:

source_blocks.source_text_en: When your private health insurance provider pays us for your non-service-connected care, we may be able to use the funds to offset part or all of your VA copayment. Your private insurer may apply your VA health care charges toward your annual deductible (the amount of money you pay toward your care each year before your insurance starts paying for care).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does my current health insurance status affect whether I can get VA health care benefits?
source_blocks.text: Does my current health insurance status affect whether I can get VA health care benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. Whether or not you have health insurance coverage doesn t affect the VA health care benefits you can get.
source_blocks.text: No. Whether or not you have health insurance coverage doesn t affect the VA health care benefits you can get.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If I m signed up for the VA health care program, does that mean I meet the requirements to have health care under the Affordable Care Act (ACA)?
source_blocks.text: If I m signed up for the VA health care program, does that mean I meet the requirements to have health care under the Affordable Care Act (ACA)?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. Being signed up for VA health care meets your Affordable Care Act health coverage requirement of having minimum essential health coverage. You don t need any other insurance to meet this requirement. We ll update this site if the ACA changes with new laws.Learn more about the ACA, VA, and you

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: It s always a good idea to let your VA doctor know if you re receiving care outside VA. This helps your provider coordinate your care to help keep you safe and make sure you re getting care that s proven to work and that meets your specific needs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: More about how VA health care works with Medicare and other insurance
source_blocks.text: More about how VA health care works with Medicare and other insurance

source_blocks.source_text_en: This is your decision. You can save money if you drop your private health insurance, but there are risks. We encourage you to keep your insurance because:
source_blocks.text: This is your decision. You can save money if you drop your private health insurance, but there are risks. We encourage you to keep your insurance because:

source_blocks.source_text_en: We don t normally provide care for Veterans family members. So, if you drop your private insurance plan, your family may not have health coverage. - We don t know if Congress will provide enough funding in future years for us to care for all Veterans who are signed up for VA health care. If you re in one of the lower priority groups, you could lose your VA health care benefits in the future. If you don t keep your private insurance, this would leave you without health coverage. - If you have Medicare Part B (coverage for doctors and outpatient services) and you cancel it, you won t be able to get it back until January of the following year. You may also have to pay a penalty to get your coverage back (called reinstating your coverage).

If you don t keep your private insurance, this would leave you without health coverage. - If you have Medicare Part B (coverage for doctors and outpatient services) and you cancel it, you won t be able to get it back until January of the following year. You may also have to pay a penalty to get your coverage back (called reinstating your coverage).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. We encourage you to sign up for Medicare as soon as you can. This is because:
source_blocks.text: Yes. We encourage you to sign up for Medicare as soon as you can. This is because:

source_blocks.source_text_en: We don t know if Congress will provide enough funding in future years for us to provide care for all Veterans who are signed up for VA health care. If you re in one of the lower priority groups, you could lose your VA health care benefits in the future. - Having Medicare means you re covered if you need to go to a non-VA hospital or doctor so you have more options to choose from. - If you delay signing up for Medicare Part B (coverage for doctors and outpatient services) and then need to sign up later because you lose your VA health care benefits or need more choice in care options, you ll pay a penalty. This penalty gets bigger each year you delay signing up and you ll pay it every year for the rest of your life. - If you sign up for Medicare Part D (coverage for prescription drugs), you ll be able to use it to get medicine from non-VA doctors and fill your prescriptions at your local pharmacy instead of through the VA mail-order service. There s no penalty for delaying Medicare Part D.

This penalty gets bigger each year you delay signing up and you ll pay it every year for the rest of your life. - If you sign up for Medicare Part D (coverage for prescription drugs), you ll be able to use it to get medicine from non-VA doctors and fill your prescriptions at your local pharmacy instead of through the VA mail-order service. There s no penalty for delaying Medicare Part D.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to choose which benefits to use each time you receive care.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To use VA benefits, you ll need to get care at a VA medical center or other VA location. We ll also cover your care if we pre-authorize you (meaning we give you permission ahead of time) to get services in a non-VA hospital or other care setting. Keep in mind that you may need to pay a VA copayment for non-service-connected care.
