Keep in mind that you may need to pay a VA copayment for non-service-connected care.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you go to a non-VA (or VA authorized) care facility, Medicare may pay for other services you may need during your stay. Or, if we only authorize some services in a non-VA location, then Medicare may pay for other services you may need during your stay. Check your Medicare plan, so you know which care locations and services you re covered for.Learn more about Medicare

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Health Care | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA 医疗保健 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA 医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: With VA health care, you re covered for regular checkups with your primary care provider and appointments with specialists (like cardiologists, gynecologists, and mental health providers). You can access Veterans health care services like home health and geriatric (elder) care, and you can get medical equipment, prosthetics, and prescriptions. Find out how to apply for and manage the health care benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: 通过 VA 医疗保健，您可以享受由您的初级保健提供者进行的定期检查以及专科医生（如心脏病专家、妇科医生和心理健康服务提供者）的预约。您可以获得退伍军人医疗保健服务，如居家健康和老年（长者）护理，并且可以获得医疗设备、假肢和处方药。了解如何申请和管理您已获得的医疗保健福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA health care Manage your health and benefits More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 获取 VA 医疗保健 管理您的健康与福利 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get help if I'm homeless or at risk of becoming homeless?
source_blocks.text: 如果我无家可归或有成为无家可归者的风险，我该如何获得帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may be able to help
source_blocks.text: 我们也许能够提供帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer many programs and services that may help including free health care and, in some cases, free limited dental care. We can also help you connect with resources in your community, like homeless shelters or faith-based organizations.
source_blocks.text: 我们提供许多可能有所帮助的项目和服务，包括免费医疗保健，在某些情况下还包括免费的有限牙科护理。我们还可以帮助您联系社区中的资源，如无家可归者收容所或宗教组织。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find the support you need:
source_blocks.text: 找到您需要的支持：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at (877-424-3838) for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You ll talk privately with a trained VA counselor for free. Contact your nearest VA medical center and ask to talk with the VA social worker. If you're a female Veteran, ask for the Women Veterans Program Manager.Find the nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心电话 (877-424-3838)，每周 7 天、每天 24 小时获得帮助。您将免费与训练有素的 VA 顾问进行私下交谈。 联系最近的 VA 医疗中心，并要求与 VA 社会工作者交谈。如果您是女性退伍军人，请要求联系女性退伍军人项目经理。查找最近的 VA 医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Talk with someone right now:
source_blocks.text: 立即与他人交谈：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.Chat online with a trained VA staff member
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们富有爱心且经验丰富的退伍军人危机热线应答者联系，获得保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候 24/7 可用。与训练有素的 VA 工作人员在线聊天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA health care
source_blocks.text: 获取 VA 医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA health benefits
source_blocks.text: 关于 VA 医疗福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how VA health care works and which Veterans health care services we cover.
source_blocks.text: 了解 VA 医疗保健如何运作以及我们涵盖哪些退伍军人医疗保健服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you re eligible for Veterans health care benefits and how priority groups work.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得退伍军人医疗保健福利以及优先组如何运作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get instructions for how to prepare and apply for VA health care online, by phone, by mail, or in person.
source_blocks.text: 获取关于如何在线、通过电话、邮寄或亲自准备和申请VA医疗保健的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply online (VA Form 10-10EZ)
source_blocks.text: 在线申请（VA表格10-10EZ）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Start your Veterans health care application now.
source_blocks.text: 立即开始您的退伍军人医疗保健申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you apply
source_blocks.text: 申请后

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out when to expect a decision on your application, and what to do next.
source_blocks.text: 了解何时会收到申请决定，以及接下来该怎么做。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family and caregiver health benefits
source_blocks.text: 家庭和照护者健康福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you qualify for VA medical benefits as a spouse, surviving spouse, dependent child, or caregiver.
source_blocks.text: 查看您作为配偶、未再婚的遗属、受抚养子女或照护者是否符合VA医疗福利的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manage your health and benefits
source_blocks.text: 管理您的健康和福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Refill and track your VA prescriptions
source_blocks.text: 续配并追踪您的VA处方

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order a prescription refill and track your shipment online.
source_blocks.text: 在线订购处方续配并追踪您的发货。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use VA Secure Messaging
source_blocks.text: 使用VA安全消息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Communicate privately with your VA health care team through Secure Messaging.
source_blocks.text: 通过安全消息与您的VA医疗团队私下沟通。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule and view your VA appointments
source_blocks.text: 安排并查看您的VA预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to schedule an appointment by phone, online, or through Secure Messaging.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何通过电话、在线或安全消息安排预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: View your VA lab and test results
source_blocks.text: 查看您的VA实验室和检测结果

source_blocks.source_text_en: View, download, and print your labs and test results.
source_blocks.text: 查看、下载并打印您的实验室和检测结果。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order hearing aid batteries and prosthetic socks
source_blocks.text: 订购助听器电池和假肢袜

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order these items online for home delivery.
source_blocks.text: 在线订购这些物品以便送货上门。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get your VA medical records (also called "VA Blue Button")
source_blocks.text: 获取您的VA医疗记录（也称为“VA蓝按钮”）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Set up your personal health record and download reports to share with your VA and non-VA doctors.
source_blocks.text: 设置您的个人健康记录并下载报告，以便与您的VA和非VA医生分享。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Update your health benefits information (VA Form 10-10EZR)
source_blocks.text: 更新您的健康福利信息（VA表格10-10EZR）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Update your personal, financial, or insurance information after you re enrolled in the VA health care program.
source_blocks.text: 在您重新加入VA医疗保健计划后，更新您的个人、财务或保险信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay your VA copay bill
source_blocks.text: 支付您的VA共付额账单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay your VA copay securely online, by phone or mail, or in person and find out what to do if you're struggling to make payments.
source_blocks.text: 通过在线、电话或邮件安全地支付您的VA共付额，或亲自支付，并了解如果您难以支付款项该怎么办。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your appeal status
source_blocks.text: 查看您的上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of an open VA health care appeal.
source_blocks.text: 跟踪未决的VA医疗保健上诉的状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA travel pay (reimbursement)
source_blocks.text: 获取VA差旅费（报销）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for reimbursement for your travel to a VA health facility.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请前往VA医疗机构的差旅费报销。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA health care copay rates
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健共付额费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: View our current copay rates for different types of care, tests, and medications.
source_blocks.text: 查看我们针对不同类型护理、检查和药物的当前共付额费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mental health services
source_blocks.text: 心理健康服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to access VA mental health services for posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), psychological effects of military sexual trauma (MST), depression, grief, anxiety, and other needs.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获取VA心理健康服务，用于创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、军事性创伤（MST）的心理影响、抑郁、悲伤、焦虑及其他需求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Specific health needs and conditions
source_blocks.text: 特定健康需求和状况

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get care for specific needs (like women's health), and learn about service-related health concerns you should be aware of (like Agent Orange-related diseases or Camp Lejeune water contamination).
source_blocks.text: 了解如何为特定需求（如女性健康）获得护理，并了解您应注意的与服务相关的健康问题（如橙剂相关疾病或勒琼营水污染）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Chemical or hazardous material exposure
source_blocks.text: 化学或危险物质暴露

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about health concerns linked to exposures during military service. Learn about the special VA health registries you can join that document Veterans' exposure to Agent Orange, depleted uranium, ionizing radiation, airborne hazards, and other hazardous materials.
source_blocks.text: 了解与服役期间接触相关的健康问题。了解您可以加入的特殊VA健康登记，这些登记记录了退伍军人接触橙剂、贫铀、电离辐射、空气传播危害和其他危险物质的情况。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans programs for health and wellness
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人健康与保健项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore VA programs to help you get and stay healthy in both body and mind.
source_blocks.text: 探索VA项目，帮助您在身心两方面保持健康。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Community care
source_blocks.text: 社区护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re enrolled in VA health care, find out how you may be able to receive care from a provider in your local community through community care.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已加入VA医疗保健，了解如何通过社区护理从当地社区的提供者那里获得护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) and your VA health care coverage
source_blocks.text: 《平价医疗法案》（ACA）与您的VA医疗保健覆盖范围

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what you need to know about the Affordable Care Act and what it means for Veterans.
source_blocks.text: 了解您需要知道的关于《平价医疗法案》及其对退伍军人的意义。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Million Veteran Program
source_blocks.text: 百万退伍军人计划

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you can be a part of this voluntary research study to better understand the role genes play in our health.
source_blocks.text: 看看您是否可以参与这项自愿研究，以更好地了解基因在我们健康中的作用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Access and quality in VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健的可及性和质量

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get information about your VA facility, like how quickly you can be seen and what other Veterans say about their experiences.
source_blocks.text: 获取有关您VA设施的信息，例如您能多快被接诊以及其他退伍军人对其体验的评价。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Patient rights and responsibilities
source_blocks.text: 患者权利和责任

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read about your basic rights and responsibilities when you receive care at a VA health facility or live in a VA community living center.
source_blocks.text: 阅读您在VA医疗机构接受护理或居住在VA社区生活中心时的基本权利和责任。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 其他VA福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation (pay)
source_blocks.text: 残疾补偿（付款）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to file a claim for disability compensation and manage your disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿申请并管理您的残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance
source_blocks.text: 人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore your life insurance options and find out how to apply as a service member, Veteran, or family member.
source_blocks.text: 探索您的人寿保险选项，并了解作为军人、退伍军人或家庭成员如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Aid and attendance benefits and housebound allowance
source_blocks.text: 援助和出勤福利及居家津贴

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you can get increased pension pay as a Veteran or surviving spouse who has disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为有残疾的退伍军人的遗属，您是否有资格获得增加的养老金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Burial benefits and memorial items
source_blocks.text: 丧葬福利和纪念物品

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about Veterans burial benefits, how to plan a burial service, and how to get compensation as a survivor.
source_blocks.text: 了解退伍军人丧葬福利、如何安排葬礼服务，以及作为遗属如何获得补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education and training
source_blocks.text: 教育培训

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for and manage GI Bill and other education benefits to help pay for college and training programs.
source_blocks.text: 申请并管理GI法案和其他教育福利，以帮助支付大学和培训项目的费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Last updated:
source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The MISSION Act and VA health care
source_blocks.text: MISSION法案与VA医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how we re making it easier for you to get health care through VA facilities, mobile clinics, telehealth, and community providers.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们如何通过VA设施、移动诊所、远程医疗和社区提供者，让您更容易获得医疗保健。

source_blocks.source_text_en: #### Message us
source_blocks.text: #### 给我们发消息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ask a question online
source_blocks.text: 在线提问

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call us
source_blocks.text: 给我们打电话

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health benefits hotline: 877-222-VETS (8387) - My HealtheVet help desk: 877-327-0022 - eBenefits technical support: 800-983-0937 - Call MyVA311 for help: 844-698-2311 - If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 711.
source_blocks.text: 健康福利热线：877-222-VETS (8387) - My HealtheVet帮助台：877-327-0022 - eBenefits技术支持：800-983-0937 - 拨打MyVA311寻求帮助：844-698-2311 - 如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：711。

source_blocks.text: 拨打National Call Center for Homeless Veterans电话(877-424-3838)，每周7天、每天24小时获得帮助。您将免费与训练有素的VA顾问进行私下交谈。 联系最近的VA医疗中心，并要求与VA社会工作者交谈。如果您是女性退伍军人，请要求联系Women Veterans Program Manager。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Talk with someone right now:
source_blocks.text: 立即与他人交谈：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.Chat online with a trained VA staff member
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们关怀备至、经验丰富的Veterans Crisis Line响应者联系，获得保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候可用。与训练有素的VA工作人员在线聊天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA health care
source_blocks.text: 获取VA health care

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA health benefits
source_blocks.text: 关于VA健康福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how VA health care works and which Veterans health care services we cover.
source_blocks.text: 了解VA health care如何运作以及我们涵盖哪些Veterans health care服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you re eligible for Veterans health care benefits and how priority groups work.
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得Veterans health care福利以及优先组如何运作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to apply
source_blocks.text: 如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get instructions for how to prepare and apply for VA health care online, by phone, by mail, or in person.
source_blocks.text: 获取关于如何在线、通过电话、邮寄或亲自准备和申请VA医疗保健的说明。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply online (VA Form 10-10EZ)
source_blocks.text: 在线申请（VA表格10-10EZ）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Start your Veterans health care application now.
source_blocks.text: 立即开始您的退伍军人医疗保健申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you apply
source_blocks.text: 申请后

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out when to expect a decision on your application, and what to do next.
source_blocks.text: 了解何时能收到申请决定，以及接下来该怎么做。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Family and caregiver health benefits
source_blocks.text: 家庭和照护者健康福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you qualify for VA medical benefits as a spouse, surviving spouse, dependent child, or caregiver.
source_blocks.text: 查看您作为配偶、未再婚配偶、受抚养子女或照护者是否符合VA医疗福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Manage your health and benefits
source_blocks.text: 管理您的健康和福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Refill and track your VA prescriptions
source_blocks.text: 续配并追踪您的VA处方

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order a prescription refill and track your shipment online.
source_blocks.text: 在线订购处方续配并追踪您的发货。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use VA Secure Messaging
source_blocks.text: 使用VA安全消息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Communicate privately with your VA health care team through Secure Messaging.
source_blocks.text: 通过Secure Messaging与您的VA医疗团队私下沟通。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Schedule and view your VA appointments
source_blocks.text: 安排并查看您的VA预约

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to schedule an appointment by phone, online, or through Secure Messaging.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何通过电话、在线或Secure Messaging安排预约。

source_blocks.source_text_en: View your VA lab and test results
source_blocks.text: 查看您的VA实验室和检测结果

source_blocks.source_text_en: View, download, and print your labs and test results.
source_blocks.text: 查看、下载并打印您的实验室和检测结果。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order hearing aid batteries and prosthetic socks
source_blocks.text: 订购助听器电池和假肢袜

source_blocks.source_text_en: Order these items online for home delivery.
source_blocks.text: 在线订购这些物品以便送货上门。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get your VA medical records (also called "VA Blue Button")
source_blocks.text: 获取您的 VA 医疗记录（也称为 "VA Blue Button"）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Set up your personal health record and download reports to share with your VA and non-VA doctors.
source_blocks.text: 设置您的个人健康记录并下载报告，以便与您的 VA 和非 VA 医生分享。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Update your health benefits information (VA Form 10-10EZR)
source_blocks.text: 更新您的健康福利信息（VA Form 10-10EZR）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Update your personal, financial, or insurance information after you re enrolled in the VA health care program.
source_blocks.text: 在您重新加入 VA 医疗保健计划后，更新您的个人、财务或保险信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay your VA copay bill
source_blocks.text: 支付您的 VA 共付额账单

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pay your VA copay securely online, by phone or mail, or in person and find out what to do if you're struggling to make payments.
source_blocks.text: 通过在线、电话、邮件或亲自前往的方式安全地支付您的 VA 共付额，并了解如果您难以支付款项该怎么办。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your appeal status
source_blocks.text: 查看您的上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of an open VA health care appeal.
source_blocks.text: 跟踪未解决的 VA 医疗保健上诉的状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA travel pay (reimbursement)
source_blocks.text: 获取 VA 差旅费（报销）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for reimbursement for your travel to a VA health facility.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请前往 VA 医疗机构的差旅费报销。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA health care copay rates
source_blocks.text: VA 医疗保健共付额费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: View our current copay rates for different types of care, tests, and medications.
source_blocks.text: 查看我们针对不同类型护理、检查和药物的当前共付额费率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mental health services
source_blocks.text: 心理健康服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to access VA mental health services for posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), psychological effects of military sexual trauma (MST), depression, grief, anxiety, and other needs.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获取 VA 心理健康服务，包括创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、军事性创伤（MST）的心理影响、抑郁、悲伤、焦虑及其他需求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Specific health needs and conditions
source_blocks.text: 特定健康需求和状况

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get care for specific needs (like women's health), and learn about service-related health concerns you should be aware of (like Agent Orange-related diseases or Camp Lejeune water contamination).
source_blocks.text: 了解如何针对特定需求（如女性健康）获得护理，并了解您应注意的与服务相关的健康问题（如与 Agent Orange 相关的疾病或 Camp Lejeune 水污染）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Chemical or hazardous material exposure
source_blocks.text: 化学或危险物质暴露

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about health concerns linked to exposures during military service. Learn about the special VA health registries you can join that document Veterans' exposure to Agent Orange, depleted uranium, ionizing radiation, airborne hazards, and other hazardous materials.
source_blocks.text: 了解与军事服役期间暴露相关的健康问题。了解您可以加入的特殊VA健康登记处，这些登记处记录退伍军人接触橙剂、贫铀、电离辐射、空气传播危害和其他危险物质的情况。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans programs for health and wellness
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人健康与保健项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore VA programs to help you get and stay healthy in both body and mind.
source_blocks.text: 探索VA项目，帮助您在身心两方面保持健康。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Community care
source_blocks.text: 社区护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re enrolled in VA health care, find out how you may be able to receive care from a provider in your local community through community care.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已注册VA医疗保健，了解如何通过社区护理从当地社区的提供者那里获得护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) and your VA health care coverage
source_blocks.text: 《平价医疗法案》(ACA) 与您的VA医疗保健覆盖范围

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out what you need to know about the Affordable Care Act and what it means for Veterans.
source_blocks.text: 了解您需要知道的关于《平价医疗法案》及其对退伍军人的意义。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Million Veteran Program
source_blocks.text: 百万退伍军人项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you can be a part of this voluntary research study to better understand the role genes play in our health.
source_blocks.text: 看看您是否可以参与这项自愿研究，以更好地了解基因在我们健康中的作用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Access and quality in VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健的可及性与质量

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get information about your VA facility, like how quickly you can be seen and what other Veterans say about their experiences.
source_blocks.text: 获取有关您VA设施的信息，例如您能多快被接诊以及其他退伍军人对其体验的评价。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Patient rights and responsibilities
source_blocks.text: 患者权利与责任

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read about your basic rights and responsibilities when you receive care at a VA health facility or live in a VA community living center.
source_blocks.text: 阅读您在VA医疗机构接受护理或居住在VA社区生活中心时的基本权利与责任。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 其他VA福利与服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation (pay)
source_blocks.text: 残疾补偿（薪酬）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to file a claim for disability compensation and manage your disability benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿申请并管理您的残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life insurance
source_blocks.text: 人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore your life insurance options and find out how to apply as a service member, Veteran, or family member.
source_blocks.text: 探索您的人寿保险选项，并了解作为军人、退伍军人或家庭成员如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Aid and attendance benefits and housebound allowance
source_blocks.text: 援助与出勤福利及居家津贴

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you can get increased pension pay as a Veteran or surviving spouse who has disabilities.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为有残疾的退伍军人或遗属，您是否有资格获得增加的养老金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Burial benefits and memorial items
source_blocks.text: 丧葬福利与纪念物品

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about Veterans burial benefits, how to plan a burial service, and how to get compensation as a survivor.
source_blocks.text: 了解退伍军人丧葬福利、如何安排葬礼服务，以及作为幸存者如何获得补偿。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education and training
source_blocks.text: 教育与培训

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for and manage GI Bill and other education benefits to help pay for college and training programs.
source_blocks.text: 申请并管理GI Bill及其他教育福利，以帮助支付大学和培训项目的费用。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Help To Avoid Mortgage Foreclosure | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部帮助避免抵押贷款止赎 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA help to avoid mortgage foreclosure
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部帮助避免抵押贷款止赎

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you fall far behind on your mortgage payments, your mortgage servicer (the company that handles collecting the money for your lender) can take your house to cover the money owed. This process is called foreclosure. Find out how our VA loan technicians can help you avoid foreclosure and keep your house.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在抵押贷款还款上严重逾期，您的抵押贷款服务商（负责为您的贷款方收取款项的公司）可以收回您的房屋以弥补所欠款项。此过程称为止赎。了解我们的VA贷款专员如何帮助您避免止赎并保住您的房屋。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get VA financial counseling to help avoid foreclosure?
source_blocks.text: 我能否获得VA财务咨询以帮助避免止赎？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran or the surviving spouse of a Veteran, we ll provide financial counseling even if your loan isn t a VA direct or VA-backed loan.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人或退伍军人的未亡配偶，即使您的贷款不是VA直接贷款或VA支持贷款，我们也会提供财务咨询。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA direct or VA-backed loan, you can contact us anytime to request that we assign a VA Loan Technician to your loan. Our technicians can offer you financial counseling and help you deal with your servicer (or work with you directly in the case of a VA direct loan).
source_blocks.text: 如果您有VA直接贷款或VA支持贷款，您可以随时联系我们，请求我们为您的贷款指派一名VA贷款专员。我们的专员可以为您提供财务咨询，并帮助您与服务商打交道（或在VA直接贷款的情况下直接与您合作）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a VA direct or VA-backed loan and it s 61 days past due, we ll automatically assign a VA Loan Technician to your loan.
source_blocks.text: 如果您有VA直接贷款或VA支持贷款，且逾期61天，我们将自动为您的贷款指派一名VA贷款专员。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What should I do if I m having trouble paying my mortgage?
source_blocks.text: 如果我难以支付抵押贷款，该怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re late with a mortgage payment, or think you might be late with your next payment, contact your loan servicer right away. The sooner you contact them, the sooner they can help you find a solution.
source_blocks.text: 如果您逾期支付抵押贷款，或认为可能无法按时支付下一期款项，请立即联系您的贷款服务商。您越早联系他们，他们就能越早帮助您找到解决方案。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re nervous about contacting your servicer, or if you d like our help and advice, please contact a VA Loan Technician at 1-877-827-3702.
source_blocks.text: 如果您对联系服务商感到紧张，或希望获得我们的帮助和建议，请致电1-877-827-3702联系VA贷款专员。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I avoid foreclosure?
source_blocks.text: 我如何避免止赎？

source_blocks.source_text_en: There are 6 general ways you can try to avoid a foreclosure:
source_blocks.text: 有6种通用方法可以尝试避免止赎：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Repayment plan: If you ve missed a few mortgage payments, this plan lets you go back to making your regular payments, with an added amount each month to cover the ones you ve missed.
source_blocks.text: 还款计划：如果您错过了几笔抵押贷款还款，此计划允许您恢复正常还款，每月额外支付一笔金额以弥补错过的还款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Special forbearance: This plan gives you some extra time to repay the missed mortgage payments.
source_blocks.text: 特别宽限：此计划为您提供额外时间来偿还错过的抵押贷款还款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Loan modification: Sometimes you need a fresh start. This plan lets you add the missed mortgage payments and any related legal costs to your total loan balance. You and your servicer then come up with a new mortgage payment schedule.
source_blocks.text: 贷款修改：有时您需要重新开始。此计划允许您将错过的抵押贷款还款及相关法律费用添加到您的总贷款余额中。然后您和服务商共同制定新的抵押贷款还款计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Extra time to arrange a private sale: If you need to sell your home, this plan lets you delay a foreclosure so you have time to sell.
source_blocks.text: 额外时间安排私下出售：如果您需要出售房屋，此计划允许您推迟止赎，以便有时间出售。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Short sale: If you owe more money than your house is worth, your servicer might agree to a short sale. This means the servicer will accept the total proceeds from the home sale (even if it s less than the full amount you owe on the mortgage) as full payment of the debt you owe.
source_blocks.text: 短售：如果您欠款超过房屋价值，您的服务商可能同意短售。这意味着服务商将接受房屋出售的全部收益（即使低于您所欠抵押贷款的全额）作为您所欠债务的全额偿还。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Deed in lieu of foreclosure: This plan lets you avoid the foreclosure process by signing over the deed to the home to your servicer. The home will then belong to the servicer.
source_blocks.text: 以契抵债（止赎替代）：此计划允许您通过将房屋契据签署给服务商来避免止赎程序。房屋随后将归服务商所有。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our VA Loan Technicians can help you figure out which option is best for you. Contact a VA Loan Technician at 1-877-827-3702.
source_blocks.text: 我们的VA贷款技术人员可以帮助您确定哪种选择最适合您。请致电1-877-827-3702联系VA贷款技术人员。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Home Loan Programs For Surviving Spouses | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人事务部为未亡配偶提供的VA住房贷款项目 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA home loan programs for surviving spouses
source_blocks.text: 为未亡配偶提供的VA住房贷款项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get a VA-backed home loan as the surviving spouse of a Veteran, you ll need a Certificate of Eligibility (COE) to show your lender that you qualify for this benefit. Find out if you can get a COE. Keep in mind that you ll also need to meet your lender s credit and income requirements to get a loan.
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人的未亡配偶，要获得VA支持的住房贷款，您需要一份资格证明（COE），以向您的贷款机构证明您有资格享受此项福利。了解您是否能获得COE。请记住，您还需要满足贷款机构的信用和收入要求才能获得贷款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get a COE?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得COE吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get a COE if you re the spouse of a Veteran, and at least one of the descriptions below is true for them.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是退伍军人的配偶，并且以下描述中至少有一项适用于他们，您或许可以获得COE。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. The Veteran:
source_blocks.text: 以下条件中至少有一项必须属实。该退伍军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Is missing in action, or Is a Prisoner of War (POW), or Died while in service or from a service-connected disability and you didn t remarry, or Died while in service or from a service-connected disability and you didn t remarry before you were 57 years old or before December 16, 2003, or Had been totally disabled and then died, but their disability may not have been the cause of death (in certain situations)
source_blocks.text: 在行动中失踪，或 是战俘（POW），或 在服役期间或因服役致残而去世，且您未再婚，或 在服役期间或因服役致残而去世，且您在57岁之前或2003年12月16日之前未再婚，或 曾完全残疾后去世，但其残疾可能不是死因（在某些情况下）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: A surviving spouse who remarried before December 16, 2003, and on or after their 57th birthday, must have applied no later than December 15, 2004, to establish home loan eligibility. We ll have to deny applications we received after December 15, 2004, from surviving spouses who remarried before December 16, 2003.
source_blocks.text: 注意：在2003年12月16日之前且在其57岁生日当天或之后再婚的未再婚配偶，必须在2004年12月15日之前申请，以确立住房贷款资格。对于在2003年12月16日之前再婚的未再婚配偶，我们将不得不拒绝在2004年12月15日之后收到的申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for a COE?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请COE？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on whether or not you re receiving Dependency & Indemnity Compensation (DIC).
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您是否正在领取遗属伤残补偿金（DIC）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re receiving DIC benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您正在领取DIC福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to fill out a Request for Determination of Loan Guaranty Eligibility Unmarried Surviving Spouses (VA Form 26-1817). Download VA Form 26-1817
source_blocks.text: 您需要填写《未婚未再婚遗属贷款资格认定申请表》（VA表格26-1817）。下载VA表格26-1817

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need the Veteran s DD214 (or other separation papers) if available. Get military service records online
source_blocks.text: 您还需要退伍军人的DD214表格（或其他退役文件）（如有）。在线获取兵役记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: Submit the form and discharge or separation papers to:
source_blocks.text: 将表格和退役或退伍文件提交至：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your lender for processing online, or The VA regional loan center that serves your state Find a VA regional loan center
source_blocks.text: 您的贷款机构进行在线处理，或 为您的州提供服务的VA区域贷款中心 查找VA区域贷款中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re not receiving DIC benefits
source_blocks.text: 如果您未领取DIC福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll first need to fill out an Application for DIC, Survivors Pension and/or Accrued Benefits (VA Form 21P-534EZ). Download VA Form 21P-534EZ
source_blocks.text: 您首先需要填写《DIC、遗属养老金和/或应计福利申请表》（VA表格21P-534EZ）。下载VA表格21P-534EZ

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll also need:
source_blocks.text: 您还需要：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veteran s DD214 (or other separation papers) if available, and A copy of your marriage license, and The Veteran s death certificate
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人的DD214（或其他退役文件）（如有），以及 您的结婚证复印件，以及 退伍军人的死亡证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get military service records online
source_blocks.text: 在线获取军人服役记录

source_blocks.source_text_en: Submit the form and documents to the VA pension management center that serves your state. Find a VA pension management center
source_blocks.text: 将表格和文件提交至为您所在州服务的VA养老金管理中心。查找VA养老金管理中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Next steps for getting a VA-backed home loan
source_blocks.text: 获取VA担保住房贷款的后续步骤

source_blocks.source_text_en: Applying for your COE is only one part of the process for getting a VA-backed home loan. Your next steps will depend on the type of loan you re looking to get and on the private bank or mortgage company that s serving as your lender.
source_blocks.text: 申请您的COE只是获得VA担保住房贷款过程的一部分。您的后续步骤将取决于您想要获得的贷款类型以及作为您的贷款方的私人银行或抵押贷款公司。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: If you already have a VA-backed loan and you re having trouble making your mortgage payments, we can help you avoid foreclosure and keep your house. Learn about VA financial counseling
source_blocks.text: 注意：如果您已经拥有VA担保贷款，并且在支付抵押贷款方面遇到困难，我们可以帮助您避免丧失抵押品赎回权并保住您的房屋。了解VA财务咨询

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Housing Assistance | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA住房援助 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA housing assistance
source_blocks.text: VA住房援助

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA housing assistance can help Veterans, service members, and their surviving spouses to buy a home or refinance a loan. We also offer benefits and services to help you build, improve, or keep your current home. Find out how to apply for and manage the Veterans housing assistance benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: VA住房援助可以帮助退伍军人、服役人员及其未再婚的配偶购买住房或再融资贷款。我们还提供福利和服务，帮助您建造、改善或保留现有住房。了解如何申请和管理您应得的退伍军人住房援助福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: On this page
source_blocks.text: 本页内容

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA Home Loan Benefits Get Veterans Housing Assistance Grants
source_blocks.text: 获取VA住房贷款福利 获取退伍军人住房援助补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get help if I'm homeless or at risk of becoming homeless?
source_blocks.text: 如果我无家可归或有成为无家可归者的风险，我该如何获得帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may be able to help
source_blocks.text: 我们可能能够提供帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer many programs and services that may help including free health care and, in some cases, free limited dental care. We can also help you connect with resources in your community, like homeless shelters or faith-based organizations.
source_blocks.text: 我们提供许多可能有所帮助的项目和服务，包括免费医疗保健，在某些情况下还包括免费的有限牙科护理。我们还可以帮助您联系社区中的资源，如无家可归者收容所或宗教组织。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find the support you need:
source_blocks.text: 找到您需要的支持：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at (877-424-3838) for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You ll talk privately with a trained VA counselor for free. Contact your nearest VA medical center and ask to talk with the VA social worker. If you're a female Veteran, ask for the Women Veterans Program Manager.Find the nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心电话(877-424-3838)，每周7天、每天24小时获得帮助。您将免费与训练有素的VA顾问进行私下交谈。 联系最近的VA医疗中心，并要求与VA社会工作者交谈。如果您是女性退伍军人，请要求与女性退伍军人项目经理交谈。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Talk with someone right now:
source_blocks.text: 立即与某人交谈：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.Chat online with a trained VA staff member
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们关怀备至、经验丰富的退伍军人危机热线响应人员联系，以获得保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候可用。与训练有素的VA工作人员在线聊天

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get VA Home Loan Benefits
source_blocks.text: 获取VA住房贷款福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: About VA Home Loan Types
source_blocks.text: 关于VA住房贷款类型

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how VA direct and VA-backed home loans work and find out which loan type may be right for you.
source_blocks.text: 了解VA直接贷款和VA支持住房贷款如何运作，并找出哪种贷款类型可能适合您。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 资格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you're eligible for a VA direct or VA-backed home loan, based on your service history and duty status.
source_blocks.text: 根据您的服役历史和服役状态，了解您是否有资格获得VA直接或VA支持的住房贷款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How to Apply for Your Certificate of Eligibility
source_blocks.text: 如何申请您的资格证明

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get instructions for how to apply for your VA home loan Certificate of Eligibility (COE) and what to do next depending on your loan type.
source_blocks.text: 获取关于如何申请VA住房贷款资格证明（COE）的说明，以及根据您的贷款类型接下来该怎么做。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Home Loan Programs for Surviving Spouses
source_blocks.text: 为未再婚配偶提供的VA住房贷款项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you're eligible and how to apply for a VA home loan COE as the surviving spouse of a Veteran or the spouse of a Veteran who is missing in action or being held as a Prisoner of War.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为退伍军人的未再婚配偶或作为失踪或被俘军人配偶的您是否符合资格，以及如何申请VA住房贷款COE。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check Your Appeal Status
source_blocks.text: 查看您的上诉状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of an open home loan COE appeal.
source_blocks.text: 跟踪未结的住房贷款COE上诉的状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Having Trouble Making Payments on a VA-Backed Mortgage?
source_blocks.text: 偿还VA担保抵押贷款有困难？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help to avoid foreclosure if you're struggling to make your monthly mortgage payments.
source_blocks.text: 如果您难以支付每月按揭还款，获取帮助以避免丧失抵押品赎回权。

source_blocks.source_text_en: A Warning about Home Loan Refinancing Offers
source_blocks.text: 关于住房贷款再融资要约的警告

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about the signs of misleading offers to refinance your VA-backed home loan, like claims that you can skip payments or get very low interest rates or other terms that sound too good to be true.
source_blocks.text: 了解误导性再融资要约的迹象，这些要约声称您可以跳过还款或获得极低的利率或其他听起来好得令人难以置信的条款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Home Buying Process for Veterans
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人购房流程

source_blocks.source_text_en: Watch a video and get more information about using your VA home loan benefit to buy a home.
source_blocks.text: 观看视频并获取更多关于使用您的VA住房贷款福利购房的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Loan Funding Fee
source_blocks.text: VA贷款资金费

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you'll need to pay this fee when using your home loan benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解在使用您的住房贷款福利时是否需要支付此费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a VA Regional Loan Center
source_blocks.text: 查找VA区域贷款中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Look up contact information for your nearest regional loan center.
source_blocks.text: 查找您最近的区域贷款中心的联系信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find VA-Acquired Properties
source_blocks.text: 查找VA收购的房产

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about buying a home we've acquired because its VA-direct or VA-backed home loan was terminated.
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于购买我们因VA直接或VA担保住房贷款终止而收购的房屋的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Guidance on Natural Disasters
source_blocks.text: 自然灾害指南

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get help if you have a VA direct or VA-backed home loan or Specially Adapted Housing grant and your home was damaged by a natural disaster.
source_blocks.text: 了解如果您的房屋因自然灾害受损，且您拥有VA直接或VA担保的住房贷款或特别适应性住房补助金，如何获得帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get Veterans Housing Assistance Grants
source_blocks.text: 获取退伍军人住房援助补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: About Disability Housing Grants for Veterans
source_blocks.text: 关于退伍军人残障住房补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for a housing grant as a Veteran or Servicemember with a service-connected disability.
source_blocks.text: 了解作为患有与服务相关残障的退伍军人或军人的您如何申请住房补助金。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for a Specially Adapted Housing Grant
source_blocks.text: 申请特别适应性住房补助金

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get financial help to make changes to your home to help you live more independently with a service-connected disability.
source_blocks.text: 获得经济援助，对您的房屋进行改造，以帮助您因服务相关残障而更独立地生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check Your SAH Grant Claim Status
source_blocks.text: 检查您的SAH补助金申请状态

source_blocks.source_text_en: Track the status of an open claim for a Specially Adapted Housing grant.
source_blocks.text: 跟踪特别适应性住房补助金的未结申请状态。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA Benefits and Services
source_blocks.text: 其他VA福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability Compensation (Pay)
source_blocks.text: 残障补偿（薪酬）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to file a claim for compensation for conditions related to your military service.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何为与您的军事服务相关的状况提交补偿申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pension Benefits
source_blocks.text: 养老金福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: See if you qualify for pension benefits as a wartime Veteran or a surviving spouse or child.
source_blocks.text: 查看您作为战时退伍军人或未亡配偶或子女是否符合养老金福利资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E)
source_blocks.text: 职业康复与就业（VR&E）

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service-connected disability limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, find out if you can get VR&E benefits and services like help exploring employment options and getting more training if required.
source_blocks.text: 如果您的服务相关残障限制了您的工作能力或使您无法工作，请了解您是否可以获得VR&E福利和服务，例如帮助探索就业选择以及在需要时获得更多培训。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Life Insurance
source_blocks.text: 人寿保险

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore your life insurance options and find out how to apply as a Servicemember, Veteran, or family member.
source_blocks.text: 探索您的人寿保险选项，并了解作为军人、退伍军人或家庭成员如何申请。

source_blocks.text: 全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how we can help you or a Veteran you care about connect with VA and local resources 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们如何帮助您或您关心的退伍军人，每周7天、每天24小时联系VA及当地资源。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call us
source_blocks.text: 给我们打电话

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Individual Unemployability If You Can't Work | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA Individual Unemployability 如果你无法工作 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Individual Unemployability if you can't work
source_blocks.text: VA Individual Unemployability 如果你无法工作

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you can t work because of a disability related to your service in the military (a service-connected disability), you may qualify for what s called Individual Unemployability. This means you may be able to get disability compensation or benefits at the same level as a Veteran who has a 100% disability rating.
source_blocks.text: 如果你因与军队服役相关的残疾（服务连接性残疾）而无法工作，你可能符合所谓的 Individual Unemployability 的条件。这意味着你可能能够获得与拥有 100% 残疾评级的 Veteran 相同水平的残疾补偿或福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get disability benefits from VA?
source_blocks.text: 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get disability benefits if you meet both of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果你满足以下列出的两项要求，你可能能够获得残疾福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Both of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下两项都必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have at least 1 service-connected disability rated at 60% or more disabling, or 2 or more service-connected disabilities with at least 1 rated at 40% or more disabling and a combined rating of 70% or more and You can t hold down a steady job that supports you financially (known as substantially gainful employment) because of your service-connected disability. Odd jobs (marginal employment) don t count.
source_blocks.text: 你至少有 1 项服务连接性残疾评级为 60% 或以上致残，或有 2 项或以上服务连接性残疾，其中至少 1 项评级为 40% 或以上致残，且合并评级为 70% 或以上，并且 由于你的服务连接性残疾，你无法维持一份能经济上支持你的稳定工作（称为 substantially gainful employment）。零工（marginal employment）不算。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: In certain cases for example, if you need to be in the hospital often you may qualify at a lower disability rating.
source_blocks.text: 注意：在某些情况下，例如，如果你需要经常住院，你可能在较低的残疾评级下符合条件。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who s covered?
source_blocks.text: 谁受保障？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans
source_blocks.text: Veterans

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得哪些类型的福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Health care Compensation (payments)
source_blocks.text: 医疗保健 补偿（付款）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. When you file, you ll have to provide evidence (supporting documents like a doctor s report or medical test results) showing that your disability prevents you from holding down a steady job. We ll also review your work and education history. Example: A Veteran has a service-connected heart condition and a 60% disability rating. She was still able to work until last year when she began to get chest pain when doing anything physical, like walking or lifting boxes. Her doctor told her to retire as soon as possible. She filed a claim for more disability compensation. We reviewed her work and education history and agreed that she was individually unemployable because of her service-connected disability. So we increased her disability compensation to the same rate as a 100% disabled Veteran.
source_blocks.text: 你需要提交残疾补偿申请。当你提交时，你需要提供证据（支持性文件，如医生报告或医学检测结果），证明你的残疾使你无法维持稳定工作。我们还会审查你的工作和教育历史。示例：一位 Veteran 有服务连接性心脏病，残疾评级为 60%。她直到去年仍能工作，当时她开始在做任何体力活动（如走路或搬箱子）时出现胸痛。她的医生告诉她尽快退休。她提交了更多残疾补偿的申请。我们审查了她的工作和教育历史，并同意她因服务连接性残疾而 individual unemployable。因此，我们将她的残疾补偿提高到与 100% 残疾 Veteran 相同的水平。

source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

source_blocks.text: 当你提交残疾申请时，你还需要填写以下针对 Individual Unemployability 福利的额外表格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA life insurance

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA life insurance can offer financial security for Veterans, service members, and their spouses and dependent children. Explore your options, manage your policy, and file claims to get the insurance benefits you've earned.
source_blocks.text: VA人寿保险可以为退伍军人、服役人员及其配偶和受抚养子女提供财务保障。探索您的选择，管理您的保单，并提交索赔，以获得您应得的保险福利。

source_blocks.text: 如果您收到了创伤性损伤保护人寿保险福利的拒绝信，且信中指示您使用此表格，请在信函中注明的日期前提交上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Enroll in VGLI Auto Pay
source_blocks.text: 注册VGLI自动支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign up to pay your Veterans' Group Life Insurance premium automatically from your bank account.
source_blocks.text: 注册从您的银行账户自动支付退伍军人团体人寿保险保费。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Search for unclaimed insurance funds
source_blocks.text: 搜索未领取的保险资金

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you think we may owe you funds from a VA insurance policy, search our unclaimed funds records by the qualifying Veteran's name.
source_blocks.text: 如果您认为我们可能欠您VA保险单的资金，请按符合条件的退伍军人姓名搜索我们的未领取资金记录。

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information and resources
source_blocks.text: 更多信息和资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much life insurance do I need?
source_blocks.text: 我需要多少人寿保险？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Use our life insurance needs calculator and VGLI comparison questionnaire to help decide how much life insurance you need.
source_blocks.text: 使用我们的人寿保险需求计算器和VGLI比较问卷来帮助决定您需要多少人寿保险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Myths and rumors about SGLI/VGLI insurance
source_blocks.text: 关于SGLI/VGLI保险的传言和误解

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get the facts on common myths, rumors, and misconceptions about SGLI and VGLI insurance.
source_blocks.text: 了解关于SGLI和VGLI保险的常见传言、谣言和误解的事实。

source_blocks.source_text_en: About the SGLI Online Enrollment System (SOES)
source_blocks.text: 关于SGLI在线注册系统（SOES）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about our new online process for enrolling in Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们新的军人团体人寿保险在线注册流程。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact us
source_blocks.text: 联系我们

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to reach out to ask a question about your policy or file a claim for benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何联系我们，就您的保单提出问题或申请福利索赔。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA life insurance forms
source_blocks.text: VA人寿保险表格

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find and download the forms you need to apply for and manage your life insurance benefits.
source_blocks.text: 查找并下载您申请和管理人寿保险福利所需的表格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Publications and handbooks
source_blocks.text: 出版物和手册

source_blocks.source_text_en: Download life insurance handbooks, guides, and newsletters.
source_blocks.text: 下载人寿保险手册、指南和新闻通讯。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mandatory electronic payments
source_blocks.text: 强制性电子支付

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn about the law requiring us to pay all benefits by electronic funds transfer.
source_blocks.text: 了解要求我们通过电子资金转账支付所有福利的法律。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical conditions that may make you uninsurable
source_blocks.text: 可能导致您无法投保的医疗状况

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out which medical conditions may make it hard for you to get private life insurance after you separate from service, and what to do to make sure you have coverage.
source_blocks.text: 了解哪些医疗状况可能使您在退役后难以获得私人人寿保险，以及如何确保您有保险保障。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Special dividend rumors
source_blocks.text: 特别股息谣言

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn the truth about the rumors that there are special dividends for Veterans who don't have an active government life insurance policy.
source_blocks.text: 了解关于没有有效政府人寿保险保单的退伍军人可获得特别股息的谣言真相。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other VA benefits and services
source_blocks.text: 其他VA福利和服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Burial benefits and and memorial items
source_blocks.text: 丧葬福利和纪念物品

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get help planning a burial, order a headstone or other memorial item, and apply for survivor and dependent benefits.
source_blocks.text: 获取安排葬礼、订购墓碑或其他纪念物品的帮助，并申请遗属和受抚养人福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Pension benefits
source_blocks.text: 养老金福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you're eligible for tax-free monthly payments as a wartime Veteran or surviving spouse or child.
source_blocks.text: 了解您作为战时退伍军人或遗属配偶或子女是否有资格获得免税的月度付款。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA医疗保健

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply for and manage your VA health care benefits.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何申请和管理您的VA医疗保健福利。

source_blocks.text: 最后更新：

documents.source_title_en: VA Mental Health Services | Veterans Affairs
documents.title: VA心理健康服务 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Mental Health Services | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: VA心理健康服务 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA mental health services
source_blocks.text: VA心理健康服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to access VA mental health services for posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), psychological effects of military sexual trauma (MST), depression, grief, anxiety, and other needs. You can use some services even if you re not enrolled in VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获取VA心理健康服务，包括创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、军事性创伤（MST）的心理影响、抑郁、悲伤、焦虑及其他需求。即使您未注册VA医疗保健，也可以使用某些服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: 我现在如何与人交谈？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: 了解如何随时获得支持，无论白天还是夜晚。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请联系我们关怀备至、经验丰富的退伍军人危机热线 responders，获取保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。这项服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候24/7可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: 要随时联系退伍军人危机热线 responder，无论白天还是夜晚：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: 拨打800-273-8255，然后选择1。 开始保密退伍军人聊天。 发送短信至838255。 如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：800-799-4889。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: 您还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 拨打911。 前往最近的急诊室。 直接前往最近的VA医疗中心。无论您的退役身份如何，或是否注册了VA医疗保健，都没有关系。查找最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get free mental health care for a year after separation no matter your discharge status, service history, or eligibility for VA health care.
source_blocks.text: 退役后一年内免费获得心理健康护理，无论您的退役身份、服役历史或是否符合VA医疗保健资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get care now
source_blocks.text: 立即获得护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need support for a specific mental health problem or if you re having problems sleeping, controlling your anger, or readjusting to civilian life you are not alone. And we can help.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要针对特定心理健康问题的支持，或者您有睡眠问题、控制愤怒困难或重新适应平民生活的问题，您并不孤单。我们可以提供帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To access free VA mental health services right away:
source_blocks.text: 要立即获得免费VA心理健康服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call or walk in to any VA medical center anytime, day or night.Find your nearest VA health facility Call or walk in to any Vet Center during clinic hours.Find your nearest Vet Center Call us at 1-877-222-VETS (1-877-222-8387). We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 1-800-877-8339.
source_blocks.text: 随时拨打或走进任何VA医疗中心，无论白天还是夜晚。查找最近的VA医疗设施 在诊所营业时间内拨打或走进任何Vet Center。查找最近的Vet Center 拨打我们的电话1-877-222-VETS（1-877-222-8387）。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上8:00在此为您服务。如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：1-800-877-8339。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You don t need to be enrolled in VA health care to get care.Learn more about accessing VA mental health services
source_blocks.text: 您无需注册VA医疗保健即可获得护理。了解更多关于获取VA心理健康服务的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with other resources for Veterans and transitioning service members:
source_blocks.text: 要联系其他针对退伍军人和过渡期服役人员的资源：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Visit the Department of Defense (DoD) Military OneSource website Visit our mental health site for transitioning service members Read about our commitment to supporting transitioning Veterans
source_blocks.text: 访问国防部（DoD）Military OneSource网站 访问我们为过渡期服役人员提供的心理健康网站 阅读我们支持过渡期退伍军人的承诺

source_blocks.source_text_en: Getting started
source_blocks.text: 入门指南

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you need support for a specific mental health problem or if you re having problems sleeping, controlling your anger, or readjusting to civilian life you are not alone. And we can help.
source_blocks.text: 如果您需要针对特定心理健康问题的支持，或者您正面临睡眠问题、难以控制愤怒或难以重新适应平民生活，您并不孤单。我们可以提供帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Over 1.7 million Veterans received mental health services at VA last year. Our services range from peer support with other Veterans to counseling, therapy, medication, or a combination of these options. Our goal is to help you take charge of your treatment and live a full and meaningful life.
source_blocks.text: 去年，超过170万退伍军人在VA接受了心理健康服务。我们的服务范围从与其他退伍军人的同伴支持到咨询、治疗、药物治疗或这些选项的组合。我们的目标是帮助您掌控自己的治疗，过上充实而有意义的生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I schedule my first appointment?
source_blocks.text: 如何安排我的第一次预约？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re already using VA medical services, ask your primary care provider to help you make an appointment with a VA mental health provider.
source_blocks.text: 如果您已经在使用VA医疗服务，请让您的主治医生帮助您预约VA心理健康服务提供者。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re not already using VA medical services, contact your nearest VA medical center or Vet Center to talk about your needs.Find your nearest VA medical center or Vet Center
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未使用VA医疗服务，请联系最近的VA医疗中心或退伍军人中心，讨论您的需求。查找最近的VA医疗中心或退伍军人中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I m not sure what kind of help I need?
source_blocks.text: 如果我不确定自己需要什么样的帮助怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can call 877-222-8387 to find the right resources for your needs. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-877-8339.
source_blocks.text: 您可以拨打877-222-8387，找到适合您需求的资源。如果您有听力障碍，请拨打TTY：800-877-8339。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上8:00提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: It s hard for me to get to a VA facility in person. Can I get mental health services online?
source_blocks.text: 我很难亲自前往VA机构。我可以在线获得心理健康服务吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. You may be able to use one or more of the care options listed below.
source_blocks.text: 可以。您或许可以使用以下一种或多种护理选项。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Veteran Training online self-help portal for overcoming everyday challenges: You can use this portal s tools to help manage your anger, develop parenting and problem-solving skills, and more. The tools are based on proven mental health practices that have successfully helped other Veterans and families. The portal is free, and you don t have to sign in or provide any personal information to use the tools.Visit the Veteran Training portal
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人培训在线自助门户，用于克服日常挑战：您可以使用此门户的工具来帮助管理愤怒、培养育儿和解决问题的技能等。这些工具基于已被证明有效的心理健康实践，成功帮助了其他退伍军人和家庭。该门户是免费的，您无需登录或提供任何个人信息即可使用这些工具。访问退伍军人培训门户

source_blocks.source_text_en: Smartphone apps for Veterans: We ve partnered with the Department of Defense (DoD) to create free smartphone applications you can use to help manage your physical and mental health. These include apps to help you deal with stress, quit smoking, and more.Learn more about apps for Veterans (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 面向退伍军人的智能手机应用程序：我们与国防部（DoD）合作，创建了免费的智能手机应用程序，您可以使用它们来帮助管理身心健康。这些包括帮助您应对压力、戒烟等的应用程序。了解更多关于退伍军人应用程序的信息（PDF）

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VA telemental health program: You can connect with a VA mental health provider through a computer or mobile device in your home or at your nearest VA health facility. If you re enrolled in VA health care, ask any of your providers to help connect you with our telemental health program.
source_blocks.text: VA远程心理健康计划：您可以通过家中的电脑或移动设备，或在最近的VA卫生机构，与VA心理健康服务提供者联系。如果您已注册VA医疗保健，请让您的任何服务提供者帮助您联系我们的远程心理健康计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I speak to a fellow Veteran who s been through this before?
source_blocks.text: 我可以与经历过类似情况的退伍军人交谈吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. The BeThere peer assistance program, in partnership with Military OneSource, offers support to service members (including National Guard soldiers and Reservists), their families, and transitioning Veterans up to 365 days after separation or retirement. Through this program, you can talk privately with peer coaches who are Veterans, service members, or military spouses.
source_blocks.text: 可以。BeThere同伴援助计划与Military OneSource合作，为服役人员（包括国民警卫队士兵和预备役人员）、其家属以及退役或退休后365天内的过渡期退伍军人提供支持。通过该计划，您可以与同伴教练私下交谈，他们可能是退伍军人、服役人员或军属。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To talk with a peer coach, call Military OneSource s free, confidential peer support services at 800-342-9647. This service is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
source_blocks.text: 要与同伴教练交谈，请拨打Military OneSource的免费、保密同伴支持服务，电话800-342-9647。该服务全年365天、每天24小时可用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What other options do I have?
source_blocks.text: 我还有其他哪些选择？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a combat Veteran, you can visit one of our Vet Centers to get free individual and group counseling for you and your family. You can access these services even if you re not enrolled in VA health care and aren t receiving disability compensation.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是参战退伍军人，您可以前往我们的退伍军人中心之一，为您和您的家人获得免费的个人和团体咨询。即使您未加入VA医疗保健且未获得伤残补偿，也可以使用这些服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Vet Centers offer services such as:
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人中心提供的服务包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Military sexual trauma (MST) counseling Readjustment counseling Bereavement (grief) counseling Employment counseling Substance abuse assessment and referral
source_blocks.text: 军事性创伤（MST）咨询 重新适应咨询 丧亲（悲伤）咨询 就业咨询 药物滥用评估和转介

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a Vet Center near you
source_blocks.text: 查找您附近的退伍军人中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also call 877-927-8387 to talk with a fellow combat Veteran about your experiences, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以拨打877-927-8387，与一位参战退伍军人谈论您的经历，全天候24小时，每周7天，每年365天。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you d like to connect with other Veterans, families, and local services, you can visit our Make the Connection website. This site connects millions of Veterans, and their family members and friends, to local VA and community mental health resources. Visit the site to access these referral resources and hear Veteran testimonials of strength and recovery.Go to Make the Connection
source_blocks.text: 如果您想与其他退伍军人、家属和当地服务联系，您可以访问我们的“建立联系”网站。该网站将数百万退伍军人及其家人和朋友与当地的VA和社区心理健康资源联系起来。访问该网站以获取这些转介资源，并听取退伍军人关于力量和康复的见证。前往“建立联系”网站

source_blocks.source_text_en: More information about VA mental health services
source_blocks.text: 关于VA心理健康服务的更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get answers to other questions you may have about our services.
source_blocks.text: 获取您可能对我们的服务有其他问题的答案。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Being diagnosed with a mental health condition or seeking mental health care doesn t automatically put work-related credentials, such as security clearances, at risk. Most employers recognize that healthy employees who get help when they need it are more productive and effective in their jobs than those who aren t performing at their best because they re not feeling well.
source_blocks.text: 被诊断出心理健康状况或寻求心理健康护理并不会自动使与工作相关的凭证（如安全许可）面临风险。大多数雇主认识到，在需要时获得帮助的健康员工比那些因感觉不适而表现不佳的员工在工作中更有效率。

source_blocks.source_text_en: No. If you don t qualify for VA health care, you may still be able to get certain health care services, like care for needs linked to military sexual trauma.
source_blocks.text: 不。如果您不符合VA医疗保健的资格，您可能仍然可以获得某些医疗保健服务，例如与军事性创伤相关的护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call our general VA hotline at 800-827-1000 to find out what your care options may be. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 拨打我们的VA总热线800-827-1000，了解您的护理选项可能是什么。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上9:00提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Depending on your needs and situation, you can also:
source_blocks.text: 根据您的需求和情况，您还可以：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get free private counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support for combat Veterans and families at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homelessness programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential. - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center
source_blocks.text: 在我们的300个社区退伍军人中心之一，为参战退伍军人和家庭提供免费的私人咨询、酒精和药物评估以及其他支持。查找您附近的退伍军人中心 - 联系无家可归退伍军人国家呼叫中心，电话877-424-3838，全天候24小时，每周7天提供帮助。训练有素的VA顾问将提供有关VA无家可归者计划、医疗保健和您所在地区其他服务的信息。电话免费且保密。 - 致电或访问您当地的VA社区资源和转介中心。即使您不符合VA医疗保健的资格，我们的工作人员也可以帮助您找到您所在社区中您可能符合资格的非VA资源。查找您当地的社区资源和转介中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or you can apply for VA health care to access more services:
source_blocks.text: 或者您可以申请VA医疗保健以访问更多服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out if you re eligible for VA health careLearn how to apply for health care benefits
source_blocks.text: 了解您是否有资格获得VA医疗保健了解如何申请医疗保健福利

source_blocks.source_text_en: To learn more about whether you re eligible for services, call your nearest VA medical center.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: 要了解更多关于您是否有资格获得服务的信息，请致电您最近的VA医疗中心。查找您最近的VA医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Or call 877-222-8387 to find the right resource for your needs. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-877-8339. We re here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 或拨打877-222-8387以找到适合您需求的资源。如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：800-877-8339。我们周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上8:00提供服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll start receiving help the day you reach out to us. We offer same-day services to make sure we can either address your mental health needs or schedule the right follow-up care right away. The specific care you receive will depend on how urgent your needs are and the level of treatment you re looking for.
source_blocks.text: 您联系我们当天就会开始获得帮助。我们提供当日服务，以确保我们可以解决您的心理健康需求或立即安排适当的后续护理。您获得的具体护理将取决于您的需求紧急程度以及您寻求的治疗水平。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Same-day services may include care such as:
source_blocks.text: 当日服务可能包括以下护理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Meeting face-to-face with a VA health care provider (including walk-in appointments at a clinic or urgent care center) - Having a telehealth or video care appointment with a VA provider - Talking by phone with a VA nurse who can offer medical advice (called nurse triage ) - Communicating with a VA provider through Secure Messaging - Scheduling a future appointment - Getting a prescription filled
source_blocks.text: 与VA医疗保健提供者面对面会诊（包括在诊所或紧急护理中心的免预约就诊） - 与VA提供者进行远程医疗或视频护理预约 - 通过电话与VA护士交谈，获取医疗建议（称为护士分诊） - 通过安全消息与VA提供者沟通 - 安排未来的预约 - 获取处方药

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer treatment and support for a range of mental health problems, including:
source_blocks.text: 我们为一系列心理健康问题提供治疗和支持，包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) - Depression - Thoughts of suicide - Issues related to military sexual trauma (MST) - Substance use problems - Bipolar disorder - Schizophrenia
source_blocks.text: 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD） - 抑郁症 - 自杀念头 - 与军事性创伤（MST）相关的问题 - 物质使用问题 - 双相情感障碍 - 精神分裂症

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also treat anxiety-related conditions, like:
source_blocks.text: 我们还治疗与焦虑相关的疾病，如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Generalized anxiety disorder - Panic disorder - Social anxiety - Specific phobias
source_blocks.text: 广泛性焦虑障碍 - 恐慌障碍 - 社交焦虑 - 特定恐惧症

source_blocks.source_text_en: We provide a range of mental health services such as:
source_blocks.text: 我们提供一系列心理健康服务，如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Short-term, inpatient care for Veterans with severe or life-threatening mental illness - Outpatient care for Veterans with serious mental illness who have a lot of trouble functioning in daily life - Regular outpatient care, which may include care provided over the phone, for Veterans facing a difficult time in their lives - Rehabilitation treatment and residential (live-in) programs for Veterans with mental health problems and other needs (like those related to homelessness, job training, and education) who would be best helped by getting treatment or living in a structured setting for a period of time - Primary care for many common mental and behavioral problems - Supported work settings to help Veterans join the work force and live well in the community
source_blocks.text: 为患有严重或危及生命的心理疾病的退伍军人提供短期住院护理 - 为患有严重心理疾病且在日常生活中遇到很多困难的退伍军人提供门诊护理 - 常规门诊护理，可能包括通过电话提供的护理，适用于面临生活困难的退伍军人 - 康复治疗和住院（住宿）项目，适用于有心理健康问题和其他需求（如与无家可归、职业培训和相关的需求）的退伍军人，这些退伍军人通过在一段时间内接受治疗或生活在结构化环境中能得到最佳帮助 - 为许多常见的心理和行为问题提供初级保健 - 支持性工作环境，帮助退伍军人加入劳动力队伍并在社区中良好生活

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also provide care to Veterans in crisis. This includes:
source_blocks.text: 我们还为处于危机中的退伍军人提供护理。这包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Emergency mental health care 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, through VA medical centers and some local, non-VA hospitals - The Veterans Crisis Line, which offers support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for Veterans in crisis and their families and friends
source_blocks.text: 通过VA医疗中心和一些当地的非VA医院，每周7天、每天24小时提供紧急心理健康护理 - 退伍军人危机热线，为处于危机中的退伍军人及其家人和朋友提供每周7天、每天24小时的支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VA mental health services
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于VA心理健康服务的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. In addition to online resources, caregiver support coordinators at your nearest VA medical center and a caregiver peer support mentoring program can help connect caregivers to one another for support and learning.
source_blocks.text: 是的。除了在线资源外，您最近的VA医疗中心的照护者支持协调员和照护者同伴支持指导计划可以帮助照护者相互联系，以获得支持和学习。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To get support as a caregiver:
source_blocks.text: 作为照护者获得支持：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find a local caregiver support coordinator - Or call the Caregiver Support Line 855-260-3274, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET
source_blocks.text: 查找当地的照护者支持协调员 - 或拨打照护者支持热线855-260-3274，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also contact our Coaching into Care program to speak directly with a licensed psychologist or social worker, free of charge. They can provide information about mental health and VA services, as well as tips for how to begin the conversation about treatment with a loved one.
source_blocks.text: 您也可以联系我们的“指导进入护理”计划，免费与持牌心理学家或社会工作者直接交谈。他们可以提供有关心理健康和VA服务的信息，以及如何开始与亲人谈论治疗的技巧。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To reach a licensed psychologist or social worker:
source_blocks.text: 联系持牌心理学家或社会工作者：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Contact Coaching into Care online - Or call 888-823-7458, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET
source_blocks.text: 在线联系“指导进入护理” - 或拨打888-823-7458，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至下午8:00

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can use our facility locator to search for VA health facilities near you.Find your nearest VA health facility
source_blocks.text: 您可以使用我们的设施定位器搜索您附近的VA医疗设施。查找您最近的VA医疗设施

source_blocks.source_text_en: Resources and support outside VA
source_blocks.text: VA以外的资源和支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also get support from resources offered by other government departments and community organizations outside of VA.
source_blocks.text: 您还可以从VA以外的其他政府部门和社区组织提供的资源中获得支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Military OneSource This free service provides expert support to connect military personnel and their families with the best available resources to fit their needs. For support, visit the Military OneSource website or call 800-342-9647 anytime, day or night.
source_blocks.text: Military OneSource 这项免费服务提供专家支持，将军事人员及其家属与最适合他们需求的可用资源联系起来。如需支持，请访问Military OneSource网站或随时拨打800-342-9647，昼夜均可。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Psychological Health Resource Center The center works to improve the lives of Veterans, service members, and their families by advancing excellence in psychological health care, readiness, and prevention.
source_blocks.text: 心理健康资源中心 该中心致力于通过推进心理健康护理、准备和预防方面的卓越表现，改善退伍军人、服役人员及其家人的生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The National Suicide Prevention Lifeline This 24/7, 365-day-a-year emergency mental health hotline offers support for people experiencing a mental health crisis.
source_blocks.text: 国家自杀预防生命线 这条全天候24/7、全年365天的紧急心理健康热线为经历心理健康危机的人们提供支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To reach the hotline:
source_blocks.text: 要联系热线：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Start an online chat - Or call 800-273-8255
source_blocks.text: 开始在线聊天 - 或拨打800-273-8255

source_blocks.source_text_en: The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention The foundation provides mental health resources for people struggling with thoughts of suicide. They also offer supportive educational tools for concerned family, friends and peers.
source_blocks.text: 美国自杀预防基金会 该基金会为与自杀念头作斗争的人们提供心理健康资源。他们还为担忧的家人、朋友和同龄人提供支持性教育工具。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) SAMHSA offers free, confidential help with treatment referral and information services for individuals and families facing mental health and/or substance use disorders. Support is available 24/7, 365-days-a-year, in both English and Spanish.
source_blocks.text: 药物滥用和心理健康服务管理局（SAMHSA） SAMHSA为面临心理健康和/或物质使用障碍的个人和家庭提供免费、保密的治疗转介和信息服务。支持全天候24/7、全年365天提供，提供英语和西班牙语服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: To reach SAMHSA s National Helpline:
source_blocks.text: 要联系SAMHSA的国家帮助热线：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 1800-662-HELP (800-662-4357) - Learn more about the helpline
source_blocks.text: 拨打1800-662-HELP（800-662-4357） - 了解更多关于热线信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: The National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI) NAMI builds better lives for millions of Americans affected by mental illness by providing education programs for families and individuals living with mental health problems.
source_blocks.text: 全国精神疾病联盟（NAMI） NAMI通过为受精神疾病影响的家庭和个人提供教育项目，为数百万受精神疾病影响的美国人创造更好的生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: The Jed Foundation The foundation works closely with teenagers and young adults who may be experiencing mental stress or may be at risk for suicide during times of change.
source_blocks.text: Jed基金会 该基金会与可能经历心理压力或在变化时期有自杀风险的青少年和年轻人密切合作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mental Health America This organization advocates for policies that promote mental health and the rights of people living with mental health problems. They also provide education and connections to mental health resources.
source_blocks.text: 心理健康美国 该组织倡导促进心理健康和心理健康问题患者权利的政策。他们还提供教育和心理健康资源的联系。

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA nursing homes, assisted living, and home health care
source_blocks.text: VA nursing homes, assisted living, and home health care

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a Veteran, you may be able to get assisted living, residential (live-in), or home health care through VA. Find out how to access these long-term care services.
source_blocks.text: As a Veteran, you may be able to get assisted living, residential (live-in), or home health care through VA. Find out how to access these long-term care services.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kinds of long-term care services does VA offer for sick or disabled Veterans?
source_blocks.text: What kinds of long-term care services does VA offer for sick or disabled Veterans?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our long-term care services include:
source_blocks.text: Our long-term care services include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: 24/7 nursing and medical care Physical therapy Help with daily tasks (like bathing, dressing, making meals, and taking medicine) Comfort care and help with managing pain Support for caregivers who may need skilled help or a break so they can work, travel, or run errands
source_blocks.text: 24/7 nursing and medical care Physical therapy Help with daily tasks (like bathing, dressing, making meals, and taking medicine) Comfort care and help with managing pain Support for caregivers who may need skilled help or a break so they can work, travel, or run errands

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get this care in many different settings some run by VA and others run by state or community organizations that we inspect and approve.
source_blocks.text: You can get this care in many different settings some run by VA and others run by state or community organizations that we inspect and approve.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Care settings may include:
source_blocks.text: Care settings may include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Nursing homes Assisted-living centers Private homes where a caregiver supports a small group of individuals Adult day health centers Veterans own homes
source_blocks.text: Nursing homes Assisted-living centers Private homes where a caregiver supports a small group of individuals Adult day health centers Veterans own homes

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can learn more about the different types of care below or see our guide to long-term services and supports.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access these services?
source_blocks.text: How do I access these services?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to use one or more of these services if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to use one or more of these services if you meet all of the requirements listed below.

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: All of these must be true:

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re signed up for VA health care, and We conclude that you need a specific service to help with your ongoing treatment and personal care, and The service (or space in the care setting) is available near you
source_blocks.text: You re signed up for VA health care, and We conclude that you need a specific service to help with your ongoing treatment and personal care, and The service (or space in the care setting) is available near you

source_blocks.source_text_en: We may also consider other factors, like your service-connected disability status or insurance coverage.
source_blocks.text: We may also consider other factors, like your service-connected disability status or insurance coverage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To find out how to access these services, contact your VA social worker. Or, call our toll-free hotline at 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: To find out how to access these services, contact your VA social worker. Or, call our toll-free hotline at 877-222-8387, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other services aren t covered under VA health care benefits. For these services, you may be able to pay through Medicaid, Medicare, or your own private insurance.
