source_blocks.source_text_en: More details about your care options
source_blocks.text: More details about your care options

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get nursing home care in 1 of the 3 different nursing home settings listed below. In each, you d live there full time and have access to nursing and medical care, as well as help with daily tasks 24 hours a day.
source_blocks.text: You can get nursing home care in 1 of the 3 different nursing home settings listed below. In each, you d live there full time and have access to nursing and medical care, as well as help with daily tasks 24 hours a day.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get VA benefits to help pay for nursing home care. It depends on your income and the level of your service-connected disability (a disability that resulted from your military service).
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get VA benefits to help pay for nursing home care. It depends on your income and the level of your service-connected disability (a disability that resulted from your military service).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about:
source_blocks.text: Learn more about:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Community Living Centers VA nursing centers that are designed to feel like home
source_blocks.text: Community Living Centers VA nursing centers that are designed to feel like home

source_blocks.source_text_en: Community Nursing Homes Non-VA nursing homes that we contract with in many parts of the country so you can get care near your home and family
source_blocks.text: Community Nursing Homes Non-VA nursing homes that we contract with in many parts of the country so you can get care near your home and family

source_blocks.source_text_en: State Veterans Homes State-owned and -managed centers that provide full-time care for Veterans and, sometimes, non-Veteran spouses and Gold Star parents
source_blocks.text: State Veterans Homes State-owned and -managed centers that provide full-time care for Veterans and, sometimes, non-Veteran spouses and Gold Star parents

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get community residential (live-in) care in settings such as those listed below. In each setting, a trained professional will provide care and support with daily tasks 24 hours a day.
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get community residential (live-in) care in settings such as those listed below. In each setting, a trained professional will provide care and support with daily tasks 24 hours a day.

source_blocks.source_text_en: These places are not run, staffed, or paid for by VA, but we do inspect and approve each one. And you may be able to use VA benefits to help pay for extra services (like visits from a VA health care provider).
source_blocks.text: These places are not run, staffed, or paid for by VA, but we do inspect and approve each one. And you may be able to use VA benefits to help pay for extra services (like visits from a VA health care provider).

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about:
source_blocks.text: Learn more about:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Medical foster homes Private homes where a few people live together and get care
source_blocks.text: Medical foster homes Private homes where a few people live together and get care

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adult family homes (or adult foster homes) Private homes with rooms to rent for 6 or fewer people
source_blocks.text: Adult family homes (or adult foster homes) Private homes with rooms to rent for 6 or fewer people

source_blocks.source_text_en: Assisted living facilities Centers where Veterans can live in a rented room or apartment, and have access to shared living spaces like a dining room
source_blocks.text: Assisted living facilities Centers where Veterans can live in a rented room or apartment, and have access to shared living spaces like a dining room

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re signed up for VA health care, you can get help managing your disability or health condition while living at home. The services you qualify for will depend on your needs and whether a service is available in your area. If you need to, you may be able to use more than one service at the same time.
source_blocks.text: If you re signed up for VA health care, you can get help managing your disability or health condition while living at home. The services you qualify for will depend on your needs and whether a service is available in your area. If you need to, you may be able to use more than one service at the same time.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about:
source_blocks.text: Learn more about:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Home-based primary care A VA health care team, led by a VA doctor, who provides services (like nursing care, physical therapy, and help with daily tasks) in your home
source_blocks.text: Home-based primary care A VA health care team, led by a VA doctor, who provides services (like nursing care, physical therapy, and help with daily tasks) in your home

source_blocks.source_text_en: Homemaker/home health aide (H/HHA) services A trained caregiver (supervised by a registered nurse) who comes into your home to help you care for yourself
source_blocks.text: Homemaker/home health aide (H/HHA) services A trained caregiver (supervised by a registered nurse) who comes into your home to help you care for yourself

source_blocks.source_text_en: Adult day health care A program you can go to during the day for social activities, companionship, and recreation as well as care and support
source_blocks.text: Adult day health care A program you can go to during the day for social activities, companionship, and recreation as well as care and support

source_blocks.source_text_en: Hospice care Skilled caregivers who come into your home to provide comfort care to you and your family. You qualify for hospice care if you have a terminal condition (a condition that can t be treated), with less than 6 months to live, and you re no longer seeking treatment other than to ease pain.
source_blocks.text: Hospice care Skilled caregivers who come into your home to provide comfort care to you and your family. You qualify for hospice care if you have a terminal condition (a condition that can t be treated), with less than 6 months to live, and you re no longer seeking treatment other than to ease pain.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Palliative care Skilled caregivers who come into your home to provide comfort care to help ease your pain and control your symptoms so you can do as much as possible in your daily life
source_blocks.text: Palliative care Skilled caregivers who come into your home to provide comfort care to help ease your pain and control your symptoms so you can do as much as possible in your daily life

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re signed up for VA health care, you can get home-based health care as part of your benefits. The services that you qualify for will depend on your needs.
source_blocks.text: If you re signed up for VA health care, you can get home-based health care as part of your benefits. The services that you qualify for will depend on your needs.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about:
source_blocks.text: Learn more about:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Skilled home health care Health care providers from a community-based home health agency who come to your house to provide care such as wound care, physical therapy, social work support, and help with daily tasks
source_blocks.text: Skilled home health care Health care providers from a community-based home health agency who come to your house to provide care such as wound care, physical therapy, social work support, and help with daily tasks

source_blocks.source_text_en: Home Telehealth A VA care coordinator who keeps track of your health remotely using special equipment in your home and will check in with you by phone, if needed. If there are any signs of a problem, your care coordinator will work with you and your VA doctor and nurse to figure out what to do next.
source_blocks.text: Home Telehealth A VA care coordinator who keeps track of your health remotely using special equipment in your home and will check in with you by phone, if needed. If there are any signs of a problem, your care coordinator will work with you and your VA doctor and nurse to figure out what to do next.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be able to get a service called respite care as part of your VA health care benefits. This service pays for a person to come into your home or for you to go to a program outside your home while your family caregiver takes a break.Learn more about respite care
source_blocks.text: You may be able to get a service called respite care as part of your VA health care benefits. This service pays for a person to come into your home or for you to go to a program outside your home while your family caregiver takes a break.Learn more about respite care

source_blocks.source_text_en: Other services for home health care (like adult day health care or skilled health aide services) listed above can also help to support caregivers.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Yes. We offer Geriatric Patient Aligned Care Team (GeriPACT) services in about two-thirds of VA medical centers.

source_blocks.text: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA Survivors Pension
source_blocks.text: VA Survivors Pension

source_blocks.source_text_en: A VA Survivors Pension offers monthly payments to qualified surviving spouses and unmarried dependent children of wartime Veterans who meet certain income and net worth limits set by Congress. Find out if you qualify and how to apply.
source_blocks.text: VA Survivors Pension 为符合条件的战时退伍军人的未再婚遗属和未婚受抚养子女提供每月补助金，前提是他们满足国会设定的收入和净资产限额。了解您是否符合资格以及如何申请。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for a VA Survivors Pension as a surviving spouse?
source_blocks.text: 作为未再婚遗属，我是否有资格获得 VA Survivors Pension？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you haven t remarried after the Veteran s death, and if the deceased Veteran didn t receive a dishonorable discharge and their service meets at least one of the requirements listed below, you may be eligible for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在退伍军人去世后未再婚，且已故退伍军人并非不名誉退役，并且其服役满足以下至少一项要求，则您可能有资格获得此项福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. The Veteran:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真。该退伍军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Entered active duty on or before September 7, 1980, and served at least 90 days on active military service, with at least 1 day during a wartime period, or
source_blocks.text: 于1980年9月7日或之前开始服现役，并在现役部队中服役至少90天，其中至少1天在战时期间，或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Entered active duty after September 7, 1980, and served at least 24 months or the full period for which they were called or ordered to active duty (with some exceptions), with at least 1 day during a wartime period or
source_blocks.text: 于1980年9月7日之后开始服现役，并服役至少24个月或完成其被征召或命令服现役的全部期限（有例外情况），其中至少1天在战时期间，或

source_blocks.source_text_en: Was an officer and started on active duty after October 16, 1981, and hadn t previously served on active duty for at least 24 months
source_blocks.text: 是军官，于1981年10月16日之后开始服现役，且此前未曾在现役部队中服役至少24个月

source_blocks.source_text_en: And this must be true for you:
source_blocks.text: 并且以下情况对您必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your yearly family income and net worth meet certain limits set by Congress. Your net worth equals the value of everything you own (except your house, your car, and most home furnishings), minus any debt you owe.
source_blocks.text: 您的年度家庭收入和净资产满足国会设定的特定限额。您的净资产等于您拥有的所有财产价值（不包括您的房屋、汽车和大多数家居用品）减去您所欠的债务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I know if the Veteran served under an eligible wartime period?
source_blocks.text: 我如何知道退伍军人是否在符合条件的战时期间服役？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Under current law, we recognize the following wartime periods to decide eligibility for pension benefits:
source_blocks.text: 根据现行法律，我们承认以下战时期间来决定养老金福利的资格：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mexican Border period (May 9, 1916, to April 5, 1917, for Veterans who served in Mexico, on its borders, or in adjacent waters) World War I (April 6, 1917, to November 11, 1918) World War II (December 7, 1941, to December 31, 1946) Korean conflict (June 27, 1950, to January 31, 1955) Vietnam War era (February 28, 1961, to May 7, 1975 for Veterans who served in the Republic of Vietnam during that period. August 5, 1964, to May 7, 1975, for Veterans who served outside of the Republic of Vietnam.) Gulf War (August 2, 1990, through a future date to be set by law or presidential proclamation)
source_blocks.text: 墨西哥边境时期（1916年5月9日至1917年4月5日，适用于在墨西哥、其边境或邻近水域服役的退伍军人） 第一次世界大战（1917年4月6日至1918年11月11日） 第二次世界大战（1941年12月7日至1946年12月31日） 朝鲜冲突（1950年6月27日至1955年1月31日） 越南战争时期（1961年2月28日至1975年5月7日，适用于在此期间在越南共和国服役的退伍军人。1964年8月5日至1975年5月7日，适用于在越南共和国境外服役的退伍军人。） 海湾战争（1990年8月2日至法律或总统公告规定的未来日期）

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for a VA Survivors Pension as the child of a deceased wartime Veteran?
source_blocks.text: 作为已故战时退伍军人的子女，我是否有资格获得 VA Survivors Pension？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re unmarried and you meet at least one of the requirements listed below, you may be eligible for this benefit.
source_blocks.text: 如果您未婚且满足以下至少一项要求，则您可能有资格获得此项福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下至少一项必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You re under age 18, or You re under age 23 and attending a VA-approved school, or You re unable to care for yourself due to a disability that happened before age 18
source_blocks.text: 您未满18岁，或 您未满23岁且正在就读VA认可的学校，或 您因18岁前发生的残疾而无法照顾自己

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I apply for a VA Survivors Pension?
source_blocks.text: 如何申请VA遗属养老金？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can apply in any of these ways:
source_blocks.text: 您可以通过以下任一方式申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: By mail
source_blocks.text: 邮寄申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Fill out an Application for DIC, Death Pension, and/or Accrued Benefits (VA Form 21-534EZ). Download VA Form 21-534EZ (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 填写《DIC、死亡养老金和/或应计福利申请表》（VA Form 21-534EZ）。下载 VA Form 21-534EZ (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Mail it to the pension management center (PMC) for your state. Find your PMC
source_blocks.text: 将其邮寄至您所在州的养老金管理中心（PMC）。查找您的 PMC

source_blocks.source_text_en: In person
source_blocks.text: 亲自申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Bring your application to a VA regional office near you. Find a VA regional benefit office near you
source_blocks.text: 携带您的申请表前往附近的VA区域办事处。查找附近的VA区域福利办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: With the help of a trained professional
source_blocks.text: 在专业人士的帮助下申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can work with a trained professional called an accredited representative to get help applying for VA survivors pension benefits. Get help filing your claim
source_blocks.text: 您可以与称为授权代表的专业人士合作，以获得申请VA遗属养老金福利的帮助。获取申请帮助

source_blocks.source_text_en: How long does it take VA to make a decision?
source_blocks.text: VA需要多长时间做出决定？

source_blocks.source_text_en: It depends. We process VA Survivors Pension claims in the order we receive them, unless a claim requires priority processing.
source_blocks.text: 视情况而定。我们按照收到申请的先后顺序处理VA遗属养老金申请，除非某项申请需要优先处理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a service-connected disability that limits your ability to work or prevents you from working, the VA Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) program also referred to as Chapter 31 can help. Find out if you re eligible and how to apply for vocational rehabilitation benefits and services, like help exploring employment options and any required training needs. In some cases, your family members may also be eligible for certain benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran in a mental health crisis and you re thinking about hurting yourself or you know a Veteran who s considering this act now. You re not alone, and you can get help.
source_blocks.text: If you re a Veteran in a mental health crisis and you re thinking about hurting yourself or you know a Veteran who s considering this act now. You re not alone, and you can get help.

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I talk to someone right now?
source_blocks.text: How do I talk to someone right now?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.
source_blocks.text: Find out how to get support anytime day or night.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.
source_blocks.text: If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.

source_blocks.source_text_en: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:
source_blocks.text: To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.
source_blocks.text: Call 800-273-8255, then select 1. Start a confidential Veterans chat. Text 838255. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also:
source_blocks.text: You can also:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center
source_blocks.text: Call 911. Go to the nearest emergency room. Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where can I turn for ongoing support?
source_blocks.text: Where can I turn for ongoing support?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can find ongoing support through VA to help you get your life back on track:
source_blocks.text: You can find ongoing support through VA to help you get your life back on track:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our specially trained suicide prevention coordinators available in each VA medical center across the country can help you get the counseling and services you need. Our Vet Centers can help you and your family readjust to life at home after you ve returned from serving in a combat zone. Our Veterans Benefits Administration offices can help you access benefits for disability compensation (monthly payments), job training, home loans, and more.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What are the signs that someone may be considering suicide?
source_blocks.text: What are the signs that someone may be considering suicide?

source_blocks.source_text_en: Many Veterans don t show any signs of an urge to harm themselves before doing so. But some may show signs of depression, anxiety, low self-esteem, or hopelessness, like:
source_blocks.text: Many Veterans don t show any signs of an urge to harm themselves before doing so. But some may show signs of depression, anxiety, low self-esteem, or hopelessness, like:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Seeming sad, depressed, anxious, or agitated most of the time Sleeping either all the time or not much at all Not caring about what they look like or what happens to them Pulling away from friends, family, and society Losing interest in hobbies, work, school, or other things they used to care about Expressing feelings of excessive guilt or shame, failure, lack of purpose in life, or being trapped
source_blocks.text: Seeming sad, depressed, anxious, or agitated most of the time Sleeping either all the time or not much at all Not caring about what they look like or what happens to them Pulling away from friends, family, and society Losing interest in hobbies, work, school, or other things they used to care about Expressing feelings of excessive guilt or shame, failure, lack of purpose in life, or being trapped

source_blocks.source_text_en: They may also change the way they act, and start to:
source_blocks.text: They may also change the way they act, and start to:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Perform poorly at work or school Act violently or take risks (like driving fast or running red lights) Do things to prepare for a suicide (like giving away special personal items, making a will, or seeking access to guns or pills)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you attend your training program in person, your housing stipend will be equal to the monthly military Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) for an E-5 with dependents. This is based on the zip code where you attend your training.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If we determine that you re eligible for VET TEC, you ll then apply to the VA-approved training provider of your choice. source_blocks.source_text_en: With Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you may be able to keep your life insurance coverage after you leave the military for as long as you continue to pay the premiums. Find out if you qualify for VGLI and how to manage your coverage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Am I eligible for Veterans Group Life Insurance?

source_blocks.source_text_en: At least one of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: At least one of these must be true. You:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Had part-time Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) as a member of the National Guard or Reserves, and you suffered an injury or disability (damage to your body or mind that makes it hard for you to do everyday tasks, including meaningful work) while on duty including direct traveling to and from duty that disqualified you for standard premium insurance rates, or Had SGLI while you were in the military and you re within 1 year and 120 days of being released from an active-duty period of 31 or more days, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) of a branch of service, or to the Inactive National Guard (ING). This includes members of the United States Public Health Service Inactive Reserve Corps (IRC), or Are within 1 year and 120 days of being put on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL)

source_blocks.text: Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI)

source_blocks.source_text_en: Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI) offers mortgage protection insurance to the families of Veterans with severe service-connected disabilities who ve adapted a home to fit their needs. Find out if you qualify and how to apply and manage your coverage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Up to \$200,000 in mortgage life insurance paid directly to the bank or other lender that holds your mortgage.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Important details about VMLI:
source_blocks.text: Important details about VMLI:

source_blocks.source_text_en: The money will be paid directly to the bank or other lender that holds your mortgage not to a life insurance beneficiary (a person chosen to receive the money from a policy when the insured dies). The amount of coverage will equal the amount you still owe on your mortgage, but won t be more than \$200,000. VMLI is a decreasing-term insurance. This means your coverage amount goes down as your mortgage balance goes down. If you pay off your mortgage, your VMLI coverage will end. VMLI has no loan or cash value and it doesn t pay dividends (cash payments made to policy holders when the company makes a profit).

source_blocks.source_text_en: VR&E Independent Living track
source_blocks.text: VR&E 独立生活轨道

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your service-connected disability limits your ability to perform activities of daily living (like bathing, dressing, accessing the community, and interacting with others) and you can t return to work right away, you may qualify for independent living services through the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Independent Living track. You may also receive these services as you work to find a job if that s a goal you and your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) have created. In both cases, your VRC can help you restore your daily-living activities. Find out if you may be eligible for services to help you live as independently as possible.
source_blocks.text: 如果你的服役相关残疾限制了你的日常生活活动能力（如洗澡、穿衣、进入社区和与他人互动），并且你无法立即重返工作岗位，你可能符合通过 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) 独立生活轨道获得独立生活服务的资格。如果你和你的 Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) 设定了找工作的目标，你也可以在寻找工作的过程中获得这些服务。在这两种情况下，你的 VRC 都可以帮助你恢复日常活动能力。了解你是否可能有资格获得服务，以帮助你尽可能独立地生活。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get independent living services through VR&E?
source_blocks.text: 我可以通过 VR&E 获得独立生活服务吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for independent living services if you re a service member or Veteran with a service-connected disability who is eligible for VR&E benefits, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果你是符合 VR&E 福利资格的服役人员或退伍军人，且患有服役相关残疾，并且满足以下所有要求，你可能符合独立生活服务的资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件都必须满足：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have a serious employment handicap (SEH), and Your disabilities prevent you from looking for or returning to work, and You re in need of services to live as independently as possible
source_blocks.text: 你有严重的就业障碍 (SEH)，并且 你的残疾使你无法寻找或重返工作，并且 你需要服务以尽可能独立地生活

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note: Having an employment handicap means your service-connected disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests).
source_blocks.text: 请注意：有就业障碍意味着你的服役相关残疾限制了你准备、获得和维持合适就业（一份不会使你的残疾恶化、稳定且与你的能力、才能和兴趣相匹配的工作）的能力。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我可以获得哪些类型的福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Depending on your needs, services may include:
source_blocks.text: 根据你的需求，服务可能包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Evaluation and counseling to identify your needs and goals Home consultations with specialists Referral to support resources Guidance to help you understand if you re eligible for our adaptive-housing programs. These programs can help you make changes to your home like widening doorways or adding ramps so you can live more independently. Learn more about adaptive housing grants
source_blocks.text: 评估和咨询，以确定你的需求和目标 与专家进行家庭咨询 转介至支持资源 指导以帮助你了解是否符合我们的适应性住房计划的资格。这些计划可以帮助你改造你的家，如拓宽门口或增加坡道，以便你能更独立地生活。了解更多关于适应性住房补助的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: These services generally last up to 24 months. In some cases, you may be able to use services for longer than this.
source_blocks.text: 这些服务通常持续最多 24 个月。在某些情况下，你可能能够使用服务超过这个时间。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, you ll need to apply for VR&E benefits. Then, you ll work with your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC).
source_blocks.text: 首先，你需要申请 VR&E 福利。然后，你将与你的 Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) 合作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have your VA disability rating, follow these steps to apply:
source_blocks.text: 如果你有 VA 残疾评级，请按照以下步骤申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your eBenefits account.
source_blocks.text: 登录你的 eBenefits 账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Additional Benefits on your dashboard.
source_blocks.text: 在仪表板上点击 Additional Benefits。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program.
source_blocks.text: 点击 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment program.
source_blocks.text: 申请 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment 计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible, we ll invite you to an orientation session at your nearest VA regional benefit office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您到最近的 VA 区域福利办公室参加 orientation 会议。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible, a VRC will work with you to determine the severity of your service-connected disability, if you re ready to work, and if you ll benefit from independent living services. Your VRC will help you create a personalized, written independent living plan that meets your needs.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，VRC 将与您合作，确定您与服务相关的残疾的严重程度、您是否准备好工作，以及您是否会从独立生活服务中受益。您的 VRC 将帮助您制定一份个性化的、书面的独立生活计划，以满足您的需求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ready to apply?
source_blocks.text: 准备好申请了吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往 eBenefits 申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply if you haven t yet received a disability rating
source_blocks.text: 了解如果您尚未获得残疾评级，如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: VR&E Reemployment track
source_blocks.text: VR&E Reemployment track

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a Veteran, you re protected under the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act (USERRA). This means you can t be disadvantaged in your civilian career because of your service. If you re a Veteran with a service-connected disability, the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Reemployment track can help your employer accommodate your needs. Your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) can provide a full range of rehabilitation services, and can refer you directly to the Department of Labor to begin the process. Find out how we can help you return to your former job and support your employer in meeting your needs.
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人，您受《Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act (USERRA)》保护。这意味着您的服役不会使您在平民职业生涯中处于不利地位。如果您是因公致残的退伍军人，Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Reemployment track 可以帮助您的雇主满足您的需求。您的 Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) 可以提供全方位的康复服务，并可直接将您转介给 Department of Labor 以启动流程。了解我们如何帮助您重返原工作岗位并支持您的雇主满足您的需求。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get help returning to my former job through VR&E?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过 VR&E 获得重返原工作岗位的帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for help if you re a Veteran with a service-connected disability, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是因公致残的退伍军人，并且满足以下所有要求，您可能有资格获得帮助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须为真。您：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Have an employment barrier or handicap, and Are enrolled in Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E), and Would like to return to your former job
source_blocks.text: 有就业障碍或 handicap，并且 已注册 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E)，并且 希望重返原工作岗位

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Having an employment handicap means your service-connected disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests).
source_blocks.text: 注意：有就业 handicap 意味着您的 service-connected disability 限制了您准备、获得和维持合适就业（不会加重您的残疾、稳定且与您的能力、才能和兴趣相匹配的工作）的能力。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help with the process of returning to the job you held before you deployed.
source_blocks.text: 帮助您重返部署前所担任的工作岗位。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, you ll need to apply for VR&E benefits. Then, you ll work with your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC).
source_blocks.text: 首先，您需要申请 VR&E 福利。然后，您将与您的 Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC) 合作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have your VA disability rating, follow these steps to apply:
source_blocks.text: 如果您已有 VA disability rating，请按照以下步骤申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your eBenefits account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的 eBenefits 账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Additional Benefits on your dashboard.
source_blocks.text: 在仪表板上点击 Additional Benefits。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Choose Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program.
source_blocks.text: 选择 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment program.
source_blocks.text: 申请 Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment 计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible, we ll invite you to an orientation session at your nearest VA regional benefit office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您参加最近的 VA 区域福利办公室的 orientation session。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ready to apply?
source_blocks.text: 准备好申请了吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往 eBenefits 申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply if you haven t yet received a disability rating
source_blocks.text: 如果你还没有收到伤残等级评定，了解如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer opportunities to get training and practical hands-on work experience at the same time through programs like:
source_blocks.text: 我们提供通过以下项目同时获得培训和实际动手工作经验的机会，例如：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VR&E Special Employer Incentives (SEI) program for eligible Veterans who face challenges getting a job.Download the SEI program fact sheet (PDF) The VR&E Non-Paid Work Experience (NPWE) program for eligible Veterans and service members who have an established career goal and learn easily in a hands-on environment or are having trouble getting a job due to lack of work experience.Download the NPWE program fact sheet (PDF)Watch this video to learn more about the NPWE program
source_blocks.text: 针对在找工作时面临挑战的符合条件的退伍军人的 VR&E 特别雇主激励（SEI）项目。下载 SEI 项目情况说明书（PDF） 针对已有明确职业目标且在手把手环境中学习效果好，或因缺乏工作经验而难以找到工作的符合条件的退伍军人和军人的 VR&E 无薪工作经验（NPWE）项目。下载 NPWE 项目情况说明书（PDF）观看此视频以了解更多关于 NPWE 项目的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also offer:
source_blocks.text: 我们还提供：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VR&E employment coordinators located at our VA regional offices and many of our out-based locations who can help you access the employment services available to you.Find an employment coordinator near you Counselors to help you transition from military to college life.Learn about VetSuccess on Campus Links to more resources outside VA that can help you in your job search.See our list of external resources If you re participating in a VR&E employment program and lost your housing because of a natural or other disaster, you may qualify for 2 more months of the Employment Adjustment Allowance.Contact your VR&E counselor for more information
source_blocks.text: 位于我们的 VA 地区办公室和许多外派地点的 VR&E 就业协调员，他们可以帮助你获取可用的就业服务。查找你附近的就业协调员 帮助你从军队生活过渡到大学生活的辅导员。了解 VetSuccess on Campus 更多 VA 外部资源的链接，这些资源可以帮助你求职。查看我们的外部资源列表 如果你正在参加 VR&E 就业项目，并且因自然或其他灾害失去了住房，你可能符合资格获得额外 2 个月的就业调整津贴。联系你的 VR&E 辅导员以获取更多信息

source_blocks.text: VR&E 自雇轨道 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: VR&E Self-Employment track
source_blocks.text: VR&E 自雇轨道

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a service member or Veteran with a service-connected disability and an employment barrier who has the strong desire, skills, and drive to run a successful business, you may be interested in the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Self-Employment track. Find out if you can get help starting your own business.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是因公致残且存在就业障碍的军人或退伍军人，并且有强烈的愿望、技能和动力去成功经营企业，您可能对职业康复与就业（VR&E）自雇轨道感兴趣。了解您是否可以获得帮助以创办自己的企业。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get help starting my own business through the VR&E Self-Employment track?
source_blocks.text: 我能否通过 VR&E 自雇轨道获得创办自己企业的帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may be eligible for these benefits if you re a service member or Veteran with a service-connected disability, and you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果您是因公致残的军人或退伍军人，并且满足以下所有要求，您可能有资格获得这些福利。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件必须为真：

source_blocks.source_text_en: You have an employment barrier or handicap, and You re enrolled in VR&E, and Your service-connected disability makes it hard for you to prepare for, obtain, and maintain suitable employment (a job that doesn t make your disability worse, is stable, and matches your abilities, aptitudes, and interests)
source_blocks.text: 您有就业障碍或残疾，并且 您已加入 VR&E，并且 您的因公致残使您难以准备、获得和维持合适的就业（一份不会使您的残疾恶化、稳定且与您的能力、才能和兴趣相匹配的工作）

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get through the VR&E Self-Employment track?
source_blocks.text: 我可以通过 VR&E 自雇轨道获得哪些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Coordination services and help with developing a proposed business plan Analysis of your business concept Training in small-business operations, marketing, and finances Guidance in getting the right resources to implement your business plan
source_blocks.text: 协调服务和制定拟议商业计划的帮助 对您的商业理念进行分析 小企业运营、市场营销和财务方面的培训 指导您获取实施商业计划所需的适当资源

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you develop your business plan, we ll review it and evaluate whether self-employment and the proposed business are viable options.
source_blocks.text: 在您制定商业计划后，我们将对其进行审查，并评估自雇和拟议业务是否可行。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: First, you ll need to apply for VR&E benefits. Then, you ll work with your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC).
source_blocks.text: 首先，您需要申请 VR&E 福利。然后，您将与您的职业康复顾问（VRC）合作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have your VA disability rating, follow these steps to apply:
source_blocks.text: 如果您已有 VA 残疾评级，请按照以下步骤申请：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Sign in to your eBenefits account.
source_blocks.text: 登录您的 eBenefits 账户。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Additional Benefits on your dashboard.
source_blocks.text: 在仪表板上点击“其他福利”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Click Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment Program.
source_blocks.text: 点击“职业康复与就业计划”。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Apply for the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment program.
source_blocks.text: 申请职业康复与就业计划。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible, we ll invite you to an orientation session at your nearest VA regional benefit office.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合资格，我们将邀请您参加最近 VA 地区福利办公室的迎新会。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Ready to apply?
source_blocks.text: 准备好申请了吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to eBenefits to apply
source_blocks.text: 前往eBenefits申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to apply if you haven t yet received a disability rating
source_blocks.text: 了解如果您尚未获得伤残评级，如何申请

source_blocks.source_text_en: Get more information
source_blocks.text: 获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We offer opportunities to get training and practical hands-on work experience at the same time through programs like:
source_blocks.text: 我们通过以下项目提供同时获得培训和实际动手工作经验的机会：

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VR&E Special Employer Incentives (SEI) program for eligible Veterans who face challenges getting a job. Download the SEI program fact sheet (PDF) The VR&E Non-Paid Work Experience (NPWE) program for eligible Veterans and service members who have an established career goal and learn easily in a hands-on environment or are having trouble getting a job due to lack of work experience. Download the NPWE program fact sheet (PDF)Watch this video to learn more about the NPWE program
source_blocks.text: VR&E特殊雇主激励（SEI）项目，适用于面临求职挑战的符合条件的退伍军人。下载SEI项目情况说明书（PDF） VR&E无薪工作经验（NPWE）项目，适用于已确立职业目标且在手把手环境中学习容易或由于缺乏工作经验而难以找到工作的符合条件的退伍军人和服役人员。下载NPWE项目情况说明书（PDF）观看此视频以了解更多关于NPWE项目的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also offer:
source_blocks.text: 我们还提供：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VR&E employment coordinators located at our VA regional offices and many of our out-based locations who can help you access the employment services available to you.Find an employment coordinator near you Counselors to help you transition from military to college life. Learn about VetSuccess on Campus Links to more resources outside VA that can help you in your job search. See our list of external resources If you re participating in a VR&E employment program and lost your housing because of a natural or other disaster, you may qualify for 2 more months of the Employment Adjustment Allowance.Contact your VR&E counselor for more information
source_blocks.text: 位于我们VA地区办公室和许多外派地点的VR&E就业协调员，他们可以帮助您获得可用的就业服务。查找您附近的就业协调员 帮助您从军队过渡到大学生活的辅导员。了解VetSuccess on Campus 指向VA以外更多资源的链接，这些资源可以帮助您求职。查看我们的外部资源列表 如果您正在参加VR&E就业项目，并且因自然或其他灾害失去了住房，您可能有资格获得额外2个月的就业调整津贴。联系您的VR&E辅导员以获取更多信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may also want to consider registering with the Office of Small & Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU) to get support for your Veteran-owned small business.
source_blocks.text: 您可能还想考虑在小企业及弱势企业利用办公室（OSDBU）注册，以获取对您退伍军人拥有的小企业的支持。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What to expect after you get a disability rating
source_blocks.text: What to expect after you get a disability rating

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you got a decision notice from us that confirms your disability rating (the rating that measures the severity of your disability), you may be able to get disability compensation or benefits. Find out what benefits you can get.
source_blocks.text: If you got a decision notice from us that confirms your disability rating (the rating that measures the severity of your disability), you may be able to get disability compensation or benefits. Find out what benefits you can get.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Disability compensation may include financial compensation (payments) as well as other benefits like health care or job training.
source_blocks.text: Disability compensation may include financial compensation (payments) as well as other benefits like health care or job training.

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you haven t gotten your decision notice:
source_blocks.text: If you haven t gotten your decision notice:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Check your status, or Contact your nearest VA regional benefit office, or Call us at 800-827-1000, or Contact us online
source_blocks.text: Check your status, or Contact your nearest VA regional benefit office, or Call us at 800-827-1000, or Contact us online

source_blocks.source_text_en: When will I get my first payment?
source_blocks.text: When will I get my first payment?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If your decision notice shows at least a 10% disability rating, you ll get your first payment within 15 days. We ll pay you either by direct deposit or check. If you don t get a payment after 15 days, please call the Veterans help line at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.

If you don t get a payment after 15 days, please call the Veterans help line at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I disagree with my disability rating?
source_blocks.text: What if I disagree with my disability rating?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you disagree with your disability rating, you can file an appeal. You ll need to do this within 1 year of getting your decision notice. Learn about how to file an appeal
source_blocks.text: If you disagree with your disability rating, you can file an appeal. You ll need to do this within 1 year of getting your decision notice. Learn about how to file an appeal

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get other benefits?
source_blocks.text: How do I get other benefits?

source_blocks.source_text_en: For health care: If you served on active duty and didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, you may be able to get VA health care. This includes access to VA doctors and care, plus medical equipment, prosthetics, and prescriptions. Apply for VA health care For life insurance: If you re in good health other than your disability caused by service in the military, you can buy Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance (S-DVI) a government life insurance policy.Apply for S-DVI online. Or, call 800-669-8477, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET. For education benefits: You can get VA support for college or job training under special programs. Or, talk with a VA education counselor to find out what benefits you may be able to get. Learn about education benefits For dependent benefits: If you re 30% or more disabled due to a disability caused by service in the military, you can get financial support and benefits for your qualified dependents.Learn more about adding dependents to your disability benefits For other benefits: Check with your local or state VA offices for other benefits you may be able to get like help with buying a home or making changes to your home to make it more accessible, or help with getting a job. Find your state s Veterans Affairs website

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get benefits that cover specific disabilities?
source_blocks.text: How do I get benefits that cover specific disabilities?

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have a 100% disability rating, you may be able to get: - Dental care, and - Access to commissaries and exchanges If you can t work due to your disability caused by service in the military even without a 100% rating you can apply for Individual Unemployability. Learn about Individual Unemployability If you need special clothing because of your injuries, you may be able to get money to buy new clothes. Learn about the annual clothing allowance benefit

source_blocks.source_text_en: Keep in touch
source_blocks.text: Keep in touch

source_blocks.source_text_en: It s important to update your information with VA when you have a new address, a change to your marital status, or any other life change that could affect your rating or payment. If your disability gets worse, you can file a claim for an increase in benefits.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where you'll go for care
source_blocks.text: Where you'll go for care

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you sign up for VA health care, you become part of the country s largest integrated health care system with more than 1,200 care locations serving nearly 9 million Veterans each year. Learn more about where you ll get care.
source_blocks.text: When you sign up for VA health care, you become part of the country s largest integrated health care system with more than 1,200 care locations serving nearly 9 million Veterans each year. Learn more about where you ll get care.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where do I go for care?
source_blocks.text: Where do I go for care?

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll receive regular care at one VA location of your choice. If you need specialized medical treatments and services, we may refer you to other locations as well. Your health care team will use our electronic medical record system to coordinate your care no matter where you are.
source_blocks.text: You ll receive regular care at one VA location of your choice. If you need specialized medical treatments and services, we may refer you to other locations as well. Your health care team will use our electronic medical record system to coordinate your care no matter where you are.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Care settings may include:
source_blocks.text: Care settings may include:

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA medical centers. These centers offer a range of services: - All centers provide traditional hospital-based services like surgery, critical care, mental health, and physical therapy. - Most centers provide medical and surgical specialty services like oncology (cancer care), geriatrics (elder care), and neurology (care for conditions of the brain and nervous system). - Some medical centers also offer advanced services like organ transplants and plastic surgery (reconstructing or repairing parts of the body in the treatment of traumatic injury).Find a medical center near you VA community-based outpatient clinics (CBOCs). These clinics provide the most common outpatient services (like health and wellness visits) so you can take care of routine appointments in a more convenient location. We keep expanding our network of CBOCs to more rural locations so we can help you access care closer to home.Find a clinic near you Vet Centers. These centers provide community-based counseling, outreach, and referral services to Veterans who served in a combat zone as well as to their families. Mobile Vet Centers also help bring care to more rural locations.Learn more about Vet CentersFind a Vet Center near you VA Community Living Centers and other assisted living or residential (live-in) settings. These places provide support for Veterans who need more intense nursing care and help with everyday tasks (like bathing, dressing, or taking medicines).Learn more about assisted living and residential care Your own home. These places provide support for Veterans who need more intense nursing care and help with everyday tasks (like bathing, dressing, or taking medicines).Learn more about assisted living and residential care Your own home. If needed, you may get medical treatment, nursing care, or help with everyday tasks in the comfort of your own home.Learn more about home health care

source_blocks.text: 女性退伍军人的医疗保健需求 | Veterans Affairs

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA women s health services
source_blocks.text: VA 女性健康服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: As a woman Veteran, you re part of the fastest-growing group within our Veteran population. And we re dedicated to meeting your health care needs. If you qualify for VA health care, you can get access to high-quality women s health services as part of your benefits. Find out more about how to access these services below.
source_blocks.text: 作为女性退伍军人，您是退伍军人群体中增长最快的一部分。我们致力于满足您的医疗保健需求。如果您符合 VA 医疗保健的资格，您可以作为福利的一部分获得高质量的女性健康服务。以下了解更多关于如何获取这些服务的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What women s health services does VA provide?
source_blocks.text: VA 提供哪些女性健康服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: We provide primary care services, including:
source_blocks.text: 我们提供初级保健服务，包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: General services, like disease prevention and nutrition counseling Female-specific services, like birth control, preconception counseling, and menopausal support (hormone replacement therapy) Screenings, like cervical cancer screens (Pap smears) and breast cancer screens (mammograms) Mental health services for depression, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and substance use problems.Learn more about mental health services Free, confidential (private) counseling and treatment for mental and physical health conditions related to military sexual trauma (MST).Learn more about services for MST
source_blocks.text: 一般服务，如疾病预防和营养咨询 女性专属服务，如节育、孕前咨询和更年期支持（激素替代疗法） 筛查，如宫颈癌筛查（巴氏涂片）和乳腺癌筛查（乳腺X光检查） 针对抑郁症、创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和物质使用问题的心理健康服务。了解更多关于心理健康服务的信息 针对与军事性创伤（MST）相关的心理和身体健康状况提供免费、保密（私人）咨询和治疗。了解更多关于 MST 服务的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also provide specialty services, including:
source_blocks.text: 我们还提供专科服务，包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Screening and management of chronic (long-lasting) conditions, like heart disease and diabetes Screening and management of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) like HIV/AIDS and hepatitis Maternity care and other reproductive health services Treatment for sexual problems, urinary incontinence, and other issues Prosthetic and sensory aid (PSA) services, like prosthetic limbs, hearing aids, and post-mastectomy items.Download our fact sheet on prosthetic and sensory services for women Veterans (PDF) Referrals for physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language therapy, and other rehabilitation therapies Homebound and long-term care for those who meet specific requirements
source_blocks.text: 慢性（长期）疾病的筛查和管理，如心脏病和糖尿病 性传播疾病（STD）的筛查和管理，如 HIV/AIDS 和肝炎 产妇护理和其他生殖健康服务 性问题、尿失禁和其他问题的治疗 假肢和感官辅助（PSA）服务，如假肢、助听器和乳房切除术后用品。下载我们关于女性退伍军人假肢和感官服务的概况介绍（PDF） 转诊至物理治疗、职业治疗、言语语言治疗和其他康复治疗 为符合特定要求的人提供居家和长期护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Please note that we cannot, by law, provide abortion services.
source_blocks.text: 请注意，根据法律，我们不能提供堕胎服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Through legislation announced January 19, 2017, we are expanding our fertility services to include counseling and treatment using assisted reproductive technologies including in vitro fertilization (IVF). These services will be available to Veterans and spouses of Veterans who have a service-connected disability that makes it impossible for them to have a baby without the help of fertility treatment. Veterans can begin scheduling appointments to find out if they qualify and to get a clinical exam, consultation, and initial treatment as we work to build the program s structure.Learn more about the recent changes in IVF coverage
source_blocks.text: 通过 2017 年 1 月 19 日宣布的立法，我们正在扩大生育服务，包括使用辅助生殖技术（包括体外受精（IVF））的咨询和治疗。这些服务将提供给因与服务相关的残疾而无法在没有生育治疗帮助的情况下生育的退伍军人及其配偶。退伍军人可以开始预约，以确定他们是否符合资格，并获得临床检查、咨询和初步治疗，同时我们正在努力构建该项目的结构。了解更多关于 IVF 覆盖范围近期变化的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Telephone care
source_blocks.text: 电话护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a woman Veteran and you re currently signed up for VA health care, you can reach a VA health care provider at your local VA medical center by phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This provider will answer questions and give you advice on health concerns. If you re currently signed up for VA health care, contact your VA medical center and ask for the provider s phone number.Find a VA medical center near you
source_blocks.text: 如果您是女性退伍军人，并且目前已注册 VA 医疗保健，您可以每周 7 天、每天 24 小时通过电话联系当地 VA 医疗中心的 VA 医疗保健提供者。该提供者将回答问题并就健康问题提供建议。如果您目前已注册 VA 医疗保健，请联系您的 VA 医疗中心并索取提供者的电话号码。查找您附近的 VA 医疗中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: Programs for specific groups of women
source_blocks.text: 针对特定女性群体的项目

source_blocks.source_text_en: We provide services for:
source_blocks.text: 我们为以下人群提供服务：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Women Veterans who are homeless Victims of intimate partner violence
source_blocks.text: 无家可归的女性退伍军人 亲密伴侣暴力的受害者

source_blocks.source_text_en: Women Veterans who want:
source_blocks.text: 想要以下服务的女性退伍军人：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Education and training Employment help Vocational rehabilitation (job training)
source_blocks.text: 教育和培训 就业帮助 职业康复（职业培训）

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I access women s health care services through VA?
source_blocks.text: 如何通过 VA 获取女性医疗保健服务？

source_blocks.source_text_en: The VA health care program covers women s health services. To access these services, first apply for VA health care.Apply for VA health care
source_blocks.text: VA健康护理计划涵盖女性健康服务。要获取这些服务，首先申请VA健康护理。申请VA健康护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once you ve signed up:
source_blocks.text: 一旦您注册：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Talk to your primary care provider, who will connect you with any services you may need, or Contact the Women Veterans Program Manager at your local VA medical center. She will help coordinate all the services you may need from primary care to specialized care for chronic (long-lasting) conditions or reproductive health. To connect with your local Women Veterans Program Manager: - Contact your local medical center and ask for the Women Veterans Program Manager (find a VA medical center near you), or - Call our Women Veterans Call Center at 855-829-6636, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET, and Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET, and we ll connect you with your local manager. - Chat online with a trained Women Veterans Call Center representative Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET. This chat function is private and anonymous. Please don t include any personal information, like your Social Security number.Start a chat with the Women Veterans Call Center
source_blocks.text: 与您的初级保健提供者交谈，他们会为您联系可能需要的任何服务，或 联系您当地VA医疗中心的女性退伍军人项目经理。她将帮助协调您可能需要的所有服务，从初级保健到慢性（长期）疾病或生殖健康的专科护理。要联系您当地的女性退伍军人项目经理： - 联系您当地的医疗中心并询问女性退伍军人项目经理（查找附近的VA医疗中心），或 - 拨打我们的女性退伍军人呼叫中心电话855-829-6636，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上10:00，周六上午8:00至下午6:30，我们将为您联系当地经理。 - 周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上10:00，与经过培训的女性退伍军人呼叫中心代表在线聊天。此聊天功能私密且匿名。请不要包含任何个人信息，如您的社会安全号码。与女性退伍军人呼叫中心开始聊天

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can also look for women s health services specific to your nearest VA medical center. To do this, go to the website of the VA health care system that the medical center is part of. In the page s navigation, click on Health Care Services. A submenu will appear. Select Women Veterans. Find your medical center s website
source_blocks.text: 您还可以查找您最近的VA医疗中心特有的女性健康服务。为此，请访问该医疗中心所属的VA医疗保健系统的网站。在页面导航中，点击Health Care Services。将出现一个子菜单。选择Women Veterans。查找您医疗中心的网站

source_blocks.source_text_en: What if I don t have VA health care benefits?
source_blocks.text: 如果我没有VA健康护理福利怎么办？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don t have VA health care benefits, you may still be able to get care:
source_blocks.text: 如果您没有VA健康护理福利，您可能仍然能够获得护理：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re not sure what health benefits you may have earned, contact our Women Veterans Call Center. Our trained, all-female staff will help you figure out your benefits and take the next step to getting care. Call 855-829-6636. Or, start a secure chat. If you ve served in a combat zone, get free private counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless: - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential. - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center
source_blocks.text: 如果您不确定自己可能获得了哪些健康福利，请联系我们的女性退伍军人呼叫中心。我们训练有素的全女性员工将帮助您了解您的福利并采取下一步获得护理。请拨打855-829-6636。或者，开始安全聊天。 如果您曾在战区服役，请在我们的300个社区Vet Centers之一获得免费私人咨询、酒精和药物评估以及其他支持。查找附近的Vet Center 如果您无家可归或有成为无家可归的风险： - 访问我们的网站，了解针对无家可归退伍军人的VA项目。了解我们的无家可归项目 - 拨打全国无家可归退伍军人呼叫中心电话877-424-3838，每周7天、每天24小时获得帮助。训练有素的VA顾问将提供有关VA无家可归项目、医疗保健以及您所在地区其他服务的信息。电话免费且保密。 - 致电或访问您当地的VA社区资源和转介中心。即使您不符合VA健康护理资格，我们的员工也可以帮助您找到您所在社区中您可能符合资格的非VA资源。查找您当地的社区资源和转介中心

source_blocks.source_text_en: How can I get help related to sexual trauma?
source_blocks.text: 如何获得与性创伤相关的帮助？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re a Veteran who has experienced MST, you can get help through VA. You don t need to have a service-connected disability rating, and you may be able to get MST-related care even if you don t qualify for other VA services. You also don t need to have reported the MST or have other proof that it happened.Learn more about support for MST
source_blocks.text: 如果您是经历过MST的退伍军人，您可以通过VA获得帮助。您不需要有服务相关的残疾评级，即使您不符合其他VA服务的资格，您也可能能够获得与MST相关的护理。您也不需要报告过MST或有其他证据证明它发生过。了解更多关于MST的支持

source_blocks.source_text_en: Where can I find more information and support?
source_blocks.text: 我在哪里可以找到更多信息和支持？

source_blocks.source_text_en: Our women s health website gives you the latest information about how we help women Veterans stay well.Visit the women s health website Our Center for Women Veterans website tells you about health care and other benefits and programs for women Veterans.Visit the Center for Women Veterans website Our Women Veterans Call Center representatives can help you understand your VA benefits and find the right services to fit your needs. Get free, confidential guidance. Call the Center at 855-829-6636, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET, and Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET.
source_blocks.text: 我们的女性健康网站为您提供我们如何帮助女性退伍军人保持健康的最新信息。访问女性健康网站 我们的女性退伍军人中心网站告诉您有关女性退伍军人的医疗保健和其他福利及项目。访问女性退伍军人中心网站 我们的女性退伍军人呼叫中心代表可以帮助您了解您的VA福利并找到适合您需求的正确服务。获得免费、保密的指导。请拨打中心电话855-829-6636，周一至周五，东部时间上午8:00至晚上10:00，周六上午8:00至下午6:30。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work Study | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 工作学习 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Work study
source_blocks.text: 工作学习

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how our Veterans work-study program can help you earn money while you re enrolled in a college, a vocational school, or professional training program.
source_blocks.text: 了解我们的退伍军人工作学习项目如何帮助你在大学、职业学校或专业培训项目就读期间赚钱。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I take part in the Veterans work-study program?
source_blocks.text: 我可以参加退伍军人工作学习项目吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can take part in our work-study program if you meet all of the requirements listed below.
source_blocks.text: 如果你满足以下所有要求，就可以参加我们的工作学习项目。

source_blocks.source_text_en: All of these must be true. You:
source_blocks.text: 以下所有条件都必须满足。你：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Are enrolled at least three-quarter time in a college degree, vocational, or professional program, and Have found an open job either at a nearby VA facility or in a VA-related role at your school, and Can finish the work-study contract while you still qualify for education benefits, and Are using an approved VA education benefits program to pay for your education or training
source_blocks.text: 至少以四分之三学时注册于大学学位、职业或专业项目，并且 已在附近的 VA 机构或你所在学校的 VA 相关岗位找到空缺职位，并且 能在仍有资格享受教育福利期间完成工作学习合同，并且 正在使用经批准的 VA 教育福利项目支付你的教育或培训费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Approved VA education benefits programs include:
source_blocks.text: 经批准的 VA 教育福利项目包括：

source_blocks.source_text_en: Post-9/11 GI Bill for Veterans Post-9/11 GI Bill for family members using transferred benefits Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve (MGIB-SR) Veterans Educational Assistance Program (VEAP) Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) (Note: Dependents who qualify under 38 U.S.C. Chapter 35 may use work study only while enrolled at a school in one of the 50 states.) National Call to Service Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment
source_blocks.text: 退伍军人后 9/11 GI Bill 使用转移福利的家庭成员的后 9/11 GI Bill Montgomery GI Bill 现役 (MGIB-AD) Montgomery GI Bill 精选预备役 (MGIB-SR) 退伍军人教育援助项目 (VEAP) 幸存者和家属教育援助 (DEA)（注意：根据 38 U.S.C. 第 35 章符合条件的家属只能在 50 个州之一的学校就读时使用工作学习。） 国家召唤服役 职业康复与就业

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of benefits can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得什么类型的福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get paid to work a part-time job while you study.
source_blocks.text: 你可以在学习期间从事兼职工作并获得报酬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How do I get these benefits?
source_blocks.text: 我如何获得这些福利？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to apply for the work-study program by filling out an Application for Work-Study Allowance (VA Form 22-8691). Download VA Form 22-8691 (PDF)
source_blocks.text: 你需要填写《工作学习津贴申请表》（VA 表格 22-8691）来申请工作学习项目。下载 VA 表格 22-8691 (PDF)

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have any questions about the program, contact the VA regional processing office that handles your claim. Contact your VA regional processing office
source_blocks.text: 如果你对该项目有任何疑问，请联系处理你索赔的 VA 地区处理办公室。联系你的 VA 地区处理办公室

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you have questions about other sources of financial assistance, contact your school s financial aid office.
source_blocks.text: 如果你对其他经济援助来源有疑问，请联系你学校的财务援助办公室。

source_blocks.source_text_en: What kind of job can I get?
source_blocks.text: 我能获得什么样的工作？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get a job that s related to VA work, meets your interests, and fills a need.
source_blocks.text: 你可以获得与 VA 工作相关、符合你兴趣并满足需求的工作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example, you can work for a:
source_blocks.text: 例如，你可以为以下机构工作：

source_blocks.source_text_en: VA facility Department of Defense, Coast Guard, or National Guard location that oversees MGIB-SR or REAP State Veterans agency to help Veterans get Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment benefits Center of Excellence for Veteran Student Success to support the academic, financial, physical, and social needs of Veteran students Cooperative program that we run together with a college, university, or other institution of higher learning College, university, or other institution of higher learning in any Veteran-related role. For example, you could help Veteran students with general questions about Veteran benefits, process documents for Veterans, or maintain and organize Veteran-related files.
source_blocks.text: VA机构 负责监督MGIB-SR或REAP的国防部、海岸警卫队或国民警卫队地点 州退伍军人事务机构，帮助退伍军人获得职业康复与就业福利 退伍军人学生成功卓越中心，支持退伍军人学生的学术、财务、身体和社交需求 我们与学院、大学或其他高等教育机构共同开展的合作项目 学院、大学或其他高等教育机构中任何与退伍军人相关的角色。例如，你可以帮助退伍军人学生解答关于退伍军人福利的一般问题，为退伍军人处理文件，或维护和组织与退伍军人相关的档案。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How much will I earn?
source_blocks.text: 我能赚多少钱？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll earn an hourly wage that s the same as the federal minimum wage or your state minimum wage, whichever is greater. If your school usually pays students more for the job you re doing, they may pay you the difference between the amount we pay and their usual rate.
source_blocks.text: 你将获得时薪，金额等于联邦最低工资或州最低工资，以较高者为准。如果你的学校通常为类似工作支付更高的工资，他们可能会支付我们支付的金额与他们通常费率之间的差额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How will I get paid?
source_blocks.text: 我将如何获得报酬？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may elect to be paid in advance for 40% of the hours in your work-study agreement, or for 50 hours, whichever is fewer. After you ve worked the hours covered by your first payment, we ll pay you each time you finish 50 hours of service or every other week, whichever comes first.
source_blocks.text: 你可以选择预先获得工作学习协议中40%小时数的报酬，或50小时的报酬，以较少者为准。在你完成首次付款覆盖的工作小时后，我们将在你每完成50小时服务或每隔一周（以先到者为准）支付你报酬。

source_blocks.source_text_en: When and how much can I work?
source_blocks.text: 我何时可以工作，工作多少小时？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can work during or between enrollment periods.
source_blocks.text: 你可以在注册期间或注册间隙工作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can t work more hours total than 25 times the number of weeks in your enrollment period.
source_blocks.text: 你的总工作小时数不能超过注册期间周数的25倍。

source_blocks.source_text_en: For example: If you re enrolled for a semester that lasts for 15 weeks, you can work up to 375 hours for that enrollment period.
source_blocks.text: 例如：如果你注册了一个为期15周的学期，那么该注册期间你最多可以工作375小时。
