source_blocks.source_text_en: Your Health Care Costs | Veterans Affairs
source_blocks.text: 您的医疗保健费用 | 退伍军人事务部

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your health care costs
source_blocks.text: 您的医疗保健费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: We're committed to providing free health care for conditions related to military service and for Veterans with catastrophic disabilities and disability ratings of at least 50%, as well as for those who can't afford to pay for care. Learn more about how we'll determine if you'll need to pay for any part of your care.
source_blocks.text: 我们致力于为与兵役相关的疾病以及患有灾难性残疾和残疾评级至少为50%的退伍军人，以及那些无力支付医疗费用的人提供免费医疗保健。了解更多关于我们将如何确定您是否需要支付部分护理费用的信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Understanding VA health care costs
source_blocks.text: 了解VA医疗保健费用

source_blocks.source_text_en: Can I get free VA health care as a Veteran?
source_blocks.text: 作为退伍军人，我能获得免费的VA医疗保健吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can get free VA health care for any illness or injury that we determine is related to your military service (called "service connected").
source_blocks.text: 您可以获得免费的VA医疗保健，用于我们确定与您的兵役相关的任何疾病或伤害（称为“服役相关”）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We also provide certain other services for free. These include readjustment counseling and related mental health services, care for issues related to military sexual trauma (MST), and a registry health exam to determine if you're at risk of health problems linked to your military service.
source_blocks.text: 我们还免费提供某些其他服务。这些包括重新调整咨询和相关心理健康服务、与军事性创伤（MST）相关问题的护理，以及注册健康检查，以确定您是否面临与兵役相关的健康问题的风险。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Find out how to get mental health care
source_blocks.text: 了解如何获得心理健康护理

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about services for military sexual trauma
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于军事性创伤的服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: Explore health issues related to service history
source_blocks.text: 探索与服务历史相关的健康问题

source_blocks.source_text_en: View more services we provide at no cost
source_blocks.text: 查看更多我们免费提供的服务

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may qualify for additional free VA health care depending on your income, disability rating, or other special eligibility factors. Keep reading below to learn more.
source_blocks.text: 根据您的收入、残疾评级或其他特殊资格因素，您可能有资格获得额外的免费VA医疗保健。请继续阅读下文以了解更多信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Will I need to pay for any of my care, tests, or medications?
source_blocks.text: 我需要为我的部分护理、检查或药物付费吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You may need to pay a fixed amount for some types of care, tests, and medications you receive from a VA health care provider or an approved community health care provider to treat conditions not related to your service. This is called a copay (short for "copayment").
source_blocks.text: 对于某些类型的护理、检查和药物，您可能需要支付固定金额，这些服务由VA医疗保健提供者或批准的社区医疗保健提供者提供，用于治疗与您的服役无关的疾病。这称为共付额（“copayment”的缩写）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Whether or not you'll need to pay copays and how much you'll pay depends on your disability rating, income level, military service record, and which of our 8 priority groups we assign you to when you enroll in VA health care. For example, if you have a service-connected condition that we've rated at 50% or more disabling or that we've determined makes you unable to work (called unemployable), or if you've received a Medal of Honor, we'll assign you to priority group 1 and you won't pay copays for any types of care, tests, or medications.
source_blocks.text: 您是否需要支付共付额以及支付多少取决于您的残疾评级、收入水平、兵役记录，以及您在注册VA医疗保健时我们为您分配的8个优先组中的哪一个。例如，如果您有服役相关疾病，我们评定为50%或以上残疾，或我们确定使您无法工作（称为不可就业），或者您获得了荣誉勋章，我们将您分配到优先组1，您将无需为任何类型的护理、检查或药物支付共付额。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about priority groups
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于优先组的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: View current copay rates
source_blocks.text: 查看当前共付额费率

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you haven't applied for VA health care yet, you can review VA health care eligibility requirements or use our Health Benefits Explorer tool to see what your copays may be if you enroll.
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未申请VA医疗保健，您可以查看VA医疗保健资格要求，或使用我们的健康福利探索工具，了解如果您注册，您的共付额可能是什么。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VA health care eligibility requirements
source_blocks.text: 详细了解VA医疗保健资格要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: Go to the Health Benefits Explorer
source_blocks.text: 前往健康福利探索器

source_blocks.source_text_en: For more information, watch our Veteran copayments video (YouTube).
source_blocks.text: 如需更多信息，请观看我们的退伍军人共付额视频（YouTube）。

source_blocks.source_text_en: How we assess and verify your income to determine eligibility and copays
source_blocks.text: 我们如何评估和核实您的收入以确定资格和共付额

source_blocks.source_text_en: How does VA determine whether I'll need to pay copays based on my income?
source_blocks.text: VA如何根据我的收入确定我是否需要支付共付额？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you're not already receiving VA disability compensation or pension payments, or don't have special eligibility factors (like receiving the Medal of Honor), we'll ask for information about your income as part of our health care enrollment process. This is called an income assessment or financial assessment (formerly known as a means test). We re required by law to collect this information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您尚未领取VA残疾补偿或养老金，或没有特殊资格因素（如获得荣誉勋章），我们将在医疗保健注册过程中要求您提供收入信息。这称为收入评估或财务评估（以前称为经济状况调查）。法律要求我们收集此信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We use your income information to help determine:
source_blocks.text: 我们使用您的收入信息来帮助确定：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you re eligible for VA health care based on your income, and Whether you ll need to pay copays for certain types of care or medications
source_blocks.text: 您是否有资格根据收入获得VA医疗保健，以及 您是否需要为某些类型的护理或药物支付共付额

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about applying for VA health care
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于申请VA医疗保健的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: Do I have to provide this information?
source_blocks.text: 我必须提供这些信息吗？

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you qualify for VA health care enhanced eligibility status, you won't need to provide your income information.
source_blocks.text: 如果您符合VA医疗保健增强资格状态，则无需提供您的收入信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: View the requirements for enhanced eligibility status
source_blocks.text: 查看增强资格状态的要求

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't qualify for enhanced eligibility status, but you agree to pay copays for your care, you don't have to provide your financial information. But if you don't, we may decline your enrollment. We also won't be able to consider your eligibility for free medications or beneficiary travel pay.
source_blocks.text: 如果您不符合增强资格状态，但同意为您的护理支付共付额，则无需提供您的财务信息。但如果您不提供，我们可能会拒绝您的注册。我们也无法考虑您是否有资格获得免费药物或受益人旅行补助。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Read more about providing financial information if:
source_blocks.text: 在以下情况下，请阅读更多关于提供财务信息的信息：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you served in combat after the Gulf War or in combat against a hostile force after November 11, 1998, you don't have to provide your income to qualify for 5 years of free VA health care for any illness that may be related to your military service.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在海湾战争后服役，或在1998年11月11日之后与敌对势力作战，您无需提供收入即可获得5年免费VA医疗保健，用于可能与您的兵役相关的任何疾病。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can still provide your income to help us determine if you re eligible for a higher priority group, beneficiary travel pay, or free care for conditions not related to your service.
source_blocks.text: 您仍然可以提供您的收入，以帮助我们确定您是否有资格获得更高的优先组、受益人旅行补助或与您的服役无关的疾病的免费护理。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about VA health care for returning service members
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于返回服役人员的VA医疗保健信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you were exposed to Agent Orange in or near Vietnam, ionizing radiation in certain service locations or jobs, or environmental contaminants in the Persian Gulf, you don't have to provide your income information to qualify for free care related to your exposure.
source_blocks.text: 如果您在越南境内或附近接触过橙剂，在某些服役地点或工作中接触过电离辐射，或在波斯湾接触过环境污染物，您无需提供收入信息即可获得与您的暴露相关的免费护理资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: You can still provide your income to help us determine if you re eligible for a higher priority group, beneficiary travel pay, or free care for conditions not related to your service.
source_blocks.text: 您仍然可以提供您的收入信息，以帮助我们确定您是否符合更高优先级群体、受益人差旅费或与您的服役无关的疾病的免费护理资格。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn more about hazardous exposures
source_blocks.text: 了解更多关于有害暴露的信息

source_blocks.source_text_en: What information do I need to provide?
source_blocks.text: 我需要提供哪些信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: You ll need to provide your gross household income for the previous year. So if you re applying for health care in 2019, you ll need to provide your gross household income for 2018.
source_blocks.text: 您需要提供上一年的家庭总毛收入。因此，如果您在2019年申请医疗保健，您需要提供2018年的家庭总毛收入。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your gross household income means the total amount of money you and anyone living with you in your home earned within one calendar year, before taxes. This includes your income from work as well as any other sources, like money you may have taken from a retirement fund or income from the sale of a house. If you have a spouse, partner, or dependent child who also contributes income to your family, you ll need to include this income in your application.
source_blocks.text: 您的家庭总毛收入是指您和与您同住的任何人在一个日历年内、税前赚取的总金额。这包括您的工作收入以及任何其他来源，例如您可能从退休基金中取出的资金或出售房屋所得的收入。如果您有配偶、伴侣或受抚养子女也为您的家庭贡献收入，您需要在申请中包含这笔收入。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Does VA verify the information I provide?
source_blocks.text: VA是否会核实我提供的信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on your situation. If the information you provide shows that your income falls below our limits and qualifies you for free VA health care, medications, or both, we re required by law to verify the information. We do this by confirming your information with the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and the Social Security Administration (SSA).
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您的情况。如果您提供的信息显示您的收入低于我们的限额，并使您有资格获得免费的VA医疗保健、药物或两者，法律要求我们核实这些信息。我们通过与国内税务局（IRS）和社会保障局（SSA）确认您的信息来做到这一点。

source_blocks.source_text_en: View our current income limits
source_blocks.text: 查看我们当前的收入限额

source_blocks.source_text_en: Because of tax deadlines, we usually begin this process in July, the year after you report your income. So, for example, if you provide information for the year 2018, we ll verify it in July of 2019.
source_blocks.text: 由于纳税截止日期，我们通常会在您报告收入后的次年7月开始此过程。因此，例如，如果您提供2018年的信息，我们将在2019年7月进行核实。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If the information we receive from the IRS and the SSA shows that you have income above our limits, we ll send a letter notifying you (and your spouse or partner if their income is part of your household income). You ll have the chance to dispute (formally express your disagreement with) this information. You can also send documents showing you have additional deductible expenses that we should consider.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们从IRS和SSA收到的信息显示您的收入高于我们的限额，我们将发送一封信函通知您（以及您的配偶或伴侣，如果他们的收入是您家庭收入的一部分）。您将有机会对这些信息提出异议（正式表达您的不同意）。您也可以发送文件，显示我们有应考虑的额外可扣除费用。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you don't respond to our letter:
source_blocks.text: 如果您不回复我们的信函：

source_blocks.source_text_en: After 45 days, we ll send you a reminder letter.
source_blocks.text: 45天后，我们将向您发送一封提醒信。

source_blocks.source_text_en: After 75 days, we ll assume the information from the IRS and the SSA is correct. We ll send you a letter to explain the changes in your eligibility or copay status. We ll also explain how you can appeal our decision.
source_blocks.text: 75天后，我们将假定IRS和SSA的信息是正确的。我们将向您发送一封信函，解释您的资格或共付额状态的变化。我们还将解释您如何对我们的决定提出上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you respond by disputing the information in our letter:
source_blocks.text: 如果您通过异议我们信函中的信息来回复：

source_blocks.source_text_en: When we receive your response, we ll assign an income verification case manager to work with you (and your representative, if you choose to have one). Your case manager will guide you through the process and help you find any authorized deductions that may reduce your total gross household income below our limits. We try to resolve all cases within 75 days.
source_blocks.text: 当我们收到您的回复时，我们将指派一名收入核实案例经理与您（以及您的代表，如果您选择有代表的话）合作。您的案例经理将指导您完成整个过程，并帮助您找到可能将您的家庭总毛收入降至我们限额以下的任何授权扣除。我们努力在75天内解决所有案例。

source_blocks.source_text_en: If our review shows that your income is still above our limits, we ll send you a final letter explaining that you ll need to pay copays for future care as well as for any care you received during the year for which we reviewed your income. We ll also explain how to appeal our decision.
source_blocks.text: 如果我们的审查显示您的收入仍高于我们的限额，我们将向您发送一封最终信函，说明您需要为未来的护理以及我们在审查您收入的那一年您所接受的任何护理支付共付额。我们还将解释如何对我们的决定提出上诉。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Once I m enrolled, do I need to update my income information every year?
source_blocks.text: 一旦我注册，我是否需要每年更新我的收入信息？

source_blocks.source_text_en: This depends on your situation:
source_blocks.text: 这取决于您的情况：

source_blocks.source_text_en: If you completed a financial assessment to find out if you were eligible for cost-free medications or for beneficiary travel pay (but not for free VA health care), you ll need to provide updated income information each year. If we determine you re eligible for free VA health care because your household income is below our income limit, you don t have to provide updated income information each year.
source_blocks.text: 如果您完成了经济状况评估，以确定您是否有资格获得免费药物或受益人旅行补助（但不包括免费的VA医疗保健），您需要每年提供更新的收入信息。 如果我们确定您有资格获得免费的VA医疗保健，因为您的家庭收入低于我们的收入限额，您就不需要每年提供更新的收入信息。

source_blocks.source_text_en: We ll receive your income information from the IRS and the SSA each year to confirm that you re still eligible for free VA health care. We ll contact you only if this information changes your eligibility or copay requirements. If you disagree with the information, you can keep using VA health care services while we review your situation.
source_blocks.text: 我们将每年从IRS和SSA收到您的收入信息，以确认您仍然有资格获得免费的VA医疗保健。只有当这些信息改变您的资格或共付额要求时，我们才会与您联系。如果您不同意这些信息，您可以在我们审查您的情况期间继续使用VA医疗保健服务。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Note: Even when not required, we encourage you to report changes in your income. It's also important to let us know about changes to your personal information (like your address, phone number, dependents, or other health insurance). You can do this any time by using our Health Benefits Update Form (VA Form 10-10EZR).
source_blocks.text: 注意：即使不要求，我们也鼓励您报告收入的变化。同样重要的是，让我们了解您个人信息的变更（如地址、电话号码、受抚养人或其他健康保险）。您可以随时通过我们的健康福利更新表（VA表格10-10EZR）进行此操作。

source_blocks.source_text_en: Learn how to submit your VA Form 10-10EZR
source_blocks.text: 了解如何提交您的VA表格10-10EZR

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your VA primary care provider and PACT team
source_blocks.text: Your VA primary care provider and PACT team

source_blocks.source_text_en: At VA, we take a team approach to health care with you at the center. Research shows this kind of approach leads to better quality care, more satisfied patients, and fewer hospital visits. Find out who will care for you when you become part of the VA health care program.
source_blocks.text: At VA, we take a team approach to health care with you at the center. Research shows this kind of approach leads to better quality care, more satisfied patients, and fewer hospital visits. Find out who will care for you when you become part of the VA health care program.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Who will provide care for me at VA?
source_blocks.text: Who will provide care for me at VA?

source_blocks.source_text_en: After you sign up for VA health care and choose your main VA location, we ll assign you to a health care team called a Patient Aligned Care Team (or PACT). Your team will be made up of you, those who support you (like your family members and caregivers), and your health care providers.
source_blocks.text: After you sign up for VA health care and choose your main VA location, we ll assign you to a health care team called a Patient Aligned Care Team (or PACT). Your team will be made up of you, those who support you (like your family members and caregivers), and your health care providers.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your team will include a:
source_blocks.text: Your team will include a:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Primary care provider (your main doctor, nurse practitioner, or physician s assistant) Clinical pharmacist (a pharmacist who works with you and your primary care provider to make sure you re taking the medicines that are right for you and your overall health) Registered nurse (RN) care manager (a nurse who makes sure your care is coordinated across all providers and services, and meets your health goals and your plan for care) Licensed practical nurse (LPN) or medical assistant and clerk (team members who help to support you and the other health care providers on your team)

source_blocks.source_text_en: When you need other services to meet your goals and needs, your team may call other providers like social workers or specialists to help with your care.

source_blocks.source_text_en: More about your VA care team
source_blocks.text: More about your VA care team

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your team s goal is to plan for all the care you need to help you stay healthy and well throughout your life.
source_blocks.text: Your team s goal is to plan for all the care you need to help you stay healthy and well throughout your life.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your team will:
source_blocks.text: Your team will:

source_blocks.source_text_en: Build a partnership with you. You ll be an active member of the team, and you ll work with your team to plan and make decisions to meet your personal health goals. Your team will offer wellness care, education, and lifestyle coaching to help you stay healthy.
source_blocks.text: Build a partnership with you. You ll be an active member of the team, and you ll work with your team to plan and make decisions to meet your personal health goals. Your team will offer wellness care, education, and lifestyle coaching to help you stay healthy.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Provide or arrange for preventive care, such as immunizations (like flu shots) to prevent illness and screenings to help find diseases like cancer in their earliest stages when treatment is most likely to be successful.
source_blocks.text: Provide or arrange for preventive care, such as immunizations (like flu shots) to prevent illness and screenings to help find diseases like cancer in their earliest stages when treatment is most likely to be successful.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Help you get care in the ways that work best for you. This may include personal visits with your primary care provider, group clinics, and 24/7 telephone care. You can also get online educational information and secure messaging with your health care team through the My HealtheVet portal.Visit My HealtheVet

source_blocks.source_text_en: Coordinate your care. Team members will meet often to talk with you and each other about your progress and goals. And they ll coordinate any care you may need from specialists outside the team.

source_blocks.source_text_en: Your health care team will have a plan in place if your primary care provider is away or leaves VA. Your team will make sure you always have access to a qualified primary care provider and that you keep getting the ongoing care you need to continue with your health care plan.
